title: Spatial Lifting for Dense Prediction
summary: We present Spatial Lifting (SL), a novel methodology for dense prediction tasks. SL operates by lifting standard inputs, such as 2D images, into a higher-dimensional space and subsequently processing them using networks designed for that higher dimension, such as a 3D U-Net. Counterintuitively, this dimensionality lifting allows us to achieve good performance on benchmark tasks compared to conventional approaches, while reducing inference costs and \textbf{drastically lowering the number of model parameters}. The SL framework produces intrinsically structured outputs along the lifted dimension. This emergent structure facilitates dense supervision during training and enables single-forward-pass self-consistency-based quality and uncertainty estimation at test time. Spatial Lifting introduces a simple and general modeling strategy that offers a promising path toward more efficient, accurate, and reliable deep networks for dense prediction tasks in vision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出空间提升(Spatial Lifting, SL)方法，将2D图像等标准输入提升到更高维空间，再用适配该维度的网络(如3D U-Net)处理，从而在稠密预测任务上以更低推理成本、大幅更少的参数取得良好性能。
AI.motivation: 稠密预测任务通常依赖参数量大、推理成本高的深度网络，作者希望探索一种更高效、准确且可靠的建模范式，以降低模型参数与推理代价。
AI.method: 将标准输入(如2D图像)提升(lift)到更高维空间，随后使用为该高维空间设计的网络(如3D U-Net)进行稠密预测。该提升过程会在被提升的维度上产生内在结构化的输出。
AI.result: 对比传统方法，SL在基准任务上仍能达到良好性能，同时显著降低推理成本并大幅减少模型参数；其提升维度上的涌现结构支持训练阶段的稠密监督，并可在测试阶段通过单次前向传播实现基于自洽性的质量与不确定性估计。
AI.conclusion: 空间提升提供了一种简单而通用的建模策略，为视觉稠密预测任务走向更高效、更准确、更可靠的深度网络提供了有前景的路径。

title: Domain generalization and synthetic data in object detection: the enabler, the probe, and the gap
summary: Object detection models often experience performance degradation when deployed under distribution shifts, caused by for example changes in weather type, operational environment, or object appearance. Domain Generalization (DG) aims to develop models that remain robust under such shifts and generalize well to unseen domains. DG research specifically focused on object detection models is scarce, although these models face additional challenges around localization and multi-scale representations. Synthetic data is a promising tool to support in DG, by enabling large-scale generation of diverse new samples. In this paper, we present an object detection-centric review of DG and examine the role of synthetic data from three complementary perspectives. First, synthetic data acts as an enabler of DG through diversification and alignment strategies that aim to improve robustness to distribution shifts. Second, it serves as a probe that enables controlled experimentation to identify and understand failure modes. Third, we discuss the synthetic-to-real gap, a particularly challenging form of domain shift that arises when models trained on synthetic imagery are deployed on real-world data. Through reviewing these perspectives, we identify limitations of current DG approaches for object detection and argue that future research requires representation-aware methods that explicitly address both localization and classification under domain shift.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了面向目标检测的域泛化(DG)研究，并从三个互补视角探讨合成数据的作用：作为DG的赋能手段、作为受控实验的探针，以及合成到真实的域差距问题。
AI.motivation: 目标检测模型在分布偏移（如天气、环境、目标外观变化）下性能下降，而专门针对目标检测的域泛化研究稀缺，且检测还面临定位与多尺度表征等额外挑战；合成数据有望通过大规模生成多样样本来支持域泛化。
AI.method: 采用以目标检测为中心的综述方法，从三个互补视角分析合成数据的角色：(1)通过多样化与对齐策略赋能DG；(2)作为探针开展受控实验以识别和理解失效模式；(3)讨论合成到真实的域差距。
AI.result: 识别出当前目标检测域泛化方法的局限性，指出该领域缺乏对检测特有挑战（定位与分类）的系统性覆盖。
AI.conclusion: 未来研究需要表征感知(representation-aware)的方法，在域偏移下同时显式处理定位与分类问题。

title: Seeing the City or Recognizing the Place? What Street-View Imagery Adds Beyond Existing Urban Data in VLM Urban Sensing
summary: Street-view imagery is increasingly used to infer urban attributes, but predictive accuracy alone does not reveal how much a photograph contributes beyond data already available for the same place. We compare image-based predictions with existing urban data across seven attributes from five public resources and three VLMs. The same urban units are evaluated using images, task context, nearby observations, and public records, while image replacements and conflicting records test source reliance. Existing urban data matched or exceeded image-only models for road damage, curb ramps, and house price, while neighbouring official statistics nearly matched the best image result for population. Images were more informative for building type, building function, and low-rise floor count. For floor count, image advantage increased by 5.7 percentage points per doubling of distance to the nearest labelled building and declined for tall buildings whose rooflines often fell outside the frame. Models frequently followed conflicting records. OpenFACADES floor annotations were generated with OpenStreetMap floor values and showed the opposite height-dependent error pattern from image-only reruns. Street-view image value therefore depends on visual legibility and local data coverage. Comparing images with existing urban data can guide image collection and clarify the provenance of derived urban maps.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较街景图像预测与现有城市数据在七类城市属性上的信息价值，发现图像优势取决于属性类型、视觉可读性、建筑高度及本地数据覆盖度。
AI.motivation: 街景图像被广泛用于推断城市属性，但仅凭预测精度无法判断图像相对于同一地点已有数据是否提供了增量信息。作者希望量化图像的信息贡献，并厘清衍生城市地图的结果来源。
AI.method: 对同一批城市单元，使用图像、任务上下文、邻近观测和公共记录进行比较评估；通过替换图像和设置冲突记录来检验模型对数据来源的依赖；覆盖五类公共资源中的七个属性，并使用三个视觉语言模型（VLM）。
AI.result: 对于道路破损、路缘坡道和房价，现有城市数据达到或超过仅用图像的模型；对于人口，邻近官方统计几乎达到最佳图像结果；对于建筑类型、建筑功能和低层楼层数，图像更有信息量。楼层数方面，距最近有标注建筑的距离每翻倍，图像优势增加5.7个百分点；而高层建筑因屋顶线常在画面外，优势下降。模型在遇到冲突记录时经常跟随记录。OpenFACADES楼层标注由OpenStreetMap楼层值生成，其高度相关误差模式与仅用图像的重复运行相反。
AI.conclusion: 街景图像的价值取决于视觉可读性和本地数据覆盖度；将图像与现有城市数据比较，可指导图像采集并明确衍生城市地图的数据来源。

title: STATERA: Hidden Mass Estimation via Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Kinematics using Frozen Temporal Tubelets
summary: Vision models pretrained for frame-level appearance often struggle to infer hidden physical properties from motion. We study center-of-mass (CoM) localization for opaque, asymmetric rigid bodies from short monocular videos, where surface cues and point tracking are unreliable under self-occlusion. We propose STATERA, which adapts a pretrained video backbone (V-JEPA) with mostly frozen weights and a lightweight temporal tubelet mixer to predict per-frame CoM heatmaps and trajectories. To support this task, we introduce the HiddenMass Benchmark, comprising 50K MuJoCo trajectories and a 63-sequence real-world test set with physically calibrated CoM ground truth. In simulation, STATERA-50K-Sigma improves normalized CoM error from 41.7% (DINOv2) to 25.2%. In zero-shot sim-to-real transfer, we observe a fundamental trade-off in supervision: phase-aware targets can induce bimodal predictions, while phase-agnostic targets can collapse toward statistically safe centroids. Nevertheless, our phase-aware STATERA-50K-Crescent is the only evaluated method that demonstrates consistent movement toward the true hidden offset. While this leads to a monocular vector overshoot artifact that marginally increases absolute Euclidean error compared to a static geometric centroid, it improves physics capture from 2.6% to 41.0%. These results suggest that frozen temporal representations can better separate inertial dynamics from visual geometry for hidden-parameter estimation.

AI.tldr: 提出STATERA，用冻结的V-JEPA视频骨干加轻量时序tubelet mixer，从单目短视频预测不透明非对称刚体的质心，并发布HiddenMass Benchmark；相位感知监督虽带来向量过冲、绝对误差略增，但物理捕获率从2.6%提升至41.0%。
AI.motivation: 视觉模型通常在帧级外观上预训练，难以从运动中推断隐藏的物理属性；在自遮挡条件下，表面线索与点跟踪都不可靠，因此需要研究如何从短单目视频中定位隐藏质心。
AI.method: 提出STATERA：以V-JEPA预训练视频骨干为主、大部分权重冻结，仅接一个轻量时序tubelet mixer，预测逐帧质心热图与轨迹。同时构建HiddenMass Benchmark，含50K条MuJoCo轨迹与63段真实序列（带物理标定的质心真值）。分析相位感知与相位无关两类监督目标。对比基线为DINOv2等。
AI.result: 仿真中STATERA-50K-Sigma将归一化质心误差从DINOv2的41.7%降至25.2%。零样本sim-to-real下存在监督权衡：相位感知目标易致双峰预测，相位无关目标易塌缩到统计安全质心。相位感知的STATERA-50K-Crescent是唯一持续朝真实隐藏偏移移动的方法，虽因单目向量过冲使绝对欧氏误差略高于静态几何质心，但物理捕获率从2.6%提升到41.0%。
AI.conclusion: 冻结的时序表征有助于将惯性动力学与视觉几何分离，从而更好地估计隐藏物理参数；相位感知监督在物理捕获上更具优势，即便牺牲部分绝对定位精度。

title: Emergent Object Binding Has a Finite Spatial Horizon
summary: Pretrained Vision Transformers encode whether two image patches belong to the same object. This IsSameObject signal is decodable from frozen patch embeddings at high accuracy, which suggests that object binding emerges from self-supervised pretraining alone. We show that this single accuracy number hides the structure of the signal. Binding is local: the probability that two patches of the same object are decoded as bound falls off monotonically with the distance between them and levels off at a nonzero floor, a falloff well described by an exponential with a finite length scale. This decay holds across object sizes, across three families of probe, on both ADE20K and COCO, and across DINO and CLIP backbones, which indicates that it is a property of the representation rather than of the decoder. Reading binding as local spatial coherence with a finite range accounts for a set of behaviors that the aggregate score leaves unexplained: binding weakens on large objects, separates distinct objects of the same class less reliably than objects of different classes, and groups object parts with their wholes. It is, by contrast, unaffected by occlusion once object size is controlled. We map each behavior with confounds controlled. As a preliminary observation, the horizon and its floor are organized at different depths in DINOv2 and DINOv3, which we report as suggestive given the small number of layers probed and the confound between the two models.

AI.tldr: 预训练ViT的冻结patch嵌入中可高精度解码出"IsSameObject"信号，但该聚合准确率掩盖了信号的空间结构：对象绑定本质上是有限尺度的局部空间一致性。
AI.motivation: 已有工作表明预训练视觉Transformer的冻结patch嵌入能高精度解码出两个patch是否属于同一对象的信号，并将其解读为对象绑定能力仅靠自监督预训练即可涌现。然而单一的准确率数字掩盖了该信号的内在结构，无法解释绑定在大对象上减弱、同类不同对象区分困难、部分与整体被错误聚合等行为，因此需要刻画绑定的空间结构。
AI.method: 将对象绑定重新定义为具有有限作用范围的局部空间相干性；在ADE20K与COCO数据集上，采用三类探针（probe），针对DINO与CLIP骨干网络，测量同对象两patch被解码为绑定的概率随patch间距离的变化曲线，并拟合指数衰减模型，在控制混淆变量（如对象尺寸、遮挡）的条件下逐一映射各行为表现。
AI.result: 同对象两patch被判定为绑定的概率随距离单调下降，并在非零下限处趋于平稳，该衰减可用具有有限长度尺度的指数函数良好描述；该规律在对象尺寸、三类探针、ADE20K与COCO以及DINO和CLIP骨干上均成立，说明属于表征本身的属性而非解码器特性。以"有限范围的局部空间相干性"解读绑定后，可解释聚合分数无法说明的现象：大对象上绑定减弱、同类不同对象比异类对象更难可靠区分、对象部分易与其整体聚合；而一旦控制对象尺寸，绑定则不受遮挡影响。此外初步观察到DINOv2与DINOv3中"作用范围"与"下限"组织在不同深度，但因探针层数少且两模型存在混淆，仅作为提示性结论。
AI.conclusion: 对象绑定信号并非全局恒定的属性，而是具有有限空间尺度的局部相干性，这一结构性视角统一解释了多种解码行为；单一聚合准确率不足以刻画该信号，需从空间衰减曲线出发理解预训练ViT的表征结构。

title: Encoded but Disconnected: Decomposing Vision-Language Model Failures under a Patching Null
summary: Across three vision-language model architectures (LLaVA-1.5-7B, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, InternVL3-8B), we report a universal negative finding for mid-layer interpretability. On POPE -- the benchmark common to all three -- the mid layers encode the ground-truth answer in 68-91% of errors, yet this signal is not causally active for the final prediction: residual-stream patching yields 0% non-trivial flip at the layer level on all three architectures, and on two of three at the per-head level (Qwen: 0/12,600 patched forwards). The lone exception, InternVL3 layer-20 head-2, is a non-vocab, self-attending head whose effect is localized to that specific head (p < 1e-4). Despite the null, the errors separate operationally into three failure modes -- Perception Failure, Encoded-but-Disconnected, Prior-Override -- learnable above 60% on all three architectures, and the architecture's prior direction predicts which of two interventions elicits a category-specific response. We report these mitigation effects under oracle labels as evidence the categories are mechanistically real, not as a deployable method.

AI.tldr: 在三种视觉语言模型（LLaVA-1.5-7B、Qwen2.5-VL-7B、InternVL3-8B）上，中层表征虽编码正确答案（错误样本中占68-91%），但对最终预测无因果作用：残差流补丁在层级别翻转率均为0%，逐头级别也是两模型为0%（Qwen为0/12,600）。唯一例外是InternVL3第20层第2头（非词表、自注意力头，p<1e-4）。尽管为负结果，错误可操作性地分为三类——感知失败、编码但断连、先验覆盖——在三模型上均以>60%准确率可学习，且模型先验方向可预测两种干预中哪种引发类别特异响应。
AI.motivation: 探究中层可解释性在视觉语言模型中是否具有跨架构的普遍性，检验中层编码的答案信号是否对最终预测具有因果作用，并试图将错误表征为可操作的失败模式。
AI.method: 在三个视觉语言模型架构上，使用残差流补丁（层级别与逐头级别）进行因果干预；以POPE为共同基准测试中层对标准答案的编码率；对错误样本进行失败模式分类并训练分类器；通过模型先验方向预测干预响应。
AI.result: 中层在68-91%的错误样本中编码正确答案，但残差流补丁层级别翻转率为0%（三模型），逐头级别两模型为0%（Qwen 0/12,600）；唯一例外为InternVL3第20层第2头（p<1e-4）。错误可分类为三种失败模式，三模型上分类准确率均超过60%，且先验方向可预测类别特异干预响应。
AI.conclusion: 中层编码的答案信号普遍不具备因果活性，构成跨架构的负结果；然而错误可操作性地区分为三种机制真实的失败模式，为理解与缓解视觉语言模型错误提供新视角，但所述缓解效果基于oracle标签，非可部署方法。

title: DSSR-3D: Decoupled Reasoning for View-Dependent Referring in 3D Gaussians
summary: Recent advances in 3D Gaussian Splatting have enabled open-vocabulary and referring segmentation by distilling semantic knowledge from 2D foundation models into 3D representations. However, existing referring fields embed language features in a globally view-invariant space, making them fundamentally unable to resolve observer-centric spatial relations (e.g., "to the left of") that depend on camera pose. We propose DSSR-3D, an inference-time framework for view-dependent referring segmentation on continuous 3D Gaussian fields, formalized as two interfaces - pose-invariant semantic localization and pose-conditioned spatial reasoning - such that any pair of functions satisfying these constraints yields a valid instantiation, requiring no retraining of the underlying semantic field and no reliance on discrete geometric proxies such as bounding boxes. We instantiate the two interfaces with a temperature-sharpened softmax localization mechanism and a projection-based directional scoring function, fused via a lightweight, training-free step, and show they transfer zero-shot to structurally distinct semantic fields without adaptation. We further propose ViewRef-GS, a benchmark isolating view-dependent segmentation on 3D Gaussian fields, evaluated jointly with an augmented Ref-LERF to provide a comprehensive testbed for viewpoint-dependent spatial grounding. Experiments show consistent gains over existing 3DGS-based referring methods, with no additional training beyond the base semantic field

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的推理期框架DSSR-3D，基于两个接口形式化视角依赖的指代分割，在连续3D高斯场上实现观察者中心空间关系推理，并发布ViewRef-GS基准。
AI.motivation: 现有3DGS指代分割将语言特征嵌入全局视角不变空间，无法处理依赖相机位姿的观察者中心空间关系（如"左边"），且常依赖离散几何代理（如边界框）。
AI.method: 将视角依赖指代分割形式化为两个接口：位姿不变的语义定位与位姿条件化的空间推理，任意满足约束的函数对均可构成有效实例化。具体以实现：温度锐化softmax定位机制 + 基于投影的方向打分函数，经轻量免训练步骤融合；并提供基准ViewRef-GS与增强版Ref-LERF。
AI.result: 相较现有基于3DGS的指代方法取得一致性提升；无需对基础语义场之外的额外训练；可零样本迁移到结构不同的语义场而无需适配。
AI.conclusion: 缓解了视角不变语义嵌入与观察者中心空间关系之间的根本矛盾，为视角依赖的3D高斯指代分割提供了免训练、可迁移的通用框架与评测基准。

title: Reachability Is Not Generalization: Understanding Verb--Noun Decomposition in Assembly Action Recognition
summary: Assembly actions are compositional: they combine a manipulation with a part or tool. In deployment, systems routinely encounter novel combinations of familiar components, yet an atomic action classifier assigns every unseen combination exactly zero probability by construction. The prevailing solution is verb--noun decomposition, which predicts components separately and recombines them to reach unseen actions. While widely adopted, how decomposition generalizes under compositional shift remains poorly understood. We present a systematic analysis of verb--noun decomposition across three assembly datasets (MECCANO, HAViD, and IMPACT). Although decomposition escapes the atomic ceiling, its generalization extends only partially beyond it. Unseen-composition performance remains strongly tied to the co-occurrence structure of the training data, indicating that much of the observed gain arises from interpolation within densely supported regions of the compositional space rather than from unconstrained recombination. Across datasets, failures consistently concentrate on the larger-vocabulary component, and IMPACT's verb-heavy vocabulary reverses the bottleneck from nouns to verbs. We further show that shared-encoder training introduces component entanglement, encouraging reliance on co-occurrence patterns that transfer poorly to unseen compositions and trailing independent recombination by up to $6.0\times$ in harmonic mean. Taken together, these findings explain why decomposition achieves only partial compositional generalization in practice. By identifying primitive support, vocabulary asymmetry, and component entanglement as connected sources of error, we provide a portable diagnostic framework for studying compositional recognition beyond aggregate accuracy. Code: https://github.com/hisalaheiyo/assembly.

AI.tldr: 论文系统分析了装配动作识别中的"动词-名词分解"方法的组合泛化能力，发现其虽然突破原子分类器的上限，但泛化仅部分有效，并识别出三个相互关联的误差来源。
AI.motivation: 装配动作具有组合性（操作+部件/工具），部署时常遇到已知组件的新组合，而原子动作分类器对任何未见过组合赋予零概率。目前主流解决方案是动词-名词分解，但其在组合分布偏移下的泛化机制缺乏深入理解。
AI.method: 在三个装配数据集（MECCANO、HAViD、IMPACT）上对动词-名词分解进行系统性分析，考察其泛化性能与训练数据共现结构的关系、失败模式分布以及共享编码器训练带来的组件纠缠效应。
AI.result: 分解虽突破原子上限，但泛化仅部分超越；未见组合性能强烈依赖训练数据的共现结构，表明增益主要来自密集支持区域的插值而非无约束重组。失败集中在词汇量较大的组件上，IMPACT的动词主导词汇使瓶颈从名词反转为动词。共享编码器训练引入组件纠缠，依赖共现模式，泛化差，调和平均落后独立重组达6.0倍。
AI.conclusion: 分解在实践中只能实现部分组合泛化。通过识别基元支持（primitive support）、词汇不对称（vocabulary asymmetry）和组件纠缠（component entanglement）三个相互关联的误差来源，提供了一个可移植的诊断框架，用于超越聚合精度的组合识别研究。

title: Robust Online Aero-Engine Blade Defect Detection via Dual-Alignment Test-Time Adaptation
comment: This manuscript is Accepted at conference PRCV 2026
summary: Reliable visual inspection is essential for quality assurance in aero-engine blade manufacturing, where defect appearance may vary across production lines, imaging conditions, blade poses, and surface backgrounds. Such domain shifts cause a mismatch between training and deployment data and degrade the reliability of deep defect detectors in online inspection. This problem is particularly challenging because aero-engine blade images usually contain sparse defects, making pseudolabel-based adaptation vulnerable to noisy or missing predictions. To address this issue, we propose Aero-engine Blade Defect Detector (ABDD), an online adaptive detection framework based on test-time adaptation. ABDD introduces a Dual-Alignment Strategy to jointly adapt global visual style and local defect morphology by combining feature-statistics alignment with pseudo-box alignment. To reduce error accumulation from unreliable pseudo labels, an Uncertainty-aware Box Filtering mechanism evaluates pseudo boxes using classification confidence, classification entropy, and localization entropy. In addition, a lightweight Sparse Dilated Mona module enables parameter-efficient delta tuning while limiting source-domain forgetting. ABDD is evaluated on CD-AeBD and HD-AeBD under multiple domain-shift scenarios, with TTA strategies compared under a unified RT-DETR + Swin-T architecture. Experiments show that ABDD consistently improves detection robustness under domain shifts, and its practicality is further validated on an industrial inspection platform.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向航空发动机叶片缺陷检测的在线自适应框架ABDD，通过测试时自适应缓解域偏移，提升检测鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 航空发动机叶片制造中，缺陷外观会随产线、成像条件、叶片姿态和表面背景变化，导致训练与部署数据间存在域偏移，使深度缺陷检测器在线检测可靠性下降。此外，叶片图像缺陷稀疏，基于伪标签的自适应易受噪声或漏检预测影响。
AI.method: 提出ABDD在线自适应检测框架，基于测试时自适应。核心包括：双对齐策略（Dual-Alignment Strategy），结合特征统计对齐与伪框对齐，联合适配全局视觉风格和局部缺陷形态；不确定性感知框过滤机制（Uncertainty-aware Box Filtering），利用分类置信度、分类熵和定位熵评估伪框，减少不可靠伪标签带来的误差累积；轻量级稀疏空洞Mona模块（Sparse Dilated Mona），实现参数高效的增量微调并限制源域遗忘。
AI.result: 在CD-AeBD和HD-AeBD数据集上，于多种域偏移场景下评估，并在统一的RT-DETR + Swin-T架构下比较TTA策略。实验表明ABDD在域偏移下持续提升检测鲁棒性，并在工业检测平台上验证了实用性。
AI.conclusion: ABDD通过双对齐、不确定性感知伪框过滤和高效增量微调，有效缓解叶片缺陷检测中的域偏移问题，具备工业在线检测的实用价值。

title: A Framework for Egocentric and Exocentric Procedural Understanding via Temporal Segmentation and Semantic Abstraction
comment: Accepted for oral and poster presentation at the ACVR Workshop, ECCV 2026. Non-archival abstract; not published in the workshop proceedings. 8 pages, 1 figure
summary: Long-horizon ego/exo data contains rich procedural evidence, but are redundant, noisy, and costly to process or retain. We propose a compact framework that converts continuous multimodal workplace video into a structured Procedural State Memory, implemented as a Work Environment Model (WEM). Inspired by event segmentation theory, we detect boundaries using changes in visual context, location, motion, narration, gaze/object interaction, and optional exocentric workspace evidence, rather than fixed windows or visual novelty alone. Each segment is abstracted into an evidence-linked event card containing actor, interval, location, action, objects/tools, pre/post state, confidence, and provenance. These event cards incrementally update the WEM, enabling compact, auditable documentation and retrieval under on-premise privacy constraints. We instantiate the design with frozen DINOv2 and VJEPA-2 encoders and a local language model, and outline evaluation criteria for segmentation quality, memory compression, retrieval fidelity, and long-horizon QA.

AI.tldr: 提出将长时程多模态工作场所视频转化为结构化"程序状态记忆"（WEM）的紧凑框架，基于事件分割理论检测边界并抽象为可追溯事件卡。
AI.motivation: 长时程自我/外部视角数据蕴含丰富的流程性证据，但冗余、含噪且处理与存储成本高。
AI.method: 受事件分割理论启发，利用视觉情境、位置、运动、叙述、注视/物体交互及可选外部视角工作区证据的变化检测边界（而非固定窗口或单纯视觉新颖性）；将每段抽象为含参与者、时间区间、位置、动作、物体/工具、前后状态、置信度与来源的事件卡；事件卡增量更新WEM。使用冻结的DINOv2与VJEPA-2编码器及本地语言模型实例化，并设计分割质量、记忆压缩、检索保真与长时程QA评估标准。
AI.result: 仅给出设计实例与评估准则的框架设想，摘要未报告实验数据或量化结果。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可在本地隐私约束下实现紧凑、可审计的文档化与检索。

title: DramaAgent: Agentic Storytelling Video Generation
summary: Recent diffusion and autoregressive models have substantially improved text-to-video generation, yet producing coherent long-form story videos with consistent characters and aligned audio remains challenging. Existing methods often suffer from narrative drift, unstable character identity, weak cross-scene continuity, and audio-visual mismatch over extended sequences. We propose DramaAgent, a hierarchical, agentic, and model-agnostic framework for long-form text-to-video-and-audio generation. Rather than improving the underlying video backbone itself, DramaAgent introduces an upper-level control layer that decomposes generation into story planning, persistent character conditioning, scene-wise synthesis, and reflection-guided targeted repair. The framework maintains reusable story and character states across scenes, diagnoses failures such as identity drift, missing scene semantics, temporal discontinuity, and cross-modal mismatch, and repairs problematic clips in a stage-specific manner. Experiments across multiple video generation backbones show that DramaAgent improves long-horizon coherence, character consistency, narrative fidelity, and scene-level audio-visual consistency over direct generation and strong baselines. These results suggest that hierarchical agentic control is a practical direction for controllable long-form audiovisual generation. Code: https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/DramaAgent. Website: https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/DramaAgent.

AI.tldr: DramaAgent 提出一种分层、智能体式、模型无关的上层控制框架，用于长格式文本到视频与音频生成，通过故事规划、角色一致性条件、逐场景合成与反思引导修复，提升长时段连贯性与音画一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散与自回归模型虽显著提升文本到视频生成，但在生成具有一致角色与对齐音频的长篇故事视频时仍面临叙事漂移、角色身份不稳定、跨场景连续性弱、音画不匹配等问题。
AI.method: DramaAgent 不改进底层视频骨干，而是引入上层控制层，将生成分解为故事规划、持久角色条件、逐场景合成与反思引导的定向修复；跨场景维护可复用的故事与角色状态，诊断身份漂移、场景语义缺失、时间不连续与跨模态不匹配等失败，并按阶段修复问题片段。
AI.result: 在多个视频生成骨干上的实验表明，DramaAgent 相较直接生成与强基线，在长时段连贯性、角色一致性、叙事保真度与场景级音画一致性上均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，分层智能体式控制是实现可控长格式音视频生成的可行方向。

title: GPEC: Efficient Pre-LLM Gaussian Process Embedding Correction for Cardiac Video Caption Generation
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown strong potential for video understanding and caption generation, but their performance may decline in specialized medical imaging domains such as echocardiography. This work introduces Gaussian Process Embedding Correction (GPEC), a modular and computationally efficient pre-LLM error-correction method that improves the visual representations used by VideoChat2 for cardiac ultrasound caption generation. GPEC is inserted between the visual projection layer and the language model and learns a residual correction that moves the projected visual representation toward an annotation-guided target. The target is constructed by converting structured video annotations into qualitative attributes, generating a fixed-format reference caption, and mapping it into the language-model embedding space. The correction is modeled using a sparse variational Gaussian Process with inducing points, natural-parameter variational updates, and a block-wise linear kernel, while the original VideoChat2 components remain frozen.The method is evaluated using representation-level, caption-level, content-oriented, and execution-time metrics by comparing the original VideoChat2 with VideoChat2 + GPEC under identical input and reference conditions. Results show improved caption similarity and content alignment after applying the proposed correction. Furthermore, GPEC adds less than 0.05 s of inference-time overhead per video in the evaluated setting. These findings indicate that GPEC can improve caption generation in specialized medical video domains with minimal computational cost, without requiring end-to-end fine-tuning of the pretrained multimodal backbone.

AI.tldr: 提出GPEC（高斯过程嵌入校正），一种模块化、低开销的预LLM纠错方法，插入视觉投影层与语言模型之间，通过稀疏变分高斯过程学习残差校正，提升VideoChat2在心脏超声视频描述生成中的表现。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在视频理解与描述生成上潜力较强，但在超声心动图等专业医学影像领域性能下降。传统做法需端到端微调预训练多模态骨干，代价高且不灵活，因此需要一种模块化、计算高效的纠错方案来改善视觉表征。
AI.method: GPEC位于视觉投影层和语言模型之间，学习一个残差校正将投影后的视觉表征推向由标注引导的目标。目标构建流程：将结构化视频标注转为定性属性，生成固定格式参考描述，再映射到语言模型嵌入空间。校正采用带诱导点的稀疏变分高斯过程建模，使用自然参数变分更新和分块线性核，同时冻结原VideoChat2各组件。
AI.result: 在相同输入与参考条件下对比原始VideoChat2与VideoChat2+GPEC，采用表征级、描述级、内容导向及执行时间等指标评估。结果显示描述相似度与内容对齐度均有提升，且GPEC在评测设置下每段视频推理额外开销不足0.05秒。
AI.conclusion: GPEC能在无需对预训练多模态骨干进行端到端微调的前提下，以极低计算成本改善专业医学视频领域的描述生成质量，体现出模块化纠错方法在特定领域适配中的实用价值。

title: A Low Grounding Score Is Not an Ungrounded Judge: Identifying the Perceptibility Confound in Multimodal Oversight
summary: Model judges now supervise multimodal systems at scale, filtering training data, selecting outputs, and supplying the reward that shapes multimodal reasoning models. Trusting one means first checking that it uses its evidence, and that check is itself worth scrutinizing, so we ask whether a counterfactual probe of visual grounding measures what it claims to. The probe edits the image so the ground truth flips, holds the reasoning trace fixed, and asks whether the verdict follows. We formalize it as the Verdict Grounding Score and show it cannot be read the way such scores are read. A verdict responds only to an edit that reaches the judge's decision-relevant reading, so the score is capped by how perceptible the edit is, and unless editing makes the attribute easier to read, the error is one-sided: the score can only make a judge look less grounded than it is. The practical failure is therefore a false alarm, an auditor discarding a usable overseer. Under assumptions we state, we show this missing quantity is not merely bounded but identified from three quantities the same audit protocol already collects, which makes the false-alarm rate directly measurable rather than merely a concern. Auditing nine judges, we find the predicted ordering holds strictly across our entire primary pool, and the typical judge there acts on only about half of the edits whose attribute it can otherwise resolve. Applying a conservative rejection threshold certifies several cells as false alarms outright, the clearest being a judge that detects the injected error essentially every time while still scoring as if it had not used the image at all. The rule that follows is that an image-side counterfactual score should never be reported alone: a detection probe on the unedited image upper-bounds it, certifies its false alarms, and costs nothing extra to run.

AI.tldr: 本文形式化了用于多模态模型评判者（judge）视觉接地性的反事实探针指标"Verdict Grounding Score"，指出该分数因受编辑可感知性上限约束而存在单侧偏差，会导致误报（把可用的监督者误判为不接地）；作者证明在给定假设下，缺失量可由同一审计流程已采集的三个量识别，从而使误报率可直接测量，并在九个评判者上验证了预测的分数排序及典型评判者仅对约一半可辨属性编辑做出反应的现象。
AI.motivation: 多模态模型评判者已大规模用于筛选训练数据、选择输出并为多模态推理模型提供奖励，因此其可靠性至关重要。检验其是否真正使用视觉证据的常见方法是"反事实探针"：修改图像使真值翻转、保持推理链不变，观察评判结论是否随之改变。但这类分数常被直接解读为接地程度，作者质疑该解读是否成立，即探针是否真的测量了它所声称的东西。
AI.method: 作者将反事实探针形式化为Verdict Grounding Score，分析其性质：结论只对能够到达评判者决策相关读数的编辑做出反应，因此分数受编辑可感知性上限的约束；若编辑未使属性更易读取，则误差是单侧的（只会让评判者显得比实际更不接地）。随后，在明确陈述的假设下，作者证明这一缺失量并非仅有界，而是可由同一审计协议已采集的三个量识别出来。最后在九个评判者上进行实证审计，并施加保守的拒绝阈值以识别误报。
AI.result: 在九个评判者的审计中，预测的分数排序在整个主池中严格成立；典型评判者仅对约一半其本可分辨的属性编辑做出反应。应用保守拒绝阈值后，若干单元被直接判定为误报，最明显的是一个几乎每次都能检测到注入错误的评判者，其得分却显示它完全没有使用图像。探测探针在未编辑图像上的表现给出该分数的上界，可认证误报，且无额外成本。
AI.conclusion: 实用的失败模式是误报——审计者丢弃了本可用的监督者。由于误报率现可基于已有审计数据直接测量而非仅停留在担忧层面，作者提出规则：图像侧反事实分数绝不应单独报告；在未编辑图像上运行的检测探针可为其提供上界、认证误报，且不增加额外成本。

title: Multi-Resolution Feature Fusion U-Net for Magnetic Resonance Imaging Segmentation
summary: The segmentation of anatomical structures in medical images and particularly in MRI scans, is essential for clinical diagnosis and monitoring disease progression. While Deep Learning (DL) architectures, such as U-Net and its extensions are very effective in medical image segmentation tasks, they often struggle with preserving fine-grained details and global contextual information. This is especially challenging for MRI data segmentation, where anatomical structures are characterized by irregular boundaries and variations in shape, contrast, and scale. To address this challenge, we propose a novel DL architecture for MRI segmentation across different anatomical structures. Specifically, the architecture introduces a module, named Multi-Resolution Feature Fusion (MRFF), that can be easily integrated into any U-Net-like architecture. The MRFF is integrated in all levels of an encode-decoder structure, along with attention mechanisms and skip connections to extract features at multiple resolutions, enabling the model to capture both fine-grained details and global contextual information. We evaluate the MRFFU-Net on two publicly available benchmark MRI datasets of different anatomical targets; one for Cerebrospinal Fluid (CSF) segmentation in spinal MR scans, and one for left atrium cardiac segmentation, from the Medical Segmentation Decathlon (MSD) challenge. Experimental results indicate that MRFFU-Net outperforms state-of-the-art models across multiple evaluation metrics, demonstrating its effectiveness in MRI segmentation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MRFFU-Net，通过在编解码器各层级嵌入多分辨率特征融合模块（MRFF），结合注意力机制和跳跃连接，提升MRI解剖结构分割的细节与全局上下文兼顾能力，在脑脊液和左心房两个公开数据集上超越现有先进模型。
AI.motivation: MRI分割中解剖结构边界不规则、形状/对比度/尺度变化大，而U-Net类深度学习架构难以同时保留细粒度细节与全局上下文信息，因此需要新的架构来平衡二者。
AI.method: 提出MRFFU-Net架构，核心为多分辨率特征融合模块（MRFF），可便捷集成到任意U-Net类架构中；MRFF嵌入编解码结构的每一层级，并与注意力机制、跳跃连接协同，实现多分辨率特征提取。
AI.result: 在两个公开MRI基准数据集上评估：脊柱MR扫描的脑脊液（CSF）分割和MSD挑战赛的左心房分割。实验显示MRFFU-Net在多个评价指标上均优于当前先进模型。
AI.conclusion: MRFFU-Net通过多分辨率特征融合有效兼顾细节与全局上下文，验证了其在MRI分割中的有效性，且MRFF模块具有良好的通用性与可集成性。

title: Evaluating the Robustness of Anti-UAV Detection under Controlled Fog Degradation: Fog-Aware Training and Clear-Sky Tradeoff
summary: Vision-based anti-UAV systems must function in poor visibility, yet most benchmarks use only clear-sky footage, and previous robustness studies treat adverse weather as a simple present/absent condition. As a result, the impact of fog severity on ground-to-air UAV detection remains poorly understood. This work presents the first severity-controlled fog benchmark for this task: synthetic fog at ten severity levels is applied to the RGB modality of the Anti-UAV300 dataset, comparing a clear-trained YOLOv5m baseline to a fog-aware model trained on both clear and foggy images. Detection performance drops sharply and non-linearly: degradation is front-loaded across light-to-moderate fog (beta approximately 0.05-0.10), with a 96% reduction in mAP@0.5:0.95 from clear to thickest fog, mainly due to lost recall and confidence. On the comparable metric (mAP@0.5), this collapse exceeds the most extreme rain degradation reported in the closest prior benchmark. Fog-aware training boosts detection across all severities (up to +0.320 mAP@0.5:0.95) with only a 9.1% drop in clear-sky accuracy, raising the threshold for reliable detection while not preventing collapse under extreme fog. Since reliability is lost within a narrow visibility range, simple clear vs adverse tests underestimate operational risk.

AI.tldr: 首个"按雾浓度分级"的无人机检测基准：对Anti-UAV300的RGB模态施加10档合成雾，对比清晰训练的YOLOv5m与雾感知模型。性能呈前重后缓的非线性崩塌（β≈0.05–0.10区间衰减最剧），清晰→最浓雾时mAP@0.5:0.95下降96%；雾感知训练在各档均提升（最高+0.320），但仅损失9.1%清晰天精度，且无法避免极端雾下的失效。
AI.motivation: 基于视觉的反无人机系统需在低能见度下工作，但现有基准几乎只用晴空数据，且既有鲁棒性研究把恶劣天气简化为"有/无"二值条件。因此，雾浓度对地—空无人机检测的影响缺乏细粒度认识，导致对实际作业风险的估计被低估。
AI.method: 1）构建首个按严重程度受控的雾天基准：以10个等级合成雾注入Anti-UAV300数据集的RGB模态；2）设置对照——清晰数据训练的YOLOv5m基线与融合清晰+雾天数据训练的雾感知模型；3）按雾浓度逐档评估检测性能，并与最接近的既有基准中极端降雨退化结果在同一指标（mAP@0.5）上比较。
AI.result: 检测性能随雾浓度非线性骤降，退化集中在轻—中度雾段（β≈0.05–0.10，即"前重后缓"）；从清晰到最浓雾，mAP@0.5:0.95下降96%，主因是召回率与置信度损失。在同一指标mAP@0.5上，该崩塌幅度超过最接近的既有基准所报告的最极端降雨退化。雾感知训练在所有雾浓度下均提升检测（最高+0.320 mAP@0.5:0.95），清晰天精度仅下降9.1%，可提高可靠检测的雾浓度阈值，但不能阻止极端雾下的失效。
AI.conclusion: 可靠检测仅在很窄的能见度区间内维持，简单的"清晰 vs 恶劣天气"二分测试会显著低估实际运行风险；后续评估应采用按严重程度分级的天气基准。

title: Query Independent Variable Rate Visual Token Coding
summary: Visual-token compression for vision--language models is posed almost entirely as a selection problem: decide which tokens to keep and discard the rest. The criteria that work best rank tokens by the attention the language model pays them, which makes the ranking a function of the question being asked. That is invisible in a single-turn benchmark and decisive whenever a compressed representation is written once and read many times, as when it is cached across the turns of a conversation or transmitted between a device and a server. We take the other half of the classical transform-coding toolkit instead: keep every token and vary its rate. A transform code exposes each token's measured distortion--rate curve, and a fixed bit budget is distributed across tokens by exact integer rate--distortion optimisation on those curves. No text enters the pipeline, so one compressed representation serves any query. At equal bit budgets, on two datasets and two capacities, it preserves the model's output distribution and its answers better than uniform-rate coding, the closed-form water-fill and distortion-ranked pruning. It matches attention-ranked pruning on the question pruning was tuned for, and overtakes it once the compressed image must answer a different question about the same image.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将视觉token压缩视为率-失真编码而非token选择问题，保留全部token并分配可变比特率，无需文本输入即可实现查询无关的单次压缩多次使用。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉token压缩方法几乎都将其视为选择问题（保留/丢弃token），最佳准则依赖语言模型对token的注意力，使排序取决于所问问题。这在单轮基准中不可见，但当压缩表示被写入一次、多次读取（如跨对话轮次缓存或设备-服务器传输）时是决定性的。
AI.method: 采用变换编码工具包的另一半：保留每个token并变化其码率。变换编码暴露每个token的实测失真-率曲线，通过在这些曲线上进行精确整数率-失真优化，将固定比特预算分配到各token。文本不进入流水线，因此一个压缩表示可服务任何查询。
AI.result: 在相同比特预算下，于两个数据集和两个容量配置上，该方法比均匀码率编码、闭式注水法和按失真排序剪枝更好地保持模型输出分布和答案。在与剪枝调优相同的问题上，匹配注意力排序剪枝；当压缩图像需回答同一图像的不同问题时，则超越注意力排序剪枝。
AI.conclusion: 将视觉token压缩重新表述为率-失真编码问题，可实现查询无关的压缩表示，在多种设置下优于现有选择式方法，尤其适用于压缩表示被重用或传输的场景。

title: LENS-GRF: Permutation-Invariant Lesion Evidence Network with Gated Residual Fusion for Acne Severity Grading and Multi-Rater Clinical Oracle Analysis
comment: Submitted to Computer Methods and Programs in Biomedicine (Elsevier)
summary: Automated acne severity grading requires both whole-face context and fine-grained lesion evidence. We propose LENS-GRF (Lesion Evidence Network with Set-Transformer and Gated Residual Fusion), an interpretable multi-stage framework for four-class acne severity grading. The method combines Adaptive Facial Skin Segmentation and a global Vision Transformer prior with a permutation-invariant Lesion Set Transformer that encodes localized lesion patches and spatial geometry. Gated Residual Fusion adaptively controls the local residual contribution and reduces to the global prediction when the gate is zero. On ACNE04, fully automated LENS-GRF with YOLOv11s achieved 80.82% accuracy; with ground-truth lesion annotations, it achieved 95.89% +/- 0.59% accuracy and a Quadratic Weighted Kappa of 0.9753. A data-integrity audit identified 15 cross-split duplicate image pairs, including five with conflicting severity labels. In locked zero-shot evaluation on the full PLSBRACNE01 cohort (200 subjects, 600 views), automated LENS-GRF achieved 35.00% accuracy versus 42.50% for the global baseline. On the 148-subject common cohort used for three-dermatologist oracle analysis, ground-truth lesion inputs increased the best oracle accuracy to 47.97%, while the highest oracle QWK was 0.5799. Pairwise oracle agreement ranged from 49.32% to 66.22%, highlighting detector domain shift, annotation variability, and cross-criterion mismatch.

AI.tldr: 提出可解释多阶段框架LENS-GRF，结合全局ViT先验与置换不变病灶集合Transformer，用门控残差融合自适应整合局部证据；ACNE04全自动80.82%、GT标注95.89%，但在PLSBRACNE01零样本与皮肤科医生oracle分析中性能大幅下降。
AI.motivation: 痤疮严重度自动分级既需全脸上下文，也需细粒度病灶证据，二者如何有效融合尚缺可解释方案；同时现有基准可能存在数据泄漏，且跨数据集泛化与标注一致性未被充分检验。
AI.method: LENS-GRF：自适应面部皮肤分割 + 全局Vision Transformer先验 + 置换不变的Lesion Set Transformer（编码局部病灶图块与空间几何），采用Gated Residual Fusion自适应控制局部残差贡献，门控为零时退化为全局预测。进行数据完整性审计，并在PLSBRACNE01上做锁定零样本评估及三位皮肤科医生的oracle分析。
AI.result: ACNE04：全自动（YOLOv11s）80.82%准确率；使用真值病灶标注达95.89%±0.59%、QWK 0.9753。数据审计发现15对跨划分重复图像，其中5对严重度标签冲突。PLSBRACNE01零样本（200人、600视图）：自动版35.00% vs 全局基线42.50%。148人共同队列oracle：真值病灶输入使最佳oracle准确率达47.97%，最高oracle QWK 0.5799，两两oracle一致率49.32%–66.22%。
AI.conclusion: 病灶证据在标注可靠时价值显著，但方法对检测器域偏移、标注变异与跨标准不匹配高度敏感，真实零样本场景下甚至低于全局基线；同时基准数据集存在跨划分重复泄漏，高精度结果需谨慎解读。

title: Beyond Pixel Reconstruction: Retrieval-Guided Glyph-Aware Restoration for Low-Resource Manchu Historical Documents
summary: Historical Manchu documents preserve invaluable linguistic and cultural heritage, yet their digitization is hindered by severe degradations and the scarcity of paired training data. Existing document restoration methods primarily optimize pixel-level reconstruction, which can produce visually plausible results while failing to preserve the structural identity of Manchu glyphs. To address this limitation, we propose a retrieval-guided glyph-aware restoration framework that goes beyond pixel reconstruction by explicitly incorporating glyph-level structural knowledge. Our method retrieves relevant glyph exemplars to provide structural guidance during restoration and integrates this information into the reconstruction process, improving the recovery of degraded character structures under low-resource conditions. Extensive experiments on Manchu historical documents demonstrate that the proposed approach improves both image restoration quality and glyph-level fidelity compared with existing restoration methods. These results highlight the importance of incorporating character-aware structural priors for reliable restoration of low-resource historical documents.

AI.tldr: 提出检索引导的字形感知修复框架，通过引入字形级结构先验，提升满文历史文档在低资源、强退化条件下的修复质量与字形保真度。
AI.motivation: 满文历史文档具有重要语言文化价值，但其数字化受限于严重退化和配对训练数据稀缺；现有文档修复方法主要优化像素级重建，虽视觉上看似合理，却难以保持满文字形的结构身份。
AI.method: 提出检索引导的字形感知修复框架，超越像素级重建，显式引入字形级结构知识；通过检索相关字形样例，为修复提供结构引导，并将该信息融入重建过程，在低资源条件下改善退化字符结构的恢复。
AI.result: 在满文历史文档上的大量实验表明，与现有修复方法相比，所提方法同时提升了图像修复质量和字形级保真度。
AI.conclusion: 结果凸显了引入字符感知结构先验对低资源历史文档可靠修复的重要性。

title: Decoding the Disaster: Multi-Task Geospatial Reasoning with Vision-Language Models and Crowdsourced Imagery for Disaster Mapping
summary: Crowdsourced imagery provides timely, fine-grained, street-level observations for disaster mapping, complementing conventional remote sensing imagery (RSI) during emergency response. However, such imagery is often unstructured, spatially ambiguous, and lacks reliable geographic metadata, making manual geolocalization and interpretation labor-intensive and difficult to scale. This work proposes a multi-task Geospatial Reasoning Disaster mapping framework, namely GRDisaster, to examine the potential of vision-language models (VLMs) in understanding, geolocalizing, and reasoning over crowdsourced disaster imagery. GRDisaster is built on a newly curated benchmark dataset derived from PhotoMappers, comprising 26,340 images organized into human-validated volunteered geographic information (VGI), street-view imagery (SVI), RSI cross-view triplets covering multiple disaster events from 2018 to 2024. The framework combines deterministic and probabilistic cross-view geolocalization with multi-view fusion to associate VGI images with georeferenced SVI and RSI. It introduces two sets of spatial reasoning indicators for cross-view geolocalization validation and disaster damage assessment. These indicators use structural, environmental, and global-scene cues to validate cross-view correspondences and visually observable damage evidence with expert-verified annotations to assess disaster severity, improving the interpretability of VLM outputs. To our knowledge, this study provides the first systematic investigation and unified evaluation framework for examining how VLM-based spatial reasoning can transform crowdsourced disaster imagery into actionable geospatial artificial intelligence (GeoAI) through cross-view geolocalization validation, interpretable spatial reasoning, and damage-aware severity assessment.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出GRDisaster多任务地理空间推理灾害制图框架，基于PhotoMappers构建含26,340张图像（VGI、街景、遥感跨视角三元组，覆盖2018–2024年多次灾害事件）的基准数据集，结合确定性与概率性跨视角地理定位及多视角融合，并引入两组空间推理指标用于跨视角定位验证与灾害损伤评估，首次系统探索视觉语言模型如何将众包灾害影像转化为可行动的GeoAI。
AI.motivation: 众包影像能提供及时、细粒度、街景级的灾害观测，弥补应急响应中传统遥感影像的不足。但这类影像通常结构松散、空间位置模糊、缺乏可靠地理元数据，人工地理定位与解译成本高、难以规模化。因此需要借助视觉语言模型（VLM）实现自动化的理解、地理定位与推理。
AI.method: 构建GRDisaster多任务地理空间推理灾害制图框架，基于新策划的PhotoMappers基准数据集（26,340张图像，组织为经人工验证的VGI、街景影像、遥感影像跨视角三元组）。采用确定性与概率性跨视角地理定位结合多视角融合，将VGI影像与带地理坐标的街景和遥感影像关联；并引入两组空间推理指标，利用结构、环境与全局场景线索验证跨视角对应关系，并基于专家验证标注评估可观测灾害损伤证据与灾害严重程度，以提升VLM输出的可解释性。
AI.result: 框架实现了跨视角地理定位验证、可解释空间推理与损伤感知的严重程度评估三类任务，并通过专家验证标注支撑损伤证据判定，提升了VLM输出的可解释性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究首次提供系统性调查与统一评估框架，考察基于VLM的空间推理如何通过跨视角地理定位验证、可解释空间推理和损伤感知严重程度评估，将众包灾害影像转化为可行动的GeoAI。

title: LEGO-OPD: Factorized Teacher Composition for Multimodal On-Policy Distillation
summary: Multimodal on-policy distillation (OPD) aims to improve visual grounding while preserving the strong reasoning capabilities of language models. Recent multi-teacher approaches combine LLM and VLM teachers to provide complementary supervision. However, directly using a VLM's full predictive distribution entangles its visual grounding signal with its own language prior, preventing the grounding information from being transferred independently. Conversely, increasing the strength of visual supervision can improve perception but may overemphasize visual evidence and degrade language reasoning. To address this trade-off, we introduce LEGO-OPD, which selectively composes factors from a Language Expert and a Grounding expert into One teacher distribution for multimodal OPD. Under a generalized Bayesian formulation, the language expert provides a prior over candidate tokens, while the grounding expert contributes a visual likelihood that updates this prior, rather than transferring its complete predictive distribution. This factorized composition allows language reasoning and visual grounding to be controlled independently. We further introduce adaptive calibration to determine how strongly the visual likelihood should update the language prior at each decoding prefix. Specifically, LEGO-OPD uses the grounding expert's image-induced prediction shift as a prefix-dependent reference, preventing both insufficient and excessive visual supervision. Experiments with Qwen3 models show that LEGO-OPD consistently outperforms the evaluated single- and multi-teacher OPD baselines on both multimodal and text-only reasoning tasks. Moreover, it improves the initial student's visual perception while preserving text-only reasoning.

AI.tldr: LEGO-OPD 通过将语言专家与视觉专家分解为"先验×似然"的因子化教师分布，实现多模态在线策略蒸馏中语言推理与视觉定位的独立控制，性能优于单/多教师基线。
AI.motivation: 现有多教师多模态 OPD 直接使用 VLM 的完整预测分布，会将视觉定位信号与自身语言先验纠缠，无法独立迁移定位信息；而单纯增强视觉监督虽能提升感知，却会过度强调视觉证据、损害语言推理能力，二者存在难以调和的权衡。
AI.method: 提出 LEGO-OPD：在广义贝叶斯框架下，将语言专家（提供候选 token 先验）与定位专家（提供视觉似然）组合为单一教师分布，用似然更新先验而非迁移完整分布。引入自适应校准，以定位专家由图像引起的预测偏移作为前缀相关的参考，逐解码前缀调节视觉似然对语言先验的更新强度，从而避免视觉监督不足或过度。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3 模型上的实验表明，LEGO-OPD 在多模态任务与纯文本推理任务上均稳定优于所评估的单教师和多教师 OPD 基线，且能提升初始学生的视觉感知能力，同时保持纯文本推理性能。
AI.conclusion: 因子化的先验-似然组合提供了可独立调控语言推理与视觉定位的蒸馏机制，配合自适应校准有效缓解了视觉监督与语言能力之间的权衡，为多模态 OPD 提供了更优的监督信号组织方式。

title: EgoRefine: Ego-Referenced Predictive Alignment and Trajectory-Conditioned Reliability-Aware Fusion for Asynchronous Collaborative Perception
comment: The source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/godk0509/EgoRefine
summary: Collaborative perception enables connected agents to share complementary observations for 3D object detection, extending sensing range and mitigating occlusion. Under asynchronous communication, however, cooperative features arrive with temporal delay. Existing prediction-based methods compensate for these features mainly from the transmitting agent's own history, leaving residual misalignment with the ego agent's current observation; subsequent fusion also often overlooks spatial variations in alignment quality. We propose EgoRefine, an ego-referenced predictive alignment and reliability-aware fusion framework for asynchronous collaborative perception. Its Ego-referenced Predictive Alignment module uses the current ego feature to guide cooperative trajectory-field prediction and refines the sampling offsets along an ego-referenced trajectory direction. Its Trajectory-conditioned Reliability-aware Fusion module treats the trajectory discrepancy between the ego and cooperative streams and the directional refinement magnitude as alignment cues, using them to condition the relation between aligned features and adaptively reweight the two streams before convolutional fusion. Experiments on V2V4Real and DAIR-V2X-Seq show that EgoRefine outperforms TraF-Align by 1.6 and 2.9 points on average in AP@0.5 and AP@0.7, respectively. The source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/godk0509/EgoRefine.

AI.tldr: 提出EgoRefine框架，用自车特征引导协同特征的预测对齐并进行可靠性感知融合，缓解异步通信下的时空错位，在V2V4Real和DAIR-V2X-Seq上超越TraF-Align。
AI.motivation: 异步通信下协同特征存在时间延迟。现有基于预测的补偿方法主要依赖发送方自身历史进行特征补偿，与自车当前观测之间仍存在残余错位；且后续融合往往忽略了对齐质量的空间差异。
AI.method: EgoRefine包含两个模块：1）Ego-referenced Predictive Alignment，利用当前自车特征引导协同轨迹场预测，并沿自车参考的轨迹方向细化采样偏移；2）Trajectory-conditioned Reliability-aware Fusion，将自车流与协同流之间的轨迹差异及方向细化幅度作为对齐线索，用于调制对齐特征之间的关系，并在卷积融合前对两路特征自适应重加权。
AI.result: 在V2V4Real和DAIR-V2X-Seq数据集上，EgoRefine在AP@0.5和AP@0.7上平均分别比TraF-Align提升1.6和2.9个点。源码将开源于https://github.com/godk0509/EgoRefine。
AI.conclusion: 以自车当前观测为参照进行协同特征预测对齐，并将对齐质量的空间差异显式建模为融合权重，可有效缓解异步协同感知中的时空错位，提升3D目标检测精度。

title: Vmem-$\varphi$: Low-Compute Out-of-Distribution Detection in Spiking Neural Networks from Membrane-Potential Statistics
summary: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) offer an energy-efficient approach to processing event-camera data, yet out-of-distribution (OOD) detection remains challenging in this setting. Existing OOD detection methods often depend on model outputs or computational components that are unavailable in object detection SNNs or are poorly suited to low-compute deployment. To that effect, we show that the subthreshold membrane potential \(V_{\mathrm{mem}}(t)\) provides a useful internal signal for detecting distribution shifts. Simple per-channel statistics derived from these membrane dynamics enable OOD detection. To evaluate this approach, we introduce Gen1-C, an event-camera corruption benchmark developed upon the Prophesee Gen1 automotive detection dataset, containing six sensor-motivated histogram-level stress tests at five severity levels. We further propose the Multi-Descriptor Deviation (MDD), a corruption-blind method that operates on membrane-potential statistics. At the highest corruption severity, MDD achieves an AUROC of more than 0.88 on five of the six corruptions using only a bounded 64-frame observation window. Notably, the remaining corruption is also the one that has the smallest effect on the underlying detector. These results show that the temporal membrane-potential dynamics can provide an effective and low-cost signal for OOD detection in SNN-based event perception.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出利用脉冲神经网络中阈下膜电位 \(V_{\mathrm{mem}}(t)\) 的逐通道统计量进行OOD检测，并构建Gen1-C事件相机损坏基准与MDD方法，在高损坏等级下取得良好AUROC。
AI.motivation: 事件相机数据的SNN处理虽节能，但其OOD检测困难：现有方法依赖目标检测SNN中不可用的模型输出或计算组件，或不适配低算力部署，因此需要一种内部、低成本且不依赖模型输出的信号。
AI.method: 提出以阈下膜电位 \(V_{\mathrm{mem}}(t)\) 作为内部信号，基于膜电位动态提取逐通道统计量；构建Gen1-C损坏基准（基于Prophesee Gen1车载检测数据集，含六种传感器级直方图压力测试、五个严重等级）；提出对损坏类型盲的Multi-Descriptor Deviation（MDD）方法，在膜电位统计上运行，仅使用有界64帧观测窗口。
AI.result: 在最高损坏等级下，MDD在六种损坏中的五种上AUROC超过0.88；唯一未达标的那种损坏也是对底层检测器影响最小的损坏。
AI.conclusion: SNN中膜电位的时间动态可为基于事件感知的OOD检测提供有效且低成本的信号，适用于低算力部署场景。

title: From Image Latent Space to Fuzzy Rules: Interpretable Analysis of Gastrointestinal Foundation Model
comment: Accepted at the excv, ECCV 2026 Workshops. 17 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables
summary: Foundation models pretrained on large-scale datasets demonstrate strong transferability to medical imaging tasks. However, understanding how their latent representations encode clinically relevant information remains an open challenge in safety-critical domains. This study proposes a prototype-based fuzzy-rule framework that interprets the patch-level features produced by the inner layers of pretrained foundation models, without any fine-tuning. Class-specific prototypes are learned by clustering in the feature space, yielding compact visual patterns. Patch features are then expressed as prototype similarities and classified by fuzzy rules with linguistic IF-THEN conditions that are human readable. The framework is applied across the final two blocks of ViT-S/16 backbones pretrained on ImageNet-1K and GastroNet-5M, and benchmarked against k-nearest neighbours, kernel SVM, and linear probing under identical frozen features, on wireless capsule endoscopy classification, gastrointestinal endoscopy classification, and colonic polyp segmentation. The experimental analysis shows that the proposed method, without backbone fine-tuning, reaches accuracy comparable to these black-box classifiers, and that domain-specific pretraining yields features that are both discriminative and symbolically compressible. Because the resulting rules are extracted from real data and expressed in interpretable terms, they are further used as an instrument to investigate synthetic medical images, providing a human-readable account of which real prototypes and rules a generator reproduces or fails to reproduce, localising where a synthetic image departs from real tissue rather than summarising it with a single score. The framework thus offers a transparent, depth-resolved view of how foundation models organise clinically relevant structure, together with a practical downstream use of the extracted rules.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于原型的模糊规则框架，在无需微调的情况下解释预训练基础模型中间层patch级特征，并用于医学影像分类与合成图像分析。
AI.motivation: 基础模型在医学影像任务上迁移性强，但其隐空间表征如何编码临床相关信息尚不清晰，这在安全攸关领域是亟待解决的开放问题。
AI.method: 在特征空间聚类学习类别原型，将patch特征表示为与原型相似度，并用具有自然语言IF-THEN条件的模糊规则进行分类；在ImageNet-1K与GastroNet-5M预训练的ViT-S/16最后两个block上验证，与kNN、核SVM、线性探测对比。
AI.result: 在无线胶囊内镜分类、胃肠内镜分类与结肠息肉分割任务上，该方法在无微调下取得与黑盒分类器相当的精度；领域特定预训练所得特征兼具判别性与符号可压缩性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提供了对基础模型如何组织临床相关结构的透明、分层可视化视角，并可将提取规则用于合成医学图像分析，定位合成图像偏离真实组织的位置。

title: Scores That Hold, Benchmarks That Leak: Measuring Dataset Contamination in Public Brain-Tumor MRI Classification
summary: Automated classification of brain tumors from MRI is a heavily published application of deep learning in medical imaging, with reported accuracies on public benchmarks routinely exceeding 98%. However, accuracy does not capture a critical dimension of benchmark quality: dataset integrity, defined as the independence of test from training data at the image, patient, and acquisition-source levels. We introduce a three-layer contamination framework comprising duplicate, patient, and source-label leakage to assess the public corpora on which this literature rests. We audit the three most widely used corpora against a chest-radiograph negative control and quantify each layer's effect on measured performance across nine architectures and three evaluation conditions. Contamination is severe at every layer: 28.8% of the dominant corpus's official test split has a near-twin in its own training split, a second corpus leaks 22.3% of its test images byte-identically, 95.5% of traceable test images share a patient with training, and file-header features containing no anatomy separate tumor from no-tumor at 0.959 balanced accuracy, at parity with fine-tuned ResNet backbones. The unexpected result is that removing every identified leaked test image leaves balanced accuracy essentially unchanged: stable performance after deduplication does not establish benchmark integrity. Our findings establish dataset integrity as a distinct, measurable axis of benchmark quality that a stable leaderboard cannot certify. For biomedical research, reported accuracy on these corpora alone does not establish that a model has learned to recognize tumors rather than exploit dataset-specific cues. We release the contaminated-file lists, recovered patient identifiers, and deduplicated splits.

AI.tldr: 本文提出三层数据污染框架（重复、患者、来源标签泄漏），审计三个最常用的脑肿瘤MRI公开数据集，发现各层污染均严重，但去除全部已识别泄漏测试图像后平衡准确率基本不变，表明稳定性能无法证明基准完整性。
AI.motivation: 脑肿瘤MRI自动分类文献报告的基准准确率普遍超过98%，但准确率无法反映基准质量的关键维度——数据集完整性，即测试数据在图像、患者和采集来源层面相对训练数据的独立性。作者希望揭示公共语料中潜在的污染问题，并说明仅凭高准确率无法证明模型真正学到了肿瘤特征而非数据集特异线索。
AI.method: 提出三层污染框架：重复泄漏、患者泄漏、来源标签泄漏。对三个最广泛使用的语料库进行审计，并以胸部X线作为阴性对照。在九种架构和三种评估条件下量化每层污染对性能测量的影响。进一步通过文件头特征分类实验和去重后的性能对比，评估污染对基准有效性的实际影响。
AI.result: 污染在各层均严重：主导语料官方测试集中28.8%的图像在自身训练集中存在近似孪生样本；第二个语料库有22.3%的测试图像字节级完全相同地泄漏；95.5%可追溯的测试图像与训练集共享同一患者；不含解剖信息的文件头特征以0.959平衡准确率区分肿瘤与非肿瘤，与微调ResNet主干相当。关键发现是，移除所有已识别的泄漏测试图像后平衡准确率基本不变。
AI.conclusion: 数据集完整性是基准质量的一个独立且可测量的维度，稳定的排行榜成绩无法为其背书。对于生物医学研究，仅凭这些语料库上报告的高准确率，不能证明模型学会了识别肿瘤，而非利用数据集特异线索。作者发布了污染文件列表、恢复的患者标识符及去重后的划分，以支持更可靠的基准评估。

title: PACT: End-to-End Learning of Human Pose, Contacts, and Forces from Video
summary: Human motion, environmental contacts, and interaction forces are governed by common physical laws, yet existing approaches typically separate visual pose reconstruction from contact and force estimation. This separation limits joint reasoning and can propagate errors between stages. We introduce PACT, an end-to-end model that jointly learns to estimate human pose, contacts and contact forces from monocular video. Our approach augments a human reconstruction foundation model with learnable contact-force tokens and a temporal transformer that integrates visual features with world-space motion. Joint prediction heads refine human poses and estimate contacts and forces, while physics-based supervision encourages consistency between the reconstructed motion and interaction forces. To address the scarcity of force annotations, we develop a data annotation pipeline that combines contact labeling with physics-based motion and force optimization, producing training supervision from synthetic and real-world videos. We also introduce a real-world climbing benchmark ForceWall with climbing videos and corresponding ground-truth contact forces obtained from the force sensors. Experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art contact and force estimation, outperforming staged reconstruction approaches and generalizing to interactions beyond the training distribution. These results support end-to-end joint learning as an effective approach to recovering human motion and physical interactions from video.

AI.tldr: 提出端到端模型PACT，通过可学习接触力token与时序Transformer，从单目视频联合估计人体姿态、接触与接触力，并构建数据标注流程与真实攀岩基准ForceWall，实现最优接触/力估计并具跨分布泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 人体运动、环境接触与相互作用力受共同物理规律支配，但现有方法通常将视觉姿态重建与接触/力估计分离处理；这种分阶段范式限制了联合推理能力，并会在阶段间传播误差。同时，接触力标注稀缺也是关键障碍。
AI.method: 在人体重建基础模型上引入可学习接触力token和时序Transformer，将视觉特征与世界坐标空间运动相融合；联合预测头分别精化人体姿态、估计接触与接触力，并用物理监督约束重建运动与相互作用力的一致性。针对力标注稀缺，设计结合接触标注与物理驱动力学/运动优化的数据标注流程，从合成与真实视频生成训练监督；并构建真实攀岩基准ForceWall，含视频与力传感器真值接触力。
AI.result: 实验显示在接触与力估计上达到最先进水平，优于分阶段重建方法，并能泛化到训练分布之外的交互场景。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持端到端联合学习是从视频恢复人体运动与物理交互的有效途径。

title: PhysVista: Benchmarking Physical Intelligence in VLMs via a Perception-Reasoning-Assessment Loop
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown strong multimodal reasoning capabilities, yet whether they truly capture the physical consistency underlying real-world dynamics remains unclear. Existing benchmark paradigms often suffer from fragmented evaluation, focusing on isolated cognitive stages while overlooking the inherent synergy between perception, reasoning, and physical judgment. The lack of a holistic perspective limits the ability to diagnose whether VLMs can reliably evaluate the physical authenticity of emerging generative models. To address these issues, we introduce PhysVista, a benchmark designed to evaluate physical intelligence in VLMs through a closed cognitive loop framework inspired by the human seeing-reasoning-assessment process. PhysVista restores this loop by jointly evaluating physical state perception, physical dynamics reasoning, and physical plausibility assessment. It further distinguishes event-level reasoning and scale-level reasoning to enable fine-grained analysis of physical understanding. In addition, PhysVista incorporates both real-world and AI-generated videos, allowing evaluation across diverse domains and emerging generative scenarios. Extensive experiments across a diverse set of VLMs reveal substantial limitations in physical reasoning and plausibility assessment, highlighting a persistent gap between visual recognition and genuine physical understanding, and pointing toward more principled designs for physically grounded multimodal intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PhysVista 基准，通过"感知-推理-评判"闭环认知框架评估视觉语言模型（VLM）的物理智能，涵盖物理状态感知、物理动力学推理与物理合理性评估三个维度，并区分事件级与尺度级推理，同时纳入真实与 AI 生成视频。实验表明现有 VLM 在物理推理与合理性判断上存在显著局限。
AI.motivation: VLM 虽展现出强多模态推理能力，但其是否真正掌握现实世界动态背后的物理一致性尚不明确。现有基准多为碎片化评估，只关注孤立的认知阶段，忽视感知、推理与物理判断之间的内在协同，缺乏整体视角，难以诊断 VLM 能否可靠评估新兴生成模型的物理真实性。
AI.method: 提出 PhysVista 基准，采用受人类"看-推理-评判"过程启发的闭环认知框架，联合评估物理状态感知、物理动力学推理与物理合理性评估三部分；进一步区分事件级推理与尺度级推理以实现细粒度分析；并同时纳入真实世界视频与 AI 生成视频，覆盖多样领域与新兴生成场景。
AI.result: 在多种 VLM 上的大量实验揭示了模型在物理推理与合理性评估方面的显著局限，表明视觉识别与真正的物理理解之间存在持续差距。
AI.conclusion: 当前 VLM 的物理理解能力仍不足，PhysVista 为诊断其物理智能提供了整体化评估手段，并为构建更具物理基础的多模态智能指明方向。

title: Memorizon: Training World Models Beyond Their Context Window
summary: Streaming world models should render a place consistently across repeated visits. Directly supervising such revisits requires training samples that capture both visits, often spanning minutes. Yet dense attention over the full span incurs quadratic costs, making long-span supervision expensive. Memorizon breaks this coupling: long spans are needed for supervision, but not for attention, since the two visits can share a forward pass without including every intervening frame. A training sample covers a span of any length but is scored only on its last $k$ chunks. Instead of tokenizing the history before them, each scored chunk retrieves its own top-$K$ latents by camera co-visibility, and the union of these requests forms a shared bank. The bank is bounded by $kK$, so the sequence stays bounded however long the span; at the shortest span the recipe is exactly conventional training. Adding the bank raises the cost of a step once; beyond that, a longer span costs little, and going from 100 to 400 s adds 12% to the step time. Against a sliding-window baseline, retrieval raises revisit consistency on every split, and a span long enough to reach the first visit of each return adds a further 24% to 30%, at some cost in image quality; beyond that span, more length no longer helps. Filling the bank from another episode lowers revisit correlation by 83%, so the model uses what it retrieves. Project page: https://tingtingliao.github.io/memorizon

AI.tldr: Memorizon 通过将长跨度监督与稠密注意力解耦，利用共视检索共享潜变量库实现有界序列长度的长程重访一致性训练。
AI.motivation: 流式世界模型需在重复到访同一地点时保持渲染一致，但直接监督重访需覆盖两次到访的长时间跨度样本；全跨度稠密注意力呈二次复杂度，导致长跨度监督代价高昂。
AI.method: 样本可覆盖任意长度跨度，但仅对最后 k 个 chunk 计分。被计分 chunk 不 tokenize 其前历史，而是按相机共视性各自检索 top-K 潜变量，其并集构成共享 bank。bank 规模受 kK 约束，序列长度不随跨度增长；最短跨度时等价于常规训练。
AI.result: 相比滑动窗口基线，检索在所有划分上提升重访一致性；跨度足以覆盖每次返回的首次到访时进一步带来 24%–30% 提升，但图像质量有所下降，且超过该跨度后更长序列不再有益。用其他 episode 填充 bank 使重访相关性下降 83%，表明模型确实使用了检索内容。代价方面，加入 bank 使单步成本一次性增加，跨度从 100 s 增至 400 s 仅使步时增加 12%。
AI.conclusion: 长跨度对监督是必要的，但对注意力并非必要；基于共视检索的共享 bank 可在有界序列成本下实现有效的长程重访一致性，且性能提升存在饱和跨度。

title: PixelDense: Dense Prediction as Representation Alignment for Pixel Diffusion
summary: Representation alignment (REPA) accelerates diffusion transformer training, but its alignment targets are almost exclusively semantic encoders such as DINOv2 and CLIP. Recent analysis points to spatial structure, not global semantics, as the carrier of the alignment effect, yet dense-prediction foundation models trained to predict that structure remain overlooked as REPA targets. In pixel-space diffusion, SAM2, Depth Anything v2, and Metric3D v2 each outperform the DINOv2-only GenEval baseline, with the two geometric teachers leading the segmentation teacher. A flat sum of all four teachers, however, lands below the best single geometric teacher, as semantic and geometric gradients compete for one denoiser projection. We introduce PixelDense, which routes DINOv2 and SAM2 through a semantic projection stream, routes Depth Anything v2 and Metric3D v2 through a geometric projection stream, and adds a weight-space orthogonality penalty that keeps the two streams in disjoint subspaces. All four teachers are frozen during training and dropped at inference. Applied to PixelGen and DeCo with a single recipe, PixelDense improves GenEval, DPG-Bench, and HPS v2.1, raises PixelGen-XXL's GenEval Overall from 0.7927 to 0.8093, and beats every single-teacher and unfactored multi-teacher variant. In partial-noise reconstruction, independent panoptic, depth, and surface-normal probes show up to 53.1% PQ gain and 36.0% depth AbsRel reduction at $τ=0.5$ across COCO and Flickr30K. From random initialization, PixelDense also reaches the baseline's peak GenEval 1.23x faster. In SDEdit editing on PIE-Bench, PixelDense keeps more of the source background and layout at every edit strength, raising background PSNR by up to 2.2 dB.

AI.tldr: 提出PixelDense，将语义与几何密集预测模型分组路由为独立投影流并施加权重正交惩罚，改进扩散Transformer的表征对齐，在多项生成与重建任务上取得提升。
AI.motivation: 现有表征对齐（REPA）几乎只采用DINOv2、CLIP等语义编码器作为对齐目标，但分析表明真正起作用的是空间结构而非全局语义；而专门预测密集空间结构的模型（SAM2、Depth Anything v2、Metric3D v2）却被忽视。同时，简单叠加所有教师会导致语义与几何梯度在同一去噪器投影中相互竞争，效果反而下降。
AI.method: PixelDense将DINOv2与SAM2经语义投影流通路，将Depth Anything v2与Metric3D v2经几何投影流通路，并加入权重空间正交惩罚使两流处于不相交子空间；四个教师模型训练时冻结、推理时丢弃，可单一配方应用于PixelGen与DeCo。
AI.result: 在PixelGen与DeCo上统一使用一套配方即提升GenEval、DPG-Bench与HPS v2.1；PixelGen-XXL的GenEval Overall由0.7927升至0.8093，优于所有单教师与未分解多教师方案。部分噪声重建中，独立的全景分割、深度、表面法线探针在τ=0.5时于COCO与Flickr30K上最高获得53.1%的PQ提升与36.0%的深度AbsRel下降。从随机初始化出发达到基线峰值GenEval快1.23倍；PIE-Bench的SDEdit编辑中在各编辑强度下均更好保留源背景与布局，背景PSNR最高提升2.2 dB。
AI.conclusion: 以密集预测基础模型作为REPA目标并按语义/几何分流、正交解耦，可有效缓解梯度竞争，同时提升生成质量、结构一致性、收敛速度与编辑保真度，为扩散Transformer的表征对齐提供了新的多教师分解范式。

title: FORTE: Adaptive Scoring and Exact Keyframe Selection for Long-Video Question Answering
summary: Query-aware keyframe selection enables multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to process long videos using only a small set of question-relevant frames. Existing score-based methods, however, typically search within a fixed, uniformly sampled candidate pool, preventing evidence outside this pool from ever being selected. Given a limited relevance-scoring budget, the key challenge is to allocate evaluations adaptively to promising frames while continuing to explore underrepresented temporal regions. We introduce FORTE, a training-free framework that addresses this challenge through two stages: adaptive relevance scoring and global keyframe optimization. Starting from sparse, uniformly distributed observations, our efficient Gaussian-process relevance predictor estimates relevance for unscored frames, exploiting temporal locality and the approximately banded kernel structure to reduce the core computation from cubic to linear time in the number of frames for fixed bandwidth. The scoring stage then selects which frames to score next by balancing predicted relevance with temporal coverage, prioritizing promising regions while also exploring less-represented parts of the video. The optimization stage selects the final keyframes by maximizing an objective that jointly captures measured relevance and temporal coverage. We derive an exact algorithm that leverages the logarithmic coverage structure to identify the optimal subset of the scored candidate pool in time linear in the pool size, for a fixed final-frame budget. Experiments on four long-video question-answering benchmarks show that FORTE achieves the highest observed mean accuracy among the compared selectors under every tested scoring budget. Further evaluations demonstrate its consistent effectiveness across different relevance scorers and downstream MLLMs.

AI.tldr: FORTE 是一个免训练框架，通过自适应相关性评分与全局关键帧优化两阶段，解决长视频问答中查询相关关键帧选择问题，在四个基准上取得最高平均准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有关键帧选择方法多采用固定均匀采样的候选池进行评分搜索，导致池外证据永远无法被选中；在评分预算有限时，关键挑战在于如何自适应地将评估分配给有前景的帧，同时持续探索时间上代表性不足的区域。
AI.method: FORTE 分两阶段：1）自适应相关性评分——从稀疏均匀观测出发，用高效的 Gaussian-process 相关性预测器估计未评分帧的相关性，利用时间局部性与近似带状核结构，将核心计算从帧数的立方复杂度降为线性；评分阶段依据预测相关性加时间覆盖度的平衡来选择下一批待评分帧，兼顾开发与探索。2）全局关键帧优化——最大化同时刻画实测相关性与时间覆盖度的目标函数，利用对数覆盖结构设计精确算法，在固定最终帧预算下以候选池规模的线性时间求解最优子集。
AI.result: 在四个长视频问答基准上，FORTE 在每种测试评分预算下均取得所比较选择器中最高的观测平均准确率；进一步实验表明其在不同相关性评分器和下游 MLLM 上均保持稳定有效性。
AI.conclusion: FORTE 通过自适应评分与全局优化的结合，在有限评分预算下实现更优的关键帧选择，方法无需训练且具有良好泛化性。

title: Gestalt: Large Multimodal Interplay Model
summary: In this paper, we propose Gestalt, a new paradigm of large multimodal model built around multimodal interplay. Despite rapid advances, large multimodal models are reaching a bottleneck: existing approaches focus primarily on accommodating additional modalities while overlooking the distinct characteristics of each modality and the relations among them. Motivated by the multistage property of human multisensory perception, we propose a multimodal interplay pyramid that organizes multimodal modeling as a progression from modality-specific processing, through cross-modal alignment, to deeper multimodal integration. Guided by this pyramid, Gestalt adopts a unified discrete diffusion framework and an interplay-partitioned architecture, with learnable interplay tokens mediating cross-modal exchange and integration. The pyramid also structures its data organization and training strategy. Strong performance across image generation, multimodal understanding, and text-only evaluation shows that Gestalt significantly improves cross-modal integration while preserving modality-specific information, effectively harnessing the strengths of diffusion-based multimodal models and offering a promising path toward unified multimodal intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Gestalt，一种以多模态交互为核心的新型大型多模态模型范式，通过"多模态交互金字塔"组织建模过程，在图像生成、多模态理解等任务上取得优异表现。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态模型主要致力于容纳更多模态，却忽视了各模态的独特特性及模态间关系，导致发展遭遇瓶颈。受人类多感官感知的多阶段特性启发，作者希望以交互为核心重构多模态建模。
AI.method: 提出多模态交互金字塔，将建模组织为从模态特定处理、跨模态对齐到深度多模态整合的递进过程；据此采用统一离散扩散框架与交互分区架构，通过可学习的交互token（interplay tokens）中介跨模态交换与整合，并以此结构组织数据与训练策略。
AI.result: 在图像生成、多模态理解和纯文本评测上均表现强劲，显著提升了跨模态整合能力，同时保留了模态特定信息。
AI.conclusion: Gestalt有效发挥了基于扩散的多模态模型优势，为通向统一多模态智能提供了一条有前景的路径。

title: Discrete Annotation, Continuous Preference: Rethinking Supervision for Accurate and Generalizable Aesthetic Image Cropping
comment: Code, model, and data are available at https://github.com/zzqingz/CPIC
summary: Aesthetic image cropping aims to identify the optimal crop of an image in terms of aesthetics and composition. While supervision based on annotated data is fundamental, the field has been hindered by a long-standing problem: existing datasets suffer from (1) human subjectivity and (2) rigid discreteness confined to fixed sampling grids. These flawed annotations not only limit the accuracy and generalization of trained models but also severely distort fair evaluation. To overcome this, we propose to model human cropping preference as a multi-peaked, continuous, and sharp field over the crop space. We introduce the Continuous Preference Field (CPF), which recovers a dense preference landscape from discrete annotations through (1) peak clustering, (2) off-lattice refinement, (3) negative shaping, and (4) field assembly. Based on this, we train CPIC, a VLM-based cropping model optimized via GRPO with the CPF reward, which overcomes template collapse, achieving state-of-the-art performance and exceptional out-of-domain generalization. Finally, to resolve the long-standing benchmark evaluation crisis, we introduce CPICD, a comprehensive recalibration of existing ground-truth boxes. By leveraging the CPF to correct grid-bound artifacts across mainstream benchmarks, CPICD establishes a rigorous and reliable foundation for future cropping research. Extensive experiments and user studies demonstrate the superiority of our CPF, CPIC, and CPICD. Code, model, and data are available at https://github.com/zzqingz/CPIC.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对图像美学裁剪中标注数据存在的主观性与离散网格刚性两大问题，提出连续偏好场CPF建模人类裁剪偏好，训练VLM裁剪模型CPIC，并构建重校准基准CPICD，实现SOTA性能与跨域泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有图像裁剪数据集存在两个长期问题：(1) 人类标注的主观性；(2) 偏好被局限于固定采样网格的刚性离散表示。这些缺陷不仅限制模型精度与泛化能力，还严重扭曲了公平评测。
AI.method: 将人类裁剪偏好建模为裁剪空间上多峰、连续且尖锐的偏好场，提出连续偏好场（CPF），通过峰值聚类、离格精化、负向塑形与场组装四个步骤，从离散标注中恢复稠密偏好景观；基于CPF奖励，用GRPO优化VLM裁剪模型CPIC；并提出CPICD对现有真值框进行重校准。
AI.result: CPIC克服了模板坍缩问题，取得SOTA性能与优异的域外泛化能力；CPICD纠正主流基准中受网格约束的标注伪影；大量实验与用户研究验证了CPF、CPIC与CPICD的优越性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将裁剪偏好建模为连续偏好场，可有效缓解标注主观性与离散化缺陷，提升模型性能与泛化性，并为图像裁剪研究建立更严谨可靠的评测基础。

title: Just Align $\bm{x}$: Aligning Predictions, Not Representations
summary: Representation alignment has become an effective way to accelerate diffusion training, but its benefits do not transfer reliably to pixel-space clean-image prediction. In JiT, we find that auxiliary feature alignment can improve access to semantic features while reducing access to image variation needed for clean-image prediction, creating a mismatch between the auxiliary objective and the denoising task. This suggests a different principle: auxiliary supervision should improve the prediction target itself rather than impose a separate representation target. We introduce JAx (Just Align x), a prediction-supervision method that aligns clean-image predictions across noise levels. JAx couples a noisier student observation with a cleaner observation through a Markov degradation that preserves the original JiT input distribution. Under this coupling, the oracle prediction from the cleaner state has the same conditional mean as the optimal JiT target, while its conditional target covariance is no greater. Thus, oracle prediction alignment preserves the population JiT objective up to a constant while providing a lower-variance training target. To make this construction practical with an imperfect EMA teacher, JAx combines ground-truth supervision with a reliability-gated coupling band that selects nearby teacher states based on prediction risk. On ImageNet 256x256, JAx consistently improves FID and accelerates convergence across JiT-B/16, L/16, and H/16, without an external encoder or changes to the architecture or sampling procedure. Gradient diagnostics further show reduced minibatch gradient variance, while ablations demonstrate that the gains cannot be explained by time reweighting alone. These results show that prediction-space supervision provides a simple and principled alternative to representation alignment for pixel-space generative models.

AI.tldr: JAx将辅助监督从"表征对齐"转向"预测对齐"，通过跨噪声水平的马尔可夫耦合对齐干净图像预测，在ImageNet 256x256上稳定提升FID并加速收敛。
AI.motivation: 表征对齐虽能加速扩散训练，但其收益无法可靠迁移到像素空间的干净图像预测。在JiT中，辅助特征对齐提升了语义特征的可获取性，却削弱了干净图像预测所需的图像变化信息，导致辅助目标与去噪任务之间出现错配。这提示一条新的原则：辅助监督应改进预测目标本身，而非强加一个独立的表征目标。
AI.method: 提出JAx（Just Align x），一种预测监督方法，在不同噪声水平间对齐干净图像预测。它通过保持原始JiT输入分布的马尔可夫退化过程，将一个噪声更大的学生观测与一个更干净的观测耦合。在该耦合下，更干净状态的oracle预测与最优JiT目标具有相同的条件均值，而条件目标协方差不大于后者，从而在保序（至多相差常数）总体JiT目标的同时提供更低方差的训练目标。为实现不完美EMA教师的实用化，JAx结合真值监督与基于预测风险、选取邻近教师状态的可靠性门控耦合带。
AI.result: 在ImageNet 256x256上，JAx在JiT-B/16、L/16、H/16上一致提升FID并加速收敛，且无需外部编码器，也不改变架构或采样流程。梯度诊断显示小批量梯度方差降低，消融实验表明收益无法仅由时间重加权解释。
AI.conclusion: 预测空间的监督为像素空间生成模型提供了一个简单且有原则的表征对齐替代方案。

title: HAWK: Rethinking Multimodal Drafting for Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding has achieved substantial lossless speedups for LLMs, but remains less effective for large vision-language models (LVLMs), where lightweight drafters struggle to use rich multimodal information. A second limitation is that standard distillation supervises the drafter only along the original training trajectory, without modeling how target predictions shift after the drafter's own proposals. As drafting moves away from this trajectory, the drafter can increasingly disagree with the target, reducing acceptance in later steps. We propose HAWK to address both limitations. HAWK uses representation similarity to select informative target layers and learns how to combine their hidden states. For visual information, it directly provides the drafter with compressed visual hidden states from the target model instead of raw visual tokens, making the visual information easier for a shallow drafter to use. HAWK also trains the drafter to capture how target predictions change after its own proposals, improving its agreement with the target during multi-step drafting. On SmolVLM-256M across ten multimodal benchmarks, HAWK raises average acceptance length from 3.32 to 4.08 and speedup from 2.19x to 2.60x over EAGLE-3 under greedy decoding, and from 2.89 to 3.41 and 1.92x to 2.19x under sampling.

AI.tldr: 提出HAWK方法，解决大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）中投机解码草稿模型难以利用多模态信息、以及蒸馏仅在原始轨迹上监督导致后续接受率下降的问题，通过表示相似度选择并融合目标层隐状态、提供压缩视觉隐状态、并训练草稿模型建模自身提议后的目标预测变化。
AI.motivation: 投机解码对LLM效果显著，但在LVLM上效果有限：轻量草稿模型难以利用丰富的多模态信息；同时标准蒸馏仅沿原始训练轨迹监督草稿模型，未建模草稿模型自身提议后目标预测的偏移，导致偏离轨迹时草稿与目标分歧增大，后续步骤接受率下降。
AI.method: HAWK包含三方面设计：(1) 利用表示相似度选择有信息量的目标层，并学习如何组合其隐状态；(2) 对视觉信息，直接将目标模型压缩后的视觉隐状态提供给草稿模型，而非原始视觉token，使浅层草稿更易使用；(3) 训练草稿模型捕捉其自身提议后目标预测的变化，提升多步起草中与目标的一致性。
AI.result: 在SmolVLM-256M上，跨十个多模态基准测试：贪心解码下平均接受长度由3.32提升至4.08，相对EAGLE-3的加速比由2.19x提升至2.60x；采样解码下接受长度由2.89提升至3.41，加速比由1.92x提升至2.19x。
AI.conclusion: HAWK通过改进多模态信息利用与草稿-目标对齐训练，显著提升了LVLM投机解码的接受长度与加速比，验证了方法的有效性。

title: Harnessing Vision-Language Models for Perceptual Quality Assessment and Autonomous Content Adjustment in Augmented Reality
comment: To be published in VRST 2026. Main Manuscript: 12 pages, 5 figures; Supplemental Materials: 7 pages, 10 figures. The accompanying public repository can be accessed by visiting https://github.com/Duke-I3T-Lab/RateAR
summary: Advancements in augmented reality (AR) continue to foster innovative solutions, facilitating novel methodologies within educational systems, healthcare delivery, and risk-mitigation protocols. However, optimizing for end-user immersion and comfort remains challenging, as AR head-mounted displays contend with constrained scene geometry, spatial jitter, and temporal instability. User studies are the standard AR evaluation method for visual quality, but their cost, diminishing scalability, and inflexibility pose bottlenecks during iterative application design. To address this problem, we present an automated framework for AR content evaluation and refinement, built on vision-language models (VLMs), to evaluate and predict the visual fidelity of AR scenes as perceived by users. First, we introduce RateAR, a benchmark of AR images and videos collected across diverse scenes and environmental conditions, with good-to-excellent reliability (ICC(2,5) >= .90) across perceptual factors, including object placement, scale, and shadow consistency. Subsequently, we evaluate eleven commercial VLMs on the crafted benchmark. Results support that VLM-based quality predictions strongly correlate with human subjective judgments, achieving Spearman's rank-order correlations of up to 0.8695. An ablation study further suggests that, compared to other prompting strategies, our contextual prompting yields better alignment with human ratings while balancing introduced complexity cues. Building on these findings, we construct an automated AR content adjustment system and conduct a 21-participant user study. More than 90% of participants found that the system improved placement and size coherence of virtual content.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的AR内容自动评估与优化框架，构建RateAR基准并验证VLM预测与人类主观评分高度相关，进而实现自动调整系统，用户研究显示其可提升虚拟内容的放置与尺寸一致性。
AI.motivation: AR头戴显示受限于场景几何约束、空间抖动与时间不稳定性，难以优化终端用户的沉浸感与舒适度。传统用户研究是视觉质量评估的标准方法，但成本高、可扩展性差、灵活性不足，成为迭代式应用设计的瓶颈，因此需要自动化的AR内容评估与优化方案。
AI.method: 1) 构建RateAR基准，涵盖多样场景与环境条件下采集的AR图像和视频，在物体放置、尺度、阴影一致性等感知因子上具有良好至优秀的信度（ICC(2,5)>=.90）；2) 在该基准上评估11个商用VLM；3) 进行消融研究比较不同提示策略；4) 基于上述发现构建自动化AR内容调整系统，并开展21名参与者的用户研究。
AI.result: VLM质量预测与人类主观判断强相关，Spearman等级相关最高达0.8695；消融研究表明，相比其他提示策略，上下文提示在平衡引入的复杂度线索的同时与人类评分对齐更好；用户研究中超过90%的参与者认为系统改善了虚拟内容的放置与尺寸一致性。
AI.conclusion: 基于VLM的自动化框架可有效评估和预测AR场景的视觉保真度，并支持AR内容的自动调整，为替代或缓解传统用户研究瓶颈提供了可行途径。

title: VisionQ: VLM-as-a-Judge Taxonomy, Dataset and Benchmark for Qualitative Analysis in Computer Vision
summary: Qualitative comparison figures are central evidence in computer vision papers, and vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used to judge them. Yet existing benchmarks score only scalar quality or overall preference, so a judge can be rewarded for picking the preferred image for the wrong visual reason. We introduce VisionQ, the first benchmark built from peer-reviewed CV comparison figures that grounds every judgment in a named visual criterion: each question states the criterion, and a judge is credited only when it selects the output the authors identify as best on that criterion. We call this task criterion-conditioned visual discrimination. VisionQ comprises (1) a corpus of 1,409 CVPR and ICCV papers with 1,800+ validated comparison figures and 3,911 hand-annotated data points linking method crops to author-stated visual claims; (2) a six-axis, 51-leaf taxonomy of the visual criteria behind qualitative judgment; (3) a criterion-conditioned evaluation protocol that hides method names, captions, and paper identity and reports accuracy per criterion; and (4) VisionQ-Judge, a DPO-tuned Gemma-4-E4B judge trained on symmetric evidence pairs, which reduces last-option predictions by 7.0pp and improves accuracy by 2.5pp on a held-out test set. Evaluating 20 open- and closed-source VLM judges, we find that the strongest reach only 63.1% accuracy (chance 32.2%) and that reliability varies sharply across criteria. Code: https://github.com/ReML-AI/visionq. Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/visionq-anon-2026/VisionQ-1k.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 VisionQ，首个基于同行评审 CV 论文定性对比图、以命名视觉准则为条件的评测基准，用于评估 VLM 判定能力；含 1,409 篇论文、1,800+ 对比图、3,911 条标注、六轴 51 叶准则分类法及隐藏方法名等信息的评测协议，并训练了 DPO 调优的 VisionQ-Judge。
AI.motivation: 定性对比图是 CV 论文的核心证据，VLM 日益被用于评判这些图，但现有基准仅给出标量质量分或整体偏好，导致评判模型可能因错误的视觉理由而选对偏好图像，评测缺乏可解释性与准则约束。
AI.method: 构建 VisionQ 基准：从 1,409 篇 CVPR/ICCV 论文收集 1,800+ 经校验的对比图与 3,911 条人工标注数据点，将方法裁剪图与作者声明的视觉主张关联；建立六轴 51 叶的视觉准则分类法；设计准则条件化评测协议（隐藏方法名、图注与论文身份，并报告各准则准确率）；在对称证据对上用 DPO 调优 Gemma-4-E4B 得到 VisionQ-Judge。
AI.result: VisionQ-Judge 将末选项预测降低 7.0pp，在留出测试集上准确率提升 2.5pp；在 20 个开源与闭源 VLM 评判模型上评测，最强模型仅达 63.1% 准确率（随机为 32.2%），且不同准则间可靠性差异显著。
AI.conclusion: 现有 VLM 评判模型在准则条件化视觉判别任务上仍远未可靠，需以准则为依据进行评测；VisionQ 提供了数据、分类法、协议与调优模型，为可解释、细粒度的对比图评判研究奠定基础。

title: SemanTok: Predictable Semantic Tokens for Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation
comment: 29 pages, 22 figures, including references and appendix; 9 pages of main text
summary: Recent video-based world models pair the scalability of autoregressive (AR) prediction with the visual quality of diffusion models. The choice of scene tokenizer is paramount for the optimal performance of each of these, both in terms of fidelity and semantics. Flexible-length, coarse-to-fine tokenizers yield exactly that: the first coarse tokens carry the clip's global semantics while later tokens further specify details. Existing flexible tokenizers only apply a representation-alignment (REPA) loss on early decoder hidden states, a target the decoder can partly meet from its noised input instead. We introduce SemanTok, a flexible video tokenizer that feeds frozen DINO features into its encoder and adds lightweight heads that reconstruct them from each retained token prefix alone.
