SemanTok achieves high semantic alignment and video fidelity at every AR model size: a 201M SemanTok AR model matches or beats a VideoFlexTok AR model $3.4\times$ its size, and larger SemanTok AR models further improve fidelity. It keeps semantic alignment on out-of-distribution classes and gives the decoder higher semantic alignment at every noise level, including pure noise. It performs well in both reconstruction and generation, and its short token prefixes are cheaper to predict and give better generation fidelity, with pixel detail deferred to later tokens.

AI.tldr: SemanTok 是一种灵活长度的视频分词器，通过将冻结的 DINO 特征输入编码器并添加轻量重建头，在任意自回归模型规模下实现高语义对齐与高视频保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有视频世界模型结合了自回归预测的可扩展性与扩散模型的视觉质量，而场景分词器的选择对保真度和语义性能至关重要。灵活长度的粗到细分词器中，早期粗粒度 token 承载全局语义、后续 token 细化细节。但现有灵活分词器仅在早期解码器隐藏状态上施加表征对齐（REPA）损失，而该目标可部分由解码器从含噪输入中直接满足，导致对齐效果受限。
AI.method: 提出 SemanTok：将冻结的 DINO 特征输入编码器，并添加轻量级预测头，使其仅从每个保留的 token 前缀重建这些 DINO 特征，从而在任意 token 前缀长度上强制实现语义对齐。
AI.result: 在每一自回归模型规模下，SemanTok 均取得高语义对齐与高视频保真度：201M 的 SemanTok AR 模型可匹配或超越参数量为其 3.4 倍的 VideoFlexTok AR 模型，且更大的 SemanTok AR 模型进一步提升了保真度。它在分布外类别上保持语义对齐，并在包括纯噪声在内的每个噪声水平上为解码器提供更高的语义对齐。在重建与生成任务中均表现良好，短 token 前缀预测成本更低且生成保真度更好，像素细节被推迟到后续 token 中。
AI.conclusion: SemanTok 通过从每个 token 前缀重建冻结 DINO 特征的方式改进灵活视频分词器的语义对齐，在多种规模下同时提升语义对齐、重建与生成性能，并展现出更好的分布外泛化能力与噪声鲁棒性。

title: Soundwich: Video Generation with Layered and Controllable Audio
summary: Recent joint audio-video generative models can synthesize realistic videos with synchronized sound, but typically generate audio as a single mixed track. This limits source-level control and differs from practical audiovisual workflows, where speech, music, sound effects, and ambient sounds are represented as separate editable tracks. We introduce Soundwich, a training-free framework that transforms a frozen joint audio-video flow-matching model into a generator of multiple synchronized, independently editable audio stems coupled to a shared video. Soundwich generates separate audio stems with explicit control over their temporal activity. To keep separately generated sounds coherent, we introduce a shared scene representation that communicates global audiovisual context across stems while preserving their source-level separation. We further route cross-modal interactions between each audio stem and its corresponding visual source, improving audiovisual consistency. The resulting stems remain synchronized with the video and can be independently retimed, muted, replaced, or remixed. Experiments and human evaluations show improved temporal control, source separation, and naturalness, while enabling flexible source-level editing within coherent audiovisual generation. Code is available at https://github.com/CodyNing/Soundwich.

AI.tldr: Soundwich是一个免训练框架，将冻结的联合音视频流匹配模型改造为生成与同一视频同步、可独立编辑的多路音频stem，并保持源级分离与音视频一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有联合音视频生成模型虽能合成带同步声音的真实视频，但通常只生成单一混合音轨，缺乏源级控制，且与实际工作流（语音、音乐、音效、环境声作为独立可编辑轨道）不符。
AI.method: 提出Soundwich免训练框架：将冻结的联合音视频flow-matching模型转化为多stem生成器；每路stem可显式控制其时间活动；引入共享场景表征在stem间传递全局音视频上下文以保持独立生成声音的连贯性；并将每路音频stem与其对应视觉源的跨模态交互进行路由以提升一致性。
AI.result: 实验与人工评估显示，在时间控制、源分离和自然度方面均有提升，同时可在连贯的音视频生成中实现灵活的源级编辑；生成的stem保持与视频同步，可独立重新定时、静音、替换或重新混音。
AI.conclusion: Soundwich实现了源级可编辑的连贯音视频生成，代码已开源。

title: FedMAD: Modulation-Aware Directional Aggregation for Federated Learning in Remote Sensing Image Classification
summary: Federated learning (FL) has recently attracted increasing attention in remote sensing (RS) since it enables collaborative model training across decentralized RS image archives without requiring direct access to local data. However, FL performance significantly degrades when the data distributions between clients are heterogeneous, which often occurs due to geographical differences, seasonal changes, and varying image acquisition and atmospheric conditions. To address this challenge, in this letter, we propose a novel personalized FL framework (denoted as FedMAD) for RS image classification problems. The proposed framework separates globally shared representation parameters from client-specific adaptation parameters to preserve client-specific features while maintaining globally transferable representations. This is achieved by integrating lightweight modulation modules and local batch normalization layers into the backbone network. Although globally shared parameters are collaboratively optimized between clients, client-specific parameters remain local to preserve domain-specific feature characteristics. In addition, FedMAD introduces a modulation-aware directional aggregation strategy that dynamically adjusts the importance of aggregation for each client according to the alignment of local modulation updates. This allows the global optimization process to suppress conflicting client updates originating from heterogeneous data distributions while enhancing the contribution of clients with consistent adaptation behaviors. The experimental results obtained on the BigEarthNet-S2 and EuroSAT datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of FedMAD compared to state-of-the-art FL algorithms under heterogeneous RS data distributions. The code of the proposed framework will be publicly available at https://git.tu-berlin.de/rsim/fedmad.

AI.tldr: 本文提出个性化联邦学习框架FedMAD，通过分离全局共享表示参数与客户端特定适配参数，并结合调制感知的方向聚合策略，缓解遥感图像分类中数据异构导致的性能下降。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习在遥感领域受到关注，因其可在不直接访问本地数据的情况下协作训练模型。但客户端间数据分布异构（地理差异、季节变化、成像与大气条件不同）会显著降低FL性能，因此需要一种能兼顾全局可迁移表示与客户端特定特征的个性化FL方法。
AI.method: 提出个性化FL框架FedMAD，将全局共享表示参数与客户端特定适配参数分离；在骨干网络中集成轻量调制模块与本地批归一化层。全局共享参数在客户端间协同优化，客户端特定参数保留在本地以维持域特定特征。同时引入调制感知的方向聚合策略，根据本地调制更新的一致性动态调整各客户端聚合重要性，从而抑制异构数据分布带来的冲突更新并增强一致适配客户端的贡献。
AI.result: 在BigEarthNet-S2和EuroSAT数据集上的实验结果表明，在异构遥感数据分布下，FedMAD优于当前最先进的联邦学习算法。
AI.conclusion: FedMAD通过全局共享参数与客户端特定参数的解耦以及调制感知方向聚合，有效应对遥感数据异构问题，提升联邦遥感图像分类性能；代码将公开。

title: Personalized Image Generation with Reasoning and Reflection
summary: Personalized image generation has remained narrowly focused on conditional synthesis from curated visual exemplars, rather than capturing who a user is. In practice, however, a user's personal context is much richer, comprising reviews, posts, images, captions, and metadata accumulated over time. A truly personalized generator should leverage this history to produce images aligned with the user's lifestyle and aesthetic preferences. To this end, we introduce the first unified benchmark for personalized image generation from user histories. The benchmark comprises two complementary tasks and a multi-axis evaluation protocol that assesses target fidelity, visual quality, user distinguishability, semantic alignment with the user's history, and task-specific utility. Grounded in real-world e-commerce and social media settings, the benchmark includes: (1) Personalized Scene Generation, which places a given object in a scene that reflects a user's preferences and lifestyle, motivated by personalized product presentation; and (2) Personalized Creative Generation, which generates a novel image on a specified topic that is faithful to a user's aesthetic and visual identity, motivated by social media content creation. We further propose PEARL, which couples a multimodal reasoner with a frozen image generator in an interleaved reason-reflect loop optimized with differential data reward. Across both tasks, PEARL outperforms strong baselines, achieving an average improvement of 15% across personalization metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个基于用户历史记录的个性化图像生成统一基准，包含两个任务及多维度评估协议，并提出PEARL方法，在个性化指标上平均提升15%。
AI.motivation: 现有工作局限于从精选视觉样本进行条件合成，未能真正捕捉"用户是谁"；而现实中用户个人语境更丰富，包含随时间长积累的评论、帖子、图像、标题和元数据。真正个性化的生成器应利用这些历史，生成符合用户生活方式与审美偏好的图像。
AI.method: 提出首个基于用户历史的个性化图像生成统一基准，涵盖两个互补任务，并设计多轴评估协议，评估目标保真度、视觉质量、用户可区分性、与用户历史的语义对齐及任务特定效用。基准根植于真实电商与社交媒体场景：(1) 个性化场景生成，将给定物体置于反映用户偏好与生活方式的场景中，动机为个性化商品展示；(2) 个性化创意生成，针对指定主题生成忠于用户审美与视觉身份的新图像，动机为社交媒体内容创作。方法上提出PEARL，将多模态推理器与冻结的图像生成器耦合，采用交错"推理-反思"循环，并以差分数据奖励优化。
AI.result: 在两个任务上，PEARL均优于强基线，在个性化指标上平均提升15%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将个性化图像生成从"精选样本条件合成"推进到"用户历史驱动生成"，通过统一基准与PEARL方法验证了利用用户长期语境进行个性化生成的可行性与有效性。

title: Video Evidence Indexing: Learning Where to Look from Video Previews for Token-Budgeted Long-Video Question Answering
summary: Long-video question answering is limited by the high cost of visual tokens and by the fixed context width of current VLMs. A long-video question may require broad temporal coverage, but the answer is often supported by only a compact set of moments. To locate these moments efficiently, we propose token-budgeted Video Evidence Indexing (VEI): given a dense low-resolution Video Preview, the model constructs a compact high-resolution Evidence Set for final reasoning. We treat VEI as a policy that must jointly solve \textit{evidence localization}, which finds question-relevant moments, and \textit{budget planning}, which decides where to spend the limited high-resolution frame budget. We implement this idea with an inference pipeline: the Video Preview provides cheap global coverage, Video Evidence Indexing constructs the Evidence Set, and Answer Generation combines both inputs for final VQA. To address missing frame-level supervision, we adopt privileged self-distillation, where an answer-aware teacher guides the normal test-time policy on student-generated indexing traces. We explore previews at 1, 6, 12, and 24 visual tokens per frame, training a single policy that supports all four resolutions. Experiments show that Video Evidence Indexing improves accuracy under limited visual budgets, and self-distillation further improves both QA accuracy and temporal evidence localization.

AI.tldr: 提出Token-Budgeted Video Evidence Indexing (VEI)，将长视频问答分解为证据定位与预算规划，通过稀疏高分辨率证据集替代全量视觉token，并用特权自蒸馏解决帧级监督缺失，在有限视觉预算下提升准确率与时序定位。
AI.motivation: 长视频问答受限于视觉token成本高以及现有VLM固定上下文宽度；长视频问题需要广 temporal coverage，但答案往往仅由少量关键片段支撑，全域高分辨率建模低效且不可行。
AI.method: 将VEI建模为策略，联合求解证据定位（找问题相关时刻）与预算规划（决定高分辨率帧预算分配）。推理流水线：低分辨率Video Preview提供廉价全局覆盖→Video Evidence Indexing构建高分辨率Evidence Set→Answer Generation融合两者做VQA。为弥补帧级监督缺失，采用特权自蒸馏：answer-aware teacher在student生成的indexing traces上指导常规测试时策略。探索1/6/12/24 tokens/帧的preview，训练单一策略支持四种分辨率。
AI.result: 在有限视觉预算下，Video Evidence Indexing提升问答准确率；自蒸馏进一步同时提升QA准确率和时序证据定位性能。
AI.conclusion: 以"预览+稀疏高分辨率证据"的token预算化索引可有效缓解长视频VQA的token成本与固定上下文瓶颈，特权自蒸馏是解决无帧级标注的有效手段，单策略多分辨率具备通用性。

title: What Builds the Scene? Luminance Dominates Geometry Formation in 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Standard 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) learns geometry and appearance jointly from RGB supervision, making it difficult to isolate how luminance and chroma contribute to the learned representation. We study this by training models under different channel supervision, freezing their non-appearance parameters (position, scale, rotation, and opacity), and re-estimating appearance with the same solver before comparing held-out reconstruction. Across eleven benchmark scenes with four independent runs each, geometry learned from luminance alone supports held-out reconstruction 0.085 dB below RGB-trained geometry on average. If chroma is deleted from a trained model, a sufficiently expressive solver can re-fit it on the frozen geometry to the original quality or slightly better. Higher-order spherical harmonics contribute much more reconstruction quality to luminance than to chroma, improving PSNR by 1.44 dB versus 0.19 dB on average, although on mirror-like surfaces hue does still change with viewpoint. The luminance advantage is even larger when geometry is being formed. Chroma-only supervision produces geometry 3.9-5.5 dB worse than luminance-only supervision after the same appearance solve; densification explains part of this gap. Overall, geometry formation in standard 3DGS is strongly luminance-dominated but not luminance-exclusive, and much of the chromatic appearance can be recovered after spatial support has formed.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过通道监督实验解耦3DGS中亮度与色度的贡献，发现几何形成强依赖亮度但非唯一，色度外观可在空间支撑形成后重新拟合恢复。
AI.motivation: 标准3DGS从RGB监督中联合学习几何与外观，难以分离亮度与色度各自对学习表示的贡献。作者旨在厘清几何形成究竟是亮度主导还是色度主导，以及色彩外观的可恢复性。
AI.method: 在不同通道监督下训练模型，冻结非外观参数（位置、缩放、旋转、不透明度），用同一求解器重新估计外观后再比较留出重建；在11个基准场景各进行4次独立运行，并分析球谐高阶项、密集化与镜像表面视角依赖色相的影响。
AI.result: 仅亮度学习的几何平均比RGB训练几何低0.085 dB；删除色度后足够表达的求解器可在冻结几何上重新拟合至原质量或略优；高阶球谐对亮度贡献远大于色度（平均PSNR提升1.44 dB vs 0.19 dB），但镜面表面色相仍随视角变化；几何形成阶段亮度优势更大；仅色度监督几何比仅亮度低3.9–5.5 dB，密集化解释部分差距。
AI.conclusion: 标准3DGS的几何形成强烈由亮度主导但非亮度唯一，大部分色度外观可在空间支撑形成后恢复。

title: VTV-FM: Flow Matching through Variational Terminal-Velocity Closure
summary: Flow matching (FM) learns generative transport by fitting continuous-time motion from a simple source distribution to the data distribution. Most existing methods use first-order bridges: once a source and a target sample are paired, the path is a straight motion with constant velocity. FM with optimal transport (OT) improves the pairing, but the bridge itself remains linear, limiting its ability to model curved motion, acceleration, and changing directions. A natural remedy is to use second-order phase-space dynamics; however, learning the bridge requires target-side terminal-velocity information that static datasets do not provide. We propose Variational Terminal-Velocity Flow Matching (VTV-FM), a second-order FM framework that derives the missing velocity by minimizing acceleration energy, yielding a closed-form closure for static data. The same minimum-acceleration variational construction also defines the OT pairing cost and the acceleration targets used for training. Experiments on low-dimensional datasets, PDE-governed physical fields, and CIFAR-10 show that VTV-FM improves transport geometry and generation quality over first-order and high-order FM baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VTV-FM（变分终端速度流匹配），一种二阶流匹配框架，通过最小化加速度能量推导出静态数据缺失的终端速度闭式解，并用同一变分构造定义最优传输配对代价与加速度训练目标。
AI.motivation: 现有流匹配（FM）方法多采用一阶桥：源样本与目标样本配对后，路径为匀速直线运动。结合最优传输（OT）可改进配对，但桥本身仍是线性的，难以建模曲线运动、加速度及方向变化。改用二阶相空间动力学是自然思路，然而学习该桥需要目标端的终端速度信息，而静态数据集并不提供这一信息。
AI.method: 提出变分终端速度流匹配（VTV-FM）：一种二阶流匹配框架，通过最小化加速度能量来推导缺失的终端速度，从而为静态数据给出闭式（closure）解；同一"最小加速度"变分构造同时定义了OT配对代价以及训练所用的加速度目标。
AI.result: 在低维数据集、PDE支配的物理场以及CIFAR-10上的实验表明，VTV-FM在传输几何与生成质量上均优于一阶及高阶流匹配基线。
AI.conclusion: 以最小加速度变分构造统一处理终端速度推断、OT配对与训练目标，可有效实现静态数据下的二阶流匹配，显著改善传输几何与生成质量。

title: Paying for Too Many Tokens? Valid and Cost-Efficient Multimodal LLM Annotation with Simple Heuristics
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) enable video annotation at scale, but costs accumulate quickly: processing a typical 60-second short-form video at one frame per second requires millions of tokens. To reduce costs, researchers rely on heuristics such as sampling a subset of frames, compressing videos into image grids, or using only a single modality. However, it remains unclear which heuristics save cost, and whether they preserve the downstream conclusions these annotations enable. To address this gap, we conduct a systematic evaluation of these heuristics using short-form videos, on two computational social science (CSS) tasks: sentiment and topic classification. We evaluate each configuration along three axes the literature typically treats separately: classification accuracy, validity of downstream inference, and per-video token cost. First, we find that accuracy and validity diverge: the highest-accuracy configuration can produce wrong conclusions. Second, modality value is not guaranteed: text alone can yield strong performance, indicating that adding modalities can add cost without adding signal. Finally, we find that cost can be decoupled from video length when annotating short-form videos: a single $2\times8$ image grid built via simple shot-transition detection approaches full-video understanding ($κ$ within~.05), at $\sim 15\%$ of the token cost. Based on these findings, we derive guidelines that can enable cost-aware VLM annotation in CSS.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了短视频视觉语言模型标注中的成本节约启发式方法，在情感与主题分类两个计算社科任务上，沿分类准确率、下游推断有效性、每视频token成本三轴评估，发现准确率与有效性会背离、模态未必增值、成本可与视频长度解耦（2×8图像网格以约15%成本达到全视频理解）。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）可规模化进行视频标注，但成本高昂：处理一段60秒短视频（每秒1帧）需数百万token。研究者常用启发式方法（抽帧、压缩为图像网格、仅用单一模态）来降本，但尚不清楚哪些启发式真正省钱，以及它们是否保留下游结论的有效性。
AI.method: 针对短视频，在计算社会科学（CSS）的两个任务（情感分类与主题分类）上开展系统评估；对每个配置沿文献通常分开处理的三条轴进行评估：分类准确率、下游推断有效性、每视频token成本。
AI.result: 第一，准确率与有效性发生背离：最高准确率的配置可能得出错误结论。第二，模态价值并非必然：仅用文本即可获得强性能，说明增加模态会增加成本却不增加信号。第三，短视频标注中成本可与视频长度解耦：通过简单镜头切换检测构建的单个2×8图像网格即可逼近全视频理解（κ差异在~.05内），而token成本仅为约15%。
AI.conclusion: 基于上述发现，本文提炼出指南，以支持CSS中成本感知的VLM标注。

title: Video Generation Models: A Survey of Post-Training and Alignment
comment: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR), 2026. Project page: https://github.com/people-robots/Awesome-Video-Generation-Post-Training
summary: Video generation has rapidly progressed from short, low-quality clips to high-resolution, long-duration sequences with complex spatiotemporal dynamics. Despite strong generative priors learned through large-scale pretraining, pretrained video models often fail to reliably follow human intent, maintain temporal coherence, or satisfy physical and safety constraints. Compared with image and text generation, alignment in video generation presents unique challenges, including error accumulation over time, motion-appearance coupling, multi-objective trade-offs, and limited supervision for temporal properties. These challenges motivate systematic post-training strategies that adapt pretrained models without retraining them from scratch. In this survey, we present the first comprehensive review of post-training and alignment in video generation models. We frame post-training as a unifying framework and distinguish between implicit alignment and explicit alignment based on how alignment signals are enforced. From this perspective, we organize existing approaches into four broad categories: supervised fine-tuning methods, self-training and distillation methods, preference- and reward-based methods, and inference-time methods. This taxonomy provides a coherent view of how alignment signals shape model behavior across both training and deployment. Beyond methodological advances, we review commonly used datasets, benchmarks, and evaluation practices, and discuss open challenges such as scalable reward design, long-horizon temporal consistency, stability-expressiveness trade-offs, and safety-aware generation. This survey aims to provide a structured conceptual foundation and practical guidance for advancing controllable and reliable video generation models.

AI.tldr: 本文是首篇系统综述视频生成模型后训练与对齐的研究，提出以隐式/显式对称为框架，将现有方法归为四类，并总结数据集、基准与开放挑战。
AI.motivation: 视频生成已从短时长、低质量片段发展到高分辨率、长时长且具有复杂时空动态的序列，尽管大规模预训练赋予了强生成先验，但模型仍难以可靠遵循人类意图、保持时序一致性并满足物理与安全约束。相较图像与文本生成，视频生成对齐面临误差随时间累积、运动-外观耦合、多目标权衡以及时序属性监督不足等独特挑战，这促使研究者采用系统的后训练策略，在不从头训练的前提下适配预训练模型。然而，该方向尚缺乏系统性综述。
AI.method: 作者将后训练构建为统一框架，并依据对齐信号的施加方式区分隐式对齐与显式对齐。在此视角下，将现有方法归纳为四大类：监督微调方法、自训练与蒸馏方法、偏好与奖励方法、推理时方法。此外，综述还梳理了常用数据集、基准与评估实践。
AI.result: 提出了首个针对视频生成模型后训练与对齐的全面综述，建立了统一的分类体系，系统整理了数据集、基准与评估方法，并识别了可扩展奖励设计、长时程时序一致性、稳定性-表现力权衡以及安全感知生成等开放挑战。
AI.conclusion: 该综述为推进可控且可靠的视频生成模型提供了结构化的概念基础与实践指导。

title: Geometric Similarity in VLM Low-Level Vision Representations
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have emerged as powerful candidates for universal vision backbones, with representative architectures including autoregressive (AR) models and diffusion transformers (DiTs). Yet, adapting them efficiently for all-in-one low-level image restoration remains a challenge. Crucially, the field lacks an understanding of how VLMs organize hidden-layer representations and whether these structurally distinct paradigms share a common geometric organization for pixel-level perception. Such shared organization is a prerequisite for building highly transferable, unified restoration VLMs and adapters. In this paper, we systematically investigate representational similarity across 24 low-level tasks spanning 5 categories. We propose GeoSim, a unified four-level framework that analyzes task-conditioned representations from global similarity, local geometry, sparse feature decomposition, and topological verification perspectives. Our formulation applies to the analysis of hidden states in AR models and feature maps in DiTs across same- and cross-task/model settings. Our results reveal the organizing principles of low-level visual representations while exposing their limits in cross-task and cross-model agreement. Ultimately, GeoSim provides an interpretability lens for probing latent transferability in low-level vision and diagnosing model limitations in task- or model-specific scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GeoSim，一个四级统一分析框架，系统研究 AR 与 DiT 两类视觉语言模型在 24 个低层视觉任务上的表征相似性与几何组织。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）被视为通用视觉骨干的候选，但将其高效适配到"一体化低层图像复原"仍具挑战。关键缺口在于：领域内尚不清楚 VLM 隐层表征如何组织，也不了解自回归（AR）与扩散 Transformer（DiT）这两种结构迥异的范式是否共享用于像素级感知的共同几何组织。这种共享组织是构建高可迁移、统一复原 VLM 与适配器的前提。
AI.method: 提出 GeoSim：一个统一四级框架，从全局相似性、局部几何、稀疏特征分解与拓扑验证四个视角分析任务条件化表征。该形式化适用于 AR 模型的隐状态与 DiT 的特征图，覆盖同任务/跨任务以及同模型/跨模型设置，评测范围涵盖 5 大类共 24 个低层任务。
AI.result: 结果揭示了低层视觉表征的组织原则，同时暴露了其在跨任务与跨模型一致性方面的局限。
AI.conclusion: GeoSim 为探测低层视觉中的潜在可迁移性、诊断任务或模型特定场景下的模型局限提供了可解释性视角。

title: Align Then Reason: A Multimodal Lip-Sync Judge for Dubbing
summary: Dubbing quality control requires a reference-free judge that can determine whether a candidate text line matches a speaker's visible articulation in both content and timing, using only silent video and text because dubbed audio may not yet exist. Existing visual speech recognizers and video-language models are poorly suited to this setting: even when fine-tuned to recover spoken content from lip motion, they remain largely insensitive to temporal errors. We introduce $\textit{Align Then Reason}$ (ATR), a multilingual lip-sync judge that first establishes a monotonic alignment between frame-level lip representations and the phonetic units of the candidate line, then reasons over this alignment to make the final judgment. An alignment scorer provides the LLM with both local evidence for each phonetic unit and a calibrated global alignment score, enabling it to reason jointly about content and timing. On a seven-language benchmark, our method improves mean AUC over the corresponding Qwen3.5 SFT baselines by 59.4%, 50.2%, and 50.8% with 2B, 4B, and 9B reasoners, respectively. The gains generalize across LLM families, reaching mean AUC improvements of 45.9% and 46.6% over the best baseline for LLaMA-3.1-8B and Mistral-7B, respectively. They also transfer across datasets to three unseen MuAViC languages. Furthermore, we evaluate on two downstream tasks built from real dubbing lines. On dub-line reranking, ATR-9B outperforms the best lip-reading baseline by 52.0%, while on script-to-clip assignment, ATR-9B improves over the best lip-reading baseline by 17.7%.

AI.tldr: 提出Align Then Reason（ATR）多语言唇形同步判定器，通过先建立唇部表征与音素单元的单调对齐再让LLM推理，实现无参考、仅用静音视频与文本的内容与时序联合判定，在多语言基准及下游配音任务上大幅超越基线。
AI.motivation: 配音质量控制需要无参考判定器，仅凭静音视频与候选文本判断其内容与时序是否与说话人的可见发音一致，因为配音音频可能尚不存在。现有视觉语音识别器与视频语言模型不适配该场景：即便微调后能从唇动恢复内容，仍对时序错误不敏感。
AI.method: ATR先建立帧级唇部表征与候选行音素单元之间的单调对齐，再基于该对齐进行推理给出最终判定。对齐评分器向LLM提供每个音素单元的局部证据以及经校准的全局对齐分数，使其能够联合推理内容与时序。
AI.result: 在七语言基准上，相比对应的Qwen3.5 SFT基线，2B、4B、9B推理器的平均AUC分别提升59.4%、50.2%、50.8%；跨LLM家族泛化，LLaMA-3.1-8B与Mistral-7B相对最佳基线分别提升45.9%与46.6%；并迁移至三个未见过的MuAViC语言。在下游任务中，配音行重排序ATR-9B比最佳唇读基线高52.0%，脚本到片段分配ATR-9B提升17.7%。
AI.conclusion: ATR通过"先对齐后推理"的范式有效解决了唇形同步判定中时序不敏感的问题，在多语言、跨模型家族、跨数据集及真实配音下游任务上均取得显著且一致的提升。

title: SmoothOperator: Enhancing Representations for Fine-grained Open-set Recognition via Modulated Label Smoothing
summary: Open Set Recognition (OSR) aims to enable models to accurately classify known classes while rejecting samples from unseen classes. A key challenge in OSR lies in the inability to model the unbounded distribution of unknown classes during training, often leading to the misclassification of samples from these classes. Rather than modeling unknowns, recent work shapes the feature space so that known classes are compact and well separated, and spherical representation learning methods have achieved strong results this way. Label smoothing has been identified as one of the key drivers of this success, yet it applies the same coefficient to every training sample, regardless of how well each sample is already embedded. We show that the spherical representation learning objectives used in OSR share a single alignment--uniformity structure in which labels enter only through the alignment term. Label smoothing therefore acts as an alignment dial, and a fixed coefficient sets this dial to the same value for every sample. We propose a plug-in, SmoothOperator (SmoothOP), which sets the smoothing coefficient of each sample from its \textbf{prominence}, an embedding-space signal measuring how clearly the sample's own class stands out against its strongest competing class. Our method integrates into four existing spherical representation learning methods at minimal training overhead. SmoothOP assigns strong smoothing to samples with high prominence, which reduces their alignment and relaxes their pull. On the Semantic Shift Benchmark, SmoothOP-augmented variants generally outperform their base objectives across datasets, degrees of semantic shift, and OSR post-processors, with gains of up to 4.7\% in AUROC, OSCR, and closed-set accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出即插即用的平滑系数分配方法 SmoothOP，依据样本在嵌入空间的 prominence 动态设定标签平滑系数，用于开集识别中的球面表示学习，最高提升 4.7%。
AI.motivation: 开集识别需准确分类已知类并拒绝未知类样本，但训练时无法建模未知类的无界分布，易将未知类误判。现有工作不建模未知类，而是将特征空间塑造成已知类紧致且相互分离的形态，球面表示学习在该思路下效果显著。其中标签平滑被视为关键驱动因素之一，但它对所有训练样本使用同一系数，忽略了各样本已嵌入质量的差异，因而存在改进空间。
AI.method: 作者首先指出 OSR 中使用的球面表示学习目标共享同一种 alignment–uniformity 结构，标签仅通过 alignment 项进入，因此标签平滑实为一个"对齐调节旋钮"，固定系数意味着所有样本被调到同一档位。据此提出即插式方法 SmoothOperator（SmoothOP）：以样本的 prominence（嵌入空间中自身类相对于最强竞争类的区分清晰度信号）为依据，为每个样本单独设定平滑系数。prominence 高的样本被赋予更强的平滑，从而降低其 alignment、放松其类内拉动。该方法可嵌入四种现有球面表示学习方法，训练开销极小。
AI.result: 在 Semantic Shift Benchmark 上，SmoothOP 增强后的变体在多个数据集、不同语义偏移程度以及多种 OSR 后处理方式下总体优于其基础目标，AUROC、OSCR 与闭集准确率最高提升 4.7%。
AI.conclusion: 标签平滑在球面表示学习中扮演 alignment 调节器角色，固定系数并非最优；按样本 prominence 自适应设置平滑系数是一种通用、低开销且有效的改进策略，可即插到多种现有 OSR 方法中并稳定带来性能提升。

title: Lang3DSeg: Annotation-Free Open-Vocabulary 3D Segmentation with Point Transformers
comment: 9 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Submitted to IEEE ICRA 2027
summary: Accurate 3D semantic perception is critical for safe autonomous navigation. However, supervised LiDAR segmentation remains tied to closed taxonomies and to the cost of point-wise manual annotation. Open-vocabulary methods avoid that cost by projecting the output of 2D vision-language models onto LiDAR and distilling it into a 3D network. These methods rely almost exclusively on voxel-based sparse convolutions, and point transformers have so far been limited to indoor environments, where 3D data is dense and bounded. We present Lang3DSeg, which establishes a point transformer as the backbone for annotation-free open-vocabulary segmentation of outdoor 3D LiDAR, and is trained from scratch without geometric pre-training. This training paradigm necessitates addressing the inherent noise in 2D-to-3D label projections; specifically, naive projection often suffers from depth ambiguity, where points behind an object are erroneously assigned its semantic label. We therefore composite masks using an explicit class-priority rule and truncate each projected instance at the first gap in its depth distribution, correcting the projection error directly rather than averaging it over registered sequences. Lang3DSeg achieves 52.8% mIoU on nuScenes validation and 41.4% on SemanticKITTI, the highest among published annotation-free methods on both benchmarks. Every 3D semantic segmentation is on a single LiDAR sweep, and inference operates in real-time without running vision-language models.

AI.tldr: Lang3DSeg提出以点变换器为骨干、无需人工标注的室外LiDAR开放词汇3D语义分割方法，通过类别优先级合成掩码与深度分布截断修正2D到3D投影噪声，在nuScenes和SemanticKITTI上达到无标注方法最优。
AI.motivation: 监督式LiDAR分割受限于封闭类别体系和逐点人工标注的高成本；现有开放词汇方法虽可避免标注成本，但几乎全部依赖体素稀疏卷积，点变换器仅用于室内稠密有界数据，室外开放词汇分割缺乏点变换器方案。
AI.method: 将2D视觉语言模型的输出投影到LiDAR并蒸馏到3D网络；以点变换器作为室外LiDAR开放词汇分割的骨干，且从零训练、不做几何预训练；针对2D-to-3D投影的深度歧义（物体后方点被误赋标签）噪声，采用显式类别优先级规则合成掩码，并在深度分布首个间隙处截断每个投影实例，直接修正投影误差而非在配准序列上取平均。
AI.result: 在nuScenes验证集达到52.8% mIoU，在SemanticKITTI达到41.4%，均为已发表无标注方法中的最高水平；每个3D语义分割基于单帧LiDAR扫描，推理实时且无需运行视觉语言模型。
AI.conclusion: 点变换器可作为室外LiDAR开放词汇分割的有效骨干，从零训练结合投影噪声的直接修正策略，可在免标注条件下取得领先性能并保持实时推理。

title: CtrlWAM: Controllable World Action Models with Aligned Intent and Foresight
summary: World action models (WAMs) jointly predict actions (intent) and visual future (foresight). Standard training adds noise to recorded actions and video simultaneously, but such training paradigms introduce a mismatch: perturbed actions imply counterfactual future visual, while the noised video remains tied to the GT recording. In low-noise regime, the scene geometry and even the dynamic behavior remain clearly visible from the noisy future frames despite the added noise. We present CtrlWAM, which executes perturbed actions in a simulator and pairs them with their noised visual consequences for joint WAM learning. To accommodate the different denoising requirements of video and actions, we introduce warped video--action noise schedules that aim to keep visual layout responsive as action predictions evolve. We further extend the action interface from ego-only control to a variable number of agent streams, allowing a unified model to represent predicted or commanded futures for multiple agents. Driving experiments show more accurate action forecasts, closer agreement between generated video and actions, and better following of supplied commands; robotics experiments show stronger motion fidelity and controllability. Matched controls support the benefit of off-path renders for command following and manipulation fidelity. Together, these findings contribute to a more controllable world action model. Project page: https://ctrl-wam.github.io/

AI.tldr: 提出 CtrlWAM：在仿真器中执行受扰动作并与其加噪视觉后果配对进行联合世界动作模型学习，配合扭曲的视频-动作噪声调度，将动作接口从仅 ego 扩展到可变数量智能体流，提升动作预测精度、视频-动作一致性与指令跟随能力。
AI.motivation: 标准的世界动作模型训练对录制的动作与视频同时加噪，导致不匹配：被扰动的动作意味着反事实的未来视觉，但加噪视频仍绑定于真实录制（GT）。在低噪声区间，场景几何乃至动态行为仍能从加噪未来帧中清晰辨认，使得动作与视觉监督信号相互矛盾。
AI.method: 在仿真器中执行受扰动动作，并将其与对应的加噪视觉后果配对，实现联合 WAM 学习；针对视频与动作不同的去噪需求，引入"扭曲的视频-动作噪声调度"（warped video-action noise schedules），使视觉布局随动作预测的演化保持响应性；同时将动作接口从仅 ego 控制扩展为可变数量的智能体流，使统一模型可表征多个智能体的预测或指令未来。
AI.result: 驾驶实验显示动作预测更准确、生成视频与动作一致性更高、对给定指令的跟随更好；机器人实验显示运动保真度与可控性更强。匹配对照实验支持了偏离路径渲染（off-path renders）对指令跟随与操作保真度的增益。
AI.conclusion: 通过以仿真中受扰动作的真实视觉后果替代与 GT 绑定的加噪视频，并配合扭曲噪声调度与多智能体流扩展，CtrlWAM 实现了更可控的世界动作模型。

title: Machine Translation for Sign Languages
comment: Accepted for publication in the Annual Review of Linguistics, Volume 13
summary: Sign language machine translation has progressed substantially over the past decade, evolving from isolated sign recognition to end-to-end translation systems. Advances in pose estimation, transformer architectures, and large-scale dataset collection have driven progress, yet challenges remain. Datasets are limited compared to spoken-language resources; evaluation metrics inadequately capture the linguistic quality of output; and models must capture the simultaneous, multi-layered, and three-dimensional structure of sign languages. This manuscript provides a comprehensive review that seeks to balance technical challenges with stakeholder considerations. We examine the linguistic properties that make sign languages computationally unique, trace the evolution of recognition, translation, and production systems, and analyze ongoing technical challenges. Crucially, we address ethical considerations around data governance, community involvement, and appropriate use. Drawing on interdisciplinary perspectives spanning computer vision, sign language linguistics, and deaf studies, our analysis emphasizes that continued progress requires sustained collaboration across these fields and with deaf communities.

AI.tldr: 本文综述手语机器翻译：梳理其从孤立手语识别到端到端翻译的演进，剖析数据、评测与三维多层同步建模等技术挑战，并结合语言学与伦理视角强调跨学科及与聋人社区的持续协作。
AI.motivation: 手语机器翻译虽在姿态估计、Transformer架构和大规模数据集推动下取得进展，但仍面临数据资源有限、评测指标难以反映输出语言质量、以及手语同步、多层、三维结构建模困难等问题；现有研究多偏技术，缺乏对利益相关者与伦理层面的平衡考量。
AI.method: 采用综合性综述方法：分析使手语在计算上独具特性的语言学属性；追溯手语识别、翻译与生成系统的演进脉络；剖析现存技术挑战；并纳入数据治理、社区参与与合理使用等伦理议题。研究视角横跨计算机视觉、手语语言学与聋人研究等交叉学科。
AI.result: 综述系统整合了手语机器翻译的技术发展脉络与语言学基础，明确指出现有数据集规模不及口语资源、评测指标对手语输出语言质量刻画不足，以及模型在捕捉手语同步性、多层性与三维结构方面仍存在缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 手语机器翻译的持续进步需要计算机视觉、手语语言学与聋人研究等领域的长期协作，并须与聋人社区共同推进；技术进步应与数据治理、社区参与和伦理使用相平衡。

title: Joint Branch-Space Transform Coding for Diffusion Activation Quantization with Classifier-Free Guidance
summary: Post-training quantization for diffusion models increasingly exploits timestep, feature, and layer structure. While recent work has begun incorporating CFG structure into diffusion quantization, activation quantization still operates independently across conditional and unconditional coordinates, leaving cross-activation structure unexploited. We show that matched CFG activations form a strongly correlated two-dimensional source and that, under a fixed bit budget, the choice of branch coding basis materially affects quantization fidelity. Motivated by this observation, we introduce branch-space transform coding, which rotates matched CFG branches via an offline derived 2x2 orthogonal matrix, requiring minimal modifications to model parameters or the quantization pipeline. We further derive the Guidance-Correlation Branch Transform (GCBT), which jointly incorporates the CFG guidance direction and cross-branch second moments. Under an equal-rate quantization-noise surrogate, GCBT admits a closed-form per-layer solution without gradient optimization or angle search. Applied on top of existing diffusion PTQ methods, GCBT yields statistically significant fidelity gains in most evaluated comparisons with no statistically significant degradation, while leaving the underlying host quantization pipeline unchanged.

AI.tldr: 提出分支空间变换编码（GCBT），通过对匹配的CFG分支激活施加离线推导的2×2正交旋转，挖掘跨分支相关性，在等速率噪声代理下获得闭式逐层解，无需梯度优化或角度搜索，在现有扩散模型PTQ方法上取得显著保真度提升。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型后训练量化（PTQ）已开始利用时间步、特征与层级结构，并逐渐引入CFG结构；但激活量化仍在条件与无条件坐标上独立进行，未利用跨激活结构。作者发现匹配的CFG激活构成强相关的二维源，在固定比特预算下，分支编码基的选择会实质影响量化保真度。
AI.method: 提出分支空间变换编码：用离线推导的2×2正交矩阵旋转匹配的CFG分支，仅需对模型参数或量化流程做最小修改。进一步推导引导-相关分支变换（GCBT），联合引入CFG引导方向与跨分支二阶矩；在等速率量化噪声代理下，GCBT具有闭式逐层解，无需梯度优化或角度搜索。
AI.result: 在现有扩散PTQ方法之上应用GCBT，在大多数评估比较中取得统计显著的保真度提升，且无统计显著的性能退化，同时底层宿主量化流程保持不变。
AI.conclusion: 利用CFG条件/无条件分支间的相关性进行分支空间变换编码，是一种低侵入、可即插即用的扩散模型PTQ增强策略，能在不改变原有量化流程的前提下稳定提升量化保真度。

title: EyeTAG: Eye Trajectory-Aware Gaze Estimation
summary: Gaze estimation under natural head-eye motion underpins applications from driver monitoring to human-computer interaction. Single-frame methods predict each frame independently, so consecutive outputs fluctuate as jitter. Multi-frame methods reduce this, but they learn motion implicitly inside appearance features, so the gaze trajectory is never an explicit variable. We propose EyeTAG (Eye Trajectory-Aware Gaze Estimation), a causal multi-frame framework built around an explicit first-order gaze prior: at each step it differentiates its own recent predictions and feeds the resulting trajectory back as a compact kinematic token. Because differencing is translation-invariant in gaze space, this token carries subject-invariant motion rather than personal gaze offsets. Face and eye streams supply visual evidence, fused by cross-attention and a causal Transformer decoder. EyeTAG reduces the mean angular error by about 1.0$^\circ$ on Gaze360 and performs on par with the strongest baseline on EVE (2.56$^\circ$ vs. 2.58$^\circ$). Within-model ablations, which keep the encoder and the rest of the architecture fixed and vary only the gaze history, show that the differential formulation, rather than temporal context alone, removes the systematic saccade bias that persists even with an absolute gaze-history prior. Our code is available at https://github.com/peter8366/EyeTAG.

AI.tldr: 提出EyeTAG，一个因果多帧视线估计框架，以显式一阶视线先验（差分轨迹token）替代隐式运动建模，在Gaze360上降低约1.0°平均角度误差，在EVE上与最强基线持平（2.56° vs 2.58°）。
AI.motivation: 自然头眼运动下的视线估计对驾驶监控、人机交互等应用至关重要。单帧方法逐帧独立预测，输出存在抖动；多帧方法虽缓解抖动，但将运动隐式地编码在表观特征中，视线轨迹从未作为显式变量存在。
AI.method: EyeTAG为因果多帧框架，核心是显式的一阶视线先验：每一步对其自身近期预测做差分，得到紧凑的运动学token并回馈网络。由于在视线空间中差分具有平移不变性，该token携带与受试者无关的运动信息而非个体视线偏移。人脸与眼部双流提供视觉证据，经交叉注意力融合，并由因果Transformer解码器处理。
AI.result: 在Gaze360上平均角度误差降低约1.0°；在EVE上与最强基线表现相当（2.56° vs 2.58°）。模型内消融（固定编码器与其余结构，仅改变视线历史）表明，是差分形式而非单纯的时序上下文消除了仅使用绝对视线历史先验时仍存在的系统性扫视偏差。
AI.conclusion: 将视线轨迹作为显式的一阶差分运动学变量，可有效抑制抖动并消除扫视偏差，优于隐式运动建模，代码已开源。

title: A Matched-Budget Audit Framework for Recaptioned Image-Text Supervision Distributions
summary: Recaptioned image-text corpora are now standard for text-to-image (T2I) training, with vision--language model (VLM) captioners replacing sparse alt-text by dense descriptions. A recaptioned corpus is a supervision distribution induced by a documented captioning policy ($π$), captioner ($V_c$), and source corpus ($C$). Length-correlated proxies miss caption-register artifacts and downstream T2I benchmarks entangle the corpus with training choices, so this distribution is hard to audit at corpus scale. We introduce a reusable matched-budget audit framework for recaptioned supervision distributions $D_{π,V_c,C}$: at a fixed text budget of $B = 64$ it reports a five-axis profile spanning prompt-side coverage, image-conditioned faithfulness, and caption-surface health, with claimed controllable basic units (CBU) as the common claim unit. We instantiate the framework on seven paired comparisons over five public source corpora. Across the four cross-corpus pairs, the released surface raises supported CBU per caption by $+3.39$ to $+6.36$ under both Qwen and Gemma Judges, and on CC12M the same framework exposes a long-vs-dense frontier that is consistent across both judges and four budgets. We release the audited multi-source recap corpus ($\approx$ 490M) together with the audit-artifact bundle.

AI.tldr: 提出可复用的匹配预算审计框架，用五轴画像刻画重标注监督分布，在七个配对比较上验证并发布约4.9亿规模的审计语料与工件包。
AI.motivation: 重标注图文语料已成为文生图训练标配，VLM标注器以密集描述替代稀疏alt-text。该语料本质是由标注策略、标注器与源语料共同诱导的监督分布，但既有审计手段存在缺陷：基于长度相关代理指标会漏掉标注语体伪影，而下游T2I基准又把语料与训练选择混在一起，导致难以在语料规模上审计该分布。
AI.method: 提出可复用的匹配预算审计框架，针对重标注监督分布D_{π,V_c,C}，在固定文本预算B=64下输出五轴画像，覆盖提示侧覆盖度、图像条件忠实度与描述表层健康度，并以"可主张可控基本单元"(CBU)作为统一主张单位；在五个公开源语料上实例化七个配对比较。
AI.result: 四个跨语料配对上，发布表层使每张图支持的CBU在Qwen与Gemma两种评判器下均提升+3.39至+6.36；在CC12M上，同一框架揭示出在两种评判器和四个预算下均一致的长文本-密集描述前沿。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可跨语料、跨评判器、跨预算稳定刻画重标注监督分布，为语料级审计提供可复用工具；并发布经审计的多源重标注语料（约4.9亿）及审计工件包。

title: Video-Index: A Curated Meta-Benchmark for Video Understanding
summary: A video benchmark should reward the capability it claims to measure, yet models can exploit answer options, question text, or partial visual evidence. We introduce the attack pyramid, five levels of shortcut attacks with increasing access to each item, and audit 115 video benchmarks with it. On 35 benchmarks, attackers that never see a frame approach full-video accuracy. On 51 benchmarks with temporal probes, shuffled frames keep a median 96% of full-video accuracy. Near-duplicate questions make up at least half the items in 63 benchmarks. We screen 505,518 question-answer pairs from 112 of them into an audited pool. Agents turn evaluation requests into specifications, and a deterministic selector with a red-team gate composes reproducible benchmarks. We release Video-Index, the 210 hardest verified items under these attacks in each of four capability groups, 840 items from 76 sources. With the same fixed input, Claude Opus 5 outscores every open-source model by over 37 percentage points, and agent tools add about 20 more, yet all systems leave room to improve efficiency and accuracy. Blog: https://www.enxinsong.com/blog/video-index/ GitHub: https://github.com/Espere-1119-Song/Video-Index Hugging Face: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Video-Index/Video-Index

AI.tldr: 提出"攻击金字塔"（五级捷径攻击）审计115个视频基准，发现大量基准存在可利用捷径，并构建抗攻击的Video-Index基准（840题）。
AI.motivation: 视频基准应奖励其声称测量的能力，但模型可利用答案选项、问题文本或部分视觉证据等捷径，导致评测失真，因此需要系统审计并构建抗捷径的基准。
AI.method: 提出攻击金字塔——五级捷径攻击（访问权限递增），用于审计115个视频基准；对其中112个的505,518个问答对进行筛选，构建受审池；由智能体将评测需求转化为规格，用带红队门控的确定性选择器组合出可复现基准。
AI.result: 35个基准上"从不看帧"的攻击者接近全视频准确率；51个基准上打乱帧仍保持中位数96%准确率；63个基准中近重复问题至少占一半。发布Video-Index，含四个能力组各210个最难验证样本，共840题、来自76个来源。相同固定输入下，Claude Opus 5比所有开源模型高37个百分点以上，智能体工具再提升约20点，但效率与准确率仍有提升空间。
AI.conclusion: 视频基准普遍存在可被捷径利用的漏洞，Video-Index提供抗捷径、可复现的评测集，但现有系统在效率与准确性上仍有较大改进空间。

title: Two Clocks in Diffusion MLLMs: When Answers Stabilize Before Rationales Unfold
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on BeNTo (Beyond Next-Token Prediction - Diffusion & Flow Models for Next-Generation Decoding)
summary: An answer candidate in a masked diffusion MLLM can stabilize while its rationale is still unfolding. We distinguish retrospective stabilization of the logged candidate from token commitment, and examine these two clocks relative to rationale generation. Analyzing our results across three visual question-answering benchmarks, we find that 89.4-98.1% of the rationale-side canvas remains unwritten at stabilization in single-block, EOS-suppressed LaViDa runs. On V*Bench, reducing block length from 128 to 8 changes this fraction from 89.4% to 1.7%, together with answer coverage and the eligible observation window. Under EOS-enabled prompting, direct instructions improve Nemotron's overall accuracy by 15.0 and 19.5 percentage points on M3CoT and ScienceQA, but reduce LaViDa/V*Bench accuracy by 11.0 points. A symmetric decomposition associates the larger absolute component of each change with coverage rather than conditional accuracy. Matched-canvas image ablations measure visual sensitivity alongside answer stabilization, separating the two temporal readouts. Together, these measurements distinguish answer stabilization, rationale unfolding, and visual sensitivity, and identify coverage as the larger component of the prompting differences.

AI.tldr: 该论文区分了掩码扩散多模态大模型（MLLM）中"答案候选回顾性稳定"与"token承诺"两个时间尺度，并考察二者与理由（rationale）生成的关系。在三个VQA基准上发现：单块、抑制EOS的LaViDa运行中，稳定时89.4–98.1%的理由画布尚未写出；将块长从128降至8，该比例从89.4%降至1.7%；EOS启用时直接指令可使Nemotron在M3CoT与ScienceQA上准确率提升15.0与19.5个百分点，却使LaViDa/V*Bench下降11.0个百分点，且变化的绝对主成分归于覆盖率而非条件准确率。
AI.motivation: 掩码扩散MLLM中，答案候选可能在理由尚未展开时即已稳定，容易将"日志中候选的回顾性稳定"误读为模型已做出token承诺。作者希望厘清答案稳定、理由展开与视觉敏感性这三个不同时间读数，并识别提示差异的主要来源。
AI.method: 在三个视觉问答基准上分析掩码扩散MLLM（LaViDa、Nemotron）。区分回顾性稳定与token承诺，比较两套"时钟"相对理由生成的位置；通过改变块长（128→8）、EOS抑制/启用及直接指令提示进行受控实验；采用对称分解将每次变化分为覆盖率成分与条件准确率成分；并用匹配画布的图像消融测量视觉敏感性。
AI.result: 单块、EOS抑制的LaViDa运行中，稳定时89.4–98.1%的理由画布未写出。V*Bench上将块长从128降到8，该比例由89.4%降至1.7%，同时改变答案覆盖率与可用观测窗口。EOS启用提示下，直接指令使Nemotron在M3CoT、ScienceQA总体准确率提升15.0与19.5个百分点，但使LaViDa/V*Bench下降11.0个百分点。对称分解显示，各项变化中较大的绝对成分来自覆盖率而非条件准确率。匹配画布图像消融分离出视觉敏感性与答案稳定两个时间读数。
AI.conclusion: 答案稳定、理由展开与视觉敏感性是可被测量并相互区分的三个过程；提示带来的性能差异主要由覆盖率而非条件准确率驱动，提示评估与扩散解码分析需明确区分回顾性稳定与真正的token承诺。

title: RelationVGGT: Visual Geometry Transformers for 3D Spatial Relation Segmentation
summary: Recent advances in 3D reconstruction have progressed from per-scene optimization to feed-forward inference, and semantic scene understanding has followed suit -- yet existing methods remain confined to object-centric perception, neglecting spatial relations between objects. We formulate 3D spatial relation segmentation in a feed-forward, pose-free multi-view setting: given a visually specified subject and a relational text query, the model segments the target across views without receiving its category name. To this end, we propose RelationVGGT, a novel feed-forward framework that integrates semantic features from a visual foundation model with geometry-aware representations from a 3D geometry foundation model and leverages a relation transformer for subject-conditioned, cross-view relation prediction -- requiring neither per-scene optimization nor known camera poses. We additionally provide a fully automated annotation pipeline built on ScanNet++ with VLMs and LLMs, enabling scalable training data generation for this new task.

AI.tldr: 本文将3D重建从逐场景优化推进到前馈推理的趋势扩展到语义理解，提出"前馈式、无需位姿的多视图3D空间关系分割"新任务，并设计RelationVGGT框架及自动化标注流程。
AI.motivation: 现有语义场景理解方法多局限于以物体为中心的感知，忽略了物体间的空间关系；作者希望在前馈、无需相机位姿的多视图设定下建模对象间的空间关系分割。
AI.method: 提出RelationVGGT框架：融合视觉基础模型的语义特征与3D几何基础模型的几何感知表征，并通过关系Transformer进行以主体为条件、跨视图的关系预测，无需逐场景优化亦无需已知相机位姿。同时基于ScanNet++构建了由VLM与LLM驱动的全自动标注流水线，用于生成可扩展的训练数据。
AI.result: 构建了新的任务设定与自动化数据生成流程；所提框架在给定视觉指定的主体与关系文本查询时，可在多视图间分割出目标而无需获知目标类别名称，且不依赖逐场景优化与已知相机位姿。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将前馈3D重建思想拓展至空间关系语义分割，提出RelationVGGT框架与自动标注方案，为关系感知的3D场景理解提供了新的任务范式与可扩展训练数据途径。

title: Concept Driven Domain Adaptation: Finding an Abstract Needle in a Haystack
summary: Science teachers frequently search for documentary excerpts not by describing what appears on screen, but by querying the abstract concepts they intend to teach. This use case exposes a limitation of existing language-based video moment retrieval methods, which typically assume that queries describe observable events, whereas instructional search requires retrieving concrete visual phenomena that instantiate an underlying scientific principle. We study this setting as concept-to-example video retrieval, an abstract-needle-in-a-haystack problem where compact curriculum concepts must be grounded in temporally sparse documentary evidence. To bridge this abstraction gap, we propose Concept-Driven Domain Adaptation (CDDA), a three-stage framework for adapting two-tower vision-language models to concept-level retrieval. CDDA treats concepts as intermediate semantic anchors: it first structures the textual embedding space with textbook and teacher-handbook example-concept pairs, then transfers this concept-aware geometry to documentary visuals under a frozen visual encoder, and finally jointly adapts both encoders with sparse visual concept supervision. From a geometric perspective, this staged alignment reduces text-concept and vision-concept angular gaps, thereby encouraging concept-level adaptation while preserving the pretrained model's concrete image description alignment. On a curated middle-school physics retrieval benchmark, CDDA achieves stronger pedagogically oriented concept retrieval than several competitive multimodal baselines, including Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B, while maintaining concrete image-text matching after adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"概念到实例视频检索"新任务及CDDA三阶段框架，通过概念驱动的域适应将双塔视觉语言模型对齐到概念级检索，在中学物理检索基准上优于Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B等基线。
AI.motivation: 科学教师检索纪录片片段时，往往不描述画面内容，而是用他们打算讲授的抽象概念进行查询。现有基于语言的视频时刻检索方法通常假设查询描述的是可观察事件，而教学检索需要的是能体现某一科学原理的具体视觉现象。这一现实需求暴露了现有方法的局限：查询（抽象概念）与目标（具体视觉实例）之间存在抽象鸿沟，且相关证据在纪录片中时间上高度稀疏。作者将这一问题形式化为"概念到实例视频检索"，即一种抽象概念的"大海捞针"问题。
AI.method: 提出概念驱动域适应（CDDA），一个用于将双塔视觉语言模型适配到概念级检索的三阶段框架。CDDA将概念视为中间语义锚点：第一阶段用教科书与教师手册中的"示例-概念"配对来结构化文本嵌入空间；第二阶段在冻结视觉编码器的条件下，将这种概念感知的几何结构迁移到纪录片视觉表示；第三阶段利用稀疏的视觉概念监督联合适配两个编码器。从几何视角看，这种分阶段对齐缩小了文本-概念和视觉-概念的角度间隔，从而在促进概念级适配的同时保留预训练模型原有的具体图像描述对齐能力。
AI.result: 在自建的中学物理检索基准上，CDDA取得了比多个竞争性多模态基线（包括Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B）更强的、面向教学的概念检索效果，同时在适配后仍保持了对具体图像-文本匹配的能力。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示了语言型视频时刻检索在教学场景下的抽象性局限，提出并定义了概念到实例视频检索任务，验证了以概念为中间语义锚点的分阶段域适应能够有效弥合抽象查询与具体视觉证据之间的鸿沟，并兼具概念级检索性能与原有图文匹配能力的保持。

title: Watch Your Speech: Text-aware Video-to-Speech Synthesis with Textual Conditioning
summary: Video-to-speech synthesis aims to generate natural-sounding speech from silent talking-face videos while ensuring phonetic accuracy. A fundamental challenge in this task is the inherent one-to-many mapping problem, where visual dynamics often lack sufficient information to uniquely determine the corresponding utterance. To address this, we propose Watch Your Speech (WYS), a video-to-speech synthesis framework that incorporates textual conditioning as an explicit linguistic cue to mitigate visual ambiguity. Our framework features an attention-based embedding fusion module that synergistically integrates textual context with video sequences, coupled with a conditional flow matching objective for high-fidelity speech generation. Extensive experiments on the LRS2 and LRS3 datasets demonstrate that WYS achieves superior performance, establishing new state-of-the-art results in audio-visual synchronization (LSE-C/D) while maintaining highly competitive textual accuracy (WER). Subjective evaluations further confirm that our model generates speech with near-human naturalness, validating the effectiveness of textual conditioning in content-controlled video-to-speech synthesis. Project page: https://github.com/gunwoo5034/Watch-your-Speech

AI.tldr: 提出WYS框架，用文本条件作为显式语言线索缓解视频到语音合成中的一对多映射问题，在LRS2/LRS3上取得SOTA的视听同步性能并保持竞争性WER。
AI.motivation: 视频到语音合成需从静音说话视频生成自然且音素准确的语音，但视觉动态信息不足，存在固有的一对多映射问题，难以唯一确定对应话语。
AI.method: WYS框架引入文本条件作为显式语言线索；包含基于注意力的嵌入融合模块，将文本上下文与视频序列协同整合；采用条件流匹配目标实现高保真语音生成。
AI.result: 在LRS2和LRS3数据集上表现优异，刷新视听同步（LSE-C/D）SOTA，同时保持极具竞争力的文本准确率（WER）；主观评估显示生成语音接近人类自然度。
AI.conclusion: 验证了文本条件在内容可控的视频到语音合成中的有效性。

title: VIEScore2: Unified Image Evaluation with Spatially Grounded Explanations
summary: Existing synthetic image evaluators typically provide only a scalar quality score and do not identify the image regions that support it. We introduce VIEScore2, a unified evaluator for image generation and editing tasks with optional conditioning images. VIEScore2 represents an image as an N x N grid and jointly predicts quality scores and defect locations in a single model pass. Its text-native grid representation provides a common interface for heterogeneous spatial supervision and enables directly verifiable post-training objectives. We train on 38K examples spanning score-only, localization-only, and joint supervision across generation and editing tasks. Starting from supervised fine-tuning, we further apply GRPO to improve defect localization using rewards that combine cell-level Dice overlap, score accuracy, and output-format validity. A parameter-free parser converts the structured predictions into readable explanations. On the primary suite, VIEScore2 achieves an overall-score SRCC of 0.601, compared with 0.491 for Gemini-3-Flash, the strongest zero-shot general-purpose VLM baseline under matched inputs. For defect localization, VIEScore2 outperforms both general-purpose VLMs and specialized spatial evaluators on three of six benchmarks in per-image grid IoU and ranks among the top three on five, including datasets beyond its training sources.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 VIEScore2，一种面向图像生成与编辑任务的统一评测器，将图像表示为 N×N 网格并单次前向同时预测质量分数与缺陷位置，通过文本原生网格表示统一异构空间监督，并在 38K 样本上以 SFT+GRPO 训练，在质量评分与缺陷定位任务上均超越通用 VLM 与专用空间评测器。
AI.motivation: 现有合成图像评测器通常只输出单一标量质量分，无法指出支撑该分数的图像区域；同时，生成与编辑任务（含可选条件图像）缺乏统一评测接口，异构空间监督难以直接用于可验证的后训练目标。
AI.method: VIEScore2 将图像表示为 N×N 网格，在单次模型前向中联合预测质量分数与缺陷位置；采用文本原生网格表示作为异构空间监督的统一接口，并支持可直接验证的后训练目标。训练数据为 38K 样本，覆盖仅分数、仅定位与联合监督三类，横跨生成与编辑任务。训练流程为先监督微调（SFT），再用 GRPO 优化缺陷定位，奖励由单元格级 Dice 重叠、分数准确率与输出格式有效性组合而成；另用无参数解析器将结构化预测转为可读解释。
AI.result: 在主要评测套件上，VIEScore2 的总体分数 SRCC 为 0.601，高于匹配输入下最强的零样本通用 VLM 基线 Gemini-3-Flash 的 0.491。在缺陷定位上，于六个基准中的三个、按每图像网格 IoU 衡量优于通用 VLM 与专用空间评测器，并在五个基准中进入前三，其中包括训练来源之外的数据集。
AI.conclusion: VIEScore2 通过文本原生网格表示在单一模型中统一了质量评分与缺陷定位，验证了联合监督与 GRPO 后训练的有效性，并在评分与定位两方面均取得领先表现，展现出良好的跨数据集泛化能力。

title: VASC: Value-Aware Sparse Attention with Cross-Layer Memory for Efficient 3D Reconstruction
summary: Feed-forward 3D vision models such as VGGT have achieved remarkable progress, unifying camera estimation and dense scene reconstruction in a single pass. However, their quadratic global attention makes long image sequences expensive, while existing sparse methods may favor highly attended yet value-redundant regions. To address these limitations, we introduce VASC, a training-free sparse attention method combining value-aware block selection and execution-aware cross-layer memory. Our value-aware block selection integrates pooled query--key relevance with neighboring value contrast, reducing redundancy while preserving query-relevant and distinctive content. Cross-layer memory tracks unserved demand across layers and updates this state according to actual execution, enabling previously underserved blocks to compete under a fixed computation budget. Experiments on 7Scenes and NeuralRGB-D with VGGT and $π^3$ demonstrate improved pose estimation and reconstruction quality compared with FasterVGGT, together with up to $2.29\times$ faster inference than dense VGGT. Code is available at https://github.com/kosakayamahoo-design/VASC.

AI.tldr: VASC：一种免训练的稀疏注意力方法，通过价值感知块选择与跨层记忆，提升长序列前馈3D视觉的效率与精度。
AI.motivation: VGGT等前馈3D视觉模型统一了相机估计与稠密场景重建，但其二次全局注意力使长图像序列计算昂贵；现有稀疏方法偏向高注意力但价值冗余的区域，导致效率与质量受限。
AI.method: 提出免训练稀疏注意力VASC，包含两部分：（1）价值感知块选择，将池化后的查询-键相关性（query-key relevance）与邻域价值对比（value contrast）结合，在保留查询相关且具区分性内容的同时降低冗余；（2）执行感知跨层记忆，跟踪各层未满足的计算需求并按实际执行情况更新状态，使此前未被充分服务的块在固定计算预算下参与竞争。
AI.result: 在7Scenes与NeuralRGB-D数据集上，结合VGGT与π³，相比FasterVGGT取得更优的位姿估计与重建质量，推理速度最高比稠密VGGT快2.29倍。
AI.conclusion: VASC以免训练方式缓解了前馈3D视觉模型的注意力冗余问题，在固定预算下兼顾效率与重建/位姿精度，代码已开源。

title: FutureWorlds: Learning Robotic World Models from Alternative Futures
comment: 32 pages, including references and appendix. Code: https://github.com/Alexander-wu/FutureWorlds
summary: Robotic world models predict action-conditioned future scenes, providing a foundation for understanding action outcomes. However, turning alternative predictions into useful learning signals remains challenging: similar candidates limit informative quality comparisons, while diverging trajectories require persistent maintenance of their individual histories. We introduce FutureWorlds, a framework that unifies candidate construction, history maintenance, and learning from relative quality. Built on a multimodal discrete autoregressive model, FutureWorlds uses diverse beam search during reinforcement learning to construct candidate futures that balance confidence and diversity. Candidate-specific bounded memory preserves scene states and ensures that generation and policy scoring use matching histories. We further propose MemSPO (Memory-Conditioned Search-Guided Policy Optimization), which converts video trajectory rewards into group-relative advantages to optimize the world model. On RT-1, BridgeV2, and RoboCasa, FutureWorlds reduces LPIPS for 32-frame predictions by 14.78%, 20.84%, and 9.12%, respectively, relative to the strongest baseline on each dataset. Under fixed evaluation configurations, only 200 MemSPO updates further improve generation quality and support continued prediction beyond the training horizon. Memory ablations, decoding sensitivity analysis, and optical-flow evaluation show that these gains extend beyond visual quality to more accurate motion prediction and more consistent object states. Project page and code: https://github.com/Alexander-wu/FutureWorlds.

AI.tldr: FutureWorlds 提出统一候选构建、历史维护与相对质量学习的框架，通过多样化束搜索与有界记忆配合 MemSPO，显著提升机器人世界模型的长时程预测质量。
AI.motivation: 将备选预测转化为有效学习信号存在两难：候选过于相似时缺乏有信息量的质量比较，而差异过大的轨迹又需要持续维护各自的历史。现有方法难以同时解决这两个问题。
AI.method: 基于多模态离散自回归模型，RL 中采用多样化束搜索构建兼顾置信度与多样性的候选未来；用候选专属有界记忆保存场景状态，确保生成与策略打分使用匹配历史；提出 MemSPO，将视频轨迹奖励转为组内相对优势来优化世界模型。
AI.result: 在 RT-1、BridgeV2、RoboCasa 上，32 帧预测的 LPIPS 相对各数据集最强基线分别降低 14.78%、20.84%、9.12%。固定评测配置下仅 200 次 MemSPO 更新即进一步提升生成质量，并支持超出训练时程的持续预测。记忆消融、解码敏感性分析与光流评测表明增益不仅限于视觉质量，还体现为更准确的运动预测与更一致的对象状态。
AI.conclusion: 统一候选构建、历史维护与相对质量学习可有效提升机器人世界模型的预测质量与运动一致性，且训练高效、可外推。

title: Towards Automatic Video Annotation with ASH: Zero-Shot Open-Vocabulary Multi-Object Tracking and Segmentation
summary: Memory-attention-based Video Instance Segmentation (VIS) methods have demonstrated strong zero-shot tracking capability, yet their substantial memory requirements confine them to short video clips and their single-prompt inference design makes multi-category open-vocabulary tracking computationally prohibitive. This work introduces two contributions toward fully automated tracking annotation of arbitrary video. The Generalized Presence Token (GPT) reformulates SAM3's inference pipeline to process N text prompts simultaneously via virtual prompt batching, reducing image encoding cost from O(N) to O(1) with no modifications to any learned component. The Annotation and Segmentation Handler (ASH) extends any memory-attention VIS tracker to sequences of arbitrary length through overlapping temporal chunks with IoU-based inter-chunk identity matching, requiring no dataset-specific training. Instantiated on SAM3, the resulting pipeline -- SAM3-ASH -- achieves state-of-the-art HOTA on MOTS20 under fully zero-shot conditions and remains competitive with trained specialists across seven additional benchmarks, while peak GPU memory consumption stays below 25 GB, establishing a practical baseline for scalable, training-free automated video annotation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出GPT与ASH两个组件，将记忆注意力型视频实例分割扩展为全自动、免训练、任意长度视频的开放词汇跟踪标注流程（SAM3-ASH），在零样本设定下取得SOTA并保持显存低于25GB。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆注意力型VIS方法虽具备强零样本跟踪能力，但内存开销大，仅能处理短视频片段；且单提示推理设计使多类别开放词汇跟踪计算代价过高，难以实现任意视频的全自动标注。
AI.method: 提出两项贡献：(1) Generalized Presence Token (GPT)，通过虚拟提示批处理重构SAM3推理流程，同时处理N个文本提示，将图像编码成本从O(N)降至O(1)，且不修改任何已学习组件；(2) Annotation and Segmentation Handler (ASH)，利用重叠时间分块与基于IoU的跨块身份匹配，将任意记忆注意力VIS跟踪器扩展到任意长度序列，无需数据集特定训练。二者实例化于SAM3得到SAM3-ASH。
AI.result: 在完全零样本条件下，SAM3-ASH在MOTS20上取得SOTA HOTA，并在另外七个基准上与训练专用方法相比保持竞争力，同时峰值GPU显存低于25GB。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为可扩展、免训练的全自动视频标注建立了一个实用基线。

title: Bootstrapping Video Interaction Generation with Synthetic State Transitions
summary: While recent video generative models can synthesize high-fidelity videos, they struggle to portray plausible physical interactions and the resulting state transitions, a critical bottleneck for applications in robotics and VR/AR. To address this, we introduce a framework to generate a scalable synthetic dataset of controllable interactions. Our pipeline leverages a structured taxonomy and state-of-the-art image editing models to create explicit `start' and `end' state images, which serve as visual anchors for the interaction. To generate a seamless video utilizing these anchors, we propose State-Guided Sampling (SGS), a novel sampling technique that mitigates artifacts common in naive conditional generation. Furthermore, we develop and validate a new automated evaluation system that aligns with human judgments to ensure data quality. Experiments show that fine-tuning a base model on our dataset significantly enhances its ability to generate plausible interactions.

AI.tldr: 提出可扩展的合成数据生成框架与 State-Guided Sampling (SGS) 采样技术，使视频生成模型能够产生物理上合理的交互及状态转换。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成模型虽能合成高保真视频，但难以刻画合理的物理交互及其状态转换，这一瓶颈制约了其在机器人与 VR/AR 领域的应用。
AI.method: 1) 构建结构化分类体系，并借助最先进图像编辑模型生成显式的"起始"与"结束"状态图像作为交互的视觉锚点；2) 提出 State-Guided Sampling (SGS)，一种新采样技术，用于缓解朴素条件生成中常见的伪影；3) 设计并验证一套与人类判断对齐的自动化评估系统以保障数据质量。
AI.result: 实验表明，在自建数据集上微调基础模型可显著提升其生成合理交互的能力。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过可控交互合成数据生成框架与SGS采样技术，有效提升了视频生成模型对物理交互与状态转换的建模能力，并提供与人类判断对齐的自动化评估手段。

title: HierGF: Hierarchical Gaussian Fields via Geometry-perception Message Passing for Sparse-view 3D Reconstruction
comment: Accepted to IEEE Transactions on Multimedia (TMM), 2026
summary: Sparse view 3D reconstruction is an important and common scenario in multimedia applications, such as augmented reality/virtual reality (AR/VR) content creation, cultural heritage digitization, and certain robotic applications, where only a limited number of randomly captured views may be available. However, sparse views contain only limited 3D information, posing two major challenges:1) too few images are available for matching, making it difficult to build multi-view consistency; 2) insufficient view coverage leads to a lack of information in under-sampled regions, resulting in missing parts of object structure. Existing methods mostly still rely on limited reprojection errors and regularization terms, which are prone to overfitting to a single view and inconsistent appearances across views. In geometrically under-sampled regions, they often rely on heuristic density control, lacking reliable guidance and often resulting in blurring and structural holes.To address these issues, this paper proposes Hierarchical Gaussian Fields (HierGF), which revisits sparse-view reconstruction from a hierarchical geometry-perception perspective and converts limited observations into reliable self-generated supervision beyond fixed priors and heuristic density control. In particular, we transform coarse 3D geometric information and additional 2D generative priors into structured pseudo-supervision through a two-stage geometry-perception backbone network, thereby enhancing multi-view consistency with very few input views. In addition, we introduce a learnable confidence network to guide gradients toward cross-view consistent content, and a geometrically consistent densification module to improve the reconstruction of multi-view alignment and under-sampled regions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出分层高斯场（HierGF），从分层几何感知角度解决稀疏视图3D重建中多视图一致性差与欠采样区域信息缺失的问题。方法将粗粒度3D几何信息与2D生成先验转化为结构化伪监督，并引入可学习置信度网络与几何一致稠密化模块。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视图仅含有限3D信息，带来两大挑战：1）可用匹配图像过少，难以建立多视图一致性；2）视图覆盖不足导致欠采样区域信息缺失、物体结构残缺。现有方法依赖有限重投影误差与正则项，易过拟合单视图、跨视图外观不一致；在几何欠采样区域依赖启发式密度控制，缺乏可靠引导，导致模糊与结构空洞。
AI.method: 提出Hierarchical Gaussian Fields（HierGF），从分层几何感知视角重新审视稀疏视图重建，将有限观测转化为可靠的自生成监督。具体而言：通过两阶段几何感知骨干网络，将粗粒度3D几何信息与额外2D生成先验转化为结构化伪监督，以在极少输入视图下增强多视图一致性；引入可学习置信度网络，将梯度引导至跨视图一致的内容；并提出几何一致稠密化模块，改善多视图对齐与欠采样区域的 重建。
AI.result: 摘要未提供定量实验结果，仅陈述方法在极少输入视图下增强多视图一致性，并改善多视图对齐与欠采样区域的重建效果。
AI.conclusion: HierGF通过将有限观测转化为结构化自生成监督，摆脱对固定先验与启发式密度控制的依赖，为稀疏视图3D重建提供了一种分层几何感知的新思路。

title: Towards Subject Consistency over Dynamic Subject Sets in Video Generation
summary: We argue that as video generation extends to longer durations, subject consistency should be evaluated over \textit{dynamic subject sets}. We therefore introduce \textbf{DynSC-Eval}, an evaluation framework that dynamically tracks eligible subjects throughout their visible lifespans and measures local continuity and global identity preservation using six complementary object-level metrics, with explicit detection of inconsistency events. To validate its effectiveness, we design synthetic experiments that actively inject inconsistency events, demonstrating both the sensitivity of DynSC-Eval and the limitations of existing metrics. Evaluations of diverse models on 5s, 15s, and 60s video generation further reveal substantial subject consistency differences that are obscured by conventional metrics. Beyond evaluation, we construct rewards from DynSC-Eval and apply DiffusionNFT post-training in an autonomous-driving testbed. On 5s generation, our approach reduces the six inconsistency metrics by an average of 13.82\% for Wan-2.1-1.3B and 5.66\% for SANA-2B, with improvements also observed on the I2V model ReSim. Qualitative comparisons further demonstrate the effectiveness of our method. We then extend generation to 10s and 30s through curriculum learning and show that consistency optimization remains effective while largely preserving other capabilities.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 DynSC-Eval，将长视频生成中的主体一致性评估扩展到动态主体集合，通过六项对象级指标追踪主体可见生命周期，并将该评估构建为奖励用于后训练以提升一致性。
AI.motivation: 随着视频生成时长增加，主体会在不同时间段出现或消失，传统基于固定主体集合的一致性评估无法反映动态变化下的局部连续性与全局身份保持。现有指标还掩盖了不同模型在长视频上的显著一致性差异。
AI.method: 提出 DynSC-Eval 评估框架：动态追踪合格主体在其可见生命周期内的表现，用六项互补的对象级指标衡量局部连续性与全局身份保持，并显式检测不一致事件。通过主动注入不一致事件的合成实验验证敏感度；基于 DynSC-Eval 构建奖励，在自动驾驶测试平台上应用 DiffusionNFT 后训练，并用课程学习扩展至更长时长。
AI.result: 合成实验证明 DynSC-Eval 的敏感度优于现有指标。在 5s、15s、60s 视频生成评测中揭示了被传统指标掩盖的主体一致性差异。5s 生成上，六项不一致指标平均降低 13.82%（Wan-2.1-1.3B）和 5.66%（SANA-2B），I2V 模型 ReSim 亦有提升；定性比较支持该方法有效性。通过课程学习扩展至 10s 和 30s 后，一致性优化仍然有效且基本保持其他能力。
AI.conclusion: 动态主体集合应成为长视频生成一致性评估的基本设定；DynSC-Eval 既能作为评估框架揭示现有指标的不足，又能作为奖励信号有效提升多类模型的一致性，并可通过课程学习扩展到更长时长。

title: Overcoming Kernel Redundancy for Scaling Logic Gate Networks
summary: Differentiable logic gate networks, which operate using only logic gates, have recently attracted attention as an efficient alternative to conventional neural networks. However, despite their efficiency, the scaling behavior of logic gate networks remains underexplored. By contrast, scaling model capacity is a central design principle in deep neural networks and typically leads to improved performance. This discrepancy raises a key question: Can similar scaling benefits also be achieved in logic gate networks? In this work, we focus on width as a primary scaling axis and conduct a systematic analysis of its behavior in logic gate networks. We observe that naive width scaling often introduces redundancy among logic kernels, limiting the effective use of additional kernels and leading to performance saturation. To address this limitation, we propose a dynamic logic kernel framework that reorganizes kernel utilization by promoting specialization across kernel groups. This enables the network to better utilize increased width via input-dependent kernel routing, while ensuring that both routing and computation are implemented entirely with gate-level Boolean operations at inference time. We further find that kernel redundancy is most pronounced at the first gate level, motivating an early-stage dynamic logic kernel strategy that concentrates adaptation at this level. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach improves kernel utilization and increases kernel diversity, leading to higher accuracy with improved parameter efficiency.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统研究可微逻辑门网络的宽度缩放行为，发现朴素宽度缩放会导致逻辑核冗余和性能饱和，提出动态逻辑核框架，通过输入依赖的核路由促进核组专业化，在推理时完全用门级布尔运算实现，从而提升核利用率、多样性和精度。
AI.motivation: 可微逻辑门网络作为高效替代方案受到关注，但其缩放行为尚未充分探索；而深度神经网络中扩大模型容量通常带来性能提升，因此需要回答逻辑门网络是否也能获得类似的缩放收益。
AI.method: 以宽度为主要缩放轴进行系统分析；针对朴素宽度缩放引起的逻辑核冗余，提出动态逻辑核框架，通过促进核组间专业化来重组核利用，并采用输入依赖的核路由；同时发现第一层门级冗余最严重，提出早期阶段动态逻辑核策略，将适应集中在第一层；路由和计算在推理时全部由门级布尔运算实现。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法提高了核利用率并增加了核多样性，在改善参数效率的同时获得更高精度。
AI.conclusion: 逻辑门网络的宽度缩放并非简单增加核即可获益，需通过动态逻辑核与早期适应策略缓解冗余，才能有效利用额外宽度并提升性能。

title: Ego2Act: Evaluating Goal-Directed Manipulation in Egocentric Video Generation
comment: Preprint. 51 pages, 19 figures, 23 tables. Code, dataset and project website linked in the paper
summary: Video generation models are increasingly being explored as world simulators for embodied planning and learning. To do so effectively, these models must not only generate visually appealing frames, but also predict how environments dynamically evolve when executing goal-directed actions. While evaluating these capabilities is crucial, existing benchmarks focus mainly on single short actions or step-by-step instructions. This leaves multi-step physical reasoning underexplored, especially in egocentric video generation that requires planning to simulate proper execution to accomplish high-level goals by carrying out multiple real-world manipulations. We introduce Ego2Act, a goal-directed benchmark featuring 2,640 videos from 110 real-world tasks across day-to-day settings, varying object clutter and multi-step complexity. Given an initial scene image and a high-level goal, Ego2Act evaluates whether video generation models can produce realistic egocentric videos of a hand manipulating objects to carry out the task. To support scalable evaluation, we also introduce Ego2ActJudge, a reference-free evaluation pipeline that achieves better task completion and physics plausibility evaluation alignment with human consensus compared to relevant baselines. Our findings reveal that models' generated simulations often skip or partially execute steps, leaving later steps missing dependent states, which leads to unfulfilled goal. Furthermore, models consistently fail at fine-grained physical dynamics, particularly during complex object manipulation and persistent world modeling. We hope Ego2Act provides a rigorous testbed for advancing video models toward physically plausible, goal-directed simulation.

AI.tldr: 提出Ego2Act基准（2640个视频、110个真实任务），评估视频生成模型在多步目标导向自我中心操作中的物理推理能力，并引入无参考评测流程Ego2ActJudge。
AI.motivation: 视频生成模型被视为具身规划与学习的世界模拟器，需在生成视觉合理帧之外，预测目标导向动作下环境的动态演化。现有基准多聚焦单一短动作或逐步指令，缺乏对多步物理推理的评估，尤其缺少需要规划多步真实操作以完成高层目标的自我中心视频生成评测。
AI.method: 构建Ego2Act目标导向基准，包含110个日常场景真实任务、2640个视频，覆盖物体杂乱度与多步复杂度变化；给定初始场景图像与高层目标，要求模型生成手部操作物体以完成任务的逼真自我中心视频；同时提出无参考评测流程Ego2ActJudge，用于可扩展评估任务完成度与物理合理性。
AI.result: Ego2ActJudge在任务完成度与物理合理性评估上与人类共识的对齐程度优于相关基线；实验发现模型生成的模拟常跳过或部分执行步骤，导致后续步骤缺少依赖状态、目标未达成；模型在细粒度物理动态上持续失败，尤其在复杂物体操作与持续性世界建模时。
AI.conclusion: Ego2Act为推进视频模型走向物理合理、目标导向的模拟提供了严格测试平台。

title: Affine-Aligned Atlas for Canonical Gaussian Construction in Video Representation
summary: Gaussian splatting has recently emerged as an efficient representation for images and videos due to its explicit structure and fast rendering capability. Existing Gaussian-based video representations often decompose a video into canonical Gaussians and temporal deformation. However, when a video contains large global motion such as camera movement, the canonical representation may become misaligned with individual frames, increasing the burden on the temporal deformation model. In this paper, we propose an affine-atlas canonical Gaussian representation, which constructs canonical Gaussians in a larger affine-aligned atlas space. Frame-wise affine transforms absorb global motion before canonical Gaussian construction, reducing the gap between the canonical representation and target frames. Since the proposed method only modifies the canonical construction stage, it can be integrated into existing canonical-Gaussian-based methods with negligible additional parameter cost. Experiments show that our method improves reconstruction quality especially for sequences with large camera motion.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出仿射图集规范高斯表示，通过在更大的仿射对齐图集空间中构建规范高斯，并用逐帧仿射变换吸收全局运动，从而提升大相机运动视频的重建质量。
AI.motivation: 现有基于高斯的视频表示将视频分解为规范高斯与时间形变，但当视频存在较大全局运动（如相机移动）时，规范表示会与单帧失配，加重时间形变模型的负担。因此作者希望减小规范表示与目标帧之间的差距。
AI.method: 提出仿射图集规范高斯表示：在更大的仿射对齐图集空间中构建规范高斯；在规范高斯构建前，用逐帧仿射变换吸收全局运动。该方法仅修改规范构建阶段，可集成到现有基于规范高斯的框架中，额外参数开销可忽略。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法提升了重建质量，尤其在具有大相机运动的序列上表现更优。
AI.conclusion: 通过仿射对齐图集空间的规范高斯构建，可有效缓解全局运动导致的规范表示失配问题，并且易于集成、参数成本低，对大相机运动视频重建具有显著效果。

title: MVDG: Efficient Multi-view 3D Disambiguation on Unconstrained Real-World Images
summary: Illusory matches between distinct yet visually similar 3D surfaces--doppelgangers--remain a fundamental obstacle for large-scale, in-the-wild 3D reconstruction and visual localization. Prior work mitigates this issue with pairwise classifiers, but this design limits multi-view contextual reasoning and incurs O(n^2) inference complexity for downstream structure-from-motion (SfM). We present MVDG, a scalable multi-view disambiguation framework built on the 3D foundation model VGGT, which jointly reasons over an arbitrary number of multiview images. By incorporating 3D-aware multi-view features, our method reduces dependence on pairwise comparisons by encoding and decoding views in a single pass. We further observe that direct multi-view fine-tuning of VGGT can be unstable under noisy supervision; motivated by label ambiguity in Doppelgangers, we construct a pseudo-pairwise training set from AerialMegaDepth and show that fine-tuning on sampled subsets yields stable optimization and strong generalization to held-out scenes. Finally, because full SfM evaluation (even with faster pipelines such as GLOMAP) remains expensive, we process a pseudo-pairwise dataset for efficient validation; we derive a predictive relationship between regular SfM metrics and the classification accuracy on this pseudo-pairwise test. Experiments show that our method achieves comparable pairwise accuracy while improving both SfM accuracy and inference speed over baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出多视角消歧框架 MVDG，基于 3D 基础模型 VGGT 单次编解码多视角图像，缓解 3D 重建中的"二重身"误匹配问题，在成对匹配精度相当的同时提升 SfM 精度与推理速度。
AI.motivation: 不同但视觉相似的 3D 表面之间会产生"二重身"式错觉匹配，是大规模野外 3D 重建与视觉定位的核心障碍。已有方法采用成对分类器，限制了多视角上下文推理能力，且在下游 SfM 中带来 O(n^2) 推理复杂度。
AI.method: 1) 构建 MVDG，基于 3D 基础模型 VGGT 对任意数量多视角图像联合推理，通过引入 3D 感知多视角特征，在单次前向中完成多视角的编码与解码，减少对成对比较的依赖。2) 针对 VGGT 直接多视角微调在噪声监督下不稳定的问题，利用 Doppelgangers 的标签模糊性，从 AerialMegaDepth 构建伪成对训练集，并证明在采样子集上微调可获得稳定优化与良好的跨场景泛化。3) 因完整 SfM 评估（即便用 GLOMAP 等加速流程）成本高昂，改用伪成对数据集进行高效验证，并推导出常规 SfM 指标与伪成对测试分类精度之间的预测关系。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在成对匹配精度上与基线相当，同时在 SfM 精度和推理速度上均优于基线。
AI.conclusion: 多视角联合推理可有效替代成对分类范式，兼具可扩展性与效率；伪成对验证为 SfM 评估提供了低成本替代方案。

title: Open Vocabulary Word Recognition From Transcribed Bangla Texts
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Accepted version of the paper published in the 2023 26th International Conference on Computer and Information Technology (ICCIT). Code: https://github.com/FaiasPromit/Optical-Character-Recognition-From-Handwritten-Bangla-Texts
summary: An optical character recognition (OCR) can scan a paper and extract text using technology, making people's jobs easier. While various OCR systems are available in the software industry, finding a reliable equivalent solution for Bangla takes much work. When it comes to handwritten texts, the situation is much more unusual. Recognizing words from word images is the most critical stage in any OCR process. It is the second stage after segmenting words from text pictures. If this stage fails, the overall performance of the OCR will be poor, regardless of how well the other phases perform. This study aims to recognize words using deep learning in a handwritten Bangla word image. Three object detection models, SSD with MobileNetV2, Faster R-CNN with InceptionResNetV2, and an ensemble model of these two, have been used to train and test handwritten word images. A modified Non-Maximum Suppression has been introduced to enhance the effectiveness of the models' results. A customized dataset of 9841 handwritten Bangla word images has been compiled, featuring diverse handwriting styles from various individuals. All three models' performances have been checked against the test dataset, and the ensemble model has been the most impressive, with an F1-score of 92.61%. Also, at the word level, the ensemble model correctly recognizes 96.12% of the words to some extent. The system can be further improved by introducing a post-processing phase to correct errors generated by the system.

AI.tldr: 本文针对手写孟加拉语单词识别难题，构建9841张图像的定制数据集，采用SSD+MobileNetV2、Faster R-CNN+InceptionResNetV2及其集成模型进行训练测试，并引入改进的非极大值抑制（NMS）提升效果。
AI.motivation: OCR可自动提取纸张文字、简化工作，但孟加拉语缺乏可靠的等效方案，手写体尤为困难；而单词识别是OCR流程中承上启下的关键阶段，其失败会拖累整体性能，因此需专门研究手写孟加拉语单词识别。
AI.method: 以单词图像识别为目标，采用三种目标检测模型：SSD+MobileNetV2、Faster R-CNN+InceptionResNetV2，以及二者的集成模型；提出改进的非极大值抑制（NMS）以提升检测效果；自建包含9841张、来源多书写风格的手写孟加拉语单词图像数据集，并在测试集上评估。
AI.result: 三种模型均在测试集上评估，集成模型表现最佳，F1-score达92.61%；在单词层面，集成模型对96.12%的单词能在一定程度上正确识别。
AI.conclusion: 集成模型结合改进NMS可有效提升手写孟加拉语单词识别性能；后续可通过引入后处理阶段纠正系统产生的错误以进一步改进系统。

title: OptimusMesh: Compact Autoregressive Mesh Generation from Point Clouds via Sparse Latent Pivots
summary: Generating compact and geometrically faithful 3D meshes directly from point clouds remains a fundamental challenge. Point clouds are unordered and sparse, whereas meshes exhibit irregular structure and varying topology. As a result, many existing approaches rely on implicit representations followed by surface extraction or reconstruction. Although effective, these pipelines can produce dense or over-smoothed meshes, often requiring computationally expensive post-processing and simplification. We present OptimusMesh, a framework for direct compact triangle mesh generation from point clouds using sparse latent pivot conditioning. Our key idea is to compress $2{,}048$ oriented input points into only $16$ sparse latent pivots, reducing the geometric conditioning set by $128\times$. These pivots provide a compact structural representation shared across a two-stage autoregressive framework that first generates mesh vertices and then predicts triangular faces conditioned on the generated vertices and the same pivots. Compared with the evaluated recent point-cloud-conditioned autoregressive methods, which use $257$ decoder-conditioning tokens, OptimusMesh uses only $16$, yielding a $16.1\times$ shorter conditioning sequence. Experiments show that OptimusMesh produces the most compact outputs among the compared recent autoregressive methods, using $25.7\%$--$94.1\%$ fewer faces while maintaining competitive geometric fidelity and distributional quality.

AI.tldr: OptimusMesh 提出一种基于稀疏隐枢轴条件的框架，可直接从点云生成紧凑的三角网格，通过将2048个定向点压缩为16个隐枢轴实现128倍条件压缩。
AI.motivation: 从点云直接生成紧凑且几何保真的3D网格仍是基础难题。点云无序稀疏，网格结构不规则且拓扑多变，现有方法多依赖隐式表示加表面提取，容易产生密集或过度平滑的网格，需要昂贵的后处理与简化。
AI.method: 将2048个定向输入点压缩为仅16个稀疏隐枢轴，使几何条件集缩小128倍。这些枢轴作为紧凑结构表示，在两阶段自回归框架中共享：首先生成网格顶点，再以生成顶点和相同枢轴为条件预测三角面片。
AI.result: 相比近期点云条件自回归方法使用的257个解码器条件token，OptimusMesh仅用16个，条件序列缩短16.1倍。实验中输出最紧凑，面片数减少25.7%–94.1%，同时保持有竞争力的几何保真度与分布质量。
AI.conclusion: 通过稀疏隐枢轴条件，OptimusMesh 实现了从点云直接生成紧凑三角网格，在显著减少条件token和面片数量的同时维持了几何保真度与分布质量，为直接网格生成提供了高效方案。

title: The RSNA Intracranial Aneurysm (RSNA-ICA) Dataset
summary: Intracranial aneurysm rupture is associated with substantial morbidity and mortality, yet aneurysm detection remains challenging, particularly for small lesions and on routine non-angiographic imaging examinations. To support the development and evaluation of artificial intelligence (AI) algorithms for intracranial aneurysm detection and localization, the Radiological Society of North America (RSNA), in collaboration with the American Society of Neuroradiology (ASNR), the Society of Neurointerventional Surgery (SNIS), and the European Society of Neuroradiology (ESNR), curated the RSNA Intracranial Aneurysm (RSNA-ICA) Dataset. Developed for the 2025 RSNA Intracranial Aneurysm Detection Challenge, RSNA-ICA is a large, publicly available, expert-annotated dataset comprising 7202 CTA, MRA, and MRI series from 4278 adult patients collected across 21 institutions in 12 countries spanning five continents. The dataset includes 2566 CTA, 2166 MRA, and 2470 MRI series from patients with and without intracranial saccular aneurysms, providing substantial geographic and imaging diversity. Expert annotations indicate both aneurysm presence and location, and 178 series additionally include three-dimensional segmentations of challenge-defined vascular locations. RSNA-ICA was used to develop and evaluate algorithms in the 2025 RSNA Intracranial Aneurysm Detection Challenge. Of the 7202 image series, 5041 are publicly available through MIRA (https://mira.rsna.org/dataset/7), while the remainder were used for challenge public and private test sets. The dataset is freely available to the research community for noncommercial use and provides a comprehensive resource for advancing AI-based aneurysm detection across both angiographic and routine neuroimaging examinations.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了RSNA-ICA数据集：由RSNA联合ASNR、SNIS、ESNR构建的大型公开专家标注颅内动脉瘤检测数据集，含来自12国21机构4278名成人的7202个CTA/MRA/MRI序列，用于2025年RSNA颅内动脉瘤检测挑战赛，推动AI动脉瘤检测算法研发与评估。
AI.motivation: 颅内动脉瘤破裂致死致残率高，但动脉瘤检测仍具挑战性，尤其对小病灶及常规非血管造影影像检查。为支持颅内动脉瘤检测与定位AI算法的开发与评估，需要大规模、多中心、专家标注的公开数据集。
AI.method: RSNA联合ASNR、SNIS、ESNR构建RSNA-ICA数据集，汇集12个国家21家机构4278名成年患者的7202个影像序列（2566个CTA、2166个MRA、2470个MRI），涵盖有/无颅内囊状动脉瘤患者，专家标注动脉瘤存在与位置，其中178个序列额外提供三维分割标注；该数据集用于2025年RSNA颅内动脉瘤检测挑战赛中算法的开发与评估。
AI.result: 数据集提供了显著的地理与影像多样性；7202个序列中5041个通过MIRA平台公开，其余用于挑战赛公开与私有测试集；数据集免费向研究界开放（非商业用途）。
AI.conclusion: RSNA-ICA为跨血管造影与常规神经影像检查的AI动脉瘤检测提供了全面资源，有望推动该领域AI算法的发展。

title: PhysicsLENS: Diagnosing Physical Property Blindness in Video Generation Models
summary: Reliable video world models could provide scalable predictive environments for robot learning, planning, and evaluation. However, generated robot videos can violate physical principles and complete tasks through physically implausible behavior, limiting their reliability for robot learning and planning. Current video-generation benchmarks exclude physics that are inherently hidden by visuals (e.g., weight, viscosity, friction). Due to this, video models are evaluated on the fidelity of physics, not the underlying accuracy of physics. We introduce PhysicsLENS, a dataset and benchmark for evaluating plausibility of physical properties grounded in robotics. PhysicsLENS uses matched scenario pairs that hold the same conditioning frame and task, while varying underlying physics in the scene description. Scenarios are curated from public robot video sources and annotated across seven physical domains: collision, gravity, momentum, friction, deformation, fluid, and causality. We evaluate across four video generation models, producing over 400 human-annotated labels. Results show that plausible-looking videos often ignore the stated property (34 of 47), and that stating the property lowers plausibility only slightly and not significantly.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出PhysicsLENS，一个面向机器人领域、基于配对场景的物理合理性评测数据集与基准，覆盖七类物理域，并揭示现有视频生成模型常生成"看似合理但违背所述物理属性"的视频。
