Across continual erasure of celebrities, artistic styles, and instances, CEASE achieves the most consistent erase-preserve trade-off, while existing methods either degrade general generation or insufficiently erase targets.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练方法 CEASE，通过双重子空间约束的闭式求解器实现扩散模型的持续概念擦除，在不损害通用生成能力的前提下连续擦除多个目标概念。
AI.motivation: 预训练文生图扩散模型需要随时间逐步擦除受版权保护、隐私敏感或不希望出现的目标概念，同时不破坏此前已擦除的效果。现有方法未约束多次编辑间的相互干扰：保留集之外的残余扰动会相互作用并累积，导致无关生成退化，甚至使先前已擦除目标坍缩为噪声。
AI.method: CEASE（基于自适应子空间编辑的持续擦除），一种免训练方法，在闭式求解器上施加两个子空间约束：一是将共享替换词的 token 表示加入求解器的不变矩阵；二是在检测到干扰时，将当前更新投影到由累积历史更新提取的主导输出方向的正交补空间上。并用闭式分解证明累积干扰来源于共享替换词的重复激活与相邻更新方向的重叠。
AI.result: 在名人、艺术风格和实例的持续擦除任务上，CEASE 取得最一致的擦除-保留权衡；现有方法要么损害通用生成，要么擦除不充分。
AI.conclusion: CEASE 通过共享替换表示的不变性约束与历史更新主导方向的正交投影约束，分别抑制了持续干扰的两个来源，实现了稳定且一致的持续概念擦除。

title: Comparing a gradient boosting algorithm to the GOES FDC for wildfire detection
summary: Wildfires pose severe risks to human life, ecosystems, and property. This study presents a machine learning approach for wildfire detection from GOES ABI imagery. A CatBoost model was trained on a large dataset with thousands of ABI images and over 300,000 matching VIIRS fire detections. An evaluation on a separate dataset across five regions showed that the learned CatBoost model outperformed the operational GOES Fire Detection and Characterization (FDC) product. It achieved higher precision, recall, and F1 scores both within and outside the training area. The CatBoost model achieved F1 scores that were 0.16 to 0.38 higher than the GOES FDC in all regions. In addition, out of 51 historical fire events, the CatBoost detected 26 fires before both VIIRS and GOES FDC, compared to only six earlier detections by the GOES FDC. Importantly, the CatBoost model achieved accurate wildfire detection also during nighttime, whereas the GOES FDC obtained very low recall values, around 0.03. This study demonstrates that machine learning models may offer significant improvements over existing geostationary fire products, including higher accuracy, fewer false alarms, and earlier detection.

AI.tldr: 基于GOES ABI影像与CatBoost的野火检测模型，在精度与时效性上全面优于业务化GOES FDC产品。
AI.motivation: 野火对人类生命、生态系统和财产构成严重威胁，现有业务化静止卫星火点产品（GOES FDC）在准确性与探测时效上存在不足，亟需更高性能的检测方法。
AI.method: 使用包含数千景ABI影像与30万余条匹配VIIRS火点探测的大规模数据集训练CatBoost模型，并在覆盖五个区域的独立数据集上进行评估，与GOES FDC产品对比精度、召回率、F1及探测时效。
AI.result: CatBoost在所有区域的F1均比GOES FDC高0.16–0.38，区域内与区域外均取得更高的精度和召回率；51起历史火事件中，CatBoost有26起早于VIIRS与GOES FDC探测，而GOES FDC仅6起更早；夜间探测召回率显著更优，GOES FDC仅约0.03。
AI.conclusion: 机器学习模型相较现有静止卫星火点产品可显著提升性能，包括更高精度、更少误报与更早探测，具备替代或补充业务化产品的潜力。

title: From Reasoning Failures to Composable Video Spatial Intelligence
summary: Spatial reasoning benchmarks evaluate vision-language models across diverse tasks, but task-level scores do not reveal which underlying capabilities account for success or failure. Each task requires recovering spatial evidence, representing geometry, and reasoning over it. We disentangle these capabilities by comparing predicted and ground-truth spatial context under a shared schema and coordinate contract. This comparison reveals four recurring sources of error: inaccurate perception, missing information in the spatial context, selection of the wrong measurement, and errors in reference frames or in tracking position and orientation. Guided by this diagnosis, we develop CROSS, a training-free library of typed geometric operators and spatial skills that function over available evidence to support reliable video spatial reasoning. The resulting library supplies verified context to non-coding VLMs or callable skills to a SpatialClaw agent. We evaluate \methodname{} on five benchmarks. \methodname{} raises the average score from 55.9\% to 60.2\% on ReVSI and improves the SpatialClaw result from 62.8\% to 66.3\% on DSI-Bench. These gains demonstrate that explicit handling of spatial conventions can repair systematic reasoning failures without additional training.

AI.tldr: 论文诊断出视频空间推理的四类系统性错误来源，并据此提出免训练库CROSS，通过显式的空间约定处理提升多基准表现。
AI.motivation: 现有空间推理基准仅给出任务级分数，无法揭示成败背后的具体能力差异；每项任务实际需要空间证据恢复、几何表征与推理三类能力，缺乏细粒度归因。
AI.method: 在统一的模式与坐标契约下比较预测与真值的空间上下文，据此识别四类反复出现的错误：感知不准确、空间上下文信息缺失、测量选择错误、参考系或位置/朝向跟踪错误。基于该诊断开发免训练的CROSS，由类型化几何算子与空间技能组成，作用于可用证据；可为非编程型VLM提供经验证的上下文，或作为可调用技能供SpatialClaw智能体使用。
AI.result: 在五个基准上评估：ReVSI平均分从55.9%提升至60.2%；DSI-Bench上SpatialClaw结果从62.8%提升至66.3%。
AI.conclusion: 显式处理空间约定可在无需额外训练的情况下修复系统性推理失败，验证了"诊断—干预"式能力分解的有效性。

title: Weather-Aware Domain Adaptation for Street-View Weather Recognition
comment: 7 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Published in the 2026 IEEE Conference on Technologies for Sustainability (SusTech)
summary: Adverse conditions such as rain, snow, fog, and dust remain challenging for camera-based perception in autonomous driving. We study multi-class weather recognition from street-view images under domain shift, where most available training data come from non-street-view sources that differ markedly from real driving scenes. We propose Weather-Aware Adversarial Discriminative Domain Adaptation (WA-ADDA), which conditions the domain discriminator on predicted weather to promote features that are both domain-invariant and weather-sensitive. We also assemble a multi-dataset benchmark by unifying diverse non-street-view weather collections as sources and real street-view images as targets, and define a standardized evaluation protocol with macro accuracy as the primary metric. Across backbones (ResNet-50, EfficientNet, VGG, DenseNet), WA-ADDA consistently improves street-view performance and yields strong per-class recalls in challenging conditions while preserving clear-weather accuracy. These findings highlight the feasibility of domain-adapted weather recognition and the value of our benchmark for advancing robust, on-board perception.

AI.tldr: 提出WA-ADDA方法，通过将域判别器以预测天气为条件，实现域不变且天气敏感的特征学习，并构建多数据集基准，在街景多类别天气识别中取得稳定提升。
AI.motivation: 雨、雪、雾、沙尘等恶劣天气对自动驾驶中基于摄像头的感知构成挑战；而多类别天气识别面临域偏移问题——现有训练数据多来自非街景来源，与真实驾驶场景差异显著。
AI.method: 提出Weather-Aware Adversarial Discriminative Domain Adaptation（WA-ADDA），将域判别器以预测天气结果为条件，从而促使特征兼具域不变性与天气敏感性；同时整合多个非街景天气数据集为源域、真实街景图像为目标域，构建多数据集基准，并以宏平均准确率为主指标定义标准化评测协议。
AI.result: 在ResNet-50、EfficientNet、VGG、DenseNet等多种骨干网络上，WA-ADDA均稳定提升街景识别性能；在困难天气条件下各类召回率表现优异，同时保持晴天准确率。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明域自适应天气识别具有可行性，该基准对推动鲁棒的车载感知研究具有价值。

title: Exploring Weaknesses of Generative Image Watermarks against Latent Frequency Masking
comment: This work has been accepted for publication at IEEE ICDM 2026 conference. The final published version will be available via IEEE Xplore
summary: Invisible watermarking has become a central tool for tracing AI-generated images, but its robustness against adaptive removal attacks remains an open security question. We introduce Latent Frequency Masking, an attack that erases watermark evidence by replacing selected Fourier coefficients in the latent representation of a watermarked image. The replacement can be sampled from Gaussian noise for efficiency or derived from diffusion regeneration for improved image preservation. We provide a theoretical distortion bound relating the change between the reconstructed adversarial image and the masked latent-frequency perturbation. We evaluate the proposed attack against six diffusion watermarking methods on images generated from DiffusionDB and MS-COCO prompts. Latent Frequency Masking removes or substantially weakens several watermarks while preserving perceptual quality and achieving favorable runtime compared with existing attacks. These results identify latent-frequency manipulation as a practical attack surface and highlight the need to include such attacks in robustness evaluations of generative image watermarking.

AI.tldr: 本文提出潜伏频率掩蔽（Latent Frequency Masking）攻击，通过在潜空间替换选定傅里叶系数来擦除水印证据，可有效去除或大幅削弱多种扩散模型水印，同时保持图像感知质量。
AI.motivation: 隐形水印已成为追踪AI生成图像的核心工具，但其面对自适应去除攻击的鲁棒性仍是一个未解决的安全问题。因此需要揭示潜空间频率操作这一实际攻击面。
AI.method: 提出潜伏频率掩蔽攻击：在水印图像的潜表示中替换选定的傅里叶系数。替换值可采样自高斯噪声（高效），或由扩散再生成导出（更好保持图像质量）。并给出重构对抗图像与掩蔽潜频率扰动之间变化的理论失真界。
AI.result: 在DiffusionDB和MS-COCO提示生成的图像上，针对六种扩散水印方法进行评估。该攻击去除或显著削弱了若干水印，同时保持感知质量，并与现有攻击相比具有更优的运行时间。
AI.conclusion: 结果确立了潜频率操纵作为一种实际攻击面，并强调需将此类攻击纳入生成图像水印鲁棒性评估。

title: Task-Adaptive Grounded 3D-Programmers Using 2D VLMs
summary:
Recent vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit remarkable generalization and reasoning abilities, yet 3D understanding in these models is limited by data scale, training diversity, and reasoning capacity. Instead of naively extending these models into 3D, we take a different approach: we enable powerful 2D VLMs to operate reliably in 3D by introducing 3D grounding and iterative feedback loops with two novel concepts: Canonical Coordinate Framing (CCF) and Task-Adaptive Feedback (TAF). CCF serves as a unified visual representation that anchors both inputs and outputs to a shared Euclidean coordinate system, solving common challenges in 3D grounding such as axis ambiguity, inconsistent metric scale, and floating references. Complementary to this structured framing of the 3D inputs, TAF closes the reasoning loop with task-adaptive dynamic feedback that enables 2D VLMs to perform varied open-vocabulary tasks within their native visual context.
  Building on this foundation, we introduce 3D-Prog, a 3D understanding, reasoning, and generation framework that jointly employs the capabilities of CCF and TAF together with powerful VLMs. Without requiring any retraining, 3D-Prog performs open-vocabulary 3D understanding, manipulation, and generation across both object-level and scene-level tasks. Our experiments show that the joint use of CCF and TAF transforms 2D VLMs into geometry-aware 3D programmers, achieving consistent, interpretable, and high-quality results across diverse 3D tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出CCF与TAF两个新概念，使2D VLM无需重训练即可可靠进行3D理解，并构建3D-Prog框架完成开放词汇的3D理解、操作与生成。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型（VLM）具备出色的泛化与推理能力，但其3D理解受限于数据规模、训练多样性和推理能力。作者不主张将模型简单扩展到3D，而是让强大的2D VLM在3D场景中可靠运行。
AI.method: 引入两个新概念：1）Canonical Coordinate Framing（CCF），作为统一视觉表示，将输入与输出锚定到共享欧氏坐标系，解决3D grounding中的轴歧义、度量尺度不一致和浮动参考等问题；2）Task-Adaptive Feedback（TAF），以任务自适应的动态反馈闭合推理回路，使2D VLM在其原生视觉上下文中完成多样的开放词汇任务。基于此构建3D-Prog框架，联合使用CCF、TAF与强大VLM。
AI.result: 无需任何重训练，3D-Prog即可在对象级和场景级任务上执行开放词汇的3D理解、操作与生成。实验表明，CCF与TAF的联合使用将2D VLM转化为几何感知的3D编程器，在多样3D任务上取得一致、可解释且高质量的结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过CCF与TAF将2D VLM有效赋能至3D，避免对3D数据的大规模依赖与重训练，实现跨任务的开放词汇3D理解、操作与生成，展现出良好的泛化性、可解释性与结果质量。

title: Form and Void: Entangled Composition through an Autonomous AI Agent
summary: Positive and negative space is a fundamental principle in visual composition, supporting visually coherent forms and layered semantic relationships. Generating such compositions is challenging because it requires coordinated control over two semantic concepts that share a common boundary. Although recent text-to-image models and multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved strong performance in image generation and visual understanding, positive-negative space generation remains difficult, particularly under direct single-pass prompting. In this work, we present the \textbf{F}orm \textbf{a}nd \textbf{V}oid \textbf{A}gent (\textbf{FaV-A}), a multimodal agent designed for staged positive-negative space generation. FaV-A follows a progressive workflow: it first generates a base object, then analyzes its shape and spatial structure to identify candidate negative-space semantics, and finally produces compositional instructions for the final image generation stage. Experimental results and ablation analyses suggest that FaV-A provides a more effective framework than direct zero-shot MLLM baselines for producing visually coherent and semantically aligned positive-negative space compositions.

AI.tldr: 提出FaV-A多模态智能体，通过分阶段流程实现正负空间构图生成，优于直接零样本MLLM基线。
AI.motivation: 正负空间是视觉构图的基本原理，能支撑视觉连贯的形式与分层语义关系。但生成此类构图具有挑战性，因为它需要对共享同一边界的两个语义概念进行协同控制。尽管近期文本到图像模型和多模态大模型在图像生成与视觉理解上表现强劲，正负空间生成仍然困难，尤其是在直接单次提示下。
AI.method: 提出Form and Void Agent（FaV-A），一种面向分阶段正负空间生成的多模态智能体。其工作流程为渐进式：首先生成基础物体；随后分析其形状与空间结构，识别候选的负空间语义；最后生成组合指令，用于最终图像生成阶段。
AI.result: 实验与消融分析表明，相比直接零样本MLLM基线，FaV-A能生成视觉更连贯、语义更对齐的正负空间构图。
AI.conclusion: FaV-A为分阶段正负空间构图生成提供了更有效的框架，验证了渐进式智能体流程相较直接零样本提示的优势。

title: DiDE:Direct Injection with Color-Texture DEcoupling for 3D Stylization
summary: Recent advances in rectified flow-based image-to-3D generative models have enabled high-fidelity 3D asset generation. Building on this, a growing line of work has exploited these strong 3D priors for training-free stylization, transferring visual attributes from a reference image onto a generated 3D asset. However, existing methods enforce an all-or-nothing paradigm: color and texture are transferred jointly, with no mechanism to control them independently -- a limitation we formalize as Disentangled 3D Stylization(Disen3D). To address this, we propose DiDE, the first training-free framework for Disen3D. Key to our approach is the observation that the structured latent space of image-to-3D models is overcomplete with respect to texture: texture information occupies only a small subset of the style-significant channels, leaving a free subspace available for independent color encoding. DiDE exploits this via a channel partition mechanism that processes a content image, a texture reference, and a color reference through dedicated branches and composes both style signals interference-free at every self-attention layer, preserving content geometry throughout. Experiments on Disen3D-Bench, our newly collected multi-reference benchmark, show that DiDE consistently outperforms 2D and 3D stylization baselines in color fidelity, texture transfer, and content preservation.

AI.tldr: 提出首个免训练的解耦3D风格化框架DiDE，通过通道划分在过完备隐空间中独立编码颜色与纹理，实现无干扰的风格组合。
AI.motivation: 现有基于矫正流的图像到3D生成模型虽可免训练风格化3D资产，但颜色与纹理被联合迁移，缺乏独立控制机制，作者将此局限形式化为"解耦3D风格化（Disen3D）"问题。
AI.method: 观察到图像到3D模型的结构化隐空间对纹理而言是过完备的：纹理信息仅占据少量风格显著通道，剩余自由子空间可用于独立颜色编码。DiDE据此采用通道划分机制，将内容图、纹理参考与颜色参考分别送入专用分支，并在每一自注意力层无干扰地组合两种风格信号，同时保持内容几何不变。
AI.result: 在新建的多参考基准Disen3D-Bench上，DiDE在颜色保真度、纹理迁移与内容保持三方面均持续优于2D与3D风格化基线。
AI.conclusion: DiDE是首个免训练的Disen3D框架，验证了利用隐空间过完备性进行通道解耦的可行性，为独立控制颜色与纹理的3D风格化提供了有效方案。

title: Learning from Failure: Leveraging Unreliable Predictions in Semi-Supervised Real-World Adverse Weather Removal
summary: Adverse weather image restoration aims to recover images degraded by rain, haze, snow, and other weather-induced artifacts, thereby improving the robustness of outdoor vision systems. Existing unified restoration models exhibit limited generalization to real-world scenes due to their reliance on synthetic supervision and insufficient semantic constraints. In this paper, we propose a novel student--teacher semi-supervised framework that addresses both challenges. Specifically, we introduce an unreliable database that preserves failed teacher predictions as informative negative samples for contrastive learning, while a reliable database stores high-quality teacher predictions as positive samples. By jointly exploiting reliable pseudo-ground truths and unreliable teacher outputs, the proposed framework learns to enhance desirable restoration characteristics while avoiding common failures. We further propose a phase spectrum-based semantic constraint that replaces computationally expensive text-based supervision with an efficient and naturally aligned semantic prior. An adaptive phase consistency loss is also designed to dynamically balance supervision between the degraded input and teacher pseudo-ground truths according to degradation severity. Extensive experiments on real-world benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed method consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art approaches in restoration quality and perceptual fidelity while exhibiting stronger generalization to real-world adverse weather conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出一种学生-教师半监督框架用于恶劣天气图像复原，通过可靠/不可靠双数据库与相位谱语义约束，提升真实场景泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有统一复原模型依赖合成监督、缺乏语义约束，导致对真实场景泛化能力有限，且合成数据与真实退化之间存在域差距。
AI.method: 构建学生-教师半监督框架：引入不可靠数据库保存失败的教师预测作为对比学习的负样本，可靠数据库保存高质量教师预测作为正样本；联合利用可靠伪真值与不可靠教师输出进行学习；提出基于相位谱的语义约束替代高成本文本监督，并设计自适应相位一致性损失，根据退化程度动态平衡退化输入与教师伪真值之间的监督权重。
AI.result: 在真实世界基准上，所提方法在复原质量和感知保真度上持续优于现有最先进方法，并对真实恶劣天气条件表现出更强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 利用不可靠预测作为负样本并结合高效相位谱语义先验，可有效缓解合成监督与语义约束不足问题，提升统一恶劣天气图像复原的真实场景泛化性能。

title: Surface-volume self-supervised representation learning of brain MRI for genetic discovery
summary: Existing genome-wide association studies (GWAS) of brain imaging provide predefined or deep-learning-derived imaging phenotypes, yet these phenotypes come from either volumetric scans or cortical surface meshes, so each captures only part of the heritable variation in brain anatomy. Here we introduce MEVA (Mesh-Enhanced Volumetric Autoencoder), a self-supervised framework that encodes voxel-level image intensity together with cortical mesh geometry, including curvature and cortical thickness at each surface vertex, into one shared set of imaging features. Combining the mesh and volumetric inputs in MEVA yields modest performance gains in age and sex prediction over models that use either input alone. When these features serve as phenotypes for GWAS in the UK Biobank, they reveal more genome-wide significant loci than features learned from volumes alone or from meshes alone. These results suggest that adding cortical surface geometry to volumetric self-supervised learning captures additional heritable variation and so increases the number of loci detected.

AI.tldr: 提出MEVA自监督框架，将体素强度与皮层网格几何统一编码为共享影像特征，用于GWAS可发现更多显著位点。
AI.motivation: 现有脑影像GWAS的影像表型来自体积扫描或皮层表面网格，各自仅能捕捉脑解剖遗传变异的一部分，信息不完整。
AI.method: 构建MEVA（Mesh-Enhanced Volumetric Autoencoder）自监督框架，将体素级图像强度与皮层网格几何（每个表面顶点的曲率和皮层厚度）编码为一组共享的影像特征；随后将这些特征作为表型在UK Biobank中进行GWAS。以年龄和性别预测作为特征质量的评估任务。
AI.result: 融合网格与体积输入的MEVA在年龄和性别预测上相较仅用单一输入的模型有小幅性能提升；作为GWAS表型时，检出的全基因组显著位点数多于仅由体积或仅由网格学到的特征。
AI.conclusion: 在体积自监督学习中引入皮层表面几何能够捕捉额外的可遗传变异，从而提高检出位点数量。

title: GeoLatent: Geometry-Guided Latent Structuring with Routed Optimization for 3D Reasoning
summary: Despite progress in vision-language models, 3D spatial reasoning from 2D images remains challenging. Text-based methods describe intermediate geometry with discrete tokens, limiting fidelity for continuous spatial relations. Continuous latents offer richer representations, but a single latent type does not explicitly separate the cues needed across spatial tasks. Decomposed spatial latents address this by representing position, direction, and global geometry separately under geometric supervision. Yet the geometry representation can still collapse toward one dominant direction, and unrestricted attention can leave the latents underused during answer learning. We introduce GeoLatent, combining Common--Residual Geometry Alignment (CR-GEO) with routed optimization to structure the geometry states while promoting latent-mediated answer learning. CR-GEO separates shared from residual teacher geometry; routed optimization jointly trains geometry and language, temporarily directs visual answer learning through the latents, and restores full attention with geometry supervision. In controlled comparisons, CR-GEO raises geometry effective rank from 1.00 to 3.87, while blocking latent readout at the bottleneck lowers direction accuracy from 89.1% to 25.8% on 128 fixed questions. After recovery, the differentiated geometry representation and latent-mediated visual route remain available alongside direct image access. GeoLatent achieves 73.0% on SPAR-Bench and 72.1% on SPBench, outperforming previously reported methods on both.

AI.tldr: 提出GeoLatent，通过CR-GEO与路由优化构建分解式几何潜变量，提升2D图像3D空间推理，SPAR-Bench达73.0%、SPBench达72.1%。
AI.motivation: 基于文本的中间几何用离散token描述，对连续空间关系保真度有限；单一连续潜变量无法显式分离不同空间任务所需的线索；分解式潜变量虽分别表征位置、方向与全局几何，但几何表示易坍缩到单一主导方向，且无约束注意力会导致潜变量在答案学习中未被充分利用。
AI.method: GeoLatent结合Common-Residual Geometry Alignment (CR-GEO)与路由优化。CR-GEO将教师几何分为共享部分与残差部分进行对齐；路由优化联合训练几何与语言，临时将视觉答案学习经由潜变量进行，并在几何监督下恢复全注意力。
AI.result: 受控对比中，CR-GEO将几何有效秩从1.00提升至3.87；在瓶颈处阻断潜变量读出使方向准确率从89.1%降至25.8%（128个固定问题）。恢复后，差异化几何表示与潜变量中介的视觉路径仍可用，同时保留直接图像访问。GeoLatent在SPAR-Bench达73.0%，SPBench达72.1%，均超越此前报道方法。
AI.conclusion: 分解式几何潜变量配合CR-GEO与路由优化可有效缓解几何表示坍缩与潜变量利用不足，显著提升3D空间推理性能。

title: Where-OPD: Spatially Guided On-Policy Self-Distillation of MLLMs with Synthetic Scenes
summary: On-policy self-distillation has recently emerged as an effective approach for improving language-model reasoning by supervising students with a frozen or EMA version of themselves that receives privileged information. Its application to multimodal large language models (MLLMs), however, remains largely unexplored. Recent approaches use privileged visual information, such as image crops corresponding to a question, to improve fine-grained perception, but their gains are confined to tasks that benefit from such visual zooming and require either human-annotated grounding data or external teacher models. We introduce a different form of on-policy self-distillation for MLLMs that provides the teacher with textual, spatially grounded guidance identifying the visual elements relevant to a query. We use procedurally generated scenes with automatically available object identities and spatial coordinates, enabling scalable and annotation-free post-training. The teacher uses this spatial guidance to locate and integrate evidence from multiple relevant image regions, while the student learns to reproduce the resulting behavior from the image and question alone. Our approach consistently improves performance on counting, document and chart understanding benchmarks across multiple models. Importantly, although post-training uses only synthetic scenes, the resulting improvements transfer to real-world perception benchmarks, yielding a 3.23-point gain in average performance across CVBench, V*, ZoomBench, BLINK, HR-Bench, and MME-RealWorld. These results show that spatially grounded privileged information can induce broader perceptual capabilities through on-policy self-distillation, enabling substantial synthetic-to-real transfer beyond the task and data distribution used for post-training. Project page: https://github.com/sirkosophia/Where-OPD

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向多模态大模型的on-policy自蒸馏方法，教师模型接收文本化、空间定位的引导信息以定位并整合多区域证据，学生模型仅凭图像与问题学习复现该行为；通过程序化生成场景实现免标注可扩展后训练，在多个模型与基准上持续提升，并展现出显著的合成到真实迁移能力。
AI.motivation: on-policy自蒸馏已有效提升语言模型推理，但在多模态大模型上探索不足；现有利用特权视觉信息（如图像裁剪）的方法仅对需要视觉放大的任务有效，且依赖人工标注的定位数据或外部教师模型，难以扩展。
AI.method: 提出一种新的多模态on-policy自蒸馏形式：教师模型获得文本化的、空间定位的引导信息，指明与查询相关的视觉元素。使用程序化生成场景，自动获取物体身份与空间坐标，实现可扩展、免标注的后训练。教师据此定位并整合多个相关图像区域的证据，学生则仅从图像和问题出发学习复现该行为。
AI.result: 在计数、文档与图表理解等基准上，跨多个模型性能持续提升；尽管后训练仅使用合成场景，改进仍迁移至真实世界感知基准，在CVBench、V*、ZoomBench、BLINK、HR-Bench和MME-RealWorld上平均性能提升3.23个点。
AI.conclusion: 空间定位的特权信息可通过on-policy自蒸馏诱导更广泛的感知能力，实现超越后训练任务与数据分布的显著合成到真实迁移。

title: Harnessing Domain Specialists in Multimodal Mixture-of-Experts for Efficient Adaptation
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures scale model capacity through sparse computation, routing each token through only a small subset of experts. In this work, we explore whether this sparsity gives rise to emergent intrinsic organization in multimodal MoEs. We find that experts develop strong semantic specialization across modalities and domains despite not being explicitly trained for modularity. Building on this structure, we introduce ExpertLens, a data-free method that identifies domain-specialized experts directly from pretrained model weights by decoding router weights into semantically meaningful vocabulary tokens. We leverage this specialization for efficient multimodal adaptation by selectively fine-tuning experts relevant to a target domain. Across math, medical, and remote sensing tasks, ExpertLens matches or surpasses full fine-tuning while updating only 21.7 - 47.0% of model parameters and achieving a 4.0x average training speedup, and outperforms LoRA in both adaptation performance and training efficiency. These results show that sparsity introduced for efficiency can give rise to semantic modularity that is directly useful for efficient adaptation.

AI.tldr: 研究发现多模态MoE的专家在无显式模块化训练下自发形成跨模态与领域的语义专精，提出无需数据的ExpertLens从路由权重解码领域专家，实现高效选择性微调。
AI.motivation: 探索MoE为提升效率而引入的稀疏性是否会产生涌现的内在组织（语义模块化），并希望将这种结构直接用于高效的多模态适配，以降低全量微调的算力成本。
AI.method: 通过分析预训练多模态MoE中专家与模态/领域的对应关系；提出ExpertLens——一种data-free方法，将路由权重解码为语义可解释的词表token以识别领域专精专家；进而仅对目标领域相关专家进行选择性微调。
AI.result: 在数学、医学、遥感任务上，ExpertLens匹配或超越全量微调，仅更新21.7–47.0%的参数，平均训练加速4.0倍；在适配性能与训练效率上均优于LoRA。
AI.conclusion: 为效率而引入的稀疏性可自然地催生语义模块化结构，且该结构可直接服务于高效的多模态适配。

title: MIRTO: a registration-gated, multiverse-tested evaluation protocol for unsupervised anomaly segmentation in brain MRI
summary: Unsupervised anomaly detection (UAD) methods for brain MRI are ranked by a single score, yet that score rests on choices that are rarely reported: how each anomaly map is aligned with the reference, how and on which data the threshold is set, and which false-positive budget, metric, aggregation and lesion definition are used. We present MIRTO, an evaluation protocol that makes these choices explicit and measures their effect. It gates the geometry of every comparison with a registration check and label-free diagnostics of known power, sets thresholds on validation data alone and reports the false-positive volume actually realised on test, repeats each comparison over 15,552 defensible evaluation pipelines, and attaches paired subject-bootstrap intervals with multiplicity control. Applied to four UAD methods trained on the same healthy data and tested on 312 BraTS 2020 subjects, MIRTO showed that an axis-order mismatch between stored maps and the reference lowered a diffusion model's voxel AUROC from 0.873 to 0.583 whilst barely moving its slice-level AUROC. Within each metric, the method explained at least 0.95 of the variance in voxel AUROC and AUPRC and 0.77 in Dice, but only 0.14 in lesion sensitivity, where the lesion definition and hit criterion dominated. A Dice advantage that was significant at validation thresholds vanished at equal realised false-positive burden, and an exact identity attributes it to threshold transfer. A training-free change to REFLECT's latent aggregation raised Dice at equal burden by 0.052. Nine hypotheses were tested against explicit criteria; because the same cohort served to develop the protocol, all inference is exploratory.

AI.tldr: 提出MIRTO评估协议，将脑MRI无监督异常检测中常被忽略的评估选择显式化，并在312例BraTS 2020受试者上量化其影响。
AI.motivation: 现有无监督异常检测方法仅用单一分数排名，而该分数依赖于对齐方式、阈值设定数据、假阳性预算、指标、聚合方式与病灶定义等鲜有报告的选择，导致比较结果不可比且可能误导。
AI.method: MIRTO在每次比较前用配准检查约束几何对齐并做已知功效的无标签诊断；仅在验证集上设阈值并报告测试集实际实现的假阳性体积；在15,552个可辩护评估流程上重复比较，并附配对受试者bootstrap区间与多重性控制。
AI.result: 应用于四种在相同健康数据上训练、在312例BraTS 2020受试者上测试的无监督方法：存储图与参考的轴序不匹配使扩散模型体素AUROC从0.873降至0.583，而切片级AUROC几乎不变；指标内方法可解释体素AUROC/AUPRC至少0.95的方差、Dice的0.77，但病灶敏感度仅0.14，由病灶定义与命中准则主导；验证阈值下显著的Dice优势在等实假阳性负担下消失，精确归因于阈值迁移；对REFLECT潜变量聚合的无训练改动在等负担下提升Dice 0.052。
AI.conclusion: 评估选择可大幅改变结论，需显式报告与受控比较；因同一队列用于协议开发，全部推断为探索性。

title: Omni-Embed-Mini: Binding Modalities Without Forgetting via Dense Distillation
comment: Findings of EMNLP 2026. 26 pages, 8 figures, 14 tables. Project page: https://omniembed.cvmbzuai.com
summary: Extending a text embedding model to new modalities typically degrades text retrieval quality, and existing omni-modal embedders compensate with multi-billion parameters. We present Omni-Embed-Mini, a 0.9B-parameter model that maps text, speech, audio, images, video, and visually-rich documents into a single shared cosine space without updating any text-side parameter. Our key insight is that the teacher signal requires no separate embedding model: each media sample is paired with a dense cascaded caption, and the teacher target is simply the frozen backbone's own embedding of that caption. Because teacher and student share the same backbone weights, they inhabit byte-identical geometry, and lightweight projectors plus phased LoRA adapters on the modality encoders suffice for alignment. Training combines a Matryoshka SigLIP contrastive loss with an online hybrid hard-negative miner whose negatives sharpen as the encoder improves. The recipe carries over to a 2.3B variant by swapping in a native vision-language backbone. Omni-Embed-Mini-0.9B keeps its text weights bit-identical to the backbone, so training cannot regress text retrieval (49.57 nDCG@10 on MTEB-v2 BEIR-8), while extending it to five additional modalities, and is ~2.7x to 9.5x smaller than every open omni embedder we compare against. The 2.3B variant is competitive with the closed gemini-embedding-2, edging ahead of it on the overall-modality average. Models, code, data and evaluation harness are on our project page: https://omniembed.cvmbzuai.com

AI.tldr: 提出 Omni-Embed-Mini，0.9B 参数模型将文本、语音、音频、图像、视频和富视觉文档映射到同一余弦空间，且不更新任何文本侧参数，从而避免文本检索性能退化。
AI.motivation: 扩展文本嵌入模型到新模态通常会损害文本检索质量，而现有全模态嵌入器靠数十亿参数来弥补这一缺陷，规模过大。
AI.method: 核心思路是不需要单独的教师嵌入模型：每个媒体样本配一个密集级联描述（caption），教师目标即冻结骨干对该描述的自身嵌入；因教师与学生共享骨干权重，二者几何完全一致，仅需轻量投影器加模态编码器上的分阶段 LoRA 适配器完成对齐。训练结合 Matryoshka SigLIP 对比损失与在线混合难负样本挖掘器，负样本随编码器提升而变难。换用原生视觉语言骨干可扩展到 2.3B 变体。
AI.result: Omni-Embed-Mini-0.9B 文本权重与骨干逐位一致，训练不会导致文本检索退化（MTEB-v2 BEIR-8 上 49.57 nDCG@10），同时扩展到五种额外模态，比所有对比的开放全模态嵌入器小约 2.7x 至 9.5x。2.3B 变体与闭源 gemini-embedding-2 具竞争力，在全模态平均上略胜。
AI.conclusion: 通过冻结文本骨干、以自身 caption 嵌入为教师信号并仅训练轻量对齐模块，可在不牺牲文本检索的前提下实现高效全模态嵌入，显著降低参数规模并保持竞争力。

title: MosaiChunk: Compositing Spatio-Temporal Memory for Autoregressive Video Generation
summary: Long-horizon autoregressive video generation is limited by a finite context window. When an object or scene falls out of context, its fine-grained visual details may be lost and difficult to recover upon reappearance. To retain access to such visual details, we introduce MosaiChunk, a spatio-temporal memory mechanism that composes a mosaic of selected historical key-value (KV) entries across space and time. Our approach is motivated by the observation that a frozen video generator can directly consume such non-contiguous historical KV and recover the corresponding visual content. We therefore keep the generator fixed and learn only a lightweight router that determines which historical sections to include in the mosaic under a fixed active-memory budget. We further introduce RememBench, a benchmark of long-horizon revisits with prompt-driven text-to-video (T2V) and camera-driven image-to-video (I2V) splits. Our experiments show that MosaiChunk consistently improves revisit consistency over both sliding-window inference and whole-chunk retrieval under matched memory budgets, across both T2V and I2V settings.

AI.tldr: 提出 MosaiChunk 时空记忆机制，通过拼合历史 KV 条目保留细粒度视觉细节，配合轻量路由器在固定预算下选择历史片段，并发布 RememBench 基准，显著提升长时视频生成的回访一致性。
AI.motivation: 长时自回归视频生成受限于有限上下文窗口，当物体或场景离开上下文后，其细粒度视觉细节会丢失且难以在重现时恢复，因此需要保留对历史视觉细节的访问能力。
AI.method: 基于冻结的视频生成器可直接消费非连续历史 KV 的观察，提出 MosaiChunk：在空间与时间上拼合选定的历史 KV 条目构成"马赛克"记忆；保持生成器固定，仅训练一个轻量路由器，在固定活跃记忆预算下决定纳入哪些历史片段。并构建 RememBench 基准，含提示驱动的 T2V 与相机驱动的 I2V 两个划分。
AI.result: 在 T2V 与 I2V 两种设置下，于匹配记忆预算条件下，MosaiChunk 在回访一致性上一致优于滑动窗口推理与整块检索方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过选择性地复用非连续历史 KV 并仅学习轻量路由策略，可在不微调生成器的前提下有效缓解长时视频生成的细节遗忘问题，提升长时回访一致性。

title: 4Director: Controlling Video World Models with Rigid 3D Geometry
summary: Precise control over camera and object motion is essential for professional video production. Existing methods control objects only coarsely, through image-plane cues that are ambiguous in depth and rotation or through 3D tracks and blobs that lack complete geometry and lose consistency across viewpoint changes. We introduce 4Director, a video world model conditioned on an explicit 4D scene representation: each object is reconstructed once from the input image as a canonical mesh and moved by one prescribed rigid transformation per frame. This representation provides an intuitive 3D control interface and prevents unobserved geometry from being regenerated independently in every frame. We render the controlled scene as a depth video and introduce a Motion Adapter that transforms this geometric scaffold into video while synthesizing view-consistent appearance, illumination, and non-rigid dynamics. For training, we construct RealCOD-Rigid, a new dataset of 20,774 clips annotated with rigid 3D scenes by our automatic pipeline. We further introduce Identity-Gated IoU (IG-IoU), which jointly evaluates adherence to prescribed object motion and preservation of object identity. Experiments demonstrate that 4Director consistently outperforms prior methods in visual quality and in camera and object control.

AI.tldr: 提出4Director，一种以显式4D场景表示为条件的视频世界模型：每个物体从输入图像重建为规范网格，并按逐帧刚性变换运动，经深度视频渲染后由Motion Adapter生成视频，实现精确的相机与物体运动控制。
AI.motivation: 专业视频制作需要精确控制相机与物体运动，但现有方法控制粗糙：基于图像平面的线索在深度和旋转上存在歧义，而基于3D轨迹和blob的方法缺乏完整几何、且跨视角变化难以保持一致。核心问题在于缺乏一个既能提供直观3D控制、又能避免未观测几何在每帧被独立重生成的显式表示。
AI.method: 1) 显式4D场景表示：每个物体从输入图像一次性重建为规范网格（canonical mesh），由每帧一个刚性变换驱动，提供直观的3D控制接口并保证几何一致；2) 将受控场景渲染为深度视频作为几何脚手架；3) 引入Motion Adapter，把几何脚手架转换为视频，同时合成视角一致的外观、光照与非刚性动态；4) 构建RealCOD-Rigid数据集，含20,774个由自动流程标注刚性3D场景的片段；5) 提出Identity-Gated IoU（IG-IoU）指标，联合评估对指定物体运动的遵循度与物体身份保持度。
AI.result: 实验表明，4Director在视觉质量以及相机与物体运动控制方面均持续优于既有方法。
AI.conclusion: 以规范网格加逐帧刚性变换的显式4D表示为条件，配合深度视频脚手架与Motion Adapter，可在保持物体身份与视角一致性的同时实现精确的相机与物体运动控制，为可控视频生成提供了可行路径。

title: Generative Cinematographer: Composing Camera and Object Motion in 3D
summary: Current controllable video generation systems often rely on 2D motion trajectories or sparse drag signals for object motion. These controls are ambiguous because the same 2D trajectory can correspond to different 3D motions, especially when the camera and objects move simultaneously. We present Generative Cinematographer (GenCine), a system that lifts a single image into an editable 3D scene scaffold where artists jointly author camera and foreground motion. Artists specify a camera path and move selected foreground regions using local 3D motion handles. Several handles can move different parts of a subject independently, providing a piecewise-rigid approximation to non-rigid motion without a physics simulator or category-specific prior. To communicate these controls to a pretrained video model, we project them into guidance maps. These maps record where the controlled regions appear in each frame, assign each handle a fixed color across frames and encode the current 3D positions of its controlled points in the same world coordinate system as the background. This lets us describe object motion relative to the scene even as the camera moves. For training, we recover controls from the motion observed in real videos and use ground-truth geometry and trajectories from synthetic videos. We train a lightweight guidance branch and LoRA adapters on a pretrained Wan model to follow these controls. Our experiments show consistent camera-relative motion, improved geometric consistency under viewpoint changes, and strong controllability across diverse real-world scenes.

AI.tldr: GenCine将单张图像提升为可编辑的3D场景支架，用局部3D运动手柄联合控制相机与前景运动，并通过引导图将控制信号注入预训练视频模型，实现相机相对运动的一致可控生成。
AI.motivation: 现有可控视频生成依赖2D运动轨迹或稀疏拖拽信号，存在歧义性：相同的2D轨迹可对应不同3D运动，尤其在相机与物体同时运动时难以准确表达意图。
AI.method: 将单张图像提升为可编辑3D场景支架；艺术家指定相机路径并用多个局部3D运动手柄独立移动前景区域，以分段刚体近似非刚体运动，无需物理模拟器或类别先验。将控制投影为引导图，记录受控区域在各帧的位置、为每个手柄分配跨帧固定颜色，并在与背景一致的世界坐标系中编码其控制点的3D位置。训练时从真实视频运动恢复控制，并利用合成视频的真值几何与轨迹；在预训练Wan模型上训练轻量引导分支与LoRA适配器。
AI.result: 实验表明生成结果具有一致的相机相对运动、在视角变化下更优的几何一致性，并在多种真实场景中展现出强可控性。
AI.conclusion: 通过3D场景支架与引导图机制，GenCine有效消除了2D控制的歧义，实现了相机与前景运动的联合可控视频生成。

title: World Observer: Joint Actor-Observer Generation for Persistent World Modeling
summary: How can a world model continuously observe regions beyond the actor's current view? Video world models simulate how an environment evolves from an agent's actions, yet remain actor-centric. Once an object leaves the actor's view, they lose direct evidence of its evolution, often failing to preserve its state and dynamics upon re-entry. To address this, we introduce World Observer, which decouples observing from acting by jointly generating a perspective actor for the agent-centric view with one or more panoramic observers that watch selected world regions. This allows objects that leave the actor's view to remain visually evolving in an observer, so their updated states are reflected when they re-enter. We ground the actor and observers by warping from a shared panoramic source for explicit geometric correspondence, and introduce an Observer Sink of high-resolution perspective references to restore fine appearance upon re-entry. Since the observers are decoupled from the actor, they can be placed freely across the scene, extended to multiple locations for broader coverage, and driven by control signals to steer out-of-view evolution. To evaluate out-of-view evolution, we further introduce world-space metrics and a benchmark spanning real and synthetic scenes. World Observer substantially improves out-of-view dynamics while remaining competitive in visual fidelity, camera control, and 3D adherence.

AI.tldr: 提出 World Observer，通过解耦"观察"与"行动"，联合生成演员视角与全景观察者视角，解决视频世界模型中物体离开视野后状态演化丢失的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有视频世界模型以演员（agent）为中心，仅模拟环境随演员动作的演化。一旦物体离开演员视野，模型就失去其演化的直接证据，导致物体重新进入视野时无法保持其状态与动态。因此需要一种能持续观察视野外区域演化的机制。
AI.method: World Observer 将观察与行动解耦：为以演员为中心的视角联合生成一个透视演员视角，同时生成一个或多个全景观察者，持续监视选定的世界区域。为建立演员与观察者的对应关系，从共享的全景源进行 warp 以获得显式几何对应；并引入 Observer Sink，用高分辨率透视参考在物体重新进入视野时恢复精细外观。观察者与演员解耦，可自由放置、扩展到多个位置以扩大覆盖范围，并由控制信号驱动以引导视野外演化。
AI.result: World Observer 显著提升了视野外动态的表现，同时在视觉保真度、相机控制和 3D 一致性方面保持竞争力。作者还引入了世界空间（world-space）指标及一个涵盖真实与合成场景的 benchmark 来评估视野外演化。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦观察与行动并引入全景观察者，World Observer 有效解决了视频世界模型中视野外物体状态与动态丢失的问题，扩展了世界模型对超出演员当前视野区域的持续模拟能力。

title: DMAD: Distribution Matching as Adversarial Distillation for Fast Visual Generation
summary: Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) trains a few-step student from the difference between separately estimated target and student scores, so it must keep an auxiliary diffusion model fitted to the student's evolving distribution at extra memory and computation cost. We introduce DMAD, Distribution Matching as Adversarial Distillation, which recasts distribution matching as classification and learns the required log-density ratios directly. Two discriminator heads on a shared backbone distinguish real data and teacher samples from the student's, and linear losses on their logits train the student without auxiliary score fitting. We prove that at the discriminator optimum these losses recover the distribution-matching gradient underlying DMD, through the classical identity linking discriminator logits to log-density ratios. We further introduce gap-based reweighting, which adapts teacher supervision across noise levels from the real-data head's empirical logit gap between real and teacher samples. DMAD reaches a Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) of 1.04 with one-step generation on ImageNet-64x64, 14.47 with four-step SDXL on COCO-10K, and a VBench total score of 85.15 with four-step Wan2.1-T2V-14B, the best values among the compared few-step methods and the multi-step teachers. On MiniMax-H3-33B, our four-step student achieves overall human preference rates of 79.1% over DMD2 and 84.6% over rCM for joint audio-video generation, excluding ties. Our code, models and demos are available at https://yzmblog.github.io/projects/DMAD.

AI.tldr: DMAD将分布匹配蒸馏重构为分类任务，通过学习对数密度比直接训练少步学生模型，无需辅助扩散模型，在图像与视频生成上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: DMD需维护一个拟合学生演化分布的辅助扩散模型，带来额外内存与计算开销，亟需一种无需辅助分数拟合的分布匹配蒸馏方法。
AI.method: 在共享骨干上设置两个判别器头，区分真实/教师样本与学生样本，利用logits上的线性损失直接学习所需对数密度比来训练学生；并引入gap-based reweighting，依据真实数据头在真实与教师样本间的经验logit差距自适应调整各噪声水平的教师监督。
AI.result: 理论上证明在判别器最优处这些损失可恢复DMD的分布匹配梯度。实验：ImageNet-64×64一步生成FID 1.04，COCO-10K四步SDXL FID 14.47，四步Wan2.1-T2V-14B的VBench总分85.15，均为对比方法中最佳；MiniMax-H3-33B四步学生联合音视频生成的总体人类偏好率较DMD2为79.1%、较rCM为84.6%。
AI.conclusion: DMAD以对抗分类形式实现分布匹配蒸馏，无需辅助分数拟合即达到甚至超越多步教师的生成质量，验证了方法的有效性与通用性。

title: OmniSeek: Native Tool Integration for Multi-turn Audio-Visual Reasoning
summary: We present OmniSeek, an agentic framework that transforms an Omni Large Language Model (Omni-LLM) into an active, multi-turn reasoning agent with native tool use. Rather than passively processing an entire audio-visual sequence in a single forward pass, OmniSeek makes evidence acquisition part of the reasoning process: it dynamically decides whether to look or listen, and over which temporal window, to retrieve sparse but critical evidence across different modalities within long contexts. Through an iterative multi-turn protocol, the retrieved raw audio or visual segments are appended back into the context to support subsequent reasoning. To cold-start this capability, we build a data engine that synthesizes OmniTraj-170K, a corpus of multi-hop Chain-of-Thought trajectories with interleaved audio and visual evidence. We first supervise the model on these trajectories to instill multi-turn tool-use behavior, and then further optimize the policy via a two-stage reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards. Moreover, we introduce an Audio-Visual Necessity objective that explicitly rewards successful trajectories whose reasoning depends on both modalities, discouraging single-modality shortcuts. Extensive experiments across a wide range of benchmarks demonstrate that OmniSeek learns adaptive cross-modal evidence seeking and consistently improves audio-visual reasoning performance.

AI.tldr: OmniSeek 将全模态大模型（Omni-LLM）改造为具备原生工具调用能力的主动式多轮推理智能体，把"取证"纳入推理过程，动态决定看或听及其时间窗口，并通过 OmniTraj-170K 冷启动与两阶段可验证奖励强化学习优化，实现自适应跨模态证据搜寻。
AI.motivation: 现有 Omni-LLM 通常以单次前向传播被动处理整段音视频序列，难以在长上下文中定位稀疏但关键的跨模态证据，且易依赖单一模态捷径，缺乏主动、多轮的证据获取能力。
AI.method: 提出 OmniSeek 智能体框架：推理过程中动态决策"看或听"及时间窗口，通过迭代多轮协议将检索到的原始音视频片段回填上下文以支撑后续推理；构建数据引擎合成 OmniTraj-170K（含交织音视频证据的多跳思维链轨迹）进行冷启动监督；随后采用两阶段可验证奖励强化学习优化策略，并引入"音视必要性"目标，奖励推理同时依赖两种模态的成功轨迹以抑制单模态捷径。
AI.result: 在广泛基准上的大量实验表明，OmniSeek 学到了自适应的跨模态证据搜寻能力，并持续提升音视频推理性能。
AI.conclusion: 将证据获取内化为推理的一部分、配合轨迹冷启动与可验证奖励强化学习，是提升 Omni-LLM 长上下文跨模态推理的有效范式。

title: HiPhy: Hierarchical Alignment for Physically-Plausible Multi-Principle Video Generation
summary: Video generation models have achieved remarkable visual fidelity and have strong potential to become general-purpose world simulators. Despite this progress, they still fail to generate videos which adhere to laws of physics. The problem becomes even more apparent in realistic settings where multiple physical principles must work together within the same video; for example, "a balloon floating upward while steam rises from a pot" requires buoyancy and fluid dynamics to unfold coherently and simultaneously. Yet existing methods largely ignore multi-principle interactions, focusing on a single principle per video. We propose HiPhy (Hierarchical Physical Alignment), a reinforcement learning framework that grounds video generation in physical laws through a dual-level objective: locally enforcing the temporal dynamics of individual physical principles, and globally ensuring the physical and semantic coherence of the entire scene. To support multi-principle generation, we construct a 50K-prompt dataset and introduce a prompt benchmark MultiPhyBench, spanning a diverse range of co-occurring physical events. Our experiments show that HiPhy significantly outperforms prior methods and baselines, improving physical commonsense and semantic alignment significantly across various benchmarks, with the largest gains on scenes involving multiple concurrent physical principles where competing methods degrade most sharply.

AI.tldr: 提出HiPhy强化学习框架，通过双层物理对齐目标让视频生成模型同时遵循多种物理规律，并构建50K提示数据集与MultiPhyBench基准。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成模型视觉保真度高、具备通用世界模拟器潜力，但仍难以生成符合物理规律的视频；尤其在多个物理原理需在同一视频中协同作用的场景下问题更突出，而现有方法多只关注单一物理原理，忽视多原理交互。
AI.method: HiPhy（Hierarchical Physical Alignment）是一个强化学习框架，采用双层目标：局部层面强制单个物理原理的时间动态，全局层面确保整个场景的物理与语义一致性。同时构建了包含50K提示的数据集，并提出涵盖多种共现物理事件的提示基准MultiPhyBench。
AI.result: 实验表明HiPhy显著优于先前方法与基线，在多个基准上大幅提升物理常识与语义对齐，且在涉及多个并发物理原理的场景中增益最大——这类场景中竞争方法退化最严重。
AI.conclusion: HiPhy通过分层物理对齐与强化学习有效提升了视频生成对多重物理规律的遵循能力与语义对齐，为面向物理一致性的世界模拟器提供了新思路与评测资源。

title: Embedding Prediction Helps Image Generation
summary: In diffusion transformers, a class label or a text prompt is embedded once, and the same condition is reused at every denoising step. We ask whether predicted embeddings can serve as this condition instead. Next-Embedding Predictive Autoregression (NEPA) trains a Transformer to predict the next continuous embedding in a sequence. In generation, the clean image follows the noisy image, so its embeddings are the next embeddings after the condition and the noisy image. We train a NEPA model to predict them all at once with Multi-Embedding Prediction, and in Embedding Conditioned Generation, a DiT generator is conditioned on these predictions, recomputed at every denoising step, so the conditioning signal adapts to the current noisy state. Experiments on class-conditional ImageNet $256\times256$ study the condition of the generator, the design of Multi-Embedding Prediction, and the scaling of both models. The NEPA model adds a second network to every sampling step; with it, and combined with REPA, our final model, NEPA-DiT-XL, reaches an FID of 1.32 using about a third of the training compute of REPA.

AI.tldr: 提出NEPA，用预测的嵌入作为DiT的动态条件，每步去噪重算，NEPA-DiT-XL在ImageNet 256×256达FID 1.32，训练算力约为REPA的三分之一。
AI.motivation: 扩散Transformer通常只在开始嵌入一次类别标签或文本提示，并在每个去噪步骤重复使用相同的固定条件，条件信号无法随当前噪声状态自适应调整。
AI.method: NEPA训练Transformer预测序列中下一个连续嵌入；生成时干净图像嵌入位于条件与噪声图像之后。通过Multi-Embedding Prediction一次性预测全部嵌入，并在Embedding Conditioned Generation中让DiT生成器以这些预测为条件，且在每个去噪步骤重新计算。
AI.result: 在类别条件ImageNet 256×256上研究生成器条件方式、Multi-Embedding Prediction设计与两模型扩展性。NEPA为每个采样步增加第二个网络，结合REPA后，NEPA-DiT-XL达FID 1.32，训练算力约为REPA的三分之一。
AI.conclusion: 预测嵌入可作为扩散Transformer的可自适应条件，替代单次固定条件，在显著降低训练算力的情况下取得更优FID。

title: SILSA: Sliding-Window Slice Latents for Topology-Preserving High-Resolution 3D Generation
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Project link: https://plan-lab.github.io/silsa
summary: High-resolution 3D generation increasingly relies on voxel latents and multi-stage pipelines that first predict active structure and then synthesize local geometry. While effective, this design fragments continuous surfaces into many local tokens, inflates generation cost, and often weakens topological consistency for thin or highly connected shapes. We introduce SILSA, a topology-aware 3D generation framework that represents shapes with compact sliding-window slice latents. Instead of generating expensive voxel tokens, SILSA uses a fixed set of overlapping slices along the three canonical axes, where each token summarizes a local depth window to preserve cross-sectional continuity and support single-stage rectified-flow generation. A Slice VAE encodes oriented surface samples into multi-axis slice latents and reconstructs them with a sparse volumetric decoder, while a Volumetric Anchor Lattice coordinates directional slice streams through a shared 3D workspace. To preserve structural correctness, we introduce slice-level topology supervision that matches persistence diagrams and aligns Betti transitions across neighboring slices. Experiments show that SILSA improves structural fidelity while substantially reducing generation cost. SILSA improves PSNR by $8.7\%$, coverage by $5.96$ absolute points, and Betti error by $9.2\%$ over the strongest baseline, while using $70.0\%$ fewer tokens than the next-most compact baseline and over $98\%$ fewer tokens than sparse or hierarchical tokenizers, effectively reducing training memory by $40.4\%$ and inference time by $58.5\%$. Qualitative results further show improved preservation of thin structures, repeated components, and long-range connectivity.

AI.tldr: SILSA 提出以紧凑的滑窗切片潜变量替代体素 token，实现拓扑感知的单阶段三维生成，在显著降低生成成本的同时提升结构保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有高分辨率三维生成依赖体素潜变量与多阶段流水线（先预测活跃结构再合成局部几何），该设计将连续表面碎片化为大量局部 token，增加生成成本，且对薄结构或高度连通形状的拓扑一致性较弱。
AI.method: SILSA 在三个标准轴上使用固定数量的重叠切片，每个 token 概括一个局部深度窗口以保持截面连续性并支持单阶段 rectified-flow 生成；Slice VAE 将带朝向的表面采样编码为多轴切片潜变量并用稀疏体解码器重建；Volumetric Anchor Lattice 通过共享三维工作空间协调各方向切片流；并引入切片级拓扑监督，匹配持久图并对齐相邻切片的 Betti 转变。
AI.result: 相比最强基线，PSNR 提升 8.7%，覆盖率提升 5.96 个绝对点，Betti 误差降低 9.2%；token 用量比次紧凑基线少 70.0%，比稀疏或层次化 tokenizer 少 98% 以上；训练内存降低 40.4%，推理时间减少 58.5%。定性结果显示薄结构、重复部件与长程连通性保持更好。
AI.conclusion: 以切片潜变量为核心的拓扑感知单阶段生成框架，可在大幅压缩 token 与计算开销的同时提升结构保真度，为高分辨率三维生成提供更高效的替代方案。

title: ROWBench: Do Video Models Render What the Program Specifies?
summary: Programmable world models separate executable dynamics from visual generation, offering a promising foundation for next-generation game engines. However, their visual adherence to explicit rules and interactions remains insufficiently evaluated. Existing benchmarks assess visual quality, controllability, and instruction or physical adherence, but rarely test fidelity to fine-grained, program-specified world events. We introduce PROWBench, comprising 170 programmatically constructed episodes and 600 proxy videos covering diverse scenes and interactions. PROWBench logs entity states and timestamped events, including those outside the camera's field of view, as replayable world records, from which it renders synchronized views and proxy representations. This enables generated videos to be checked against the observable consequences of program execution. An extensible framework constructs scenes, controls behaviors, and can render each camera view in different representations, such as coarse 3D, and bounding boxes. The benchmark covers first- and third-person perspectives, with synchronized multi-view observations available for a subset of episodes. Grounded in these records, PROWBench evaluates entity control, long-horizon memory, and, with two VLM-based metrics, Logic-Render Alignment and Interaction Success Rate, adherence to the prescribed timeline and the visual realization of timestamped engine-recorded events.

AI.tldr: 提出PROWBench基准，基于程序化构建的可重放世界记录来评估可编程世界模型对细粒度程序事件与规则交互的视觉遵循能力。
AI.motivation: 可编程世界模型将可执行动力学与视觉生成分离，但现有基准多评估视觉质量、可控性、指令或物理遵循，很少检验生成视频对细粒度、程序指定世界事件的视觉忠实度。
AI.method: PROWBench包含170个程序化构建的回合与600段代理视频，覆盖多样场景与交互；记录实体状态与时间戳事件（含视场外事件）为可重放世界记录，并据此渲染同步视图与代理表示。框架可构建场景、控制行为，并以粗3D、边界框等不同表示渲染各相机视角，覆盖第一/第三人称视角，部分回合提供同步多视角观测。
AI.result: 基于世界记录，PROWBench评估实体控制、长时程记忆，并通过两个基于VLM的指标（Logic-Render Alignment与Interaction Success Rate）考察对规定时间线及引擎记录的时间戳事件之视觉实现的遵循程度。
AI.conclusion: PROWBench弥补了可编程世界模型在视觉遵循显式规则与交互方面评估不足的空白，为下一代游戏引擎提供程序执行可观察后果对齐的系统性评测框架。

title: One Basis to Animate Them All: Gaussian Blendshape Distillation for Real-Time Avatars
summary: 3D Gaussian avatars support fast rendering, however, their real-time animation is often challenged by the costly neural inference. We address this bottleneck and show that the animation of pretrained avatar models can be closely approximated by a linear combination of identity-independent blendshapes. Building on this finding, we introduce GALA (Gaussian Animation via Linear Approximation), a distillation method that replaces per-frame heavy neural decoding with a shallow coefficient predictor and a linear blend. To improve fidelity and reduce memory requirements, we propose to construct the basis using block-local PCA under a rendering-aware metric and a memory budget. Our method learns a shallow MLP network to predict blendshape coefficients and applies to various animation architectures without retraining original models. We validate GALA by accelerating the inference of three distinct avatar models for 3D animation of facial expressions and full-bodies with clothing dynamics. Across these models, our distillation generalizes to held-out identities and reduces CPU animation cost by up to three orders of magnitude while preserving most of the rendering quality. Excellent results of our method confirm the shared linear structure of learned avatar representations and enable highly efficient and accurate animation at frame rates reaching up to 60fps on mobile devices. Project page: https://ramazan793.github.io/gala/

AI.tldr: GALA：用线性近似蒸馏预训练3D高斯替身模型的动画，以浅层系数预测器+线性混合替代逐帧神经解码，实现移动端实时动画。
AI.motivation: 3D高斯替身渲染快，但实时动画受限于昂贵的神经推理开销，需在保持渲染质量的前提下大幅降低动画计算成本。
AI.method: 发现预训练替身模型的动画可由与身份无关的blendshapes线性组合近似；据此提出GALA蒸馏法：用浅层MLP预测blendshape系数，再做线性混合；基向量通过块局部PCA（渲染感知度量+内存预算约束）构建，无需重训原模型，可适配多种动画架构。
AI.result: 在三个不同替身模型（面部表情、带衣物动态的全身）上验证，可泛化到未见身份；CPU动画成本降低最多三个数量级，保留大部分渲染质量，移动端帧率达60fps。
AI.conclusion: 结果证实学习到的替身表征具有共享线性结构，可实现高效准确的实时动画。

title: Sphere Encoder 2
comment: Code will be available at https://github.com/kaiyuyue/sphere2
summary: Sphere Encoder is an autoencoder that generates images by decoding random points from a high-dimensional latent sphere. We identify two limitations of the original formulation that reduce its generation quality. First, random points concentrate near the equator relative to the pole on an encoded latent, but the training rotation never reaches this region, leaving a gap that limits one-step generation. Second, training for generation with pixel-wise reconstruction loss encourages the decoder to average over plausible images, producing blurry images that lack high-frequency details. We present Sphere Encoder 2 to address both limitations, substantially improving image generation quality while maintaining the speed and simplicity of a autoencoder. Models are released at \href{https://github.com/kaiyuyue/sphere2}{github.com/kaiyuyue/sphere2}.

AI.tldr: 本文指出原始 Sphere Encoder 的两个局限：训练旋转未覆盖随机点集中的赤道区域导致单步生成存在间隙，以及像素级重建损失使解码器对可行图像取平均而产生模糊。作者提出 Sphere Encoder 2 解决这两个问题，在保持自编码器速度与简洁性的同时显著提升图像生成质量。
AI.motivation: 原始 Sphere Encoder 虽能通过从高维潜在球面解码随机点生成图像，但生成质量受限：训练旋转无法到达随机点聚集的赤道附近区域，形成覆盖间隙，限制了一步生成；同时像素级重建损失驱使解码器对多张可行图像取平均，导致生成结果模糊、缺乏高频细节。
AI.method: 提出 Sphere Encoder 2，针对上述两个局限进行改进：一是解决训练旋转未覆盖潜在球面赤道区域的问题，以弥合单步生成的间隙；二是缓解像素级重建损失导致的解码器平均化与模糊问题。具体技术细节未在摘要中给出。
AI.result: 在保持自编码器速度与简洁性的前提下，显著提升了图像生成质量。模型已开源：github.com/kaiyuyue/sphere2。
AI.conclusion: Sphere Encoder 2 通过针对性地修复训练旋转覆盖不足与重建损失导致的模糊两大问题，改进了原方法的生成质量，同时保留了自编码器高效、简单的优势。

title: Moore, Escher, Penrose: A Conformal Golden Braid
summary: I don't think I have ever done anything as peculiar in my life. Among other things, it shows a young man looking with interest at a print on the wall of an exhibition that features himself. How can this be? Perhaps I am not far removed from Einstein's curved universe.'' So wrote M.C. Escher about his 1956 lithograph Print Gallery. Nearly half a century later, a mathematical analysis related its geometry to an untwisted source image through a conformal power map $z \mapsto z^α$, $α\in \mathbb{C}$. Building on this construction, we use a frozen text-to-image diffusion model to generate new self-referential scenes. Prompting alone does not enforce the recursion, while a post-hoc transformation can leave structures poorly connected. Applying the transformation during sampling is also insufficient: the denoiser may "repair" the intended distortion or drift out of the prescribed geometry. We construct a generalized inverse $T^\dagger$ of the non-invertible image transformation $T$, adapted to its recursive constraint. In the idealized formulation, the Penrose identity $TT^\dagger T = T$ makes $TT^\dagger$ an idempotent projection onto geometrically admissible images. Yet denoising only the transformed image remains an out-of-distribution task, even with projection. We therefore braid denoising steps with $T$ and $T^\dagger$: source-space steps develop the untwisted scene, while transformed-space steps refine its appearance and connections in the final geometry. We generate Print Gallery-like compositions and explore further transformations. Rather than distorting a finished image, we let the scene and its distortion develop together.

AI.tldr: 提出将几何变换 T 及其广义逆 T† 编织进扩散采样过程的方法，利用冻结的文本到图像扩散模型生成自指性的“Print Gallery”式递归场景。
AI.motivation: 单纯依靠提示词无法强制实现递归结构；事后变换会导致结构连接不良；采样中直接施加变换则会被去噪器“修复”掉或使图像漂移出既定几何。目标是让场景与其几何畸变共同生长，而非对成品图像做扭曲。
AI.method: 基于 Escher《Print Gallery》的数学分析，将几何与未扭曲源图通过共形幂映射 z↦z^α（α∈ℂ）相关联。针对不可逆的图像变换 T，构造适配其递归约束的广义逆 T†（满足 Penrose 恒等式 TT†T = T，使 TT† 成为几何可行图像上的幂等投影）。由于仅对变换后图像去噪仍是分布外任务，故将去噪步骤与 T 和 T† 交替编织：源空间步骤发展未扭曲场景，变换空间步骤细化其在目标几何中的外观与连接。
AI.result: 成功生成了类似 Print Gallery 的自指递归构图，并进一步探索了其他变换类型。
AI.conclusion: 让场景与其畸变在扩散采样过程中同步演化，是一种比提示词约束、事后变换或采样中直接整流更有效的自指几何图像生成策略。

title: A2Z GameSpec-Bench: How Faithfully Can Coding Agents Generate Games from Game Design Specifications?
summary: Delegating complete application development to coding agents requires preserving the intended design rather than simply producing plausible outputs through naive prompting. Game development provides a demanding testbed, as long-form Game Design Documents (GDDs) describe requirements that must work together across game logic, visual rendering, and player interactions. However, existing game-development benchmarks typically use compact specifications and provide limited support for evaluating interdependent requirements across these aspects in long-form GDDs. We introduce A2Z GameSpec-Bench, a benchmark of 100 long-form GDDs for evaluating end-to-end game development by agents. We measure faithfulness by checking whether the game satisfies the GDD requirements and preserves the relationships among them. Each GDD is turned into a dependency-aware contract that contains rules, constraints, and prerequisite relations. Following game-development practices, we combine source-code inspection with agent-generated test policies for scenario-based replay and adaptive playtesting. The contract remains fixed across agents and revision rounds, while judgments and evidence linked to the same requirements support consistent comparison and failure detection. Our evaluations show that current agents struggle to jointly satisfy interdependent requirements across code implementation and actual play. Requirement-specific feedback improves GDD Fidelity by 10.9% relative to self-revision after two rounds. A2Z GameSpec-Bench assesses end-to-end specification-following ability beyond implementation judgments and provides targeted feedback to support more faithful game development. Code and datasets are available at https://a2z-gamespec-bench.github.io.

AI.tldr: 提出 A2Z GameSpec-Bench 基准，用 100 份长文游戏设计文档（GDD）评测智能体端到端游戏开发中遵循规范的能力，通过依赖感知契约与代码审查+自适应试玩来度量保真度。
AI.motivation: 将完整应用开发交给编码智能体，需要保留设计意图而非仅靠朴素提示生成看似合理的结果。游戏开发是严苛的测试场景：长文GDD中的需求需在游戏逻辑、视觉渲染、玩家交互间协同工作。但现有游戏开发基准多使用简短规格，缺乏对长文GDD中跨方面相互依赖需求的评估支持。
AI.method: 构建 A2Z GameSpec-Bench，含100份长文GDD。每份GDD转化为依赖感知契约，包含规则、约束与前置关系。结合源码审查与智能体生成的测试策略，进行场景化回放与自适应试玩。契约在智能体与修订轮次间保持固定，使判定与证据可对齐同一需求，支持一致性比较与失败检测。
AI.result: 当前智能体难以在代码实现与实际游玩中同时满足相互依赖的需求；相比自我修订，需求特定反馈在两轮后使 GDD Fidelity 提升 10.9%。
AI.conclusion: A2Z GameSpec-Bench 评估了超越实现判定的端到端规范遵循能力，并提供针对性反馈以支持更忠实于设计的游戏开发。代码与数据集已公开。

title: Uncertainty-Aware RL-Controlled Adaptive 3D Mapping
comment: To appear at BMVC 2026. Code available at https://github.com/alpayozkan/UnRL
summary: Voxel-based volumetric mapping is fundamental to 3D reconstruction, yet fixed-resolution grids remain inherently inefficient - wasting memory in uniform regions and losing detail in complex ones. Existing adaptive methods, such as MAP-ADAPT, partially address this by varying resolution based on geometry and user-defined semantic class lists, but these heuristics require expert tuning, lack generalization to unseen objects, and provide no explicit mechanism to control memory usage. We propose an adaptive framework that refines voxels based on semantic entropy, which captures label uncertainty, together with geometric curvature and texture richness as scene complexity cues, yielding principled resolution allocation without reliance on semantic taxonomies. To make the accuracy-memory trade-off explicit and user-controlled, we further introduce a reinforcement learning agent that learns voxel subdivision policies under a user-specified target memory budget, replacing hand-tuned thresholds with a single intuitive control parameter. The resulting multi-resolution TSDF achieves higher geometric accuracy, better semantic consistency, and improved memory-accuracy trade-offs compared to MAP-ADAPT and fixed-resolution baselines on both synthetic and real-world datasets. Our code and models are available at https://github.com/alpayozkan/UnRL.

AI.tldr: 提出基于语义熵、几何曲率和纹理丰富度的自适应体素细分框架，并引入强化学习智能体在用户指定内存预算下学习细分策略，实现精度-内存权衡的可控优化。
AI.motivation: 固定分辨率体素网格内存效率低：均匀区域浪费内存、复杂区域丢失细节。现有自适应方法（如MAP-ADAPT）依赖专家调节的启发式规则和语义类别列表，泛化能力差，且无法显式控制内存使用。
AI.method: 以语义熵（标签不确定性）结合几何曲率与纹理丰富度作为场景复杂度线索，进行有原则的分辨率分配，不依赖语义分类体系；并引入强化学习智能体，在用户指定目标内存预算下学习体素细分策略，用单一直观控制参数替代手工阈值。
AI.result: 所得多分辨率TSDF在合成与真实数据集上相比MAP-ADAPT和固定分辨率基线，实现更高的几何精度、更好的语义一致性以及更优的内存-精度权衡。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过场景复杂度驱动的分辨率分配与内存预算约束下的强化学习细分策略，实现了无需语义分类、内存可控的自适应体素建图，代码与模型已开源。

title: DriftOPD: Sequence-Level Reverse-KL Distillation for One-Step VLA Policies
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models increasingly rely on action experts that generate short action chunks under receding-horizon control. While chunk-level training is convenient across robot embodiments, it optimizes local action likelihood without explicitly accounting for long-horizon task success. Sequence-level reinforcement learning can address this limitation, but typically requires policy rollouts and closed-loop interaction, which are costly for real-robot manipulation. We introduce DriftOPD, a teacher-free, rollout-free framework for sequence-level on-policy distillation of continuous VLA action experts. We show that the sequence-level reverse Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence decomposes into a chunk-level reverse-KL term and a future-potential term that captures the long-horizon effect of the current action. DriftOPD optimizes these two terms using a one-step drifting objective and a Q-function critic learned from offline demonstrations, respectively, enabling sequence-level optimization with only offline data and one-step action generation. Across multiple VLA architectures in simulation and real-world manipulation, DriftOPD generally outperforms existing one-step distillation baselines while achieving task success performance comparable to multi-step teacher policies. These results demonstrate that long-horizon behavior can be effectively distilled into one-step VLA action experts without online interaction or a separate teacher.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DriftOPD，一种无需教师、无需 rollout 的序列级 on-policy 蒸馏框架，用于连续 VLA 动作专家。通过将序列级反向 KL 分解为 chunk 级反向 KL 项与未来势能项，分别用一步 drifting 目标和离线示范学习的 Q 函数优化，实现仅用离线数据与一步动作生成完成序列级优化。
AI.motivation: VLA 模型的动作专家在滚动时域控制下生成短动作块，chunk 级训练虽便于跨本体迁移，但只优化局部动作似然，未显式考虑长时程任务成功。序列级强化学习可弥补这一缺陷，却通常依赖策略 rollout 与闭环交互，对真实机器人操作代价高昂。
AI.method: 理论层面，证明序列级反向 KL 散度可分解为 chunk 级反向 KL 项和一个刻画当前动作长时程影响的未来势能项。算法层面，DriftOPD 分别以一步 drifting 目标优化前者，以由离线示范学习的 Q 函数 critic 优化后者，从而在仅有离线数据和一步动作生成的条件下完成序列级优化，且无需教师模型与在线交互。
AI.result: 在仿真与真实世界操作任务上，跨多种 VLA 架构的实验中，DriftOPD 总体优于现有一步蒸馏基线，同时任务成功率与多步教师策略相当。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，长时程行为可被有效蒸馏进一步 VLA 动作专家，无需在线交互或独立教师模型。

title: Retrospective Open-Vocabulary Memory for Long-Term Object Search
summary: Long-term object search requires learning where objects usually appear from repeated but uneven observations of a changing environment. We formulate retrospective open-vocabulary memory as probabilistic inference from censored observations, where the key idea is to reason with evidence per opportunity: a detection or non-detection should influence belief only in proportion to the robot's opportunity to observe the corresponding location. We introduce ECROM, which uses this principle to estimate long-term prevalence for concepts specified only at query time and converts the resulting belief directly into an active-search prior. To evaluate this problem, we introduce a controlled long-term benchmark in ten HM3D homes that independently varies object placement and observation opportunity across repeated traversals. ECROM improves support-level AP on held-out queries by 4.5 points and search SPL by 4.2 points over the strongest competing memory in each metric. The benchmark, dataset, and code will be open-sourced.

AI.tldr: 本文提出回溯式开放词汇记忆（ECROM），把长期目标搜索中的记忆问题建模为对删失观测的概率推断，按"观测机会"加权证据，并构建长期基准验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 长期目标搜索需要从对环境反复但不均匀的观测中学习物体的常见出现位置，现有记忆方法未考虑机器人实际观测机会的不均等性，导致信念更新偏差。
AI.method: 将回溯式开放词汇记忆表述为对删失观测（censored observations）的概率推断，核心原则是按"每个机会的证据"推理：检测或未检测只应依据机器人观测对应位置的机会大小来影响信念。据此提出ECROM，用于估计仅在查询时指定概念（开放词汇）的长期流行度，并将所得信念直接转化为主动搜索先验。同时构建包含10个HM3D住宅的受控长期基准，在重复遍历中独立变化物体摆放与观测机会。
AI.result: 在留出查询上，ECROM将support-level AP提升4.5点，搜索SPL提升4.2点，均优于各指标上最强的对比记忆方法。
AI.conclusion: 按观测机会加权证据的删失观测概率推断能有效估计开放词汇的长期流行度并指导主动搜索，基准、数据集与代码将开源。

title: Manifold-Constrained Initial Noise Optimization for Efficient Generative Model Alignment
summary: Recent advances in distillation and flow-map models have enabled deterministic one- or few-step generation for high-quality data, facilitating a new branch of reward alignment approaches that directly optimize the initial noise from a Gaussian distribution. However, most existing initial-noise optimization methods rely on first-order gradient information, which is either inapplicable or suffers from instability and inefficiency in black-box reward scenarios. Here, we introduce ZeNOVA, a stable and efficient initial noise alignment method in a gradient-free manner. Specifically, we address existing algorithms' major challenge in black-box scenarios through annealed soft-value guidance, manifold-constrained hyperspherical Langevin dynamics, and Metropolis-Hastings jumping. Extensive experiments on image and video generative models show that ZeNOVA outperforms all evaluated zeroth-order baselines by optimizing the initial noise toward higher rewards substantially more stably while exploiting the geometry of the Gaussian prior, demonstrating its practical applicability to various black-box reward alignment.

AI.tldr: ZeNOVA：一种无梯度的初始噪声对齐方法，通过退火软价值引导、流形约束超球面朗之万动力学与Metropolis-Hastings跳跃，在图像和视频生成模型中稳定高效地优化高斯初始噪声以实现更高奖励。
AI.motivation: 蒸馏与流映射模型使确定性少步生成成为可能，催生了直接优化高斯初始噪声的奖励对齐新分支。但现有初始噪声优化方法多依赖一阶梯度信息，在黑盒奖励场景下不适用，或存在不稳定与低效问题。
AI.method: 提出ZeNOVA，以无梯度方式实现稳定高效的初始噪声对齐。核心技术包括：退火软价值引导（annealed soft-value guidance）、流形约束的超球面朗之万动力学（manifold-constrained hyperspherical Langevin dynamics）以及Metropolis-Hastings跳跃（Metropolis-Hastings jumping），针对黑盒场景下现有算法的主要挑战进行设计。
AI.result: 在图像与视频生成模型上的大量实验表明，ZeNOVA在优化初始噪声以获得更高奖励方面，比所有评估的零阶基线更稳定，且显著更优，同时有效利用了高斯先验的几何结构。
AI.conclusion: ZeNOVA验证了无梯度初始噪声对齐的实用性与有效性，适用于各类黑盒奖励对齐任务。

title: DexPolicy: Scheduled Exploration for Trajectory-Guided Dexterous Manipulation
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) for dexterous manipulation must discover finger-object contacts and then control the object precisely; the action noise that serves the first goal can interfere with the second. In trajectory-guided settings such as ViViDex, where RL refine hand-object trajectories from human video, our baseline PPO runs end near their initial action noise after 5M steps, motivating explicit control of exploration scale. DexPolicy makes that scale an explicit function of training steps, annealing from broad to narrow exploration while holding loss, architecture, reward, and optimizer settings fixed. We study three policy-optimization settings: PPO, critic-free GRPO continuation, and a flow-parameterized PPO variant (FPO). Across five YCB objects and three training seeds, mean deterministic Target success rises from 49.4% to 68.1% (FPO), 14.1% to 45.4% (GRPO), and 32.0% to 35.7% (PPO). On a RealMan RM75 arm with an Inspire/RH56 hand, 360 trials over three objects raise mean Target success from 25.0% to 85.0% (FPO), 10.0% to 63.3% (GRPO), and 8.3% to 43.3% (PPO), with one trained model per object-method condition. PPO component screening favors noise control over the tested optimizer contraction; the selected PPO schedule yields higher mean Target success than linear decay with the same endpoints on three tested objects. Training return, deterministic Target success, and tolerance to execution noise dissociate; schedules should therefore be judged by terminal task success under the intended execution conditions, per task and policy-optimization setting. Code: https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/DexPolicy. Website: https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/DexPolicy.

AI.tldr: 提出 DexPolicy，将 RL 探索噪声尺度显式设为训练步数的退火函数，在轨迹引导的灵巧操作中一致提升任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 灵巧操作的 RL 需先发现手指-物体接触、再精确控制物体；服务前一目标的动作噪声会干扰后一目标。在 ViViDex 等轨迹引导设定中，基线 PPO 训练 5M 步后动作噪声几乎未下降，因而需显式控制探索尺度。
AI.method: 将探索噪声尺度设为训练步数的显式函数，由宽到窄退火；保持损失、架构、奖励与优化器设置不变。在三种策略优化设定下验证：PPO、无 critic 的 GRPO 续训、以及流参数化的 PPO 变体（FPO）。并做 PPO 组件消融（噪声控制 vs. 优化器收缩）及调度曲线对比（所选调度 vs. 同端点线性衰减）。
AI.result: 仿真：5 个 YCB 物体、3 个随机种子，确定性 Target 成功率均值由 49.4%→68.1%（FPO）、14.1%→45.4%（GRPO）、32.0%→35.7%（PPO）。真机 RealMan RM75 + Inspire/RH56，3 个物体共 360 次试验，均值由 25.0%→85.0%（FPO）、10.0%→63.3%（GRPO）、8.3%→43.3%（PPO），每种物体-方法条件训练一个模型。消融显示噪声控制优于所测试的优化器收缩；所选 PPO 调度在同端点下优于线性衰减。
AI.conclusion: 训练回报、确定性 Target 成功率与执行噪声容忍度三者解耦；调度应依据目标执行条件下的最终任务成功率来评估，且需按任务与策略优化设定分别判定。

title: Signal-Noise Factorization Isolates Nuisance Variation into Removable Subspaces
summary: Recent theoretical work identified fundamental properties of representation geometry that shape inference ability of deep neural networks. These include signal-noise factorization (SNF), the ability to segregate signal from noise, and signal-signal factorization (SSF), the ability to segregate task-specific and task-irrelevant signals. Here, we built regularizers that reinforce these two properties during training. We compared networks trained with these regularizers to $L_2$-regularized baseline networks on the CIFAR-100 classification task to understand how our regularizers shape representation geometry and impact performance on a well-known computer vision baseline. Enhancing SNF via regularization improved model performance but enhancing SSF did not. Motivated by biomedical applications, we investigated how our regularizers affected performance on the BloodMNIST dataset treated with MedMNIST-C corruptions at five severity levels, and found even larger performance gains using the SNF regularizer. To understand the mechanism by which SNF-regularization produces improved performance, we analyzed the nuisance subspaces across regularization regimes, finding that the SNF-regularized models represent noise in distinct subspaces, separate from class-relevant signal. Because this geometry is explicit, the dominant corruption-induced directions can be estimated on held-out data and projected out of the representations. This manipulation led to a substantial gain in accuracy. These results show that regularizers that enforce signal-noise factorization can produce substantial improvements on computer vision tasks that contain out-of-distribution image distortions at inference time. They also highlight how shaping representations affects model performance: isolating nuisance variables from categorical ones is more important than maintaining factorized representations of categorical variables.

AI.tldr: 本文提出强化表征几何中信号-噪声分解（SNF）与信号-信号分解（SSF）的正则化器，在 CIFAR-100 与受 MedMNIST-C 扰动的 BloodMNIST 上验证其效果。
AI.motivation: 既有理论工作表明，表征几何中的信号-噪声分解（SNF，即区分信号与噪声的能力）和信号-信号分解（SSF，即区分任务相关与任务无关信号的能力）决定了深度网络的推理能力，但如何通过训练手段强化这些性质并影响实际性能尚不清楚。
AI.method: 构建分别强化 SNF 与 SSF 的正则化器，在训练中施加；以 L2 正则化网络为基线，在 CIFAR-100 分类任务上比较；进一步在经 MedMNIST-C 五种严重程度腐蚀处理的 BloodMNIST 数据集上评测；并分析不同正则化机制下的噪声子空间，在留出数据上估计腐蚀主导方向并从表征中投影剔除。
AI.result: 强化 SNF 提升了模型性能，而强化 SSF 未带来提升；在受腐蚀的 BloodMNIST 上，SNF 正则化带来更大性能增益。分析发现 SNF 正则化模型将噪声表征于与类别相关信号分离的独立子空间；据此在留出数据上估计腐蚀方向并投影剔除后，准确率显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 强制实现信号-噪声分解的正则化器可显著提升推理时含分布外图像失真的计算机视觉任务性能；同时表明塑造表征的方式影响模型表现：将噪声变量与类别变量分离，比保持类别变量自身的分解表征更为重要。

title: Frozen Scenes, Shifting Winners: Configuration Fragility in Text-to-3D Evaluation
summary: Can a text-to-3D leaderboard change when every generated scene stays fixed? We audit this question for rendered-image evaluation, where camera settings and caption wording become part of the measurement protocol. Across 300 frozen scenes from six generators, we vary eight render and caption factors for 19 alignment evaluators plus one perceptual-quality control, then test four targeted scene degradations. Peak configuration variance exceeds between-generator variance for 17/19 alignment evaluators, with prompt-bootstrap lower bounds above 1 for 11/19. Rankings are more stable than scores, yet 18/19 evaluators change their point-estimate winner under some configuration. Pairwise protocol margin envelopes show which comparisons keep their direction across the tested settings. Selected pairs have opposite pointwise intervals, but no reversal survives simultaneous inference over the full search. Thus the observed winner changes are descriptive, not confirmed changes in generator superiority. Sensitivity remains separate: no evaluator, even the prompt-free control, exceeds 67% tie-adjusted directional discrimination on layout scrambling, which is diagnostic rather than human-validated ground truth. The audit separates score stability, decision uncertainty, and targeted sensitivity, and recommends reporting (generator, score, card ID) with protocol-dependent comparisons and selection-aware uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 该论文审计了文生3D渲染图像评测的协议敏感性：在300个冻结场景上变动8个渲染/描述因素，发现多数对齐评测器的峰值配置方差超过生成器间方差，排名虽较稳定但胜者会随协议变化，且配对比较在多重推断下无稳健反转；同时所有评测器对布局扰动的敏感性均不超过67%。
AI.motivation: 文本到3D排行榜通常被当作生成器优劣的稳定结论，但在渲染图像评测中，相机设置与描述措辞本身构成测量协议的一部分。论文质疑：当生成场景固定不变时，仅改变评测协议是否足以改变排行榜结果，即分数、排名与胜者判定在多大程度上依赖协议选择。
AI.method: 使用六个生成器的300个冻结场景，对19个对齐评测器和1个感知质量控制评测器变动8个渲染与描述因素；随后测试四种针对性场景退化。通过配置方差与生成器间方差比较、prompt-bootstrap下界、排名与胜者变化统计、配对协议边际包络及全搜索同时推断来分离分数稳定性、决策不确定性与敏感性问题；敏感性部分采用.tie-adjusted方向判别率评估布局打乱。
AI.result: 17/19个对齐评测器的峰值配置方差超过生成器间方差，11/19的prompt-bootstrap下界大于1。排名比分数更稳定，但18/19的评测器在某些配置下点估计胜者发生改变。配对边际包络显示部分比较方向可跨设置保持，但所选配对虽有点态区间相反，经全搜索同时推断后没有任何反转存活，说明胜者变化仅为描述性的。敏感性方面，包括无prompt对照在内，没有任何评测器在布局打乱上的tie-adjusted方向判别率超过67%，且该指标是诊断性的而非经人类验证的基准真值。
AI.conclusion: 文生3D渲染图像评测结果对协议高度敏感，排行榜胜者变化多为描述性而非确证的生成器优越性变化。作者建议报告(generator, score, card ID)三元组，并采用协议依赖的比较与选择感知的不确定性度量，将分数稳定性、决策不确定性与针对性敏感性分开报告。

title: Increasing Width Allows Greedy Layer-wise Training to Rival End-to-End Backpropagation in Self-Supervised Learning
summary: End-to-end backpropagation has been the dominant mode of training in deep learning, allowing for the coordination of parameter updates across layers of a neural network. Prior studies have explored alternative -- and, in some cases, simpler -- training mechanisms, showing that they can sometimes achieve performance similar to backpropagation. However, the architectural conditions under which locally optimized networks, which avoid end-to-end backpropagation of error, can learn representations comparable to those learned through end-to-end training remain unclear. We aim to answer this question in the context of self-supervised learning, an important framework for large-scale pretraining in artificial intelligence. Here, we investigate how network width and depth affect the efficacy of greedy layer-wise and end-to-end self-supervised training in convolutional networks. We find that in wider networks, the benefits of end-to-end backpropagation over greedy layer-wise training shrink: in relatively shallow and very wide networks, we even observed higher performance in models trained with greedy layer-wise training. Subsequent analysis of the representations formed by these networks shows that very wide greedy-trained networks exhibit more favorable representational geometry than do networks trained end-to-end with backpropagation. This work shows that width can compensate for restricted credit assignment and identifies differences in representational geometry as a potential mechanism for their improved performance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在自监督学习中，网络宽度与深度如何影响贪心逐层训练与端到端反向传播的效果，发现宽网络会缩小两者差距，极宽浅网络中贪心逐层训练甚至更优，且其表征几何更有利。
AI.motivation: 端到端反向传播是深度学习主流训练方式，但已有研究提出更简单的替代机制可达到相近性能。然而，局部优化的网络（无需端到端误差反传）在何种架构条件下能学到与端到端训练相当的表示仍不明确，本文在自监督学习背景下回答该问题。
AI.method: 在卷积网络中，以自监督学习为框架，系统改变网络宽度与深度，对比贪心逐层训练与端到端自监督训练的效果，并对所形成表征的几何性质进行分析。
AI.result: 在更宽的网络中，端到端反向传播相对贪心逐层训练的优势缩小；在相对较浅且非常宽的网络中，贪心逐层训练的模型性能甚至更高；极宽贪心训练网络表现出比端到端反向传播更有利的表征几何。
AI.conclusion: 网络宽度可补偿受限的信用分配，表征几何差异是其性能提升的潜在机制，揭示了架构条件对局部优化网络表示学习能力的重要影响。

title: Don't Waste the Noise: Importance-Guided Perturbation Allocation under Joint Global and Local Constraints
summary: Adversarial optimization under a shared $\ell_1$ budget requires deciding not only how much perturbation to use, but also where that limited budget should be spent. This allocation problem becomes particularly important when individual input coordinates are subject to local magnitude constraints, which restrict the extent to which perturbation can be concentrated on a small number of locations. We introduce an importance-guided allocation mechanism that uses a fixed clean-gradient prior to steer perturbation toward model-sensitive regions while leaving the feasible perturbation set unchanged. A centered allocation objective encourages perturbation at above-average importance locations and discourages unnecessary expenditure elsewhere, thereby redistributing rather than enlarging the available budget. Across ten robust model--dataset configurations under a common capacity-limited threat setting, the proposed method improves attack success over matched APGD- and PMA-based baselines by $2.52$ to $17.70$ percentage points. Allocation analysis shows that these gains are accompanied by substantially greater perturbation mass in high-importance regions without increased global $\ell_1$ consumption. Mechanism ablations further show that centered non-uniform redistribution provides part of the benefit, while model-derived importance yields an additional improvement. These results identify perturbation allocation as a distinct and practically relevant dimension of adversarial optimization under shared-budget, locally constrained threat models.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种重要性引导的扰动分配机制，在共享ℓ1预算与局部幅度约束下重新分配而非扩大扰动预算，从而提升攻击成功率。
AI.motivation: 在共享ℓ1预算的对抗优化中，不仅要决定扰动总量，还要决定有限预算花在哪里。当输入坐标受局部幅度约束时，扰动无法集中于少数位置，分配问题因此尤为关键。现有方法（如APGD、PMA）未将扰动分配视为独立的优化维度。
AI.method: 引入重要性引导的分配机制，利用固定的干净梯度先验将扰动导向模型敏感区域，同时保持可行扰动集不变；设计中心化分配目标，鼓励在高于平均重要性的位置施加扰动、抑制其他位置的无谓开销，实现预算的再分配而非扩大。
AI.result: 在十种鲁棒模型—数据集配置、统一容量受限威胁设定下，方法较匹配的APGD与PMA基线将攻击成功率提升2.52至17.70个百分点；分配分析显示高重要性区域的扰动质量显著增加而全局ℓ1消耗未增加；消融实验表明中心化非均匀再分配贡献部分收益，模型导出的重要性带来额外提升。
AI.conclusion: 扰动分配是共享预算、局部受限威胁模型下对抗优化的一个独立且具有实际意义的维度。

title: Right In-Place (RiP) Convolution: A Simple, General, and Near-Optimal Strategy for Memory-Efficient CNN Inference
comment: Extended version of a paper accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Global South in AI
summary: Activation memory, not compute, limits CNN inference on constrained hardware such as microcontrollers. Direct in-place convolution removes the dual-buffer cost, but the memory-optimal formulation of Gural and Murmann assumes valid padding, unit stride, unit dilation, and odd square kernels, and needs a non-sequential traversal costing $2\times$ inference time in transposes. We identify two regimes in which their published closed form does not hold: (1) an under-allocation of exactly $(k-1)C_{in} \bmod (C_{out}-C_{in})$ scalars, active on every convolutional layer of their own deployed network and manifesting as a silent corruption of still-live input; (2) an unbounded overestimate, up to $2{,}432\times$, once the critical leg leaves the output grid. We correct both and generalize to arbitrary stride, dilation, padding, and rectangular kernels. We then propose Right In-Place (RiP) convolution, a bit-identical operation in which every layer reads its input right-aligned in a shared workspace and writes its output left-aligned from index zero. The debt is piecewise affine in the output pixel index, so evaluating its breakpoints in $O(1)$ yields the minimum safe gap without enumerating the output grid, with row-major access preserved. Across $10{,}000$ random layers RiP produced no corruption, and across 84 convolutional layers from 25 architectures it matches the herringbone workspace exactly on 58 and within 5% on 81, using 24.8% less memory than dual buffering on average. Written into TinyEngine's kernels and deployed to a Raspberry Pi Pico 1 and Pico 2, it cuts peak activation memory across eleven MCUNet models by 12.5 to 33.3% at unchanged cycle counts and bit-identical outputs, raising the number of models that fit the Pico 1's 256 KB SRAM from six to nine.

AI.tldr: 本文针对微控制器上CNN推理的激活内存瓶颈，修正了现有内存最优原地卷积公式的两类缺陷，并提出Right In-Place (RiP)卷积，实现任意stride、dilation、padding与矩形核的通用原地卷积，在保持位一致与周期数不变的前提下降低峰值激活内存。
