We use Effective Training Time (ETT%) as an operational framework to instrument lost time, localize it to independently owned infrastructure components, and expose work repeated across job restarts. This analysis guides optimizations like communication elimination and pipeline overlap during trainer initialization; dynamic-shape handling, autotuning pruning, and reusable Py- Torch 2 compilation caches; asynchronous checkpointing; stan- dalone model publishing; and reductions in recovery cost. We evaluate the optimizations on representative models and measure their impacts in our training fleet. ETT% improves on every benchmark, by 15.5% on average, and reaches 85% on our largest workload. Fleet-wide ETT% rose from about 80% to above 90% after deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文针对大规模推荐模型训练中的生命周期开销问题进行舰队级研究，提出以有效训练时间占比（ETT%）为核心的度量框架，并给出覆盖全训练栈的一系列优化，使最大工作负载ETT%达85%，全舰队ETT%从约80%提升至90%以上。
AI.motivation: 大规模推荐训练每天要在数千块GPU上处理数百亿训练样本，但此前端到端墙钟时间中仅有50-60%真正用于在新数据上推进训练，其余被生命周期开销（初始化、编译、检查点、恢复等）静默消耗，造成算力浪费。作者希望量化、定位并消除这部分损失时间。
AI.method: 提出ETT%（Effective Training Time）作为可运营的度量框架，对丢失时间进行插桩，将其归因到各自独立负责的基础设施组件，并揭示跨作业重启重复执行的工作。基于该分析实施优化：训练器初始化阶段的通信消除与流水线重叠；动态形状处理、自动调优剪枝、可复用的PyTorch 2编译缓存；异步检查点；独立模型发布；降低恢复成本。并在代表性模型与生产训练舰队上评估。
AI.result: 所有基准测试的ETT%均有提升，平均提升15.5%；最大工作负载的ETT%达到85%。优化部署后，全舰队范围的ETT%从约80%上升到90%以上。
AI.conclusion: 生命周期开销是可系统化度量与治理的算力损耗来源，通过统一指标与覆盖训练栈的针对性优化，可显著提高GPU有效训练利用率，为大规模推荐训练舰队带来可观产能回收。

title: Madeleine: Learning Involuntary Recall for Conversational Memory from Simulated Lives
summary: A long-term conversational assistant must recall the right memory at the right moment, yet the memory that matters most is often not similar to what the user says now. Current systems recover such associations by letting an LLM reason at write or read time, at a cost of hundreds to over a thousand LLM calls per memory bank and up to several thousand context tokens per query. We argue that association is a learnable relevance: the pointwise mutual information of memories under how human lives unfold. We introduce Madeleine, which learns amortized association: offline, an LLM life simulator writes simulated lives, whose cue-trigger pairs teach a query encoder a residual association on top of frozen similarity; online, it calls no LLM and plugs into any vector memory by replacing only the query encoder. On LoCoMo-Plus under the official protocol, Madeleine (I) reaches 66.6 when plugged into HyperMem, the highest among all systems evaluated under this protocol; (II) used alone, reaches the score of HyperMem as released (52.4 vs. 52.9) with zero LLM calls and about 1/21 of its answer context; and (III) lifts T-Mem by 26.2 points, significantly outperforms the same untrained backbone inside both systems, and leaves ordinary QA intact on the 4B backbone.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Madeleine，将长期对话记忆中的联想关系建模为可学习的相关性（记忆在人类生活展开方式下的点互信息），通过离线LLM生活模拟器生成训练数据、教查询编码器在冻结相似度之上学习残差联想，从而在线零LLM调用地提升记忆检索。
AI.motivation: 长期对话助手需要在恰当时机召回恰当记忆，但最重要的记忆往往与用户当前话语并不相似。现有系统依赖LLM在写入或读取时进行推理来恢复这种关联，代价高昂：每个记忆库需数百至上千次LLM调用，每次查询消耗数千上下文token。
AI.method: Madeleine学习摊销式联想（amortized association）。离线阶段，LLM生活模拟器生成模拟人生，其中的线索-触发对（cue-trigger pairs）训练查询编码器，在冻结的相似度之上学习残差联想；在线阶段不调用任何LLM，仅替换查询编码器即可插入任意向量记忆系统。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo-Plus官方协议下：(I) 接入HyperMem达66.6分，为该协议下所有评估系统中的最高分；(II) 单独使用时以零LLM调用和约1/21的答案上下文达到已发布HyperMem水平（52.4 vs. 52.9）；(III) 将T-Mem提升26.2分，在两个系统中均显著优于相同未训练骨干，并在4B骨干上保持普通QA性能不变。
AI.conclusion: 联想可作为可学习的相关性，通过离线模拟数据训练轻量查询编码器即可摊销关联推理成本，在零在线LLM调用下实现强记忆检索，且不损害通用QA能力。

title: JoinGR: Learning to Traverse Join Graphs for Table Retrieval
summary: Retrieving the right tables is a prerequisite for Text-to-SQL over realistic databases. Dense table retrievers rank schema elements independently, but this ignores a key source of evidence: some required tables are not mentioned in the question and become identifiable only through their join relationships to already relevant tables. We introduce JOINGR, a join-aware table retrieval method that treats the database join graph as the retrieval space. Columns are represented as graph nodes, while intra-table and foreign-key relationships are represented as typed edges. Given a question, JOINGR selects semantically similar anchor tables, traverses join edges with a query-conditioned scorer, and aggregates the resulting edge deposits into table scores. The scorer is a lightweight MLP on top of frozen query, node, and edge embeddings, trained with a pairwise margin loss over gold tables. On BIRD and Spider datasets, JOINGR is competitive with the strongest retrieval baselines. On BEAVER, a challenging enterprise benchmark with multi-hop table requirements, JOINGR substantially improves recall over dense retrieval and re-ranking baselines. Cross-domain experiments show that the learned scorer transfers across benchmarks, indicating that the method captures reusable joingraph traversal behavior.

AI.tldr: JOINGR 将数据库连接图作为检索空间，通过锚点表选择、查询条件化的连接边遍历与边"沉积"聚合实现连接感知的表格检索，在 BIRD/Spider 上与最强基线相当，在 BEAVER 多跳场景显著提升召回，且打分器可跨基准迁移。
AI.motivation: 现实数据库的 Text-to-SQL 需要先检索出正确的表。稠密表格检索器独立地对各 schema 元素排序，忽略了一类关键证据：某些必需表并未在问题中被提及，只能通过其与已相关表的连接关系被识别出来。
AI.method: 以数据库连接图作为检索空间：列作为图节点，表内关系与外键关系作为带类型边。给定问题，JOINGR 先选出语义相似的锚点表，再用查询条件化的打分器遍历连接边，并将边上的"沉积"（edge deposits）聚合为表分数。打分器是叠加在冻结的查询、节点、边嵌入之上的轻量 MLP，用针对金标准表的成对 margin 损失训练。
AI.result: 在 BIRD 与 Spider 上，JOINGR 与最强检索基线相比具有竞争力；在具有多跳表需求的企业级挑战基准 BEAVER 上，其召回率相较稠密检索与重排序基线有大幅提升。跨域实验表明，学习到的打分器可跨基准迁移。
AI.conclusion: 连接图遍历是表格检索中被忽视但有效的证据来源；所提方法能够捕捉可复用的连接图遍历行为，在困难的多跳企业场景中尤其有效。

title: Enterprise Representation Simplification (ERS): Reducing Representational Complexity for Enterprise AI
summary:
Enterprise information is represented through artifacts shaped by applications, projects, technologies, organizational boundaries, and local requirements. These structures accumulate over time, creating representational complexity that must be maintained by the enterprise and interpreted by information consumers and AI systems. This paper introduces Enterprise Representation Simplification (ERS) as reducing unnecessary representational complexity while preserving required information within a defined scope, and Enterprise Representation Complexity (ERC), a representation-neutral model for comparing complexity across representation states.
  ERC characterizes representational extent through four dimensions: Representation Objects, Interactions, Behaviors, and Supporting Sources. Objects, Interactions, and Behaviors form dependent categories, while Supporting Sources characterize representation exposure. ERC is defined at representation and task levels, enabling comparison and distinguishing architectural simplification from retrieval optimization.
  The paper develops two consequences of ERS. First, representational structures create lifecycle obligations for maintenance, governance, dependencies, change, enhancement, and operation. An economic model distinguishes recurring global representation cost, recurring task-level cost, and one-time transformation cost, enabling evaluation over a defined time horizon. Second, reductions in task-level ERC reduce the representational extent an AI system must identify, relate, and interpret. Text-to-SQL research provides evidence that reduced schema and reasoning complexity can improve reasoning accuracy.
  ERC is not a universal complexity, performance, or cost metric. It provides measurable architectural variables for comparing representational alternatives, transformation effects, economic outcomes, and AI reasoning performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出企业表示简化（ERS）与企业表示复杂度（ERC）模型：ERS指在给定范围内减少不必要的表示复杂度而保留必要信息；ERC通过表示对象、交互、行为与支撑来源四个维度刻画表示规模，并区分表示级与任务级复杂度，用于比较表示状态、区分架构简化与检索优化。文章进一步给出表示结构的生命周期义务经济模型（全局表示成本、任务级成本、一次性转换成本），并论证任务级ERC降低可缩减AI系统需识别、关联与解释的表示范围，Text-to-SQL证据表明其可提升推理准确率。ERC并非通用复杂度/性能/成本指标，而是可度量的架构变量。
AI.motivation: 企业信息通过应用、项目、技术、组织边界与本地需求塑造的制品来表示。这些结构随时间累积，形成表示复杂度，需要企业持续维护，并由信息消费者与AI系统解释。其动机在于：缺少可度量、表示中立的框架来刻画并比较表示复杂度，从而难以判断简化是否保留必要信息、是否属于架构简化而非检索优化，也难以评估简化的经济后果与对AI推理的影响。
AI.method: 1）提出ERS定义：在定义范围内减少不必要的表示复杂度，同时保留所需信息。2）构建ERC表示中立模型，用四个维度刻画表示规模：表示对象（Objects）、交互（Interactions）、行为（Behaviors）、支撑来源（Supporting Sources）；对象、交互、行为构成依赖类别，支撑来源刻画表示暴露程度。3）在表示级与任务级两个层面定义ERC，以支持比较，并区分架构简化与检索优化。4）建立经济模型：区分经常性全局表示成本、经常性任务级成本与一次性转换成本，用于在给定时间范围内评估。5）分析任务级ERC下降对AI系统需识别、关联、解释的表示范围的影响，并引用Text-to-SQL研究作为证据。
AI.result: 1）ERS的两个推论：表示结构产生生命周期义务（维护、治理、依赖、变更、增强、运行）；简化需在经济模型中权衡全局/任务级经常性成本与一次性转换成本。2）任务级ERC降低可减少AI系统需识别、关联与解释的表示范围；Text-to-SQL研究表明，降低模式与推理复杂度可提升推理准确率。3）ERC提供可度量的架构变量，用于比较表示替代方案、转换效果、经济结果与AI推理性能。
AI.conclusion: ERC不是通用的复杂度、性能或成本指标，而是面向企业表示的可度量架构变量框架。其价值在于：在定义范围内比较不同表示状态与转换方案，区分架构简化与检索优化，评估生命周期与经济后果，并分析与AI推理性能的关系，从而支持企业表示简化的决策。

title: A Matryoshka Hierarchical RAG for Efficient Multi-Hop Question Answering
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems for multi-hop Question Answering (QA) must balance retrieval quality with computational cost. This cost is incurred during indexing time, through the use of expensive Knowledge Graphs (KGs) or Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate summaries, or during querying, through iterative LLM-driven retrieval. To reduce it while maintaining retrieval quality, we present MatRAG, a hierarchical framework that combines RAG systems with Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL). MatRAG addresses both kinds of cost by aligning the semantic hierarchy of a clustering structure with the nested structure of MRL. Specifically, it organizes the corpus of documents into a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) of clusters with progressively coarser granularity. Each level is indexed by a lower Matryoshka dimension. MatRAG pairs an iterative, top-down traversal of the DAG with an entity-driven mechanism that controls the hop budget and re-ranks candidates. We evaluated MatRAG on three standard multi-hop QA benchmarks against seven representative baselines. MatRAG outperforms its strongest competitors in terms of retrieval quality; furthermore, it reduces indexing costs by avoiding KG construction and LLM-based summarization, and lowers query-time costs through dimension-aware similarity.

AI.tldr: MatRAG将RAG与Matryoshka表示学习结合，通过层次化聚类DAG在降低索引与查询成本的同时提升多跳QA检索质量。
AI.motivation: 多跳QA的RAG系统需在检索质量与计算成本间权衡。成本来自索引阶段（构建知识图谱或LLM生成摘要）与查询阶段（迭代式LLM驱动检索），需在保持检索质量的前提下降低这两类成本。
AI.method: 提出MatRAG层次化框架，将RAG与Matryoshka表示学习（MRL）结合：把语料组织为粒度逐级变粗的聚类有向无环图（DAG），每层用更低的Matryoshka维度索引；采用自上而下的迭代DAG遍历，并配以实体驱动机制控制跳数预算与候选重排序。
AI.result: 在三个标准多跳QA基准上，与七个代表性基线对比，MatRAG在检索质量上优于最强竞争者；同时通过避免KG构建和LLM摘要降低索引成本，并通过维度感知相似度降低查询时成本。
AI.conclusion: MatRAG表明对齐聚类结构的语义层次与MRL的嵌套结构，可在不牺牲检索质量的情况下有效削减多跳QA中RAG的索引与查询成本。

title: Not All Is Lost: Repairing Lossy User Preference States of Personalization Encoders
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Author-prepared archival version with expanded discussion and interpretation. 59 pages, including references and appendices
summary: Personalization encoders compress evolving interaction histories into preference states used to rank items or condition text generation. A task head operating only on this state can miss useful evidence that remains in the frozen encoder's cached representations for individual timesteps. We study this recoverability gap and propose REPAIR, which compares cached representations with the current preference state in a compact learned coordinate space. It resolves corrective evidence over extended history, recent interactions, and localized bursts. It then selects which patterns at which timesteps contribute and adds their aggregate correction to the state before the task head. Encoder-host repair reuses representations from the existing forward computation without re-encoding the history. Across MovieLens, PENS, MIND, and Amazon Reviews 2023, training only REPAIR improves MRR and nDCG@10 for all twelve representative recommendation hosts while both encoder and task head remain frozen. Head-only finetuning of the same hosts yields smaller gains. For example, Mamba4Rec on MovieLens gains 3.96 MRR points, compared with 0.19 from head-only finetuning. Rank and temporal diagnostics support a compact, host-dependent corrective structure. In personalized generation, IMPerSumm improves the two reported weighted PerSEval variants, which assess responsiveness to user preference, by up to 25.23%. These results support post-compression state correction and distinguish the availability of preference evidence from its downstream use.

AI.tldr: 本文研究个性化编码器"可恢复性差距"，提出REPAIR方法：在冻结编码器与任务头之间插入一个学习到的坐标空间校正模块，从缓存表征中检索纠正性证据并聚合修正偏好状态，无需重编码历史，也无需微调编码器或任务头。
AI.motivation: 个性化编码器将不断演化的交互历史压缩为偏好状态，但仅基于该状态的任务头会遗漏仍保留在冻结编码器各时间步缓存表征中的有用证据，即存在"可恢复性差距"。
AI.method: REPAIR在紧凑的学习坐标空间中将缓存表征与当前偏好状态进行比较，在长历史、近期交互与局部突发三个尺度上解析纠正性证据；随后选择哪些时间步的哪些模式应被贡献，并将其聚合校正量加到偏好状态上，再送入任务头。该"编码器宿主修复"复用现有前向计算中的表征，不重新编码历史。
AI.result: 在MovieLens、PENS、MIND与Amazon Reviews 2023上，仅训练REPAIR即提升全部十二个代表性推荐宿主的MRR与nDCG@10，且编码器与任务头均保持冻结；例如Mamba4Rec在MovieLens上提升3.96个MRR点，而仅微调任务头仅提升0.19。秩与时间诊断支持一种紧凑、宿主依赖的校正结构。在个性化生成中，IMPerSumm将两个加权PerSEval变体提升最高25.23%。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持"压缩后状态校正"这一范式，并区分了偏好证据的"可获得性"与其"下游使用"，表明在冻结宿主上插入轻量校正模块即可高效利用被压缩丢弃的证据。

title: Neither Black nor White: Balancing Semantic and Collaborative Signals with Graph-Informed Semantic IDs (GrIS)
summary: Existing work on Semantic IDs (SIDs) for generative recommendation treats SID construction as a representation learning problem: encode items into a quantised latent space and read off codes. We argue this view is incidental. SID construction is, at heart, a recursive clustering problem, and once stated this way the natural object to cluster is a graph whose nodes carry semantic content and whose edges carry collaborative signal; SID assignment becomes a hierarchical graph partition. This reframing yields a unified framework, Graph-Informed Semantic IDs (GrIS), that subsumes prior approaches rather than displacing them. RQ-VAE and RQ-KMeans are recovered as the special case where the graph is empty, exposing content-only quantisation as one corner of a larger design space along two so-far-collapsed axes: graph construction and recursive partition algorithm. We explore two contrasting instantiations: RecDMoN, which performs hierarchical assignment via differentiable graph pooling, and RQ-GAE, which extends RQ-VAE with graph-aware item representations and a graph reconstruction objective. On multiple real-world datasets, GrIS consistently improves over CF-aware SOTA, with gains of up to +52\% Hit@10. Because graph construction and partition are explicit, separately configurable components, improvements on either axis can be combined and evaluated systematically.

AI.tldr: 本文将语义ID（SID）构建重新定义为递归聚类问题，提出统一框架GrIS，将图构建与递归划分解耦，在真实数据集上较CF-aware SOTA最高提升+52% Hit@10。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式推荐的SID构建被当作表示学习问题（将物品编码到量化隐空间并读取码字），作者认为这种视角是偶然的、局限的：它只能刻画内容信息，无法自然纳入协同信号，且把图构建与划分算法两个设计轴坍缩为单一选择，限制了设计空间。
AI.method: 将SID构建重新表述为递归聚类问题，聚类对象为“节点带语义内容、边带协同信号”的图，SID分配即层次化图划分。据此提出统一框架GrIS，包含两个可独立配置的组件轴：图构建与递归划分算法。RQ-VAE与RQ-KMeans被证明是图为空时的特例（纯内容量化）。实例化两条路线：RecDMoN采用可微图池化进行层次化分配；RQ-GAE在RQ-VAE上扩展图感知物品表示与图重构目标。
AI.result: 在多个真实世界数据集上，GrIS一致优于CF-aware的SOTA方法，Hit@10提升最高达+52%。
AI.conclusion: SID构建的本质是递归图聚类而非表示学习；GrIS以统一框架涵盖了既有方法，并把图构建与递归划分暴露为显式、可分别配置的组件，使两个轴上的改进可被组合并系统评估。

title: ScholarCatalyst: A Benchmark for Retrieving Papers That Inspire New Research
summary: What makes great scientists great? Even as AI systems start to make progress on open problems, scientists remain far ahead of them at sensing which prior idea, buried in an ever-growing archive of research, a new problem needs. To study this skill, we draw on researchers who know firsthand which earlier work advanced their completed projects, with papers serving as pointers to the ideas within. Using our automated pipeline that makes author annotation scalable, we build ScholarCatalyst by having 184 lead authors of 207 recent computer science papers label which candidates did or could have advanced their project, each with a detailed rationale. We introduce a retrieval task with author-provided judgments: given an initial research question, retrieve these papers from only the literature available when the project began. Agentic search does no better than embedding retrieval (0.42 vs. 0.48 Recall@20) despite calling that same retriever as a tool. Even an agent built on Claude Fable 5.1, which may have seen the completed papers during training, reaches only 0.51 R@20. These results highlight the need for new training recipes that equip models with expert intuition for searching broad corpora. We envision ScholarCatalyst as a step toward scientific agents that can take a half-formed idea and point to the prior research it needs.

AI.tldr: 论文提出ScholarCatalyst数据集与检索任务，考察模型能否像科学家一样识别推动研究的关键前期文献。结果显示，代理式检索并不优于普通嵌入检索，即使基于强模型的智能体也仅略高，说明模型缺乏专家式检索直觉。
AI.motivation: 科学家擅长在不断增长的文献库中判断哪些早期想法能推动新问题，而AI系统在这方面的能力仍远落后。论文旨在研究并量化这种“研究直觉”，为构建能定位所需前期文献的科学智能体提供基础。
AI.method: 通过可扩展的自动化标注流程，让207篇近期计算机科学论文的184位第一作者标注哪些候选文献推动或可能推动了其项目，并提供详细理由；构建ScholarCatalyst数据集，并设计检索任务：给定初始研究问题，仅从项目开始时可见的文献中检索相关论文。同时比较嵌入检索、代理式检索以及基于强模型的智能体表现。
AI.result: 代理式检索并未优于嵌入检索（Recall@20为0.42对0.48），即使代理将该检索器作为工具调用；基于Claude Fable 5.1的智能体（可能已在训练中见过完成论文）也仅达到0.51 R@20。
AI.conclusion: 现有模型缺乏专家式检索直觉，需要新的训练方法以在广泛语料中实现有效搜索。ScholarCatalyst可作为迈向科学智能体的一步，使其能从半成型想法出发，定位所需前期研究。

title: Multi-Behavioral Evolved Substrates Through Neuromodulation and Activation Selection
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Published version of the paper presented at ALIFE 2026: Proceedings of the 2026 Artificial Life Conference (MIT Press). Code and data: https://github.com/RomainClaret/emr-hyperneat
summary:
Open-ended artificial life systems must acquire diverse competencies from a single evolving genotype. Biological brains combine neuromodulation, which reconfigures circuits without changing connections, with diverse neuron types matched to specific computational roles. Can artificial evolution achieve something analogous in indirectly encoded substrates?
  Using indirectly encoded substrates evolved via CPPNs, we show through more than 10,000 experiments that neuromodulation alone is insufficient: under evolutionary search, monotonic activation functions impose a 75% ceiling on parity tasks that persists regardless of capacity, topology, or population size. This is an evolutionary search barrier, not a representational limit, since Adam gradient descent achieves 100% on the identical architecture.
  We combine neuromodulation with per-task activation function selection, matching oscillatory primitives to parity tasks and monotonic to threshold tasks, producing multi-behavioral evolved substrates. The result: 100% simultaneous 5-task success across all 30 seeds (median 14 generations). This generalizes across the oscillatory activation class: all four functions reach 100% (30 seeds each). Neither mechanism suffices alone.
  The barrier extends to higher-arity and asymmetric tasks, while multi-layer depth provides an alternative path. For open-ended evolution, the computational primitive should itself be an evolvable trait. At inference, one evolved genotype expresses many behaviors.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过超万次实验证明：在间接编码（CPPN）基质中，仅靠神经调质无法突破奇偶校验任务的进化搜索障碍（75%上限），需将激活函数选择作为可进化性状与神经调质结合，才能实现单一基因型表达多种行为（5任务100%成功）。
AI.motivation: 开放式人工生命系统需从单一进化基因型获得多样化能力。生物大脑通过神经调质（不改变连接即重构回路）与多样化神经元类型（匹配特定计算角色）实现这一点。作者欲探究人工进化能否在间接编码基质中实现类似机制。
AI.method: 采用间接编码基质（CPPN演化）；开展超10,000次实验，对比神经调质单独作用、神经调质结合逐任务激活函数选择（振荡原语匹配奇偶任务、单调函数匹配阈值任务）；并以Adam梯度下降在相同架构上作对照，以区分进化搜索障碍与表征极限。
AI.result: 神经调质单独作用时，单调激活函数对奇偶任务强加75%性能上限，且不随容量、拓扑或种群规模改变；相同架构下Adam梯度下降可达100%，表明是进化搜索障碍而非表征限制。结合神经调质与逐任务激活函数选择后，30个种子全部实现5任务同时100%成功（中位数14代）；在振荡激活函数类中通用（4种函数各30种子均达100%）。障碍亦延伸至更高元数与不对称任务，多层深度提供了替代路径。
AI.conclusion: 开放式中进化中，计算原语本身应作为可进化性状；推理时单一进化基因型可表达多种行为。神经调质与激活函数选择两种机制均不可或缺。

title: Neuromorphic Pseudo-Random Number Generators with a Low Power Hardware Implementation
summary: Pseudo-random number generation often requires trade-offs among quality, power consumption, and bandwidth to produce unpredictable sequences of numbers. The brain, on the other hand, efficiently generates unpredictable output complex network dynamics occurring in a high-dimensional state. This state, which is hypothesized to be chaotic, relies on the balance between excitation and inhibition. Here, we investigated if computational models of these chaotic balanced states can be harnessed for Neuromorphic Pseudo-Random Number Generators (NPRNGs) in low power hardware. We successfully constructed a balanced spiking neural network model consisting of leaky-integrate-and-fire neurons that could be readily implemented in low power FPGAs and used as a NPRNG. The prototyped NPRNG consumed 3.24 mW during operation and produced pseudo-random numbers at 120kbps. In both hardware and software instantiations, NPRNGs produce high-quality random numbers as validated by standard metrics for testing RNG quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用类脑平衡脉冲神经网络（LIF神经元）的混沌动力学构建神经形态伪随机数发生器（NPRNG），在低功耗FPGA上原型实现，功耗3.24 mW、速率120 kbps，随机数质量通过标准RNG测试验证。
AI.motivation: 传统伪随机数生成需在质量、功耗和带宽之间权衡。大脑能在高维状态中高效产生不可预测输出，其混沌动力学依赖于兴奋-抑制平衡，因此作者探索能否将这种平衡混沌态的计算模型用于低功耗硬件的神经形态伪随机数发生器。
AI.method: 构建由泄漏积分发放（LIF）神经元组成的兴奋-抑制平衡脉冲神经网络模型，使其混沌动力学可映射到低功耗FPGA实现，并在硬件与软件两种实例化形式下作为NPRNG运行与评估。
AI.result: 原型NPRNG运行时功耗为3.24 mW，伪随机数生成速率达120 kbps；硬件与软件实例均通过标准RNG质量测试指标，产生高质量随机数。
AI.conclusion: 类脑平衡脉冲神经网络的混沌动力学可作为低功耗神经形态伪随机数生成器的有效方案，在保证随机数质量的同时实现低功耗与可接受的带宽。

title: Inherited Learning in an Artificial Ecology: How Controls and Update Allocation Shape Benefits
summary: Learning can improve an individual's behavior, yet a population risks losing that experience whenever individuals die and are replaced. Inheriting learned preferences offers a way to preserve useful behavior across generations, raising a question for artificial populations: when does inheritance improve collective performance, and how can its benefits be measured fairly? The challenge is that inheritance changes not only offspring behavior but also survival, reproduction, and opportunities for further hereditary updates. Random controls with equal update magnitudes may therefore yield misleading comparisons if they alter different states or obey different stability constraints. We investigate this problem in a resource-limited artificial ecology, combining structured random controls with interventions on newborn preferences and the allocation of hereditary updates. Preserving the state structure of random updates substantially narrows the apparent inheritance advantage, while a conditional establishment-speed benefit remains. Preference erasure and faster-learning compensation support a contribution from reduced offspring relearning. Update allocation also changes the comparison: event quotas and common time cutoffs can reverse rankings, although they also change realized update amounts. With update count and cumulative magnitudes matched, staged release improves occupancy but does not achieve the prespecified establishment criterion. These findings provide a framework for distinguishing the value of inherited preferences from the effects of control design and update allocation, clarifying how inherited learning should be evaluated in artificial populations.

AI.tldr: 在资源受限的人工生态中，采用结构化随机对照与遗传更新分配干预，检验“继承学习偏好”对群体表现的真实增益及其公平测量方式。
AI.motivation: 个体学习可优化行为，但个体死亡与更替会使群体丢失经验；继承学习偏好可跨代保留有用行为。核心问题是：继承何时提升集体表现，以及如何公平测量其收益——因为继承不仅改变后代行为，还改变存活、繁殖与后续遗传更新机会，等更新幅度的随机对照可能因改变不同状态或受不同稳定性约束而产生误导性比较。
AI.method: 在资源受限的人工生态中进行实验，将结构化随机对照与两类干预结合：对新生个体偏好的干预，以及遗传更新分配方式的干预；并进一步匹配更新次数与累计幅度，比较事件配额与共同时间截止等不同分配规则。
AI.result: 保持随机更新的状态结构后，表观继承优势显著缩小，但仍存在条件性的“建立速度”收益；偏好擦除与更快学习补偿支持“减少后代重复学习”这一贡献来源。更新分配会改变比较结果：事件配额与共同时间截止可反转排名，但同时改变了实际更新量。在更新次数与累计幅度匹配下，分阶段释放提高占用率，却未达到预设的建立标准。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了一个框架，用于区分继承偏好的价值与控制设计、更新分配效应，明确人工群体中继承学习应如何被评估。

title: Per-Node Activation Function Evolution in Indirectly Encoded Substrates: Solvability, Limits, and Emergent Diversity
comment: 9 pages, 2 figures, 10 tables. Published in ALIFE 2026 (MIT Press). This is the version of record, posted under CC BY 4.0
summary:
Biological neurons achieve computational diversity through specialized types: tonic, bursting, adapting, and fast-spiking cells coexist within the same circuit. Artificial neural networks, by contrast, apply a single activation function uniformly to all nodes, which limits what they can represent. We show that this uniformity creates hard limits for evolutionary search: across sparse evolved substrates, monotonic functions fail to solve parity beyond its smallest instance, XOR, while a single oscillatory unit suffices at all tested scales. The gap is one of search and sparsity, not representation: monotonic networks can represent parity with a modest number of hidden units, and gradient descent recovers that solution. We evolve, to our knowledge for the first time in indirect encoding, per-node activation function assignments from an 18-function palette across more than 4,500 experimental runs spanning Boolean logic, regression, and spatial classification.
  Testing each of the 18 functions individually on Parity-4 reveals a three-tier solvability structure: oscillatory functions achieve 100%, intermediate functions 6.7-80%, and all 9 monotonic functions 0%. This divide is not universal. Recurrence collapses it, and gradient descent inverts it entirely, showing that the barrier is specific to evolutionary search in sparse substrates. What activation functions a network can use, beyond its topology and weights, determines what evolutionary search can solve. Indirect encoding discovers heterogeneous per-node activation assignments unlikely to be chosen by hand.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究间接编码进化搜索中逐节点激活函数分配问题。发现单调激活函数在稀疏基质上无法进化求解Parity问题（Parity-4全为0%），而振荡函数可达100%；但该搜索壁垒并非表征能力所限：单调网络本身可表征Parity，梯度下降可求解，循环连接亦可消除该壁垒。
AI.motivation: 生物神经元通过多种专门类型（紧张型、爆发型、适应型、快放电型）实现计算多样性，而人工神经网络对所有节点统一使用单一激活函数，限制了其表征能力与搜索性能。作者希望探究这种同质性对进化搜索（尤其稀疏基质与间接编码）造成的具体限制，并检验"逐节点异质激活函数分配"是否能被间接编码自动发现。
AI.method: 采用间接编码方法，从包含18种激活函数的函数库中进化逐节点的激活函数分配。实验覆盖布尔逻辑、回归与空间分类任务，总运行数超过4500次。此外对Parity-4逐一测试18种激活函数的单独性能，并对比循环连接与梯度下降两种设置以分离"搜索壁垒"与"表征壁垒"。
AI.result: Parity-4上呈现三层可解性结构：振荡函数100%成功，中间类函数6.7%-80%，全部9种单调函数0%。单调网络在进化搜索下无法求解超过最小实例（XOR）的Parity。该分化非普遍规律：循环连接可使其瓦解，梯度下降则完全逆转该顺序（单调网络可表征Parity，仅需少量隐藏单元即可求解）。间接编码能发现难以手工设计的异质逐节点激活分配。
AI.conclusion: 激活函数的选择——超越拓扑与权重——决定了进化搜索可求解的问题范围。均匀单调激活在稀疏进化基质上构成搜索壁垒而非表征壁垒，因其可通过梯度下降或循环连接被绕开。间接编码能自动发现异质、非直觉的逐节点激活函数分配，为进化神经网络的表达力扩展提供新途径。

title: LESS: Lightweight Evolutionary Supernet Search in Minutes
summary: Low-cost NAS must both explore high-performing architectures and identify them reliably, yet reducing evaluation cost often weakens the fidelity of candidate comparisons. Training-free methods reduce evaluation cost by replacing learned task feedback with proxy signals measured at initialization. We introduce LESS (Lightweight Evolutionary Supernet Search), a data-driven method that combines a brief fair hard-path warm-up with discrete search under a single CMA-ES distribution. Each proposal is evaluated as its decoded hard genotype after six candidate-conditioned supernet updates. On NAS-Bench-201, LESS achieves \(93.189\pm0.467\%\) CIFAR-10 test accuracy in 409.1 seconds, coming within 0.04 percentage points of FairNAS using approximately \(1/24\) of its source-reported search time. Matched controls show that calibration improves selected validation accuracy by \(0.577\) percentage points while changing best-visited accuracy by only \(0.054\) points, indicating that its primary effect is to reduce selection regret. The frozen configuration transfers without tuning to CIFAR-100 and ImageNet16-120 with \(69.615\pm1.139\%\) and \(43.720\pm1.697\%\) accuracy. Applied without tuning to the larger DARTS space, LESS achieves \(96.95\pm0.14\%\) on CIFAR-10 and \(82.43\pm0.80\%\) on CIFAR-100, with each search completing in approximately 43.5 minutes on a single GPU. Together, these results show that short, balanced, data-dependent updates enable competitive neural architecture search across datasets and search spaces within minutes.

AI.tldr: LESS是一种轻量级进化超网搜索方法，通过将短暂公平的硬路径预热与单一CMA-ES分布下的离散搜索结合，以极低成本实现高精度神经架构搜索。
AI.motivation: 低成本NAS需同时高效探索高性能架构并可靠识别最优架构，但降低评估成本常削弱候选比较的保真度。无训练方法虽用初始化代理信号降低评估成本，但可能存在评估可靠性问题，LESS旨在解决低成本与高保真比较之间的矛盾。
AI.method: LESS结合短暂公平的硬路径预热与单一CMA-ES分布下的离散搜索。每个候选方案在其解码后的硬基因型上评估，经过六次候选条件化的超网更新。这是一种数据驱动方法。
AI.result: 在NAS-Bench-201上，LESS以409.1秒达到CIFAR-10测试准确率93.189±0.467%，与FairNAS相差0.04个百分点，但搜索时间约为其1/24。匹配对照显示，校准将所选验证准确率提高0.577个百分点，而最佳访问准确率仅变化0.054个百分点，表明主要作用是减少选择遗憾。冻结配置无需调优即可迁移至CIFAR-100和ImageNet16-120，准确率分别为69.615±1.139%和43.720±1.697%。在更大的DARTS空间上无需调优应用，CIFAR-10达96.95±0.14%，CIFAR-100达82.43±0.80%，每次搜索约43.5分钟（单GPU）。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，短暂、平衡、数据依赖的更新能够在数分钟内跨数据集和搜索空间实现有竞争力的神经架构搜索。

title: Controllable Stochastic Quantization Encoding for Adversarially Robust Spiking Neural Networks
summary: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) have attracted increasing attention due to their impressive temporal dynamics, energy efficiency, and brain-inspired mechanisms. Although SNNs have demonstrated promising performance in image classification tasks, recent studies have shown that they remain vulnerable to adversarial attacks, where imperceptible perturbations are added to input images to mislead model predictions. Existing defense methods mainly focus on training strategies, while the role of input encoding remains less explored. An observation is that the robustness advantage of Poisson encoding over direct encoding may benefit from its inherent randomness. Motivated by this, we propose a stochastic quantization encoding method that encodes the input image with controllable randomness adjusted by the quantization scale, thereby improving the adversarial robustness of SNNs. We further show that this method constitutes a general framework that reduces to both Poisson encoding and direct encoding under different choices of the quantization scale. Since it enhances robustness at the input encoding stage, it can be combined with existing training-based defenses for further gains. Experimental results on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed stochastic quantization encoding method. To sum up, this work highlights the importance of input encoding for the adversarial robustness of SNNs, providing a new perspective for understanding and improving it.

AI.tldr: 本文提出随机量化编码方法，通过量化尺度控制随机性，提升脉冲神经网络（SNN）的对抗鲁棒性，并统一了泊松编码与直接编码。
AI.motivation: SNN虽在图像分类表现优异，但仍易受对抗攻击。现有防御方法主要关注训练策略，而输入编码的作用研究不足。作者观察到泊松编码的鲁棒性可能源于其固有随机性。
AI.method: 提出随机量化编码，用量化尺度调节编码的随机性；该框架在不同量化尺度下可退化为泊松编码或直接编码。由于作用于输入编码阶段，可与现有基于训练的防御方法结合。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100上的实验验证了所提随机量化编码方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作凸显了输入编码对SNN对抗鲁棒性的重要性，为理解和提升其鲁棒性提供了新视角。

title: Multi-Reference Path Tracking Control for an Agricultural Tractor with Nonlinear Model Predictive Control
summary: Guiding a tractor along a predefined reference path is a key component of precision agriculture. This study develops a path tracking controller based on Nonlinear Model Predictive Control, which incorporates multiple segments of a piecewise-linear reference path directly into the objective function. In addition, methods for selecting viable reference segments from the full path are presented. The control system is evaluated during a field test with a tractor controlled via the Tractor Implement Management steering interface. The NMPC solver converged on average after 3.45 ms and tracked the curved reference path with a mean absolute cross-track error of 6.1 cm.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一种基于非线性模型预测控制(NMPC)的拖拉机路径跟踪控制器，将分段线性参考路径的多段直接纳入目标函数，并在田间试验中验证其跟踪精度与求解效率。
AI.motivation: 引导拖拉机沿预定参考路径行驶是精准农业的关键环节，传统路径跟踪控制器在处理分段线性路径时可能存在精度或计算效率方面的不足，需要一种能直接利用多段参考路径信息的高效控制方法。
AI.method: 采用非线性模型预测控制构建路径跟踪控制器，将分段线性参考路径的多段直接嵌入目标函数；同时提出从完整路径中选取可行参考段的方法；通过拖拉机经Tractor Implement Management转向接口进行田间试验评估。
AI.result: NMPC求解器平均在3.45 ms内收敛；对弯曲参考路径的跟踪平均绝对横向误差为6.1 cm。
AI.conclusion: 基于NMPC的控制器结合分段路径选择方法能够实现高精度、实时的拖拉机路径跟踪，满足精准农业对路径跟踪的需求。

title: Continual Reinforcement Learning with Neuroevolution
summary: Despite many studies about causes and remedies of plasticity loss in Reinforcement Learning (RL) under continual task changes, no RL method has yet consistently achieved a good balance between adaptation and forgetting. Here we turn to an alternative optimization paradigm, neuroevolution (NE): algorithms that search directly in weight space through mutation and selection over a population of neural networks. Across a wide array of environments and environmental changes, with policies ranging from a few hundred parameters to million-parameter networks, we compare evolution strategies (ES) and genetic algorithms (GAs) against state-of-the-art continual RL variants and population-based RL. ES most consistently achieves a good stability-plasticity trade-off, while the GA is the most plastic method but forgets more than ES. To explain this, we study the return landscape around each method's solutions. ES finds the widest neighborhoods, i.e.\ regions of weight space in which perturbed policies still solve the task, and the size of the overlap between the neighborhoods of consecutive tasks correlates with a method's stability-plasticity trade-off. Rewarding behavioral diversity in a GA through novelty search makes the population even more plastic, at the cost of forgetting. Finally, symptoms of plasticity loss commonly reported in RL do not transfer to NE. Overall, these results establish NE as a competitive alternative to RL under continual task changes, and suggest that training under perturbations in weight space may be a useful mechanism for continual learning more broadly.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统比较了神经进化（ES与GA）与主流持续强化学习方法，在稳定性-可塑性权衡上，ES表现最均衡、GA最可塑但遗忘更严重，并从权重空间邻域宽度和任务间邻域重叠角度给出解释。
AI.motivation: 持续强化学习在任务不断变化时普遍面临可塑性丧失与灾难性遗忘的矛盾，现有RL方法难以稳定地兼顾适应新任务与保留旧知识，因此作者转向直接在小权重空间进行搜索的神经进化范式，探索其是否能提供更好的稳定性-可塑性权衡。
AI.method: 在多种环境和环境变化条件下，涵盖从数百参数到百万参数规模的策略网络，将进化策略（ES）与遗传算法（GA）同最先进的持续RL变体及种群型RL方法进行对比；通过分析各方法解附近的回报景观，衡量权重空间中扰动后仍能完成任务的邻域宽度，以及相邻任务邻域之间的重叠大小；并尝试在GA中引入新颖性搜索以奖励行为多样性。
AI.result: ES最一致地取得良好的稳定性-可塑性权衡；GA可塑性最强但遗忘最多。ES找到最宽的邻域，且相邻任务邻域重叠程度与方法的稳定性-可塑性权衡相关。通过新颖性搜索增加GA的行为多样性会使其更具可塑性，但代价是遗忘加剧。RL中常见的可塑性丧失症状并未迁移到神经进化中。
AI.conclusion: 神经进化在持续任务变化下是强化学习的有竞争力替代方案，权重空间扰动下的训练可能是更广泛持续学习中的一种有效机制。

title: TRACE: Tackling Real-World Resource Assignment Problems via Agentic Heuristic Design
summary: Dynamic resource assignment, the real-time allocation of task streams to heterogeneous processing nodes, is the backbone of modern computing infrastructure. While learning-based schedulers excel in research, industrial deployments still rely on hand-written rules that operators can read, audit, and execute within tight latency budgets. LLM-based Automatic Heuristic Design (AHD) promises to automate writing such rules. However, existing AHD frameworks were developed for combinatorial problems fully specified to the LLM, and they learn only from a scalar fitness score. In real systems, the behaviour that determines a good heuristic, such as processor speeds or power consumption, is unknown a priori: the score reveals which heuristic performs better, but not why. This missing information is recorded in the system logs that every evaluation produces. Exploiting it is non-trivial: logs are massive and noisy, the relevant signals depend on the objective, and their content and format vary across hardware and software stacks, so they can neither be fed to an LLM as is nor processed by a fixed parser. We propose TRACE, which couples an evolutionary AHD loop with an agentic knowledge-extraction workflow. A Reasoner agent analyzes the log schema in light of the objective and formulates hypotheses about the system dynamics; a Coder agent writes and executes schema-specific code to test them, producing insights or executable tools for the evolved heuristics. We evaluate TRACE on a synthetic cloud benchmark and a 5G vRAN scenario built from industrial testbed measurements and operational traffic traces. TRACE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art AHD methods in resource assignment problems and yields more auditable heuristics at under 2% overhead.

AI.tldr: TRACE将进化式自动启发式设计（AHD）与智能体知识抽取工作流结合，通过Reasoner分析日志schema提出假设、Coder编写并执行schema特定代码验证假设，从系统日志中提取可解释知识。在合成云基准和基于工业测试床测量与运营流量轨迹构建的5G vRAN场景中，TRACE在资源分配问题上持续优于主流AHD方法，生成的启发式规则更可审计，开销低于2%。
AI.motivation: 动态资源分配是现代计算基础设施的核心，工业部署仍依赖人工编写的启发式规则，因为其可读、可审计且能满足严格延迟预算。LLM驱动的AHD有望自动化规则编写，但现有框架面向完全给定的组合问题、仅依赖标量适应度学习。在真实系统中，决定启发式优劣的内在行为（如处理器速度、功耗）先验未知，标量分数只说明"哪个更好"而非"为什么更好"。而这一缺失信息恰好记录在每次评估产生的系统日志中，但日志规模大、噪声高、目标相关信号因硬件软件栈而异，无法直接输入LLM，也无法用固定解析器处理。
AI.method: TRACE将进化式AHD循环与智能体知识抽取工作流耦合。Reasoner智能体结合目标分析日志schema，提出关于系统动态的假设；Coder智能体编写并执行针对该schema的代码来检验假设，产出的结果或作为洞察、或作为可执行工具反馈给进化中的启发式。该设计使AHD过程能利用日志中的结构化与非结构化信号，而非仅依赖标量适应度。
AI.result: 在合成云基准和一个由工业测试床测量数据与运营流量轨迹构建的5G vRAN场景上进行评估。TRACE在资源分配问题上持续优于现有最先进（state-of-the-art）的AHD方法，生成的启发式规则可审计性更强，且额外开销低于2%。
AI.conclusion: 将智能体知识抽取与进化式AHD相结合，可有效利用系统日志弥补标量适应度信息不足的问题，在真实异构系统场景下提升资源分配启发式的性能与可审计性，且开销可接受。

title: HumanoidTTT: Test-Time Capability Reuse for Efficient Humanoid Control
summary: Recent advances in motion generation and whole-body tracking have enabled humanoid robots to execute increasingly diverse motions, yet the same motion capabilities may be requested repeatedly during continual deployment. Reliable reuse is challenging because intervening motions can change the robot's entry state, making previously successful motions unsafe to replay blindly. Meanwhile, validated capabilities accumulate during deployment, while bounded storage requires deciding which ones are worth retaining. To address these challenges, we present HumanoidTTT, a framework for test-time capability reuse in continual humanoid control. Specifically, we introduce Selective Full-Motion Reuse, which authorizes direct reuse of validated complete motions only from certified applicable entry states, allowing accepted reuse to bypass fresh generation. We further introduce Test-Time Capability Consolidation, which adapts which qualified capabilities persist in a bounded Full-Motion Store using subsequent deployment reuse as feedback. Experiments demonstrate zero unsafe accepts and a 16.4$\times$ end-to-end speedup over fresh generation, while online consolidation improves avoided generator calls by 13.2 per 200 requests over its frozen counterpart. Overall, HumanoidTTT enables reliable and efficient reuse of validated motion capabilities while adaptively retaining useful capabilities throughout continual deployment. Code: https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/HumanoidTTT. Website: https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/HumanoidTTT.

AI.tldr: 提出HumanoidTTT框架，通过选择性完整动作复用与测试时能力巩固，实现人形机器人持续部署中已验证动作能力的可靠高效复用。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人在持续部署中会反复请求相同动作，但中间动作会改变机器人入场状态，导致此前成功的动作盲目重放不安全；同时已验证能力不断累积，而存储有限，需决定哪些能力值得保留。
AI.method: 1）选择性完整动作复用（Selective Full-Motion Reuse）：仅从经认证的适用入场状态直接复用已验证完整动作，使被接受的复用绕过重新生成；2）测试时能力巩固（Test-Time Capability Consolidation）：以后续部署复用作为反馈，在有界完整动作存储中自适应调整哪些合格能力得以保留。
AI.result: 实验实现零次不安全接受，端到端相比重新生成提速16.4倍；在线巩固相比冻结版本每200次请求多避免13.2次生成器调用。
AI.conclusion: HumanoidTTT在持续部署中实现已验证动作能力的可靠高效复用，并自适应保留有用能力。

title: Probabilistic Plan Legibility with Off-the-shelf Planners
comment: Accepted at the 9th ICAPS Workshop on Planning and Robotics. ICAPS 2021
summary: Legible planning is the creation of plans that best disambiguate their goals from a set of other candidates from an observer's perspective. In this paper we propose a method for legible planning for arbitrary PDDL domains, by extending previous research on legibility to classical planning without requiring to construct ad-hoc planners. We also discuss how the observer perspective may be estimated through a second order theory of mind that connects the planner's and the observer's task spaces. Our solution can for example be deployed in human-robot teaming scenarios, where an autonomous robot in a team can implicitly communicate its goal by producing legible plans. We present benchmark results on several PDDL planning domains. Our results generally show that plan legibility is a trade-off with plan efficiency, however, not all planning domains allows to increase legibility in the same way and a regularizing factor to balance legibility and efficiency was proved necessary.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向任意PDDL域的易读规划方法，将易读性研究扩展到经典规划，无需构造专用规划器，并用二阶心智理论估计观察者视角，在多个基准域验证了易读性与效率之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 易读规划旨在使观察者能从多个候选目标中正确推断规划者的真实目标；既有易读性研究多局限于特定场景或需构建专用规划器，缺乏对任意PDDL域的通用支持，也难以刻画观察者的推断视角。
AI.method: 将已有易读性度量扩展至经典规划，在任意PDDL域上进行易读规划而无需ad-hoc规划器；通过连接规划者与观察者任务空间的二阶心智理论来估计观察者视角；引入正则化因子以平衡易读性与规划效率。
AI.result: 在多个PDDL规划域上进行了基准测试，结果表明规划易读性与规划效率之间存在权衡关系；不同规划域提升易读性的方式与程度不同，且实验证明引入正则化因子来平衡易读性与效率是必要的。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法可在任意PDDL域中实现易读规划，可应用于人-机器人协作等场景，使自主机器人通过生成易读计划隐式传达其目标；易读性与效率需通过正则化因子加以折中。

title: Bounded-Fidelity Sim-as-Demo-Stage: Mocap Handoff for Governance Benchmarks
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Reference implementation and data: https://github.com/s20sc/bounded-fidelity-mocap-handoff
summary: Sim-to-real research pursues physics fidelity as a primary objective: simulators are judged by how closely they reproduce real-world contact dynamics. For governance benchmarking of LLM-driven robots, where the simulator demonstrates that an admission/policy/contract/audit pipeline behaves correctly, contact fidelity at object handoffs (grasp, carry, place) becomes a liability: contact-force integration noise injects audit-chain divergence that is structurally unrelated to the governance property under test. We propose bounded-fidelity sim-as-demo-stage, a design pattern that suppresses contact physics within explicitly bracketed handoff envelopes while preserving full dynamics elsewhere. The construction uses MuJoCo's mocap-body primitive driven by a 220-line Python adapter that the governance bridge invokes via structured intents. We formalise audit-chain stability as byte-equality of the hashed event log across replays and identify two structural envelope properties that imply it. Across N=1000 replays per posture, the mocap variant produces one distinct audit-chain hash (1000/1000 byte-identical; Wilson 95% CI [0.997, 1.000]); the contact-force baseline produces 584 distinct hashes (993/1000 diverged; CI [0.987, 0.998]). A timestep sweep (1, 2, 5, 10 ms) shows the divergence is structural, not a tuning artefact: it stays at 0.985 at every timestep. Envelope-edge timing jitter (+/-10 simulation steps, 1,400 replays) produces 0 divergence, and audit chains remain byte-equal across K in {1, 2, 3} sequentially handed-off objects (1,500 replays) with sub-linear per-pick-and-place overhead. The pattern gives benchmark designers audit-chain reproducibility at near-zero engineering cost; we also map where it is harmful (sim-to-real validation, policy training, contact-rich tasks) so it is not mis-deployed.

AI.tldr: 提出"有界保真度仿真即演示台"设计模式：在显式括号化的交接包络内抑制接触物理、包络外保留完整动力学，用MuJoCo mocap-body与220行Python适配器实现，使审计链在回放中逐字节一致。
AI.motivation: 仿真到现实研究以物理保真度为首要目标，模拟器按对真实接触动力学的复现程度被评判。但在LLM驱动机器人的治理基准测试中，仿真器需证明准入/策略/合约/审计流水线行为正确，此时物体交接（抓取、搬运、放置）处的接触保真度反而成为负担：接触力积分噪声会注入与被测治理属性在结构上无关的审计链分歧。
AI.method: 提出有界保真度仿真即演示台设计模式，在显式括号化的交接包络内抑制接触物理，包络外保留完整动力学。实现基于MuJoCo的mocap-body原语，由220行Python适配器驱动，治理桥以结构化意图调用。将审计链稳定性形式化为哈希事件日志在多次回放中的字节相等性，并给出蕴含该性质的两个包络结构属性。实验设置：每种姿态N=1000次回放；时间步扫描1、2、5、10 ms；包络边缘时序抖动±10仿真步共1400次回放；K∈{1,2,3}顺序交接物体共1500次回放。
AI.result: N=1000次回放/姿态下，mocap变体仅产生1个不同审计链哈希（1000/1000字节一致，Wilson 95% CI [0.997, 1.000]）；接触力基线产生584个不同哈希（993/1000发生分歧，CI [0.987, 0.998]）。时间步扫描（1、2、5、10 ms）显示分歧率为结构性的而非调参假象，各时间步下均保持0.985。包络边缘时序抖动（±10仿真步，1400次回放）产生0分歧；审计链在K∈{1,2,3}顺序交接物体的1500次回放中保持字节相等，且每次抓取-放置的额外开销呈次线性。
AI.conclusion: 该模式以近乎零的工程成本为基准设计者提供审计链可复现性；同时明确其有害场景（仿真到现实验证、策略训练、接触丰富任务），以避免误用。

title: Real-Time Whole-Body Safe Motion Generation for Multi-Segment Tendon-Driven Continuum Robots
summary: Real-time motion generation for tendon-driven continuum robots requires accurate modeling of nonuniform bending and whole-body collision avoidance. This paper presents a unified actuation-space framework for planar multi-segment tendon-driven continuum robots. An energy-based variable-curvature model captures spatially varying tendon spacing and bending stiffness and provides analytical Jacobians for differential inverse kinematics and safety monitoring. A multipoint CBF-QP enforces backbone clearance under obstacle motion and actuation-velocity bounds, while its decision dimension depends only on the number of independently actuated segments. The model closely agrees with GVS references, with a maximum curvature error of $5.223 \times 10^{-2}\,\mathrm{m}^{-1}$. Over 100 MuJoCo trials, the proposed method achieves collision-free success rates of 96% and 100% in static and dynamic scenarios, respectively, compared with approximately 60% and 80% without CBF constraints. Hole-traversal tests further demonstrate safe motion in constrained environments. With 600 backbone monitoring points, the mean control-step time is 6.66 ms, demonstrating real-time whole-body safe motion generation.

AI.tldr: 提出面向平面多段腱驱动连续体机器人的统一驱动空间框架，结合能量型变曲率模型与多点CBF-QP约束，实现实时全身无碰撞运动生成。
AI.motivation: 腱驱动连续体机器人的实时运动生成依赖对非均匀弯曲的精确建模与全身避障，但现有方法难以兼顾变曲率建模精度与实时安全约束。
AI.method: 建立能量型变曲率模型以刻画空间变化的腱间距与弯曲刚度，并推导解析雅可比用于微分逆运动学与安全监测；采用多点CBF-QP在障碍物运动与驱动速度约束下保证骨架间隙，其决策维度仅取决于独立驱动段数。
AI.result: 模型与GVS参考吻合，最大曲率误差5.223×10⁻² m⁻¹；100次MuJoCo试验中静态与动态场景成功率分别为96%和100%，无CBF约束时约为60%和80%；穿孔测试验证受限环境安全运动；600个骨架监测点下平均控制步耗时6.66 ms。
AI.conclusion: 该统一驱动空间框架在保证变曲率建模精度的同时实现实时全身安全运动生成，验证了CBF约束对碰撞规避有效性与计算可行性。

title: IndoorBEV: A Lightweight Real-Time LiDAR BEV Perception System for Indoor Mobile Robots
summary: Efficient indoor LiDAR perception is challenging because mobile robots must understand cluttered three-dimensional environments under strict latency and memory constraints. Existing point-based and voxel-based methods often incur substantial computational overhead, whereas conventional bird's-eye-view (BEV) representations improve efficiency at the cost of discarding vertical geometric information. We present IndoorBEV, a lightweight LiDAR perception framework that mitigates this tradeoff through a height-aware BEV representation and geometry-conditioned feature fusion. IndoorBEV summarizes the vertical point distribution in each BEV cell using statistical height features and multi-frequency height encoding, allowing informative three-dimensional cues to be processed efficiently by two-dimensional convolutions. A lightweight encoder then integrates complementary geometric features with multi-scale local representations and compact global scene context. Decoupled dense prediction heads jointly produce semantic BEV maps and oriented object bounding boxes. IndoorBEV contains only 0.6M parameters and requires 2.3 MB of model storage. On an NVIDIA AGX Orin, it uses 21.52 MB of GPU memory per inference and achieves a mean latency of 169.6 ms under a 200 ms perception deadline, with a deadline miss ratio of 1.8\%. Evaluations on simulated scenes, real-world robot scans, and an open-source indoor point-cloud dataset demonstrate a favorable tradeoff among perception accuracy, latency, and memory consumption. These results indicate that explicitly encoding vertical geometry within a compact BEV representation provides an effective approach to resource-efficient indoor LiDAR perception.

AI.tldr: IndoorBEV：面向室内LiDAR感知的轻量框架，通过高度感知BEV表示与几何条件特征融合，在精度、延迟与内存间取得良好折衷。
AI.motivation: 移动机器人需在严格延迟与内存约束下理解杂乱三维室内环境。点云/体素方法计算开销大，而传统BEV虽高效却丢失垂直几何信息，故需在效率与三维信息保留间取得平衡。
AI.method: 提出高度感知BEV表示，用统计高度特征与多频高度编码汇总每个BEV单元的垂直点分布，使三维线索可由2D卷积高效处理；轻量编码器融合互补几何特征、多尺度局部表示与紧凑全局场景上下文；解耦稠密预测头联合输出语义BEV图与有向目标包围框。
AI.result: 仅0.6M参数、2.3MB模型存储；NVIDIA AGX Orin上单次推理GPU内存21.52MB，200ms感知截止下平均延迟169.6ms，截止错过率1.8%；在模拟场景、真实机器人扫描及开源室内点云数据集上均展现精度-延迟-内存的良好折衷。
AI.conclusion: 在紧凑BEV表示中显式编码垂直几何，是实现资源高效室内LiDAR感知的有效途径。

title: DeepJEPA: Scaling World Models from Within
summary: World-model planners typically scale outward by rolling farther, sampling more trajectories, or optimizing longer, while assigning the same computation to every imagined transition. We show that making every transition uniformly deeper wastes computation and can degrade planning because useful refinement is concentrated at a small set of decision-critical events. We introduce DeepJEPA, a weight-tied joint-embedding predictive world model that treats transition depth as an inner test-time scaling axis and learns when another recurrent update is worth computing for each candidate and rollout step. Across five visual-control settings, DeepJEPA improves or matches the strongest fixed-depth planner while averaging only 1.00-1.26 updates per transition. Its additional computation concentrates at contact onset and sustained object interaction, where latent corrections can change which candidates enter the planner's elite set and which action is selected. Representation probes further show that improved planning does not require uniformly better object-state decodability. DeepJEPA therefore reframes world-model scaling as a problem of allocating internal computation where it can change the planner's decision: think deeper at decision-critical transitions instead of making every rollout uniformly deeper or longer.

AI.tldr: DeepJEPA将世界模型中每个转移的递归深度视为测试时内部扩展轴，学习按需自适应分配计算，在决策关键事件上“想得更深”，以极低平均更新次数（1.00-1.26次/转移）匹配或超越最强固定深度规划器。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型规划器主要靠“向外扩展”（滚得更远、采样更多轨迹、优化更久）提升性能，却对每次想象转移分配相同计算量；作者指出均匀加深每个转移既浪费算力，又可能因有用细化集中在少数决策关键事件上而损害规划质量。
AI.method: 提出DeepJEPA：权重共享的联合嵌入预测（joint-embedding predictive）世界模型，将转移深度作为测试时内部扩展轴，对每个候选轨迹及每个 rollout 步自适应地决定是否需要再一次递归更新，从而把内部计算动态分配到更能改变规划决策的位置。
AI.result: 在五类视觉控制任务中，DeepJEPA匹配或超越最强固定深度规划器，平均每次转移仅需1.00-1.26次更新；额外计算集中于接触开始与持续物体交互阶段，此时潜在修正可改变进入规划器精英集的候选及最终动作选择。表征探针显示，规划改进并不依赖统一更优的物体状态可解码性。
AI.conclusion: DeepJEPA重新定义了世界模型扩展方式：从“均匀加深或加长 rollout”转向“在能改变规划决策的转移处分配内部计算”，即只在决策关键转移上加深思考，而非对所有 rollout 一致加深或加长。

title: Towards a General Humanoid Loco-Manipulation Model via Egocentric Whole-Body Human Data Pretraining
summary: Humanoid whole-body manipulation has advanced rapidly, enabling policies to coordinate locomotion, posture, bimanual interaction, and dexterous hand movements. Meanwhile, egocentric human videos provide diverse examples of everyday interactions across objects and scenes, offering scalable supervision without robot operation. However, existing supervision from these videos provides limited coverage of whole-body movement and coordination with hand-object interaction, while obtaining such supervision through humanoid teleoperation is also costly and difficult to scale. We therefore explore how human experience can support scalable learning of humanoid loco-manipulation. To support this study, we introduce HumanVerse-500, a 500-hour dataset of diverse human loco-manipulation behaviors in open-world environments, collected with a lightweight wearable system that synchronizes egocentric video with body and hand motion. Building on this dataset, we develop $λ_0$, a whole-body humanoid vision-language-action policy, through three-stage training that first learns interaction from diverse egocentric datasets, then coordinates body and hand motion using HumanVerse-500, and finally adapts the policy to downstream tasks and robot embodiments. Across these stages, $λ_0$ learns a shared representation space for human experience transfer, while domain-specific interfaces handle differences between human and robot states and actions. We evaluate $λ_0$ on SIMPLE and 4 real-world loco-manipulation tasks, achieving state-of-the-art performance, and further analyze its scaling behavior, generalization, and training-stage contributions to understand how human data support downstream whole-body humanoid control. We will release our code, models, and data to support further research.

AI.tldr: 提出HumanVerse-500数据集与λ₀整体式人形视觉-语言-动作策略，通过三阶段训练利用人类第一视角视频实现可扩展的全身移动操作学习。
AI.motivation: 人形全身操作策略进展迅速，但现有第一视角人类视频对全身运动与手-物交互协同的监督覆盖不足，而人形遥操作采集此类监督成本高、难扩展，故探索如何利用人类经验支持可扩展的人形移动操作学习。
AI.method: 构建轻量可穿戴系统，同步第一视角视频与身体、手部运动，采集500小时开放环境多样化人类移动操作行为，形成HumanVerse-500数据集；在此基础上设计λ₀全身人形VLA策略，采用三阶段训练：先从多样第一视角数据集学习交互，再用HumanVerse-500协调身体与手部运动，最后适配下游任务与机器人本体；各阶段共享表征空间以迁移人类经验，域特定接口处理人机状态与动作差异。
AI.result: 在SIMPLE及4项真实世界移动操作任务上取得最优性能，并进一步分析其扩展行为、泛化能力及各训练阶段贡献。
AI.conclusion: 人类经验可作为人形全身移动操作的可扩展监督来源，共享表征与域特定接口相结合的三阶段训练有效支撑下游全身人形控制；代码、模型与数据将开源以促进后续研究。

title: Whole-Body Aerial Grasping and Lifting via Partial Visual Observations
summary: Aerial grasp-and-lift tasks require whole-body coordination across approach, acquisition, and lifting under partial target observations. Early approach failures can limit exposure to later task stages during training, while changing visibility complicates alignment and closure timing during execution. We present a recurrent teacher-student framework that learns a single policy in simulation to jointly command flight, arm motion, and gripper closure without an explicit task-phase input. A privileged teacher learns through reinforcement learning with a critical-state curriculum that exposes acquisition and lifting states before connecting them to normal approach trajectories. Its behavior is distilled into a recurrent visual student that replaces privileged target states with dual-view point clouds and proprioception, integrating observation history for closed-loop control. A dedicated closure objective supervises closure timing from sustained model-defined readiness sequences. Training and primary evaluation use a simulated acquisition-and-payload model with condition-triggered latching, virtual attachment, and wrench-based payload loading for short-distance lifting. Across 8,996 completed simulation episodes under this model, the frozen student achieves full-task success rates of 99.97%, 97.14%, and 95.84% under nominal, physics/control-randomized, and additional camera-randomized conditions, respectively. The nominal latch-count-weighted mean of per-seed 90th-percentile alignment errors at acquisition is 8.12 mm.

AI.tldr: 提出循环教师-学生框架，在仿真中学习单一策略，联合控制飞行、机械臂运动与夹爪闭合，无需显式任务阶段输入，将特权教师策略蒸馏为循环视觉学生策略，在多种随机化条件下实现高成功率空中抓取-举升。
AI.motivation: 空中抓取-举升任务需在部分目标观测下实现接近、抓取、举升的全身体协调。训练早期接近阶段失败会减少后续阶段样本暴露，而执行时目标可见性变化又给对准与闭合时机带来困难。
AI.method: 采用循环教师-学生框架：特权教师通过强化学习训练，并使用关键状态课程，先暴露抓取与举升状态再衔接正常接近轨迹；其行为蒸馏到循环视觉学生，学生以双视角点云与本体感受替代特权目标状态，并整合观测历史实现闭环控制；另设专门闭合目标，基于持续的模型定义就绪序列监督闭合时机。仿真环境含条件触发闩锁、虚拟附着与基于力旋量的负载加载。
AI.result: 在该模型下完成8,996个仿真回合，冻结学生策略在标称、物理/控制随机化、附加相机随机化条件下的全任务成功率分别为99.97%、97.14%、95.84%；标称条件下按闩锁计数加权的各种子第90百分位抓取对准误差均值为8.12 mm。
AI.conclusion: 该循环教师-学生框架可在无显式任务阶段输入下实现稳健的空中抓取-举升，且对物理、控制与相机随机化具有较强泛化能力，抓取对准精度较高。

title: ScaffoldM3C: A Multimodal Sequential Monte Carlo Framework for Generative Stable Construction Planning
comment: This work has been submitted to IEEE Transactions on Robotics and Learning (T-RL) and is currently under review. Project Page: https://stanfordmsl.github.io/ScaffoldM3C/
summary: Autonomously constructing physically realizable 3D structures remains a significant challenge due to combinatorial action spaces, interchangeable components, equifinal assembly sequences, and strict stability requirements during construction. State-of-the-art methods fine-tune large language models for text-based generative construction. However, these approaches do not allow for Multimodal (text, image, sketch) conditioning, overlook the practical role of scaffolding for stabilizing intermediate structures, and suffer from slow inference speeds. Therefore, we formulate construction as a probabilistic next-block generation task with multiple potential assembly actions and multiple potential task conditioning modalities. Concurrently, we explicitly consider the utility of scaffolding by introducing an auxiliary scaffold block token. We present Scaffold Multimodal Monte Carlo (ScaffoldM3C), a multimodal, lightweight, auto-regressive model for stable block-based construction, that proposes a set of next-step candidate blocks. Leveraging these candidates, we utilize Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) to maintain a population of possible assembly sequences, allowing us to consider multiple, potentially different, assembly directions simultaneously. We train our multimodal architecture by extending the StableText2Brick dataset to contain image conditioning prompts and scaffold-stabilized build sequences. ScaffoldM3C is 4x smaller than competing baselines, yielding a 5x to 20x speedup during inference, while achieving comparable construction quality to state-of-the-art methods and higher overall stability. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach through simulations and real-world robot assembly demonstrations.

AI.tldr: 提出ScaffoldM3C：一种轻量级多模态自回归模型，将积木搭建建模为带脚手架token的概率下一步生成任务，结合SMC维护候选装配序列，实现更小、更快、更稳定的3D结构自主构建。
AI.motivation: 自主构建物理可实现的3D结构面临组合动作空间大、组件可互换、多解装配序列、构建过程稳定性要求高等困难。现有基于大语言模型微调的文本生成式方法存在三点不足：不支持多模态（文本、图像、草图）条件输入；忽略脚手架对稳定中间结构的实际作用；推理速度慢。
AI.method: 将构建问题形式化为多潜在装配动作、多条件模态的概率"下一积木"生成任务，并引入辅助脚手架块token显式建模脚手架效用。提出ScaffoldM3C——多模态轻量级自回归模型，生成下一步候选块集合；再用序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）维护一组可能装配序列的种群，从而同时考虑多个潜在的不同装配方向。训练时扩展StableText2Brick数据集，加入图像条件提示与脚手架稳定化的搭建序列。
AI.result: ScaffoldM3C比对比基线小4倍，推理速度提升5倍至20倍，构建质量与最先进方法相当，整体稳定性更高；并通过仿真与真实机器人装配演示验证了方法有效性。
AI.conclusion: 多模态条件、显式脚手架token与SMC序列搜索相结合的轻量自回归方案，可在保证构建质量的同时显著提升效率与稳定性，并具备真实机器人落地的可行性。

title: Same Scene, Different Task: Skill Alignment for Compositional Generalization in VLAs
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models often struggle to generalize to skill combinations absent from their fine-tuning demonstrations, even when every constituent skill has been demonstrated. We focus on a vision shortcut as one failure mode: during fine-tuning, visual observations can serve as a proxy for the instruction, so a policy may execute a demonstrated combination associated with similar observations rather than the instructed combination. This motivates training with counterfactual pairs formed by holding a demonstration observation fixed while changing the instruction to specify an undemonstrated combination. These pairs, however, lack corresponding demonstrated action targets. Crucially, the currently required skill has already been demonstrated, but actions from those executions cannot serve as direct targets because the same skill can require different actions across observations. We propose CRAFT, which transfers supervision from demonstrated executions of the required skill to counterfactual pairs using skill representations that can be reused across executions of the same skill. Across three VLA models and two simulation benchmarks, CRAFT improves success on undemonstrated combinations while maintaining high success on demonstrated ones; it also improves compositional generalization on a real robot. Project website: https://taegeunyang.github.io/craft/

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 CRAFT，通过反事实配对和技能表征迁移监督，缓解 VLA 模型的视觉捷径问题，提升未演示技能组合的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: VLA 模型难以泛化到微调演示中未出现的技能组合，即使每个组成技能都已演示。作者将视觉捷径视为一种失败模式：微调时视觉观察可能成为指令的代理，导致策略根据相似观察执行已演示的组合，而非执行指令要求的组合。
AI.method: 用反事实配对进行训练：固定演示观察，改变指令以指定未演示的组合。但这类配对缺少对应的演示动作目标。尽管所需技能已被演示，其动作也不能直接作为目标，因为同一技能在不同观察下可能需要不同动作。CRAFT 利用可在同一技能不同执行间复用的技能表征，将所需技能已演示执行中的监督迁移到反事实配对。
AI.result: 在三个 VLA 模型和两个仿真基准上，CRAFT 提升了未演示组合的成功率，同时保持已演示组合的高成功率；在真实机器人上也提升了组合泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过技能表征迁移监督解决反事实配对缺乏动作目标的问题，可有效缓解视觉捷径并改善 VLA 模型的组合泛化，且在仿真与真实机器人上均验证有效。

title: Does Continual Imitation Learning Remain Grounded? A Language-Perturbed Benchmark for Robotic Task Retention
summary: Continual imitation learning evaluates whether a robot can learn new knowledge without forgetting previously learned skills. However, retaining task performance does not ensure the behavior remains grounded in language because policies may rely on scene cues, object associations, or memorized task structure. We introduce a benchmark protocol to study how language-guided behavior changes as robotic policies learn successive tasks. We construct meaning-preserving and meaning-changing instruction variants for the Goal, Spatial, Object, and Long suites of LIBERO. Policy experiments focus on LIBERO-Goal, evaluating Original and Paraphrase instructions after each continual-learning stage. We compare representative continual imitation learning methods under their original assumptions while separating task competence from language sensitivity. The proposed diagnostics complement standard learning and forgetting metrics by measuring semantic robustness, goal adaptation, and language sensitivity. Results show that strong continual-learning performance does not always translate to reliable language grounding, and our diagnostics help determine whether retained skills remain correctly guided by their instructions. Additional materials are available at https://sites.google.com/view/stillgrounded

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种语言引导持续模仿学习基准协议，用语义保持/改变指令变体诊断策略是否真正将行为建立在语言上，而不仅是保持任务性能。
AI.motivation: 持续模仿学习通常只评估是否会遗忘旧技能，但保留任务性能不代表行为真正由语言引导——策略可能依赖场景线索、物体关联或记忆的任务结构而非指令语义。因此需要区分"任务胜任度"与"语言敏感性"。
AI.method: 为LIBERO的Goal、Spatial、Object、Long四个套件构建语义保持与语义改变两类指令变体；策略实验聚焦LIBERO-Goal，在每个持续学习阶段后评估原始指令与改写指令；在保持各持续模仿学习方法的原始假设下进行比较，并将任务胜任度与语言敏感性分离。诊断指标包括语义鲁棒性、目标适应性与语言敏感性。
AI.result: 实验表明，较强的持续学习性能并不总能转化为可靠的语言 grounding；所提出的诊断可判断保留的技能是否仍被指令正确引导。
AI.conclusion: 提出的诊断指标补充了标准的学习与遗忘指标，为持续模仿学习中的语言 grounding 提供了新的评估维度；相关材料见项目主页。

title: Token-World: World Modeling in Vision-Language Model Token Space for Robot Manipulation
comment: Submitted to IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA) 2027
summary: A common approach to world-model simulation for vision-language-action (VLA) systems is to predict future RGB observations and then re-encode them into policy inputs, introducing an indirect interface between simulation and downstream policy execution. We instead investigate whether world dynamics can be modeled in a compact, policy-oriented state derived from VLM visual tokens. A key challenge is that raw VLM visual tokens are high-dimensional, making efficient and accurate autoregressive dynamics modeling challenging. To address this, we introduce Token-World, an action-conditioned world model that compresses VLM features into a compact token state, learns future dynamics in this reduced space, and maps predicted states back to the original policy-facing representation for downstream use. Across manipulation benchmarks, Token-World improves open-loop feature fidelity and policy-action consistency over recent world-model simulators, with slower degradation over long rollout horizons. In closed-loop evaluation, its simulated policy performance correlates more strongly with reference policy performance than Ctrl-World ($r=0.794$ vs.\ $0.583$), while requiring lower simulation latency. Ablations further show that compact-representation design and dimensionality substantially affect future-state prediction. Code will be available at https://chuyaofu.github.io/Token-World/.

AI.tldr: 提出 Token-World：在 VLM 视觉 token 派生的紧凑策略导向状态中建模动作条件世界动力学，提升保真度、动作一致性与闭环仿真相关性。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLA 世界模型通常预测未来 RGB 观测再重编码为策略输入，仿真与下游策略执行之间存在间接接口，效率和一致性受限。作者探索能否直接在 VLM 视觉 token 派生的紧凑、策略导向状态中建模世界动力学，但原始 VLM 视觉 token 维度高，自回归动力学建模困难。
AI.method: Token-World 是一个动作条件世界模型：将 VLM 特征压缩为紧凑 token 状态，在该降维空间中学习未来动力学，再把预测状态映射回原始面向策略的表示供下游使用。
AI.result: 在操作基准上，Token-World 相比近期世界模型仿真器提升了开环特征保真度与策略-动作一致性，长时程 rollout 退化更慢。闭环评估中，其仿真策略性能与参考策略性能的相关性高于 Ctrl-World（r=0.794 vs. 0.583），且仿真延迟更低。消融显示紧凑表示设计与维度显著影响未来状态预测。
AI.conclusion: 在紧凑的策略导向 token 状态中建模世界动力学可行且有效，可提高仿真与策略执行的一致性和闭环评估可靠性，同时降低延迟；紧凑表示的设计与维度是关键因素。

title: TacDyn-WAM: Learning Implicit Tactile Dynamics in a Heterogeneous Visuo-Tactile World Action Model
summary: World action models improve robotic manipulation by conditioning actions on predicted futures, yet existing tactile variants largely inherit video-generation pipelines that reconstruct future tactile observations through iterative denoising. Such prediction can become unreliable under deployment drift: small changes in contact position or force may substantially alter tactile pixels even when the underlying contact evolution remains predictable. We introduce TacDyn-WAM, a heterogeneous visuo-tactile world action model that predicts implicit tactile dynamics rather than reconstructing future tactile observations. It learns TacRep, a dynamics-aware tactile target space trained through masked spatio-temporal prediction on tactile clips and regularized by relational structure distillation. A visual expert and an Implicit Tactile Dynamics Expert predict future visual and tactile representations in separate target spaces while interacting through joint attention; the tactile expert predicts future representations and their changes at multiple horizons in a single forward pass, and a read-only tactile memory supplies the current tactile state. On UniVTAC, TacDyn-WAM achieves an average success rate of 81.5% using only the provided demonstrations, reaching state-of-the-art-level performance and remaining competitive with models pretrained on large-scale visuo-tactile trajectories. Ablations confirm the benefits of both tactile pathways and TacRep over pixel-reconstruction and static alternatives. On five real-robot tasks, TacDyn-WAM reaches 71.0% average success, and modest-scale pretraining raises it to 85.0%, further validating our method.

AI.tldr: TacDyn-WAM：一种异构视触觉世界动作模型，通过预测隐式触觉动力学（而非重建未来触觉像素）来提升机器人操作的鲁棒性与成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有触觉世界动作模型多沿用视频生成流程，需通过迭代去噪重建未来触觉观测；在部署漂移下，接触位置或力的微小变化即可显著改变触觉像素，导致预测不可靠，即便底层接触演化本身仍具可预测性。
AI.method: 提出TacDyn-WAM，预测隐式触觉动力学而非重建未来触觉观测。学习TacRep：动力学感知的触觉目标空间，通过触觉片段的掩码时空预测训练，并以关系结构蒸馏正则化。模型包含视觉专家与隐式触觉动力学专家，在各自目标空间中预测未来视觉与触觉表征，并通过联合注意力交互；触觉专家单次前向即预测多时间尺度的未来表征及其变化，只读触觉记忆提供当前触觉状态。
AI.result: 在UniVTAC上，仅用给定演示数据达到81.5%平均成功率，达到当前最优水平，并与在大规模视触觉轨迹上预训练的模型相当。消融实验证实两条触觉通路及TacRep优于像素重建与静态方案。五项真实机器人任务平均成功率71.0%，中等规模预训练提升至85.0%。
AI.conclusion: 以隐式动力学表征预测替代触觉像素重建，可有效缓解部署漂移下的预测不可靠问题，在仿真与真实任务中均验证了方法的有效性与可扩展性。

title: When Reasoning Helps Action: Monitoring and Steering Chain-of-Thought in Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary: Reasoning-enabled VLA policies expose chain-of-thought (CoT) traces that appear to explain and guide their actions, creating a potential interface for runtime safety through reasoning monitoring and correction. In this work, we define and operationalize two evaluation axes for assessing when this interface can improve embodied behavior: correctability, which measures whether unreliable reasoning can be detected and improved during generation, and actionability, which measures whether reasoning corrections produce behaviorally meaningful changes in the intended direction. To enable correctability, we introduce Token-level Reward for Utility-Steered Chain-of-Thought (TRUST), an offline-trained value model that predicts eventual reasoning correctness from partial prefixes and uses these estimates to monitor and selectively steer reasoning generation in frozen VLA policies. On the Alpamayo 1.5 driving VLA, TRUST monitors correctness with 88.9% accuracy and improves reasoning correctness from 75.9% to 90.0%. On a baseline-defined challenging subset in AlpaSim, TRUST reduces collision rate by 30.4% and maximum trajectory error by 11.5% relative to the unsteered policy, outperforming a compute-matched Best-of-4 baseline. On the DeepThinkVLA manipulation VLA, TRUST improves the correctness of grasp-state claims from 69.3% to 90.2% and action-choice claims from 68.8% to 85.9%, yet closed-loop task performance on LIBERO-Plus remains largely unchanged. Empirical analysis reveals intent-consistent behavioral effects in Alpamayo 1.5 but limited effects in DeepThinkVLA, helping interpret these different task-level outcomes. Together, our results show that gains in reasoning correctness do not automatically imply gains in embodied performance, motivating evaluation of correctability and actionability when using CoT as a runtime safety interface.

AI.tldr: 本文提出评估VLA策略中CoT推理作为运行时安全接口的两个维度——可纠正性（correctability）与可行动性（actionability），并开发TRUST方法实现推理监控与引导。结果显示推理正确性提升并不自动转化为具身性能提升。
AI.motivation: 推理驱动的VLA策略会输出CoT轨迹，看似能解释并指导动作，为运行时安全监控与纠正提供了潜在接口。然而，推理正确性的提升是否真正改善具身行为尚不明确，缺乏评估这一接口有效性的框架。
AI.method: 作者定义并操作化两个评估维度：correctability（能否在生成过程中检测并改进不可靠推理）与actionability（推理纠正是否产生行为上有意义的预期方向变化）。为实现correctability，提出TRUST（Token-level Reward for Utility-Steered Chain-of-Thought），一个离线训练的价值模型，从部分前缀预测最终推理正确性，用于监控并选择性引导冻结VLA策略的推理生成。
AI.result: 在Alpamayo 1.5驾驶VLA上，TRUST监控正确性达88.9%准确率，推理正确性从75.9%提升至90.0%；在AlpaSim困难子集上，碰撞率降低30.4%，最大轨迹误差降低11.5%，优于算力匹配的Best-of-4基线。在DeepThinkVLA操作VLA上，抓取状态断言正确性从69.3%升至90.2%，动作选择断言从68.8%升至85.9%，但LIBERO-Plus闭环任务性能基本不变。实证分析显示Alpamayo 1.5存在意图一致的行为效应，而DeepThinkVLA效应有限。
AI.conclusion: 推理正确性的提升并不自动带来具身性能提升。将CoT作为运行时安全接口时，需同时评估correctability与actionability，以判断该接口是否真正改善具身行为。

title: CF-JEPA: Improving Robustness of JEPA World Models via Controllability Factorization
summary: Controlling an agent with vision requires being able to separate useful information from irrelevant background information. JEPA-style latent world models seem like a natural approach for this, as they do not perform pixel-level reconstruction; however, they are still sensitive to these distractor signals and experience latent collapse. In this work, we introduce Controllability Factorized JEPA (CF-JEPA), a JEPA-style world model which splits the latent space into controllable and uncontrollable subspaces. This factorization allows us to capture all the distractor information into the uncontrollable region, while we use the control-relevant latent information for our task. With this, we show comparable performance across 2D and 3D control tasks under nominal conditions and improved performance under distracted conditions, where CF-JEPA is the only model that does not experience latent collapse. We also validate our model under distracted conditions for a simulated robot task, highlighting the practical application of such a scheme.

AI.tldr: 提出了Controllability Factorized JEPA（CF-JEPA），将JEPA世界模型的潜空间分解为可控与不可控两个子空间，从而在存在干扰信息的条件下实现更鲁棒的控制。
AI.motivation: 基于视觉控制智能体时，需从无关背景信息中分离出有用信息。JEPA风格的潜世界模型因不做像素级重建，看似是天然解决方案，但实际仍对干扰信号敏感，并会出现潜空间崩溃（latent collapse）问题。
AI.method: 提出CF-JEPA（Controllability Factorized JEPA），一种JEPA风格的世界模型。它把潜空间划分为可控子空间与不可控子空间：将全部干扰信息归入不可控区域，而控制相关的潜信息则用于下游任务。
AI.result: 在2D和3D控制任务中，名义条件下性能与基线相当；在存在干扰的条件下性能更优，且CF-JEPA是唯一未出现潜空间崩溃的模型。此外，在仿真机器人任务的干扰条件下进行了验证，体现了该方案的实际应用价值。
AI.conclusion: 通过对潜空间的可控性分解，CF-JEPA有效隔离干扰信息，缓解了JEPA模型的潜空间崩溃问题，并在干扰环境下展现出更强的鲁棒性与实用潜力。

title: Toward Humanoid Robots in Construction: A Teleoperation Feasibility Study
comment: Accepted at IROS 2026 Workshop on Future of Construction
summary: We present a teleoperation system that enables a single operator to perform construction tasks on a Unitree G1 humanoid, combining extended reality (XR) based upper body control with pedal-based locomotion to enable simultaneous manipulation and locomotion. Motivated by persistent labor shortages, hazardous working conditions, and challenges in humanoid autonomy, we investigate teleoperation as a practical near-term approach for reducing physical strain on workers while generating high quality demonstration data. We evaluate the system on two representative construction tasks drawn from O*NET occupational database, and report task success and completion time relative to a manual baseline. The system achieved 100% success on tool transport and 80% success on surface painting, with teleoperation requiring substantially more time compared to manual execution.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向Unitree G1人形机器人的遥操作系统：XR上半身控制结合踏板式移动，使单人可同时操作与行走；在两项建筑任务上验证，工具搬运成功率100%、墙面喷涂80%，但耗时明显高于人工基线。
AI.motivation: 劳动力持续短缺、作业环境危险，且人形机器人自主能力不足，因此将遥操作视为短期内可行的替代方案，既能减轻工人身体负担，又能采集高质量示教数据。
AI.method: 构建单操作者遥操作系统：基于扩展现实（XR）的上半身操控 + 踏板驱动的移动控制，实现操作与移动并行；从O*NET职业数据库选取两项代表性建筑任务进行评测。
AI.result: 工具搬运任务成功率100%，表面喷涂任务成功率80%；与人工基线相比，遥操作完成时间显著更长。
AI.conclusion: XR+踏板的单人遥操作可完成建筑类任务并具备数据采集价值，但效率仍受限于完成时间；后续需提升操作速度与精细作业（如喷涂）的可靠性。

title: Measuring Asset and Scene Reconstruction Effects in Real-to-Sim Robot Evaluation
summary: Simulated evaluation is increasingly used alongside real-world evaluation of robot policies because it is cheaper and easier to repeat; however, its value depends on how closely its outcomes track the real robot's. We test whether our reconstruction pipeline, combining metrically scaled object geometry, authored physical parameters and scene reconstruction, reduces disagreement between simulated and real robot scores relative to a default open-source recipe. We constructed two simulated versions of one bimanual robot cell: an authored reconstruction, using object geometry at estimated metric scale, projected textures, authored physics and our own scene splat; and a baseline, referred to as the default reconstruction, using the open-source recipe of a generative single-image mesh, engine-default physics and a Gaussian-splat scene. Both reconstructions use the same object photographs and scene video. Two policies ran five tasks each, giving ten task-policy pairs, which we call cells; each cell was run twenty times in each reconstruction with all other settings held fixed. Both reconstructions were scored against the same real trials, graded by a third-party evaluator. Pearson correlation between the ten simulated and real cell means is r = 0.90 for the authored reconstruction and 0.51 for the default. Mean score error is 6.97 percentage points for the authored reconstruction and 17.54 for the default, a reduction of 10.56 percentage points. These results show that improving the quality of the environment reconstruction through higher visual fidelity, authored physics and metric scale makes the simulation more faithful to the real world and narrows the sim-to-real gap. We release the harness, the per-trial scores, every reported run's configuration, and the assets and scenes of both reconstructions.

AI.tldr: 作者构建了同一双臂机器人工作单元的两个仿真版本（精细重现实与开源默认重建），用10个任务-策略单元各20次试验与真实试验对照评估，结果表明高质量重建（度量尺度几何、人工设定物理参数、自有场景splat）显著缩小sim-to-real差距。
AI.motivation: 仿真评估因成本低、易重复而被广泛用于机器人策略评估，但其价值取决于仿真结果与真机结果的一致程度。论文旨在检验：通过度量尺度物体几何、人工设定物理参数与场景重建构成的精细重建流程，能否相对于开源默认配方降低仿真与真机评分之间的分歧。
AI.method: 构建同一双臂机器人工作单元的两个仿真版本：（1）精细重建（authored reconstruction）：采用估计度量尺度下的物体几何、投影纹理、人工设定物理参数及自有场景splat；（2）基线默认重建（default reconstruction）：采用开源配方，即生成式单图网格、引擎默认物理参数与高斯splat场景。两者使用相同的物体照片与场景视频。两个策略各执行五项任务，共10个任务-策略单元（cells）；每个单元在每种重建中运行20次，其余设置固定。两种重建均与同一批真实试验对照，由第三方评估者评分。
AI.result: 10个单元仿真均值与真机均值的皮尔逊相关系数：精细重建 r = 0.90，默认重建 r = 0.51；平均评分误差分别为6.97和17.54个百分点，降低10.56个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 通过更高视觉保真度、人工设定物理参数与度量尺度提升环境重建质量，可使仿真更贴近真实世界并缩小sim-to-real差距。作者公开了评测框架、逐次试验得分、所有报告运行的配置，以及两种重建的资产与场景。

title: DITTO-X: Forward and Reverse Teleoperation for Dexterous Manipulation and Human Intervention
summary: Teleoperated demonstrations are a primary source of data for robot manipulation, and teleoperated interventions are a primary mechanism for correcting policies at deployment. Yet most teleoperation systems close the loop through vision alone and are built around parallel-jaw grippers, limiting both what the robot can execute and what the operator can express through it. This is most damaging in shared autonomy, where the operator sees the scene only through occluded cameras and must take over a dexterous hand mid-task, often with an object already grasped. We present DITTO-X, a hand-agnostic dexterous teleoperation interface that renders joint-level force and fingertip contact events from sensing already on the robot hand, and drives three commercial dexterous hands (Sharpa, Wuji, and Inspire) without per-hand redesign. Because the exoskeleton is actuated, DITTO-X also supports reverse teleoperation, in which the robot back-drives the operator's fingers into its own configuration before control is transferred, so the human enters the loop already matched to the state they inherit. Our results show that DITTO-X improves demonstration quality and throughput over a commercial hand-tracking glove, both in regular data collection and in human intervention during policy deployment for contact-rich manipulation tasks. More information can be found from our website: https://tml.stanford.edu/ditto-x/.

AI.tldr: 提出DITTO-X，一种手部无关的灵巧遥操作接口，通过关节级力反馈与指尖接触事件驱动三款商用灵巧手，并支持反向遥操作，使操作者接管时已与机器人手形匹配，提升演示质量与吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 现有遥操作系统多依赖视觉闭环且围绕平行夹爪设计，限制了机器人的可执行动作与操作者的表达；在共享自主场景中，操作者仅能通过被遮挡的相机观察，并常在已抓取物体时需中途接管灵巧手，问题尤为严重。
AI.method: DITTO-X为手部无关的灵巧遥操作接口：利用机器人手上已有传感渲染关节级力与指尖接触事件，无需逐手重新设计即可驱动Sharpa、Wuji、Inspire三款商用灵巧手；外骨骼具驱动能力，支持反向遥操作，在控制权转移前由机器人反向驱动操作者手指至自身构型。
AI.result: 在常规数据采集与策略部署中的人为干预（面向接触丰富操作任务）两方面，DITTO-X相较商用手部追踪手套均提升了演示质量与吞吐量。
AI.conclusion: DITTO-X通过力/接触反馈与反向遥操作实现手部无关的灵巧遥操作，改善演示与干预表现；更多信息见 https://tml.stanford.edu/ditto-x/。

title: Getting Out and Getting Back: World and Behavior Grounding in Real2Sim2Real Co-Training
summary: Simulation can expand scarce real demonstrations for co-training, yet how world fidelity and similarity to human behavior affect policy performance remains unclear. We distinguish world grounding, which aligns simulation with the real system, and behavior grounding, which aligns simulated trajectories with human motion. We build a real2sim2real pipeline that varies these axes independently to generate data for co-training. On a dynamic dexterous pick-and-sort task, fully grounded co-training raises success from 52% to 86%; averaged across configurations, world grounding improves success by 18 percentage points and behavior grounding by 10. Deployed policies behave like a mixture of real-derived and simulation-derived policies, imitating real demonstrations in covered states and relying on simulated behavior elsewhere, which we examine through latent-space analysis. Together, these results suggest complementary roles: world grounding lets policies use simulated experience beyond real-data coverage, while behavior grounding matters mainly when world grounding is imperfect. Grounded simulation remains beneficial when co-training foundation models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出real2sim2real协同训练流程，将仿真与真实系统对齐的"世界接地"和与人类运动对齐的"行为接地"作为两个独立轴进行解耦研究，验证二者对策略性能的互补作用。
AI.motivation: 仿真可扩展稀缺的真实演示数据以支持协同训练，但"世界保真度"和"与人类行为的相似度"如何影响策略性能尚不明确，二者作用常被混淆。
AI.method: 构建real2sim2real流水线，独立调节世界接地（对齐仿真与真实系统）与行为接地（对齐仿真轨迹与人类运动）两个维度以生成协同训练数据；在动态灵巧抓取分拣任务上评测，并通过潜在空间分析考察部署策略的行为模式。
AI.result: 完全接地的协同训练将成功率从52%提升至86%；跨配置平均来看，世界接地提升成功率18个百分点，行为接地提升10个百分点。部署策略表现为真实来源与仿真来源策略的混合：在已覆盖状态下模仿真实演示，其他情形依赖仿真行为。
AI.conclusion: 世界接地使策略能利用超出真实数据覆盖范围的仿真经验，行为接地主要在世界接地不完善时发挥作用，二者角色互补；协同训练基础模型时接地仿真仍具收益。

title: ECoMEM: Explicit Concept Memory for Memory-Dependent Robot Control
summary: A robot may lose sight of an object it must later retrieve, need to recall what a person demonstrated earlier, or track which steps of a task it has already completed. Current vision-language-action (VLA) policies often fail once the information needed for action disappears from the current observation, making memory critical for long-horizon robot behavior. Existing approaches typically provide longer histories or learn implicit memory from observation-action trajectories. But action supervision tells a policy how to act, not what to remember: it does not specify which past facts should persist or how they should change as new evidence arrives. We therefore separate maintaining an evidence-grounded account of the past from learning how to act on it. This insight motivates Explicit Concept Memory (ECoMEM), which represents task-relevant history with a reusable library of grounded concepts. An evidence-based Writer selects and updates these records, while a learned Reader turns them into memory tokens that directly condition the VLA. Across 16 RoboMME tasks, ECoMEM leads the evaluated robot policies on 15 tasks. On two new real-robot tasks, the same memory library either transfers directly or requires only one new concept, achieving 86.1% success versus 8.6% for a no-memory VLA. These results show that explicit concepts provide a reusable and extensible memory interface for robot control. Project website: https://ecomem.github.io/

AI.tldr: ECoMEM 将"维护任务相关历史"与"学习如何据此行动"解耦，用可复用的具身概念库显式表示记忆，在 16 个 RoboMME 任务中 15 个领先，真实机器人任务成功率达 86.1%（无记忆 VLA 仅 8.6%）。
AI.motivation: 机器人常需回忆当前观测中已消失的信息（如被遮挡的待取物体、先前的人类演示、任务已完成步骤），而现有 VLA 策略在信息离开当前观测后即失效。现有做法依赖更长观测历史或从观测-动作轨迹中隐式学习记忆，但动作监督只说明"如何行动"而非"该记住什么"，无法指定哪些过去事实应持久保留、以及随新证据如何更新。
AI.method: 将记忆维护与动作学习解耦，提出 Explicit Concept Memory（ECoMEM）：用一个可复用的、基于证据的具身概念库来表示任务相关历史；由基于证据的 Writer 负责选择与更新记录，由学习得到的 Reader 将记录转化为记忆 token，直接对 VLA 策略进行条件化。
AI.result: 在 16 个 RoboMME 任务中，ECoMEM 在被评估的机器人策略里于 15 个任务上领先；在两个新的真实机器人任务上，同一记忆库或可直接迁移，或仅需新增一个概念，成功率达 86.1%，而无记忆的 VLA 仅为 8.6%。
AI.conclusion: 显式概念为机器人控制提供了一种可复用、可扩展的记忆接口，验证了将"记忆维护"与"动作学习"分离的有效性。

title: Reactive Humanoid Multi-Contact Using Learned Stability Models
