summary: We present a planning and control approach to reactively use hand contacts to stabilize a humanoid in low stability scenarios, where only using feet contacts may result in a fall. Candidate contacts are sampled within the robot's reachable workspace, and a preview is computed by rolling out the centroidal dynamics through pre-impact, impact and post-impact phases. Sampled points are scored based on the Center of Pressure (CoP) control authority at the post-impact phase. Central to our approach is a learned model of the robot's CoP region during post-impact, which enables rapid evaluation of candidate contact points compared to traditional optimization-based methods. The presented planner has two stages: the first selects an optimal bracing region and the second computes an optimal bracing point within the region. Our simulation results demonstrate an average increase in impulse resilience of 89% over recovery without hand contacts and 17% over a naive planning strategy (closest reachable region). We validate our framework on hardware, performing push tests while standing and walking. The standing trials show an average 43% reduction in stabilization time compared to naive hand placement and the walking trials demonstrate a 18% reduction compared to baseline recovery (without hand contacts).

AI.tldr: 提出一种利用手臂接触（支撑）实现人形机器人反应式稳定控制的规划与控制方法，通过学习质心动力学后冲击阶段的CoP区域模型，快速评估候选支撑点。
AI.motivation: 在低稳定性场景中，仅依靠足部接触可能导致人形机器人跌倒，需要利用手部接触提供额外的稳定支撑。
AI.method: 在机器人可达工作空间内采样候选接触点，通过展开质心动力学（pre-impact、impact、post-impact三个阶段）计算预览；基于post-impact阶段的CoP控制能力对采样点打分。核心是学习post-impact阶段机器人CoP区域的模型，从而实现候选接触点的快速评估。规划器分两阶段：先选择最优支撑区域，再在区域内计算最优支撑点。
AI.result: 仿真结果显示，冲量恢复能力较无手部接触恢复平均提升89%，较朴素规划策略（最近可达区域）提升17%。硬件push测试中，站立试验较朴素手部放置平均减少43%的稳定时间，行走试验较无手部接触基线恢复减少18%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过手部接触的反应式规划有效提升人形机器人在低稳定性场景下的抗扰与恢复能力，并在仿真与硬件实验中验证了有效性。

title: TRACE: Privacy-Preserving Next-Best-View Selection over Distributed 3D Gaussian-Splat Maps
summary: Share the light, not the map. We study next-best-view selection for a team of robots, each of which builds its own 3D Gaussian Splatting map and keeps it private. A robot picks the view with the largest expected information gain (EIG) about the splats along its own path. This gain depends on the other maps. Their splats occlude its own and shine behind them, so the gain has to be evaluated against the pooled map. No robot has this map. We show that the coupling passes through only two ray quantities, the transmittance in front of a splat and the radiance behind it, and that both are sums over the hits of the ray. Hence, they decompose across the robots, and each robot sums them over depth bins in its own map, along the rays of a candidate view, and sends the sums with their pose derivatives. The robot planning the view turns them into its EIG and gradient on SO(3). Transmittance and Radiance Aggregates, communicated for the EIG, give the protocol its name: TRACE. No robot shares its splats, and the message size does not grow with a map. We prove that the reconstruction is exact unless a depth bin behind a splat mixes hits of two robots, and we bound the error otherwise. Over 100 next-best-view decisions in Habitat-Sim, TRACE picks a heading within 15 degrees of the centralized one in 83.3% of the cases, and its views reach 97.9% of the centralized EIG.

AI.tldr: 提出TRACE协议，用于多机器人私有3D高斯溅射（3DGS）地图下的下一最佳视角（NBV）选择，各机器人仅交换两条射线聚合量即可在不共享地图的前提下近似集中式EIG。
AI.motivation: 多机器人各自维护私有3DGS地图时，单机器人选择下一最佳视角所需的信息增益（EIG）依赖所有他人地图（他人splat对本机器人splat的遮挡与背景辐射），而没有任何机器人拥有全局融合地图，因此需要一种不共享地图、通信量不随地图规模增长的去中心化NBV选择方法。
AI.method: 证明耦合仅经过两个射线量：某splat前方的透射率（transmittance）与其后方的辐射度（radiance），二者均为射线命中项之和，因此可跨机器人分解。每个机器人沿候选视角的射线、按自身地图的深度分箱（depth bins）对这些量求和，并附带位姿导数发送；规划视角的机器人据此在SO(3)上重构EIG及其梯度。通信的正是用于EIG的透射率与辐射度聚合量（Transmittance and Radiance Aggregates），协议因此得名TRACE。各机器人不共享splat，消息大小不随地图规模增长。
AI.result: 理论上证明：除非某splat之后的深度分箱混合了两个机器人的命中项，重构是精确的；对混合情形给出了误差上界。实验上在Habitat-Sim中进行100余次NBV决策，TRACE在83.3%的情况下选出的航向与集中式方法相差在15度以内，其视角达到集中式EIG的97.9%。
AI.conclusion: TRACE以极小且与地图规模无关的通信开销，实现了多机器人私有3DGS地图下的去中心化NBV选择，精度接近集中式方案，同时保护各机器人的地图隐私。

title: Real-Time Human-Adaptive Task Allocation for Multi-Human Multi-Robot Supervision
comment: 10 pages, 7 figures. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: We propose a human-factor-aware method of allocating robot supervision tasks to multiple human operators. In scenarios where multiple operators occasionally teleoperate multiple robots to help the robots overcome difficulties, the allocation of the supervisory control tasks to humans needs to consider the real-time cognitive states of individual operators. However, most existing methods assume fixed supervisory capacity per operator and overlook fluctuations in the human factors such as workload and fatigue. As a result, workload distribution can be unbalanced where some operators become overloaded while the others remain underused. Our method dynamically regulates supervisory capacity and allocates tasks in a way that maintains balanced mental workload, prevents overload, and improves overall team performance. The allocation method uses a greedy strategy that minimizes estimated operator workloads with task prioritization. Robots are assigned to operators by reflecting their current supervisory capacity where the required effort depends on the types of tasks. In the user study, the analysis across predefined time intervals shows that the proposed method consistently achieves higher performance and lower behavioral signs of fatigue compared to a baseline method that does not consider human factors. These results highlight adaptive capacity adjustment as an effective preventive mechanism for sustaining operator performance in long-duration, high-demand settings.

AI.tldr: 提出一种考虑人因的机器人监督任务分配方法，动态调整操作员监督容量以平衡心理负荷，提升团队绩效。
AI.motivation: 现有多机器人监督任务分配方法通常假设每位操作员的监督容量固定，忽视工作负荷与疲劳等人因波动，导致部分操作员过载、部分闲置，负荷分布失衡。
AI.method: 采用人因感知的分配方法，实时根据操作员认知状态动态调整其监督容量；基于贪心策略，在任务优先级约束下最小化估计的操作员工作负荷；依据任务类型对应的所需投入，将机器人分配给具备相应当前监督容量的操作员。
AI.result: 用户研究在预设时间区间上的分析表明，与不考虑人因的基线方法相比，所提方法持续获得更高绩效和更低的疲劳行为迹象。
AI.conclusion: 自适应容量调整是维持长时间、高需求场景下操作员绩效的有效预防机制。

title: Are Frontier VLM Agents Ready to Be Robot Generalists? An Empirical Study with the Embodied Agent Arena
summary: Frontier vision-language models (VLMs) combine scene estimation, interaction grounding, and executable actions. Understanding how these abilities support complete robotic tasks is central to evaluating their readiness as robot generalists. We introduce Embodied Agent Arena to examine where local competence supports, or falls short of, complete task success across Geometry, Spatial Reasoning, Affordance, Task Planning, and Manipulation. The arena contains 1,000 cases drawn from 32 established sources and GeoProbe, our new benchmark for geometric estimation on Blender renders and real-scene images. A minimal harness preserves source observations and operations while separating metric precision, functional grounding, and native goal completion. We evaluate seven VLMs, analyze Astra's task-specific advantages, and compare richer-observation execution protocols and multi-round review. Across the arena, Astra's advantage is strongest in precise estimation and usable-contact localization; completing coordinated, goal-directed actions remains the key gap to robot generalism.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Embodied Agent Arena，用于系统评估视觉语言模型（VLM）在完整机器人任务中的表现，涵盖几何、空间推理、可供性、任务规划与操作五个维度。该平台包含 1000 个案例，来自 32 个既有数据源及新基准 GeoProbe。通过对七种 VLM 的评测，发现模型在精确估计和可用接触点定位上表现较强，但在完成协调的目标导向动作方面仍存在明显差距。
AI.motivation: 前沿 VLM 已整合场景估计、交互接地与可执行动作能力，但学界尚不清楚这些局部能力能否支撑完整的机器人任务。为评估 VLM 作为机器人通用智能体的成熟度，需要构建统一的评测平台，定位局部能力与完整任务成功之间的差距所在。
AI.method: 作者构建了 Embodied Agent Arena 评测平台，涵盖几何、空间推理、可供性、任务规划与操作五个能力维度，包含 1000 个案例，来源于 32 个既有数据源以及新提出的几何估计基准 GeoProbe（包含 Blender 渲染图与真实场景图像）。平台采用最小化测试框架，在保留原始观测与操作的同时，将度量精度、功能接地与原生目标完成度进行分离评估。基于此对七种 VLM 进行评测，并分析 Astra 的任务特定优势，同时比较更丰富观测的执行协议与多轮复核机制。
AI.result: 在整体评测中，Astra 的优势主要体现在精确估计与可用接触点定位上；而在完成协调的、目标导向的动作方面，各模型均表现不足，这成为实现机器人通用智能的关键瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: VLM 在局部感知与接地能力上已具备一定可用性，但完整的机器人任务执行仍需突破协调动作生成这一核心短板。Embodied Agent Arena 为衡量 VLM 的机器人通用性提供了结构化评测框架，并揭示了从局部能力到完整任务成功之间的关键差距。

title: TOAST: Stochastic Robot Action Tokenization for Autoregressive Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Autoregressive Vision-Language-Action models often represent continuous robot actions as discrete token sequences, enabling action prediction with standard next-token objectives. FAST has substantially improved this representation by compactly encoding action containing diverse temporal frequencies into relatively few tokens. However, while such compression reduces the number of action tokens required for autoregressive prediction, it does not necessarily improve the efficiency of policy learning from limited demonstrations. In particular, FAST typically assigns a single deterministic tokenization to each quantized action sequence, although multiple token sequences can represent and decode to the same robot motion. We investigate whether exploiting this representational redundancy can improve policy learning. In this paper, we propose TOkenization of Action sequences with STochastic sampling (TOAST), a stochastic action tokenization method that samples alternative tokenizations of the same quantized action sequence during policy training. This diversifies the discrete supervision while preserving the underlying robot action and requires no additional demonstrations. Experiments on LIBERO show that TOAST consistently improves over its deterministic counterpart, with the improvement increasing as training data decreases, achieving a 6.8 point gain in success rate when only 1/16 of training data is available. Across four real-robot manipulation tasks, TOAST further improves mean success rate by 15.8 points over the deterministic counterpart. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of stochastic action tokenization for autoregressive robot policy learning, particularly when training data are limited.

AI.tldr: 提出TOAST，一种随机动作分词方法，通过采样同一量化动作序列的多种分词方式实现监督多样化，在数据受限场景显著提升策略学习效果。
AI.motivation: 自回归VLA模型将连续机器人动作表示为离散token序列。FAST虽通过紧凑编码减少动作token数量，但压缩未必提升有限示范下的策略学习效率。FAST对每个量化动作序列仅分配单一确定性分词，而同一机器人运动可对应多种可解码一致的分词序列，作者欲探究利用这种表征冗余能否改进策略学习。
AI.method: 提出TOAST（TOkenization of Action sequences with STochastic sampling）：一种随机动作分词方法，在策略训练过程中对同一量化动作序列采样替代分词方案，多样化离散监督信号，同时保持底层机器人动作不变，且无需额外示范数据。
AI.result: 在LIBERO上，TOAST稳定优于确定性基线，且数据越少提升越明显，仅用1/16训练数据时成功率提升6.8个百分点；在四个真实机器人操作任务上，平均成功率较确定性基线进一步提升15.8个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 随机动作分词能有效提升自回归机器人策略学习，尤其在训练数据有限时优势突出，为利用分词表征冗余提供了可行方向。

title: eRLT: Efficient VLA Reinforcement Learning via Action-Relevant Token Routing
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models provide strong behavioral priors for robotic manipulation, yet efficiently adapting them to downstream tasks remains challenging. Recent work addresses this challenge by adapting frozen VLAs through online reinforcement learning (RL), whose sample efficiency depends on the quality of the state representation used by the actor and critic. Existing methods construct such representations either with VLA-independent visual encoders or through fixed compression of internal VLA representations. Neither design explicitly extracts the task-specific action-relevant VLA features most useful for downstream action refinement and action-value estimation, therefore limiting sample efficiency. To address this limitation, we introduce eRLT, which constructs an effective state representation by routing task-specific action-relevant information across both tokens and layers of the frozen VLA. Specifically, learned routing tokens dynamically aggregate visual-language features at multiple depths, while a lightweight layer router combines these summaries into a fixed-dimensional RL token. The routing module is initialized using expert demonstrations to capture features predictive of expert actions and then refined using critic feedback from online interactions for action-value estimation. Across seven LIBERO and RoboTwin tasks, eRLT improves mean normalized learning-curve AUC by up to 23.7% over representative baselines. Real-robot experiments on USB connector insertion and motherboard ribbon-cable insertion further show AUC improvements of 108.9% and 46.7%, respectively, over the strongest baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出 eRLT，通过在冻结 VLA 的 token 与层间路由任务相关的动作信息来构建高效状态表示，显著提升在线 RL 微调的样本效率。
AI.motivation: 利用在线强化学习适配冻结 VLA 是高效方案，但其样本效率取决于 actor 与 critic 所用状态表示的质量。现有方法要么使用与 VLA 无关的视觉编码器，要么对 VLA 内部表示做固定压缩，均未显式提取对下游动作精炼和动作价值估计最有用的任务相关动作特征。
AI.method: eRLT 跨冻结 VLA 的 token 与层构建状态表示：可学习的路由 token 动态聚合多个深度的视觉-语言特征，轻量层路由器将其组合为固定维度的 RL token。路由模块先用专家演示初始化以捕获可预测专家动作的特征，再利用在线交互的 critic 反馈进行精炼以服务于动作价值估计。
AI.result: 在七个 LIBERO 与 RoboTwin 任务上，eRLT 相比代表性基线将平均归一化学习曲线 AUC 最高提升 23.7%。真实机器人 USB 连接器插入与主板排线插入实验中，AUC 分别较最强基线提升 108.9% 和 46.7%。
AI.conclusion: 通过任务相关动作信息的路由式聚合构建 VLA 状态表示，并联合演示初始化与 critic 反馈精炼，可在仿真与真实任务中大幅提升冻结 VLA 在线 RL 适配的样本效率。

title: Screw Attention: Rigid-Body Algebra Inside a Transformer
summary: Learned manipulation policies rediscover from data the spatial relations that rigid-body mechanics supplies in closed form. This costs data, and it leaves the policies fragile to geometric changes in the scene. We present Screw Attention, a transformer layer in which the relation between two bodies is a spatial transform rather than a graph edge. Every token is a body with a pose. Each pair of tokens carries the relative pose and, for robot joints, the joint screw. Messages are transported along this relation into the receiver's frame, while the attention scores see only frame-invariant quantities. By construction, the messages are equivariant to an independent change of frame at every token, and a single layer can express the velocity recursion of rigid-body mechanics. On simulated manipulation tasks, Screw Attention matches or outperforms controls of the same size, including graph, transformer and flat networks on LIBERO-Spatial. With 16,162 parameters it reaches 97.3% on LIBERO-Spatial from object poses (without images or language), above a flat network with 27x more parameters. Under a change of per-link frame convention its success is unchanged, while every other learned network falls below 3%. Placed on an analytic controller as a gated residual, it raises insertion success by 17.3 points. It is unaffected by pose noise up to 10,mm and by joint offsets within the factory calibration of a Franka arm. These results suggest a criterion: geometry is decisive when the task requires relations between frames that no other part of the system supplies. Code and trained policies will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出Screw Attention：一种将刚体间关系表示为空间变换（而非图边）的Transformer层，token为带位姿的刚体，消息沿相对位姿/关节螺旋变换到接收者坐标系，注意力分数仅用坐标系不变（frame-invariant）量。构造上对每个token的独立坐标系变换具有等变性，单层即可表达刚体力学速度递推。
AI.motivation: 学习到的操作策略需从数据中重新发现刚体力学本可闭式给出的空间关系，代价是数据量高，且对场景几何变化脆弱。作者认为应把几何先验直接编码进架构。
AI.method: Screw Attention层：每token为一个刚体及其位姿；每对token携带相对位姿，机器人关节额外携带关节螺旋（joint screw）；消息沿该关系被输运到接收者坐标系，注意力分数只看坐标系不变量。
AI.result: 在仿真操作任务上匹配或超过同规模对照（图网络、Transformer、扁平网络）。在LIBERO-Spatial上以16,162参数达97.3%（仅用物体位姿，不用图像与语言），优于参数多27倍的扁平网络；改变逐连杆坐标系约定时成功率不变，而其他学习网络均低于3%；作为门控残差置于解析控制器上，插入成功率提升17.3个百分点；在10mm以内位姿噪声及Franka机械臂出厂标定范围内的关节偏置下不受影响。
AI.conclusion: 提出一条判据：当任务需要的坐标系间关系是系统其他部分无法提供时，几何是决定性的。代码与训练好的策略将公开。

title: ShowerFlex: Achieving Pseudo-Static Balancing in a Continuum Shower Hose
comment: 10 pages, 9 figures. Accepted to ASME IDETC/CIE 2026, Mechanisms and Robotics Conference
summary: With the global population rapidly aging, maintaining independence in Activities of Daily Living (ADLs), particularly bathing or showering, has become a critical challenge. Older adults who sit while showering currently have limited options, often relying on rigid overhead showerheads or flexible hand-held hoses that require continuous gripping and precarious user maneuvers, increasing the risk of falls. To address this need, this paper introduces a highly articulated, pseudo-static balanced continuum mechanism designed specifically for accessible bathing assistance. The proposed mechanism features a modular continuum architecture composed of friction-locked ball-and-socket joints (loc-line), seamlessly integrated with a retractable spring-loaded reel for effective gravity compensation. This hybrid design achieves an intuitive "Push-and-Stay" interaction logic, maintaining an approximate static equilibrium with ergonomically low actuation force, without any external electronic power, while significantly minimizing the force needed for repositioning. Theoretically, we established a recursive forward kinematics framework to construct the geometric model of the structure, coupled with a comprehensive static equilibrium analysis to evaluate the system's holding capacity across its 51-DOF structure. Numerical simulations utilizing Monte Carlo methods validate the system's morphological adaptability and stability at various extreme positions within a standard bath space. Physical experiments further validate the prototype's real-world performance, confirming its intrinsic static stability against gravity and ensuring that the actuation force remains well within the ergonomic capabilities of older adults. Ultimately, this research provides a low-cost, intrinsically safe showerhead design that reduces physical strain, restoring dignity and autonomy in personal hygiene.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种用于辅助洗浴的高关节度准静态平衡连续体机构，采用摩擦锁定球窝关节与弹簧卷收器结合的模块化设计，实现无需外部动力的"推即停"交互，降低老年人洗浴时的跌倒风险。
AI.motivation: 全球人口老龄化背景下，老年人维持日常生活活动（尤其是洗浴）的独立性成为关键挑战。现有坐姿洗浴方案依赖刚性顶置花洒或需持续握持的手持软管，用户操作不便且增加跌倒风险，亟需一种低成本、易操作的辅助洗浴装置。
AI.method: 提出模块化连续体架构，由摩擦锁定球窝关节（loc-line）与可伸缩弹簧卷收器集成实现重力补偿，形成"推即停"交互逻辑；建立递归正运动学框架构建几何模型，并进行涵盖51自由度结构的静态平衡分析；采用蒙特卡洛数值仿真评估其在标准浴室空间内的形态适应性与稳定性，并通过物理实验验证原型性能。
AI.result: 数值仿真验证了系统在标准浴室空间内多种极限位姿下的形态适应性与稳定性；物理实验证实原型具备抗重力的固有静态稳定性，且操作力处于老年人体能可承受的人机工程学范围内。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了一种低成本、本质安全的淋浴头设计，可减少身体负担，帮助老年人在个人卫生护理中恢复尊严与自主性。

title: Divide-and-Remember: Recursive Action-Relevant Memory for Long-Horizon VLA Policies
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models struggle on history-dependent manipulation tasks, where the current observation alone does not determine the action, and the policy needs a memory of the history. Existing memory methods decide what to remember by design, for example, keeping frames with large pixel changes, and show inconsistent gains across tasks. We view what to remember as an optimisation problem. From the POMDP formulation of imitation learning, we show that the optimal memory maximises the conditional mutual information $I(a_t; m_t \mid o_t)$ between the action and the memory given the current observation. Intuitively, this means preserving the action-relevant information in the history that is not already contained in the current observation. Based on our analysis, we propose Divide-and-Remember (D&R), a recursive memory method that learns a memory function $m_t = M(h_t)$ and scales to long contexts while staying compute-light. It involves two strategies: (1) the selection over the full history is divided recursively into subproblems of top-$K$ selection over $2K$ tokens, so that fixed-size, lightweight selectors learned end-to-end support an unbounded history; (2) all recursion blocks share one selector, which captures the selection rule common to every block and keeps the method efficient. On RoboMME, a benchmark of 16 long-horizon manipulation tasks that require remembering when, where, what, and how to act, D&R achieves a state-of-the-art average success rate with consistent gains across all four suites under a budget of only 64 tokens; real-robot experiments show the same gain. Code, checkpoints and more results are at https://dnr-memory.github.io/

AI.tldr: 提出Divide-and-Remember（D&R）记忆方法，将"记住什么"建模为优化问题，通过递归式top-K选择学习记忆函数，仅用64个token即在长程操作任务上取得SOTA成功率。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在依赖历史的任务上表现不佳——仅凭当前观测无法确定动作，策略需要历史记忆。现有记忆方法（如保留像素变化大的帧）由人工设计决定记忆内容，在不同任务上增益不一致。
AI.method: 从模仿学习的POMDP形式化出发，证明最优记忆应最大化动作与记忆在当前观测条件下的互信息 I(a_t; m_t | o_t)，即保留历史中与动作相关、且当前观测尚未包含的信息。基于此提出D&R递归记忆方法，学习记忆函数 m_t = M(h_t)，包含两个策略：(1) 将全历史的top-K选择递归分解为对2K个token的top-K子问题，使固定尺寸的轻量选择器可端到端训练并支持无界历史；(2) 所有递归块共享同一选择器，捕获各块共有的选择规则以保持高效。
AI.result: 在RoboMME基准（16个需记忆"何时、何地、做什么、如何做"的长程操作任务）上，D&R在仅64个token预算下于全部四个套件上均取得SOTA平均成功率并保持一致性增益；真实机器人实验呈现相同增益。
AI.conclusion: 将记忆内容的选择视为优化问题并最大化条件互信息，能有效指导VLA模型的历史记忆设计；递归分解与选择器共享使方法兼具长上下文可扩展性与计算轻量性，在仿真与真机任务上均验证了其有效性。

title: Online Planning for Sparse Ground Target Search from a High-Altitude UAV under Partial Observability
summary:
Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) searching for ground targets from a high altitude face a unique challenge, particularly when the target is already within the field of view but effectively unobservable because of its small apparent scale. Standard object detectors often underperform in such scenarios because of resolution downscaling and limited context. In contrast, active object search frameworks address this challenge by directing the agent to a suitable pose to gather richer visual information. However, flight regulations in urban airspace often restrict such physical movements for UAVs. As an alternative active sensing approach, the UAV can leverage the pan-tilt-zoom (PTZ) mechanism of the onboard camera to dynamically adjust its field of view and sequentially gather enhanced visual information from specific regions of interest. Once the candidate locations of the target are identified, it can deploy more expensive object detection schemes, such as an ensemble of multiple models, to get better reasoning at a fixed scale. In this work, we formulate the sequential exploration with PTZ operation as a partially observable Markov decision process (POMDP), in which the agent maintains a belief state over the target's true location. To solve the POMDP, we deploy partially observable Monte Carlo planning (POMCP), where we condition the sensing reliability on target object scale and deploy selective ensemble detection as an additional reasoning step.
  We validate our methodology with experiments in a photorealistic simulator under different environmental conditions and vehicle states, showing detection of ground targets at variable scales with significantly fewer steps and minimal dependence on sensor resolution compared to baseline methods.

AI.tldr: 本文将无人机利用PTZ相机的顺序搜索建模为POMDP，用POMCP求解，并结合基于目标尺度的感知可靠性与选择性集成检测，在仿真中实现更少步数、低分辨率依赖的地面目标检测。
AI.motivation: 高空无人机搜索地面目标时，目标虽在视场内但表观尺度极小，难以被观测；分辨率下采样与上下文受限导致常规检测器性能不足。主动目标搜索虽可引导无人机改变位姿获取更多信息，但城市空域飞行法规常限制此类物理机动，因此需要一种替代的主动感知手段。
AI.method: 将基于PTZ（平移-倾斜-变焦）相机的顺序探索形式化为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP），智能体维护对目标真实位置的信念状态；采用部分可观测蒙特卡洛规划（POMCP）求解，并将感知可靠性条件化于目标物体尺度，同时引入选择性集成检测作为额外推理步骤。
AI.result: 在照片级真实感仿真器中进行不同环境条件与载具状态下的实验，相比基线方法，能以显著更少的步数检测到不同尺度的地面目标，且对传感器分辨率的依赖极小。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，利用机载相机PTZ机构进行主动感知并配合POMCP规划与选择性集成检测，是规避物理机动限制、提升高空小尺度地面目标检测效率的有效方案。

title: OrbitTAMP: Grounding Language Models for Task and Motion Planning in Spacecraft Rendezvous
summary: Spacecraft rendezvous and proximity operations (RPO) are currently planned through an expertise-intensive process in which engineers translate high-level operational intent into safe, dynamically feasible trajectories, creating a bottleneck to scalable operations. Large language model (LLM)-based agents could offer an intuitive interface for this process, although their outputs are not inherently grounded in orbital dynamics, operational constraints, or the structure of admissible spacecraft maneuvers. To exploit their semantic reasoning while ensuring the generated plan's physical validity, this paper presents a hierarchical framework for spacecraft task-and-motion planning (TAMP) that grounds LLM reasoning in a graph of reusable behaviors and domain-specific planning modules. Within this framework, a pretrained LLM maps a natural-language command to a partial mission specification. The associated planners then resolve unspecified decisions within the admissible operational space. Finally, trajectory optimization converts the completed mission specification into a dynamically feasible trajectory. Numerical experiments demonstrate that this architecture substantially improves intent recovery over direct LLM generation, achieving 98% exact recovery of partial mission specifications across all evaluated splits when backed by frontier LLMs. Additional test-time-compute experiments show that, for a compact 9B model, verifier-guided revision increases exact recovery from 75% to 88%, while broader behavior-plan search independently improves selection among admissible trajectory realizations. Overall, these results establish a scalable and auditable foundation for language-driven agentic planning of spacecraft RPO.

AI.tldr: 提出一种分层TAMP框架，将LLM语义推理与可复用行为图及领域规划模块结合，实现航天器RPO任务的可行轨迹生成。
AI.motivation: 航天器交会与近距离操作（RPO）的规划目前依赖专家密集型流程，工程师需将高层操作意图转化为安全且动力学可行的轨迹，这成为可扩展操作的瓶颈。基于LLM的智能体可提供直观交互接口，但其输出本身并不根植于轨道动力学、操作约束或合法机动结构。
AI.method: 框架采用分层任务与运动规划（TAMP）结构：预训练LLM将自然语言指令映射为部分任务规格；随后由规划器在允许操作空间内补全未指定决策；最后通过轨迹优化将完整任务规格转化为动力学可行轨迹。核心在于以可复用行为图和领域专用规划模块对LLM推理进行"接地"（grounding）。
AI.result: 数值实验表明该架构显著优于直接LLM生成：在先进LLM支持下，所有评估划分上部分任务规格的精确恢复率达98%。测试时计算实验显示，对9B紧凑模型，验证器引导的修订将精确恢复率从75%提升至88%；更广泛的行为-规划搜索则独立改善了可行轨迹实现方案的选择。
AI.conclusion: 结果确立了面向航天器RPO的语言驱动机器人式规划的可扩展且可审计的基础。

title: WBAG: A Whole-Body and Attached-Geometry Safety Framework for Vision-Language-Action Manipulation
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies have demonstrated impressive capabilities in generalizable robotic manipulation, but their deployment in the real world remains challenging due to potential collisions involving different parts of the robot, manipulated objects, and the surrounding environment. Existing inference-time VLA safety frameworks typically rely on simplified end-effector-centered representations that do not explicitly model the full articulated robot and attached-object geometry. In this paper, we present WBAG, a safety framework that models the robot's whole-body and grasp-dependent attached geometry. WBAG constructs a grasp-conditioned safe set that adapts the protected geometry as objects are grasped, then converts this evolving geometry into differentiable CBF constraints that minimally modify the VLA's native six-dimensional operational-space action for collision avoidance across robot, scene, and attached geometry. On the SafeLIBERO benchmark, a variant of LIBERO augmented with obstacles for safety evaluation, WBAG achieves the best overall safety and safe task success among the evaluated methods under a scene-level safety evaluator that monitors all eligible non-task objects, reaching 97.38\% aggregate Scene Safety and 59.38\% Safe Success.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WBAG，一种建模机器人全身与抓取相关附加几何的安全框架，通过抓取条件下的安全集与可微CBF约束最小化修改VLA的6D操作空间动作；在SafeLIBERO上达到97.38%场景安全与59.38%安全成功率。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略在通用机器人操作上表现优异，但真实部署仍面临机器人自身部位、被操作物体与周围环境之间的碰撞风险；现有推理时VLA安全框架多依赖简化的末端执行器中心表示，未显式建模完整的关节式机器人与附着物体几何。
AI.method: WBAG构建抓取条件化的安全集（grasp-conditioned safe set），在物体被抓取时自适应调整受保护几何，并把这一随抓取演化的几何转化为可微控制障碍函数（CBF）约束，用以最小程度修改VLA原生的六维操作空间动作，实现机器人、场景与附着几何间的碰撞规避。
AI.result: 在SafeLIBERO（LIBERO的障碍物增强变体，用于安全评估）上，在监控所有非任务物体的场景级安全评估器下，WBAG在各对比方法中取得最佳综合安全性与安全任务成功率：场景安全（Scene Safety）达97.38%，安全成功率（Safe Success）达59.38%。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模全身与抓取相关的完整几何，并以可微CBF约束在推理时微调VLA动作，可有效提升VLA策略在含障碍环境中的部署安全性，同时保持较好的任务成功率。

title: MASkillBlender: Decentralized Whole-Body Coordination for Multi-Humanoid Loco-Manipulation via Skill Blending
summary: Coordinated multi-humanoid loco-manipulation is promising yet challenging due to high-dimensional whole-body control, decentralized decision making, and scalability. While recent reinforcement learning methods have improved single-humanoid whole-body control, extending them to the multi-humanoid setting remains nontrivial and often requires substantial reward engineering or task-specific design. We propose MASkillBlender, a general multi-agent reinforcement learning framework to achieve decentralized multi-humanoid whole-body coordination. By learning a shared decentralized high-level policy over reusable pre-trained single-humanoid skills, MASkillBlender enables coordinated behaviors using only task-level rewards, without requiring task-specific motion references. To improve learning efficiency, we further introduce a permutation-based data augmentation strategy for homogeneous multi-humanoid systems, and theoretically show that the permuted samples preserve the policy-gradient direction of the original samples under the homogeneous Markov game formulation. We evaluate MASkillBlender on multiple multi-humanoid coordination tasks across two humanoid embodiments. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed framework consistently achieves strong task performance and enables coordinated behaviors across different tasks and humanoid embodiments.

AI.tldr: 提出MASkillBlender，一种通用的去中心化多智能体强化学习框架，通过复用单机器人预训练技能与共享高层策略，实现多类人机器人全身协调，无需任务特定运动参考。
AI.motivation: 多类人机器人协同的全身控制面临高维控制、去中心化决策与可扩展性难题；已有强化学习多聚焦单机器人，扩展到多机器人往往依赖大量奖励工程或任务特定设计，缺乏通用性。
AI.method: 在可复用的单类人机器人预训练技能之上学习共享的去中心化高层策略，仅用任务级奖励驱动协同；为同构多机器人系统引入基于置换的数据增强，并在同构马尔可夫博弈框架下从理论上证明置换样本保持原样本的策略梯度方向。
AI.result: 在两种类人机器人本体、多个多机器人协同任务上进行评估，框架持续取得较强任务表现，并能跨任务与跨本体实现协调行为。
AI.conclusion: MASkillBlender 提供了一种通用、可扩展的去中心化多类人机器人全身协调方案，结合技能复用与置换数据增强，降低了对奖励工程和任务特定运动参考的依赖。

title: quARtet Marker: A 3D-Printable Multi-Tag Fiducial for Robust Near-Frontal Pose Estimation
summary: Robotic manipulation of labware is difficult when transparent or reflective objects must be identified and localized. Coded planar fiducials are a practical retrofit: easy to print, they leave the marked face flat and graspable. Yet a single planar tag is least reliable in near-frontal views, where perspective cues fade. Non-planar geometries restore those cues but intrude on the flat face that a parallel-jaw gripper must contact. Our idea is to tilt multiple tags within one compact footprint, so that each tag is seen at a non-frontal angle even when the marker faces the camera. We propose the quARtet marker, a 3D-printable fiducial embodying this idea: all detected corners of its four tilted AprilTags enter one Perspective-n-Point solve, and a shared configuration defines the fabricated geometry and the detector model. Because tilting consumes flat area, its three layouts trade pose-estimation consistency against graspability. In robot-referenced, same-setup fixed-camera experiments, all three layouts reduced the mean frontal orientation error from 2.18 degree for a single planar tag to 0.24-0.47 degree and the root-mean-square position error from 1.50 to 0.17-0.20 mm. A robot-mounted-camera pose-hold test confirmed this separation under closed-loop visual feedback. In swing-down trials under identical conditions, the two layouts with flat contact strips retained the object with about 2 mm of in-grasp slip, whereas the layout without flat strips slipped by roughly 100 mm. For the tested conditions, the results support a rule: the layout without flat strips when pose-estimation consistency dominates, a layout with flat strips when the marked face must remain graspable.

AI.tldr: 提出 quARtet——一种由四个倾斜 AprilTag 组成、可 3D 打印的立体基准标记；在紧凑占位内使各标签始终以非正视角度被观测，从而提升位姿估计一致性，但需在精度与可抓取性之间折中。
AI.motivation: 透明或反光实验器皿难以被识别与定位；平面编码基准标记虽易打印、保持标记面平整可抓，但单一平面标签在近正视视角下透视线索消失，位姿估计最不可靠。非平面几何可恢复透视线索，却会占用平行夹爪需接触的平整面。
AI.method: 核心思路是在一个紧凑占位内倾斜布置多个标签，使标记正对相机时每个标签仍处于非正视角度。具体提出 quARtet：四个倾斜 AprilTag 的全部检测角点输入同一次 PnP 求解，并由共享配置统一定义加工几何与检测器模型；因倾斜占用平整面积，设计三种布局以在位姿估计一致性与可抓取性之间权衡。
AI.result: 在机器人坐标系下的同装置固定相机实验中，三种布局将平均正视姿态误差由单一平面标签的 2.18° 降至 0.24–0.47°，位置 RMSE 由 1.50 mm 降至 0.17–0.20 mm；机载相机位姿保持测试在闭环视觉反馈下验证了该差异。相同条件下的下摆抓取试验中，两种带平整接触条的布局抓持滑移约 2 mm，而无平整条布局滑移约 100 mm。
AI.conclusion: 在该实验条件下，结果支持一条选型规则：当位姿估计一致性优先时选用无平整条布局；当标记面必须保持可抓取时选用带平整条布局。quARtet 为透明/反光实验器皿的机器人操作提供了实用、可打印且兼顾抓取的重定位方案。

title: Extreme Length Generalization in a Compact Recurrent Architecture for One-Shot Exploration
summary: Autonomous robots on one-shot missions run over horizons far longer than the trajectories seen during training, under a fixed onboard compute budget. We present FRANK, a 507K-parameter recurrent architecture that combines tau-gated recurrent modules, content-addressable memory, and a feedforward reflex pathway. We evaluate it against recurrent, state-space, and reduced modular baselines at matched parameter count on four algorithmic sequence tasks, trained at length 5-20 and evaluated out to two million tokens. At 100,000x the maximum training length, 6 of 10 FRANK seeds retain exactly 100.0% accuracy, while none of the 50 baseline configurations does, five architectures at ten seeds each with none left incomplete (Fisher exact, two-sided p = 4.2E-6. Targeted lesions across the four tasks yield four distinct component-reliance profiles, consistent with task-dependent allocation across the recurrent, memory, and reflex pathways. Separately, a FRANK policy trained in simulation drives a physical ground vehicle to commanded waypoints through obstacles without teleoperation.

AI.tldr: FRANK是一种507K参数的循环架构，结合tau门控循环模块、内容可寻址记忆和前馈反射通路，在参数匹配条件下实现了远超训练长度的长时程序列保持能力，并可迁移到真实地面车辆导航。
AI.motivation: 自主机器人在一次性任务中需要在远超训练轨迹时长的时域上运行，且机载算力预算固定。现有循环、状态空间及模块化架构在极长时程外推下难以维持性能，因此需要一种在参数受限条件下仍能保持长时程稳定性的架构。
AI.method: 提出FRANK架构，包含三部分：tau门控循环模块、内容可寻址记忆以及前馈反射通路，总参数量507K。在四个算法序列任务上，与循环、状态空间和精简模块化基线在参数数量匹配条件下对比，训练长度为5-20，评估外推至两百万tokens。此外进行跨四任务的定向消融（lesion）分析，并在仿真中训练策略后部署到物理地面车辆执行避障航点跟踪。
AI.result: 在最大训练长度10万倍的外推条件下，10个FRANK种子中有6个保持精确100.0%准确率，而50个基线配置无一达到该水平（5种架构×10种子，Fisher精确检验双侧p=4.2E-6）。定向消融在四个任务上呈现四种不同的组件依赖模式，说明任务依赖性地在循环、记忆与反射通路之间分配功能。仿真训练的FRANK策略可驱动物理地面车辆在无遥操作条件下穿越障碍到达指定航点。
AI.conclusion: FRANK以极小参数量在极长时程外推任务上显著优于多种基线，其性能来自循环、记忆与反射通路的任务依赖组合，并成功实现从仿真到物理车辆的真实世界迁移。

title: Experience-Based Feasibility-Aware Generative Adversarial Imitation from Observation under Embodiment Mismatch
summary: With the increasing use of robot-free demonstration interfaces that provide state trajectories without action labels, imitation from observation has become a promising approach for learning robot behaviors from human demonstrations. However, due to differences in embodiment and dynamics between humans and robots, demonstrated human motions may not be feasible for the robot, potentially degrading policy performance. In this study, we propose Experience-Based Feasibility-Aware Generative Adversarial Imitation from Observation (EF-GAIfO), which estimates the feasibility of state-only demonstrations from the robot's own experience rather than relying on explicit dynamics models or large prior exploration datasets. A key feature of EF-GAIfO is that the notion of feasibility evolves with policy learning: as the policy improves and the robot experiences a broader range of state transitions, the feasible region is progressively expanded, allowing additional demonstrations to be incorporated into learning. This enables feasibility-aware imitation that adapts to the current stage of policy learning, rather than relying on a pre-designed feasibility criterion. We validate the effectiveness of EF-GAIfO on a locomotion task in simulation and on a real quadruped robot performing a object-reaching-and-grasping task.

AI.tldr: 提出EF-GAIfO方法，从机器人自身经验估计无动作标签演示的可行性，实现可行性感知的模仿学习，并在仿真与真实四足机器人任务上验证有效。
AI.motivation: 无机器人演示接口只提供状态轨迹而无动作标签，使Observation Imitation成为学习机器人行为的有前景方法。但人与机器人在具身结构与动力学上存在差异，人类运动可能对机器人不可行，从而降低策略性能。现有方法依赖显式动力学模型或大规模先验探索数据集，成本高且缺乏适应性。
AI.method: 提出Experience-Based Feasibility-Aware Generative Adversarial Imitation from Observation (EF-GAIfO)。核心是从机器人自身经验估计仅状态演示的可行性，不依赖显式动力学模型或大规模先验探索数据。可行性概念随策略学习动态演化：策略提升、机器人经历更广状态转移后，可行域逐步扩大，更多演示被纳入学习，从而实现随学习阶段自适应调整的可行性感知模仿，而非依赖预设的可行性判据。
AI.result: 在仿真环境中的locomotion任务上验证了EF-GAIfO的有效性，并在真实四足机器人执行reach-and-grasp任务上进行了验证。
AI.conclusion: EF-GAIfO通过从机器人自身经验中估计可行性并随策略学习动态扩展可行域，缓解了人机动力学差异导致的演示不可行问题，为无动作标签演示的模仿学习提供了有效的可行性感知方案。

title: EIDA: Execution-Interface Dynamics Adaptation for Real-to-Sim-to-Real Robot Navigation
summary: Simulation-to-robot transfer can fail when velocity commands produce motion and feedback that differ from those modeled during policy training. We present execution-interface dynamics adaptation (EIDA), which fits these responses from target-platform execution data without reconstructing actuator dynamics. A model of body-frame pose increments updates simulator geometry, while a separate model predicts the velocity feedback observed by the policy; a short history of velocity feedback is included in the policy input. The fitted models are used within a lightweight GPU-parallel simulator. On the full Jackal and Go2 validation sets, the fitted models reduced position and yaw prediction errors relative to the simulator's predefined motion model. Across 100 benchmark navigation environments evaluated in a separate physics-based simulator, EIDA achieved the highest success rate and navigation score among the compared learned policies, both with and without global guidance. Feedback ablations further supported the need to match policy-facing velocity estimates. On a physical Unitree Go2, EIDA reached the goal without collision in all 20 static-scene trials, compared with 4 of 20 for the baseline. These results show that execution-interface adaptation can improve navigation transfer without detailed actuator simulation.

AI.tldr: 提出执行接口动力学自适应（EIDA），通过目标平台执行数据拟合体坐标系位姿增量和速度反馈模型，在轻量GPU并行仿真器中使用，提升仿真到真机的导航迁移性能。
AI.motivation: 仿真到机器人迁移中，速度指令产生的运动与反馈常与策略训练时建模的不一致，而重建精确执行器动力学困难，导致迁移失败。
AI.method: EIDA不需重建执行器动力学，而是从目标平台执行数据拟合两类响应：一个体坐标系位姿增量模型用于更新仿真器几何，另一个模型预测策略观测到的速度反馈；并将速度反馈的短历史纳入策略输入。拟合模型嵌入轻量GPU并行仿真器中使用。
AI.result: 在Jackal与Go2完整验证集上，拟合模型相较仿真器预定义运动模型降低了位置与偏航预测误差；在100个基准导航环境中（独立物理仿真器评估），EIDA在有无全局引导下均取得最高成功率和导航分数；反馈消融实验验证了匹配策略侧速度估计的必要性；在实体Unitree Go2上，20次静态场景试验均无碰撞到达目标，基线仅4/20。
AI.conclusion: 执行接口自适应可在无需精细执行器仿真的情况下改善导航迁移性能。

title: Recova: Agent-Guided Failure Recovery for Autonomous Robotic Manipulation
summary: Manipulation failures can leave scenes in states from which a task policy cannot recover. Learning corrective behaviors requires scalable failure exploration and physical grounding. We present Recova, an agent-guided framework that jointly develops task execution and recovery in a reconstructed digital twin, then verifies and refines both through real-world experience. In the twin, the agent diagnoses failures, tests corrective programs, and collects successful task and recovery rollouts for separate policies. During deployment, it monitors progress, invokes a learned or programmatic recovery, verifies scene restoration, and resumes execution. When no suitable recovery is available, a human demonstration resolves the failure and enters the learning loop, allowing the system to expand its recovery capabilities. Physical rollouts and human demonstrations are routed to the corresponding policy for DAgger training. Across six LIBERO-Pro settings and four MolmoSpaces categories, Recova achieves 78.8% and 64.9% mean success, compared with 71.7% and 38.0% for the strongest baselines. With parallel collection across four real-robot workstations, DAgger fine-tuning raises mean success from 23.8% to 77.5%, and recovery skills further raise it to 87.5%. Over four collection rounds on one task, observed human intervention falls from 87.5% to 0%. Together, these results show how agent-guided recovery turns failures into reusable capabilities, improving robustness while progressively reducing human intervention. Project page: https://www.liuisabella.com/Recova

AI.tldr: Recova提出一种智能体引导的任务执行与恢复联合学习框架,先在数字孪生中进行失败诊断与纠正行为探索,再通过真实世界经验验证与迭代,将失败转化为可复用的恢复技能,显著提升操作成功率并逐步消除人工干预。
AI.motivation: 操作失败会使场景进入任务策略无法恢复的状态,而学习纠正行为需要可扩展的失败探索与物理接地。现有方法难以同时满足失败探索的规模化和真实物理验证需求,因此需要一种既能大规模探索失败恢复、又能与真实部署闭环迭代的框架。
AI.method: 在重建的数字孪生中,智能体诊断失败、测试纠正程序,并分别采集成功任务rollout与恢复rollout以训练两个独立策略;部署阶段监控进度,调用学习型或程序化恢复,验证场景恢复后继续执行;当无可用恢复时由人类演示解决失败并纳入学习循环;物理rollout与人类演示按类别路由至对应策略进行DAgger训练;支持四台真实机器人工作站的并行采集。
AI.result: 在六种LIBERO-Pro设置和四类MolmoSpaces任务中,Recova分别达到78.8%和64.9%的平均成功率,优于最强基线的71.7%和38.0%;四工作站并行采集下,DAgger微调将平均成功率从23.8%提升到77.5%,加入恢复技能后进一步提升至87.5%;单任务四轮采集中,人工干预率从87.5%降至0%。
AI.conclusion: 智能体引导的恢复机制能够将失败转化为可复用的能力,在提升鲁棒性的同时逐步减少人工干预,验证了数字孪生探索与真实物理经验闭环迭代的有效性。

title: AFD-CAMLs: Agile Force-Distribution-Aware Planning and Control for Cable-Suspended Aerial Multi-Lifting Systems
summary: Multiple UAVs can cooperatively transport heavy payloads while controlling their position and orientation. Trajectory-based methods offer high agility while satisfying system constraints, but can produce uneven force distributions when the tension-to-wrench allocation is redundant or ill-conditioned, particularly under geometric mismatch and low-level tracking errors. We propose a hybrid planning-and-control framework to address this problem. A global planner generates payload trajectories and cable-force references by exploring the allocation null space under a prescribed internal-force setting. These references augment the cost of a centralized local planner, promoting feasible force distributions while generating trajectories for all UAVs. An admittance filter then compares the planned forces with onboard cable-tension estimates and adjusts the kinematic references to improve force tracking in degenerate or near-degenerate configurations. Simulations and experiments involving four to ten UAVs demonstrate more balanced tension distributions during both hovering and demanding agile maneuvers, without compromising agility or payload-tracking performance.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种混合规划-控制框架，通过在分配零空间中生成缆力参考并结合导纳滤波，实现多无人机协同吊运中更均衡的张力分配，同时保持敏捷性与负载跟踪性能。
AI.motivation: 多无人机协同运输重载时需同时控制位置与姿态。基于轨迹的方法虽具高敏捷性并满足系统约束，但在张力-力旋量分配存在冗余或病态（尤其几何不匹配与底层跟踪误差下）时，会产生不均匀的力分布，影响系统性能与安全。
AI.method: 提出混合规划-控制框架：全局规划器在给定内力设定下探索分配零空间，生成负载轨迹与缆力参考；这些参考被引入集中式局部规划器的代价函数，在生成所有无人机轨迹的同时促进可行力分布；随后通过导纳滤波器将规划力与机载缆张力估计进行比较，调整运动学参考，以在退化或近退化构型下改善力跟踪。
AI.result: 在涉及四至十架无人机的仿真与实验中，悬停和高难度敏捷机动过程中均实现了更均衡的张力分布，且未牺牲敏捷性与负载跟踪性能。
AI.conclusion: 该框架有效缓解了多无人机协同吊运中力分配不均问题，在保证敏捷性与负载跟踪的前提下改善了张力均衡性，具有良好的可扩展性（4-10架验证）。

title: ColoACT: Multi-Cue Action Chunking for Smooth Autonomous Colon Navigation on a Self-Propelled Endoscopic Robot
summary: Autonomous colonoscopic navigation can reduce operator burden and the risk of loop formation or tissue trauma, but remains challenging due to deformable anatomy, weak-texture and specular endoscopic visuals, and contact-rich viscoelastic interactions. Existing methods either rely on geometry-driven pipelines, which are efficient and interpretable yet brittle due to manually engineered features and switching logic, or adopt learning-based policies, whose inferred depth/geometry can become temporally inconsistent or overly smooth under weak texture and specular highlights while simulation-trained variants (e.g., deep reinforcement learning) may further suffer from a sim-to-real gap. We propose ColoACT, an autonomous navigation system that integrates an RGB-D-E based Action Chunking Transformer policy (ColoACT policy) for a compact self-propelled Bevel-Gear-Based Endoscopic Robot (BGER). The ColoACT policy augments RGB with estimated relative depth and a gradient-based pseudo-elevation map to enhance fold-ridge saliency and other high-frequency geometric cues, and enables smooth continuous control of the BGER by predicting overlapping action chunks and fusing them via temporal ensembling. In different \textit{ex-vivo} porcine colons (approximately 60 cm), our system achieves success rates of 85.4\% and 72.5\% in straight and curved segments, respectively, and achieves 70\% success in 90-degree turns and 60\% in double-bend sequences, with feasibility further demonstrated in challenging triple-bend segments. The project page is available at: https://Adamhu1.github.io/ColoACT/.

AI.tldr: 提出ColoACT自主结肠镜导航系统，融合RGB-D-E动作分块Transformer策略与自驱动齿轮内镜机器人，在离体猪结肠中实现较高成功率。
AI.motivation: 自主结肠镜导航可降低操作者负担并减少成环或组织损伤风险，但因解剖变形、弱纹理与镜面高光视觉、以及接触丰富的黏弹性交互而极具挑战。现有几何驱动方法高效可解释但依赖人工特征与切换逻辑而脆弱；学习型策略的深度/几何推断在弱纹理与高光下时序不一致或过度平滑，仿真训练的深度强化学习还存在sim-to-real鸿沟。
AI.method: ColoACT系统整合RGB-D-E动作分块Transformer策略（ColoACT policy）与紧凑自驱动斜面齿轮内镜机器人（BGER）。策略在RGB基础上引入估计的相对深度与基于梯度的伪高程图，增强褶皱脊线显著性与高频几何线索；通过预测重叠动作块并时序集成融合，实现BGER平滑连续控制。
AI.result: 在约60 cm离体猪结肠中，直段与弯段成功率分别为85.4%和72.5%；90度转弯成功率70%，双弯序列60%，并在高难度三弯段验证可行性。
AI.conclusion: ColoACT通过多模态视觉增强与动作分块时序集成，在真实离体解剖环境中实现稳定的自主结肠镜导航，具备应对复杂弯曲路径的可行性。

title: PROMO: Preference-conditioned Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning for Quadrupedal Robots
comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Robotics. Project website, code, and videos: https://amrmousa.com/promo/
summary: Quadrupedal locomotion requires balancing conflicting objectives such as command tracking, stability, and energy efficiency, yet conventional reinforcement learning (RL) hardcodes these priorities into a fixed scalar reward at training time. We present PROMO (Preference-Conditioned Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning), a semantic multi-objective approach that makes this trade-off an explicit runtime input to a single locomotion policy. PROMO conditions the policy on deployment facing preferences while keeping embodiment-specific locomotion priors fixed, thereby separating operator intent from reward shaping terms required for viable gait generation. Compared with fixed-objective controllers, multi-objective baselines, and independently trained specialists, PROMO achieves objective specialization and robustness from a single deployable policy. Across 100 sampled preferences in simulation, 67 behaviors are non-dominated under exact Pareto dominance, with a mean preference-objective correlation of 0.843, demonstrating broad Pareto coverage and predictable preference response. The same policy transfers zero-shot to a Unitree Go2, where preference changes alone reduce specific energy by up to 30.4%, position error by 38.7%, and peak body-attitude deviation by 59.0% relative to the balanced preference. These results establish preference-conditioned multi-objective RL as a practical runtime interface for adaptive legged locomotion, extending its role beyond offline Pareto-set construction. Open-source code and videos are available at https://amrmousa.com/promo/.

AI.tldr: PROMO 提出一种偏好条件化的多目标强化学习框架，将四足机器人步态中的指令跟踪、稳定性与能效权衡作为运行时输入交给单一策略，实现从单一可部署策略中获得广泛的帕累托覆盖与零样本真机迁移。
AI.motivation: 传统强化学习将指令跟踪、稳定性、能效等冲突目标硬编码为训练时的固定标量奖励，导致部署时无法调整权衡；多目标方法多停留在离线帕累托集构建，缺乏实用的运行时接口。
AI.method: PROMO 将部署时的偏好向量作为显式运行时输入对策略进行条件化，同时保持与具体机体相关的运动先验固定，从而把操作者意图与保证可行步态所需的奖励塑形项解耦，用单一策略实现多目标条件化控制。
AI.result: 仿真中对 100 个采样偏好，67 个行为在严格帕累托支配下非受支配，偏好-目标平均相关性为 0.843，表明帕累托覆盖广且偏好响应可预测；同一策略零样本迁移至 Unitree Go2，仅改变偏好即可使比能耗最多降低 30.4%、位置误差降低 38.7%、机体姿态峰值偏差降低 59.0%（相对平衡偏好）。
AI.conclusion: 偏好条件化多目标强化学习可作为自适应腿足运动的实用运行时接口，其作用超越离线帕累托集构建；相较固定目标控制器、多目标基线与独立专家策略，PROMO 以单一可部署策略同时实现目标专精与鲁棒性。

title: Interaction-Stiffness-Guided Basis Allocation in Dynamic Movement Primitives for Efficient Skill Transfer
summary: Dynamic Movement Primitives (DMPs) provide a compact and stable formulation for trajectory representation and generalization in robot skill learning. However, their predefined basis layout limits the allocation of approximation capacity according to stage-dependent precision requirements. To address this issue, this article proposes Stage-Criticality-Guided Dynamic Movement Primitives (SC-DMPs) with adaptive basis allocation for precision-critical skill learning. Operator-robot interaction stiffness and a trajectory-consistency cue derived from cross-demonstration task-space variability are integrated to construct a stage-criticality index. Guided by this index, basis centers are redistributed in normalized time through inverse cumulative criticality and mapped to the canonical phase domain, while their bandwidths are refined to adjust local approximation support. This enables denser and more flexible representation at high-criticality stages while retaining sparser allocation elsewhere. Experiments on handwriting trajectories and three real-robot tasks show that the inferred criticality is concentrated in geometrically demanding and task-constrained regions. Comparisons with DMPs, ProMPs, ProDMP, GP-MP, and KMP demonstrate improved trajectory reproduction, endpoint generalization, and task-critical accuracy while retaining a compact model and the stable structure of classical DMPs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出阶段关键性引导的动态运动基元（SC-DMPs），通过任务相关的关键性指标自适应分配基函数，实现精度关键阶段的高密度表示。
AI.motivation: 经典DMPs基函数布局固定，无法依据不同阶段的精度需求分配逼近能力，导致高精度关键阶段表示不足。
AI.method: 构建由人机交互刚度与跨示教任务空间变异性导出的轨迹一致性线索组成的阶段关键性指标；据此通过逆累积关键性在归一化时间上重分布基中心，并映射到典型相位域，同时细化带宽以调整局部逼近支撑。
AI.result: 在书写轨迹与三类真实机器人任务上，推断的关键性集中于几何要求高和任务约束强的区域；与DMPs、ProMPs、ProDMP、GP-MP、KMP相比，轨迹复现、端点泛化与任务关键精度均提升，同时保持紧凑模型与经典DMPs的稳定结构。
AI.conclusion: SC-DMPs通过关键性引导的自适应基分配，兼顾高精度阶段表示能力与模型紧凑性，适用于精度关键技能学习。

title: Continual Learning for 6-DoF Grasp Synthesis via Experience and Demonstrations
summary: Most current grasp synthesis systems are trained offline and remain fixed during deployment. While this works well when deployment conditions resemble the training data, performance can degrade when robots encounter conditions they have not seen before, such as unfamiliar objects. In this work, we present a continual-learning framework for single-view 6-DoF grasp synthesis for a parallel-jaw gripper in cluttered scenes. Rather than finetuning a large parametric model, our method adapts through memory in a learned embedding space: grasp outcomes update future grasp scores, while optional user demonstrations are recalled and transferred to new scenes as additional candidate grasps. We evaluate our method in simulation and in extensive real-world experiments comprising over 1500 grasp trials. We show that our method matches the performance of existing 6-DoF grasping baselines even before adaptation, improves online on unseen objects from categories absent or underrepresented during training, and supports long-horizon continual learning with limited forgetting. In real-world experiments, our method reaches over 90\% success rates on several challenging object categories after only 50 online grasp attempts. Videos and code at https://giuschio.github.io/cl_grasping/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向杂乱场景下平行夹爪单视角6-DoF抓取合成的持续学习框架，不微调大模型，而是在学习到的嵌入空间中通过记忆进行自适应：抓取结果更新未来抓取评分，用户示范可被召回并迁移为新候选抓取。在仿真与超1500次真实抓取试验中，方法在适应前即匹配现有基线，能对未见类别在线提升，并支持有限遗忘的长时程持续学习；真实实验中仅50次在线抓取即达90%以上成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有抓取合成系统多为离线训练且部署后固定不变，当部署条件与训练数据不同（如遇到未见物体）时性能会下降，缺乏在线适应能力。
AI.method: 不微调大型参数化模型，而是在学习到的嵌入空间中通过记忆实现自适应：利用抓取结果更新未来抓取评分，并将可选的用户示范召回并迁移到新场景中作为额外候选抓取。
AI.result: 在仿真和超过1500次真实抓取试验中，方法在适应前即可匹配现有6-DoF抓取基线；能对训练中缺失或欠代表的类别物体在线提升；支持长时程持续学习且遗忘有限；真实实验中在多个困难类别上仅需50次在线抓取即达到90%以上成功率。
AI.conclusion: 该工作验证了以嵌入空间记忆为核心的持续学习框架可有效提升单视角6-DoF抓取在未见物体上的在线适应能力，并具备低遗忘的长时程学习潜力。

title: Cross-entropy optimization with prioritized constraints
summary: When constraints conflict, an optimizer must determine which requirements to preserve and which to relax. On the one hand, a priority ordering specifies which requirements take precedence. On the other hand, penalty-based formulations encode their relative importance through numerical weights. Depending on these weights, a solution can improve its weighted score while violating intended priorities. We introduce TierCEM, a variant of the cross-entropy method that incorporates strict constraint priorities directly into elite selection without requiring per-constraint importance weights. TierCEM works by sequentially filtering sampled candidates, from highest- to lowest-priority constraint. If and when a constraint eliminates all remaining candidates, TierCEM returns to the last nonempty set and selects elites with the smallest violations of that blocking constraint, recursively preserving satisfaction of all higher-priority constraints. We evaluate TierCEM on 2D navigation and contact-rich pushing tasks in proprioceptive and learned world-model settings. Experiments show that reversing the constraint ordering changes which constraints are violated under conflict. Prioritizing progress toward the task objective also enables TierCEM to relax lower-priority constraints when they would otherwise prevent further progress.

AI.tldr: 提出TierCEM，将严格约束优先级直接嵌入交叉熵方法的精英选择，无需逐约束权重。
AI.motivation: 约束冲突时，优先级排序与数值权重惩罚两种机制可能不一致：按权重优化的解可能违反既定优先级，因此需要一种不依赖逐约束重要性权重、能在冲突中遵循严格优先级的方法。
AI.method: TierCEM是交叉熵方法的变体。它按优先级从高到低依次过滤采样候选；当某约束淘汰所有剩余候选时，回退到上一个非空候选集，选择对该阻塞约束违反最小的精英，并递归保持所有更高优先级约束的满足。
AI.result: 在二维导航与富接触推挤任务（本体感知与学习世界模型两种设定）中评估。实验显示：反转约束排序会改变冲突下被违反的约束；将任务目标推进设为高优先级，可使TierCEM在低优先级约束阻碍进展时放松它们。
AI.conclusion: 将严格约束优先级直接融入精英选择，可在无需权重调参的情况下刻画冲突取舍，且约束排序直接决定冲突中的违反模式。

title: Is Success All You Need? Investigating the Impact of Input Perturbations on VLA Behaviour in Tabletop Manipulation Tasks
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have achieved high task success rates on robot manipulation task benchmarks. More recently, there has been an emphasis on evaluating the robustness of VLA models to perturbations. However, this robustness is still predominantly measured through Task Success Rate (TSR). In this work, we propose a benchmark-agnostic evaluation framework to measure the behavioural robustness of models by characterising how successful trajectories are executed under perturbation. We implement this methodology by extending the widely-used LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus benchmarks. Across three state-of-the-art VLA models, four LIBERO task suites and seven perturbation conditions, we evaluate changes in both typical successful behaviour and its variability, including metrics of motion smoothness, efficiency and gripper behaviour. We find that perturbations can alter the behaviour of successful trajectories, a phenomenon which cannot necessarily be inferred from TSR alone. Across LIBERO suites, we identify cases where state-of-the-art VLA models achieve comparable TSR under the same perturbation condition, yet behaviour on successful trajectories diverges substantially. Therefore, to have a more robust assessment of task performance, we argue that suitable measures of robustness should capture not only whether a task is completed, but also how the robot behaves while completing it. When evaluating the robustness of VLA models, TSR may be complemented by behavioural evaluation metrics that characterise the nature and variability of successful task execution by robots.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种与基准无关的VLA模型鲁棒性评估框架，通过刻画扰动下成功轨迹的执行行为（而非仅看任务成功率），并在LIBERO/LIBERO-Plus上验证。
AI.motivation: 当前VLA模型鲁棒性评估主要依赖任务成功率（TSR），但TSR只能反映任务是否完成，无法揭示成功轨迹在扰动下行为的变化，可能掩盖模型间实质差异。
AI.method: 扩展LIBERO与LIBERO-Plus基准，构建与基准无关的行为鲁棒性评估框架；在3个SOTA VLA模型、4个LIBERO任务套件、7种扰动条件下，评估成功行为的变化及其变异性，指标涵盖运动平滑度、效率与夹爪行为。
AI.result: 扰动会改变成功轨迹的行为，这一现象无法仅由TSR推断；在不同LIBERO套件中，存在SOTA模型在相同扰动下TSR相近、但成功轨迹行为显著分化的情形。
AI.conclusion: 评估VLA鲁棒性时，应不仅关注任务是否完成，还应关注机器人如何完成；TSR需辅以刻画成功任务执行性质与变异性的行为评估指标。

title: Ex vivo breach detection using electrical conductivity during robotic pedicle drilling in the spine
summary:
Purpose: Pedicle screw placement is technically demanding in scoliosis treatment. High precision is required due to limited visibility, anatomical variability, and the risk of complications. Although robotic systems assist CT-based planning and execution, they still rely on ionizing intraoperative imaging and complex registration. This study proposes robotic pedicle drilling with real-time preventive breach detection using electrical bioimpedance sensing.
  Methods: We developed a robotic approach combined with a pedicle-drilling tool equipped with a proprioceptive electrical bioimpedance sensor developed by SpineGuard. A real-time detection algorithm was designed to analyze the electrical bioimpedance signal during drilling and identify abrupt changes in conductivity associated with potential breaches towards the spinal canal. The method operates without external devices or sensors.
  Results: The ex vivo experiments showed that the proposed method prevented breaches in 100 of the 51 drilling cases. These findings demonstrate the system's ability to detect potentially hazardous events during drilling and to stop the procedure before. The ex vivo experiments demonstrated that the proposed method prevented breaches in all 51 drilling cases.
  Conclusions: This work demonstrates the feasibility of robotic pedicle drilling with electrical bioimpedance sensing for real-time breach prevention. Using only the tool signal, the method eliminates the need for external sensing systems and supports safer pedicle screw placement.

AI.tldr: 提出一种机器人椎弓根钻孔方法，利用骨钻自带的电生物阻抗传感实时检测突破，无需额外外部传感设备，离体实验中51例钻孔全部避免了突破。
AI.motivation: 椎弓根螺钉置入在脊柱侧凸治疗中技术难度高：视野受限、解剖变异大、并发症风险高，对精度要求极高。现有机器人系统虽可辅助基于CT的规划与执行，但仍依赖术中电离辐射成像和复杂的配准流程。因此需要一种不依赖外部成像与传感、能在钻孔过程中实时预防突破的方法。
AI.method: 将机器人系统与SpineGuard公司开发的带本体感受式电生物阻抗传感器的椎弓根钻孔工具相结合；设计实时检测算法，在钻孔过程中分析电生物阻抗信号，识别与向椎管方向潜在突破相关的电导率突变。整个方法仅使用工具自身信号，不需要外部设备或传感器。
AI.result: 离体实验中，所提方法在全部51例钻孔案例中均成功预防了突破（摘要中"100 of the 51"表述有误，应理解为全部51例）。结果表明系统能检测钻孔中的潜在危险事件并在突破发生前终止操作。
AI.conclusion: 本工作证明了结合电生物阻抗传感的机器人椎弓根钻孔用于实时预防突破的可行性；仅凭工具信号即可摆脱对外部传感系统的依赖，有助于实现更安全的椎弓根螺钉置入。

title: Completion Aware Guidance for World Action Models
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) predict visual futures and robot actions, yet they remain susceptible to task-incomplete imagination, where plausible, action-consistent predictions omit the transition needed for task completion. In this paper, we show that this failure is not inherent to the world model backbone, but emerges when adapted for short-chunk control, which can repeatedly favor plausible local continuations over task-completing transitions. To address this, we introduce Completion Aware Guidance (CAG), a training-free sampling method that guides generation toward task completion. Across representative WAMs, CAG improves success from 64% to 70% on a RoboTwin 2.0 subset and from 69% to 75% in zero-shot simulation, while reducing task-incomplete imagination from 79% to 40%.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示World Action Models（WAMs）的"任务未完成式想象"缺陷源于短时序控制适配，并提出免训练采样方法Completion Aware Guidance（CAG）以引导生成向任务完成方向偏移。
AI.motivation: WAMs虽能预测视觉未来与机器人动作，但存在"任务未完成式想象"：预测看似合理且动作一致，却缺失完成任务所需的关键状态转移。作者欲证明该问题并非世界模型主干固有缺陷，而是短时序（short-chunk）控制适配时反复偏好局部合理延续、而非任务完成式转移所导致。
AI.method: 提出Completion Aware Guidance（CAG），一种免训练（training-free）的采样引导方法，在生成过程中将采样方向引导至任务完成，无需重新训练或微调模型参数。
AI.result: 在多个代表性WAMs上，CAG将RoboTwin 2.0子集成功率从64%提升至70%，零样本仿真成功率从69%提升至75%；同时将任务未完成式想象的比例从79%降至40%。
AI.conclusion: 任务未完成式想象是短时序控制适配带来的问题而非世界模型本身缺陷，通过CAG这一免训练采样引导即可有效缓解，显著提升任务成功率并大幅减少未完成式想象。

title: OpenSpace Lab Solution to the IROS 2026 Indoor Exploration Competition
summary: This report presents the \textbf{OpenSpace Lab}'s solution to the Competition on Intelligent Information Gathering for Single and Multi-Robot Systems Workshops, organized as part of the IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS) 2026. Our team reached 1st place in the Single-Robot Public Track and 3rd place in both the Single- and Multi-Robot Private Tracks. The single-robot framework utilizes pre-trained map completion predictions for global planning to prioritize unexplored areas. To reconcile map coverage with limited operation time, we introduce a remaining-time-based exploration strategy that integrates homing constraints into the decision-making process. For multi-robot exploration, we utilize a utility-driven target selection strategy that balances observation gains, movement costs, and budget constraints, leveraging shared map and intent data to eliminate redundant search and maximize coordination efficiency. Our solution reached a 61.04\% coverage rate in the Single-Robot Public Track, while reaching 39.53\% and 39.91\% coverage in the Single- and Multi-Robot Private Tracks, respectively. An extended full-length paper based on this report is currently being prepared for submission, and the source code will be released upon acceptance of the full manuscript at https://github.com/OpenSpace-Lab/Indoor-Exploration-IROS2026.

AI.tldr: 提出OpenSpace Lab在IROS 2026智能信息收集竞赛中的单/多机器人探索方案：单机器人利用预训练地图补全预测引导全局规划并结合剩余时间与返航约束，多机器人采用效用驱动目标选择；公开赛道覆盖率61.04%，私有赛道单/多机器人分别为39.53%和39.91%，获单机器人公开赛道第1名、单/多机器人私有赛道第3名。
AI.motivation: 在有限作业时间内，机器人需平衡地图覆盖与返航约束，避免无效探索；多机器人之间需消除重复搜索、提升协同效率，而现有探索策略在时间预算、返航与协同冗余处理上仍不足。
AI.method: 单机器人框架采用预训练地图补全预测进行全局规划以优先探索未探索区域，并引入基于剩余时间的探索策略，将返航约束融入决策过程；多机器人探索采用效用驱动的目标选择策略，在观测增益、移动代价与预算约束间权衡，并共享地图与意图信息以消除冗余搜索。
AI.result: 单机器人公开赛道覆盖率达61.04%；单机器人私有赛道覆盖率39.53%，多机器人私有赛道覆盖率39.91%。团队获单机器人公开赛道第1名，单机器人与多机器人私有赛道均获第3名。
AI.conclusion: 该方案在IROS 2026智能信息收集竞赛中取得领先成绩，验证了地图补全预测引导规划、剩余时间返航约束与效用驱动协同策略的有效性；基于本报告的完整论文正在准备投稿，代码将在全文录用后于GitHub开源。

title: Continue, Abort, or Fall: Viability-Aware Policy Selection (VAPS) for Safe Humanoid Acrobatics
summary: Dynamic humanoid motions such as flips risk hardware damage due to suboptimal policies, disturbances or sim-to-real gaps. A motion tracking policy offers no way out once the maneuver leaves its reference, and a backup policy needs to take over to protect the hardware for a minimum-damage landing. Which backup to use matters as much as when to switch. We present Viability-Aware Policy Selection (VAPS), which treats safety as a policy-conditioned, receding-horizon decision. Besides a protective fall policy, we also train an abort policy which can abort the motion at any time, landing on its feet. At every control step, learned predictors estimate whether the nominal tracking policy and the abort policy remain viable over a short horizon, and a least-sacrificial hierarchy keeps the most task-ambitious behavior that remains viable. In simulation with randomized disturbances, VAPS sharply reduces head contact and hand contact, which are the dominant sources of hardware damage, with both a Unitree G1 and a LimX Oli; on the LimX Oli, we validate the viability predictors and the full VAPS controller for side-flip motions. VAPS Pareto-dominates the strongest single-network alternatives we could train, including an end-to-end safe-tracking policy and students distilled from VAPS's own oracle-routed decisions, in both task success and head impact. We also show that VAPS is a powerful framework to supervise undertrained policies and protect the hardware.

AI.tldr: 提出VAPS（生存性感知策略选择），把动态人形动作的安全问题建模为策略条件下的滚动时域决策：学习预测器判断跟踪策略与中止策略在短时域内是否"生存可行"，再用最小牺牲层级选择仍可行的最具任务进取性的行为。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人执行翻转等动态动作时，因策略次优、扰动或仿真到现实的差距，存在硬件损坏风险。运动跟踪策略一旦偏离参考轨迹便无法恢复，而备用策略需在此时接管以实现最小损伤的落地保护。因此，选择"用哪个备用策略"与"何时切换"同样关键。
AI.method: VAPS将安全性视为策略条件下的滚动时域决策。除保护性跌倒策略外，额外训练一个可在任意时刻中止动作并双脚落地的abort策略。每个控制步中，学习到的预测器估计名义跟踪策略与abort策略在短时域内是否仍保持可行（viable），并通过最小牺牲层级保留仍可行的、任务进取性最高的行为。
AI.result: 在带随机扰动的仿真中，VAPS在Unitree G1和LimX Oli上均显著降低头部接触与手部接触（硬件损伤的主要来源）；在LimX Oli上验证了生存性预测器与完整VAPS控制器用于侧翻动作。在任务成功率与头部冲击两方面，VAPS均帕累托支配最强单网络替代方案（端到端安全跟踪策略、以及从VAPS自身oracle路由决策蒸馏的学生策略）。
AI.conclusion: VAPS是一个有效的框架，可用于监督训练不足的策略并保护硬件，在任务成功与硬件保护之间取得优于现有替代方案的权衡。

title: LiDARFlow: Real-Time Panel-Based MAV Guidance in Unknown Environments
summary: This paper presents a guidance algorithm for micro aerial vehicles operating in unknown, cluttered environments using only onboard sensing. The method is based on a panel formulation originally derived from aerodynamic potential-flow theory and generates smooth, collision-free guidance vectors from locally perceived obstacles. The approach is extended to unknown environments by constructing and updating the obstacle representation online from onboard LiDAR measurements. The resulting obstacle-avoidance field is integrated with a nominal guiding vector field to produce the final control input. The system is experimentally validated in indoor flight tests under two scenarios: waypoint navigation and directional guidance. In both cases, the vehicle successfully completes its task while avoiding all obstacles in real time using only onboard perception. The results demonstrate that the method is computationally lightweight and suitable for onboard implementation, with pointcloud processing identified as the main practical limitation. These results support the feasibility of lightweight onboard guidance in unknown environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种仅依赖机载感知的微型飞行器制导算法，将源自空气动力学势流理论的面板法扩展至未知环境，通过在线构建障碍物表征生成光滑无碰撞制导向量，并经室内飞行实验验证其轻量化与实时可行性。
AI.motivation: 微型飞行器需在未知、杂乱环境中自主飞行，且受载荷与算力限制，只能依靠机载感知；现有方法在计算开销与实时避障之间存在权衡，亟需一种计算轻量、可在线运行且能生成光滑制导指令的方案。
AI.method: 基于空气动力学势流理论中的面板（panel）公式，从局部感知障碍物生成光滑、无碰撞的制导向量；利用机载LiDAR测量在线构建并更新障碍物表征，以适应未知环境；将该避障场与标称制导向量场融合，生成最终控制输入。
AI.result: 在室内飞行实验中，针对航点导航与定向制导两种场景进行验证，飞行器均仅凭机载感知成功完成任务并实时避开所有障碍物；结果表明该方法计算轻量、适合机载实现，点云处理被识别为主要实际瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证实了在未知环境中实现轻量化机载制导的可行性，同时指出点云处理是后续优化与工程应用的关键限制环节。

title: ReCo: Response-Consistent Locomotion with Policy-Aware MPC for Legged Manipulation
summary: Continuous legged manipulation requires accurate end-effector tracking while the base keeps walking. Combining reinforcement learning (RL) with model predictive control (MPC) suits this task: the learned policy provides robust locomotion, while MPC coordinates the base and arm to compensate for tracking errors. However, MPC can compensate only for base motion that it can predict, and a learned policy's command response varies with gait phase, contact, and payload. We present ReCo, a framework that couples response-consistent locomotion with policy-aware MPC for legged manipulation. Response shaping trains the policy to respond to commands consistently and repeatably across randomized dynamics. An identified closed-loop response model then lets MPC jointly plan locomotion commands and arm motion. On the simulation benchmark, ReCo reduces position and orientation root-mean-square error (RMSE) by 28.7% and 27.4% relative to the best baseline for each metric. Real-world experiments demonstrate onboard continuous legged manipulation with coordinated base and arm motion.

AI.tldr: ReCo提出一种将"响应一致的腿式运动控制"与"策略感知MPC"相耦合的框架，用于足式机器人连续操作任务。通过响应塑造训练策略，并用辨识出的闭环响应模型让MPC联合规划运动指令与机械臂动作。仿真中相比最佳基线将位置与姿态RMSE分别降低28.7%与27.4%，并完成真实平台上机载连续足式操作实验。
AI.motivation: 连续足式操作要求机器人在行走过程中保持末端执行器的精确跟踪。RL提供鲁棒的运动能力，MPC协调基座与手臂以补偿跟踪误差，但二者结合存在两个瓶颈：一是MPC只能补偿其可预测的基座运动；二是学习策略的指令响应会随步态相位、接触状态与负载而变化，导致基座运动难以被准确预测，从而使MPC补偿能力受限。
AI.method: 提出ReCo框架，包含两部分核心机制：（1）响应塑造（response shaping）：在随机化动力学条件下训练策略，使其对指令的响应具有一致性与可重复性；（2）策略感知MPC（policy-aware MPC）：基于辨识得到的闭环响应模型，让MPC能够联合规划运动指令与机械臂动作，从而对基座运动进行有效预测与补偿。
AI.result: 在仿真基准测试中，ReCo相对于各指标下的最佳基线，将位置RMSE降低28.7%，姿态RMSE降低27.4%。真实世界实验验证了机载的连续足式操作，基座与机械臂实现协调运动。
AI.conclusion: 通过让策略响应具备一致性并使其可被MPC建模预测，ReCo有效耦合了RL运动控制与MPC的协同规划，显著提升了足式机器人连续操作中的末端跟踪精度，并在真实平台上验证了可行性。

title: SonarVoxNet: Diver Detection in 3D Bounding Box using 3D Sonar
summary: Autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) assisting human divers must continuously track not only the diver's 3D position but also their full-body orientation. However, vision-based perception is unreliable underwater, and forward-looking sonar -- despite being widely used -- discards the elevation information needed for orientation estimation, posing a fundamental limitation. Recently commercialized 3D sonar preserves elevation but produces sparse, noisy returns, and existing detectors are built for dense LiDAR data and for targets that remain upright and rotate only about the yaw axis (e.g., vehicles, pedestrians), making them unable to represent a freely pitching and rolling diver. To address this gap, we present two contributions. First, SonarVoxNet adapts a voxel-based encoder and an anchor-free center-based detection head to 3D sonar data, replacing the conventional yaw-only rotation representation with a continuous 6D rotation parameterization to predict full 9-DoF oriented bounding boxes -- to our knowledge, the first 3D sonar diver detector to do so. Second, Diver3D is the first public 3D sonar dataset with full 3D orientation labels for divers in diverse, non-upright poses, collected at a natural cave-diving site. Through controlled ablations over the backbone and detection head, we show that the dominant factor behind accurate 3D sonar-based diver detection is the transition from yaw-only rotation to full-SO(3) rotation. This transition substantially improves detection accuracy and reduces orientation error. These results demonstrate that full-body diver orientation is recoverable from 3D sonar alone, laying the groundwork for future work on diver pose estimation and diver-robot interaction.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对3D声呐数据稀疏、噪声大且现有检测器仅支持偏航旋转的问题，提出SonarVoxNet检测器（采用6D连续旋转参数化预测完整9-DoF有向包围盒）与Diver3D数据集（首个带完整3D姿态标注的潜水员3D声呐公开数据集），并证明从偏航旋转过渡到完整SO(3)旋转是提升检测精度的主导因素。
AI.motivation: 辅助人类潜水员的自主水下航行器（AUV）需要持续跟踪潜水员的3D位置及全身姿态。然而水下视觉感知不可靠；前视声呐虽广泛使用却丢失了姿态估计所需的高度（elevation）信息，构成根本性限制。近期商用化的3D声呐虽保留高度信息，但回波稀疏且噪声大，而现有检测器面向稠密LiDAR数据、且仅针对保持直立、只绕偏航轴旋转的目标（如车辆、行人），无法表示自由俯仰和翻滚的潜水员。
AI.method: 第一，SonarVoxNet：将基于体素的编码器与无锚框（anchor-free）的基于中心的检测头适配到3D声呐数据，用连续6D旋转参数化替代传统的仅偏航旋转表示，从而预测完整的9-DoF有向包围盒，据作者所知是首个实现该能力的3D声呐潜水员检测器。第二，Diver3D：首个公开的3D声呐数据集，为处于多样、非直立姿态的潜水员提供完整3D姿态标注，采集于天然洞穴潜水场景。此外对骨干网络与检测头进行了受控消融实验。
AI.result: 消融实验表明，实现准确3D声呐潜水员检测的主导因素是"从仅偏航旋转转向完整SO(3)旋转"这一转变；该转变显著提升了检测精度并降低了姿态误差。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明仅凭3D声呐即可恢复潜水员的全身姿态，为后续潜水员姿态估计与潜水员-机器人交互研究奠定基础。

title: Learning a Resolution-Consistent Jacobian Field for Bio-Inspired Rigid-Soft Finger
comment: 27 pages, 8 figures, including supplementary material. Under review at Robotics and Autonomous Systems
summary: Bio-inspired tendon-driven rigid-soft coupled dexterous fingers exhibit strong nonlinearity and configuration-dependent sensitivity, making accurate modeling challenging. In discrete-time control, Jacobian-based kinematic algorithms typically rely on point-wise local linear approximations, which makes their performance sensitive to sensor sampling frequency and controller update frequency. To address this issue, we propose Jacobian Flow Matching (JFM), a structured learning framework based on Conditional Flow Matching (CFM), to learn a resolution-consistent Jacobian field that models actuation-to-motion transitions as a dynamical flow. The proposed framework supports both single-step prediction and continuous rollout via ODE integration, enabling consistent inference across temporal resolutions. Experiments on a tendon-driven rigid-soft finger show that the proposed method suppresses outlier errors and improves single-step prediction accuracy, reducing the global average RMSE by over 53% compared with a baseline discrete Jacobian learning approach. For long-horizon prediction, trajectories recovered via ODE integration achieve higher fidelity under sparse sampling (Stride = 8), reducing the RMSE median by 14.43% and the error variance by 24.87%. These results demonstrate that the learned flow-based Jacobian field provides an effective local model for offline multi-step trajectory optimization in rigid-soft coupled nonlinear systems.

AI.tldr: 提出Jacobian Flow Matching（JFM）框架，将驱动-运动关系建模为分辨率一致的Jacobian场，支持单步预测与ODE连续展开，在腱驱动刚软耦合手指上显著降低预测误差。
AI.motivation: 腱驱动刚软耦合灵巧手指具有强非线性与构型依赖的灵敏度，精确建模困难；离散时间控制中基于Jacobian的运动学算法依赖逐点局部线性近似，其性能对传感器采样频率与控制器更新频率敏感。因此需要一种分辨率一致、跨时间分辨率可一致推理的建模方法。
AI.method: 提出Jacobian Flow Matching（JFM），一种基于Conditional Flow Matching（CFM）的结构化学习框架，学习分辨率一致的Jacobian场，将驱动到运动的过程建模为动态流；框架同时支持单步预测与通过ODE积分的连续rollout，实现跨时间分辨率的一致性推理。
AI.result: 在腱驱动刚软手指实验中，所提方法抑制了离群误差并提升单步预测精度，相比基线离散Jacobian学习方法全局平均RMSE降低超过53%；长时程预测中，在稀疏采样（Stride=8）下ODE积分恢复的轨迹保真度更高，RMSE中位数降低14.43%，误差方差降低24.87%。
AI.conclusion: 所学习的基于流的Jacobian场可为刚软耦合非线性系统的离线多步轨迹优化提供有效的局部模型。

title: Query-Conditioned Articulation Estimation from a Single Image
comment: Code and video are available at https://abwerby.github.io/queryart/
summary: Enabling robots to estimate the kinematic parameters of articulated objects unlocks a wide range of capabilities for interaction and manipulation. The estimation has to happen from the information the robot currently observes, often just a single RGB image of an object it has never seen before. Current single-image approaches couple articulation part segmentation with articulation estimation, making their predictions vulnerable to missed detections and incorrect part associations, and they regress metric 3D geometry that a single view fixes only up to scale. We present QueryArt, a model that estimates articulation parameters from a single RGB image, a 2D query point, and camera intrinsics. QueryArt is trained to estimate the 3D articulation geometry relative to the queried point and in units of its depth, which keeps its target identifiable from the image alone. A single depth measurement at the query point then supplies the scale and recovers the metric parameters. We train QueryArt on a curated mixture of synthetic and real-world articulation datasets. We evaluate QueryArt on several benchmarks and compare it against recent baselines. QueryArt outperforms recent baselines on most articulation metrics, including on out-of-distribution data. To demonstrate the model's capabilities in real-world settings, we evaluate QueryArt on a mobile manipulator across 57 manipulation trials spanning 16 object parts and five viewpoint classes, achieving a 70.2% success rate. We provide code and videos at: https://abwerby.github.io/queryart/

AI.tldr: 提出QueryArt，从单张RGB图像、一个2D查询点和相机内参估计铰接物体运动学参数，实现相对查询点的3D铰接几何预测，并在移动操作机器人上验证。
AI.motivation: 铰接物体运动学参数估计对机器人交互与操作至关重要，但机器人通常只能获取单张RGB图像且面对未见过的物体。现有单图方法将铰接部件分割与铰接估计耦合，导致预测易受漏检和错误部件关联影响；同时其回归的度量3D几何在单视图下仅能恢复到尺度不确定。
AI.method: QueryArt以单张RGB图像、一个2D查询点及相机内参为输入，训练目标是估计相对于查询点、并以查询点深度为单位的3D铰接几何，从而保证目标在图像内可辨识；再通过查询点处的一次深度测量提供尺度，恢复度量参数。训练使用合成与真实铰接数据集的精选混合。
AI.result: 在多个基准上与近期基线对比，QueryArt在多数铰接指标上更优，包括分布外数据；在移动操作机器人上跨16个物体部件、5类视点的57次操作试验中达到70.2%成功率。
AI.conclusion: QueryArt通过查询点相对表达与深度单位归一化，缓解了单视图尺度不确定与部件耦合问题，在基准和真实机器人操作中均表现良好，并提供代码与视频。

title: FlashDexRetarget: Accelerating Dexterous Manipulation Data Generation through Multi-Motion Retargeting
summary: Human hand-object demonstrations offer a reusable source of dexterous robot manipulation data, but transferring them across embodiments requires physically feasible retargeting. Existing physics-based approaches face limitations in retargeting success, motion-specific training efficiency, or both. To address these limitations, we introduce FlashDexRetarget, an RL-based framework for high-success, efficient dexterous motion retargeting. To make the demonstrated interaction easier to learn, we combine object point-cloud observations, hand-object distance features, and future trajectory encodings with complementary rewards that supervise object motion and reference hand-object relationships. To further accelerate learning, we employ separate left- and right-hand actor critic networks and adapt the off-policy algorithm, FlashSAC to dexterous motion tracking. On a benchmark of 50 motions spanning single-object and two-object interactions, FlashDexRetarget achieves a 90% success rate, approximately 2.5x that of the evaluated sampling-based baselines, while requiring up to 100x less training compute than the evaluated RL-based baselines. Evaluations on both XHand and Sharpa Wave Hand show consistent gains, and component-wise ablations examine the contributions of our design choices. Beyond the 50-motion benchmark, experiments with 200, 500, and 1,000 motions demonstrate that our method remains stable at larger scales and produces successful retargeted motions more efficiently as the training set grows. Qualitative replay results using real-world-captured demonstrations further illustrate the applicability of our framework to recorded human manipulation. Videos and code are available at https://davian-robotics.github.io/FlashDexRetarget/

AI.tldr: FlashDexRetarget：基于RL的高成功率、高效灵巧手-物重定向框架，在50个动作基准上达90%成功率，约为采样类基线2.5倍，训练算力比RL基线最多降低100倍。
AI.motivation: 人手-物演示是可复用的灵巧操作数据源，但跨本体迁移需物理可行的重定向。现有物理方法在重定向成功率、动作特定训练效率或两者兼有上存在局限。
AI.method: 提出RL框架FlashDexRetarget：(1) 输入融合物体点云观测、手-物距离特征与未来轨迹编码；(2) 设计互补奖励，监督物体运动与参考手-物关系；(3) 采用左右手分离的actor-critic网络，并将off-policy算法FlashSAC适配到灵巧运动跟踪。
AI.result: 在涵盖单物体与双物体交互的50动作基准上成功率90%，约为采样类基线的2.5倍，训练算力较RL基线最多减少100倍；在XHand与Sharpa Wave Hand上均获一致提升；200/500/1000动作规模实验显示方法稳定且随训练集增大更高效；真实采集演示的重放验证了适用性。
AI.conclusion: FlashDexRetarget在成功率与训练效率上同时优于现有物理重定向方法，具备良好的跨手型泛化性与大规模可扩展性，适用于真实人手操作演示的重定向。

title: ActiveWAM: Evidence-Aware Active Vision for World-Action Models
summary: Active vision manipulation requires a policy to control both its camera and its end-effectors, yet camera motion determines which evidence remains visible within finite observation windows. Acquiring a new view can displace task-critical cues, while retaining a view forgoes potentially useful observations. We formulate this as an evidence-aware retain--acquire problem and present ActiveWAM, a unified world--action model that learns observation and manipulation jointly. To this end, we propose training-time inversion which constrains a frozen video prior by task-bearing source evidence and visible temporal changes, eliminating the need for test-time inversion or candidate ranking. At deployment, the policy generates bimanual and pan/tilt actions-including stay and reacquisition behaviors-from view-aware history, and updates context from newly measured RGB observations. Future-video prediction serves as a co-training signal, while action generation requires neither future-video decoding nor optimal viewpoint annotations. We introduce RoboTwin-AV, a 50-task benchmark with executable pan/tilt control and automatically generated demonstrations. ActiveWAM improves TAVIS out-of-distribution success by up to 17.0 percentage points over the strongest baselines, achieves 20.0 additional points over Fast-WAM on RoboTwin-AV, and outperforms it by 26.7 points on real-world physical kitchen tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出ActiveWAM统一世界-动作模型，将主动视觉操作建模为"证据感知的保留-获取"问题，通过训练时反演与未来视频协同训练联合学习观察与操作，在多个基准和真实任务上显著超越基线。
AI.motivation: 主动视觉操作需同时控制相机与末端执行器，而相机运动决定有限观测窗口内哪些证据可见：获取新视角可能移出任务关键线索，保留当前视角则放弃潜在有用观测。现有方法面临测试时反演、候选排序或依赖最优视角标注等困难。
AI.method: 1) 将问题形式化为证据感知的保留-获取（retain-acquire）问题；2) 提出ActiveWAM统一世界-动作模型，联合学习观测与操作；3) 训练时反演（training-time inversion）：用承载任务的源证据与可见时序变化约束冻结的视频先验，无需测试时反演或候选排序；4) 部署时策略基于视角感知历史生成双臂及云台/俯仰动作（含保持与重新获取行为），并用新测RGB观测更新上下文；5) 未来视频预测作为协同训练信号，动作生成无需未来视频解码或最优视角标注；6) 构建RoboTwin-AV基准（50任务，可执行云台/俯仰控制，自动生成演示）。
AI.result: 在TAVIS分布外成功率上比最强基线提升最多17.0个百分点；在RoboTwin-AV上比Fast-WAM高20.0个百分点；在真实厨房物理任务上高出26.7个百分点。
AI.conclusion: ActiveWAM通过训练时反演与未来视频协同训练，无需测试时反演、候选排序或最优视角标注即可实现联合观察-操作策略，配合新基准RoboTwin-AV，在仿真与真实任务中均取得显著性能优势。

title: ChunkVLA-AM: Parallel Action Chunking for Vision-Language-Action Robot Control in Additive Manufacturing
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models unify visual perception, language understanding, and action generation, offering new opportunities for automation in additive manufacturing (AM). However, deployment in AM remains challenging because adapting these models to unseen robot embodiments is costly, and performance can degrade under environment changes. In this work, we present a framework for deploying OpenVLA-OFT on a FAIRINO FR3 robot in a fixed AM workcell. A data pipeline converts monocular real-world demonstrations into OpenVLA-compatible TFDS/RLDS datasets to support adaptation to the FR3 embodiment. At runtime, each inference request predicts an eight-step chunk of 7-D actions. The FR3 executes each chunk open loop before capturing a new observation, providing closed-loop feedback between chunks. The system uses a cloud-edge architecture in which the FR3 client streams observations to a remote inference server through a FastAPI interface. In 42 physical A-to-B object-transfer trials, evenly split between red and blue targets, the system succeeded in 39 (92.9%). All three failures occurred during final placement, when insufficient release-height control caused the object to topple. An illumination sweep identified a low-error luminance range of 85-125 on a 0-255 scale, with the lowest mean spatial error at 95.

AI.tldr: 本文将 OpenVLA-OFT 部署到增材制造工位中的 FAIRINO FR3 机器人，构建数据管线与云边推理架构，在 42 次实物转移试验中取得 92.9% 成功率。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型统一了视觉感知、语言理解与动作生成，为增材制造（AM）自动化带来新机遇。但将此类模型适配到未见过的机器人本体成本高昂，且环境变化下性能易退化，因此在实际 AM 场景中的部署仍具挑战。
AI.method: 提出面向固定 AM 工位中 FAIRINO FR3 机器人的 OpenVLA-OFT 部署框架。数据管线将单目真实世界演示转换为 OpenVLA 兼容的 TFDS/RLDS 数据集，以支持向 FR3 本体的适配。运行时每次推理请求预测 8 步的 7 维动作块（chunk）；FR3 以开环方式执行每个动作块后再采集新观测，从而在块间形成闭环反馈。系统采用云边架构，FR3 客户端通过 FastAPI 接口将观测流式传输至远程推理服务器。
AI.result: 在 42 次实物 A 到 B 物体转移试验中（红、蓝目标各半），系统成功 39 次，成功率 92.9%。三次失败均发生在最终放置阶段，原因是释放高度控制不足导致物体倾倒。光照扫描确定了 0-255 尺度下低误差的亮度区间为 85-125，其中平均空间误差最低出现在亮度 95。
AI.conclusion: 该框架验证了 OpenVLA-OFT 在固定 AM 工位中适配 FR3 本体的可行性，云边架构与动作块闭环执行可支撑较高任务成功率；未来需改进释放高度控制并利用最优光照区间以降低失败率。

title: Towards Physical Underwater Robotic Assistance for Scuba Diver Movement in Confined Spaces
