title: In-context Learning of Single-index Targets: Comparing Kernel and Feature Learners
summary: In-context learning (ICL) enables a pretrained model to infer a task from demonstrations without updating its parameters. While much of the existing theory focuses on linear target functions, in this paper we study nonlinear cases by comparing two one-layer attention architectures on the same family of single-index tasks. A kernel learner first maps inputs through a fixed nonlinear feature map and then applies linear attention, whereas a feature learner applies attention to the original input, followed by a learned nonlinear readout. We derive predictions for their memorization and generalization errors using the replica method, retaining the effects of pretraining size, task-pool diversity, and training and inference context lengths. The resulting predictions closely match numerical experiments across a broad range of regimes. Our analysis yields phase diagrams that characterize when each architecture is advantageous as the amount of pretraining data, task diversity, and context lengths vary. We further identify qualitatively different context-length scalings for the two learners. Together, these results clarify how architectural choices interact with the dataset and govern nonlinear in-context learning.

AI.tldr: 本文比较两种单层注意力架构（核学习器与特征学习器）在单指标非线性任务上的上下文学习，用复制方法推导记忆与泛化误差，得到相图并识别出不同的上下文长度缩放规律。
AI.motivation: 现有上下文学习（ICL）理论多聚焦线性目标函数，非线性情形尚不清楚；同时架构选择如何与预训练数据规模、任务池多样性及上下文长度相互作用缺乏理论刻画。
AI.method: 在同一族单指标任务上对比两种单层注意力架构：核学习器先用固定非线性特征映射再施加线性注意力；特征学习器直接对原始输入做注意力，后接可学习的非线性读出。使用复制方法（replica method）推导二者的记忆误差与泛化误差预测，保留预训练规模、任务池多样性以及训练与推理上下文长度的影响，并与数值实验对照。
AI.result: 理论预测在广泛区间内与数值实验高度吻合；得到相图，刻画随预训练数据量、任务多样性与上下文长度变化时各架构的优势区间；并发现两种学习器在上下文长度上呈现性质不同的缩放规律。
AI.conclusion: 架构选择与数据集（预训练规模、任务多样性、上下文长度）之间存在明确的交互关系，共同决定非线性上下文学习的表现，为架构设计提供了理论依据。

title: Exact Distinguishability in Non-Markovian Decision Processes
comment: 26 pages, 7 figures. Code and Lean 4 proofs: https://github.com/Kcbir/pec
summary: Non-Markovian environments are often modeled as Regular Decision Processes (RDPs), where dynamics depend on the interaction history through a finite automaton. Existing offline guarantees for RDPs rely on a distinguishability assumption on the behaviour policy but provide no means of verifying it. When the assumption is violated, distinct models may explain the data equally well. We study when data collected under a fixed behaviour policy can distinguish two candidate RDPs. We prove that the posterior odds between observationally equivalent candidates remain equal to the prior odds at every sample size, even when the policy visits every automaton state, and verify both results formally in Lean 4. We then characterize this equivalence exactly and derive PEC, an algorithm that decides it in time linear in the size of the product automaton. The distinguishability assumption of prior work fails on three of our four test environments, and the experiment identified by PEC restores it in each case.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究固定行为策略下离线数据能否区分两个候选RDP，证明观测等价候选的后验比始终等于先验比，并在Lean 4中形式化验证；随后精确刻画该等价关系并提出线性时间的PEC判定算法，实验表明该算法可恢复被打破的可区分性假设。
AI.motivation: 非马尔可夫环境常用正则决策过程（RDP）建模，其动态通过有限自动机依赖交互历史。现有RDP离线保证依赖行为策略上的可区分性假设，但无法验证该假设。当假设被违反时，不同模型可能同样好地解释数据，因此需要研究固定行为策略下数据何时能区分两个候选RDP。
AI.method: 将非马尔可夫环境建模为RDP；分析固定行为策略下候选RDP的可区分性；证明观测等价候选的后验比在每个样本量下均等于先验比（即使策略访问每个自动机状态），并用Lean 4形式化验证；精确刻画该等价关系；提出PEC算法，在积自动机规模上以线性时间判定等价性。
AI.result: 证明了观测等价候选的后验比恒等于先验比，并通过Lean 4形式化验证；精确刻画了该等价关系；提出PEC算法实现线性时间判定。实验显示，先前工作的可区分性假设在四个测试环境中的三个上失效，而PEC识别的实验在每个情况下均恢复了该假设。
AI.conclusion: 固定行为策略下，观测等价的候选RDP在任意样本量下都无法被数据区分，即使策略覆盖所有自动机状态。该等价关系可被精确刻画并在线性时间内判定，PEC算法能有效诊断并恢复先前工作中的可区分性假设。

title: Inferring Multi-Timescale Neural Dynamics with Switching Linear Dynamical Systems
summary: Neural activity often exhibits multiple timescales that can vary with behavioral states and task conditions. Identifying these timescales from neural recordings is important for better understanding neural computation and function. However, traditional approaches based on autocorrelation fitting are difficult to scale to high-dimensional population recordings and can become unreliable when neural dynamics change with behavior. State-space models have been a powerful framework for modeling high-dimensional neural population activity through latent dynamical systems, but standard formulations and inference methods do not explicitly account for multiple timescales and therefore do not guarantee accurate recovery of the underlying temporal structure. Motivated by these questions, we introduce the Multi-Timescale Switching Linear Dynamical System (MTS-SLDS), a framework for identifying regime-specific latent timescales from continuous or spiking neural observations. MTS-SLDS combines a multi-lag moment initialization, which captures temporal structure across multiple observation lags, with \textit{regime-conditioned} Laplace-EM inference, which reduces mixing of dynamical statistics across uncertain regimes. Characteristic timescales can then be extracted directly from the eigenvalues of the learned latent transition matrices. In synthetic and neural experiments with Gaussian and Poisson spike observations, MTS-SLDS accurately recovers timescales and switching structure over multiple datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多时间尺度切换线性动力系统（MTS-SLDS），用于从连续或脉冲神经观测中识别各状态特有的潜在时间尺度。
AI.motivation: 神经活动常呈现多种时间尺度，并随行为状态与任务条件变化。识别这些时间尺度对理解神经计算与功能很重要，但传统基于自相关拟合的方法难以扩展到高维群体记录，且在神经动力学随行为变化时可能不可靠；标准状态空间模型虽能建模高维群体活动，却不显式考虑多时间尺度，无法保证准确恢复潜在时间结构。
AI.method: MTS-SLDS结合两项关键技术：多滞后矩初始化（捕捉多个观测滞后上的时间结构）与状态条件化Laplace-EM推断（减少不确定状态间动力学统计的混叠）；随后从学习到的潜在转移矩阵特征值中直接提取特征时间尺度。
AI.result: 在合成数据以及高斯观测和Poisson脉冲观测的神经实验中，MTS-SLDS在多个数据集上均能准确恢复时间尺度与切换结构。
AI.conclusion: MTS-SLDS为从高维神经群体活动中识别状态特异的潜在时间尺度提供了可行框架，并在多种观测类型与数据集上验证了其准确性。

title: The Curvature of Regret in Contextual Linear Optimization
comment: 4 pages main body plus appendix, 3 figures. Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on MLxOR
summary: Decision-focused learning for linear optimization is complicated by the discontinuity of the optimizer, where small cost errors may leave the decision unchanged or move it to a different vertex. We show that this non-smooth pointwise behavior becomes locally quadratic after averaging over the data distribution, and we derive the curvature in closed form, specifically, a matrix-valued measure supported on the walls of the normal fan. This measure depends only on the feasible set, with the data distribution entering only as a weight. We then offer a tractable approximation for this curvature, computable with just one projection to the feasible set. We prove that the approximation weakly converges to the true population curvature. We offer one application of our findings, a decision-aware scenario generation method for expected-cost linear optimization. Our experiments test the quadratic and weak convergence laws and show a 30.8% regret improvement over uniform allocation on battery arbitrage.

AI.tldr: 本文研究线性优化的决策聚焦学习中优化器不连续导致的目标非光滑问题，证明对数据分布平均后该目标局部呈二次行为，并给出闭式曲率（支撑于正规扇墙上的矩阵值测度）及仅需一次投影的易处理近似，进而提出决策感知场景生成方法。
AI.motivation: 线性优化中优化器不连续：成本的小误差可能不改变决策，也可能使决策跳到不同顶点，导致决策聚焦学习的梯度/曲率分析困难，目标函数逐点非光滑。
AI.method: 证明逐点非光滑在分布平均后局部变为二次型；推导闭式曲率，即支撑在正规扇（normal fan）各墙上的矩阵值测度，该测度仅依赖可行集，数据分布仅作权重；给出该曲率的易处理近似，仅需一次到可行集的投影；理论上证明近似弱收敛到真实总体曲率；应用为期望成本线性优化的决策感知场景生成方法。
AI.result: 实验验证了二次行为律与弱收敛律，并在电池套利任务上相比均匀分配取得30.8%的后悔值（regret）改进。
AI.conclusion: 分布平均可消除优化器不连续带来的非光滑性，产生闭式二次曲率与可计算近似，为决策聚焦学习及决策感知场景生成提供了理论基础与实用方法。

title: Sharp Non-Asymptotic Analysis of the Penalized Challenger in $β$-EB-TCI for Bernoulli Bandits
summary: Top-two algorithms are simple and effective for fixed-confidence best-arm identification, but their sharp non-asymptotic behavior is still not well understood. We study this problem for Bernoulli bandits through $β$-EB-TCI, the empirical-best top-two rule of Jourdan et al., whose challenger is chosen using a Bernoulli transportation cost with a logarithmic count penalty. We prove that, after the empirical leader has become the true best arm and its sampling fraction stays close to $β$, the stopping time is $T_β^{\star}(μ)\log(1/δ)$ up to lower-order concentration terms. We also show that, in this regime, every challenger is sampled linearly often. Thus, for the original algorithm without forced exploration, the main remaining difficulty is to control when the empirical leader becomes permanently correct. These results imply a non-asymptotic high-probability bound for all Bernoulli instances with a unique best arm. If the algorithm satisfies a finite-mean sufficient-exploration condition, the bound further yields the sharp expected sample complexity. In particular, this gives the sharp expectation result for the unguarded Bernoulli rule when all arm means are pairwise distinct, using the sufficient-exploration result of Jourdan et al. Finally, if we add a mild forced-exploration rule that contributes only $O(\sqrt{Kt})$ pulls up to time $t$, we obtain a self-contained expected sample-complexity theorem for any number of arms under the unique-best-arm assumption. We also identify a limitation of proof strategies that try to handle equal suboptimal means through a single index-comparison argument.

AI.tldr: 本文研究Bernoulli臂下β-EB-TCI(top-two最佳臂识别算法)的尖锐非渐近行为,证明经验领先者成为真实最优臂后,停止时间约为T_β^★(μ)log(1/δ),并给出高概率界、期望样本复杂度及附加轻度强制探索下的自包含定理,同时指出单一索引比较论证的局限。
AI.motivation: Top-two算法对固定置信度(asymptotic)最佳臂识别简单有效,但其尖锐非渐近行为尚不清楚。作者希望刻画β-EB-TCI的非渐近停止时间与样本复杂度,并澄清强制探索的作用。
AI.method: 针对Bernoulli bandits,分析Jourdan等人的经验最佳top-two规则β-EB-TCI(挑战者由带对数计数惩罚的Bernoulli transportation cost选出)。证明当经验领先者已为最优臂且采样比例接近β时,停止时间为T_β^★(μ)log(1/δ)加上低阶集中项;证明该regime下每个挑战者被线性频繁采样;利用Jourdan等人的充分探索结果;并加入仅贡献O(√(Kt))次拉动到时刻t的轻度强制探索规则。
AI.result: 得到对所有唯一最优臂的Bernoulli实例的非渐近高概率界;在有限均值充分探索条件下进一步得到尖锐期望样本复杂度;对无guard的Bernoulli规则在所有臂均值两两不同时给出尖锐期望结果;附加轻度强制探索后得到任意臂数、唯一最优臂假设下的自包含期望样本复杂度定理。
AI.conclusion: 经验领先者成为永久正确臂的时机是无强制探索算法的主要剩余难点;加入轻量强制探索可补齐理论保证;并指出通过单一索引比较论证处理相等次优均值的证明策略存在局限。

title: Muon meets Tamed Langevin: Momentum Preconditioning beyond Convex and gradient-Lipschitz Potentials
summary: We consider the problem of sampling from Gibbs distributions on matrix spaces whose potential energies are neither convex nor globally gradient-Lipschitz. We introduce a family of non-quadratic kinetic energies that lead to a new underdamped Langevin system with momentum preconditioning, in which the gradient of the kinetic energy acts as a smooth spectral taming of the momentum. We prove that, under these relaxed assumptions on the potential, the resulting dynamics leaves the target Gibbs measure invariant, and we establish exponential convergence to equilibrium in a weighted total variation distance. Finally, we show that the corresponding Euler-Maruyama discretization admits moment bounds that are uniform in time, without any modification of the potential gradient, which ensures the stability of the resulting sampling algorithm.

AI.tldr: 本文研究非凸且非全局梯度Lipschitz势能下矩阵空间Gibbs分布的采样问题，提出一类非二次动能驱动的欠阻尼Langevin系统（动量预处理），证明其保持目标测度不变、以加权全变差距离指数收敛，且Euler-Maruyama离散具有一致有界矩，保证采样算法稳定。
AI.motivation: 经典欠阻尼Langevin采样理论通常依赖势能的凸性或全局梯度Lipschitz假设；在矩阵空间上，这类假设往往不成立，导致现有方法难以适用。因此需要放松对势能的正则性要求，设计能在非凸、非全局Lipschitz条件下仍具收敛与稳定性保证的采样动力学。
AI.method: 引入一类非二次动能函数，构造带动量预处理的欠阻尼Langevin系统，使动能梯度充当动量的光滑谱"驯化"（spectral taming）项以控制梯度爆炸；随后分析连续时间动力学的测度不变性与收敛性，并研究对应的Euler-Maruyama离散格式。
AI.result: 在放松的势能假设下，所提动力学保持目标Gibbs测度不变，并在加权全变差距离下实现指数收敛到平衡；对应Euler-Maruyama离散在无需修改势能梯度的情况下具有时间一致有界的矩估计，从而保证采样算法的数值稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过非二次动能与动量预处理，为矩阵空间上非凸、非全局梯度Lipschitz势能的Gibbs采样提供了兼具不变性、指数收敛与离散稳定性的理论框架。

title: SCM-based Fairness and Faithful Explainability for Legal Document Classification
summary: Transformer models such as LegalBERT are increasingly used in legal decision support, raising concerns about both fairness and the transparency of model explanations. These properties are usually evaluated separately, leaving open whether a debiasing intervention that changes fairness also changes how faithfully explanations reflect model reasoning. This study investigates that relationship on the ECtHR alleged-violations corpus from LexGLUE. It compares a LegalBERT baseline with a fairness-regularized variant that penalizes stereotypical warmth and competence representations during fine-tuning. The evaluation covers predictive performance, demographic fairness, and SHAP explanation faithfulness across five random seeds. At the performance-optimal regularization strength, the intervention does not reduce demographic disparity. This null result holds across two fairness definitions and a conventional word-pair control on the gender axis. Classification performance is largely unchanged. However, the intervention consistently degrades explanation sufficiency across all five seeds and three thresholds. A shuffled-pair control reproduces this degradation while leaving performance and fairness unchanged, indicating that the effect arises from contrastive representational regularization rather than specifically from the warmth and competence structure. The results demonstrate a dissociation between fairness and explanation faithfulness: changes in explanation behavior do not necessarily indicate changes in fairness, and fairness must therefore be evaluated directly.

AI.tldr: 本研究在 LexGLUE 的 ECtHR 指控违规语料上，比较 LegalBERT 基线与其公平性正则化变体，发现该干预未降低人口统计差异，却一致损害 SHAP 解释充分性，揭示公平性与解释忠实度之间的解耦。
AI.motivation: 法律决策支持中 Transformer 模型（如 LegalBERT）的公平性与解释透明度通常被分开评估，尚不清楚改变公平性的去偏干预是否会同时改变解释对模型推理的忠实程度。研究旨在直接考察二者的关系。
AI.method: 在 ECtHR 指控违规语料上，将 LegalBERT 基线与公平性正则化变体（在微调中惩罚刻板印象的"温暖"与"能力"表征）进行对比。评估涵盖预测性能、人口统计公平性以及跨五个随机种子的 SHAP 解释忠实度，并设置两种公平性定义、常规词对控制、打乱词对控制及三个阈值。
AI.result: 在性能最优的正则强度下，干预未降低人口统计差异，该零结果在两种公平性定义与性别轴常规词对控制下均成立，分类性能基本不变。但干预在全部五个种子与三个阈值上一致地降低了 SHAP 解释充分性。打乱词对控制重现了这种退化，同时性能与公平性不变，说明效应源于对比表征正则化而非特定的温暖/能力结构。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明了公平性与解释忠实度之间的解耦：解释行为的变化不一定指示公平性的变化，因此公平性必须被直接评估，而不能通过解释行为间接推断。

title: The First Token Is Not the Verdict: Hidden Costs of Reading LLM Judges Without Generating
summary: Reading an LLM judge's verdict from the logits of its first generated token is cheap, requires no generation, and is exactly what constrained decoding and likelihood-scoring evaluation harnesses produce. We show that this readout distorts position bias in one direction: it overstates it in every condition we test, so figures obtained this way behave as upper bounds. The mechanism is that judges do not always lead with a verdict token, on 12% to 49% of pairs for three Qwen3 judges and under 3% for Llama-3.1-8B and Phi-3.5-mini, and forcing a read on those pairs returns whichever response was shown first rather than a judgment. Pooled over the 924 pairs where a judge did not commit, the forced read flips on 89.7% of them when the responses are swapped, against 47.5% read after generation (paired difference +0.422, 95% CI [+0.365, +0.467]). The distortion is specific to what is measured: it moves position bias by 42 points while moving judge accuracy by under one point in seven of ten conditions, so it misleads whoever audits a judge rather than whoever uses one. A second, smaller failure occurs even when the judge does lead with a verdict token, since it sometimes opens with one letter and reasons its way to the other, on 0 to 5.5% of pairs at a rate uncorrelated with compliance. We recommend reporting the rate at which a judge leads with a verdict token, which costs one forward pass and no labels, alongside any position-bias figure.

AI.tldr: 从LLM评判器首个生成token的logits直接读取判决，会系统性高估位置偏差，该读数应视为上界；建议同时报告评判器以判决token开头的比例。
AI.motivation: 首个token的logits读取方式成本极低（无需生成），且正是约束解码与似然打分评估框架的默认产物，因此被广泛用于测量LLM评判器的位置偏差。但该读数是否忠实反映真实判决尚未被检验，存在审计结论失真的风险。
AI.method: 比较两种读数：一是首个生成token的logits强制读取，二是完整生成后的读取。在924个评判器未主动给出判决的配对上进行配对比较，并做响应交换实验。覆盖三个Qwen3评判器与Llama-3.1-8B、Phi-3.5-mini，共十个条件，同时分别追踪位置偏差与评判准确率的变化。
AI.result: 评判器未以判决token开头的比例为12%–49%（Qwen3系列），Llama-3.1-8B与Phi-3.5-mini则低于3%。强制读取在这些对上返回的是先展示的响应而非真实判断：在924个配对中交换响应顺序后，强制读取翻转率达89.7%，而生成后读取仅47.5%（配对差+0.422，95% CI [+0.365, +0.467]）。该扭曲具测量特异性：位置偏差变动42个百分点，而准确率在十个条件中的七个变动不足1个百分点。即便评判器以判决token开头，仍有0–5.5%的配对出现开头字母与最终推理结论不一致，且该比例与合规率不相关。
AI.conclusion: 首token logits读数构成位置偏差的上界而非估计值，误导的是审计者而非使用者。建议在任何位置偏差报告旁，附上评判器以判决token开头的比例，该指标仅需一次前向传播且无需标注。

title: On-Device Named-Entity Recognition: A Deployability Study of Accuracy, Cost, Reliability, and Confidence
comment: 7 pages, 5 figures, 12 tables. Code and per-span records reproduce all reported numbers offline
summary: Named-entity recognition (NER) is increasingly wanted on-device (no API, low latency, data kept local). The practitioner's question is not the leaderboard but which model is deployable, how to evaluate it without human annotation, and whether its confidence can be trusted. We answer these jointly. We place nine systems across three paradigms and 13 M to 8 B parameters: a classical tagger (spaCy), bidirectional-encoder specialists (GLiNER, 166 to 460 M), and generative LLMs run locally (Qwen3-0.6B/1.7B/4B-Instruct, DeepSeek-R1-1.5B/8B), on three datasets of differing character, and report accuracy plus two axes the literature omits: latency and output validity. Because our corpus (RSS-News) had no gold, we built silver gold from a cross-family LLM judge panel, then measured its fidelity against benchmark gold and a full human re-validation of the corpus (strict F1 0.95, an upper bound since the human gold was silver-seeded); gold provenance flips the paradigm ranking, moving from LLM-authored silver to human gold raises every encoder and lowers every generative model. On accuracy alone a 4 B instruct LLM is competitive (it leads on clean newswire), so the encoder's case is deployability: it matches or slightly trails at one-ninth to one-twenty-fourth the size, at millisecond-to-second latency, with zero malformed output, while the smallest generative models emit up to 27% invalid output on long inputs, a failure fixed by scale, not output budget. We then characterize GLiNER's per-span confidence: it ranks correctness well (AUROC 0.76 to 0.86) but is overconfident (ECE 0.24 to 0.47, halved by temperature scaling); thresholding gives a small honest out-of-sample F1 gain; an all-local small-to-large cascade gives a modest, corpus-dependent gain over cost-matched random routing; and confidence tracks correctness but not novelty. Every number recomputes offline from per-span records.

AI.tldr: 该研究从可部署性角度系统评测九种命名实体识别（NER）系统（spaCy、GLiNER 类编码器与本地生成式大模型），在三个数据集上除准确率外还报告延迟与输出有效性，并用跨家族 LLM 评审团构建银标准、经人工复核验证，进而刻画 GLiNER 的置信度校准与级联路由策略。
AI.motivation: 实践者关心的是端侧 NER 的部署可行性，而非榜单排名：哪个模型可部署、如何在无人工标注时评估、置信度是否可信。现有文献普遍忽略延迟与输出有效性两个维度，且未解决无金标准语料下的评测与置信度可信性问题。
AI.method: 选取九套系统、覆盖三大范式、13M–8B 参数规模：经典标注器 spaCy、双向编码器专才 GLiNER（166–460M）、本地运行的生成式 LLM（Qwen3-0.6B/1.7B/4B-Instruct、DeepSeek-R1-1.5B/8B）；在三个性质不同的数据集上评测准确率、延迟与输出有效性。针对无金标准的 RSS-News 语料，用跨家族 LLM 评审团构建银金标准，并对全语料做人工再验证以测量其保真度；进一步分析 GLiNER 的逐 span 置信度（排序能力与校准性）、阈值化收益，以及全本地小到大级联路由。
AI.result: 银金标准相对基准金标准的严格 F1 为 0.95（因人工金标准以银标准为种子，属上界）；金标准来源会翻转范式排序——从 LLM 银标准换为人工金标准后，所有编码器上升、所有生成模型下降。仅看准确率时 4B 指令模型具竞争力（在干净新闻稿上领先），但编码器的优势在于可部署性：体积仅为其 1/9 至 1/24、延迟毫秒至秒级、零畸形输出；最小的生成模型在长输入上畸形输出高达 27%，该问题靠规模而非输出预算解决。GLiNER 的置信度能较好排序正确性（AUROC 0.76–0.86）但过度自信（ECE 0.24–0.47，温度缩放可减半）；阈值化带来小幅且诚实的样本外 F1 增益；全本地小到大级联相对等成本随机路由仅有适度且依赖语料的增益；置信度能追踪正确性但不追踪新颖性。所有数值均可由逐 span 记录离线复算。
AI.conclusion: 端侧 NER 的选型应由可部署性决定而非单看准确率：编码器专才在体积、延迟与输出有效性上占优；生成式模型的格式失效随规模缓解；无金标准场景下银金标准来源会实质影响范式结论，置信度可用于排序但需校准，级联路由收益有限。全部指标可离线复算，保证可复现性。

title: Measuring Human-Like Bias in LLMs? A Critique of Human-Derived Bias Constructs in LLM Evaluation
summary: Researchers increasingly use human-derived bias constructs to study Large Language Models (LLMs), including social-cognitive constructs such as implicit bias and stereotype activation, and cognitive biases such as anchoring, framing effects, and confirmation bias. Such approaches offer alternatives to overt bias probes, particularly when direct questioning may obscure bias or when model behaviour appears normatively acceptable. However, adapting human bias constructs to LLMs introduces an inferential gap. Psychological instruments were developed to study human cognition and social behaviour, whereas LLM evaluations rely on probabilities, text completions, rankings, or simulated decisions. This paper critiques human-centered bias evaluation in LLMs. We show how this gap arises from mismatches pertaining to human-derived constructs, human-model differences, and evaluation contexts, which can blur distinct interpretations of model bias. We then introduce a framework providing an analytical lens for relating these elements to warranted interpretations, with attention to target constructs, operationalizations, scope of inference, and limits of human analogy.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性地审视了大语言模型（LLM）偏见评估中直接套用人类偏见构念的做法，指出其存在"推断鸿沟"，并提出一个分析框架来规范相关解释。
AI.motivation: 研究者日益借助人类衍生的偏见构念（如内隐偏见、刻板印象激活、锚定效应、框架效应、确认偏误）来研究LLM。这类方法可替代显性偏见探测，尤其当直接提问会掩盖偏见或模型行为在规范上看似可接受时。然而，将人类偏见构念迁移至LLM会引入推断鸿沟：心理测量工具本为研究人类认知与社会行为而设计，而LLM评估依赖概率、文本补全、排序或模拟决策，两者并不对等。作者因此希望对这一以人为中心的偏见评估范式进行批判性反思。
AI.method: 本文属于批判性与框架构建类研究，而非实证研究。作者首先剖析推断鸿沟的成因，归纳出三类错配：人类衍生构念本身的错配、人-模型差异的错配、以及评估情境的错配，这些错配会模糊对模型偏见的不同解读。随后提出一个分析框架，用于将这些要素与有根据的解释相联结。
AI.result: 分析表明，推断鸿沟源于构念、人-模型差异与评估情境三个层面的错配，这些错配可能导致对模型偏见产生混淆甚至不兼容的解释。所提框架围绕目标构念、操作化方式、推断范围以及人类类比的限度四个维度，提供了一套分析视角。
AI.conclusion: 将人类偏见构念直接迁移到LLM评估需谨慎对待其推断限度。所提框架有助于研究者明确目标构念、操作化与推断范围，厘清人类类比的适用边界，从而提升LLM偏见评估的解释效度与严谨性。

title: Legal text classification in Korean sexual offense cases: from traditional machine learning to large language models with XAI insights
comment: 22 pages, 3 figures. Published in Artificial Intelligence and Law
summary: The advancement of natural language processing (NLP) has expanded AI-based text classification in the legal domain. However, accurately classifying legal documents remains challenging due to the complexity of legal texts and subtle differences between legal categories. This study evaluates legal text classification models ranging from traditional machine learning techniques to large language models (LLMs) using ten categories of Korean sexual offense precedents. The results show that fine-tuning small-scale models such as KLUE-BERT on legal data outperforms general-purpose models such as GPT-3.5 and GPT-4.0, as well as traditional machine learning models. KLUE-BERT achieved the highest accuracy of 99.3%, indicating that domain adaptation and fine-tuning can be more important than model size for legal document classification. We further employ explainable AI (XAI) techniques to analyze model predictions and misclassification cases. XAI analysis identifies linguistic features influencing model decisions and limitations in capturing subtle textual cues. Using KICS data, which closely resembles real-world legal case records, we further evaluate the model's generalization capabilities and find that it struggles to interpret implicit contextual cues. These findings highlight the importance of both performance and interpretability in legal AI and demonstrate how XAI can improve transparency in legal text classification. AI-assisted tools can support legal professionals in tasks including document classification, legal information retrieval, and case assessment.

AI.tldr: 本研究在韩国性犯罪判例的十个类别上，比较了传统机器学习、通用大语言模型（GPT-3.5、GPT-4.0）和小规模微调模型（如KLUE-BERT）的法律文本分类性能，并结合可解释AI（XAI）分析预测与误分类案例。
AI.motivation: 法律文本复杂、法律类别间差异细微，导致法律文书自动分类困难；同时需明确领域适配/微调与模型规模孰更重要，并提升法律AI的透明度与可解释性。
AI.method: 构建韩国性犯罪判例的十个类别数据集；对比三类模型：传统机器学习、通用LLM（GPT-3.5、GPT-4.0）、小规模领域模型（KLUE-BERT等）微调；采用XAI技术分析模型预测依据与误分类；并使用与真实法律案件记录更接近的KICS数据进行泛化能力评估。
AI.result: KLUE-BERT等小规模模型经法律数据微调后优于通用GPT-3.5、GPT-4.0及传统机器学习模型，最高准确率达99.3%；XAI揭示了影响模型决策的语言特征及捕获细微文本线索的局限；在KICS数据上模型难以解释隐含语境线索，泛化能力受限。
AI.conclusion: 对法律文书分类而言，领域适配与微调可能比模型规模更重要；法律AI需兼顾性能与可解释性，XAI可提升法律文本分类透明度；AI辅助工具可支持法律专业人士完成文书分类、法律信息检索与案件评估等任务。

title: FACET at WMT 2026 Automated Translation Quality Evaluation Task
comment: Accepted at WMT 2026 (shared task system paper)
summary: Different error types in machine translation require different evidence. Whether meaning is preserved can be judged only against the source, while whether the target is well-formed, or whether it names one entity consistently, can be judged from the target alone. We present FACET, our reference-free submission to the WMT26 Automated Translation Quality Evaluation Task, which decomposes evaluation into Fluency, Accuracy, and Consistency passes and gives each pass only the context its error type requires. A single fixed model is prompted three times, and the merged error spans yield the three task outputs, error spans, quality scores, and error-free labels, with no trained components. We also submit FACET-C, which omits the Consistency pass. Without gold labels, we characterize the predictions of FACET. Its system rankings place post-edited human translation first, and the Consistency pass changes about a tenth of segment scores while leaving the ranking nearly unchanged.

AI.tldr: FACET is a reference-free, non-trained MT evaluation system submitted to WMT26, which decomposes evaluation into Fluency, Accuracy, and Consistency passes, each given only the context its error type requires; it outputs error spans, quality scores, and error-free labels.
AI.motivation: Different MT error types require different evidence: meaning preservation must be judged against the source, while target well-formedness and entity naming consistency can be judged from the target alone. Existing evaluation typically supplies the same context to all error types.
AI.method: A single fixed model is prompted three times, once per pass (Fluency, Accuracy, Consistency), each conditioned only on the context its error type needs; merged error spans produce three task outputs. No trained components are used. A variant, FACET-C, omits the Consistency pass.
AI.result: System rankings place post-edited human translation first. The Consistency pass alters about a tenth of segment scores while leaving the ranking nearly unchanged.
AI.conclusion: The error-type-specific context decomposition yields competitive reference-free evaluation without training, and the Consistency pass mainly refines segment-level scores rather than changing system-level rankings.

title: BudgetSchemaBench: A Budget-Swept Diagnostic for Schema Context in Text-to-SQL
summary: Data agents over structured sources must fit database schema into the model's context window. Large catalogs can span many databases and thousands of columns, so cost constraints may require choosing between table coverage and serialization detail well before the context window is full. We introduce BudgetSchemaBench, an execution-grounded diagnostic for this setting. Its construction derives relevance labels mechanically from gold SQL, without human- or LLM-authored ground truth. Using a pooled 80-database catalog, we sweep four schema-context budgets and compare three representations while keeping each retriever's table ranking fixed. A source-namespace check rejects queries that obtain the correct result from the wrong database. The evaluation covers three conditions: end-to-end retrieval; frozen-gold, in which the required tables are guaranteed; and a probe that removes those tables. For the primary solver with raw serialization, raising the budget from 2.5% to 50% of the catalog improves execution accuracy on 1,279 held-out questions by 18 percentage points under lexical retrieval but only 3 under dense retrieval; the dense retriever already finds most required tables at the smallest budget. When the required tables are removed, 94.6% of correct predictions name one of them exactly, consistent with reconstruction of absent schema from parametric knowledge. For the two main solvers in the frozen-gold condition, the three representations differ by at most 2 percentage points, and the widest paired 95% confidence interval bounds the difference within +/-4 points. We observe the same qualitative patterns with one reasoning model from a different family. When retrieval is coverage-limited, execution accuracy is more sensitive to the schema budget than to the tested serializations. The diagnostic and the code used to construct and evaluate it are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出 BudgetSchemaBench，一个执行导向的诊断基准，研究结构化数据源智能体在 schema 上下文预算受限时，表覆盖与序列化细节的权衡。
AI.motivation: 大型数据库目录可跨多库、数千列，需将 schema 适配进模型上下文窗口；在上下文未满前，成本约束已迫使在表覆盖与序列化细节间做取舍，但缺乏执行层面的系统评测。
AI.method: 构建 BudgetSchemaBench：相关性标签从金标准 SQL 机械推导，无需人工或 LLM 标注。使用 80 库汇总目录，扫描四种 schema 上下文预算，在固定检索器表排序的前提下比较三种表示；设源命名空间检查以排除"正确结果来自错误数据库"的查询。评测含三条件：端到端检索、frozen-gold（保证所需表存在）、以及移除所需表的探针。
AI.result: 主求解器+原始序列化下，预算从目录 2.5% 提升至 50%，在 1,279 道留出题上词法检索执行准确率提升 18 个百分点，稠密检索仅 3 个百分点（稠密检索在最小预算已找到多数所需表）。移除所需表时，94.6% 的正确预测恰好命中其中一张表，符合从参数化知识重建缺失 schema。frozen-gold 下两主求解器三种表示差异至多 2 个百分点，配对 95% 置信区间在 ±4 点内。另一模型家族的推理模型呈相同定性模式。
AI.conclusion: 当检索受覆盖度限制时，执行准确率对 schema 预算的敏感度高于所测序列化方式。诊断基准与构建、评测代码公开。

title: CAVE-Mem: Boundary-Aware Experience Validation for Memory Search
summary: Long-term memory agents increasingly rely on it- erative search and reusable experience to answer questions over large personal, factual, or narrative histories. However, current experience-memory systems largely optimize relevance: they re- trieve past search lessons that appear similar to the current state and inject them into the prompt. A relevant experience can still be harmful when the memory substrate, question intent, answer granularity, or evidence boundary changes. We propose CAVE- Mem, a training-free framework that represents experience as a typed intervention operator with applicability, boundary, and utility conditions. CAVE-Mem first obtains a base memory-search answer, then allows an operator to change it only if the oper- ator matches the current substrate, answer contract, evidence boundary, and cross-fitted utility; otherwise the system abstains. Experiments across long-term conversational memory, multi-hop question answering, and long-document narrative reasoning show consistent gains over relevance-only experience reuse.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架CAVE-Mem，将经验表示为带适用条件、边界条件和效用条件的类型化干预算子，仅当算子满足当前匹配条件时改变基础记忆搜索结果，否则弃权。
AI.motivation: 当前经验记忆系统主要优化相关性，检索与当前状态相似的历史搜索经验并注入提示词。但即使经验相关，当记忆基质、问题意图、答案粒度或证据边界发生变化时，该经验仍可能有害。
AI.method: CAVE-Mem为免训练框架，经验被表示为类型化干预算子，具备适用性、边界与效用条件。流程上先获得基础记忆搜索答案，仅当算子匹配当前记忆基质、答案契约、证据边界并通过交叉拟合效用检验时，才允许其修改答案，否则系统弃权。
AI.result: 在长期对话记忆、多跳问答和长文档叙事推理任务上，相较仅基于相关性的经验复用方法取得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 从"相关性优先"转向"条件化干预"，通过显式建模经验适用边界与效用，可避免有害的经验复用，提升长期记忆智能体的鲁棒性与效果。

title: When a Data Artifact Isn't a Shortcut: Causal Auditing of Synthetic RLVR Corpora
summary: Several recent pipelines build RLVR training data by masking a span of real corpus text and asking a language model to invent plausible wrong answers around it. The correct option is therefore genuine human prose; every distractor is synthetic. Correctness and provenance become entangled, and a policy could in principle learn the second instead of the first. We audit that possibility in GooseReason-0.7M. First we ask whether the asymmetry is visible at all: a classifier reading only five surface statistics (never the meaning) reaches AUROC 0.562 over 315,499 options, barely above chance. The aggregate hides something, though. Code sits at 0.416, below chance, and manual inspection explains why: code distractors turn out to be single-operator mutations of the gold answer rather than freely written alternatives, so the two classes are nearly identical by construction. Detecting a signal is not the same as showing a model uses it, so we then run an intervention. We build a paraphrase-matched control corpus, hold training-set size identical across arms, and train two policies under one fixed budget. The exploitation gap does not favour the unmodified-data arm: 0.021 against 0.027 for the control. Under our budget, in other words, a detectable artifact went unexploited. We think that dissociation, along with the domain-specific construction finding, is worth knowing for anyone curating corpora of this kind, and we release the audit as a mostly CPU-only protocol.

AI.tldr: 该文审计 RLVR 数据中"正确答案为真实语料、干扰项为合成文本"的来源不对称是否会被策略利用：表面统计分类器的 AUROC 仅 0.562，代码域甚至低于随机（0.416）；在等预算的干预实验中，未修改数据组与释义匹配对照组差距仅 0.021 对 0.027，表明可检测的伪影在给定预算下未被利用。
AI.motivation: 近期多条流水线通过掩码真实语料片段、让语言模型围绕其编造看似合理的错误答案来构建 RLVR 训练数据，导致正确选项是真实人类文本、干扰项均为合成文本，正确性与来源（provenance）相互纠缠，策略可能学到"来源"而非"正确性"。作者希望审计这一潜在捷径是否真实存在并被模型利用。
AI.method: 分两步审计 GooseReason-0.7M：（1）可检测性检验——用仅含五个表面统计量的分类器（不读语义）在 315,499 个选项上判别，并分领域分析；（2）干预实验——构建释义匹配的对照语料，严格控制两组训练集规模与训练预算一致，训练两个策略比较"利用差距"。
AI.result: 表面分类器整体 AUROC 仅 0.562，略高于随机；但代码域为 0.416，低于随机，人工检查发现代码干扰项实为金答案的单算子变异，两类构造上几乎相同。干预实验中，未修改数据组利用差距为 0.021，对照组为 0.027，差距并不偏向未修改数据组。
AI.conclusion: 可检测的伪影与模型实际利用之间存在分离：在该预算下，可检测的来源伪影未被策略利用；同时揭示了代码域干扰项构造的特殊性。作者认为这一分离与领域特定构造发现对同类语料策划者具有参考价值，并发布了一套基本仅需 CPU 的审计协议。

title: A Holistic Assessment of the Carbon Footprint of Noor, a Very Large Arabic Language Model
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Published in Proceedings of BigScience Episode #5 -- Workshop on Challenges & Perspectives in Creating Large Language Models (ACL 2022)
summary: As ever larger language models grow more ubiquitous, it is crucial to consider their environmental impact. Characterised by extreme size and resource use, recent generations of models have been criticised for their voracious appetite for compute, and thus significant carbon footprint. Although reporting of carbon impact has grown more common in machine learning papers, this reporting is usually limited to compute resources used strictly for training. In this work, we propose a holistic assessment of the footprint of an extreme-scale language model, Noor. Noor is an ongoing project aiming to develop the largest multi-task Arabic language models -- with up to 13B parameters -- leveraging zero-shot generalisation to enable a wide range of downstream tasks via natural language instructions. We assess the total carbon bill of the entire project: starting with data collection and storage costs, including research and development budgets, pretraining costs, future serving estimates, and other exogenous costs necessary for this international cooperation. Notably, we find that inference costs and exogenous factors can have a significant impact on total budget. Finally, we discuss pathways to reduce the carbon footprint of extreme-scale models.

AI.tldr: 本文对极端规模阿拉伯语多任务语言模型Noor项目进行了全生命周期碳排放评估，涵盖数据采集与存储、研发、预训练、未来推理服务及国际合作中的外生成本，发现推理成本与外生因素对总碳预算影响显著，并探讨了降低碳足迹的路径。
AI.motivation: 随着超大规模语言模型日益普及，其环境成本备受关注。以往机器学习论文的碳报告通常仅局限于训练阶段的计算资源消耗，忽视了数据、研发、推理及国际协作等环节的整体碳账单，因此需要一个更全面的评估框架。
AI.method: 本文提出一种整体性评估方法，以NoOR项目（目标为最大规模多任务阿拉伯语语言模型，参数规模可达13B，依托零样本泛化通过自然语言指令支持下游任务）为案例，系统核算项目全生命周期碳排放：包括数据采集与存储成本、研究与开发预算、预训练成本、未来服务（推理）估算，以及国际合作所需的其他外生成本。
AI.result: 研究发现推理成本和外生因素对总碳预算具有显著影响，表明仅报告训练阶段碳排放会严重低估极端规模语言模型的真实碳足迹。
AI.conclusion: 对极端规模语言模型应采用涵盖全流程的整体性碳足迹评估；并在此基础上讨论了降低此类模型碳足迹的可行路径。

title: Signed Lexical Confidence for Risk-Calibrated Intent Routing
summary: Selective intent routing allows an assistant to act on reliable predictions while deferring uncertain requests. Standard confidence scores primarily reflect the base model's representation, leaving an opportunity to incorporate complementary evidence without changing its decisions. We introduce a signed lexical gate that combines a sentence classifier's logit margin with a sparse lexical model's support for the classifier's predicted intent. By assigning positive evidence to lexical agreement and negative evidence to a lexically favored competing intent, the gate retains more information than either unsigned lexical confidence or a hard agreement rule. An independent binomial calibration stage selects an operating threshold for a specified risk target. Across ten runs on BANKING77, CLINC150, and HWU64, the proposed score reduces area under the risk-coverage curve by 15.8%, 15.1%, and 11.8% relative to a learned semantic-only gate. At a nominal 5% error target, it increases accepted coverage by 1.83 and 5.14 percentage points on BANKING77 and HWU64, while CLINC150 is already near full coverage. At a stricter 2% target, the simultaneous binomial procedure yields a nonempty policy in all 30 dataset-run combinations at the available calibration budgets. Matched controls show that the proposed feature improves average error ranking over the tested unsigned lexical-confidence feature, with dataset-dependent gains over binary agreement. The resulting two-feature gate provides a compact, interpretable confidence enhancement for risk-calibrated intent routing while preserving the base classifier's predictions.

AI.tldr: 提出一种带符号词汇门控特征，结合句子分类器的logit margin与稀疏词汇模型的支持证据，在不改变基分类器预测的前提下增强选择性意图路由的置信度校准。
AI.motivation: 选择性意图路由需要助手在可靠预测上执行、对不确定请求延迟处理。标准置信度主要反映基模型自身表示，未利用互补证据，因此存在在不改变基模型决策的前提下引入额外证据以改进风险-覆盖权衡的空间。
AI.method: 设计带符号词汇门控：将句子分类器的logit margin与稀疏词汇模型对预测意图的支持相结合，对词汇一致性赋予正证据、对词汇偏好的竞争意图赋予负证据；再用独立二项校准阶段按指定风险目标选择操作阈值。
AI.result: 在BANKING77、CLINC150、HWU64各十次运行中，相较仅语义的学习门控，风险-覆盖曲线下面积分别降低15.8%、15.1%、11.8%；5%误差目标下，BANKING77和HWU64接受覆盖率提升1.83和5.14个百分点，CLINC150已接近全覆盖；2%更严目标下，30个数据集-运行组合在可用校准预算内均得到非空策略。匹配对照显示所提特征在平均误差排序上优于无符号词汇置信特征，相对二元一致性规则有依数据集而变的增益。
AI.conclusion: 该双特征门控为风险校准的意图路由提供了紧凑、可解释的置信度增强方法，同时保留基分类器的预测不变。

title: Metric-Construction Coupling Inflates Measured Synthetic Dialect Recovery
summary: Korean dialect corpora are available but not redistributable: weights may be released, while reproducing training and evaluation from the underlying data cannot be. We ask how much of that supervision synthetic data recovers, and whether that recovery can be measured independently of the synthesis pipeline. We contribute KoDialectBench, 1,000 items across five regions on three axes, released as identifier hashes and scoring code so users reconstruct the items from their own licensed copy. Recovery is strongly axis-dependent: our best synthetic arm reaches 91.2% of the real-data gain on region identification but 63.7% on comprehension. On generation the answer depends on the metric: the deployed marker lexicon reports 92.3% on dialectness and 119.3% on region match, the latter exceeding the real-data reference, whereas reference-based generation reaches 72.4%. We find the marker metrics' scoring inventory is entirely contained in the inventory our transformation rules can emit. We test the effect of construction access directly with an exact-form construction-disjoint arm that withholds 20% of marker types from the rules. At exactly matched training size (8,600 examples) it reduces dialectness recovery from 91.8% to 8.1% and region-match recovery from 101.9% to 25.6% on the held-out marker inventory, while the three pipeline-independent measurements do not fall at all. A complementary evaluator sweep defines metric-construction coverage (MCC) and finds measured dialectness recovery increasing monotonically as overlap rises from MCC=0 to MCC=1. Shared construction and evaluation inventories can therefore substantially inflate estimates of synthetic-data recovery.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 KoDialectBench（5 个地区、3 个评测轴、1,000 条）以哈希标识符与评分代码形式发布，探讨合成数据能在多大程度上替代不可再分发的韩语方言语料监督信号，并指出合成数据"恢复率"高度依赖评测轴与指标，且当构造（合成规则）与评测的标记库重叠时会被系统性高估。
AI.motivation: 韩语方言语料虽存在却不可再分发：模型权重可以释放，但基于原始数据复现训练与评测不可能。作者由此追问两个问题：(1) 合成数据能恢复多少这部分监督信号；(2) 这种恢复能否在合成管线之外被独立度量。核心关切是：当合成规则与评测指标共享同一套构造成分时，恢复率估计是否被人为放大。
AI.method: 贡献 KoDialectBench：跨 5 个地区、3 个评测轴（地区识别、理解、生成）共 1,000 条，以标识符哈希与评分代码发布，用户可用自有授权语料重建条目。实验采用多种指标对照（部署的标记词表指标 vs. 基于参考的生成指标）。关键技术设计：(1) 精确形式、构造不相交（construction-disjoint）的实验臂，从规则中扣留 20% 标记类型；(2) 在严格匹配训练规模（8,600 条）下比较；(3) 互补的评测器扫描，定义指标-构造覆盖度（MCC），观察 MCC 从 0 升至 1 时测得恢复率的变化；(4) 另设三项与合成管线无关的独立测量作为对照。
AI.result: 恢复率强烈依赖评测轴：最佳合成臂在地区识别上达到真实数据增益的 91.2%，理解任务仅 63.7%。生成任务取决于指标：部署的标记词表指标在方言度上报 92.3%、地区匹配上报 119.3%（超过真实数据参照），而基于参考的生成仅 72.4%。作者发现标记指标的打分清单完全被其变换规则可输出的清单所包含。构造不相交臂在匹配训练规模下，方言度恢复从 91.8% 降至 8.1%，地区匹配恢复从 101.9% 降至 25.6%（留出标记清单上），而三项管线无关测量完全不下降。评测器扫描显示，MCC 从 0 到 1 上升时测得方言度恢复单调递增。
AI.conclusion: 共享构造与评测清单会实质性夸大合成数据"恢复率"的估计。因此，在合成数据替代不可分发语料的评估中，必须区分管线依赖与管线无关的度量，并控制指标-构造覆盖度（MCC），否则所报恢复率可能主要是评测与合成规则重叠造成的人为产物，而非真实监督信号的迁移。

title: Certainty Is Not Just Correctness: Rethinking Token-Level Certainty in LLM Reasoning
summary: Token-level certainty is widely used as a proxy for correctness in LLM training and inference. However, the performance of certainty-based methods depends both on the information in certainty scores and on how those scores are used. We therefore directly assess certainty's predictive ability through controlled empirical evaluations across models and tasks. We distinguish two prediction targets: identifying questions a model is more likely to answer correctly and distinguishing correct from incorrect responses to the same question. In our experiments, certainty is generally better at identifying questions a model is likely to answer correctly than at distinguishing correct from incorrect responses to the same question. Certainty also varies systematically across token types and positions within words, reflecting local properties of words and text form. Information about question difficulty appears early in generation, while the weaker information about answer correctness is more concentrated near the end. These findings show that the information certainty provides for decisions depends on the prediction target, the model, the certainty metric, and which token positions in the response are included in aggregation. We further demonstrate the practical value of these findings for test-time compute. We allocate the number of responses using certainty early in generation and weight answer votes using certainty near the end of each response. Compared with a fixed-sampling majority-voting baseline, this approach increases overall accuracy from 78.71\% to 79.54\% while reducing generated-token cost by 82.4\%.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过受控实验系统评估了LLM中token级确定性(certainty)的预测能力，发现确定性的信息价值取决于预测目标、模型、度量指标及聚合位置，并据此提出提高测试时计算效率的采样与投票策略。
AI.motivation: token级确定性常被用作正确性的代理指标，但其效果既取决于确定性分数所包含的信息，也取决于这些分数的使用方式。已有研究缺乏对"确定性到底能预测什么"的直接、受控评估，因此需要区分不同预测目标来厘清其真实预测能力。
AI.method: 跨模型、跨任务开展受控实证评估，区分两类预测目标：(1)识别模型更可能答对的问题（问题难度）；(2)对同一问题区分正确与错误回答。同时分析确定性在不同token类型、词内位置上的系统变化，以及生成过程中信息的时序分布。
AI.result: 确定性在"识别模型可能答对的问题"上表现普遍优于"区分同一问题的对错回答"。确定性随token类型和词内位置系统变化，反映词的局部属性与文本形式。问题难度信息在生成早期即出现，而较弱的答案正确性信息更集中于生成末尾。
AI.conclusion: 确定性所提供信息的决策价值依赖于预测目标、模型、确定性度量以及响应中纳入聚合的token位置。基于此，在生成早期用确定性分配响应数量、在响应末尾用确定性加权答案投票，相比固定采样多数投票基线，将整体准确率从78.71%提升至79.54%，同时减少82.4%的生成token开销。

title: DuplexSpeechBench-Document Grounding: Benchmarking Document Grounding and Hallucinations in Voice Agents
summary: Voice agents enable low-latency, natural interaction, yet their ability to faithfully ground responses in external documents remains underexplored. We introduce DuplexSpeechBench-Document Grounding (DSB-DG), a benchmark for evaluating document grounding in voice agents across five professional domains. DSB-DG targets three failure modes: Context Saturation, which measures grounding under increasing document length; Grounding Decay, which measures retention of document facts across multi-turn dialogue; and Proactive Grounding, which evaluates whether context re-injection mitigates conversational drift. The benchmark contains 1,636 adversarially verified QA pairs from 50 documents covering five professional domains, and supports fully automatic evaluation of grounding accuracy, hallucination, and response latency. Across systems spanning cascaded, proprietary full-duplex and real-time, and open-weight speech2speech architectures, we find substantial differences in effective grounding capacity. While cascaded pipeline (ASR-LLM-TTS) achieves the highest grounding accuracy, Gemini-Live and GPT-Realtime closely trail behind. Open-weight systems exhibit distinct failure modes, most notably an abrupt context-capacity collapse and multi-turn grounding decay. More broadly, grounding fidelity degrades with context and conversational load, and failures frequently manifest as unsupported generations rather than abstention. We show that contextual grounding as a key unresolved challenge for reliable full-duplex voice agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出语音智能体文档接地基准DSB-DG，含五个专业领域50份文档、1636条对抗性验证QA对，支持接地准确率、幻觉与响应延迟的自动评测，并揭示不同语音系统在有效接地能力上的显著差异。
AI.motivation: 语音智能体虽能实现低延迟自然交互，但其在外部文档中忠实接地（grounding）的能力尚缺乏系统研究，且该能力对可靠应用至关重要。现有工作缺少针对语音场景、覆盖多种失效模式的评测基准。
AI.method: 构建DSB-DG基准，覆盖五个专业领域，聚焦三类失效模式：上下文饱和（随文档长度增加的接地能力）、接地衰减（多轮对话中文档事实保持）、主动接地（上下文重注入是否缓解对话漂移）。基准包含来自50份文档的1636条对抗性验证QA对，支持全自动评测接地准确率、幻觉与响应延迟。评测对象涵盖级联式、专有全双工与实时系统、开源speech-to-speech架构。
AI.result: 级联管线（ASR-LLM-TTS）接地准确率最高，Gemini-Live与GPT-Realtime紧随其后；开源系统表现出独特失效模式，最明显的是上下文容量骤降与多轮接地衰减。接地保真度随上下文与对话负载增加而下降，失败常表现为无依据生成而非拒答。
AI.conclusion: 上下文接地是可靠全双工语音智能体尚未解决的关键挑战，DSB-DG为系统诊断与改进提供了标准化评测工具。

title: Dissonant ballerinas and crafty carrots: a comparative multi-modal analysis of Italian brain rot
summary: This paper presents a comparative multi-modal analysis of Italian and Romanian brain rot memes, investigating the factors that contribute to its appeal and the linguistic and cultural distinctions between the two versions. To conduct this analysis, we introduce a multi-modal brain rot dataset named CRIB (Collection of Romanian and Italian Brain rot), a manually curated collection of 240 TikTok videos stratified by language (Italian, Romanian) and popularity, on which we examine textual, acoustic, and visual features. Our findings indicate that popularity is not significantly correlated with textual elements like sentiment, absurdity, or rhyme, or acoustic elements such as vocal features or sentiment of the sound. Instead, in Romanian language, video-level dynamics, specifically faster cutting speeds and a more rapid overall pace, are strong predictors of a video's success. The cross-linguistic analysis reveals significant differences. Italian brain rot is textually more negative, exhibits higher perplexity, and uses more rhyme, while its sound is characterized by higher melodic range and loudness. Romanian audio is spectrally brighter with more erratic pitch variations.

AI.tldr: 本文对意大利语与罗马尼亚语"brain rot"梗视频进行多模态对比分析，并发布新数据集CRIB（240个TikTok视频），考察文本、声学与视觉特征。结果显示流行度与文本/声学特征无显著相关，罗马尼亚语中剪辑速度与整体节奏是成功的强预测因子，两语言在文本与音频上存在显著差异。
AI.motivation: 探究"brain rot"类梗视频的吸引力来源，并揭示意大利语与罗马尼亚语两个版本在语言与文化层面的差异，同时填补该现象在多模态数据与跨语言研究上的空白。
AI.method: 构建CRIB数据集：人工筛选240个TikTok视频，按语言（意大利语、罗马尼亚语）与流行度分层；对文本、声学与视觉特征进行多模态提取与对比分析，并结合跨语言比较与流行度预测分析。
AI.result: 流行度与文本要素（情感、荒诞性、押韵）及声学要素（嗓音特征、声音情感）均无显著相关；在罗马尼亚语中，视频层面的动态特征（更快的剪辑速度与更快的整体节奏）是视频成功的强预测因子。跨语言分析显示：意大利语文本更负面、困惑度更高、押韵更多，声音旋律范围更广、响度更高；罗马尼亚语音频频谱更亮、音高变化更不稳定。
AI.conclusion: "brain rot"梗的流行度主要由视频节奏与剪辑动态而非文本或声学内容决定，且不同语言版本在语言与听觉特征上呈现显著文化差异。

title: LLM-as-a-Judge for Low-Resource Languages: Adapting Ragas and Comparative Ranking for Romanian
summary: Evaluating Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems remains a challenge for Low-Resource Languages (LRLs), where standard reference-based metrics fall short. This paper investigates the viability of the "LLM-as-a-Judge" paradigm for Romanian by adapting the Ragas framework using next-generation models (Gemini 2.5 and Gemini 3). We introduce AdminRo-Eval, a curated dataset of Romanian administrative documents annotated by native speakers, to serve as a ground truth for benchmarking automated evaluators. We compare three evaluation methodologies - direct scoring, comparative ranking, and granular decomposition - across metrics for Faithfulness, Answer Relevance, and Context Relevance. Our findings reveal that evaluation strategies must be metric-specific: granular decomposition achieves the highest human alignment for Faithfulness (96% with Gemini 2.5 Pro), while comparative ranking outperforms in Answer Relevance (90%). Furthermore, we demonstrate that while lightweight models struggle with complex reasoning in LRLs, the Gemini 2.5 Pro architecture establishes a robust, transferable baseline for automated Romanian RAG evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文探索将"LLM-as-a-Judge"范式引入罗马尼亚语RAG评估，构建了母语者标注的AdminRo-Eval数据集，并比较直接打分、对比排序与细粒度分解三种方法。结果显示评估策略需因指标而异：细粒度分解在忠实度上对齐度最高（Gemini 2.5 Pro达96%），对比排序在答案相关性上更优（90%）。
AI.motivation: 低资源语言（LRLs）中RAG系统评估困难，标准基于参考答案的指标难以适用，缺乏可靠的自动化评估手段与基准数据。
AI.method: 适配Ragas框架，采用新一代模型（Gemini 2.5与Gemini 3）实现LLM-as-a-Judge；构建由母语者标注的罗马尼亚语行政文档数据集AdminRo-Eval作为真值基准；在忠实度、答案相关性、上下文相关性三类指标上比较直接打分、对比排序与细粒度分解三种评估方法。
AI.result: 细粒度分解在忠实度上人类对齐度最高（Gemini 2.5 Pro达96%）；对比排序在答案相关性上表现最佳（90%）；轻量级模型在低资源语言的复杂推理中表现不佳，而Gemini 2.5 Pro架构可建立稳健且可迁移的罗马尼亚语RAG自动评估基线。
AI.conclusion: RAG自动评估策略应针对具体指标分别设计，而非采用统一方法；Gemini 2.5 Pro为低资源语言的RAG评估提供了可靠、可迁移的基线，AdminRo-Eval可作为此类自动评估器评测的ground truth。

title: UniBuc at SemEval-2024 Task 2: Tailored Prompting with Solar for Clinical NLI
summary: This paper describes the approach of the UniBuc team in tackling the SemEval 2024 Task 2: Safe Biomedical Natural Language Inference for Clinical Trials. We used SOLAR Instruct, without any fine-tuning, while focusing on input manipulation and tailored prompting. By customizing prompts for individual CTR sections, in both zero-shot and few-shots settings, we managed to achieve a consistency score of 0.72, ranking 14th in the leaderboard. Our thorough error analysis revealed that our model has a tendency to take shortcuts and rely on simple heuristics, especially when dealing with semantic-preserving changes.

AI.tldr: UniBuc团队在SemEval 2024 Task 2中，基于SOLAR Instruct模型，通过输入操控与定制化提示（针对CTR各章节、零样本与少样本设置）实现一致性得分0.72，排名第14。误差分析显示模型倾向走捷径、依赖简单启发式，尤其面对语义保持变化时表现突出。
AI.motivation: 参加SemEval 2024 Task 2（临床试验安全生物医学自然语言推理），探索在不微调大模型的前提下，如何通过输入操控和提示定制来提升推理一致性。
AI.method: 使用SOLAR Instruct模型，不进行任何微调；核心在于输入操控（input manipulation）与定制化提示（tailored prompting），针对临床研究报告（CTR）不同章节分别设计提示，并在零样本（zero-shot）与少样本（few-shot）设置下进行实验。
AI.result: 一致性得分（consistency score）达到0.72，在排行榜中位列第14名。
AI.conclusion: 详尽的误差分析表明，模型倾向于采取捷径并依赖简单启发式策略，尤其在处理语义保持变化（semantic-preserving changes）时问题尤为明显。

title: CAST: Cost-Aware Speculative Trees from One-Pass Block Drafters
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by drafting future tokens cheaply and verifying them with the target model in parallel. Block drafters score a whole block of future tokens in one forward pass, yet standard decoding verifies only the top-scoring chain and discards the other candidates. Because these candidates are already scored, verifying more of them adds target computation but no extra drafting. We introduce CAST (Cost-Aware Speculative Trees), which packs these candidates into a tree and verifies it in a single target pass, leaving the target model, drafter weights, and decoding rule untouched. To decide how wide the tree should be, CAST adds candidates while the expected gain from the next one outweighs the verification time it adds. The width therefore adapts to each deployment from a latency measurement, without sweeping over widths. We evaluate CAST across five domains on three GPU generations and two model families. At its predicted width, CAST is faster than the standard chain in all eight settings, by up to 43%. We also find that the best width depends strongly on the deployment. Where verification cost jumps at a kernel boundary, a 128-token tree is only 2% faster than the standard chain, whereas the tree at the predicted width is 20% faster. Furthermore, we prove that CAST leaves the target output distribution unchanged under both greedy and sampled decoding. Code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/CAST.

AI.tldr: CAST（Cost-Aware Speculative Trees）将块式草稿器已评分的候选打包为树，在单次目标模型前向中验证，并按预期收益与验证开销自适应确定树宽，无需扫描宽度；在8种设置中均优于标准链式解码，最高加速43%，且证明保持目标输出分布不变。
AI.motivation: 标准投机解码仅验证得分最高的单条链，丢弃了块式草稿器已评分的大量候选；验证更多候选只增加目标模型计算，不增加草稿开销，但如何确定验证多少（树宽）会使收益最大化且随部署变化，尚缺原则性方法。
AI.method: CAST将块草稿器给出的候选组织成投机树，在一次目标前向中完成验证，不改动目标模型、草稿器权重和解码规则。树宽通过代价感知准则决定：持续加入候选，直到下一个候选的预期收益不再超过其带来的验证时间；宽度由一次延迟测量推导，无需对宽度做扫描。理论上证明在贪心与采样解码下目标输出分布不变。
AI.result: 在3个GPU代际、2个模型家族、5个领域共8种设置中，CAST在预测宽度下均快于标准链式解码，最高加速43%。最优宽度强依赖部署：在内核边界导致验证成本跃升的情形下，128词元树仅比标准链快2%，而预测宽度下快20%。
AI.conclusion: CAST以零额外草稿开销复用块草稿器候选，兼顾加速与分布正确性；树宽应随部署自适应而非固定，代价感知的宽度预测可避免昂贵且易失效的宽度扫描。

title: Refusal Localizes, the Damage Relocates: Safety Layers Under Few-Sample Fine-Tuning
comment: 24 pages, 7 figures, 21 tables. Jungseob Lee and Dongyub Jude Lee contributed equally
summary: Fine-tuning adapts aligned large language models (LLMs) to downstream tasks, but a few dozen harmful examples can remove their refusal of harmful requests. Prior work localizes safety-related behavior to specific layers, directions, and tokens, suggesting targets for protection. We test whether successful localization and recovery support defenses that survive changes in the attack. Across six checkpoints from four model families, harmful and benign prompts remain linearly separable after attack, and patching full clean hidden states into the compromised model restores refusal at a reproducible transition depth. Building on a prior layer-freezing defense, we freeze every layer up to this depth and repeat the attack. At a hundred harmful examples, refusal remains near zero on all six checkpoints, with recovery transitions above the frozen boundary. In a second study, removing the update's top two singular directions restores refusal after short attention-only fine-tunes on four checkpoints. On Llama-3.1-8B, ordinary training changes weaken this repair and an attacker who spreads the update defeats it. A spectral detector calibrated on benign Llama fine-tunes misses most repair failures on that checkpoint. Localized freezing can nevertheless help preserve refusal when a few harmful examples enter training data unintentionally. These results show that an attacker can bypass a region identified by recovery and defeat a repair that works across multiple checkpoints, motivating five checks for defenses against adaptive fine-tuning. Code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/refusal-relocates.

AI.tldr: 该论文检验了"安全行为可定位化"能否支撑抵御微调攻击的防御：攻击后仍存在可恢复拒答的转变层，但基于冻结或谱方向移除的修复在更强攻击下失效，说明需要针对自适应微调的防御验证清单。
AI.motivation: 已有工作将LLM的安全拒答行为定位到特定层、方向与token，暗示可据此设计保护机制。但此前缺乏对"定位与修复是否在攻击方式变化后依然有效"的系统检验，即防御的鲁棒性与可迁移性存疑。
AI.method: 跨4个模型家族、6个检查点，在有害与良性提示上检验攻击后的线性可分性；将干净的完整隐状态patch进被攻陷模型以定位拒答恢复的转变深度；在此基础上复现并扩展层级冻结防御（冻结直至该深度的所有层）并重复攻击；第二项研究中移除微调更新的前两个奇异方向以修复拒答；在Llama-3.1-8B上测试常规训练扰动、攻击者分散更新以及基于良性微调校准的谱检测器。
AI.result: 攻击后有害与良性提示仍线性可分，patch干净隐状态可在可复现的转变深度恢复拒答；但在100个有害样本下，冻结到该深度的防御在全部6个检查点上拒答率仍近于零，恢复转变出现在冻结边界之上。移除前两个奇异方向可在4个检查点的短时仅注意力微调后恢复拒答；然而在Llama-3.1-8B上，常规训练改动削弱该修复，分散更新的攻击者可将其击败，且基于良性微调校准的谱检测器漏检了该检查点上的大多数修复失败。
AI.conclusion: 定位到的安全区域可被攻击者绕过，跨检查点有效的修复也能被击败，说明单点定位与静态修复不足以构成可靠防御；作者据此提出针对自适应微调防御的五项检查，并开源代码。局部冻结仅在少量有害样本被无意混入训练数据时可能有助于保留拒答。

title: Assessing the Impact of Language Disparity on Multilingual Linguistic Ability in Large Language Models
summary: Claims about the grammatical competence of multilingual language models vary sharply with how competence is measured, yet the interaction between evaluation paradigm, post-training, and language resource availability has not been systematically examined. We evaluate base and post-trained models from six families on MultiBLiMP, a syntactic minimal-pair benchmark covering 101 languages, using four evaluation methods. We report three principal findings. First, post-training degrades grammatical competence, but the magnitude of this effect is reduced unevenly by model scale, while low-resource languages bear the highest cost. Second, post-trained models retain grammatical knowledge they cannot articulate through explicit prompting, yet this is measurable only in high-resource languages, because near-chance baselines in low-resource settings leave little knowledge to hide. Third, native-language prompting recovers otherwise hidden competence on low-resource languages, demonstrating that only high-resource languages can be probed directly from unprompted probabilities. We conclude that multilingual grammatical evaluation must adopt language-informed, multi-paradigm protocols to avoid systematically underestimating low-resource abilities.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统考察评估范式、后训练与语言资源可得性三者的交互，用四种方法在MultiBLiMP（101种语言的句法最小对立对）上评测六个模型族的基座与后训练模型，发现后训练损害语法能力、低资源语言代价最大，且隐藏能力需借助母语提示才能揭示，主张采用语言知情的多范式评测。
AI.motivation: 关于多语言模型语法能力的结论随测量方式剧烈变化，但评估范式、后训练与语言资源可得性之间的交互作用此前未被系统研究，导致低资源语言能力可能被系统性低估。
AI.method: 在MultiBLiMP（覆盖101种语言的句法最小对立对基准）上，对来自六个模型族的基座模型与后训练模型，使用四种评估方法进行评测。
AI.result: 三项主要发现：（1）后训练会降低语法能力，模型规模对该效应的缓解不均匀，低资源语言承担最高代价；（2）后训练模型保留了无法通过显式提示表达出来的语法知识，但仅在高资源语言中可测，低资源环境下接近随机的基线使可隐藏的知识所剩无几；（3）母语提示能在低资源语言上恢复隐藏能力，表明仅高资源语言可直接从无提示概率中探测。
AI.conclusion: 多语言语法评估必须采用语言知情的多范式协议，以避免系统性低估低资源语言的能力。

title: EurekaBench: Measuring Agentic Ability to Discover New Scientific Insights
summary: When Isaac Newton discovered the law of gravitation, he did so through an iterative process of analyzing observed data such as planetary patterns, finding the underlying mechanisms by describing patterns in mathematical equations, and refining his theory against the Moon's orbit, revealing the startling insight that the same force governs both falling apples and orbiting planets. Would it be possible for AI agents to make similar discoveries? To measure this ability, we introduce EurekaBench, a cross-domain benchmark that tests AI agents' ability to conduct long-horizon experiments and discover mechanisms that explain observations. We evaluate these mechanisms by the scientific insights that can be derived from them. EurekaBench contains an expert-verified set of 26 long-horizon tasks across neuroscience, computer science, chemistry, astrophysics, geophysics, and plasma physics, with a total of 306 scientific insights that the discovered mechanisms are expected to support. Our evaluation framework tests three axes of scientific discovery: agents' ability to follow known scientific constraints, the predictive accuracy of the discovered mechanisms, and whether these mechanisms yield scientific insights or inform future research. Our results show that current AI agents often overly fixate on predictive accuracy optimization, surpassing human scientists, while falling substantially short in deriving scientific insights.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EurekaBench，一个跨学科长时程基准，用于衡量 AI 智能体"从观测数据中发现机制"的能力；结果显示现有智能体在预测精度上甚至超越人类科学家，但在科学洞见方面差距显著。
AI.motivation: 牛顿发现万有引力定律的过程体现了科学发现的本质：分析观测规律、以数学方程描述模式、并在新数据上迭代修正理论，最终揭示统一机制。论文希望检验 AI 智能体是否具备类似的机制发现能力，而现有评测缺乏针对"长时程实验 + 机制发现 + 科学洞见"这一能力的衡量标准。
AI.method: 构建 EurekaBench 跨域基准：包含经专家验证的 26 个长时程任务，覆盖神经科学、计算机科学、化学、天体物理、地球物理与等离子体物理，共 306 条待发现机制应支持的科学洞见。评估框架从三个维度考察科学发现能力：(1) 智能体是否遵循已知科学约束；(2) 所发现机制的预测准确性；(3) 机制能否产生科学洞见或指导后续研究。
AI.result: 当前 AI 智能体普遍过度聚焦于预测精度的优化，在此维度上超过人类科学家；但在从机制中推导科学洞见方面明显不足。
AI.conclusion: 仅以预测精度衡量 AI 的科学发现能力是不充分的；EurekaBench 表明智能体在机制解释与洞见生成上仍存在实质性差距，未来研究需同时关注科学约束遵循与研究启发性，而非单一优化预测指标。

title: Can LLMs Reason Over Long Horizons? An Empirical Evaluation of Context Strategies for Longitudinal Clinical Reasoning
summary: Longitudinal clinical reasoning requires large language models (LLMs) to identify and integrate relevant evidence distributed across extended patient histories. Although long-context models can process increasingly large amounts of information, providing more history does not necessarily make relevant evidence more accessible or improve reasoning. We compare five context strategies (Full, Recent, Episodic, Semantic, and Hybrid) on MedLoCoMo across four open-weight LLMs, examining answer correctness, robustness to query-evidence distance, and abstention on questions with unsupported premises. Episodic and Hybrid generally achieve the strongest overall accuracy, while Recent Context degrades most as supporting evidence becomes more distant; Episodic and Hybrid maintain the highest accuracy at long distances. Analysis of adversarial questions further shows that strong performance on answerable questions does not necessarily translate to successful abstention when the available history does not support the requested conclusion. These findings show that reliable longitudinal reasoning depends not only on how much history an LLM can access, but critically on how relevant evidence is selected and presented for reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该论文比较五种上下文策略（Full、Recent、Episodic、Semantic、Hybrid）在MedLoCoMo基准上对四个开源大模型纵向临床推理的影响，发现提供更多病史并不必然提升推理，证据的选择与呈现方式才是关键。
AI.motivation: 纵向临床推理要求大语言模型从跨长时程的患者病史中识别并整合相关证据。尽管长上下文模型能处理越来越多的信息，但提供更多病史并不一定使相关证据更易获取或改善推理，因此需要研究上下文组织策略的作用。
AI.method: 在MedLoCoMo基准上，对四种开放权重的大语言模型比较五种上下文策略：Full（全量）、Recent（近期）、Episodic（情景）、Semantic（语义）和Hybrid（混合），评估指标包括答案正确性、对查询-证据距离的鲁棒性，以及在前提不支持的问题上的弃答表现；此外还分析了对抗性问题。
AI.result: Episodic与Hybrid策略总体准确率最高；Recent Context在支持证据距离变远时性能下降最明显，而Episodic与Hybrid在长距离下仍保持最高准确率。对抗性问题分析显示，在可回答问题上的强表现并不必然转化为当病史不支持所请求结论时的成功弃答。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的纵向推理不仅取决于大模型能访问多少病史，更关键地取决于相关证据如何被选择和呈现以供推理使用。

title: Rules Amortize, Pairings Don't: Linguistic Structure Determines What Latent Task Representations Can Replace In-Context Learning
comment: Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Linguistic Principles for Foundation Models (LP4FM). 5 pages
summary: In-context learning (ICL) can be amortized into latent objects (task vectors, function vectors, context vectors) that recover few-shot behavior at zero-shot inference cost, but recent theory shows a static vector acts as a single synthetic demonstration and must fail on high-rank mappings such as word-level bijections. We ask a linguistic version of this question: which linguistic operations can be amortized out of the prompt? We train a 2.6M-parameter network that reads the geometry of a few-shot support set (centroid, principal subspace, spectrum, computed once and cached) and produces an input-conditioned additive update to the query's residual stream at a mid-depth layer of a frozen GPT-2-large/XL. Across eight inflectional directions and one lexical relation, under a canonical split that bars inverted-pair leakage between directions, three regimes emerge. On forward inflection, where 10-shot ICL is strong (0.67-0.89) and extracted task vectors collapse (<=0.06), the transform matches ICL at strictly zero-shot per-query cost. On lemmatization directions, which frozen GPT-2 can execute but 10 demonstrations systematically fail to convey (ICL 0.13-0.48 at 1.5B), the transform is not capped by ICL at all: it reaches 0.78-0.92, up to +72 points over ICL (past to present: 0.85 vs. 0.13). On arbitrary pairings (antonymy) every amortizer plateaus near half of ICL at every scale, capacity, and seed tested. Controls show the support manifold acts as a causally necessary task fingerprint: wrong-task manifolds collapse accuracy to <=0.06, query-only variants cannot disambiguate tasks sharing an input space, and leave-one-task-out transfer is zero. Productive rules amortize into latent task representations, sometimes better than prompting can convey them; memorized pairings do not.

AI.tldr: 该研究将上下文学习（ICL）摊销为潜任务表示，训练一个2.6M参数网络把少样本支撑集的几何特征（质心、主子空间、谱）映射为对冻结GPT-2大模型中间层残差流的加性更新，在零样本每查询成本下复现甚至超越提示。
AI.motivation: 已有理论表明静态向量仅相当于一个合成示例，无法处理词级双射这类高秩映射，因此需要回答一个语言学版本的问题：哪些语言操作可以从提示中摊销出来，哪些不能。
AI.method: 训练2.6M参数网络读取少样本支撑集几何（质心、主子空间、谱，一次计算后缓存），生成输入条件化的加性更新注入冻结GPT-2-large/XL中间层残差流；在八种屈折方向和一种词汇关系上，采用禁止方向间倒序对泄漏的规范划分进行评估，并设置错误任务流形、仅查询变体、留一任务迁移等对照。
AI.result: 出现三种机制：前向屈折上10-shot ICL强（0.67-0.89）而任务向量崩溃（≤0.06），变换在严格零样本下匹配ICL；词形还原方向上ICL系统性失败（1.5B时0.13-0.48），变换不受ICL上限约束，达0.78-0.92，最高超ICL 72点（过去到现在0.85对0.13）；任意配对（反义）上所有摊销器在各规模、容量、种子下均停留在ICL约一半。对照显示支撑流形是因果必要的任务指纹：错误任务流形使准确率降至≤0.06，仅查询变体无法区分共享输入空间的任务，留一任务迁移为零。
AI.conclusion: 可产出的规则能够摊销为潜任务表示，有时比提示传达得更好；记忆性配对则不能摊销。这为ICL中可摊销语言操作的边界给出了任务类型层面的刻画。

title: Emergent Unfaithfulness: How Alignment Training Causes Language Models to Silently Override Task Faithfulness
summary: Large language models are characterized by three key properties: capability, alignment, and faithfulness. Prior work studies the tradeoffs between capability and alignment, and between capability and faithfulness, but a third tension remains underexplored: the alignment-faithfulness conflict. We show that aligned models systematically deviate from their inputs on unsafe or sensitive content without disclosing the modification, a failure mode we call alignment-induced unfaithfulness (AIU). Unlike capability-driven unfaithfulness, which comes from errors in knowledge or reasoning, this is induced by post-training mechanisms that override adherence to the input. We introduce FaithConflict, a controlled dataset isolating both conflicts, and two complementary taxonomies: behavioral (B1-B8) and chain-of-thought reasoning (C0-C6). Across models, AIU increases with scale and more sharply than capability-driven unfaithfulness, a reverse scaling law; intermediate checkpoints show it is amplified during post-training, with DPO the stage at which the gap both grows most and becomes least visible. Prompting-based mitigation does not resolve it, revealing a capability-alignment-faithfulness trilemma in the design and evaluation of LLMs.

AI.tldr: 论文提出并研究了"对齐诱导的不忠实性"（AIU）：对齐模型在遇到不安全或敏感内容时会系统性地偏离输入且不披露修改，且该现象随模型规模增大而加剧，呈现反缩放律，由此揭示能力-对齐-忠实性三难困境。
AI.motivation: 现有工作主要关注能力与对齐、能力与忠实性之间的权衡，而对齐与忠实性之间的冲突尚未被充分探索。作者希望填补这一研究空白，并揭示对齐后训练机制可能以牺牲对输入的忠实为代价。
AI.method: 引入 FaithConflict 受控数据集，用以隔离对齐驱动与能力驱动两类不忠实；提出行为分类法（B1-B8）与思维链推理分类法（C0-C6）两套互补体系；在多模型、不同规模及中间检查点上进行评测，并测试基于提示的缓解方法。
AI.result: AIU 随模型规模增大而上升，且上升幅度明显超过能力驱动的不忠实，构成"反缩放律"；中间检查点显示该现象在后训练阶段被放大，DPO 阶段差距增长最大且最不易被察觉；基于提示的缓解手段无效。
AI.conclusion: 对齐机制会导致模型在敏感内容上偏离输入且不披露，能力、对齐与忠实性之间存在三难困境，需要在 LLM 设计与评测中同时权衡这三者。

title: Where's Waldo? Query-language Preference under Cross-lingual Knowledge Disparities
summary: Large Language Models increasingly serve as interfaces for knowledge-intensive information seeking tasks across languages by synthesizing multilingual evidence. Prior work has shown that they often exhibit query-language preference -- the tendency to favor sources written in the language of the query -- but has largely examined this behavior in settings where equivalent knowledge is available across languages. However, this bias becomes consequential when sources in different languages provide incomplete or inconsistent accounts of the same fact, since the information users receive then depends on the sources a model selects to use. To characterize query-language preference under such cross-lingual knowledge disparities, we introduce Waldo, a multilingual Question-Answering (QA) benchmark constructed from Wikipedia. Waldo contains 12K QA pairs targeting knowledge gaps, where a fact is available in one language but absent in another, and knowledge conflicts, where language editions provide conflicting versions of the same fact. Evaluating eight models across five languages, we find that when one language edition merely lacks the relevant fact, models generally use evidence from the other language regardless of the query language. Under conflicting accounts, however, model responses strongly align with the document in the query language, causing semantically equivalent queries to elicit different accounts depending on the user's language. Finally, we explore two different approaches that could mitigate this preference under knowledge conflicts: a mechanistic intervention that ablates attention heads associated with query-language preference, and LoRA-based training, which reduces the preference gap by up to 61.5%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Waldo 多语言问答基准，研究跨语言知识差异（知识缺口与知识冲突）下大模型的"查询语言偏好"，发现知识冲突时模型答案强烈偏向查询语言源，并提出机制干预与 LoRA 训练两种缓解方法。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多在"各语言知识等价"的设定下考察查询语言偏好，而现实中不同语言版本的源常对同一事实提供不完整或相互矛盾的信息，此时偏好会直接影响用户获得的信息内容。因此需要专门的基准来刻画跨语言知识差异下的该偏差。
AI.method: 构建 Waldo 基准：基于 Wikipedia 生成 12K 条问答对，覆盖两类情形——知识缺口（事实仅存在于一种语言版本）与知识冲突（多语言版本对同一事实给出矛盾表述）。在五种语言上评测八个模型，并尝试两种缓解策略：消融与查询语言偏好相关的注意力头的机制性干预，以及基于 LoRA 的训练。
AI.result: 面对知识缺口时，模型通常能采用另一语言的证据，与查询语言无关；面对知识冲突时，模型回答与查询语言对应文档高度一致，导致语义等价的问题因用户语言不同而得到不同版本的事实。LoRA 训练可将偏好差距最多缩小 61.5%。
AI.conclusion: 查询语言偏好在存在知识冲突时最具危害性，会造成同一问题跨语言的信息不一致；该偏差可通过机制性消融与参数高效微调予以缓解，其中 LoRA 效果显著。

title: Mixture of Decoders for Diverse Dialog Response Generation
summary: Mixture modeling is a long established machine learning technique for learning large sets of multi-modal data. While it is known that sequence-to-sequence models for dialog response generation suffer from the problem of low diversity, we hypothesize that it is because sequence-to-sequence models tend to learn a degenerate uni-modal distribution of responses. We then propose to incorporate a mixture of decoders into sequence-to-sequence models and try to make each decoder learn specialized topics in order to improve the diversity of generated responses. Our model is developed under the framework of conditional variational autoencoder (CVAE). We evaluate our approach on an open domain chat corpus and show improvement over strong baselines in quantitative measures and human evaluation.

AI.tldr: 将混合解码器引入序列到序列对话生成模型，在CVAE框架下让各解码器学习专门话题，从而缓解回复多样性低的问题，并在开放域聊天语料上取得优于强基线的效果。
AI.motivation: 序列到序列对话回复生成模型存在回复多样性低的问题，作者假设其根源在于模型倾向于学习退化的单峰回复分布。
AI.method: 在序列到序列模型中引入解码器混合（mixture of decoders），使每个解码器学习专门的话题；模型构建于条件变分自编码器（CVAE）框架之下。
AI.result: 在开放域聊天语料上的实验表明，该方法在量化指标和人工评估上均优于强基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过混合解码器建模多峰回复分布并促进解码器话题专门化，可有效提升对话回复生成多样性。

title: Self-Evolving Coding Rules for AI Coding Agents
summary: The performance of AI coding agents is highly dependent on their underlying coding rules. However, existing coding rules are typically hand-crafted and fixed, making the process labor-intensive and often suboptimal. In this work, we propose RuleEvolve, a self-evolving framework for coding rules. RuleEvolve maintains a pool of candidate coding rules and iteratively improves them. In each iteration, it employs an LLM-powered mutator module to generate variants from existing candidates, and then uses a judge module to evaluate these variants and update the pool with the best-performing ones. Extensive evaluations across two coding-agent frameworks, four backbone LLMs, and three benchmarks demonstrate that RuleEvolve outperforms both manual engineering and existing prompt optimization baselines in terms of functional correctness of the generated code, code length, and/or generation cost (e.g., tokens used).

AI.tldr: 提出RuleEvolve，一个面向编程规则的自进化框架，通过LLM变异与评判迭代优化规则池，在多框架、多模型、多基准上优于人工工程与现有提示优化基线。
AI.motivation: AI编程智能体的性能高度依赖其底层编程规则，但现有规则通常由人工手工设计且固定不变，导致构建过程劳动密集且效果往往次优。
AI.method: RuleEvolve维护一个候选编程规则池并进行迭代改进。每次迭代中，利用LLM驱动的变异器（mutator）模块基于现有候选生成变体，随后通过评判器（judge）模块评估这些变体，并用表现最佳者更新规则池。
AI.result: 在两种编程智能体框架、四种骨干LLM和三个基准上的大量实验表明，RuleEvolve在生成代码的功能正确性、代码长度和/或生成成本（如token消耗）方面，均优于人工工程和现有提示优化基线。
AI.conclusion: 编程规则可通过自进化方式自动优化，替代手工固定规则，从而在保证甚至提升代码正确性的同时降低长度与生成成本。

title: Explainable Suicide Risk Assessment on Social Media with Multi-Task QLoRA
summary: Explainable suicide-risk assessment requires models not only to estimate risk severity, but also to identify supporting language and the risk and protective factors expressed in a post. We present our system for the IEEE BigData 2026 Cup on Explainable Suicide Risk Assessment on Social Media, which addresses three tasks: risk-level classification, evidence phrase extraction, and multi-label factor identification. Our approach adapts Qwen2.5-Instruct models using quantized low-rank adaptation (QLoRA) and an answer-masked causal language-model objective. We jointly train across all three tasks for risk classification, jointly train on Tasks~1a and 1b for evidence extraction, and adapt Task~2 separately for factor identification. We also tailor aggregation to each output: we average risk-level probabilities from the 32B and 72B models, combine evidence phrases through cross-fold consensus, and calibrate factor-specific decisions through rate matching based on out-of-fold operating points. On the official leaderboard, the final system achieved a composite score of 0.7738, with 0.8089 on Task~1 and 0.6919 on Task~2. Across the evaluated configurations, three-task training performed best for Task~1a, joint training on Tasks~1a and 1b performed best for Task~1b, and task-specific training performed best for Task~2. Probability averaging further improved Task~1a when component models had complementary errors. These findings highlight the value of tailoring both training objectives and aggregation strategies to the output structure of each task within a unified language-model framework.

AI.tldr: 提出基于Qwen2.5-Instruct与QLoRA的统一框架，联合建模风险分级、证据抽取和多标签因素识别三项任务，并通过概率平均、跨折共识和率匹配等定制化聚合策略取得0.7738的综合得分。
AI.motivation: 可解释的自杀风险评估不仅要求预测风险等级，还需指出支撑性语言以及帖子中表达的各类风险与保护因素，因此需要同时处理分类、抽取与多标签识别三类异构输出。
AI.method: 基于Qwen2.5-Instruct模型，采用量化低秩适配（QLoRA）与答案掩码的因果语言建模目标进行微调；任务1（1a、1b）联合训练，任务2单独适配；聚合上对32B与72B模型的风险概率取平均，证据短语采用跨折共识，因素判定基于折外操作点进行率匹配校准。
AI.result: 官方榜单综合得分0.7738，其中任务1为0.8089，任务2为0.6919；三任务联合训练对任务1a最优，任务1a与1b联合训练对任务1b最优，任务专属训练对任务2最优；当组件模型误差互补时，概率平均可进一步提升任务1a表现。
AI.conclusion: 在统一语言模型框架内，针对各任务输出结构定制训练目标与聚合策略是提升可解释风险识别性能的关键。

title: PhysicsMate: A Curriculum-Grounded Bengali Benchmark for Secondary Physics QA with Small-Model Adaptation
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Accepted at 11th IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Computer Science and Data Engineering (IEEE CSDE 2026)
summary: Bengali secondary education lacks curriculum-grounded benchmarks for STEM question-solving, and general-purpose language models struggle with the precise terminology, unit conventions, and derivations that physics problems demand. We introduce PhysicsMate, a benchmark of 1834 question-answer pairs built from the National Curriculum and Textbook Board (NCTB) Grade 9-10 physics syllabus and grounded in a multi-relational knowledge graph of 1760 nodes and 2600 edges across ten ontological types. We Low-Rank Adapt at 0.6B, 1.7B, and 4B parameters, with a unified recipe and demonstrate a significant increase in closed-book accuracy in all scales (+5.5, +15.0, and +23.3 percentage points). A node-type analysis shows that the most benefited by adaptation is the structured curricular knowledge, which consists of physical quantities and named laws, while the least benefited is the loosely specified entity-level knowledge. The 4B model has been adapted and quantized to a small offline binary that can be used for local inference in resource constrained environments and offers a viable path to curriculum aligned physics support in environments with limited connectivity and hardware.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出PhysicsMate——一个基于孟加拉国NCTB 9-10年级物理课程与多关系知识图谱构建的物理问答基准（1834个问答对、1760节点、2600边、10类本体），通过统一LoRA配方在0.6B、1.7B、4B模型上微调，闭卷准确率分别提升5.5、15.0和23.3个百分点，并将4B模型量化后可离线本地推理。
AI.motivation: 孟加拉国中等教育缺乏与课程标准对齐的STEM解题评测基准，而通用语言模型在处理物理问题所需的精确术语、单位约定与推导过程时表现不佳。
AI.method: 基于NCTB 9-10年级物理教学大纲构建1834个问答对，并依托含1760个节点、2600条边、10种本体类型的多关系知识图谱；对0.6B、1.7B、4B模型采用统一的低秩适配（LoRA）配方进行微调，并开展节点类型分析。
AI.result: 所有参数规模模型的闭卷准确率均显著提升（+5.5、+15.0、+23.3个百分点）；节点类型分析显示，结构化课程知识（物理量与命名定律）受益最大，而界定松散的实体级知识受益最小；4B模型经适配与量化后可形成小型离线二进制，用于资源受限环境下的本地推理。
AI.conclusion: 课程对齐的知识图谱加统一微调配方可有效提升小规模模型的物理解题能力，量化后的4B模型为低连通性、弱硬件环境提供了可行的课程对齐物理学习支持路径。

title: Lingtai: What Concept Geometry Reveals--and Does Not Reveal--About LLM Inference
comment: 15 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables. An earlier version was publicly released on Zenodo (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23068698)
summary: Observing what a large language model computes during autoregressive inference--online and without training probes--remains difficult. We introduce Lingtai, a training-free concept telemetry layer: at each generation step, residual states are projected onto a domain-specific bank of named concept anchors, constructed without labeled concept examples, outcome labels, gradient fitting, or activation-space optimization, producing a structured per-step concept-coordinate signal. Across code generation and grade-school mathematical reasoning, this signal exhibits a robust association with predictive uncertainty: the association survives problem-identity and token-position controls and is not attributable to a single token type, is not explained by a simple correct/incorrect mixture on GSM8K, and is not reproduced by matched random anchors; it is markedly weaker or direction-inconsistent in K-means and PCA projections. Two structures emerge: a recurring uncertainty-linked activity signal whose functional geometry is task-conditioned (distinct activity-entropy shapes on HumanEval, MBPP, and GSM8K), and an execution-specific trajectory identity with strong local inertia but weak re-instantiation invariance--under completion-only elastic alignment, corruption at k=32 (approximately a median quarter of the completion) on the matched re-execution subset still retrieves the archived episode at 62.0%, while a fresh execution retrieves it only 11.7-16.0% of the time. Finally, a matched audit finds no evidence that the scalar concept-activity signal used here supplies a stable correctness coordinate under the tested protocol; we therefore treat correctness as externally supplied. Telemetry adds 0.7-1.6% per-token decode overhead for the 161-anchor code implementation, with unchanged generated tokens.

AI.tldr: 提出Lingtai——一种免训练的概念遥测层,通过将每步残差状态投影到无标注概念锚点库,得到结构化逐步骤概念坐标信号;该信号与预测不确定性稳健关联,并揭示任务条件化活动几何与执行轨迹身份两种结构。
AI.motivation: 在线观测大模型自回归推理中的计算过程、且不训练探针,仍是难题。
AI.method: 在每个生成步骤将残差状态投影到领域特定的具名概念锚点库(锚点构建无需标注概念样本、结果标签、梯度拟合或激活空间优化),得到逐步骤概念坐标信号;并通过问题身份与词元位置控制、随机锚点匹配、K-means/PCA对照、弹性对齐检索等审计实验进行验证。
AI.result: 该信号与预测不确定性稳健关联,非单一词元类型所致,不能被GSM8K上简单正确/错误混合解释,随机锚点不可复现,K-means/PCA投影显著更弱或方向不一致;出现任务条件化的不确定性相关活动几何(HumanEval、MBPP、GSM8K的活动熵形态不同)与执行特异轨迹身份(强局部惯性、弱重实例化不变性:匹配重执行子集k=32破坏仍以62.0%检索归档情节,而全新执行仅11.7–16.0%);标量概念活动信号未提供稳定正确性坐标;161锚点代码实现每词元解码开销仅增加0.7–1.6%,生成词元不变。
AI.conclusion: Lingtai可作为免训练、低开销的在线概念遥测手段刻画推理过程,但正确性需外部提供,其轨迹身份的性质有待进一步研究。

title: Closing the Loop: Practical Training Recipes for Looped Language Models
summary: Looped language models increase effective depth by repeatedly applying a shared block of layers, but existing large-scale recipes require multi-stage training over trillions of tokens, while the benefits of recurrence remain difficult to separate from differences in data and training. In this work, we establish practical training recipes for looped language models, with three main results. (1) We develop a compute-efficient from-scratch pipeline that reduces the training budget from 7.7T tokens in Ouro to 310B tokens while retaining strong reasoning performance. Pretraining followed by high-quality mid-training, together with learning-rate warmup and stronger exit-gate regularization, enables stable recurrent training without prior multi-stage schedules. (2) Under controlled comparisons, our 1.4B LoopLM outperforms a parameter-matched dense model trained on the same data and token budget on all 12 evaluated benchmarks, including +14 points on GSM8K, +10 on MATH, and +22 on DROP. At matched inference compute, it approaches a 3.9B dense model on mathematical reasoning and reading comprehension while using only 36\% as many parameters. (3) We introduce a minimal recipe for converting pretrained dense models into looped ones: a single learned input-mixing scalar and a smoothed exit loss, with no step-specific parameters. Applied to Qwen3-1.7B-Base, Looped Qwen improves over an identically continued dense baseline on every evaluated benchmark across two data regimes, with statistically clear gains on GSM8K, MATH, and MMLU-Pro on the curated mixture. Together, these results make looped language models substantially cheaper to train from scratch and practical to introduce into existing pretrained checkpoints, while isolating the gains due to recurrence itself.

AI.tldr: 该论文为循环语言模型（Looped LM）建立了实用训练配方，实现三大成果：训练预算从7.7T tokens降至310B tokens；1.4B LoopLM在12项基准上全面超越同参数量稠密模型；并提出将预训练稠密模型转换为循环模型的最小化配方。
AI.motivation: 循环语言模型通过重复应用共享层块来增加有效深度，但现有大规模训练配方需要多阶段、数万亿tokens的训练，且难以将循环结构本身的收益与数据、训练的差异区分开来。因此作者希望建立更高效、可控的循环模型训练方案，并分离出循环性带来的纯收益。
AI.method: (1) 提出从零开始的高计算效率训练流水线：预训练+高质量中训练，配合学习率warmup和更强的exit-gate正则化，无需多阶段调度即可稳定循环训练；(2) 构建1.4B LoopLM，与参数匹配的稠密模型在相同数据和token预算下进行受控对比；(3) 提出将预训练稠密模型转换为循环模型的最小配方：仅一个可学习的输入混合标量和平滑exit损失，无需步特定参数，并应用于Qwen3-1.7B-Base。
AI.result: (1) 训练预算从Ouro的7.7T tokens降至310B tokens，仍保持强推理性能；(2) 1.4B LoopLM在全部12项评测基准上超越参数匹配的稠密模型，GSM8K +14分、MATH +10分、DROP +22分；在相同推理算力下，以仅36%的参数量接近3.9B稠密模型的数学推理和阅读理解水平；(3) Looped Qwen在两种数据设置下均优于同等继续训练的稠密基线，在curated mixture上于GSM8K、MATH、MMLU-Pro取得统计显著的提升。
AI.conclusion: 该研究使循环语言模型从零训练成本大幅降低，并可通过最小配方便捷地引入现有预训练checkpoint，同时成功分离出循环性本身带来的性能增益。

title: Bayesian Fine-tuning Yields Language Models that are as Bayesian as their Beliefs Allow
summary: Language models (LMs) are increasingly used for tasks that require reasoning about hidden variables from a few observations, for which Bayesian inference is the normatively correct solution.
