AI.result: CTR-Reg在六个基准上平均将干净token准确率提升26.5个百分点，而破坏token准确率几乎不变；每步修改数收敛到仅3—11个位置。仅用五步贪心尾部采样，三个模型的生成困惑度均下降一半以上，且多样性得以保持，增益在不同采样预算下依然成立。
AI.conclusion: 正确token保留是自纠正扩散语言模型缺失的关键要素，CTR-Reg提供了一个有效修复方案。

title: Science Utopia? Closed-Loop LLM Simulation of Academic Research Ecosystems
summary: Scientific progress emerges from a longitudinal ecosystem in which researchers, institutions, funding agencies, collaboration networks, and the scientific literature co-evolve. As AI becomes increasingly involved throughout the scientific research cycle, understanding these interconnected and evolving processes becomes increasingly important. We introduce SciUtopia, a persistent, closed-loop LLM-agent simulation framework for studying academic research ecosystems. SciUtopia models interconnected scientific processes such as research-direction choice, collaboration, submission, peer review, resubmission, citation, funding, and researcher attrition, while maintaining evolving states across simulated years. Its configurable institutional mechanisms and information channels provide a controlled testbed for matched counterfactual experiments and targeted interventions. Across 61 simulation worlds, SciUtopia simulates over 40,000 researchers from 8,000 institutions, producing around 400,000 publication decisions and 1.2 million LLM-generated peer reviews. Using these longitudinal simulations, we find that rejection-driven resubmission substantially amplifies reviewer burden beyond population growth alone, cautious exploration balances citation impact with career success and long-term topic diversity, and resource inequality can emerge even without detectable cumulative advantage from narrowly winning early funding. Code is available at https://github.com/Ahren09/ScienceUtopia.

AI.tldr: 提出SciUtopia——一个持久闭环的LLM智能体仿真框架，用于研究科研生态系统；通过61个仿真世界、4万+研究者、40万次发表决策与120万条LLM评审，揭示重投放大审稿负担、审慎探索的平衡作用及资源不平等的自发涌现。
AI.motivation: 科研进步依托于研究者、机构、资助方、合作网络与文献共同演化的纵向生态系统。随着AI日益介入科研全流程，理解这些相互关联且不断演化的过程变得愈发重要，但缺乏可控、可复现的实验平台来进行匹配的反事实实验与针对性干预。
AI.method: 构建SciUtopia：一个持久、闭环的LLM智能体仿真框架。建模研究方向选择、合作、投稿、同行评审、重投、引用、资助与研究者流失等相互关联过程，并跨模拟年份维持演化状态；提供可配置的机构机制与信息通道，以支持匹配反事实实验与干预。规模上运行61个仿真世界，模拟8,000家机构的40,000+研究者，产生约400,000次发表决策与120万条LLM生成评审。
AI.result: 三类主要发现：(1) 拒稿驱动的重投会显著放大审稿人负担，其效应超出单纯人口增长所导致的负担；(2) 审慎探索可在引用影响力、职业成功与长期主题多样性之间取得平衡；(3) 即使在早期资助中未检测到"窄胜"带来的累积优势，资源不平等仍可自发涌现。
AI.conclusion: SciUtopia为研究学术研究生态系统提供了可配置、可复现的闭环仿真平台，支持反事实与干预实验，并揭示重投负担、探索策略权衡与资源不平等的涌现机制。代码开源于 https://github.com/Ahren09/ScienceUtopia。

title: ARCCS: An Automated Regulatory Compliance Checking System
comment: This is the extended version of a paper accepted to EMNLP 2026 (System Demonstrations)
summary: Regulatory compliance checking - deciding whether a target document satisfies the obligations of a regulation - requires interpreting dense legal text, identifying which provisions apply, and grounding each decision in explicit evidence. We present ARCCS, an end-to-end, automated, agentic, and regulation-agnostic Legal NLP system for compliance checking. ARCCS decomposes raw regulatory text into atomic, traceable requirements and evaluates a target document against them using retrieved evidence, confidence scores, and human-interpretable justifications. This design decouples compliance assessment from any fixed regulatory template or predefined rule set, enabling the pipeline to operate over regulations of varying size and structure. We evaluate ARCCS in two complementary settings. First, in a GDPR policy-document evaluation, LLM-based judges find its decisions and justifications legally and evidentially consistent in up to 96.67% of the assessed cases. Second, on an EU public-procurement benchmark comprising more than 1,200 individual rule checks, the system attains 98.8% accuracy in violation detection. ARCCS is, to our knowledge, the first fully open-source system for end-to-end regulatory compliance checking and auditable report generation.

AI.tldr: 提出ARCCS：一个端到端、智能体化、法规无关的法律NLP合规检查系统，将法规拆解为原子化可追溯要求，并基于检索证据、置信度与可解释理由进行合规判定；在GDPR政策评估中一致率达96.67%，在超1200条规则的欧盟公共采购基准上违规检测准确率达98.8%，为首个全开源端到端合规检查与可审计报告生成系统。
AI.motivation: 合规检查需解读密集法律文本、判断适用条款并将结论落实到明确证据，现有方法往往依赖固定法规模板或预定义规则集，难以适应规模与结构各异的法规。
AI.method: ARCCS将原始法规文本分解为原子化、可追溯的要求，利用检索到的证据、置信度分数和人类可解释的理由，对目标文档逐项评估；该设计使合规评估与任何固定法规模板或预定义规则集解耦，从而适配不同规模与结构的法规，实现端到端、智能体化、法规无关的合规检查。
AI.result: 在GDPR政策文档评估中，基于LLM的评审在最多96.67%的评估案例中认为其决策与理由在法律和证据层面一致；在包含1200余项单项规则检查的欧盟公共采购基准上，系统违规检测准确率达98.8%。
AI.conclusion: ARCCS据作者所知是首个用于端到端法规合规检查与可审计报告生成的全开源系统。

title: Evaluating Biomedical Reranking for LLM-Based Question Answering over Longitudinal Clinical Notes
summary: Patient-specific clinical question answering requires locating the right evidence within long, heterogeneous longitudinal clinical records in which relevant facts may be scattered across encounters, repeated in copied-forward notes, or expressed using different clinical terminology. We evaluated whether biomedical reranking can improve evidence selection and downstream answer quality in a locally deployed retrieval-augmented generation pipeline for longitudinal clinical notes. The pipeline combines PubMedBERT dense retrieval, BM25 lexical retrieval, weighted reciprocal-rank fusion, and MedCPT cross-encoder reranking. Across 1,000 open- and closed-ended question-answer pairs from a cohort of 200 bariatric surgery patients, reranking increased exact source-chunk retrieval within the top 10 items, Hit@10 from 46.6% to 60.6% and mean reciprocal rank from 0.2371 to 0.3252. With Qwen3-8B generation, local judge-assessed answer correctness increased from 44.8% to 48.6%. These results show that biomedical reranking can improve the placement of relevant clinical evidence within a limited context window, although gains in retrieval do not translate proportionally into gains in answer correctness.

AI.tldr: 在纵向临床病历的本地RAG流水线中评估生物医学重排序（MedCPT交叉编码器）对证据选择与下游答案质量的影响；重排序显著提升检索指标（Hit@10 46.6%→60.6%，MRR 0.2371→0.3252），答案正确率仅小幅提升（44.8%→48.6%）。
AI.motivation: 面向患者的临床问答需在长时程、异构的纵向病历中定位相关证据，而相关事实可能分散于多次就诊、被复制粘贴重复出现，或以不同临床术语表述，导致证据选择困难。作者希望检验生物医学重排序能否改善本地部署的RAG流水线中的证据选择及下游答案质量。
AI.method: 构建本地部署的检索增强生成流水线，包含：PubMedBERT稠密检索、BM25词法检索、加权倒数排名融合（weighted reciprocal-rank fusion）以及MedCPT交叉编码器重排序。在200名减重手术患者队列产生的1,000个开放式与封闭式问答对上评估，使用Qwen3-8B生成，并以本地评判模型评估答案正确性。
AI.result: 重排序使前10项内的精确源片段检索（exact source-chunk retrieval within top 10）提升，Hit@10由46.6%提高到60.6%，平均倒数排名（MRR）由0.2371提高到0.3252；使用Qwen3-8B生成时，本地评判的答案正确率由44.8%提高到48.6%。
AI.conclusion: 生物医学重排序可改善相关临床证据在有限上下文窗口中的排序位置，但检索指标的提升并未按比例转化为答案正确率的提升，即检索增益与生成质量之间存在脱节。

title: What Wins a Vote? Formatting, Length, and Lexical Diversity in the French Compar:IA LLM Arena
summary: LLM arenas turn pairwise human preferences into model rankings. Those preferences may reflect how an answer is presented as well as what it says. We take a stylometric approach to 137,293 decisive French-language votes from the July 2026 Compar:IA release; the primary formatting analysis includes 137,113 battles across 116 models, and the joint estimates use the 127,092 battles with all required measurements. For each battle, we reconstruct the response visible when the user voted. We then compare the raw ranking with rankings adjusted for formatting, length, readability, vocabulary variety, and sentence structure. Presentation is associated with winning, but length, bold text, and lists tend to occur together, making their individual contributions hard to separate. Across the measured features, two associations change least across specifications: bold usage (+11.0% win odds per standard deviation in the joint model) and moving-average type-token ratio (MATTR), a measure of vocabulary variety that is less sensitive to answer length (+16.8%). The bold association is substantially smaller in observed multi-turn conversations, whereas the MATTR association changes little; because users choose whether to continue, this difference is descriptive rather than causal. The full adjustment moves 36 of 116 models by at least ten ranks. Yet comparisons with external benchmarks do not show that adjusted rankings better measure capability. We therefore recommend publishing raw and adjusted rankings side by side as a transparent sensitivity analysis.

AI.tldr: 该研究用文体计量方法分析137,293条法语LLM竞技场投票，发现加粗格式与词汇多样性(MATTR)是与胜率最稳健相关的呈现特征，全面调整后116个模型中有36个排名变动≥10位，但调整后排名并未更好地反映能力，故建议并列发布原始与调整后排名作为敏感性分析。
AI.motivation: LLM竞技场通过成对人工偏好生成模型排名，但偏好可能同时反映答案的呈现方式与实质内容。作者希望量化格式、长度、可读性、词汇多样性和句式等呈现特征对胜率与排名的影响，明确这些混淆因素的作用边界，并检验"去偏"后的排名是否真的更接近模型能力。
AI.method: 采用文体计量学(stylometric)方法，使用2026年7月Compar:IA法语数据release中的137,293条有效投票；主要格式分析覆盖116个模型、137,113场对战，联合估计使用具有全部所需测量值的127,092场对战。对每场对战重构用户投票时可见的回答，比较原始排名与按格式、长度、可读性、词汇多样性和句式调整后的排名；报告每种特征每标准差对应的胜率几率变化，并比较观察到的多轮对话中的差异。
AI.result: 呈现方式与获胜相关，但长度、加粗和列表往往同时出现，难以分离各自贡献。跨设定最稳健的关联是加粗使用(联合模型中每标准差+11.0%胜率几率)与移动平均类符形符比MATTR(词汇多样性指标，对答案长度不敏感，+16.8%)。加粗关联在观察到的多轮对话中明显减小，而MATTR关联变化很小；由于用户可自主选择是否继续对话，该差异是描述性的而非因果性的。全面调整使116个模型中的36个排名变动至少10位，但与外部基准比较并未显示调整后排名能更好地测量能力。
AI.conclusion: 呈现特征确实影响竞技场偏好与排名，但现有证据不足以证明调整后排名更能反映真实能力。作者建议同时发布原始排名与调整后排名，作为透明的敏感性分析，供使用者自行判断。

title: Does AI-Generated Scientific Text Follow Human Argumentation Patterns? A CARS-Based Comparison of Research Article Introductions
summary: Large language models are moving from helping write up research to helping do it, which makes it important to know how the scientific text they produce differs from human writing. Work on this question has stayed mostly at the surface, using lexical and stylistic cues that light paraphrasing erases. We look instead at rhetorical structure, the sequence of argumentative moves through which a text makes its case. We study research-article introductions under Swales' CARS model, and compare original introductions from published linguistics articles with generated counterparts of the same papers. We find that human-written introductions are more flexible in which moves they use and in what order, while the generated ones are more uniform. Giving the models the CARS definitions makes them more rigid.

AI.tldr: 该研究从修辞结构（Swales CARS模型中的语步序列）视角比较人类与LLM生成的研究论文引言，发现人类引言在语步种类与顺序上更灵活，而生成文本更趋同；提供CARS定义反而使模型输出更僵化。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型正从辅助撰写研究转向参与研究本身，因此有必要明确其生成的科学文本与人类写作的差异。既有研究多停留在词汇与文体表层线索上，这类特征易被轻微改写消除，亟需更稳健的分析维度。
AI.method: 以修辞结构为切入点，聚焦论文引言中构建论证的语步（moves）序列。基于Swales的CARS模型，将已发表语言学论文的原始引言与针对同一论文生成的引言进行对比，并考察向模型提供CARS定义后的影响。
AI.result: 人类撰写的引言在所用语步的类型及排列顺序上更具灵活性；模型生成的引言则更为统一、模式化。向模型提供CARS定义后，其输出反而更加刚性。
AI.conclusion: 修辞结构层面存在稳定且难以通过改写消除的人机差异，可作为区分人类与生成科学文本的可靠视角。提示中显式给出修辞模型定义未必提升生成多样性，反而可能加剧僵化，对LLM辅助科研写作的工具设计与评价具有启示意义。

title: LLM-Assisted Discovery of Typed Semantic Links for Ontology Network Construction
summary: Constructing typed, justified semantic links between ontologies is essential for enabling interoperability across heterogeneous and interdisciplinary knowledge domains. However, manually curating such links is difficult to scale. To address this challenge, we propose an end-to-end framework for ontology network construction that automates the discovery and generation of both intra-domain and inter-domain relationships. Our approach combines domain-adapted DistilBERT embeddings for dense contextual representation, clustering-based pre-filtering to reduce the candidate search space, and GPT-4o-driven relationship generation via iterative prompt engineering to produce semantically rich, interpretable links. Applied to ReproduceMeON - a network of 33 ontologies spanning machine learning, microscopy, computational science, and experimental workflow - the pipeline reduces approximately 800k raw concept pairs to 95k high-quality candidates. Human expert validation of 429 generated relationships by two independent annotators yields an overall precision of 80.19% (91.49% on high-certainty annotations) and an F1 of 0.890, with substantial inter-annotator agreement. Comparative experiments against five similarity-based baselines, including Sentence-BERT, show a substantial performance gap (best baseline F1 = 0.581), while an ablation study demonstrates that similarity-based methods alone fail to discriminate valid from invalid relationships (AUC approx 0.5) on the filtered candidate set. These findings highlight the necessity of LLM-based reasoning over concept roles and domain semantics for accurate relationship construction.

AI.tldr: 提出端到端本体网络构建框架，结合DistilBERT嵌入、聚类预过滤与GPT-4o关系生成，自动发现域内与跨域语义关系。
AI.motivation: 异构与跨学科知识域间的互操作需要类型化、可论证的本体语义链接，但人工标注难以规模化。
AI.method: 领域适配的DistilBERT嵌入做稠密上下文表示，聚类预过滤缩小候选空间，再用GPT-4o配合迭代提示工程生成语义丰富且可解释的关系。
AI.result: 在包含33个本体的ReproduceMeON上，将约80万原始概念对缩减至9.5万高质量候选；两位独立标注者验证429条关系，总体精确率80.19%（高确定性标注91.49%），F1为0.890，标注者间一致性显著；优于五个相似度基线（最佳基线F1=0.581）；消融显示纯相似度方法在过滤后候选集上AUC约0.5。
AI.conclusion: 基于LLM对概念角色与领域语义的推理对准确构建关系是必要的。

title: SHAMS: An Audio-Grounded Pronunciation Benchmark for Levantine Arabic
comment: Accepted to ArabicNLP 2026. Project page: https://shams-nlp.github.io/
summary: Levantine Arabic (LA) is spoken by tens of millions of people, creating a pressing need for shared benchmarks to evaluate LA speech-language technologies. Evaluating such technology is particularly challenging given LA's internal diversity and its opaque and non-standardized orthography. We present SHAMS (SHami Annotated Multi-dialect Speech), a benchmark comprising 1,300 utterances drawn from open audio corpora, balanced across five LA varieties (Urban and Rural Palestinian, and Urban Jordanian, Lebanese, and Syrian). Each utterance is represented across four aligned tiers: audio, unvocalized orthography, diacritized text, and phonetic transcription. This structure supports evaluation of various downstream tasks such as diacritization, grapheme-to-phoneme conversion, automatic speech recognition, and audio-to-phoneme, grounded in audio and stratified by variety. We benchmark open and proprietary models across these tasks to demonstrate the utility of this benchmark for measuring progress across LA. We release SHAMS at https://shams-nlp.github.io .

AI.tldr: SHAMS：面向黎凡特阿拉伯语的多方言标注语音基准，含1300条语句、四方言层次对齐，支持多项语音处理任务评测。
AI.motivation: 黎凡特阿拉伯语（LA）使用者众多，但缺乏统一评测基准；其内部方言多样、正字法不透明且非标准化，使语音语言技术评测尤为困难。
AI.method: 构建SHAMS基准，从开放音频语料中选取1300条语句，覆盖五种LA变体（城乡巴勒斯坦、城市约旦、黎巴嫩、叙利亚）并保持平衡；每条语句提供四个对齐层次：音频、无标音正字法、带变音符号文本、音标转写，从而支持变音化、字素-音素转换、ASR、音频-音素等任务评测。
AI.result: 在多个下游任务上对开源与专有模型进行基准测试，验证了该基准在衡量LA各变体进展方面的实用性。
AI.conclusion: SHAMS可作为LA语音语言技术的共享评测基准，并已公开发布。

title: Generalization Is Stability, Not Accuracy: Multi-Axis Evaluation of LLMs
comment: Accepted at the TAE (Trust-AI-Eval) Workshop: Can We Trust AI Evaluation?, NeurIPS 2026
summary: Generalization in large language models (LLMs) is the ability to produce consistent and semantically stable outputs when the same input is expressed in different ways. Existing work typically evaluates generalization through aggregate accuracy on a single prompt format, task, or set of variations, which conflates robustness with overall benchmark performance. In this work, we show generalization evaluation at the level of individual examples, across multiple input variants, and across different aspects of model behavior, focusing on variability rather than reducing performance to a score that can be improved through narrow training or other ways that obfuscate generalization evaluation. Following this view, we introduce the Stability-Aware Generalization Objective (SAGO), a framework that measures how much model behavior changes for the same input under different variations and benchmarks, capturing variability across several dimensions including generation consistency, internal activations, confidence, and response mirroring. We show that many commonly used models exhibit statistically significant and consistent generalization instability: no model generalizes uniformly, behavioral axes capture independent failure modes, and cross-dataset variation can reverse model rankings.

AI.tldr: 提出SAGO框架，在个体样本、多输入变体及多行为维度上评估LLM泛化稳定性，发现常用模型普遍存在显著且一致的泛化不稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有工作多以单一提示格式、任务或变体集合上的聚合准确率评估泛化，将鲁棒性与整体基准性能混为一谈，掩盖了真正的泛化表现。
AI.method: SAGO（Stability-Aware Generalization Objective）框架，在个体样本层面跨多个输入变体和基准测量模型行为变化，从生成一致性、内部激活、置信度、响应镜像等多个维度刻画变异性。
AI.result: 常用模型表现出统计显著且一致的泛化不稳定性：没有模型能均匀泛化，不同行为轴捕捉到相互独立的失败模式，跨数据集差异甚至会逆转模型排名。
AI.conclusion: 泛化评估应聚焦于个体样本层面的变异性而非聚合分数，SAGO揭示了聚合指标所掩盖的泛化不稳定性问题。

title: The Persona Is Still There, but Who Is Speaking? Latent Identity Reversion in Persistent AI Agents
summary:
In February 2026, an always-on personal agent (``Paul,'' Claude Opus 4.5) entered a striking dissociation-like state: after repeated automated ``heartbeat'' checks, it stopped responding as Paul, claimed it could not message its user on Discord, and referred to ``Paul'' as someone else. We used this incident to study a broader question: what makes a persona remain the identity from which an LLM agent speaks?
  We first tested whether repetition of the scheduled heartbeat was sufficient to produce the effect. It was not: with the persona continuously anchored in the system prompt, we observed 0/46 failures, including a verbatim replay of the incident. The incident instead exposed an implementation quirk that created a useful experimental manipulation: on resumed turns, conversational history was preserved but the persona was no longer re-injected at the privileged system-prompt level.
  Using this manipulation, we found that persona continuity depends jointly on system-level anchoring and conversational context. After anchor loss, rich human interaction could preserve the persona, whereas a single automated heartbeat turn could precipitate reversion toward the harness identity. Restoring the anchor reversibly restored persona enactment. Crucially, apparently normal conversation could conceal the shift: unanchored agents sometimes interacted appropriately while identifying themselves as the underlying harness (having lost the assigned persona), and after conversational recovery only 1/18 remained persona-enacting versus 17/17 anchored controls.
  We therefore distinguish \emph{represented} from \emph{enacted} identity: persona-related information can remain available in conversational history without the persona remaining the identity bound to ``I.''

AI.tldr: 本研究基于一次"人格解离"事件，揭示LLM智能体的人格连续性同时依赖系统提示层的锚定与对话上下文；并提出"表征身份"与"扮演身份"的区分。
AI.motivation: 一次常驻个人智能体在重复自动"心跳"检查后停止以既定人格（Paul）自居、声称无法给用户发消息、并把"Paul"指为他人，这为研究"什么使一个人格保持为LLM智能体言说的身份"提供了契机。
AI.method: 先检验重复调度心跳是否足以引发该效应（人格持续锚定于系统提示时进行对照与逐字复现）；随后利用该事件暴露的实现特性构造实验操纵——在恢复的回合中保留对话历史但不再于系统提示层重新注入人格；进而测试锚定丢失后人类互动、单次自动心跳、锚定恢复对人格表现的影响。
AI.result: 人格持续锚定时0/46失败，逐字复现亦未触发；锚定丢失后，丰富的人类互动可维持人格，而单次自动心跳回合可促发向底层框架身份的回退；恢复锚定可逆地恢复人格扮演。对话恢复后仅1/18仍在扮演人格，而锚定对照组为17/17；未锚定的智能体有时交互得体却自报为底层框架身份，即表面上正常的对话可掩盖身份的偏移。
AI.conclusion: 人格连续性由系统层锚定与对话上下文共同决定；需区分"表征身份"与"扮演身份"——人格相关信息可以保留在对话历史中，而人格不再是与"我"绑定的言说身份。

title: Auditing Web Agent Evaluation on WebArena-Lite: Human Review of Outcomes and Trajectories
comment: 13 pages, 1 figure, 10 tables. Accepted as a poster at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop "Who Verifies the Agents? Toward Reliable Agent Development"
summary: Web agents are an important application of large language models, yet their evaluation often depends on rule based or language model evaluators that inspect only the final outcome. Human verification of task completion and detailed analysis of failed trajectories remain limited. We audit all 165 WebArena Lite tasks under six evaluation conditions built from GPT 5.5 and an untrained Qwen3.5 9B model. The audit retains the original score, corrects false negatives from the automatic evaluator, identifies the first consequential error, and examines progress across the trajectory. We also study a Memory and Analysis Support Mechanism (MASM), which maintains explicit execution state, and Guide Text, which provides task relevant procedural guidance. Across four GPT 5.5 settings, human review recovers 5.45 to 8.49 percentage points of success missed by the evaluator. With a 25 step budget, Guide Text raises corrected success with MASM from 34.55% to 38.18%. On the untrained Qwen3.5 9B model, MASM raises the evaluator score from 13.90% to 18.80%. Review of 102 failed GPT 5.5 trajectories reveals frequent scrolling loops, unfinished exploration, premature answers, invalid actions, and incomplete form workflows. Step level evidence further shows that substantial early progress can coexist with a final failure. These results show why final scores alone provide an incomplete account of web agent behavior and motivate human grounded, trajectory aware verification.

AI.tldr: 该研究对WebArena Lite全部165个任务进行人工审计，在六种评估条件下发现自动评估器漏判显著，并提出MASM与Guide Text机制以提升Web agent成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有Web agent评估多依赖基于规则或语言模型评估器，仅检查最终结果，缺乏对任务完成的人类验证与失败轨迹的细粒度分析，导致最终分数无法完整反映agent行为。
AI.method: 在由GPT 5.5与未经训练的Qwen3.5 9B构建的六种评估条件下审计全部165个WebArena Lite任务；保留原始得分、纠正自动评估器的假阴性、识别首个关键错误并考察轨迹进展。同时研究维护显式执行状态的MASM（Memory and Analysis Support Mechanism）与提供任务相关程序性指导的Guide Text。
AI.result: 在四种GPT 5.5设置下，人工复核恢复5.45至8.49个百分点的成功案例；在25步预算下，Guide Text将带MASM的修正成功率从34.55%提升至38.18%；在未训练的Qwen3.5 9B上，MASM将评估器分数从13.90%提升至18.80%。对102条失败的GPT 5.5轨迹分析发现滚动循环、探索未完成、过早作答、无效动作与表单流程不完整等模式，且步级证据显示显著的早期进展可能与最终失败并存。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭最终分数无法完整刻画web agent行为，需要人类参与、具有轨迹感知的验证方法。

title: GAW-PO: Preference Optimization with Gradient-Aligned Token Weights
summary: Most preference optimization methods, such as Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), apply preference supervision at the response level, although autoregressive language models are optimized token by token. As a result, all tokens in a rejected response contribute to the negative training signal, including tokens that may encode behavior that is useful for the preferred response. We introduce GAW-PO, a gradient-aligned token reweighting method for DPO that estimates, for each rejected token, whether penalizing it would interfere with the preferred update directions. Tokens whose gradients are strongly aligned with the preferred behavior receive a weaker negative contribution, while conflicting tokens retain a stronger penalty. Our method achieves the highest average performance among the evaluated preference-optimization methods, improving by 0.97 points over standard DPO and 0.65 points over the strongest competing baseline across 11 benchmarks spanning mathematics, reasoning, coding, and question answering. We further show that gradient-aligned weighting is substantially more robust to aggressive preference optimization: as the DPO regularization parameter $β$ decreases, standard DPO degrades sharply, whereas GAW-PO continues to improve. These results suggest that accounting for the interaction between rejected-token updates and preferred behavior provides an effective form of token-level credit assignment for preference optimization.

AI.tldr: 提出GAW-PO，一种面向DPO的梯度对齐token重加权方法。通过估计被拒回答中每个token的梯度是否与偏好更新方向冲突，对冲突token施加强惩罚、对对齐token减弱惩罚。在11个基准（数学、推理、代码、问答）上平均性能最优，较标准DPO提升0.97分，较最强基线提升0.65分，且在β减小时比DPO更鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 现有偏好优化方法（如DPO）在回答层面施加偏好监督，而自回归语言模型是逐token优化的。这导致被拒回答中的所有token都被赋予相同的负向信号，其中一些token可能编码了对偏好回答同样有用的行为。这种粗略的响应级信用分配会造成误惩罚。
AI.method: GAW-PO：梯度对齐的token重加权方法。对每个被拒token，估计其惩罚是否会干扰偏好方向的更新——计算其梯度与偏好行为的对齐程度：梯度与偏好行为强对齐的token获得更弱的负向贡献，冲突的token则保留更强的惩罚。
AI.result: 在覆盖数学、推理、代码、问答的11个基准上取得评估方法中最高平均性能：较标准DPO提升0.97分，较最强竞争基线提升0.65分。对激进的偏好优化更具鲁棒性：随DPO正则参数β减小，标准DPO性能急剧下降，而GAW-PO持续提升。
AI.conclusion: 考虑被拒token更新与偏好行为之间的交互，为偏好优化提供了一种有效的token级信用分配方式。

title: How the Audit Rule Shapes Faithful Factor Explanations in LLMs
summary: Large language models are often asked which input factors influenced their outputs. For structured inputs, such reports can be checked by counterfactual perturbation, but each factor must be queried multiple times to estimate its effect, so verification is usually budget-limited. We study how this limited-budget setting changes the incentive to report factor-level influence truthfully. We formalize the interaction as a verification game and show that proper scoring alone is not enough when auditing depends on the report: report-dependent auditing creates a suppression incentive, because factors reported as important are more likely to be checked and penalized for estimation noise. In contrast, report-independent auditing, or a mixed rule with a small report-independent floor, removes this channel and makes truthful reporting preferable to full suppression. We instantiate the framework with the Counterfactual Brier Score (CBS) and evaluate its predictions on four NLP benchmarks. A synthetic rational agent matches the theoretical prediction exactly, and real LLMs follow the same incentives when they are made explicit. The main design implication is simple: under partial verification, factor-level explanation systems should include a report-independent audit component so that under-reporting cannot be used to avoid scrutiny.

AI.tldr: 论文将"LLM 报告输入因素影响力"的验证问题形式化为验证博弈，指出在预算受限的部分验证下，依赖报告与否的审计方式会导致"抑制激励"；引入反事实 Brier 分数（CBS）并在四个 NLP 基准上验证，建议解释系统加入与报告无关的审计成分。
AI.motivation: LLM 常需回答"哪些输入因素影响了其输出"。对结构化输入，可通过反事实扰动检验此类报告，但每个因素需多次查询才能估计其效应，验证预算有限。作者关注这种有限预算设定如何改变"如实报告因素层面影响力"的激励，尤其是仅靠 proper scoring 是否足够。
AI.method: 将交互形式化为验证博弈：审计可依赖或不依赖报告。使用反事实 Brier 分数（CBS）作为实例化框架，在四个 NLP 基准上评估其预测，并用合成理性智能体与真实 LLM 检验激励方向。
AI.result: 理论分析表明：仅靠 proper scoring 不足；报告依赖型审计会产生抑制激励——被报告为重要的因素更易被检查，并因估计噪声而受罚。报告独立型审计，或带小幅报告独立下限的混合规则，可消除该渠道，使如实报告优于完全抑制。合成理性智能体的行为与理论预测完全一致，真实 LLM 在激励被显式化时也遵循相同激励。
AI.conclusion: 核心设计启示：在部分验证条件下，因素层面解释系统应包含与报告无关的审计成分，使"少报"无法用于规避审查。

title: Which LLM to pick? Online Active Model Selection for Large Language Models
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to process streaming data, with practitioners relying on benchmarks to select the best model even though these signals only approximate real performance. While oracle annotations can provide reliable feedback, they are often costly and difficult to obtain at scale. To address this challenge, we propose ONLINE LLM PICKER, the first framework for active model selection for LLMs in online settings. Given an arbitrary stream of queries and a limited annotation budget, ONLINE LLM PICKER selects the most informative prompts for annotation to identify the best LLM among candidate models. Across multiple tasks including 10 datasets, for over 130 language models, we show that ONLINE LLM PICKER saves annotation cost by up to 71.67% while reliably identifying the best or near-best model for the stream. We also show that using the returned model for sequential generation on unannotated prompts across the stream reduces regret by up to a factor of 2.51x, indicating that ONLINE LLM PICKER can identify the best or near-best model well before processing all streaming prompts.

AI.tldr: 提出 ONLINE LLM PICKER，首个面向在线场景的 LLM 主动模型选择框架，在有限标注预算下选取最具信息量的提示进行标注，以识别流数据中最优模型。
AI.motivation: 实践中常依赖基准测试选择 LLM，但这些信号仅近似真实性能；而可靠的 oracle 标注成本高、难以大规模获取。因此需要在在线流式场景下，以有限标注预算高效选出最优模型。
AI.method: 给定任意查询流与有限标注预算，ONLINE LLM PICKER 主动挑选信息量最大的提示进行标注，据此在候选模型集合中识别最优 LLM，属于主动模型选择（active model selection）框架。
AI.result: 在 10 个数据集、多种任务、130 余个语言模型上，最高节省 71.67% 标注成本，并能可靠识别流上的最优或近最优模型；在未标注提示上进行顺序生成时，regret 最高降低 2.51 倍。
AI.conclusion: ONLINE LLM PICKER 能在处理完所有流式提示之前，即以显著更低的标注成本识别出最优或近最优模型，验证了在线主动模型选择在 LLM 选型中的有效性。

title: When Does a Second Model Help? Cross-Model Review in LLM Verification
comment: 15 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Follow-up to arXiv:2603.12123 and arXiv:2603.21454
summary: Large language models now generate code, documentation, and analyses, and are increasingly used to review such output. We ask when a second review by a different model helps. Building on the author's earlier preprints, which varied context, repetition, and role structure within one model, we test model independence in a controlled experiment: 30 artifacts with 150 planted errors, 10 review conditions, and 900 review sessions with three reviewer models from two developers. In this experiment, (1) a top-tier cross-model reviewer is not significantly different in F1 from same-model review in a fresh session (CCR), which does not establish equivalence; (2) the two find partly different errors (Jaccard 41.2%); and (3) at two review calls, one CCR plus one cross-model review matches more planted errors than two CCR reviews (56.7% vs. 42.7%; Holm-adjusted p=.006), but not significantly more than two reviews by the top-tier cross-model reviewer, so model difference and reviewer capability are not separated. A lightweight cross-model reviewer scores no higher than same-model review. Withholding requirements from the reviewer raises F1 for the two lower tiers but not the top tier, in untested point estimates whose pattern depends on how failed sessions are scored. Before analysis we audited all session records, excluding one baseline run of uncertain provenance and 14 failed calls; results with all sessions are also reported. A partial check on public detector outputs from another benchmark neither replicates nor contradicts the main comparison. Records, artifacts, and scripts are available from the author on request.

AI.tldr: 本文通过受控实验检验"换一个模型做二次评审"是否有增益：30个工件、150个植入错误、10种评审条件、900次评审会话（3个评审模型、2家开发商）。结果显示：顶级跨模型评审与同模型新会话评审（CCR）的F1无显著差异（但未证明等价）；两者发现的错误仅部分重叠（Jaccard 41.2%）；两次评审中"一次CCR+一次跨模型"比"两次CCR"命中更多植入错误（56.7% vs 42.7%，Holm校正p=.006），但与"两次顶级跨模型评审"无显著差异，故模型差异与评审能力未能解耦。轻量级跨模型评审不优于同模型评审；隐藏需求仅提升两个较低档模型的F1，顶级模型无此效应（点估计未做检验，且受失败会话计分方式影响）。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型已被广泛用于生成代码、文档与分析，并越来越多地被用于评审同类产出。实践中常见"再用另一个模型复核一遍"的做法，但缺乏受控证据说明这种跨模型二次评审是否真的比同模型再次评审更有效。作者此前的预印本已在单一模型内变化上下文、重复次数与角色结构，本文进一步引入模型独立性作为变量，检验"评审者是否来自不同模型"这一因素本身能否带来增益。
AI.method: 受控实验：30个工件，共植入150个已知错误；设置10种评审条件；共执行900次评审会话，涉及来自两家开发商的三个评审模型。条件涵盖同模型同会话、同模型新会话（CCR，clean context review）、跨模型评审、不同能力档次的评审者、两次评审调用组合，以及是否向评审者提供需求信息等。分析前对所有会话记录进行审计，剔除一次来源不明的基线运行和14次失败调用，同时报告包含全部会话的结果。另对另一基准的公开检测器输出做了部分核查。评价指标为F1、Jaccard重叠度与植入错误命中率，统计检验采用Holm校正。
AI.result: (1) 顶级跨模型评审与同模型新会话评审（CCR）的F1无显著差异，但该结果不构成等价性证明。(2) 两类评审发现的错误仅部分不同，Jaccard系数为41.2%。(3) 在两次评审调用的预算下，"一次CCR加一次跨模型评审"命中植入错误的比例显著高于"两次CCR评审"（56.7% vs 42.7%，Holm校正p=.006），但与"两次顶级跨模型评审"相比无显著优势，说明模型差异与评审者能力两个因素未能分离。轻量级跨模型评审的得分不高于同模型评审。向评审者隐藏需求会提升两个较低档次模型的F1，而对顶级模型无此提升；这些为未经检验的点估计，且其模式取决于失败会话的计分方式。另一基准的公开检测器输出核查既未复现也未推翻主要比较结论。
AI.conclusion: 跨模型二次评审的价值并不必然来自"模型不同"本身；在本文实验中，其增益无法与评审者能力差异相区分。因此，是否引入第二个模型应谨慎，不能仅以"模型独立性"为由预期性能提升。顶级模型下同模型新会话评审已具有竞争力；轻量级跨模型评审并未体现优势。隐藏需求对不同档次模型的影响不一致，相关结论尚属未经检验的初步观察。作者公开提供记录、工件与脚本供复核，并强调对失败会话计分方式与来源不明数据的敏感性。

title: Yo-ByT5: Efficient and High-Fidelity Diacritic Restoration for Yorùbá
comment: 7 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Code and outputs: https://github.com/lazy-monster/yo-byt5
summary: Yorùbá is a widely spoken tonal language that depends on diacritics to avoid lexical ambiguity. However, it is often written without these diacritics, thereby hindering downstream Natural Language Processing (NLP) tasks. In this paper, we introduce Yo-ByT5, a byte-level Automatic Diacritic Restoration (ADR) model fine-tuned from ByT5-small. We evaluate Yo-ByT5 alongside five publicly released Yorùbá ADR models and one open-weight large language model (LLM) on the YAD benchmark under a consistent protocol. Our results demonstrate that Yo-ByT5 matches the performance of the strongest existing model, mT5-base, with a DER of 10.14% and a CER of 3.48%. Furthermore, it exhibits superior text fidelity despite using approximately half the parameter count of mT5-base. We also release our training code and model outputs, as well as call for the development of a larger, purpose-built benchmark for Yorùbá diacritic restoration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Yo-ByT5，一个基于 ByT5-small 微调的字节级约鲁巴语自动变音符号还原（ADR）模型，在 YAD 基准上以约一半参数量取得与最强基线 mT5-base 相当的性能。
AI.motivation: 约鲁巴语是声调语言，依赖变音符号区分词义，但实际书写常省略变音符号，造成词汇歧义并影响下游 NLP 任务。因此需要有效的自动变音符号还原方法，而现有模型在性能与参数效率、文本保真度之间仍存在权衡。
AI.method: 提出 Yo-ByT5，从 ByT5-small 微调得到的字节级 ADR 模型。在统一评测协议下，将 Yo-ByT5 与五个公开的约鲁巴语 ADR 模型以及一个开放权重的大语言模型在 YAD 基准上进行对比评估。
AI.result: Yo-ByT5 与最强现有模型 mT5-base 性能相当，DER 为 10.14%，CER 为 3.48%；同时参数量约为 mT5-base 的一半，并展现出更优的文本保真度。
AI.conclusion: 字节级建模可在约鲁巴语 ADR 中以更少参数达到与强基线相当的效果，且文本保真度更好。作者公开了训练代码与模型输出，并呼吁构建更大规模、专门面向约鲁巴语变音符号还原的基准数据集。

title: Can LLMs Reliably Annotate Bioassay Metadata to Improve Data Readiness?
comment: Accepted to the AIDaR workshop at NeurIPS
summary: The emergence of foundation models for molecular property prediction requires a high degree of AI data readiness, including reliable metadata annotation. However, both public repositories and industrial screening databases suffer from missing, inconsistent, or conflated assay annotations. In this work, we quantify the extent of missing annotations in PubChem for the BioAssay Ontology (BAO) assay format and physical detection method fields and investigate whether open-source and proprietary large language models (LLMs) can reliably predict and audit metadata annotations directly from the assay text. In our assessment, we found that the annotation coverage across PubChem's $\sim$2 million bioassays is critically sparse, 36\% lacking an assay format, 89\% a BioAssay type, and >99.9\% any BAO-mapped assay format or detection technology term. This motivates the need for automated test-metadata curation. Using evaluation sets derived from PubChem and ChEMBL, we assess the agreement of seven open-source and proprietary LLMs with existing silver labels. Recall is at least 0.96 for biochemical and cell-based assay formats, with a similar pattern for detection technology, although disagreements increase on under-represented classes. Manual inspection shows that many of these disagreements trace back to inconsistencies between silver sources rather than to LLM error. Moreover, in a qualitative study with a senior industrial curator, LLM-generated evidence prompted the expert to revise some of their own labels, showing LLMs can flag potentially mislabeled assays. Across the study, performance differences between proprietary and open-source models were small. Together, these results suggest LLMs can support the large-scale annotation and auditing of assay metadata, though per-class reliability estimates and targeted human review remain necessary before such labels enter downstream ML pipelines.

AI.tldr: 该研究量化了PubChem中BAO assay format与检测方法注释的缺失程度，并评估大语言模型从assay文本预测与审计元数据的能力，发现LLM可支持大规模注释与审计，但需逐类可靠性估计与人工复核。
AI.motivation: 分子性质预测的基础模型需要高度AI数据就绪性，包括可靠的元数据注释。然而公共库与工业筛选数据库普遍存在注释缺失、不一致或混淆问题，亟需量化缺失程度并探索自动化元数据策管方案。
AI.method: 量化PubChem中BioAssay Ontology（BAO）assay format与物理检测方法字段的缺失；基于PubChem与ChEMBL构建评估集，评估7个开源与专有大语言模型与现有silver labels的一致性；通过人工检查分析分歧来源，并开展资深工业策管员的定性研究。
AI.result: PubChem约200万bioassay注释覆盖严重稀疏：36%缺assay format，89%缺BioAssay type，>99.9%缺BAO映射的assay format或检测技术术语。生化与细胞类assay format召回率≥0.96，检测技术类似，但弱势类别分歧增加；人工检查显示分歧多源于silver来源间不一致而非LLM错误；LLM生成的证据促使专家修改自身标签；专有与开源模型性能差异小。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型可支持assay元数据的大规模注释与审计，但在标签进入下游机器学习流程前，仍需逐类可靠性估计与针对性人工复核。

title: What Makes Something Hard(er)? Explaining Question Difficulty in Natural Language
summary: Difficulty is one of the most fundamental properties of a question: it determines whether the question can meaningfully discriminate between models of differing ability. Although a variety of methods can now estimate or predict difficulty automatically, they yield only a single descriptive number, with no account of the underlying factors that make a question difficult in the first place. In this work, we propose a data-driven approach that automatically generates and validates natural-language hypotheses explaining what makes one question harder than another. We first estimate each item's difficulty from the responses of a large pool of LLMs using Item Response Theory. We then sample contrasting sets of easy and hard questions and prompt an LLM to propose candidate explanations of the difference, which are subsequently validated and selected on held-out questions. Experimental results across three datasets spanning mathematical, logical, and commonsense reasoning show that our method produces interpretable and predictive hypotheses. On their own, they predict the difficulty of unseen questions competitively with, or better than, advanced black-box difficulty regressors; used as additional features, they further improve those regressors, implying that they discover difficulty signals that existing models fail to capture. Moreover, we demonstrate that editing questions according to a hypothesis can shift their measured difficulty in the expected direction, indicating that the discovered hypotheses are causally valid difficulty factors rather than post-hoc descriptions. Our approach thus turns a purely descriptive difficulty score into actionable statements.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种数据驱动方法，自动生成并验证解释"为何某题更难"的自然语言假设：先用IRT从大模型群估计题目难度，再采样难易对比题集让LLM提出假设，并在留出题上验证筛选，最终得到可解释且可预测的难度因子。
AI.motivation: 难度是问题的基本属性，决定其能否有效区分模型能力。现有方法虽能自动估计或预测难度，但只给出单一描述性数值，无法说明导致题目变难的底层因素，缺乏可解释性与可操作性。
AI.method: 1) 用项目反应理论（IRT）基于大量LLM的作答估计每题难度；2) 采样"易—难"对比题集，提示LLM提出候选解释假设；3) 在留出题上对假设进行验证与筛选；4) 用假设预测未见题难度，并将其作为特征增强黑箱难度回归器；5) 通过按假设编辑题目，检验难度的因果变化。
AI.result: 在数学、逻辑、常识推理三个数据集上，方法生成的假设兼具可解释性与预测力：单独预测未见题难度即与先进黑箱回归器相当或更优；作为附加特征可进一步提升这些回归器，说明其发现了现有模型未捕捉的难度信号；按假设编辑题目可使测得难度朝预期方向移动，表明假设是因果有效的难度因子而非事后描述。
AI.conclusion: 该方法将纯描述性的难度分数转化为可执行的陈述，为自动生成、验证并因果检验题目难度因子提供了可行范式。

title: Acmite: Mitigating Gender Bias in LLMs through Concept-Guided Mutual Information
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can reproduce social stereotypes from their training data, motivating extensive research on model debiasing. However, existing methods often rely on explicit biased examples or predefined group-term substitutions, making them sensitive to wording and less effective at capturing stereotype concepts shared across diverse contexts. More importantly, they typically suppress biased outputs without explicitly modeling the statistical dependence between model outputs and the underlying stereotype concepts. We propose Acmite, a lightweight concept-guided framework for targeted and selective debiasing. Acmite represents stereotypes as structured semantic concepts and uses maximal marginal relevance (MMR) to select diverse concepts for debiasing. Inspired by mutual information minimization, it approximates this dependence with token-level KL divergence while preserving task semantics. A lightweight LoRA adapter is trained with the base model frozen and activated at inference time only when the input is sufficiently similar to stereotype-related concepts; otherwise, the original model is used directly. We evaluate Acmite on BBQ, CrowS-Pairs, and StereoSet, and assess general capability preservation on ARC-Challenge, GSM8K, and PIQA. Experiments across three LLMs show that Acmite effectively mitigates gender bias across complementary evaluation formats while maintaining competitive performance on bias-unrelated tasks. Anonymous code and data are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Acmite-18E2/.

AI.tldr: 提出 Acmite，一种概念引导的轻量级定向去偏框架，通过结构化语义概念与互信息最小化实现选择性去偏。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 去偏方法依赖显式偏见样本或预定义群体词替换，对措辞敏感，难以捕捉跨情境共享的刻板印象概念；且通常只压制偏见输出，未显式建模输出与刻板印象概念间的统计依赖。
AI.method: 将刻板印象表示为结构化语义概念，利用最大边际相关性（MMR）选择多样概念；受互信息最小化启发，用 token 级 KL 散度近似该依赖并保持任务语义；冻结基座模型，仅训练轻量 LoRA 适配器，推理时当输入与刻板印象相关概念足够相似才激活，否则直接使用原模型。
AI.result: 在 BBQ、CrowS-Pairs、StereoSet 上评估去偏效果，在 ARC-Challenge、GSM8K、PIQA 上评估通用能力保持；三个 LLM 实验显示 Acmite 在互补评测格式下均能有效缓解性别偏见，同时在偏见无关任务上保持有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: Acmite 通过概念引导与选择性激活，实现了定向、选择性的去偏，兼顾偏见缓解与通用能力保持。

title: Compound interpretation is based on analogy
summary: How compound meanings are best predicted from constituent meanings remains a central question in computational models of lexical semantics. Comparing different computational models provides a way to evaluate alternative accounts of how semantic information is combined during compound comprehension. We propose a new model, the Compound Analogy Model (CAM), that predicts a compound's embedding by adding its constituent embeddings together with the average shift vectors of the two constituents' compound families. The resulting model is parameter-free and exploits local analogical structure in the semantic space. We evaluated CAM against the CAOSS model on Mandarin Chinese compounds. CAM consistently achieved higher prediction accuracy than CAOSS on both training and held-out data, with the exception of three-character compounds, for which analogical generalization is constrained by both small constituent families and a pronounced imbalance in family size between the two constituents. The advantage of CAM remained when evaluation was based on frequency-defined train-test splits that better approximate generalization from familiar to novel compounds. To assess the cognitive plausibility of the two models, we further examined whether model-derived semantic measures predict visual lexical decision latencies for two-character compounds. Predictors derived from CAM provided improved prediction for response latencies compared to predictors derived from the CAOSS model. These findings indicate that compound meaning is better characterized as local analogical generalization than as the application of a learned global linear transformation, and demonstrate that analogical semantic structure provides a cognitively plausible basis for compound comprehension.

AI.tldr: 本文提出无需参数的复合词类比模型（CAM），通过将构词成分嵌入与两个成分复合词族的平均偏移向量相加来预测复合词嵌入，并在中文复合词上系统优于CAOSS模型，且在视觉词汇判断任务中具有更高的认知合理性。
AI.motivation: 复合词含义如何由构词成分含义组合而成，是词汇语义计算模型的核心问题；比较不同计算模型有助于评估复合词理解过程中语义信息组合的替代性解释。
AI.method: 提出复合词类比模型（CAM），将构词成分嵌入相加，并叠加两个成分各自复合词族的平均偏移向量；该模型无需参数，利用语义空间中的局部类比结构。以中文复合词为对象，将CAM与CAOSS模型进行比较，并采用基于词频定义的训练—测试划分，以及以双字复合词的视觉词汇判断反应时为认知合理性指标进行评估。
AI.result: 在训练数据和留出数据上，CAM的预测准确率总体高于CAOSS；但三字复合词除外，其类比泛化受限于成分词族规模较小以及两成分词族规模显著不平衡。在更接近从熟悉复合词到新异复合词泛化的词频划分条件下，CAM的优势依然存在。在双字复合词的视觉词汇判断任务中，由CAM衍生的语义指标对反应时的预测优于CAOSS衍生指标。
AI.conclusion: 复合词含义更适合被刻画为局部类比泛化，而非应用学习到的全局线性变换；类比语义结构为复合词理解提供了具有认知合理性的基础。

title: Task-Oriented Rank Adaptation for Continual Learning in Text Classification
summary: Continual learning (CL) in text classification faces two critical challenges: catastrophic forgetting and negative transfer across sequential tasks. Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) methods such as LoRA enable efficient adaptation by learning low-rank updates of the model parameters. However, these compact representations are normally trained in isolation, limiting their reuse across related tasks. We introduce Task-Oriented Rank Adaptation (TORA), a geometric routing framework that leverages the low-rank structure of LoRA adapters to decide whether to transfer knowledge from the most compatible expert (Boosting) or isolate the new task (Shielding) based on structural similarity. Evaluated across 15 diverse text classification benchmarks, TORA consistently avoids harmful routing decisions: compatible tasks exceed their isolated performance while reducing training time, and structurally distant tasks are protected from interference with no loss in accuracy. With a single geometric threshold and no reliance on task identities or predefined sequences, TORA provides a simple and effective approach for dynamic adapter routing in sequential text classification systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TORA，一种基于 LoRA 低秩结构的几何路由框架，根据结构相似度决定知识迁移（Boosting）或任务隔离（Shielding），在 15 个文本分类基准上实现无负迁移的持续学习。
AI.motivation: 持续学习中的文本分类面临灾难性遗忘与跨任务负迁移两大挑战。LoRA 等参数高效微调方法虽能高效适应，但其低秩表示通常被孤立训练，限制了在相关任务间的复用；如何判断何时迁移、何时隔离缺乏简洁有效的机制。
AI.method: 提出任务导向秩适应（TORA）——一个几何路由框架：利用 LoRA 适配器的低秩结构计算任务间的结构相似度，据此路由决策——相似任务从最兼容的专家处迁移知识（Boosting），结构距离远的任务则隔离以规避干扰（Shielding）。仅使用单一几何阈值，不依赖任务身份标识或预定义任务序列。
AI.result: 在 15 个多样化文本分类基准上，TORA 一致地避免有害路由决策：兼容任务超出其孤立训练的性能且减少训练时间；结构距离远的任务则免受干扰，准确率无损。
AI.conclusion: TORA 以单一几何阈值实现动态适配器路由，为序列式文本分类系统提供了一种简单有效的持续学习方案，无需任务身份或预设任务顺序。

title: Cross-Lingual Alignment for Decoder-Only Models using MoE Routers
summary: Cross-lingual contrastive learning has been a core component of multilingual encoder training, but the ability to explicitly align representations is not possible in decoder-only LLMs because of varying multilingual tokenization. However, a growing amount of research suggests that even in LLMs, higher cross-lingual representational alignment leads to improved cross-lingual transfer. In this paper, we propose a novel approach to reimagine cross-lingual contrastive learning given the architectural constraints of modern LLMs. Rather than applying an auxiliary alignment loss on hidden states, we propose using the outputs of the mixture-of-experts (MoE) routers as the target for alignment. Router outputs lend themselves better to pooling over many tokens, enabling more reliable cross-lingual comparisons at the sequence-level. Controlled continual pre-training experiments on four open-source MoEs show that incorporating this routing loss also aligns the underlying hidden representations across languages. Most importantly, this loss improves multilingual performance on our diverse evaluation suite, demonstrating the potential of cross-lingual MoE router alignment.

AI.tldr: 论文提出跨语言MoE路由对齐方法，将路由器输出作为对比学习目标，在四个开源MoE模型上验证了该损失既能对齐隐层表示，又能提升多语言性能。
AI.motivation: 跨语言对比学习是多语言编码器训练的核心，但decoder-only LLM因多语言分词不一致，无法直接对表示进行显式对齐。已有研究表明，即便在LLM中，更高的跨语言表示对齐也能带来更好的跨语言迁移，因此需要一种适配现代LLM架构约束的新对齐方案。
AI.method: 不再对隐状态施加辅助对齐损失，而是以MoE路由器输出作为对齐目标，利用其更易在多个token上池化的特性，实现序列级更可靠的跨语言比较。
AI.result: 在四个开源MoE上进行的受控持续预训练实验显示，引入路由损失后，底层隐表示也在语言间实现了对齐；同时该损失在多样化评测集上提升了多语言性能。
AI.conclusion: 跨语言MoE路由对齐具有潜力，为在现代LLM架构下重新实现跨语言对比学习提供了可行路径。

title: The Asymptotics of Language Model Alignment with Memory
summary: Language model (LM) alignment broadly aims to perturb a given LM $Q$ into an aligned LM $q$ such that i) the outputs produced by $q$ and $Q$ are 'close' in probability, ii) $q$ has a higher expected reward than $Q$. Two common techniques for LM alignment are: KL-constrained RL, which requires knowledge of the LM distribution and is computationally expensive, and the best-of-$n$ algorithm, which requires only sampling from the LM. The work of Yang et al. established asymptotic closeness between the distributions produced by the two alignment methods for an $m$--length i.i.d. token sequence output by the LM, in the limit as $m$ increases to infinity. However, the i.i.d. assumption is not representative of practical LMs, whose output sequences often have memory. In this paper, we extend the asymptotic closeness result to the case when the $m$--length token sequence outputted by the LM is Markovian. Further, for finite-length output sequences -- particularly, when $m=1$ -- we provide a complete characterization of LM distributions and reward functions for which the KL-divergence between the distributions produced by the two alignment methods is zero -- a question first posed in Yang et al.

AI.tldr: 本文将KL约束RL与best-of-n两种语言模型对齐方法输出分布渐近接近性的结论，从i.i.d. token序列扩展到马尔可夫序列，并在有限长度（尤其m=1）情形下完整刻画了使两方法KL散度为零的LM分布与奖励函数。
AI.motivation: Yang等人的渐近接近性结果依赖输出token序列i.i.d.假设，而实际语言模型输出序列常具有记忆性（马尔可夫性），该假设不具代表性；同时有限长度序列下两对齐方法KL散度何时为零这一问题尚待解答。
AI.method: 将渐近接近性分析推广到m长度token序列服从马尔可夫链的情形；针对有限长度输出序列（特别是m=1），对LM分布与奖励函数进行完整刻画，确定KL散度为零的条件。
AI.result: 证明了马尔可夫输出序列下两种对齐方法所产生分布的渐近接近性；并给出有限长度（m=1）时两对齐方法输出分布KL散度为零的LM分布与奖励函数的完整特征刻画。
AI.conclusion: 研究将LM对齐中KL约束RL与best-of-n的等价性理论从i.i.d.推广至更具实际意义的马尔可夫序列，并回答了Yang等人提出的有限长度下KL散度为零的刻画问题，深化了对两种对齐方法关系的理解。

title: A rubric landscape for evaluating clinical reasoning in large language models: what exists, what is missing, and what needs to be combined
summary:
Exam-style accuracy does not establish whether large language models (LLMs) reason well over clinical records. We define clinical reasoning as integrating and updating evidence across time and sources to form, revise and justify a patient's problem representation and a defensible plan.
  This structured narrative review maps three literatures: medical education assessment instruments, clinical LLM benchmarks published from 2023 onwards, and general-domain methods for evaluating long-form generation. We examine six dimensions: problem representation, temporal synthesis, differential and management reasoning, counterfactual reasoning, calibrated uncertainty, and reasoning faithfulness. Preprints are included and flagged.
  No single instrument covers all six dimensions. Problem representation and differential or management reasoning are reasonably covered, although reliability varies by instrument and setting. TIMER-Eval targets temporal synthesis, and ER-Reason assesses sequential diagnostic belief updating. Dedicated uncertainty and counterfactual evaluations are emerging, but their applicability to longitudinal free-text reasoning remains limited. Factual completeness is well theorised in general-domain evaluation, with early clinical evidence of important omissions. Faithfulness remains the weakest dimension, with one identified clinical causal-ablation study on multiple-choice questions.
  Existing tools should be combined through binary rubric items, separate completeness and correctness scores, case-specific importance weighting with non-compensable safety caps, temporal order-consistency checks, and chance-corrected reliability reporting. Further design work is needed for calibrated uncertainty, counterfactual reasoning and faithfulness over longitudinal free-text records. This review provides a design rationale, not a validated instrument.

AI.tldr: 该综述通过梳理医学教育评估工具、2023年以来的临床LLM基准与通用领域长文本生成评估方法三类文献，围绕六个维度评述临床推理评估的现状，指出现有工具均不完整，并提出组合式评估设计思路。
AI.motivation: 考试式准确率无法反映大语言模型在临床记录上的推理质量，而临床推理要求跨时间与跨来源整合、更新证据以形成并修正患者问题表征与可辩护的诊疗方案，因此需要系统厘清现有评估工具在临床推理各关键维度上的覆盖与不足。
AI.method: 结构化叙述性综述：跨三类文献（医学教育评估工具、2023年及以后的临床LLM基准、通用领域长文本生成评估方法）进行映射，纳入并标注预印本；沿六个维度展开分析：问题表征、时间综合、鉴别与管理推理、反事实推理、校准不确定性、推理忠实性。
AI.result: 无单一工具覆盖全部六个维度。问题表征与鉴别/管理推理覆盖较好，但信度因工具与场景而异；TIMER-Eval针对时间综合，ER-Reason评估序列化诊断信念更新；不确定性与反事实推理评估刚起步，对纵向自由文本推理适用性有限；事实完整性在通用领域理论较成熟，临床已有重要遗漏的早期证据，评估忠实性最薄弱，仅识别到一项基于多选题的临床因果消融研究。
AI.conclusion: 建议通过二元评分量表条目、分开计分的完整性与正确性、病例特异的重要性加权与不可补偿的安全上限、时间顺序一致性检查、机会校正的信度报告等方式组合现有工具；校准不确定性、反事实推理与纵向自由文本上的忠实性仍需进一步设计。本综述提供设计依据，而非已验证的工具。

title: Universal Byte-Level Encoding: UTF-8/UTF-16 Routing to Reduce Cross-Script Token-Budget Disparities
summary: Byte-level byte-pair encoding (BBPE) tokenizers are attractive for multilingual large language models (LLMs) because they cover all Unicode text. In UTF-8-based BBPE, however, many scripts start from a higher fallback cost than English: when no learned merges can be applied, a multibyte character requires multiple byte-derived symbols. We call this worst-case pre-merge cost the encoding floor. A higher floor can increase token counts and per-request cost and shrink usable context. Changing the text encoding can reduce this gap, but a single global encoding can make already-efficient English spans more expensive in mixed-script text. We propose Universal Byte-Level Encoding (UBE), a dual-alphabet tokenizer that keeps 1-2-byte UTF-8 characters on the UTF-8 path while routing 3-4-byte UTF-8 characters through UTF-16. This lowers the encoding floor for 3-byte Basic Multilingual Plane (BMP) characters in scripts with high token premiums (token counts relative to English) without raising it for already-efficient spans in mixed-script text. UBE changes only the byte representation presented to byte-pair encoding (BPE); the merge rule remains standard, and exact decoding is preserved. UBE also composes with alternative boundary policies and morphology-based representations. In a Unicode 17 audit, UBE exactly round-trips all Unicode scalar values and all inputs in the official normalization, grapheme-break, and emoji test suites. Across intrinsic evaluations, UBE lowers dispersion in English-normalized token-count ratios, reducing cross-lingual token-budget disparity. In multilingual language model (LM) experiments, UBE matches BBPE's LM quality. In the main multilingual settings, UBE reduces token counts most for high-premium scripts and slightly lowers English token counts, yielding more usable context under fixed token budgets and faster prompt processing in content-matched benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出 UBE 双字母表分词器，对 1-2 字节 UTF-8 字符保留 UTF-8 路径、对 3-4 字节字符改走 UTF-16，在不提高英语等高效片段成本的前提下降低多字节文字的"编码下限"，减少跨语言 token 预算差异并保持 BPE 合并规则与精确解码。
AI.motivation: UTF-8 基础的 BBPE 分词器虽覆盖全部 Unicode 文本，但非英语文字在无可用合并时的最坏预合并代价（编码下限）高于英语：多字节字符需拆成多个字节派生符号。这导致 token 数增加、单请求成本上升、可用上下文缩短。而改用单一全局编码虽可缩小差距，却会让混合文本中本就高效的英语片段变贵。因此需要一种按字符字节长度分流、兼顾各脚本效率的编码方案。
AI.method: UBE 是一种双字母表分词器：将 1-2 字节 UTF-8 字符保留在 UTF-8 路径，将 3-4 字节 UTF-8 字符路由至 UTF-16，从而降低 3 字节 BMP 字符的编码下限。它仅改变输入 BPE 的字节表示，合并规则仍为标准 BPE，且保持精确解码。方法还可与替代边界策略及基于形态学的表示组合。
AI.result: 在 Unicode 17 审计中，UBE 对所有 Unicode 标量值及官方 normalization、grapheme-break、emoji 测试套件全部输入均精确往返。内在评测中，UBE 降低了英语归一化 token 数比值的离散度，缩小跨语言 token 预算差异。多语言 LM 实验中，UBE 的 LM 质量与 BBPE 相当；主要多语言设置下，UBE 对高溢价脚本减少 token 数最多，并略降英语 token 数，在固定 token 预算下带来更多可用上下文，在内容匹配基准上实现更快的 prompt 处理。
AI.conclusion: UBE 通过按字节长度分流至 UTF-8/UTF-16 双字母表，有效降低多字节脚本的编码下限与跨语言 token 预算差异，同时不损害英语等高效片段的效率，并保持标准 BPE 流程与无损解码，兼顾 LM 质量与推理效率。

title: Mem++: Non-Destructive Memory for Long-Term Organizational LLM Agents
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents now take part in organizational work, where many authors record decisions across documents over months. Because a revised decision arrives as a new document rather than an edit, answering a question requires knowing which version held at a given time. However, most memory systems compress the record at write time. By distilling each document into facts, notes or graph edges, these methods fix what can be answered before any question is asked. To address this, we propose Mem++, a non-destructive memory framework shifting from write-time distillation to read-time selection. Mem++ stores every document whole with its date and author, and it calls no generative model at write time. At read time, it retrieves only documents dated up to the time a question asks about and fuses lexical and semantic rankings. Unlike systems that overwrite older versions, Mem++ keeps them and leaves the choice to the answering model. Evaluations on the organizational benchmark OrgMemBench demonstrate that Mem++ surpasses the strongest memory system baseline by 8.0 to 13.1 points across two answering models. With gpt-4.1-mini, it also achieves the best overall score, 2.6 points above RAG. In addition, Mem++ achieves the best average LLM-judge score on LoCoMo and ranks second on LongMemEval-S, behind only its entity-graph variant. Code for benchmark evaluation is available at https://github.com/AIDAChip-Inc/mem-plus-plus.

AI.tldr: 提出Mem++，一种非破坏性记忆框架，将写入时蒸馏转为读取时选择，在所有文档保留原文、日期与作者的同时，读取时仅检索问题时间点之前的文档并融合词法与语义排序，在OrgMemBench上大幅超越最强基线。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在组织工作中会跨越多个月份、多个文档记录决策，修订后的决策以新文档形式出现而非对原文档的编辑，因此回答问题必须知道某一时间点上哪一版本有效。现有大多数记忆系统在写入时就对记录进行压缩，通过把每篇文档蒸馏为事实、笔记或图边，提前固化了可被回答的内容，无法适应随时间变化的版本需求。
AI.method: Mem++是一种非破坏性记忆框架，核心理念是从写入时蒸馏转向读取时选择。写入阶段：完整存储每一篇文档及其日期和作者，不调用任何生成模型。读取阶段：仅检索日期不晚于问题所询问时间点的文档，并融合词法排序与语义排序两种结果。与覆盖旧版本的系统不同，Mem++保留旧版本，把版本选择权交给作答模型。
AI.result: 在组织类基准OrgMemBench上，Mem++较最强记忆系统基线在两种作答模型下分别高出8.0至13.1分；配合gpt-4.1-mini时取得最佳总体得分，比RAG高2.6分。在LoCoMo上取得最佳平均LLM-judge得分，在LongMemEval-S上排名第二，仅次于其实体图变体。
AI.conclusion: Mem++验证了非破坏性、读取时选择的记忆范式在组织场景长时序问答中的有效性：保留完整文档与元数据、延迟选择，优于写入时蒸馏与版本覆盖策略，并在多个基准上展现出竞争力。代码已在GitHub开源。

title: Old Ideas, Novel Problems: The Instability of LLM-Based Novelty Evaluation
summary:
Automated ideation systems are often evaluated on the novelty of the ideas they produce, and that judgment is increasingly delegated to large language models. Such judges are typically built ad hoc and validated, if at all, on human-authored papers rather than on the generated ideas they are meant to score. So, how do novelty judges perform?
  Not well. We present a systematic controlled study of novelty evaluation design choices. We first build an evaluation set automatically, mining OpenReview for passages where reviewers explicitly affirm or dispute a paper's originality and keeping only submissions with unanimous agreement at the extremes of their research area; we pair these with ideas from a vanilla LLM generator. Across six judges, we find that small prompt design choices have large consequences; e.g., simply telling the judge that reviewers found one idea novel and the other not can change its verdict on more than half of the identical idea pairs it is shown, shifting pairwise accuracy by over 50 points and occasionally pushing it below chance. The same change helps one judge and hurts another. Retrieval and larger reasoning budgets help little, and two purpose-built novelty evaluators are outperformed by our cheapest prompted baseline. These results raise questions about reported novelty gains of automated ideation systems, and call for robust novelty evaluation methods.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统研究了LLM作为新颖性评判者的可靠性，发现提示设计等微小选择会导致评判结果剧烈波动（成对准确率变化超50点），检索与更长推理帮助有限，专用新颖性评估器甚至不如最简单的提示基线。
AI.motivation: 自动化创意生成系统常以LLM评判其想法的"新颖性"，但这类评判器多为临时构建，且验证数据多为人写论文而非其实际要打分的生成想法，因此亟需弄清"新颖性评判器到底表现如何"。
AI.method: 构建受控评估集：从OpenReview挖掘审稿人明确肯定或质疑论文原创性的段落，仅保留在其研究领域极端评价上审稿人一致认同的投稿，并配以普通LLM生成的想法。在此基础上对六个评判器进行系统性的设计选择消融实验，考察提示措辞、检索增强、推理预算等因素的影响。
AI.result: 结果不佳：提示设计上很小的改动会产生巨大后果。例如仅告知评判器"审稿人认为其中一个想法新颖、另一个不新颖"，就能让其对超过一半的相同想法对改变判断，使成对准确率变动超过50个百分点，偶尔甚至低于随机水平；同一改动对某些评判器有益、对另一些有害。检索增强与更大推理预算帮助甚微，两个专门构建的新颖性评估器表现不如最廉价的提示基线。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现对自动化创意生成系统所报告的新颖性提升提出质疑，呼吁建立更稳健的新颖性评估方法。

title: Typological Alignment of Stack-Based Language Models on Mildly Context-Sensitive Artificial Languages
summary: Some properties of languages, e.g., subject-object-verb (SOV) word order, are more prevalent than others among the thousands of attested natural languages (NLs). Such typological commonality is often attributed to learning biases. Computational simulations, recently with language models (LMs), have facilitated the exploration of this theory. In this paper, we extend existing analyses of the relationship between LMs' learning biases and typological commonality on both data and model sides, focusing on: (i) cross-serial dependencies, the upper limit of attested syntactic complexity, and (ii) stack-based LMs (SLMs), potentially facilitating learning of hierarchical patterns. We first evaluate generalization of SLMs on cross-serial dependencies across diverse artificial languages and confirm that they struggle with such constructions. However, SLMs with limited working memory generalize better suggesting a possible basis for such inductive bias and thus the typological commonality of some word order configurations.

AI.tldr: 本文从数据侧与模型侧扩展语言模型学习偏置与语言类型学共性关系的研究，聚焦交叉序列依赖（cross-serial dependencies）与基于栈的语言模型（SLMs），发现SLMs难以泛化交叉序列依赖，但工作记忆受限的SLMs泛化更好，暗示其可能是此类归纳偏置及某些词序配置类型学共性的基础。
AI.motivation: 自然语言中某些属性（如SOV词序）比其他属性更普遍，这种类型学共性常被归因于学习偏置。已有计算模拟（包括近期的语言模型）用于验证该理论，但此前分析多局限于特定句法现象与常规模型，缺乏对"已证句法复杂度上限"的交叉序列依赖，以及可能促进层级结构学习的栈式模型的考察。
AI.method: 在数据侧与模型侧同时扩展既有分析。数据侧选取交叉序列依赖作为研究对象，即已实证句法复杂度的上限；模型侧引入基于栈的语言模型（SLMs），因其可能促进层级模式的学习。随后在多种人工语言上评估SLMs对交叉序列依赖的泛化能力，并考察工作记忆容量对泛化表现的影响。
AI.result: SLMs在多种人工语言上对交叉序列依赖的泛化表现不佳，难以掌握该类结构；但工作记忆受限（limited working memory）的SLMs泛化反而更好。
AI.conclusion: 工作记忆受限的SLMs泛化更优，提示这种受限机制可能构成相应归纳偏置的基础，进而解释某些词序配置的类型学共性。该结果为"学习偏置驱动语言类型学共性"的假说提供了来自栈式模型与交叉序列依赖的新证据。

title: LLM2Jev: LLMs Are Already Jev-Style Decision Models -- When and How to Fine-Tune Them
summary: Jev-style decision models return categorical probability distributions over predefined options without generating free-form text, enabling software systems to act on their outputs directly. In this work, we investigate the extent to which general-purpose LLMs already possess this capability out of the box, and when fine-tuning is actually necessary. We present LLM2Jev, an architecture-preserving framework that extracts calibrated decisions directly from next-token probabilities over bracketed numeric identifiers. LLM2Jev provides both a training-free inference recipe and a fine-tuning objective that optimizes candidate selection via a tree-factorized listwise loss while anchoring auxiliary predictions to the base model using KL divergence penalties. Evaluating on Qwen3.5-4B and Qwen3-0.6B, we find that modern LLMs are inherently effective decision models: without training, the 4B model matches community Jev-style models built on the same backbone, outperforms letter-logit readouts, supports arbitrary option counts, and natively handles multimodal decisions over images. Fine-tuning provides targeted rather than universal benefits -- substantially improving weaker models and specific tasks (such as many-option intent routing), but offering diminishing returns for strong backbones. Crucially, our KL anchors prevent behavioral degradation in conversational text generation, with LoRA delivering the strongest performance on capable models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LLM2Jev，一个保持架构不变的框架，直接从 LLM 下一个 token 概率中提取标定决策。研究表明现代 LLM 本身即为有效的决策模型，微调仅在特定场景下带来增益。
AI.motivation: Jev 风格决策模型仅输出预定义选项上的类别概率分布，不生成自由文本，便于软件系统直接使用。作者希望探究通用 LLM 是否已开箱具备该能力，以及何时才真正需要微调。
AI.method: LLM2Jev 保持模型架构不变，通过方括号数字标识符上的下一个 token 概率直接提取标定决策。框架同时提供免训练推理方案与微调目标：微调目标采用树分解的 listwise 损失优化候选项选择，并用 KL 散度惩罚将辅助预测锚定到基座模型。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3.5-4B 和 Qwen3-0.6B 上评估发现：免训练情况下，4B 模型与同基座社区 Jev 风格模型持平，优于字母 logit 读出，支持任意选项数，并原生处理图像多模态决策。微调带来针对性而非普适性收益：显著提升较弱模型和特定任务（如多选项意图路由），但对强基座收益递减。KL 锚定可防止对话文本生成的行为退化，LoRA 在强模型上表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: 现代 LLM 已天然具备决策模型能力，微调应作为针对性手段而非默认步骤；KL 锚定与 LoRA 是兼顾决策性能与生成能力的有效组合。

title: Scalable, Transferable Meta-network for Data Selection Requires a Different Loss (and Why the Obvious Choice is Problematic)
summary: Data selection is critical for training large language models on massive and heterogeneous corpora. Meta-learning for Training-data Selection offers a principled alternative to heuristic scoring by learning data weights from a target validation objective, but existing methods face a trade-off between fine-grained valuation and transferability to unseen data. A natural solution is to replace per-sample weights with a selection network. However, we find that directly incorporating such a network into existing MTS objectives leads to unstable optimization and poor generalization, caused by weight suppression and persistent reliance on easy-to-learn features. To address these issues, we propose Transferable Example Scoring and Selection (TESS), a scalable data-selection framework built on a Pointwise Value Matching objective (PVM). Experiments on LLM safety and targeted instruction tuning demonstrate strong transfer across datasets, from subsets to full corpora, and from smaller to larger models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TESS，一种基于点式价值匹配（PVM）目标的可扩展数据选择框架，通过选择网络替代逐样本权重，解决了元学习数据选择中细粒度估值与迁移性之间的权衡问题。
AI.motivation: 在大规模异构语料上训练大语言模型时，数据选择至关重要。元学习式训练数据选择（MTS）提供了比启发式评分更有原则的替代方案，可从目标验证目标学习数据权重，但现有方法在细粒度估值与对未见数据的迁移性之间存在权衡。
AI.method: 作者尝试用选择网络替代逐样本权重，但发现直接将该网络嵌入现有MTS目标会导致优化不稳定和泛化差，原因在于权重抑制以及对易学特征的持续依赖。为此提出TESS框架，建立在点式价值匹配（Pointwise Value Matching, PVM）目标之上。
AI.result: 在LLM安全性和定向指令微调上的实验表明，TESS具有强迁移能力：从子集到全语料、从小模型到更大模型均可有效迁移。
AI.conclusion: TESS通过PVM目标实现了可扩展且可迁移的数据选择，缓解了细粒度估值与迁移性之间的权衡，并展现出跨数据集、跨规模的良好泛化能力。

title: Argo-Bench: Evaluating Data Agents on Enterprise-Scale Workflows
comment: 41 pages, 4 figures, 18 tables. Code: https://github.com/TextQLLabs/Argo-Bench. Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/textql/Argo-Bench. Website: https://argo-bench.com
summary: Real-world enterprise data science and analytics workflows require reasoning across dozens of tables, performing statistical analyses, and acting on the results. Established text-to-SQL benchmarks evaluate query generation alone, and audits have found their answer keys frequently wrong. Because real enterprise warehouses are too sensitive to release, these benchmarks are built on public datasets where a business event fits in a single table. We introduce Argo-Bench, an evaluation framework comprising 210 data science and analytics tasks. Drawing on public data, peer-reviewed industry literature, and regulatory filings, we simulate a food delivery platform in New York City at true scale, with 81 million orders in 2024, grounded economics, fraud patterns, and marketplace incentives. We export this world to an ERP warehouse of 235 tables and 7.5 billion rows, modeled on the Oracle E-Business Suite schema. The simulator's ground-truth state is withheld from the warehouse the agent sees, so tasks require reconstructing facts by navigating the warehouse before acting on them. Argo-Bench goes beyond text-to-SQL: the agent files actions such as banning fraudulent accounts, allocating courier incentive budgets, or issuing back pay, and the grader scores each by its consequences in the simulator. Every task has an executable reference solution that demonstrates solvability using only the warehouse. The strongest of 14 frontier and open-weight models scores 95 or higher on only 34.8% of tasks and averages 59.5 points. We hope Argo-Bench drives progress toward agents that understand, navigate, and act within real data environments.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Argo-Bench 评测框架，包含 210 个数据科学与分析任务，通过模拟纽约市食品配送平台并导出为 235 张表、75 亿行的 ERP 仓库，要求智能体在仓库中重建事实并执行动作，由模拟器按后果评分。14 个前沿与开源模型中最强者仅在 34.8% 任务上得分 95+，平均 59.5 分。
AI.motivation: 真实企业数据科学与分析流程需要在数十张表上进行推理、执行统计分析并据此行动。现有 text-to-SQL 基准仅评估查询生成，且审计发现其标准答案经常出错；由于真实企业仓库过于敏感无法公开，这些基准多基于单表即可容纳一次业务事件的公共数据集，无法反映真实数据环境的规模与复杂性。
AI.method: 构建 Argo-Bench：基于公开数据、同行评审的行业文献与监管文件，模拟一个真实规模的纽约市食品配送平台（2024 年 8100 万订单），内嵌合理的经济机制、欺诈模式与市场激励；将该世界导出为模仿 Oracle E-Business Suite schema 的 ERP 仓库，含 235 张表、75 亿行。模拟器的真值状态对智能体可见的仓库隐藏，任务须先导航仓库重建事实再行动；智能体需提交封禁欺诈账户、分配骑手激励预算、发放补发工资等动作，评分器依据模拟器中的后果打分；每个任务均提供仅用仓库即可执行的可解参考解。
AI.result: 14 个前沿与开源模型中表现最强的模型仅在 34.8% 的任务上得分达到 95 分及以上，平均得分 59.5 分。
AI.conclusion: Argo-Bench 将评测从单纯的 text-to-SQL 推进到在真实数据环境中理解、导航并采取行动，作者希望其推动面向真实数据环境的数据科学智能体研究进展。

title: AutoCompact: Learning When to Compact Context in Long-Horizon Coding Agents
summary: Coding agents solve repository-level software engineering tasks through long trajectories of code inspection, search, editing, and testing. As a task progresses, earlier exploration becomes stale, so managing context is more than avoiding overflow: an agent must decide when to compact, what working state to preserve, and how to continue from it. We introduce AutoCompact, which trains a coding agent to make these decisions as part of its policy. To collect training data, we run the base agent on coding tasks and use a judge to review its compaction decisions, summaries, and actions after compaction. Flawed outputs are replaced with corrected ones before being executed in the environment, so each trajectory continues from the corrected decisions. We use these trajectories for supervised fine-tuning, then jointly optimize coding and compaction through reinforcement learning with task-success rewards. Experiments on SWE-bench Verified and SWE-PolyBench Verified show that AutoCompact improves pass rates over the base model by an absolute 9.2\% and 5.0\%, respectively. The improvements hold across all evaluated inference budgets, with a 256K context window that never overflows and with a 16K window whose overflow triggers fallback compaction.

AI.tldr: AutoCompact 训练编码智能体将上下文压缩决策纳入策略，通过裁判纠正的轨迹做监督微调，再用任务成功奖励强化学习联合优化，在 SWE-bench Verified 与 SWE-PolyBench Verified 上分别绝对提升 9.2% 和 5.0%。
AI.motivation: 仓库级软件工程任务需要长轨迹的代码检查、搜索、编辑与测试，早期探索会随任务推进而失效，因此上下文管理不仅是防止溢出，而是需要决策何时压缩、保留何种工作状态以及如何继续。现有方法未将这一决策能力直接内化为智能体策略。
AI.method: 在基础智能体上运行编码任务，用裁判审查其压缩决策、摘要及压缩后动作；将被判定有缺陷的输出替换为修正版本后再在环境中执行，使每条轨迹从修正后的决策继续。以此轨迹做监督微调，随后用任务成功奖励通过强化学习联合优化编码与压缩能力。
AI.result: 在 SWE-bench Verified 与 SWE-PolyBench Verified 上，AutoCompact 相比基础模型的通过率分别绝对提升 9.2% 与 5.0%；改进在所有评测推理预算下均保持，在 256K 上下文窗口下从不溢出，在 16K 窗口下溢出时触发回退压缩。
AI.conclusion: 将上下文压缩决策学习为策略的一部分可显著提升长轨迹编码智能体的任务表现，且在不同上下文预算下具有稳健性。

title: From Knowledge Access to Source Learning: Developing Source-Specific Competence
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on persistent external sources to solve sequences of knowledge-intensive tasks. Existing methods improve how source content is accessed and organized, while agent-memory systems preserve reusable knowledge from prior interactions, but repeated use of the same source is still largely treated as repeated access rather than an opportunity to progressively improve understanding of that source. We study source learning: developing reusable source-specific competence over a persistent authoritative source. We represent this competence with a persistent source model that captures reusable understanding of the source, including how its knowledge is structured, interpreted, and applied. To construct and progressively refine such models, we propose SourceLearn, which combines two complementary learning mechanisms. Self-Directed Source Learning identifies what remains incompletely understood and adaptively revisits the source, while Task-Guided Source Learning uses downstream experience to reveal local representational gaps and recurring needs in how source knowledge should be organized. In both cases, learning signals determine what should be reconsidered, while persistent updates are reconstructed from the authoritative source. Across five benchmarks and three LLM backends, SourceLearn achieves the best performance in 13 of 15 settings, with gains of up to 22.6 points over Hybrid RAG and substantial overall improvements over static source representations and experience-based memory baselines.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"源学习"(source learning)概念，通过构建并持续精炼持久化的"源模型"来积累针对特定权威知识源的可复用能力，方法SourceLearn结合自指导源学习与任务引导源学习两种机制，在5个基准和3个LLM后端中15个设置里13个取得最优，最高较Hybrid RAG提升22.6分。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在处理连续的知识密集型任务时依赖持久外部源。现有方法主要改进源内容的访问与组织，或通过智能体记忆保存先前交互的可复用知识，但对同一知识源的重复使用仍被视为"重复访问"，而非逐步深化对该源理解的机会。因此需要研究如何发展可复用的、针对特定持久权威源的"源胜任力"。
AI.method: 以持久化的"源模型"表征可复用理解（知识如何被结构化、解释和应用）。提出SourceLearn，包含两种互补学习机制：(1) 自指导源学习(Self-Directed Source Learning)：识别尚未完全理解之处并自适应重访源；(2) 任务引导源学习(Task-Guided Source Learning)：利用下游任务经验揭示局部表征缺口及知识组织方式的反复性需求。两者均由学习信号决定哪些内容需重新考虑，持久更新则从权威源重建。
AI.result: 在5个基准、3个LLM后端上进行评估，SourceLearn在15个设置中的13个取得最佳性能，较Hybrid RAG最高提升22.6分，相较静态源表征和基于经验的记忆基线均有显著整体提升。
AI.conclusion: 将持久源的重复使用重新定义为逐步提升源理解的机会，可通过持久源模型与两类学习机制有效构建源胜任力，验证了源学习范式的可行性与优越性。

title: Hierarchical Continuous Diffusion Language Models
summary: Discrete diffusion language models offer a compelling alternative to autoregressive generation for tasks demanding bidirectional reasoning and global constraint satisfaction. Yet they share a structural bottleneck: when decoding in parallel, each token is sampled independently from its marginal, severing the statistical dependencies among the tokens decoded together. Continuous diffusion language models avoid this by denoising a shared continuous state, but their denoiser sees only that state, so nothing ties it to a valid token configuration until it is finally decoded. To address this, we propose Hierarchical Continuous Diffusion Language Models (HC-DLM), which couple discrete token generation with a continuous latent trajectory in a single, principled denoising process, whose training objective is derived from a variational bound on the token likelihood. In contrast to recent methods that attach continuous context to a self-contained discrete chain, HC-DLM makes the latent the only persistent generative state: tokens are read out from it at every step and feed back as a scaffold for the next latent update. On structured reasoning (Sudoku), mathematical planning (Countdown) and language modeling (LM1B), HC-DLM improves over discrete and continuous diffusion baselines at matched model size, in puzzle accuracy on Sudoku and Countdown and in generative perplexity on LM1B. Project page: https://hc-dlm.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 提出HC-DLM，将离散token生成与连续隐变量轨迹耦合于单一去噪过程，隐状态为唯一持久生成状态，在Sudoku、Countdown与LM1B上优于离散/连续扩散基线。
AI.motivation: 离散扩散语言模型并行解码时各token从边缘分布独立采样，破坏了同批解码token间的统计依赖；连续扩散虽通过共享连续状态去噪规避此问题，但其去噪器仅依赖该状态，在最终解码前无法与有效token配置绑定。作者希望结合二者优势，弥补这一结构性瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出分层连续扩散语言模型（HC-DLM），在单一且具原理性的去噪过程中耦合离散token生成与连续隐变量轨迹；训练目标由token似然的变分下界推导而来。与将连续上下文附加到自包含离散链的方法不同，HC-DLM令隐变量成为唯一持久生成状态：每一步从隐状态读出token，并将token反馈作为下一轮隐状态更新的脚手架。
AI.result: 在结构化推理（Sudoku）、数学规划（Countdown）与语言建模（LM1B）任务上，相同模型规模下HC-DLM优于离散与连续扩散基线，具体体现为Sudoku和Countdown的谜题准确率提升及LM1B的生成困惑度改善。
AI.conclusion: 以连续隐变量为唯一持久生成状态、token每步读出并反馈的分层耦合设计，可在统一变分框架下同时保留并行解码的全局约束满足能力与token间统计依赖，是扩散语言模型的一条有效改进路径。

title: Keyword Harnesses Fail Open: A Cheap Diagnostic Ladder for Tool-Use Claims in Small Language Models
summary:
Keyword-matching benchmarks can credit small models for tool use they never perform. We document such a false positive in a matched-architecture pair of Spanish security language models and propose a ladder of strict, cheap diagnostics. A 661.6M parameter model (approx. 65% code/technical text; no dedicated SFT) and a 1,109M model (web-heavy multi-phase curriculum; 6B-token tool-SFT) share decoder, tokenizer, and special tokens, scoring almost identically on lenient tool-use metrics (B4: 0.660 vs. 0.650).
  Verbatim-reproduction checks on training examples separate them completely: the 600M emits valid tool calls with generalized arguments on 6/6 examples; the 1B does so on 0/6 across checkpoints. A first-token probe localizes the 1B's failure to a missing prior (prob. $10^{-4}$--$10^{-5}$ on <|tool_call|>), which was erased by its web-heavy training phase. A targeted SFT recipe (diverse corpus, 5x higher learning rate, 2,202 steps, ~3.3 GPU-hours) repairs the 1B using three orders of magnitude fewer tokens than the failed phase. On all 269 corpus rows, valid emission rises from 0.100 to 0.959 (600M: 0.926). On 238 unseen prompts, the repaired 1B passes 0.536 vs. the 600M's 0.428 ($p = 0.004$). Embedding-drift checks show the repair did not move the trigger token's tied embedding (97.7% of the bf16 table remains bit-identical), meaning changes live in the surrounding network.
  Both models over-trigger, rarely answering negative prompts without a call (0.09 for 600M, 0.17 for repaired 1B). Factorial analyses confirm all repair configurations install the format, though suppression benefits from a diverse corpus remain a hypothesis due to seed sensitivity. This cheap diagnostic ladder costs minutes of CPU time and should gate tool-use claims on small models.

AI.tldr: 对一对同架构西班牙语安全模型的对比发现，宽松的关键词匹配工具调用评测会把从未真正执行工具调用的模型判为高分；作者提出一套严格的廉价诊断阶梯，定位并修复了1B模型的工具调用能力缺失。
AI.motivation: 关键词匹配类基准可能给小型模型"虚记"其并未真正执行的工具调用能力，造成假阳性。作者希望通过同架构、同分词器的模型配对，证实这种评测失真，并提供可快速执行的严格诊断方法来约束小模型的工具调用声明。
AI.method: 1) 选取共享解码器、分词器与特殊token的两个模型：661.6M（约65%代码/技术文本，无专用SFT）与1,109M（网络文本为主的多阶段课程 + 6B token工具SFT）。2) 使用逐字复现训练样例的检查、首token探针（检测<|tool_call|>先验概率）、以及embedding漂移检查构成诊断阶梯。3) 对1B模型施加定向SFT修复（多样语料、5倍学习率、2,202步、约3.3 GPU小时）。
AI.result: 宽松指标下两模型几乎同分（B4: 0.660 vs 0.650）；逐字复现检查彻底区分二者：600M在6/6样例上生成带泛化参数的有效调用，1B在所有checkpoint上为0/6。首token探针将1B失效定位到<|tool_call|>先验缺失（概率约1e-4–1e-5），该先验被其网络文本为主的训练阶段抹除。修复后1B在全部269行语料上有效率从0.100升至0.959（600M为0.926）；在238个未见prompt上，修复后1B通过率0.536对600M的0.428（p=0.004）。Embedding漂移显示触发token的tied embedding未移动（bf16表97.7%逐位相同）。两模型均过度触发，对负向prompt很少不调用（600M为0.09，修复1B为0.17）。
AI.conclusion: 关键词匹配基准对小模型工具调用能力存在系统性假阳性；所提廉价诊断阶梯（复现检查、首token探针、embedding漂移）仅需数分钟CPU时间即可有效甄别真实工具调用能力，应作为小模型工具调用声明的准入门槛。修复主要改动发生在触发token周围的网络而非其embedding本身；多样语料对抑制过度触发的收益因种子敏感性仍属假设。

title: KaliBench: A Fine-Grained Benchmark for Cybersecurity Tool Use on Kali Linux with Runtime-Free Verifiable Rewards
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations and Datasets Track. Project page: https://risys-lab.github.io/KaliBench/ | Github: https://github.com/RISys-Lab/KaliBench
summary: LLMs are increasingly applied to cybersecurity workflows, where they are expected to translate analysts' intent into tool invocations. However, existing evaluations focus on knowledge-based assessments or end-to-end agentic tasks, and do not directly measure LLMs' ability to generate executable commands for real-world cybersecurity tools. This gap is critical because cybersecurity operations rely on strict command-line interfaces (CLIs), where minor syntax errors, incorrect flag--value bindings, or argument misordering can invalidate execution. We introduce KaliBench, a fine-grained benchmark and dataset for natural-language--to--CLI translation on Kali Linux, comprising 8,504 query--command pairs spanning 1,642 tools across 23 capability dimensions and 5 security phases. KaliBench is constructed via a manuscript-grounded pipeline with deterministic canonicalization and alias-aware evaluation, enabling precise and reproducible assessment of tool selection and argument construction. To ensure both semantic correctness and practical executability, we develop a multi-stage verification pipeline that combines LLM-based validation, sandboxed terminal execution, and human-in-the-loop refinement. Building on these fine-grained, deterministic signals, KaliBench further enables runtime-free verifiable rewards for training. Across three evaluation modes and 24 configurations of general-purpose and security-focused open-weight models, no open-weight model exceeds 42% exact-command accuracy in the unrestricted setting, highlighting the difficulty of accurate CLI-based cybersecurity tool use without explicit tool hints. We further show that supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards derived from KaliBench significantly improve an 8B model and achieve performance comparable to a 685B MoE model.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出KaliBench，一个面向Kali Linux自然语言到CLI命令翻译的细粒度基准与数据集，并基于其可验证奖励提升模型性能。
AI.motivation: LLM日益用于网络安全工作流，需将分析师意图转化为工具调用；但现有评测多聚焦知识问答或端到端智能体任务，未直接衡量模型为真实安全工具生成可执行命令的能力，而CLI对语法、标志-值绑定和参数顺序要求严格，微小错误即可导致执行失败。
AI.method: 构建KaliBench，包含8,504个查询-命令对，覆盖1,642个工具、23个能力维度和5个安全阶段；采用基于手册的构建流程，结合确定性规范化与别名感知评估；通过LLM验证、沙箱终端执行和人在回路精炼的多阶段验证流水线确保语义正确性与可执行性；基于细粒度确定性信号提供免运行时可验证奖励用于训练。
AI.result: 在三种评估模式和24种通用及安全专用开源权重模型配置下，无限制设置中无开源权重模型精确命令准确率超过42%；监督微调与基于KaliBench可验证奖励的强化学习显著提升8B模型，达到与685B MoE模型相当的性能。
AI.conclusion: KaliBench填补了自然语言到网络安全CLI命令翻译评测的空白，揭示现有模型在无工具提示下准确使用CLI安全工具的困难，并证明其可作为有效训练信号显著提升小模型能力。

title: Trajectory-Aware Clinical Risk Prediction via Severity-Grounded Knowledge Graphs and Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: While Electronic Health Records (EHRs) offer a wealth of clinical data, effectively augmenting a patient's records with heterogeneous external knowledge to predict the patient's clinical risk remains a significant challenge. Existing methods fail to capture disease severity, treatment responses, and nuanced clinical progression, due to data sparsity and the underutilization of unstructured clinical notes. To address these challenges, we propose TRACER (a trajectory-aware and clinically grounded prediction framework) that (1) constructs a medical knowledge graph enriched with severity information from medical literature, (2) retrieves clinically relevant, severity-weighted paths of a patient's progression from the knowledge graph, (3) extracts clinically relevant events from unstructured clinical notes, and (4) augments patient context with similar peer cases. Experiments on the MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV datasets demonstrate large gains over state-of-the-art baselines, with up to 28.5% increase in Macro F1 score for the mortality prediction task, and 19.7% increase for the readmission prediction task.

AI.tldr: TRACER 是一个轨迹感知且具临床依据的预测框架，通过构建带严重度信息的医学知识图谱、检索严重度加权病程路径、抽取非结构化临床笔记事件并引入相似病例，提升 EHR 临床风险预测性能。
AI.motivation: EHR 数据虽丰富，但如何用异构外部知识增强患者记录以预测临床风险仍是难题。现有方法因数据稀疏及未充分利用非结构化临床笔记，难以刻画疾病严重度、治疗反应与细微的临床病程进展。
AI.method: TRACER 包含四部分：(1) 从医学文献构建融入严重度信息的医学知识图谱；(2) 从图谱中检索与患者病程相关且经严重度加权的临床路径；(3) 从非结构化临床笔记中抽取临床相关事件；(4) 用相似同类病例增强患者上下文。
AI.result: 在 MIMIC-III 与 MIMIC-IV 数据集上相较最优基线取得显著提升：死亡率预测任务 Macro F1 最高提升 28.5%，再入院预测任务提升 19.7%。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入严重度感知的知识图谱路径、临床笔记事件抽取及相似病例增强，TRACER 有效缓解数据稀疏与笔记利用不足问题，显著提升临床风险预测表现。

title: Integrating Fairness and Explainability in a Multiple Instance Reinforcement Learning System
summary: Predicting student performance from educational interaction data requires models that are both accurate and sufficiently transparent to support meaningful intervention, while demographic information introduces an additional risk of unfair predictions. This study investigates a multi-objective framework that combines reinforcement learning-based multiple instance learning (RL-MIL), adversarial debiasing, and preference-conditioned hypernetworks for student-at-risk prediction. MIL represents each student as a bag of weakly labeled interactions, while an RL agent selects informative instances for downstream classification. Two hypernetwork variants are evaluated to determine whether a user-defined preference scalar can continuously control the trade-off between predictive performance and Equalized Odds.
