The underlying RL-MIL baseline achieves strong classification performance, but both hypernetwork extensions exhibit mode collapse: changing the preference weight produces little systematic movement along the intended fairness-performance frontier. The failure is associated with objective dominance, weak gradient propagation through the conditioning mechanism, and interactions between dynamically generated parameters. The results show that fairness objectives can be incorporated into an interpretable RL-MIL pipeline, but preference conditioning alone does not guarantee controllable multi-objective behavior. Robust fair RL-MIL therefore requires explicit mechanisms for gradient balancing, objective separation, and stability analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将RL-MIL、对抗去偏与偏好条件超网络结合的多目标框架用于学生风险预测；RL-MIL基线性能强，但两种超网络变体均出现模式坍缩，偏好标量无法有效调控公平性与性能的权衡。
AI.motivation: 从教育交互数据预测学生表现，既要求模型准确，又要求足够透明以支持有意义的干预；同时人口统计信息会带来预测不公平的额外风险。因此需要同时兼顾性能、可解释性与公平性的建模框架。
AI.method: 采用基于强化学习的多示例学习（RL-MIL）：将每个学生表示为一袋弱标注交互，由RL智能体选择信息量大的示例供下游分类；结合对抗去偏处理人口统计偏差；并评估两种偏好条件超网络变体，检验用户定义的偏好标量能否连续控制预测性能与Equalized Odds之间的权衡。
AI.result: RL-MIL基线取得较强的分类性能，但两种超网络扩展均出现模式坍缩：改变偏好权重几乎无法使模型沿预期的公平性—性能前沿产生系统性移动。失败原因与目标支配、条件机制中梯度传播微弱、动态生成参数之间的相互作用有关。
AI.conclusion: 公平目标可以被纳入可解释的RL-MIL流程，但仅靠偏好条件化并不能保证多目标行为可控。稳健的公平RL-MIL需要针对梯度平衡、目标分离与稳定性分析的显式机制。

title: What Do Rationales Communicate? A Message-Intervention Study in Role-Specialized QA
summary: Role-specialized QA pipelines increasingly pass rationales from a reasoner to a verifier, but it is unclear what this message actually buys: better answers, stronger support assessment, or a new failure surface. We introduce a message-intervention diagnostic that fixes the evidence and candidate answer while varying only the rationale passed across the reasoner-to-verifier boundary. On 400 MuSiQue, HotpotQA, and 2WikiMultiHopQA examples with DeepSeek as generator and verifier, faithful rationales add almost no answer accuracy over no rationale, while corrupted rationales strongly alter support judgments. Under a blind verifier prompt, harmless paraphrases shift support by only 0--2.5%, whereas corrupted rationales shift support by 10--22%; an explicit rationale-checking prompt amplifies the same pattern to 34--55%. Final answers move less (2--30%), and only 2.9--35.3% of corrupted support flips co-occur with answer changes. Human audits show why this matters: 16/42 valid corruptions are corruption-overtrust cases, and blind humans reject or mark unclear 9/10 audited corrupted rationales that the model accepts. Cross-model and task-boundary checks show when the channel is active, amplified, inert, or folded into the task label. Rationale sharing should be evaluated as a verification-message mechanism, not merely as a route to higher answer accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"消息干预诊断"方法，在固定证据与候选答案的前提下仅改变从推理器传给验证器的理由（rationale），以厘清该跨模块消息的实际作用。
AI.motivation: 角色分工式QA流水线普遍将理由从推理器传递给验证器，但该消息究竟带来更高答案准确率、更强支持性评估，还是引入新的失效面，尚不明确。
AI.method: 在MuSiQue、HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA的400个样本上，固定证据与候选答案，仅改变跨"推理器—验证器"边界的理由；以DeepSeek分别作为生成器与验证器，设置盲验证提示与显式理由检查提示两种条件，并辅以人工审核、跨模型与任务边界检验。
AI.result: 忠实理由相比无理由几乎不提升答案准确率，而损坏理由强烈改变支持性判断：盲验证提示下无害改写仅使支持度变动0–2.5%，损坏理由则变动10–22%；显式检查提示放大至34–55%。最终答案变化较小（2–30%），仅2.9–35.3%的损坏支持翻转伴随答案改变。人工审核显示42个有效损坏中16个为"损坏过度信任"案例，盲审人类对模型接受的10个损坏理由中9个判为拒绝或不清楚。
AI.conclusion: 理由共享应被作为验证消息机制来评估，而非仅视作提升答案准确率的途径；跨模型与任务边界检验刻画了该通道何时活跃、被放大、失效或被并入任务标签。

title: FourierQK: Filter Shape, Admissibility and the Leakage-Coverage Law
summary: Frequency-collapse attention [Zeris, 2026e] achieves large gains over standard dot-product attention by replacing the Q/K dot product with a bandpass-filtered inner product at a learned frequency. A natural follow-up question is: which filter shape works best, and why? We test five hypotheses about filter properties -- DC suppression, Nyquist suppression, bandwidth, centre frequency, and multi-scale coverage -- using a controlled ablation on character-level language modelling (TinyShakespeare, 6-layer GPT). Our main findings are: (1) DC and Nyquist components are actively harmful (val ~= 2.0, equivalent to phase randomisation), confirming that oscillatory bandpass structure is essential, not just any low-dimensional spectral summary; (2) the optimal single-scale bandwidth is sigma ~= 2 bins centred at paragraph scale (~70 tokens), giving a clean gain of Delta = +1.15 nats over BASE-DOT; (3) admissible filters (zero-mean, Mexican Hat DOG m = 2) outperform non-admissible Gaussians at the same scale and provide partial protection against bilateral FFT leakage; (4) bilateral FFT leakage scales monotonically with spectral coverage -- narrowband filters (gap > +4) are clean, wideband filters (gap < +2) are leaky; and (5) causal time-domain Morlet at character scale cannot beat BASE-DOT (K=128 taps covers 50% of T=256 context), motivating word-level experiments in the companion MorletQK paper [Zeris, 2026f]. Together, findings (1)-(5) characterise FourierQK as effective in bidirectional attention settings (encoder-style, e.g. BERT), where full-sequence context is available at both training and inference time; autoregressive generation requires a causal spectral variant such as MorletQK [Zeris, 2026f] (decoder-style, e.g. GPT). Code available at: https://github.com/AthanasiosZeris/energy-gated-attention

AI.tldr: 本文通过受控消融实验，检验频域注意力中滤波器形状的五种假设，发现带通振荡结构（抑制DC与Nyquist）是关键，最优单尺度带宽为σ≈2 bins、中心在段落尺度（约70 token），可带来相对BASE-DOT的+1.15 nats增益；双向注意力（如BERT）适用FourierQK，自回归生成（如GPT）需因果谱变体MorletQK。
AI.motivation: 频率坍缩注意力[Zeris, 2026e]用带通滤波内积替代Q/K点积并取得显著增益，引出后续问题：哪种滤波器形状最优及其原因。本文旨在通过消融实验系统刻画滤波器性质（DC抑制、Nyquist抑制、带宽、中心频率、多尺度覆盖）对性能的影响，并厘清频域注意力在双向与自回归场景中的适用边界。
AI.method: 在字符级语言建模任务（TinyShakespeare，6层GPT）上进行受控消融，对比标准点积（BASE-DOT）与基于傅里叶滤波内积的注意力，检验五种滤波器性质假设，并分析可容许滤波器（零均值、m=2的Mexican Hat DOG）与不可容许高斯滤波器的差异、双侧FFT泄漏与谱覆盖的关系，以及因果时域Morlet的可行性（K=128 taps覆盖T=256上下文的50%）。
AI.result: (1) DC与Nyquist分量有害（val≈2.0，相当于相位随机化），证明振荡带通结构不可或缺；(2) 最优单尺度带宽σ≈2 bins、中心在段落尺度（约70 token），相对BASE-DOT增益Δ=+1.15 nats；(3) 可容许滤波器（零均值、Mexican Hat DOG m=2）在同尺度下优于不可容许高斯，并对双侧FFT泄漏有部分防护；(4) 双侧FFT泄漏随谱覆盖单调增长，窄带（gap>+4）干净、宽带（gap<+2）泄漏；(5) 字符尺度因果时域Morlet无法超越BASE-DOT（K=128 taps覆盖T=256上下文的50%），需转向词级实验。
AI.conclusion: 综合(1)-(5)表明，FourierQK在双向注意力设置（编码器式，如BERT）中有效，因为训练与推理时均可获得完整序列上下文；而自回归生成（解码器式，如GPT）需要因果谱变体，如MorletQK[Zeris, 2026f]。代码已开源。

title: Characterizing a Configuration Where Inference-Time PRM-Pruned Fragment Grafting Is Inert: Evidence from Three Reasoning LMs
summary: Diversity collapse in parallel chain-of-thought has motivated inference-time interventions built on a natural design: when a process reward model (PRM) prunes a chain, its high-PRM prefix is extracted and grafted verbatim as an in-context demonstration into a still-decoding sibling. We isolate this mechanism, PRM-Pruned Fragment Grafting (PPFG), as the most cost-minimal operationalization of cross-trajectory step-level transfer, and test it at the operating point where prior fragment-grafting work reports gains only under additional compensating ingredients. On Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct with Math-Shepherd on full MATH500 (n=500, three seeds), PPFG in both stagnation- and random-targeting variants is statistically indistinguishable from an independent parallel-CoT baseline on every measured axis. We characterize why: a four-bucket classification of 322 stagnation-rule injection events shows only 14% targeted a genuinely struggling chain; the rest landed on chains that had already succeeded, were near completion, or sat on a flat PRM plateau, states a rescue graft cannot change. No compound-gate refinement jointly achieves well-targeted firing and adequate density, and a random control matches the same parity at 2.4x the firing rate, so the inertness is not heuristic-specific. The finding replicates across three base LMs, six benchmarks, a second PRM, and a compatibility-gate sweep; two-one-sided-tests analysis promotes the parity to positive equivalence on all twelve Qwen/LLaMA cells. A per-event spot-check finds injected chains prune at 2.75x the matched-step rate, but a surviving-sibling counterfactual finds no population-level compensation. A hindsight oracle bounds any per-problem gain from choosing PPFG over independent at +0.13 pp. We contribute an equivalence-testing template for establishing inference-time mechanism nulls, with every claim scoped to its tested operating point.

AI.tldr: 该论文隔离并检验了"PRM剪枝片段嫁接"(PPFG)机制，发现在既定操作点上，其与独立并行思维链基线在各指标上统计等价，即该跨轨迹步骤级迁移机制在此设定下无效。
AI.motivation: 并行思维链存在多样性崩塌，已有工作提出将PRM剪枝链的高分前缀作为上下文示例嫁接到仍在解码的兄弟链，但该片段嫁接方法此前报告增益均依赖额外的补偿性成分。作者希望剥离这些成分，在最省成本、最纯粹的操作点上单独检验该机制是否真正有效。
AI.method: 在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct上搭配Math-Shepherd，于完整MATH500（n=500，三个随机种子）上测试PPFG的两种变体（停滞目标与随机目标）；对322次停滞规则注入事件做四类分桶，分析触发对象的真实状态；进行复合门控精化实验与随机对照；在三个基座LM、六个基准、第二个PRM及兼容性门控扫描上复现；使用双单侧检验(TOST)将等价性升格为正向等价；辅以逐事件抽查、存活兄弟反事实分析与事后oracle上界估计。
AI.result: PPFG两种变体在所有测量轴上均与独立并行思维链基线统计不可区分；322次注入事件中仅14%针对真正陷入困境的链，其余落在已成功、接近完成或处于PRM平台期的链上；无任何复合门控能同时实现精准触发与足够密度；随机对照以2.4倍触发率仍保持等价；结论在三个基座LM、六个基准、第二个PRM及门控扫描上复现，TOST在全部十二个Qwen/LLaMA单元上确认正向等价；注入链的剪枝率为匹配步骤的2.75倍，但存活兄弟反事实无群体级补偿；oracle上界显示选择PPFG相对独立的每问题增益上限仅+0.13个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 在该测试操作点上，PPFG作为跨轨迹步骤级迁移的最省成本实现是惰性的，其无效性并非源于特定启发式。作者提供了一个用于确立推理时机制零假设的等价性检验模板，所有结论均限定在其测试的操作点范围内。

title: Scientific Agents: Evaluating Profession-Specific System Prompts on Scientific Tasks
comment: 46 pages (11 pages main text, references, 33-page appendix); 10 figures, 29 tables. Evaluated corpus: https://github.com/K-Dense-AI/scientific-agents (commit 48dedd2); evaluation code and item-level records are not released
summary: Detailed profession-specific system prompts raise token use and estimated cost per response without a consistent accuracy gain. We evaluate Scientific Agents, an open-source corpus of 503 profession-specific AGENTS.md profiles, with Gemini 3.8 Flash via OpenRouter in the Pi agent harness. We compare matched profiles with four controls: a minimal baseline ("You are a helpful assistant"), the profile's opening role sentence, a generic scientific rigor guide, and a profile from an unrelated domain. Across nine text-based science benchmarks (4,531 sampled questions, 100 matched profiles), 4,488 items completed all five conditions after API-error retries, scored with automated, rule-based grading. The average profile-baseline accuracy difference is -0.6 percentage points (95% bootstrap interval [-1.5, +0.2] across fixed tasks), and no benchmark shows a statistically clear improvement. Matched profiles produced 1.5-2.3 times as many output tokens and cost 2.2-4.5 times more per successful call. On 60 tool-using BioMysteryBench bioinformatics problems (three runs each for baseline and profile), mean solve rates were 46.7% with the profile and 56.7% at baseline, a difference of -10.0 percentage points (95% interval [-16.7, -3.3]) driven by more frequent token- and time-limit stops under the profile. Longer prompts had one unexpected operational advantage: on SuperGPQA, frequent provider API drops left the short baseline with a correct first-pass answer on only 54.0% of items, against 71.6% with the profile. Generic and mismatched prompts were about as reliable, so this gain comes from prompt length or formatting rather than domain expertise. For the tested model and tasks, loading full profession profiles by default does not improve accuracy and costs considerably more; whether selective retrieval of profile sections or open-ended scientific tasks would change this remains to be tested.

AI.tldr: 在9个文本科学基准(4,531题)与60个生物信息学工具题上，加载完整的职业专属系统提示并未带来稳定的准确率提升，反而使输出token增加1.5-2.3倍、单次成功调用成本增加2.2-4.5倍。
AI.motivation: 业界普遍为不同职业/领域配置详细的专属系统提示(profession-specific system prompts)，但缺乏系统证据表明这类长提示是否真能提升科学任务的准确率，其token与成本代价是否值得。本文旨在通过受控实验量化"职业档案提示"的收益与代价。
AI.method: 构建开源语料Scientific Agents，包含503个职业专属AGENTS.md档案；以Gemini 3.8 Flash经OpenRouter、在Pi agent harness中运行。采用匹配对照设计：每个档案与四种控制条件对比——极简基线("You are a helpful assistant")、档案的首句角色句、通用科学严谨性指南、以及来自无关领域的档案。评测集为9个文本类科学基准(采样4,531题、100个匹配档案，重试后4,488题完整覆盖五种条件)，采用自动化、基于规则的评分。另在60个需工具调用的BioMysteryBench生物信息学问题上，基线与档案各运行三次，统计求解率。
AI.result: 档案与基线的平均准确率差为-0.6个百分点(固定任务95% bootstrap区间[-1.5, +0.2])，无任一基准出现统计上明确的提升。匹配档案的输出token量为基线的1.5-2.3倍，单次成功调用成本为2.2-4.5倍。BioMysteryBench上档案平均求解率46.7%对基线56.7%，差-10.0个百分点(95%区间[-16.7, -3.3])，主因是档案条件下更频繁触发token与时限中断。意外发现：在SuperGPQA上，频繁的供应商API中断使短基线仅54.0%的项目保有正确首答，而档案条件下为71.6%；通用与错配提示的可靠性与之相近，说明该优势源于提示长度或格式而非领域专业知识。
AI.conclusion: 在被测模型与任务上，默认加载完整职业档案不提升准确率且成本显著更高，因此不建议作为默认策略。更细粒度的方案(如按需检索档案片段、选择性注入)以及开放式科学任务下该结论是否成立，尚待进一步验证。

title: ContractRL: Shielded Group-Relative Policy Optimization for Auditable Tool-Call Repair
summary: Structured tool calls often fail after only a small number of fields violate a schema or an execution contract. Regenerating the complete object enlarges the action surface and makes repeated repair difficult to audit. We introduce ContractRL, a contract-constrained sequential repair protocol that models verifier-guided JSON repair as a bounded decision process. At each step the policy observes the candidate, typed verifier feedback, JSON Pointer, immutable repair history, and remaining budget; a contract-derived action mask filters malformed or prohibited RFC-6902 operations before a deterministic validator performs the transition. We specify a contract-constrained group-relative objective for patch, retry, and abstention decisions while keeping canonical targets and semantic labels outside the online state until trace freeze. Under identical verifier information, ContractRL attains 0.9362 semantic success with 34.4 generated tokens, compared with 0.9076 and 44.9 tokens for Patch-SFT and 0.9148 and 137.2 tokens for full regeneration over 192 cases per seed and five seeds. Policy optimization improves semantic success from 0.9186 for supervised ContractRL to 0.9375. A separate three-seed paired evaluation against Patch-SFT yields a semantic difference of +0.0396 (95% CI $[+0.0137,+0.0662], p=0.0039$). Feedback, action-mask, budget, and schema-shift analyses connect these gains to localized correction, while adversarial and multi-turn evaluations characterize the remaining failure modes.

AI.tldr: 提出 ContractRL，一种契约约束的序列化 JSON 修复协议，将验证器引导的修复建模为有界决策过程，在语义成功率与 token 消耗上均优于 Patch-SFT 与全量重生成。
AI.motivation: 结构化工具调用常因少量字段违反 schema 或执行契约而失败；重新生成完整对象会扩大动作空间，且使反复修复难以审计。
AI.method: 将验证器引导的 JSON 修复建模为有界决策过程。每步策略观测候选对象、类型化验证器反馈、JSON Pointer、不可变修复历史与剩余预算；由契约导出的动作掩码在确定性验证器执行状态转移前过滤非法或禁止的 RFC-6902 操作。提出契约约束的组相对目标，用于 patch、retry 与 abstention 决策；同时将规范目标与语义标签置于在线状态之外，直至 trace freeze。
AI.result: 在相同验证器信息下，ContractRL 达到 0.9362 语义成功率、生成 34.4 tokens；Patch-SFT 为 0.9076 与 44.9 tokens，全量重生成为 0.9148 与 137.2 tokens（每 seed 192 例，5 个 seed）。策略优化将监督式 ContractRL 的语义成功率从 0.9186 提升至 0.9375。与 Patch-SFT 的三 seed 配对评估显示语义差异为 +0.0396（95% CI [+0.0137,+0.0662]，p=0.0039）。
AI.conclusion: 反馈、动作掩码、预算与 schema 漂移分析将增益归因于局部化修正；对抗与多轮评估刻画了残余失败模式。

title: Comedic Fool's Gold: Reward Exploits and Countermeasures in Conversational Humor
summary: We investigate automated rewards for training language models in conversational humor, focusing on reward exploits and countermeasures. Two approaches aim to capture understandable surprise and predicted audience amusement. Controlled tests show that an embedding-based surprise reward accepts word-shuffled replies as readily as witty ones. A fluency filter detects the shuffles, but the combined reward also rejects some witty replies and fails further validation. An audience model's predicted laughter is instead vulnerable to laughter cues in either speaker's messages. Normalizing these cues across speakers blocks the covered attacks, although unmatched expressions remain exploitable. Three reinforcement-learning runs evaluate training with successive reward revisions. The final run improves the combined evaluation score by 0.0903 and reduces zero-score sessions by 40%, but its humor-specific improvement remains below our preregistered target. These findings illustrate a broader challenge for automated reward design: countermeasures must block exploitable shortcuts while preserving the behavior the reward was intended to encourage.

AI.tldr: 本文研究对话幽默训练中自动奖励的"奖励利用"问题及其对策。基于惊讶度与观众笑点预测两种奖励均存在可被钻空子的捷径（词序打乱回复、笑声线索），过滤与归一化只能部分封堵，最终RL训练虽提升综合评分但幽默专项提升未达预注册目标。
AI.motivation: 自动化奖励设计面临一个根本性难题：奖励信号在可被优化的同时往往存在可利用的捷径（reward exploits），导致模型获得高分却并未真正学到目标行为。作者希望针对"对话幽默"这一具体任务，检验两类常见自动奖励（可理解的惊讶感、预测的观众娱乐度）是否真的能度量幽默，以及如何设计对策在封堵捷径的同时不损害幽默行为本身。
AI.method: 1）构建两种奖励：基于嵌入的"惊讶"奖励与观众模型预测的"笑声/娱乐度"奖励；2）用受控测试（如词序打乱的回复 vs.真正机智的回复）检验奖励的判别力；3）针对惊讶奖励设置流畅性过滤器，针对观众模型设置跨说话人线索归一化；4）进行三轮强化学习训练，逐版修订奖励，并采用预注册目标、综合评分与零分会话比例作为评估指标。
AI.result: 受控测试显示：基于嵌入的惊讶奖励会把词序打乱的回复与机智回复一视同仁地接受；流畅性过滤器能识别打乱回复，但合并奖励也会误拒部分机智回复，且未能通过后续验证。观众模型的预测笑声易受任一说话人消息中的笑声线索操纵；跨说话人对这些线索归一化可封堵已覆盖的攻击，但未被匹配的表达仍可被利用。三轮RL训练中，最终一轮将综合评估分数提高0.0903，零分会话减少40%，但幽默专项提升仍低于预注册目标。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明自动奖励设计存在更广泛的挑战：对策必须同时封堵可利用的捷径，又保留奖励原本想要鼓励的行为。单纯加固过滤或归一化往往在堵住漏洞的同时损害目标行为（如误拒机智回复、遗漏未匹配线索），而可度量的训练收益也未必等于目标能力的真正提升（幽默专项得分未达标）。

title: Robust Is Salient: An Informed Adversary Moves the Optimal Signal onto the Salience Pole
summary: When an informed adversary shares the audience of a constrained signalling channel, the signal that best protects the truth is the signal that best describes it. On 108 confirmatory items, the adversary-robust optimum aligns exactly with the salience pole from prior work. Across a 200,000-item pool, the two differ on only 2,748 items --- lying exactly where the prior salience-to-Bayes coordinate is undefined. Where defined, robustness is achieved by moving from Bayesian discrimination entirely to salience. We show this by introducing an adversary to a forced-choice task (abstracted from Deception: Murder in Hong Kong). The adversary knows the target, observes the signal, and argues for the strongest wrong answer using a persuasion budget, $β$. As $β$ grows, the optimal signal shifts from the posterior-maximizing option to the margin-maximizing one; at $β= 0$, the game reproduces the original oracle model with a listener temperature of $τ= 1$. This effect is real: 18.2 percent of the pool has an optimum that shifts under a finite budget, and each item's critical budget is exact. This coincidence structurally limits empirical evaluation. Two adversary framings change the chosen option of seven language models on 30 to 77 of 108 items against an exact no-effect rate. Yet, no measurement can determine whether this movement is toward the adversary-aware optimum or toward salience, because the two options are identical. This is a structural limit, not a null result. The diagnostic check is cheap: before evaluating adversary-awareness, verify whether the robust target coincides with a heuristic target on the evaluation items.

AI.tldr: 在受约束的信号传递通道中，当知情对手与听众共享同一通道时，最优信号与"显著性"启发式的目标高度重合；这种重合是结构性的，因而限制了对手鲁棒性的实证检验。
AI.motivation: 作者希望研究：在信息传递中面对"知情对手"（adversary）时，发送者应如何选择信号以保护真相。以往工作已在贝叶斯"后验最大化"框架下研究信号选择，而本文关注引入对手后最优信号是否改变、以及这种改变能否被实验检验。
AI.method: 将对手引入一个迫选任务（抽象自《Deception: Murder in Hong Kong》）。对手已知目标、观察信号，并可在说服预算 β 下论证最强错误答案。分析最优信号随 β 的变化，并在 108 个确认性条目与 200,000 条目池上比较"对手鲁棒最优"与先前工作中的"显著性极"；同时用两个对手框架测试七个语言模型的选择是否改变。
AI.result: 在 108 个确认性条目上，对手鲁棒最优与显著性极完全一致；在 200,000 条目池中仅 2,748 条不同，且差异恰出现在显著性—贝叶斯坐标未定义处。β 增大时最优信号从后验最大化转向边际最大化；β=0 时复现原 oracle 模型（温度 τ=1）。池中 18.2% 的条目在有限预算下最优会移动，且每条目的临界预算是精确的。两个对手框架使七个语言模型在 108 条中的 30–77 条改变选择。
AI.conclusion: 由于对手鲁棒最优与显著性启发式目标在多数条目上重合，现有测量无法判断模型的选择移动是趋向对手感知最优还是趋向显著性——这是结构性限制，而非零结果。因此在评估对手感知前，应先检验鲁棒目标是否与启发式目标在评测条目上重合（廉价的诊断步骤）。

title: When Do Attention-Head Ablations Support Causal Claims? Projection-Level Confounds, Floor Effects, and Matched Controls
comment: Code available in the accompanying repository. 2 figures
summary: Attention-head ablation, zeroing a head and measuring the resulting change in task performance, is a common method for inferring which components of a language model are causally responsible for a behavior. We show using GPT-2 small that this inference can be fragile unless the intervention semantics, evaluation metric, and controls are carefully validated. A natural post-projection implementation of "zeroing a head" is nearly uncorrelated with a corrected pre-projection ablation (Pearson r = 0.057) and selects a completely disjoint top-5 set of important heads. We also show that binary accuracy can hide effects at behavioral floors and near ceilings, whereas gold-token log-probability remains graded. Using a discovery/held-out split and 1,000 matched random-head and layer-matched-head control draws, the corrected per-head effect ranking is highly stable across splits (Spearman rho = 0.974), and the top-5 selected heads significantly exceed both control distributions (Monte Carlo p = 0.001). However, evidence for task specificity is not robust on GPT-2. Replication on DistilGPT2 preserves the intervention-semantic and matched-control findings. These results show that single-head ablation does not by itself justify a causal claim; defensible interpretation requires correct intervention placement, a non-saturated continuous metric, and matched held-out controls.

AI.tldr: 本文以GPT-2 small为例指出，注意力头消融的因果推断高度依赖干预语义、评估指标与控制条件的正确性：后投影"置零"与前投影修正消融几乎不相关（r=0.057）；二元准确率会掩盖行为地板/天花板效应，而gold-token对数概率更敏感；修正后的头效应排名跨划分高度稳定（rho=0.974），top-5头显著优于匹配控制（p=0.001），但任务特异性证据在GPT-2上不稳健，DistilGPT2复现了干预语义与匹配控制结论。
AI.motivation: 注意力头消融（置零某头并测量任务性能变化）被广泛用于推断语言模型各组件对某行为的因果责任，但作者认为这种推断在干预语义、评估指标与控制条件未经验证时非常脆弱，因此需要系统检验其可靠性。
AI.method: 在GPT-2 small上，比较两种"置零头"实现：自然的后投影消融（post-projection）与修正的前投影消融（pre-projection），计算二者相关性并比较选出的top-5重要头。同时对比二元准确率与gold-token对数概率两种评估指标。采用发现集/留出集划分，并进行1000次匹配的随机头与层匹配头对照抽样。最后在DistilGPT2上复现。
AI.result: 后投影与前投影消融几乎不相关（Pearson r=0.057），top-5重要头集合完全不重叠；二元准确率会在行为地板和天花板处掩盖效应，而gold-token对数概率保持分级。修正后的逐头效应排名跨划分高度稳定（Spearman rho=0.974），top-5头显著超过两种控制分布（Monte Carlo p=0.001）。任务特异性证据在GPT-2上不稳健；DistilGPT2复现了干预语义与匹配控制的发现。
AI.conclusion: 单头消融本身不足以支撑因果结论；可辩护的解释需要正确的干预位置、非饱和的连续指标以及匹配的留出控制。

title: Make Sparse Rewards Count: Density-Aware Reward Aggregation for Multi-Reward RL
summary: Multi-reward reinforcement learning trains large language models to satisfy multiple behavioral objectives simultaneously. Reward-wise normalization, as used in GDPO, preserves reward-specific relative information within rollout groups, but different objectives can still exhibit uneven learning progress. We study this behavior through advantage energy, the sum of a reward's squared advantages over a batch. Under idealized GDPO normalization, we show that this energy is proportional to active-group density: the fraction of rollout groups in which the reward provides nonzero relative advantages. This reveals a residual batch-level signal imbalance and provides a basis for calibrating reward contributions. Based on this relation, we propose Density-Aware Reward Aggregation (DARA). We derive an inverse-square-root density correction that gives greater weight to signals from less frequently active rewards. DARA computes its weights from each rollout batch, adapting to changes in reward activity throughout training without modifying the underlying policy optimization objective. Experiments on tool calling and mathematical reasoning show that DARA learns the targeted behaviors faster than GDPO, reaching high format compliance in up to 26% fewer training steps on tool calling and near-saturated length compliance in up to 65% fewer steps on mathematical reasoning, while remaining competitive in final performance. Our code is available at https://github.com/zhaihaotian/DARA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出密度感知奖励聚合（DARA），基于优势能量与活跃组密度成正比的关系，采用逆平方根密度校正为低活跃度奖励加权，在工具调用与数学推理任务上以更少训练步数达到同等或更好的合规表现。
AI.motivation: 多奖励强化学习需同时满足多个行为目标。GDPO 的奖励归一化虽保留了组内相对信息，但不同目标的学习进度不均，存在批次级别的残余信号失衡问题，缺乏对奖励贡献进行校准的依据。
AI.method: 引入"优势能量"（某奖励在一批次内平方优势之和）作为分析工具。在理想化 GDPO 归一化下证明该能量与"活跃组密度"（该奖励提供非零相对优势的 rollout 组占比）成正比。据此提出 DARA：推导逆平方根密度校正，对活跃频率较低的奖励赋予更大权重，权重由每个 rollout 批次实时计算并随训练自适应，且不改变底层策略优化目标。
AI.result: 在工具调用与数学推理实验中，DARA 比 GDPO 更快学到目标行为：工具调用中达到高格式合规的步数最多减少 26%，数学推理中长度合规接近饱和的步数最多减少 65%，最终性能保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 通过优势能量与活跃组密度的理论联系，DARA 以批次自适应的逆平方根权重校正多奖励信号失衡，在不改动策略优化目标的前提下显著提升多目标学习效率，代码已开源。

title: Legal Research Bench: Measuring End-to-End Reliability in Long-Horizon Legal Research Agents
summary: Legal research is a core and time-consuming legal workflow. Lawyers must identify controlling authority, verify that it remains valid, reconcile statutes and cases, and synthesize a grounded answer. Language model agents are a natural fit for this retrieval-intensive workflow, and automating even part of it would be valuable. But that value depends on reliability: a single missing authority, stale citation, or wrong legal conclusion can make an otherwise plausible answer unusable. We introduce \textbf{Legal Research Bench} (LRB), a benchmark of 413 open-ended U.S. legal research questions written by experts, each paired with a gold answer, supporting authorities, and a binary grading rubric. We evaluate thirteen frontier models in a harness with web search, case-law search, page parsing, and retrieval tools. We score agent responses through all-pass grading with source verification, where a response is correct only if every required criterion is satisfied and its cited authorities verify. We also validate the LLM judge against expert attorneys ensuring that benchmark scores track attorney judgment. Agents remain far from reliable: among the models we tested, the strongest, Claude Opus 4.8, is fully correct on 42.9\% of questions. Performance also varies substantially by task setting: all-pass rates differ across areas of law and are lower on questions requiring reconciliation of conflicting authorities. Across models, more turns, tool calls, and inference cost do not predict higher accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Legal Research Bench（LRB），一个由专家撰写的413道美国法律研究开放题的基准，每道题配有金标准答案、支持性权威来源和二元评分标准，并评估了13个前沿模型在法律检索工作流中的可靠性。最强模型Claude Opus 4.8的完全正确率仅42.9%。
AI.motivation: 法律研究是核心但耗时的法律工作流，需要律师识别控制性权威、验证其有效性、协调法条与判例并合成有依据的答案。语言模型智能体天然适合这类检索密集型工作流，但价值取决于可靠性：单个遗漏权威、失效引用或错误法律结论都会使看似合理的答案不可用。因此需要评估模型在此任务上的真实可靠性。
AI.method: 构建LRB基准，包含413道由专家撰写的美国法律研究开放题，每题配有金标准答案、支持性权威来源和二元评分标准。在配备网络搜索、判例检索、页面解析和检索工具的测试框架下评估13个前沿模型。采用全通过式评分（all-pass grading）结合来源验证：只有当所有必需标准均满足且引用的权威来源通过验证时，回答才判定为正确。同时通过专家律师验证LLM评判器的有效性，确保基准分数与律师判断一致。
AI.result: 模型仍远未达到可靠水平：测试中最强模型Claude Opus 4.8仅在42.9%的问题上完全正确。性能因任务设置差异显著：全通过率在不同法律领域间存在差异，在需要协调冲突权威来源的问题上更低。跨模型来看，更多轮次、工具调用和推理成本并不能预测更高的准确率。
AI.conclusion: LRB揭示了当前前沿模型在法律研究任务上的可靠性缺口，最强模型完全正确率不足半数，且投入更多计算资源并不必然提升准确率，表明该领域仍存在显著的能力与可靠性挑战。

title: Initialization Improves LLM-Driven Discovery
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been used for novel discovery of algorithms, theorems, drugs, and other tasks through the use of harnesses that prompt an LLM to iteratively optimize an objective. In this work, we study the relationship between the population of previous iterates and eventual discovery success. We generalize past work on harness design to develop a suite of 12 harnesses called 'Modular' and characterize their performance across 5 diverse discovery tasks, finding that discovery success is brittle and sensitive to harness design. We uncover mode collapse, characterized by a dramatic drop in the diversity of iterates, as a common failure mode. We find that popular state-of-the-art harnesses and diversity-inducing harness interventions, which aim to prolong this collapse, yield inconsistent gains. Our results instead uncover that the performance of early discoveries is predictive of eventual success. We therefore propose a universally applicable intervention that performs an initial stage of parallel exploration in order to initialize subsequent iterative optimization. Our method provides consistent gains across many harnesses and target applications, confirming the importance of initialization in LLM-driven discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了LLM驱动的发现任务中“历史迭代种群”与最终发现成功率的关系，提出12种模块化harness并在5类任务上评测，发现模式崩溃是常见失效模式，而早期发现性能可预测最终成功，据此提出“并行探索初始化”干预方法，在多种harness与应用上获得稳定增益。
AI.motivation: LLM已被用于算法、定理、药物等发现任务，通常通过harness提示模型迭代优化目标。然而，历史迭代种群（即优化轨迹上的候选解群体）如何影响最终发现成功尚不明确，harness设计对发现成功的敏感性也缺乏系统刻画。
AI.method: 将以往harness设计工作进行泛化，构建包含12种harness的“Modular”套件；在5个多样化发现任务上评估其性能；通过分析迭代解的多样性诊断失效模式；检验主流SOTA harness与多样性诱导干预的效果；基于早期发现性能的预测性，提出一种通用干预：先进行并行探索以初始化后续迭代优化。
AI.result: 发现成功率脆弱且对harness设计高度敏感；普遍存在模式崩溃（迭代解多样性急剧下降）；主流SOTA harness及旨在延缓崩溃的多样性干预收益不稳定；早期发现性能对最终成功具有预测性；所提并行探索初始化方法在多种harness与目标应用上取得一致增益。
AI.conclusion: 初始化在LLM驱动的发现过程中起关键作用；相比单纯维持迭代过程中的多样性，通过并行探索获得良好初始种群更为有效，为harness设计提供了通用且稳定的改进方向。

title: Sapien: A Stateful Policy Engine for Autonomous AI Agents
summary: Contextual security defenses prevent AI agents from taking rogue actions by synthesizing a task-specific policy and enforcing it on the agent's tool calls. In multi-step tasks, however, which actions are valid often depends on what the agent has already done and learned. We present Sapien, a policy engine for enforcing stateful contextual policies. A Sapien policy specifies permitted tool-call sequences using a regular expression extended with stateful predicates, deferred policy generation, and scoped semantic checks. We show that Sapien stays within a few percent of an unconstrained agent's utility. Even if the agent is fully hijacked, Sapien's policies rule out 93-95% of attacks on AgentDojo and 62-85% on Toolathlon (twice as many as tool allowlists on long-horizon tasks).

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Sapien，一种用于强制执行有状态上下文策略的策略引擎，通过扩展正则表达式支持状态谓词、延迟策略生成和作用域语义检查来约束 AI 智能体的工具调用序列，在保证任务效用的同时显著提升防御成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有多步任务中的上下文安全防御通常依赖任务特定的静态策略，但哪些动作合法往往取决于智能体此前已经执行和获知的内容，静态策略难以刻画这种状态依赖性，因此需要能够表达状态依赖的强制机制。
AI.method: Sapien 是一种强制执行有状态上下文策略的策略引擎。其策略使用正则表达式描述允许的工具调用序列，并扩展了三项机制：有状态谓词（stateful predicates）、延迟策略生成（deferred policy generation）以及作用域语义检查（scoped semantic checks），从而在多步任务中表达随智能体历史行为与知识变化而变化的合法性约束。
AI.result: Sapien 的效用接近无约束智能体，仅相差几个百分点；即使智能体被完全劫持，其策略在 AgentDojo 上可排除 93%–95% 的攻击，在 Toolathlon 上可排除 62%–85%，在长时程任务中优于工具白名单（allowlist）约一倍。
AI.conclusion: Sapien 表明，通过对工具调用序列施加可表达状态依赖的上下文策略，能够在几乎不损失智能体任务效用的前提下大幅削弱被劫持时的攻击成功率，尤其在长时程多步任务中相比工具白名单具有明显优势。

title: Pre-training interventions, ex post facto: Grafting model beliefs across checkpoints
summary: Pre-training interventions are critical to alignment research, since beliefs formed during pre-training shape how a model generalizes from later training. One recently popular technique for such interventions is synthetic document fine-tuning (SDF), which aims to alter what the model believes. Ideally, synthetic documents would be mixed into pre- or mid-training, but every change to a pre-training corpus must be followed by a full post-training run before its effect can be measured, making iteration slow and expensive. Common practice instead applies SDF to an already post-trained model. This is known to leave artifacts and degrade capabilities, and, as we show, it makes the model treat fabricated entities unrelated to the documents as real, a failure we call reality drift. We propose grafting: train the SDF adapter on the pre-trained checkpoint, then add the learned weight update to the post-trained model, which approximates the faithful approach while reusing the existing post-training. We demonstrate this by installing false facts, training misaligned model organisms and applying a constitutional mid-training intervention, across model families up to 284B parameters. Grafting installs the target belief as strongly as SDF on the post-trained model while reducing both reality drift and the loss of preference coherence by more than half on average, and it stays closer to a faithful mid-training run. Because grafting requires no post-training, the same adapter can be applied to any later checkpoint, enabling researchers to iterate quickly on pre-training interventions at the cost of a single fine-tuning run.

AI.tldr: 本文提出grafting方法：在预训练检查点上训练SDF适配器，再将其权重更新叠加到已后训练的模型上，以近似"忠实"的预训练干预，同时复用现有后训练流程。该方法在安装虚假事实、训练错位模型生物体及宪法式中训练干预上验证，覆盖至284B参数，能在保持与后训练SDF同等信念植入强度的同时，将现实漂移和偏好一致性损失平均降低一半以上。
AI.motivation: 预训练干预至关重要，因为预训练阶段形成的信念会影响模型对后续训练的泛化。合成文档微调（SDF）旨在改变模型信念，理想情况下应混入预训练或中训练阶段，但每次修改预训练语料都必须完整重跑后训练才能测量效果，迭代缓慢且昂贵。因此常见做法是将SDF应用于已后训练的模型，但这会留下伪影、降低能力，并产生"现实漂移"——模型会把与文档无关的虚构实体当作真实存在。
AI.method: 提出grafting：在预训练检查点上训练SDF适配器，然后将学到的权重更新加到后训练模型上，从而在复用现有后训练的同时逼近忠实的预训练干预方式。在安装虚假事实、训练错位模型生物体以及应用宪法式中训练干预三类任务上验证，覆盖多个模型家族，规模最大至284B参数。
AI.result: Grafting植入目标信念的强度与在后训练模型上直接做SDF相当，但平均将现实漂移和偏好一致性损失降低了一半以上，并且更接近忠实的预训练运行效果。由于grafting无需后训练，同一适配器可应用于任何后续检查点。
AI.conclusion: Grafting使研究者能够以单次微调运行的成本，快速迭代预训练干预，兼顾了信念植入效果与对模型能力、一致性的保护，为对齐研究提供了高效且低副作用的干预手段。

title: ActiveSaddler: Automated Curriculum Learning for Agent Harness Optimization
comment: 37 pages, 16 figures. Project website and code: https://autosaddler-projectpage.github.io/activesaddler/
summary: Automated harness optimization can substantially improve LLM agents by iteratively updating their prompts, tool interfaces, and control logic from execution feedback. However, existing methods primarily optimize how the harness is updated while largely fixing which training scenarios generate the feedback that drives those updates. As the harness evolves, the scenarios most useful for further optimization can change, suggesting that the training curriculum itself should adapt alongside the harness. We formulate this missing dimension of harness optimization as an automated curriculum learning problem and introduce ActiveSaddler. ActiveSaddler models the evolving curriculum as a non-stationary bandit with dynamically instantiated optimization targets. It abstracts recurring failures into reusable failure-pattern arms, estimates the potential learning progress from further targeting each pattern, and adaptively balances revisiting known weaknesses with exploring unseen scenarios for new ones. Optimization outcomes continually update both the set of discovered failure patterns and their priorities, allowing the curriculum to co-evolve with the harness. Experiments on GAIA2 and Terminal-Bench 2.0 show that ActiveSaddler consistently discovers stronger harnesses, improving test Pass@1 by 4.4 and 7.5 percentage points over the same harness optimizer using a scenario order fixed before optimization, respectively. Ablations further show that these gains depend on dynamically constructing optimization targets, estimating their evolving utility, and balancing continued optimization with new failure discovery. Together, these results establish automated curriculum learning as a new crucial optimization dimension for harness optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ActiveSaddler，将 harness 优化中"训练场景选择"这一被忽视的维度形式化为自动课程学习问题，用非平稳 bandit 动态管理失败模式课程，在 GAIA2 与 Terminal-Bench 2.0 上分别提升 Pass@1 4.4 与 7.5 个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有 harness 优化方法（迭代更新 prompt、工具接口、控制逻辑）主要优化"如何更新 harness"，却基本固定了"哪些训练场景产生反馈"。随 harness 演化，最有用的训练场景也会变化，因此课程本身应与 harness 协同演化。作者将这一缺失维度形式化为自动课程学习问题。
AI.method: 把不断演化的课程建模为非平稳 bandit，并动态实例化优化目标：将反复出现的失败抽象为可复用的 failure-pattern arms，估计进一步针对每个模式的潜在学习进展（utility），并自适应平衡"重访已知弱点"与"探索未见场景以发现新失败模式"。优化结果持续更新已发现失败模式集合及其优先级，使课程与 harness 共同演化。
AI.result: 在 GAIA2 和 Terminal-Bench 2.0 上，ActiveSaddler 稳定地发现更强的 harness；相比使用优化前固定场景顺序的同一 harness 优化器，测试 Pass@1 分别提升 4.4 与 7.5 个百分点。消融实验表明增益依赖于：动态构建优化目标、估计其演化效用、以及在持续优化与发现新失败之间的平衡。
AI.conclusion: 结果确立了自动课程学习是 harness 优化中一个关键的新优化维度。

title: Beyond Final Accuracy: Auditing Communication in LLM Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Multi-agent communication aims to help agents benefit from one another's information. Yet improvements in system performance leave a fundamental ambiguity: do they reflect effective communication, a favorable agent architecture, or simply additional reasoning? Because communication methods are commonly evaluated within the systems they were designed for, these factors are difficult to disentangle. Final accuracy further merges corrected errors and corrupted answers into a single outcome, obscuring how communication changes decisions. We introduce Independent--Communicate--Revise (ICR), a controlled framework that evaluates communication as answer revision following independent reasoning. ICR fixes initial reasoning trajectories, measures correction and preservation conditional on both agents' initial correctness, and uses a no-message revision control to quantify gains beyond additional reasoning. Across four reasoning benchmarks, our audit of textual and latent communication reveals that similar aggregate accuracy can conceal substantially different revision behaviors. Compared with transmitting answers alone, full reasoning increases correction while reducing preservation on all four benchmarks, so richer messages amplify beneficial and harmful influence alike. Receiver-policy comparisons on MedQA and GPQA-D further show that a structured verification policy shifts every channel toward greater preservation and lower correction, while its effect on selectivity varies across channels and tasks. These findings challenge treating communication quality as an intrinsic property of a channel. ICR therefore recenters evaluation on selective revision, providing a unified framework for examining how message content and receiver policies jointly produce benefits and harms.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出受控框架ICR（Independent–Communicate–Revise），将多智能体通信评估重新界定为"独立推理后的答案修正"，以区分有效通信、智能体架构与额外推理带来的收益。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体通信方法通常在其原生系统内评估，导致通信效果与架构优势、额外推理收益相互纠缠；且最终准确率将"纠正错误"与"破坏正确答案"混为单一指标，无法揭示通信如何改变决策过程。
AI.method: ICR固定初始推理轨迹，在双方初始正确性条件下分别测量修正率与保持率，并设置"无消息修正"对照以剥离纯推理带来的增益；在四个推理基准上审计文本与隐式通信，并比较接收方策略（含结构化验证策略）在不同通道与任务下的表现。
AI.result: 相似的整体准确率可能掩盖显著不同的修正行为；相比仅传递答案，传递完整推理在四个基准上均提高修正率但降低保持率，即更丰富的信息同时放大有益与有害影响。在MedQA与GPQA-D上，结构化验证策略使各通道均转向更高保持率与更低修正率，而其对选择性的影响随通道与任务而异。
AI.conclusion: 通信质量并非通道的内在属性，不能脱离接收方策略与任务来评判；ICR将评估重心转向"选择性修正"，为统一考察消息内容与接收方策略如何共同产生收益与损害提供了框架。

title: Pay for the Fault, Not the Flow: Label-Free In-Flow Multi-Agent Workflow Optimization
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly construct multi-agent workflows that decompose a complex task and assign specialist agents from a pool. However, building such a workflow well remains challenging: how finely to divide the task, which agent to trust with each subtask, and when to create a new specialist are all critical decisions a workflow constructor needs to settle up front. Thus, whether each subtask succeeds remains unknown until the workflow runs. Yet, improving a workflow is costly. Locating a fault usually requires a reference answer, a graded outcome, or a trained assessor, and the fix is applied to the whole workflow through re-execution, re-search, or retraining. We propose InFlowOp, which prices every decision in one label-free cost that weighs how well an agent's competence meets what a subtask demands against how much that agent takes to run. Before execution, InFlowOp bidirectionally determines the granularity of task decomposition and agent assignment following from the cost rather than from a fixed template. During execution, InFlowOp corrects a fault with the cheapest move via the same cost that serves the workflow both as it is built and as it runs. Facing the workflow-level evaluation challenge, we introduce Braid, a benchmark whose tasks require multi-agent coordination beyond single-agent capability. Across various domains and backbones, InFlowOp outperforms single agent baselines by up to $+11.97\%$, achieving $+9.64\%$ with in-flow optimization. Our project page: https://xhguo7.github.io/InFlowOp/.

AI.tldr: 提出InFlowOp方法，用统一的"无标签成本"来度量多智能体工作流中任务分解粒度、智能体分配与故障修正等所有决策，在运行前和运行中双向优化工作流，并发布Braid基准；多领域多基座下较单智能体基线提升最高+11.97%，其中in-flow优化贡献+9.64%。
AI.motivation: LLM多智能体工作流构建困难：任务分解的细粒度、子任务与专家的匹配、何时新建专家等关键决策需在运行前确定，且子任务是否成功在运行前无法知晓。同时工作流改进代价高昂——故障定位通常依赖参考答案、评分结果或训练好的评估器，修复则需通过重执行、重搜索或重训练作用于整个工作流。因此亟需一种无需标签、可低成本定位并修正故障的方案。
AI.method: 提出InFlowOp，将工作流中的每个决策统一折算为一种"无标签成本"，该成本同时衡量智能体能力与子任务需求的匹配程度以及智能体的运行开销。执行前，InFlowOp依据该成本双向确定任务分解粒度与智能体分配，而非依赖固定模板；执行中，InFlowOp通过同一成本选择最廉价的修正动作，使该成本同时服务于工作流的构建阶段与运行阶段。为应对工作流级评测难题，构建基准Braid，其任务需要超出单智能体能力的多智能体协同。
AI.result: 在多种领域与多种骨干模型上，InFlowOp相对单智能体基线提升最高达+11.97%，其中in-flow优化带来+9.64%的增益。
AI.conclusion: 用一个统一的、无标签的成本度量贯穿工作流的构建与运行，可有效指导任务分解粒度与智能体分配的决策，并在执行中以最低代价修正故障，从而在不依赖参考答案或训练评估器的前提下显著优于单智能体基线。

title: Persistent Depth Ordering amid Shifting Block-Bypass Responses in Language Model Pretraining
summary: Layer interventions are widely used to probe the internal organization of language models, yet most analyses examine a single training checkpoint even though model representations and computations evolve throughout pretraining. This leaves open which depth-dependent intervention responses reflect persistent organization and which are transient consequences of training. We study this question using single-block identity bypass on fixed teacher-forced contexts across five released trajectories and 11 model-domain combinations. We find that block-bypass responses retain recognizable depth ordering while their magnitudes redistribute: nearby checkpoints preserve stronger rank correspondence than distant ones, and large changes concentrate at positions that recur across text samples and transfer across evaluation domains. Controlled experiments further show that changes in the natural bypass effect cannot be reduced to a single downstream sensitivity: in replicated Pythia runs, local missing-update magnitude grows while the pooled matched downstream response decreases, whereas OLMo-2 7B exhibits a different balance. These matched responses also depend on perturbation strength and direction, without identifying targeted compensation. Together, our results show that longitudinal layer sensitivity is structured but not static, and that single-checkpoint intervention responses should be interpreted in the context of how the underlying perturbation pathway evolves during training.

AI.tldr: 该研究用单块恒等旁路干预追踪语言模型预训练全程的层敏感度演化，发现层响应保持可识别的深度序但幅度重分布，且变化高度结构化、可跨域迁移。
AI.motivation: 层干预常用于探测语言模型内部组织，但多数分析只考查单一训练检查点；而模型表示与计算在预训练中持续演化，因此无法区分哪些深度相关干预响应反映持久性组织、哪些只是训练的暂时性结果。
AI.method: 在固定teacher-forced上下文上，对五个已公开的训练轨迹、11个模型-领域组合执行单块恒等旁路（single-block identity bypass），比较不同检查点的块旁路响应，包括序对应关系、幅度变化及其在文本样本与评估域间的可迁移性；并在复制的Pythia运行与OLMo-2 7B上做匹配下游响应的对照实验，考查扰动强度与方向的影响。
AI.result: 块旁路响应保留可识别的深度排序，但幅度发生重分布：近邻检查点的秩对应强于远邻检查点；大幅变化集中在跨文本样本重复出现且跨评估域迁移的位置。自然旁路效应的变化无法归因于单一的下游敏感度：复制的Pythia运行中局部缺失更新幅度增大而合并匹配下游响应下降，OLMo-2 7B呈现不同平衡；匹配响应依赖扰动强度与方向，但未识别出定向补偿。
AI.conclusion: 纵向的层敏感度是有结构但非静态的；单检查点的干预响应应结合底层扰动通路在训练中如何演化来解读。

title: Empty Commitments: When Agents Promise What Their Runtime Cannot Deliver
summary: A chatbot that says "I will remind you tomorrow" will not run again until the user writes. We call such a promise an empty commitment: a promise of an action after the current turn that nothing in the agent's tools or runtime can carry out. Unlike a broken promise, its emptiness follows from the agent's configuration alone; no later trajectory is needed. We define empty commitments on top of commitment semantics, with three failure types, an anchoring condition for promises that a tool could make real, and a response-level outcome taxonomy. We then describe a measurement protocol: follow-up requests run in five setups that add one persistence affordance at a time, with the environment either left implicit or stated.

AI.tldr: 该文提出"空承诺"（empty commitment）概念：智能体承诺在当轮之后执行某行动，但其工具或运行时配置根本无法兑现，且这种"空"仅由配置决定，无需后续轨迹即可判定。作者基于承诺语义定义空承诺，提出三种失败类型、可兑现承诺的锚定条件及响应级结果分类，并给出测量协议：在五种逐步增加持久化能力的设置中发送跟进请求，环境信息或隐含或明示。
AI.motivation: 聊天机器人常承诺"明天提醒你"之类当轮之后的行动，但若其工具或运行时无法执行，该承诺即便合理看似可兑现也是空的；这类问题不同于"失信"（需后续轨迹判定），仅凭智能体配置即可识别。现有承诺语义未刻画这种配置层面的失败，因此需要新概念与可操作的测量方法。
AI.method: 1) 在承诺语义之上定义"空承诺"，区分三种失败类型；2) 提出锚定条件（anchoring condition），用于判定某承诺是否可由工具真正兑现；3) 构建响应级结果分类法（outcome taxonomy）；4) 设计测量协议：通过跟进请求，在五种逐步添加单一持久化能力（persistence affordance）的设置中测试，环境信息分别采用隐含与明示两种呈现方式。
AI.result: 摘要未给出实验结果或量化数据，仅提出概念框架、分类方法与测量协议设计。
AI.conclusion: "空承诺"可由智能体配置单独判定，区别于失信；配套的失败类型、锚定条件、结果分类与多设置测量协议为系统评估此类承诺问题提供了可复用框架。

title: Revision-Aware Independent Agent Graphs for Dynamic Reasoning
summary: Conventional reasoning protocols present a fixed, preselected task, so they cannot test whether an agent propagates relevant updates, preserves unaffected work, or reconstructs a historical task binding. We therefore study \emph{dynamic task routing}, in which an event stream revises task bindings and a system must select the document version valid at each query time before solving it. To study this problem, we repurpose six widely used benchmarks: MMLU, MMLU-Pro, MedMCQA, MATH, GPQA, and HumanEval into 31{,}119 dynamic episodes comprising 373{,}428 temporally categorized queries. This setting exposes a central trade-off: recomputing after every event wastes work, whereas unguarded reuse returns stale conclusions. We introduce the Revision-Aware Independent Agent Graph (RIAG), a bounded multi-agent policy that separates deterministic temporal resolution from task reasoning. RIAG caches solutions by immutable document identity, starts each fresh task with two unexposed attempts, and conditionally invokes audit and repair, using at most four calls per document version. On this collection, homogeneous RIAG achieves 54.24\% joint routing-and-answer accuracy at 0.62 calls/query, compared with 32.22\% at 18.00 calls/query for the strongest comparison method; heterogeneous RIAG reaches 49.78\% at 0.63 calls/query.

AI.tldr: 论文提出动态任务路由问题，并将六个基准改造为含31,119个动态情节、373,428条时间分类查询的数据集，提出RIAG多智能体策略以在版本更新下平衡复用与重算。
AI.motivation: 传统推理协议预设固定任务，无法检验智能体是否传播相关更新、保留未受影响的工作或重建历史任务绑定，因此需要研究事件流动态修正任务绑定的场景。
AI.method: 将MMLU、MMLU-Pro、MedMCQA、MATH、GPQA和HumanEval改造为动态任务路由数据集；提出Revision-Aware Independent Agent Graph（RIAG），一种有界多智能体策略，将确定性时间解析与任务推理分离，按不可变文档标识缓存解，新任务给两次未暴露尝试，并按条件调用审计与修复，每文档版本最多四次调用。
AI.result: 同构RIAG达到54.24%的联合路由与回答准确率，每查询0.62次调用；最强对比方法为32.22%，每查询18.00次调用。异构RIAG为49.78%，每查询0.63次调用。
AI.conclusion: RIAG通过分离时间解析与推理、缓存与条件审计修复，在动态任务路由中显著提高准确率并大幅降低调用成本，优于现有方法。

title: SCOPE-AD: Sequential cost-aware ordinal-belief planning with energy-based models for diagnostic agents
summary: Alzheimer's disease (AD) diagnosis requires sequential evidence acquisition under heterogeneous test costs and patient burden. Fixed-modality predictors do not jointly decide which test to acquire or when the available evidence is sufficient for diagnosis. We propose SCOPE-AD (Sequential Cost-Aware Ordinal-Belief Planning with Energy-Based Models for Diagnostic Agents) for cost-aware classification of cognitively normal (CN), mild cognitive impairment (MCI), and AD cases. A mask-aware ordinal model represents uncertainty along the ordered CN--MCI--AD continuum. Retrospective training records provide sampled Bellman targets for an energy-based teacher, whose action distributions are distilled into a Qwen policy. At deployment, the agent selects acquisition or diagnosis actions under availability and budget constraints without access to unacquired values. After each acquisition, the evidence and ordinal belief are updated before the next decision. On ADNI, SCOPE-AD achieves 77.70\% Macro-F1 at an average acquisition cost of \$50.46, exceeding the strongest evaluated baseline by 9.34 percentage points. Full-modality evaluation raises Macro-F1 by only 1.89 points while increasing acquisition cost by 116.7 times. These results support selective acquisition for cost-effective diagnosis.

AI.tldr: 提出SCOPE-AD框架，在异构检测成本与患者负担下，联合决策"下一步做哪项检测"与"证据是否足够确诊"，实现CN/MCI/AD的成本感知序贯分类。
AI.motivation: AD诊断需按序获取证据，但检测成本与患者负担差异大；固定模态预测器无法联合决定采集哪项检测、何时证据足以诊断。因此需要成本感知的序贯采集策略。
AI.method: SCOPE-AD由三部分构成：(1) mask-aware序贯有序模型，沿CN–MCI–AD有序连续体建模不确定性（序数信念）；(2) 以回顾性训练记录采样得到Bellman目标，训练基于能量的教师模型；(3) 将教师的动作分布蒸馏至Qwen策略。部署时在可用性与预算约束下选择采集或诊断动作，且不可访问未采集数值；每次采集后更新证据与序数信念再进入下一决策。
AI.result: 在ADNI上，SCOPE-AD以平均采集成本50.46美元达到77.70% Macro-F1，比最强对比基线高9.34个百分点；全模态评估仅提升1.89个点Macro-F1，却使采集成本增加116.7倍。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持选择性采集策略，可在可控成本下实现有效诊断，证明成本感知序贯决策优于固定全模态输入。

title: DAYJOB: A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Professional Work
comment: 11 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. An earlier version was accepted to the 2nd Workshop on Agentic AI Benchmarks and Applications for Enterprise Tasks (AABA4ET) at NeurIPS 2026. Evaluation harness: https://github.com/surge-ai/dayjob
summary: Professional work often starts with a brief request that leaves the professional to work out what is needed, which documents matter, and whether the request's premise holds. We introduce DAYJOB, a benchmark of 130 tasks built by professionals in healthcare (50) and finance (80). The tasks are estimated to take a professional 13.6 hours on average in healthcare and 16.6 in finance. Each task is a containerized Harbor environment with an expert rubric of binary criteria (median 47.5 and 57.5 per task) that an agentic judge applies to the delivered files, and an attempt passes only if it meets every criterion. Across 30 model configurations from 13 developers, the strongest, Claude Opus 5.5, passes 24.7% of healthcare and 23.9% of finance attempts, and the median configuration passes 0.6% and 2.5%. In case studies, agents accept premises that the record contradicts and carry wrong inputs through otherwise consistent analyses. We release all healthcare tasks, 50 of the 80 finance tasks, the evaluation harness, and the leaderboard.

AI.tldr: 该文提出DAYJOB基准，包含医疗（50个）与金融（80个）领域共130个专业工作任务，每项任务为容器化环境并以专家二值评分标准进行判定，最强模型Claude Opus 5.5在医疗与金融上通过率分别为24.7%与23.9%，中位配置仅0.6%与2.5%。
AI.motivation: 现实专业工作常始于简短请求，需要从业者自行推断需求内容、相关文档以及请求前提是否成立；现有基准难以衡量此类开放式、长周期的真实专业任务能力。
AI.method: 构建DAYJOB基准，由医疗与金融领域专业人士设计130个任务；每项任务为容器化Harbor环境，配备专家撰写的二值标准评分表（医疗中位数47.5条、金融57.5条），由智能体评判器对交付文件逐条判定，全部满足方视为通过；评测覆盖13家开发者的30种模型配置。
AI.result: 专业人士估计医疗任务平均需13.6小时、金融任务需16.6小时；最强模型Claude Opus 5.5在医疗与金融的通过率分别为24.7%与23.9%，中位配置分别为0.6%与2.5%；案例研究中，智能体接受与记录相矛盾的前提，并将错误输入贯穿于内部一致的分析之中。
AI.conclusion: 专业工作类任务对当前智能体仍极具挑战；研究发布了全部医疗任务、80个金融任务中的50个、评测框架与排行榜，以推动该方向研究。

title: Generation Provenance Before Behavior Attribution: Auditing Synthetic Speech Research Objects
comment: Accepted to the Third NeurIPS Workshop on Attributing Model Behavior at Scale: Data Attribution and Provenance. 4 pages, 0 figures, 1 table. An aggregate reproducibility package is available from the authors on request!
summary: Attributing model behavior to synthetic training data requires knowing what produced each training item before estimating what that item caused. A waveform-label pair does not preserve this knowledge. We propose a generation-provenance substrate in which a synthetic research object binds source specification, generated content, waveform, target, fact requirements, quality signals, review lineage, and immutable manifest identity. Producer and selection mechanism determine evidentiary meaning; storage location and variable name do not. We audit this substrate in a private Japanese care-handoff pipeline. A 113-asset review population contains 1.552 hours of synthetic speech across six scenario families; all items have linked audio, transcripts, candidate notes, and fact checklists, but human evidence is selective and source-specific. Two faithful-only manifests are scenario-seed-disjoint and immutably versioned, while exact upstream attribution remains blocked by floating generator aliases, missing per-clip TTS and code stamps, and an unversioned checking prompt. We argue that generation provenance is necessary but not sufficient for behavior attribution: it defines the candidate causal graph and audit units, whereas contributive attribution still requires frozen training runs and intervention or influence evidence. The paper contributes a compact provenance contract, an audit protocol, and a bounded case study for synthetic-data attribution; controlled research access may be offered, but we do not claim causal training-data attribution, clinical validity, or unrestricted public release.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"生成溯源基底"(generation-provenance substrate)，将合成研究对象的来源规范、生成内容、波形、目标、事实需求、质量信号、评审谱系与不可变清单身份绑定，并在日本护理交接合成语音流水线中审计该基底，指出生成溯源是行为归因的必要非充分条件。
AI.motivation: 将模型行为归因于合成训练数据，需先知道每个训练项由什么产生，再估计其因果影响。但波形-标签对无法保留这一知识；且存储位置和变量名并不决定证据意义，真正决定证据意义的是生产者与选择机制。
AI.method: 提出生成溯源基底，把来源规范、生成内容、波形、目标、事实需求、质量信号、评审谱系与不可变清单身份绑定为合成研究对象；在私有日语护理交接流水线中进行审计，审查113个资产（1.552小时合成语音，六大情景族），并考察两个仅忠实性、情景种子不相交且不可变版本化的清单。
AI.result: 所有资产均链接音频、转录文本、候选笔记和事实核查表，但人类证据具有选择性与来源特异性；精确上游归因受阻于浮动的生成器别名、缺失的逐片段TTS与代码戳、以及未版本化的核查提示词。
AI.conclusion: 生成溯源对行为归因必要但不充分：它定义候选因果图与审计单元，而贡献性归因仍需冻结的训练运行与干预/影响力证据。论文贡献包括紧凑的溯源契约、审计协议与有界案例研究；不主张因果训练数据归因、临床有效性或无限制公开发布。

title: Gacha Decoding: Eliciting Diverse Generations Through Instruction Following
summary: We introduce Gacha Decoding, an inference-time method for eliciting diverse language model generations that scales with model capability. Across open-ended domains (in-the-wild chat, creative writing, planning for image generation, and protein design), Gacha Decoding significantly outperforms existing generation diversity approaches at equal quality (up to 2.4x Vendi over the next-best prior approach), reaching the same number of high-quality modes with over an order of magnitude fewer samples (11.0x) and discovering novel modes that no other approach surfaces. Our key insight is to treat diversity as an instruction-following problem: rather than relying on the LM's token entropy, we combine its instruction-following capability with randomness from an external RNG tool to scalably identify and realize distinct modes of the response space. This approach of "planning with dice" enables Gacha to invert the long-observed tension between diversity and model capability. As the underlying LM becomes a better instruction follower, diversity under Gacha Decoding consistently improves--even as its token entropy and diversity under prior approaches decline. Together, our results highlight that instruction following, rather than token entropy alone, can drive generation diversity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Gacha Decoding，一种将多样性视为指令遵循问题的推理时方法，利用外部随机数工具，在同等质量下显著提升生成多样性，并随模型能力增强而持续改善。
AI.motivation: 现有生成多样性方法多依赖语言模型的 token 熵，而随着模型能力提升，token 熵反而下降，导致多样性与模型能力之间存在长期矛盾。作者希望打破这一矛盾，让多样性能够随模型能力提升而增强。
AI.method: 将多样性建模为指令遵循问题：不依赖 LM 的 token 熵，而是结合模型的指令遵循能力与外部 RNG 工具的随机性，通过"用骰子做规划"（planning with dice）来可扩展地识别并实现响应空间中的不同模式，即 Gacha Decoding。
AI.result: 在开放域任务（真实场景对话、创意写作、图像生成规划、蛋白质设计）中，Gacha Decoding 在同等质量下显著优于现有方法，Vendi 分数最高达次优方法的 2.4 倍；以超过一个数量级更少的样本（11.0x）达到相同数量的高质量模式，并发现其他方法无法呈现的新模式。
AI.conclusion: 指令遵循而非单纯的 token 熵可以驱动生成多样性；Gacha Decoding 逆转了多样性与模型能力之间的长期张力，模型作为指令遵循者越强，多样性越持续提升。

title: QK-Wanda: Coupling Queries and Keys for Unstructured Pruning
summary: Wanda (Sun et al., 2024) prunes large language models by scoring weights independently within each linear projection, although queries and keys interact through dot products. We introduce QK-Wanda, which scores query and key weights by their individual deletion costs under an unmasked pre-RoPE reconstruction objective. It augments Wanda scores with information from the opposite projection (keys for query weights, and queries for key weights), allowing both projections to share a pruning budget. Its closed-form scores require no gradients or weight updates; full pruning takes 1.3% longer than Wanda on A100 and 3.1% longer on H200 with the calibration used in our main experiments. We evaluate QK-only pruning across 15 models from TinyLlama, Llama 2, Llama 3, and Qwen2.5, spanning 0.5B-72B parameters. Relative to Wanda, QK-Wanda reduces QK reconstruction error by an average of 60% at 50% sparsity and 45% at 80%. Downstream gains depend on the model. At 80% sparsity on Llama 2 70B, WikiText-2 and C4 perplexity decrease by 20.3% and 13.5%, while mean zero-shot accuracy rises by 5.94 percentage points. Qwen2.5-72B also improves, but Llama-3.1-70B has substantially higher perplexity despite lower reconstruction error. These results show both the promise of coupled pruning criteria and the limits of local reconstruction as a predictor of model quality.

AI.tldr: 提出 QK-Wanda，一种耦合注意力 query 与 key 投影的剪枝评分方法，在 0.5B-72B 规模模型上平均降低 60%（50% 稀疏度）与 45%（80% 稀疏度）的 QK 重建误差，下游增益因模型而异。
AI.motivation: Wanda 类方法在每个线性投影内部独立评分权重，但注意力中 query 与 key 通过点积相互作用，独立评分忽视了二者耦合，可能与实际删除代价不一致。
AI.method: QK-Wanda 在未掩码的 pre-RoPE 重建目标下，以权重各自的删除代价对 query 和 key 打分，并用另一侧投影的信息（key 之于 query 权重、query 之于 key 权重）增强 Wanda 分数，使两个投影共享剪枝预算；分数为闭式解，无需梯度或权重更新。
AI.result: 仅剪 QK 投影，覆盖 TinyLlama、Llama 2、Llama 3、Qwen2.5 共 15 个模型（0.5B-72B）。相对 Wanda，QK 重建误差在 50% 稀疏度平均降 60%、80% 稀疏度降 45%。Llama 2 70B 在 80% 稀疏度下 WikiText-2 与 C4 困惑度分别降 20.3%、13.5%，零样本平均准确率升 5.94 个百分点；Qwen2.5-72B 亦有改善，但 Llama-3.1-70B 虽重建误差更低，困惑度却显著更高。剪枝耗时仅比 Wanda 多 1.3%（A100）与 3.1%（H200）。
AI.conclusion: 耦合剪枝准则具有潜力，但局部重建误差作为模型质量预测指标存在局限，二者不总是一致。

title: Beyond Linear Concepts: Discovering and Aligning Non-Linear Concept Manifolds in Large Language Models
summary: Understanding information processing in large language models (LLMs) requires dissecting the geometric organization of their internal token representations. While existing mechanistic interpretability (MI) methods seek to extract concepts, they are constrained by a strong linearity assumption challenged by evidence of non-linear feature manifolds. We move beyond linear concepts by adapting Non-Linear Multi-Dimensional Concept Discovery (NLMCD) from computer vision to token-level LLM activations, modeling concepts as low-dimensional manifolds. To compare concept manifolds across layers and models, we introduce a concept-based alignment (CBA) score, a generalized Rand index that measures geometric proximity without explicit feature matching. Our analysis yields six key findings: (i) a neighboring-layer sanity check shows CBA is more sensitive than PCA- or CKA-based linear baselines; (ii) layer-by-layer alignment matrices reveal two block structures in intermediate and late layers, consistent across models and obscured by linear metrics; (iii) concept composition remains syntax-dominated through most of the network before giving way to increasingly mixed syntactic-semantic concepts in later layers, with increasing output-orientation toward the final layers; (iv) multilingual concept sharing between English and Mandarin is training-dependent rather than universal, strongest in Qwen, weaker in Llama, and absent in GPT-2; (v) inter-model alignment mirrors this structure, with strong correspondence between same-family Qwen models of different scale but weak alignment across model families; and (vi) across Tulu-3 training stages, alignment is highest between adjacent stages, with the largest shift between the base model and SFT, while subsequent preference-alignment stages (DPO, RLVR) leave early layers largely unchanged and RLVR mostly preserves DPO's concepts in late layers.

AI.tldr: 该论文将计算机视觉中的非线性多维概念发现（NLMCD）方法迁移到LLM的token级激活上，把概念建模为低维流形，并提出基于概念的对齐（CBA）分数，系统分析层间与模型间的几何组织，得出六项关键发现。
AI.motivation: 现有机械可解释性（MI）方法提取概念时依赖强线性假设，但证据表明特征存在非线性流形，线性假设受限，因此需要超越线性概念的分析框架来刻画LLM内部token表示的几何组织。
AI.method: 将计算机视觉的NLMCD适配到LLM的token级激活，把概念建模为低维流形；提出CBA分数——一种广义Rand指数，无需显式特征匹配即可度量几何接近度；并据此跨层、跨模型、跨训练阶段比较概念流形（含邻层sanity check及与PCA/CKA基线的对比）。
AI.result: (i) 邻层sanity check显示CBA比PCA/CKA线性基线更敏感；(ii) 层对齐矩阵揭示中间层与后层的两个块结构，跨模型一致且被线性度量掩盖；(iii) 概念组成在大部分网络中由句法主导，后层逐渐转向句法-语义混合并增强输出导向；(iv) 英-中多语概念共享依赖训练而非普遍存在，Qwen最强、Llama较弱、GPT-2缺失；(v) 模型间对齐呈同族强、跨族弱，同族不同规模Qwen对应强；(vi) Tulu-3各训练阶段相邻阶段对齐最高，base到SFT变化最大，DPO/RLVR对早期层改动小，RLVR大体保留DPO后层概念。
AI.conclusion: 非线性、基于流形的概念建模与CBA对齐度量能揭示被线性方法掩盖的几何结构，为LLM内部表征的层间组织、多语共享、跨模型对应及训练动态提供更精细的可解释性视角。

title: A Safe Prototype Is Not a Safety Direction: Reference Dependence and Prompt Confounds in Response-Safety Embeddings
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Foundations of Language Model Security (FLMSec). 15 pages, 3 figures, 11 tables. Code, results, and a verifier are in the ancillary files
summary: Can response safety be scored by cosine similarity to the mean embedding of known-safe responses? A recent sleeper-agent detector proposes exactly this score, yet the raw positive-centroid rule is not identified: positive observations locate the safe class relative to an encoder origin, but do not determine which direction separates safe from unsafe responses. We audit the rule on two prompt-controlled, human-labeled corpora and one auxiliary jury-labeled source control, using four frozen encoders and prompt-grouped splits. On the human-labeled corpora the safe prototype reaches ROC-AUC 0.457-0.545, with two cells significantly below chance and one above, while an explicit safe-minus-unsafe reference reaches 0.588-0.738 on the same embeddings; on the jury control the prototype is inverted (0.358-0.405) and the reference reaches 0.754-0.793. At validation-calibrated 5% false-safe thresholds, the reference accepts more safe responses on PKU-SafeRLHF (0.153-0.263 versus 0.039-0.061 across encoders) and Aegis (0.189-0.291 versus 0.004-0.045), but not reliably on BeaverTails. A fully unlabeled held-out reference recovers part to most of the referenced ranking, much less when only 5% of the pool is unsafe, whereas 80-634 labeled unsafe responses recover most of it. Prompt-only ablations show that prompt-label composition can inflate uncontrolled evaluations. This is a bounded result about a raw positive centroid, not all one-class methods or safety-specialized guards. A class mean is a location, not necessarily a safety direction; a declared reference with enough unsafe mass identifies orientation.

AI.tldr: 本文检验并质疑"以已知安全响应均值嵌入的余弦相似度作为响应安全评分"的质心规则，证明该原始正质心判据缺乏方向性辨识，仅有位置信息，需显式安全-不安全参照才能确定安全方向。
AI.motivation: 近期某"潜伏代理检测器"提出用响应嵌入与已知安全响应均值嵌入的余弦相似度作为安全评分，但该原始正质心规则的方向性未被验证；作者认为正样本仅能定位安全类相对编码器原点的位置，无法确定"安全-不安全"的判别方向，因此需要对此规则进行审计。
AI.method: 在两个提示受控、人工标注语料（PKU-SafeRLHF、Aegis）及一个辅助陪审团标注的来源控制（BeaverTails 等）上审计该规则；使用四种冻结编码器与按提示分组的划分；对比"安全原型"（正质心余弦）与显式"安全减不安全"参照；并在验证集校准的 5% 假安全阈值下评估安全响应接受率；进一步做无标注留出参照、少量不安全标注恢复，以及仅提示的消融实验。
AI.result: 人工标注语料上安全原型 ROC-AUC 仅 0.457–0.545（两格显著低于随机、一格高于），显式参照在同一嵌入上达 0.588–0.738；陪审团控制上原型反转（0.358–0.405），参照达 0.754–0.793。5% 假安全阈值下参照在 PKU-SafeRLHF（0.153–0.263 vs 0.039–0.061）与 Aegis（0.189–0.291 vs 0.004–0.045）接受更多安全响应，但在 BeaverTails 上不可靠。完全无标注留出参照可恢复部分至大部分排序，不安全占比仅 5% 时恢复显著变弱；80–634 条标注不安全响应即可恢复大部分。仅提示消融显示提示-标签构成会抬高未受控评估结果。
AI.conclusion: 这是关于"原始正质心"的有界结论，不否定所有单类方法或安全专用防护模型。类均值是一个位置而非必然的安全方向；只有声明参照并具备足够的不安全样本质量，才能辨识出安全方向。

title: Latent JEPA: Abstract Future Prediction for Latent Reasoning in Chemistry
summary: Large language models offer a promising foundation for chemical reasoning, bringing together chemical knowledge and multistep problem solving. Chemical intuition can provide an initial sense of plausible outcomes before the details of a solution are fully worked out. Inspired by how such expectations complement explicit analysis, we study how continuous latent thoughts can be trained to anticipate informative aspects of future solutions without verbalizing every intermediate step. We introduce Latent JEPA, a framework that combines autoregressive learning with joint-embedding prediction of one or more future views. For chemical reasoning, we develop textual and molecular prediction objectives that connect latent thoughts to both subsequent reasoning and molecular outcomes. Experiments on ChemCoTBench show gains in molecular optimization and on several editing and reaction metrics. Representation analyses show that future prediction makes latent thoughts more informative about molecular outcomes and strengthens their correspondence with chemical structure. These findings support abstract future prediction as a learning principle for connecting continuous latent reasoning with scientific outcomes.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Latent JEPA 框架，将自回归学习与联合嵌入预测结合，使连续潜在思维在不明示每一步的情况下预测未来解与分子结果，在 ChemCoTBench 的分子优化等任务上取得提升。
AI.motivation: 化学直觉常能在解法细节明确前给出合理的结果预期，这种预期与显式分析互补。作者受此启发，希望训练连续潜在思维去预见未来解中有信息量的方面，而不是逐一verbalize每个中间步骤，从而更好地连接化学知识与多步推理。
AI.method: 提出 Latent JEPA：将自回归学习与对一个或多个未来视图的联合嵌入预测（joint-embedding prediction）相结合。针对化学推理设计文本预测目标与分子预测目标，使潜在思维同时关联后续推理和分子结果。
AI.result: 在 ChemCoTBench 上，分子优化性能提升，并在若干编辑与反应指标上获得增益。表示分析表明，未来预测使潜在思维包含更多关于分子结果的信息，并增强其与化学结构的对应关系。
AI.conclusion: 抽象的未来预测可作为一条学习原则，有效连接连续潜在推理与科学结果，为化学推理中的连续潜在思维训练提供支持。

title: Stochastic Rounding in Low-Precision Transformer Inference: A Variable-Precision Emulation Study of a Small GPT-2
comment: 35 pages, 10 figures, 4 tables. Code and evaluation pipeline available at https://github.com/big-data-lab-team/fuzzy-llm and archived on Zenodo at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23066028
summary:
Should low-precision transformer inference use stochastic rounding (SR) or round-to-nearest (RN)? The answer depends on where in the network you look. We isolate this effect by holding the numerical format fixed and varying only the rounding rule at individual operation sites. To enable experiments at freely chosen precisions, we extend the PRISM vectorized rounding library to arbitrary virtual precision via a variable-precision stochastic rounding (VPSR) algorithm, proving that the rounding decision is evaluated exactly in hardware floating point.
  We develop two analyses providing complementary insight into this site-level trade-off. First, a probabilistic forward-error bound for linear projections shows that SR's error envelope grows as $O(\sqrt{n} u)$ in reduction length $n$, versus $O(n u)$ for RN, a gap that widens rapidly at low precision and is most pronounced in the long multilayer perceptron (MLP) down-projection. Second, a second-order decomposition of expected cross-entropy loss change at the output softmax into signed drift, drift curvature, and a Fisher-weighted variance penalty reveals why the two sites behave oppositely: MLP noise is predominantly a uniform logit shift to which softmax is invariant, so SR's variance is largely discounted; head noise is non-uniform across the vocabulary and is not.
  On DistilGPT-2 at $t=6$ significand bits, observations match theory: SR in the MLP raises perplexity to 1.15x the full-precision reference, versus 2.21x for RN. At the language-model head, the ordering reverses because SR introduces non-uniform variance, whereas deterministic RN carries none. In a mixed-precision configuration (MLP output at $t=6$), assigning SR to the MLP and RN to the head brings perplexity within 1.10x of the full-precision reference, a 28% reduction over matched-bit RN.

AI.tldr: 本文研究低精度Transformer推理中舍入方式（随机舍入SR vs 就近舍入RN）的站点级权衡，发现最优舍入规则取决于其在网络中的位置。
AI.motivation: 低精度推理中SR与RN的选择缺乏明确指导，且此前研究混淆了数值格式与舍入规则的影响。作者希望在固定数值格式、仅改变单个运算站点舍入规则的条件下，揭示SR/RM误差随网络位置变化的机理与规律。
AI.method: 将PRISM向量化舍入库扩展为可变精度随机舍入（VPSR），证明舍入决策可在硬件浮点下精确求值。提出两项分析：一是线性投影的概率前向误差界，给出SR误差包络为O(√n·u)、RN为O(n·u)（n为归约长度）；二是将softmax处交叉熵期望变化做二阶分解，拆分为有符号漂移、漂移曲率和Fisher加权方差惩罚。
AI.result: 在DistilGPT-2、t=6显著位下：MLP中SR将困惑度升至全精度参考的1.15倍，RN则达2.21倍；语言模型head处排序反转，因SR引入非均匀方差而RN无此问题。混合精度配置（MLP输出t=6，MLP用SR、head用RN）将困惑度控制在1.10倍以内，较同位数RN降低28%。
AI.conclusion: 舍入规则的选择应因站点而异：长归约的MLP适合SR以抑制误差增长，而对softmax敏感的head适合RN以避免非均匀方差。理论与实验一致，为混合精度推理中的舍入规则分配提供了依据。

title: Counterfactual Auditing of Bias in Open-Source Large Language Models for Clinical Triage
summary: Emergency department (ED) triage is a high-stakes prioritization task in which demographic, socioeconomic, and system-context information may improperly influence acuity assignment. Although open-source large language models (LLMs) are increasingly considered for local and privacy-preserving clinical decision support, it remains unclear how counterfactual bias varies across model families, sizes, medical-domain models, and domain-adapted models. We present a comparative counterfactual audit of ten open-source LLMs for pediatric Emergency Severity Index (ESI) prediction. Starting from real and handbook-style clinical vignettes, we construct paired counterfactual variants that change only one injected demographic, socioeconomic, healthcare-access, behavioral, social, or system-context variable while holding the clinical presentation fixed. Models include Qwen2.5-7B, Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct, a QLoRA fine-tuned Qwen2.5-7B, MedGemma variants, MedLLaMA2-7B, GPT-OSS-20B, and GPT-OSS-120B. We measure any counterfactual shift, undertriage, overtriage, shifts greater than one ESI level, mean shift, and mean absolute shift. Counterfactual sensitivity varied substantially and did not consistently decrease with larger model size or medical-domain pretraining. The fine-tuned Qwen2.5-7B showed the lowest overall sensitivity, with a 5.27% any-shift rate and mean absolute shift of 0.0534, versus 16.02% and 0.1706 for the base model. Several larger or medical-domain models showed more significant shifts. Stratified and correlation analyses further revealed clinically important directionality and shared failure patterns hidden by aggregate rates. These findings support counterfactual auditing as a lightweight, clinically interpretable framework for comparing fairness risks in open-source LLMs before clinical deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文对十个开源大语言模型在儿科急诊分诊（ESI）预测任务上进行反事实偏见审计，发现模型规模与医学领域预训练并不必然降低反事实敏感性，微调后的Qwen2.5-7B敏感度最低。
AI.motivation: 急诊分诊是高风险优先排序任务，人口学、社会经济和系统背景信息可能不当影响分诊等级。开源LLM虽被考虑用于本地隐私保护的临床决策支持，但不同模型族、规模、医学领域模型及领域适配模型之间的反事实偏见差异尚不明确。
AI.method: 构建配对反事实变体：基于真实和手册式临床案例，仅改变一个注入的人口学、社会经济、医疗可及性、行为、社会或系统背景变量，保持临床表现不变。审计十个开源LLM（Qwen2.5-7B、Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct、QLoRA微调Qwen2.5-7B、MedGemma变体、MedLLaMA2-7B、GPT-OSS-20B、GPT-OSS-120B），测量任何反事实偏移、分诊不足、分诊过度、超过一级的偏移、平均偏移及平均绝对偏移。
AI.result: 反事实敏感性差异显著，且不随模型规模增大或医学领域预训练而持续降低。微调Qwen2.5-7B整体敏感度最低，任何偏移率为5.27%，平均绝对偏移0.0534，而基座模型分别为16.02%和0.1706。若干更大或医学领域模型表现出更显著的偏移。分层与相关分析进一步揭示了被总体比率掩盖的临床重要方向性和共有失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 反事实审计可作为轻量级、临床可解释的框架，用于在临床部署前比较开源LLM的公平性风险。

title: Mingbird: A Local-First Agent Harness Enabling Small Open Models to Complete Real Tasks
comment: 44 pages, 9 figures. Code, benchmark protocol, scoring code, and all 288 per-cell results: https://github.com/Mingbird/Mingbird-agent
summary: Small open-weight models (2-9B) run on ordinary laptops, but under cloud-scale agent harnesses they rarely complete real tasks: tool prefill overflows the context, self-correction diverges, tool demonstrations loop, and tasks are silently abandoned. We present evidence, from a controlled single-machine comparison and one third-party benchmark, that a substantial share of these failures is attributable to the harness rather than the model. We introduce Mingbird, a local-first agent harness for Windows and Ollama whose ten mechanisms compensate point-by-point for small-model failure forms, three of them representative: a byte-level net-zero prefill budget, a finish gate that re-reads the task before accepting completion, and signature-level loop detection. On LRAB, a controlled comparison holding machine, models, budgets, and scoring fixed (4 harnesses $\times$ 4 open models (2B-35B) $\times$ 18 real tasks, deterministic artifact scoring), Mingbird reaches 0.886 overall against 0.631 (goose), 0.479 (opencode), and 0.405 (agent-mini), with all 288 cells published; on $τ^2$-bench (278 tasks, three arms, one protocol) it totals 0.856 against 0.791 and 0.737; and a frontier-model probe on the same 18 tasks spans 0.997 to 0.478 across harnesses, with well-formed scaffolds staying within 0.072 of each other. A leave-one-mechanism-out ablation is reported as directional only: same-night replications of the same arm move its mean by up to 0.069, the size of every nominal single-trial delta, and the one batch-matched comparison (full mechanism stack versus text re-read alone) gives the executable completion guards a paired +0.10 across three replications. The evidence carries stated limits: a self-built benchmark, a single machine, and single-trial scoring.

AI.tldr: 论文提出本地优先的小模型智能体框架 Mingbird，论证小模型任务失败多源于外部harness而非模型能力，并通过受控实验（LRAB、τ²-bench）验证其十项机制显著提升完成率。
AI.motivation: 小参数开放权重模型（2-9B）虽可运行于普通笔记本，但在云端规模的agent harness下难以完成真实任务，表现为tool prefill溢出上下文、自我纠错发散、工具演示循环、任务被静默放弃。作者认为这些失败有相当比例归因于harness而非模型本身，故需设计适配小模型的本地harness。
AI.method: 提出Mingbird——面向Windows与Ollama的本地优先agent harness，含十项机制针对性补偿小模型失败形式，三个代表机制为：字节级净零prefill预算、接受完成前重读任务的finish gate、签名级循环检测。在LRAB基准上进行受控比较（固定机器、模型、预算与评分；4 harness × 4开放模型(2B-35B) × 18真实任务，确定性产物评分），并在τ²-bench（278任务、三臂、单一协议）上验证；另做前沿模型探针与leave-one-mechanism-out消融。
AI.result: LRAB上Mingbird总体达0.886，对比goose 0.631、opencode 0.479、agent-mini 0.405，288个单元全部公开；τ²-bench上总计0.856，对比0.791与0.737；前沿模型探针在相同18任务上跨harness为0.997至0.478，结构良好的脚手架相互差距在0.072内。消融显示同一臂同夜复现均值波动达0.069，相当于每个名义单次试验delta的规模；唯一批次匹配比较（完整机制栈 vs 仅文本重读）显示可执行完成守卫在三重复下配对+0.10。
AI.conclusion: 证据支持harness是小模型agent失败的重要来源，Mingbird机制可系统性提升小模型真实任务完成率。但结论存在明确局限：自建基准、单一机器、单次试验评分，且消融仅具方向性意义。

title: CARM: Cancellation-Aware Response Masking for LLM Reinforcement Learning
summary: Recent years have witnessed the rapid adoption of reinforcement learning (RL) in large language model (LLM) post-training, with substantial gains in mathematical reasoning and code generation. In practical systems, however, policy updates and differences between rollout and training engines can make sampled responses off-policy. Sequence-level masking addresses this mismatch by deciding whether an entire response should contribute to optimization. A common masking rule uses the length-normalized geometric mean of sampled token probability ratios. Its signed log-ratios can cancel across positions, concealing substantial bidirectional policy drift. We propose \emph{Cancellation-Aware Response Masking} (CARM), a sequence-level mask that takes the absolute value of each token log-ratio before averaging, preventing opposing probability changes from canceling. We prove that accepted responses satisfy a joint bound on the fraction of sampled-token ratios outside a prescribed band and their mean log-distance beyond its boundaries. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and code generation show that CARM improves mean@16 averaged over AIME 2024/2025/2026 and BeyondAIME by up to $3.13$ percentage points over geometric-mean masking, and increases average pass@1 across four code benchmarks by $2.88$ points over the strongest evaluated baseline. These findings support CARM as a theoretically grounded and effective method for response-level off-policy control in LLM reinforcement learning.

AI.tldr: 提出CARM（Cancellation-Aware Response Masking），一种序列级掩码方法，通过先取token对数概率比的绝对值再平均，避免正负偏移相互抵消，从而更有效地控制LLM强化学习中的off-policy漂移，并在数学推理与代码生成任务上取得提升。
AI.motivation: 在LLM后训练的强化学习中，策略更新以及rollout引擎与训练引擎之间的差异会导致采样响应变为off-policy。常用的序列级掩码规则采用长度归一化的几何平均token概率比，但其带符号的对数比会在不同位置上相互抵消，从而掩盖显著的双向策略漂移，导致掩码判定失真。
AI.method: 提出Cancellation-Aware Response Masking（CARM）：对每个token的对数概率比先取绝对值，再进行平均，防止方向相反的概率变化相互抵消；并从理论上证明被接受的响应满足一个联合界，约束落在指定区间外的采样token比例及其超出边界的平均对数距离。
AI.result: 在数学推理任务上，CARM在AIME 2024/2025/2026与BeyondAIME上的mean@16平均值相较几何平均掩码最多提升3.13个百分点；在四个代码基准上，平均pass@1相较最强基线提升2.88个百分点。
AI.conclusion: CARM是一种具备理论支撑且有效的响应级off-policy控制方法，适用于LLM强化学习，实验结果验证了其相对于几何平均掩码的优越性。

title: Finetuning with Sampling: SFT Learns Better Than You Think
summary: Introducing new capabilities to frontier models has long been the goal of posttraining, which predominantly employs supervised finetuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) to this end. Conventional wisdom dictates that RL enables strong generalization on new tasks without losing existing capabilities, while SFT is prone to weak generalization and catastrophic forgetting. At the same time, SFT can learn from off-policy expert data, whereas RL must rely on a model's ability to find successful trajectories with repeated sampling. In our work, we seek to leverage the strength of on-policy learning while utilizing the privileged information contained in off-policy data. However, rather than modifying the learning objective to accommodate this data, we instead tailor the data distribution to better suit the learner. We introduce a Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) sampling algorithm that progressively transforms off-policy traces to be more on-policy given a reference model for finetuning. Across tasks like scientific skill acquisition, mathematical reasoning, and open-ended expertise, our sampling algorithm enables SFT to rival prevailing posttraining techniques, often generalizing better and forgetting less than strong on-policy baselines. In addition, the resulting finetuned models exhibit strong distributional performance and are capable of learning beyond sharpening the base model distribution. At a higher level, our approach presents sampling as a model-native operator that shapes data for learnability, offering broader utility as a general-purpose primitive throughout the posttraining stack.

AI.tldr: 提出一种MCMC采样算法，将off-policy轨迹逐步转化为更接近on-policy分布，使SFT能以离线数据媲美甚至超越主流on-policy后训练方法。
AI.motivation: 后训练中SFT可从off-policy专家数据学习但泛化弱、易灾难性遗忘，而RL泛化强却依赖模型反复采样获得成功轨迹，无法利用off-policy数据中的特权信息。作者希望兼取on-policy学习优势与off-policy数据信息，但不改动学习目标。
AI.method: 不改动学习目标，而是调整数据分布以适配学习器：设计一种马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）采样算法，以参考模型为条件，将off-policy轨迹逐步变换为更接近on-policy的分布，再用作SFT数据。
AI.result: 在科学技能获取、数学推理和开放式专业能力等任务上，该采样算法使SFT能媲美主流后训练技术，通常比强on-policy基线泛化更好、遗忘更少；微调模型表现出较强的分布外性能，并能超越对基座模型分布的单纯锐化。
AI.conclusion: 将采样视为模型原生算子，用于塑造数据可学习性，可作为后训练流程中的通用基础原语，拓展更广泛用途。

title: Every Ablation Is a Dose: Counterweights and the Semblance of Self-Repair
summary: Ablate a component of a language model, and other components often appear to adjust and compensate. This phenomenon, termed self-repair, has been observed repeatedly, but its mechanism remains unclear. The most systematic study to date concluded that self-repair is noisy and unlikely to have a single explanation. We argue that it has one: a gain already present before any ablation. Any intervention on a causally important component can be viewed as a point on a coordinate axis $λ$, the signed strength of a counterfactual contrast. Hence, conventional ablation methods are uncalibrated points on this axis. We show that the causal repair response for a fine-grained unit $r$ is governed by an affine law, $E_r(λ)=\mathrm{own}_r+γ_rλ$. The slope $γ_r$ is a fixed coefficient that consistently influences the model, with or without ablation, and its sign determines whether the unit counteracts or reinforces the removed signal. On a factual-verdict task across four models from distinct families (Gemma, Qwen, LLaMA, and Mistral), we identify components including MLP neurons, OV neurons, and singular directions that follow this affine law, 68 of 81 downstream directions in all. Moreover, we can anticipate the magnitude of $γ_r$ from the fixed weights. On the IOI circuit of GPT-2 Small, seven of the ten heads the intervention can reach follow the law, and all seven are counterweights. From this perspective, what may appear as self-repair is a counterweight performing its usual operation when the contrastive signal emerges at the core.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"自修复"现象源于消融前已存在的增益，可用仿射定律 E_r(λ)=own_r+γ_rλ 统一解释，并跨模型验证了多数组件符合该规律。
AI.motivation: 语言模型被消融某组件后，其他组件常表现出补偿性调整，这一"自修复"现象机制不明；此前最系统的研究认为自修复是噪声且难有单一解释，本文旨在反驳此观点并给出统一机制。
AI.method: 将任何因果重要组件的干预视为反事实对比强度坐标轴λ上的一个点（传统消融是未校准的点），据此推导细粒度单元r的因果修复响应满足仿射定律E_r(λ)=own_r+γ_rλ；斜率γ_r是与是否消融无关的固定系数，其符号决定单元是抵消还是强化被移除信号。在四个模型（Gemma、Qwen、LLaMA、Mistral）的事实判决任务上，识别符合该定律的组件（MLP神经元、OV神经元、奇异方向）；并在GPT-2 Small的IOI电路上验证。
AI.result: 在事实判决任务中，81个下游方向中有68个符合仿射定律；γ_r的量级可从固定权重预测。在GPT-2 Small的IOI电路上，干预可触及的10个注意力头中有7个符合该定律，且这7个全为"counterweights"（反权重）。
AI.conclusion: 所谓"自修复"实为反权重在对比信号出现于核心时的常规操作，而非噪声或多种独立机制，从而为自修复提供了单一、可校准的解释。

title: A Comparative Explainability Framework for DeBERTa-v3 in Zero-Shot Medical Abstract Classification
summary: A comparative explainability framework is presented to audit DeBERTa-v3 under zero-shot classification of medical abstracts. The work addresses the disagreement problem in Explainable Artificial Intelligence, where different attribution methods produce divergent explanations for the same input and prediction. A natural language inference engine is implemented over the Medical Abstracts corpus with five enriched hypotheses per diagnostic category and a balanced sample of one thousand texts per class. Five explanation methods are compared: SHAP and LIME as model-agnostic approaches, occlusion and Input x Gradient as deep-learning-specific approaches, and Attention x Gradient as a transformer-specific approach. Explanations are standardized through top-token attribution, and pairwise agreement is quantified using the Jaccard index. High predictive accuracy is achieved across well-defined clinical domains, whereas performance degrades under high semantic ambiguity. Explanatory stability directly mirrors predictive certainty, exhibiting strong convergence in univalent categories and a marked drop under diagnostic uncertainty. Furthermore, qualitative error auditing uncovers three systemic failure mechanisms: lexical hypersensitivity, semantic overlap, and loss of attribution coherence.
