The results support the combined use of several explanation methods and quantitative agreement metrics when auditing transformer-based models in medical text classification, and suggest prioritizing specific clinical ontologies over broad diagnostic labels.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个比较性可解释性框架，用于审计 DeBERTa-v3 在医学摘要零样本分类中的表现，核心解决 XAI 中不同归因方法解释不一致的"分歧问题"。
AI.motivation: 可解释人工智能（XAI）存在"分歧问题"：针对同一输入和预测，不同归因方法会给出相互矛盾的解释，削弱了解释的可信度。在医学文本分类这一高风险场景中，缺乏对归因方法一致性的系统审计。
AI.method: 在 Medical Abstracts 语料上构建自然语言推理引擎，每个诊断类别配五个增强假设，每类均衡采样一千篇文本。比较五类解释方法：模型无关的 SHAP、LIME；深度学习专属的遮挡法（occlusion）与 Input x Gradient；transformer 专属的 Attention x Gradient。通过 top-token 归因对解释进行标准化，并用 Jaccard 指数量化方法两两之间的一致性。
AI.result: 在定义明确的临床领域中预测准确率较高，但在高语义模糊条件下性能下降。解释稳定性与预测确定性直接对应：在单义类别中收敛性强，在诊断不确定性下显著下降。定性错误审计揭示三种系统性失效机制：词汇过敏（lexical hypersensitivity）、语义重叠（semantic overlap）与归因连贯性丧失（loss of attribution coherence）。
AI.conclusion: 建议在审计基于 transformer 的医学文本分类模型时，结合使用多种解释方法与量化一致性指标，并建议优先采用具体的临床本体而非宽泛的诊断标签。

title: Heavy-Tailed Memory Traces in Long-Horizon Language Agents
summary: Long-horizon language agents increasingly rely on external memory as a frozen world model, yet current memory systems are usually judged only by task success or token cost. We argue that the missing object is the shape of memory use: under finite context and repeated retrieval, agent memory can concentrate on a small core while leaving rare states in a long tail where prediction errors accumulate. We study this effect through a conservative tail audit and find that concentration is reproducible but policy-dependent. Random-walk agents produce log-normal-compatible retrieval artifacts, whereas semantic LLM policies yield the strongest truncated-power-law-compatible core--tail traces. Motivated by this audit, we propose Core--Tail World Model (CTWM), a rank-based memory controller that allocates prompt budget with a single exponent $τ$ while retaining a summarized tail. On Synthetic Graph World, CTWM preserves full state and transition coverage, reduces prompt tokens by 5.9%, and lowers bottom-half tail prediction error by 13.6% relative to a graph-memory baseline. The same paired comparison gives consistent token savings on ALFWorld and a 24.48% token reduction on LongMemEval with aggregate accuracy parity. These results suggest that heavy-tailed memory traces are not only a diagnostic of finite retrieval, but also a practical control signal for token-efficient agent world models.

AI.tldr: 提出 Core–Tail World Model (CTWM)，基于秩的显存控制器，通过单一指数 τ 分配提示预算并保留摘要化的长尾，使记忆轨迹呈重尾分布的同时提升 token 效率与稀有状态预测精度。
AI.motivation: 现有长时程语言智能体的外部记忆系统通常仅以任务成功率或 token 成本衡量，忽视了"记忆使用形态"这一关键维度。在有限上下文与重复检索条件下，记忆会集中于小核心、把稀有状态留在长尾，导致预测误差在长尾累积，因此需要将记忆轨迹的分布形态作为诊断与调控信号。
AI.method: 先进行保守的长尾审计，刻画随机游走策略与语义 LLM 策略下检索产物分布（对数正态兼容 vs 截断幂律兼容的核心–长尾轨迹）；据此提出 CTWM，一种基于秩的记忆控制器，用单一指数 τ 分配提示预算，并对长尾进行摘要化保留，与图记忆基线在同一配对设置下比较。
AI.result: 在 Synthetic Graph World 上，CTWM 保持完整状态与转移覆盖，提示 token 减少 5.9%，下半区长尾预测误差降低 13.6%（相对图记忆基线）；配对比较在 ALFWorld 上得到一致的 token 节省，在 LongMemEval 上 token 减少 24.48% 且总体准确率持平。
AI.conclusion: 重尾记忆轨迹不仅是有限检索的诊断指标，还可作为实用的控制信号，用于构建 token 高效且保留稀有状态覆盖的智能体世界模型。

title: When Do Causal World Models Help Modular LLM Agents
summary: LLM agents increasingly act through modular systems, such as order, payment, inventory, and shipment services, where actions in one module change which transitions are valid in another. Standard world models usually fit observational traces, but this is not the quantity needed for intervention-time planning: a trace may show that payment precedes shipment without identifying whether payment authorizes shipment, inventory mediates the effect, or a hidden trigger explains both. We study this gap through FedCausalCompose, a causal world-model framework for modular LLM agents in which local actions provide intervention-response evidence for cross-module interfaces. We first show that observational world models incur an irreducible interventional error under unblocked back-door paths, that interface recovery improves with intervention-response coverage, and that an oracle causal composition can beat the non-causal lower bound when coverage and local mechanism errors are controlled. We then test the resulting prediction in diagnostic agent settings. Causal interfaces help most in structured tool environments, where API signatures expose preconditions and downstream effects. In contrast, dialogue and narrative environments often ignore raw edge lists unless a short attention anchor makes the causal information decision-relevant. These results identify a concrete condition for causal world models in LLM agents: causal structure helps when cross-module interfaces are both statistically identifiable and presented in a form the agent can use at action time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FedCausalCompose，一个面向模块化 LLM 智能体的因果世界模型框架，论证观测式世界模型在干预时存在不可约误差，而因果接口机制可提升跨模块规划，但前提是接口在统计上可识别且以可用形式呈现。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体越来越多地通过模块化系统（订单、支付、库存、物流等）行动，一个模块中的动作会改变另一模块中合法状态转移。标准世界模型通常拟合观测轨迹，但观测轨迹并非干预时规划所需的量：轨迹可以显示"支付先于发货"，却无法区分支付是否授权发货、库存是否中介该效应，或存在共同隐藏触发因素。因此需要研究从局部干预响应证据中恢复跨模块因果接口的问题。
AI.method: 提出 FedCausalCompose，一个用于模块化 LLM 智能体的因果世界模型框架，其中局部动作提供针对跨模块接口的"干预-响应"证据。理论部分刻画观测式世界模型在未阻断后门路径下的不可约干预误差、接口恢复随干预-响应覆盖度的改善，以及在校准覆盖度与局部机制误差条件下，oracle 因果组合可超越非因果下界。随后在诊断性智能体环境中检验该预测，比较结构化工具环境与对话、叙事环境。
AI.result: 因果接口在结构化工具环境中收益最大，因为 API 签名本身暴露前置条件与下游效应。相反，对话与叙事环境通常忽略原始边列表，除非加入简短的注意力锚点使因果信息与决策相关。实验支持覆盖度越高接口恢复越好、oracle 因果组合可突破非因果下界等理论预测。
AI.conclusion: 因果世界模型在 LLM 智能体中发挥作用需同时满足两个条件：跨模块接口在统计上可识别，且以智能体在动作时可用的形式呈现。这为模块化 LLM 智能体的因果世界模型给出了明确的适用边界。

title: Gradient-Aligned Pair Selection for Personalized Preference Optimization
summary: Personalizing large language models (LLMs) requires aligning generation behavior with user-specific preferences rather than aggregate quality. While Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) provides a stable framework for preference learning, its effectiveness in personalized settings critically depends on how preference pairs are selected. Existing approaches typically rely on heuristic criteria, such as likelihood-based extremes, which decouple optimization from explicit user utility and can lead to degraded personalization. We formalize personalized preference learning as a geometry-aligned optimization problem by analyzing the first-order interaction between gradients of expected user utility and DPO update directions. Our analysis reveals that, under off-policy sampling, the DPO update transitions from a purely error-corrective signal to a reinforcement-like update when preference margins are directionally aligned with utility gradients. This perspective exposes pair selection as a geometric decision that governs whether preference optimization advances or hinders personalization. Motivated by this insight, we propose GAP-DPO (Geometry-Aligned Preference DPO), an iterative algorithm that performs utility-aware, geometry-aligned pair selection while controlling distribution shift via epoch-wise regeneration. Experiments on personalized text generation benchmarks show that GAP-DPO consistently improves stylistic fidelity, preference alignment, and generation quality compared to standard DPO variants. Together, our results establish gradient alignment as a unifying principle for personalized preference optimization and demonstrate that pair selection is an intrinsic component of the optimization geometry rather than a heuristic preprocessing step.

AI.tldr: 本文将个性化偏好学习形式化为几何对齐优化问题，揭示偏好对选择决定DPO更新是纠错信号还是类强化更新，并提出GAP-DPO实现效用感知的几何对齐偏好对选择。
AI.motivation: 个性化LLM需使生成行为对齐用户特定偏好而非聚合质量。DPO虽提供稳定的偏好学习框架，但在个性化场景中其效果关键取决于偏好对的选取方式。现有方法多依赖启发式准则（如基于似然的极端样本），使优化与显式用户效用脱钩，导致个性化性能下降。
AI.method: 作者将个性化偏好学习形式化为几何对齐的优化问题，分析期望用户效用梯度与DPO更新方向之间的一阶交互。分析表明：在离策略采样下，当偏好间隔与效用梯度方向对齐时，DPO更新从纯纠错信号转变为类强化更新。据此提出GAP-DPO（Geometry-Aligned Preference DPO），一种迭代算法，执行效用感知、几何对齐的偏好对选择，并通过逐轮次（epoch-wise）重新生成控制分布漂移。
AI.result: 在个性化文本生成基准上，GAP-DPO在风格保真度、偏好对齐和生成质量上均持续优于标准DPO及其变体。结果确立了梯度对齐作为个性化偏好优化的统一原则，并表明偏好对选择是优化几何的内在组成部分，而非启发式预处理步骤。
AI.conclusion: GAP-DPO通过几何对齐的效用感知偏好对选择提升个性化DPO性能，验证了梯度对齐作为个性化偏好优化统一原则的有效性。偏好对选择应被视为优化几何的内在组成部分，而非独立启发式预处理步骤。

title: From Proposal to Verified Effect: Praxa, an Evidence-Bound Harness for Governed AI Agent Execution
comment: 30 pages, 8 figures. Engineering validation and descriptive pilot. Public artifacts: https://github.com/praxa-labs/praxa-benchmarks/releases/tag/preprint-v1.4.0
summary: Large-language-model agents can propose and execute actions, but proposal, authority, dispatch, verified external effect, and serving promotion are different claims. We present Praxa, an agent harness that represents these states explicitly through deterministic admission, brokered execution, external read-back, reconciliation, and reviewed promotion. We report four evidence lanes. First, an author-run repository-local audit at a pinned revision passed 1,027/1,027 unit tests and 89/89 Workerd tests, instrumented all 363 expected source files, and met four coverage floors; raw per-test transcripts and independent reproduction are unavailable. Second, in a provider-backed Terminal-Bench Core 0.1.1 pilot across 12 curated tasks, baseline and reliability-layer arms each passed 17/36 strict trials. The reliability layer used 37.49% more input and 50.73% more output tokens, so the pilot does not support superiority. Third, in a post-debug, two-order coordination-proxy development comparison, baseline and a source-authored candidate each completed 180/180 trials with equal measured accuracy, full hermetic crash recovery, and zero protected violations. The candidate used 37.11% fewer tokens, 33.84% lower estimated endpoint cost, and 11.63% fewer steps; this does not establish improved quality, latency, or production behavior. Fourth, deployed source/configuration evidence shows bounded reflection, recall accounting, memory compilation, and tool-health paths, but no production outcome lift. Praxa's supported contribution is an evidence-bound architecture that makes authority-to-effect transitions explicit and testable. Current evidence does not establish adversarial security, production safety, general specialist superiority, autonomous recursive optimization, or user benefit.

AI.tldr: Praxa 是一个显式区分"提议—授权—派发—外部验证效果—服务晋级"五种状态的智能体执行框架，作者报告了四条证据链，但明确承认当前证据不支持其性能、安全或生产收益上的优越性。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体系统常把"提出动作"与"实际产生经核实的外部效果"混为一谈。论文旨在指出这些是不同的、可分别验证的主张，并提供一个让"授权到效果"的转换变得显式且可测试的架构骨架，从而避免把提议、权限、派发、外部验证效果与服务晋级混同为同一件事。
AI.method: 提出 Praxa 智能体执行骨架（harness），通过确定性准入（deterministic admission）、代理执行（brokered execution）、外部读回（external read-back）、对账（reconciliation）和经评审的晋级（reviewed promotion）显式表示上述状态。评估采用四条证据链：仓库本地在固定版本上的审计（单元测试、Workerd 测试、覆盖率与源码插桩）；基于服务商的 Terminal-Bench Core 0.1.1 试点（12 个精选任务，基线与可靠性层各 36 次严格试验）；一次后调试的双顺序协调代理开发对比（基线与源码自研候选各 180 次试验）；以及已部署的源码/配置证据（反射、召回核算、记忆编译、工具健康路径）。
AI.result: 第一条：固定版本审计通过 1,027/1,027 单元测试和 89/89 Workerd 测试，插桩全部 363 个预期源文件并满足四项覆盖率下限，但原始逐测试记录与独立复现不可用。第二条：Terminal-Bench 试点中基线与可靠性层均为 17/36 通过，可靠性层多耗 37.49% 输入与 50.73% 输出 token，故不支持优越性。第三条：开发对比中两者各完成 180/180 试验、测量精度相同，均具备完全密封崩溃恢复与零受保护违规；候选方案少用 37.11% token、估计端点成本低 33.84%、步骤少 11.63%，但这不构成对质量、时延或生产行为的改进证据。第四条：部署证据显示存在有界反射、召回核算、记忆编译与工具健康路径，但无生产结果提升。
AI.conclusion: Praxa 有支撑的贡献是一个证据约束的架构，使授权到效果的转换显式且可测试。当前证据不足以确立对抗性安全、生产安全、通用专家优越性、自主递归优化或用户收益，因此论文以"证据边界"而非性能宣称作为核心主张。

title: EviGraph: Proof-Carrying Selective Recommendation over Temporal Public-Service Knowledge Graphs
summary: Public-service recommendations require evidence that matches the requested service, scope, and date. Yet treating every missing detail as decisive can withhold useful recommendations. We introduce EviGraph, which distinguishes critical decision requirements from information that can remain unresolved. A language agent links these requirements to evidence in a temporal knowledge graph, while a deterministic checker establishes whether a recommendation is supported. Evaluation on a bilingual Hong Kong public-service benchmark with executable policy references shows that this distinction reduces unnecessary abstention. Additional verification, however, can withdraw supported recommendations without improving decision quality. These findings suggest that reliable evidence-based navigation depends on specifying what must be established for a decision, rather than simply adding more verification.

AI.tldr: EviGraph 通过区分"关键决策要求"与"可容忍未决信息"，并借助语言代理在时序知识图谱中链接证据、确定性检查器判定推荐是否被支持，在香港公共服务基准上减少了不必要弃答；但额外验证会撤回本可支持的推荐而不提升决策质量。
AI.motivation: 公共服务推荐需要与服务类型、范围和日期相匹配的证据，但若把每个缺失细节都视为决定性条件，就会过度弃答（unnecessary abstention），从而隐藏掉本可用的推荐。因此需要区分"必须确立的信息"与"可保持未决的信息"。
AI.method: 提出 EviGraph：由语言代理将关键决策要求链接到时序知识图谱（temporal knowledge graph）中的证据，再由确定性检查器（deterministic checker）判定推荐是否获得支持。在带可执行政策引用的双语香港公共服务基准上进行评估。
AI.result: 该"关键/非关键"区分降低了不必要的弃答率；然而，增加额外验证会撤回已有支持的推荐，且并未改善决策质量。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的循证导航取决于明确"决策必须确立什么"，而非单纯叠加更多验证步骤。研究提示：验证的边际价值受限于是否精确定义了决策所需证据条件。

title: K-Dense BYOK: An Open-Source AI Research Assistant That Runs Locally and Keeps a Hash-Chained Lab Notebook
comment: 38 pages, 8 figures plus a graphical abstract; includes benchmark prompts, scoring rubric, and per-prompt scores. Code: https://github.com/K-Dense-AI/k-dense-byok
summary: K-Dense BYOK (bring your own keys) is a free, open-source AI research assistant for scientists in any field that runs on the researcher's own computer. The researcher supplies access to a model of their choice, hosted or running locally, and the application supplies everything else: a place for the work to run, a layer of scientific scaffolding, and a complete record. Each project is an ordinary folder, so the data, the code, the results, and the record stay on a machine the researcher administers and can be read years later without the application. Three things separate it from a chat assistant or a general-purpose coding agent. It ships a library of written scientific procedures, guided workflow templates, catalogs of where research data can be found, and reviewer and writer roles the agent can hand work to. It keeps a Living Lab Notebook whose entries link into an argument and are added to but never erased. And it records what happened by watching what the agent does rather than by taking the agent's word for it, in a log the agent has no tool that can write to. That choice targets the most common failure, model overclaiming, in our earlier benchmark of nine frontier models, by making claims checkable rather than preventing them. On twenty interdisciplinary research prompts, scored under a rubric fixed in advance, K-Dense BYOK led two managed platforms on both scientific quality and research execution. Its deliverables were the only ones that recorded the software they ran in, and the only ones that usually arrived with a command that regenerates the results. One of the managed platforms ran the same frontier model and supplied neither. Those environment records were files the agent wrote, not part of the observed log, which does not yet capture the software environment itself. The code is available under the MIT license at https://github.com/K-Dense-AI/k-dense-byok.

AI.tldr: K-Dense BYOK 是一款免费开源、在研究者本机运行的 AI 科研助手，用户自带模型密钥；它以科学脚手架、不可删除的 Living Lab Notebook 和独立于智能体的行为日志为核心，在二十个跨学科研究提示上于科学质量与研究执行度两方面优于两个托管平台。
AI.motivation: 现有聊天助手与通用编码智能体缺少科研专用支撑：缺乏成体系的科学流程、可追溯且不可篡改的研究记录，以及独立可信的执行日志。最常见的失败模式是模型过度声称（overclaiming），而仅靠模型自述无法核实。作者希望以"可核查"而非"事先阻止"的方式应对该问题，并让数据、代码、结果与记录留在研究者自己管理的机器上。
AI.method: 系统采用 BYOK（自带密钥）与本机运行架构，每个项目即一个普通文件夹。三项差异化设计：一是内置成文科学流程库、引导式工作流模板、研究数据来源目录，以及可交接任务的审稿人与写作者角色；二是 Living Lab Notebook，条目相互链接构成论证，只增不删；三是通过观测智能体行为（而非采信其自述）记录过程，日志对智能体不开放写入工具。评估采用二十个跨学科研究提示，并按事先固定的评分量表打分，与两个托管平台对比。
AI.result: 在科学质量与研究执行度两项评分上，K-Dense BYOK 均领先两个托管平台。其交付物是唯一记录了所运行软件的，也是唯一通常附带可复现结果的命令的。其中一个托管平台使用相同的前沿模型，却两项均未提供。环境记录属于智能体写入的文件，尚不属于观测日志的一部分，日志目前仍未捕获软件环境本身。
AI.conclusion: 面向科学家的本机运行、自带模型密钥的 AI 科研助手在科学质量与执行可复现性上优于托管平台，其关键在于科学脚手架、不可篡改的笔记本记录与独立观测日志。但当前观测日志尚未覆盖软件环境本身，环境信息仍依赖智能体写入的文件，可复现性保障仍有扩展空间。代码以 MIT 许可证开源。

title: Build2SPARQL: A Large-Scale Text-to-SPARQL Benchmark Dataset for Building Knowledge Graph Querying
comment: 26 pages, 2 figures, 16 tables. Data paper. Dataset openly available at https://zenodo.org/records/20451474. Under review at the ASCE Journal of Computing in Civil Engineering
summary: Building automation systems are increasingly represented as semantic knowledge graphs (KGs) using ontologies such as Brick and ASHRAE 223P, creating a machine-readable substrate for artificial-intelligence applications. One promising application is translating natural-language questions into SPARQL (text-to-SPARQL), which would let building operators query these graphs through language agents, but progress is limited by the scarcity of large natural-language/SPARQL benchmarks. This paper presents Build2SPARQL, a large-scale benchmark for building KGs generated by a KG-grounded pipeline: SPARQL queries are produced and validated entirely by graph-traversal code, while large language models generate only the natural-language questions, keeping query correctness independent of model behavior. The pipeline mines six query-pattern families -- linear chains, branching, UNION, aggregation, OPTIONAL, and attribute-filtered -- and phrases each query across five vocabulary registers. Applied to 201 building KGs (180 Brick, 21 ASHRAE 223P), it yields 6,136 executable SPARQL queries and 30,680 questions. A two-rater human validation of 300 questions found 98.8% semantic fidelity, 98.8% naturalness, and 84.0% operational plausibility. A retrieval-augmented evaluation across three open-weight language models raised exact-match accuracy from 0.2-20% (zero-shot) to 56-65% (three-shot retrieved).

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Build2SPARQL，一个面向建筑知识图谱的大规模text-to-SPARQL基准，通过图谱遍历代码生成并验证SPARQL查询、由大模型仅生成自然语言问题，覆盖201个建筑KG，产出6,136条可执行查询与30,680个问题，并验证了其质量与检索增强评估效果。
AI.motivation: 建筑自动化系统越来越多地以语义知识图谱形式表示（如Brick和ASHRAE 223P本体），为AI应用提供机器可读基础。将自然语言问题翻译为SPARQL（text-to-SPARQL）可让运维人员通过语言代理查询图谱，但缺乏大规模自然语言/SPARQL基准限制了进展。
AI.method: 提出KG-grounded流水线：SPARQL查询完全由图谱遍历代码生成并验证，大语言模型仅生成自然语言问题，使查询正确性独立于模型行为。流水线挖掘六类查询模式（线性链、分支、UNION、聚合、OPTIONAL、属性过滤），并将每条查询以五种词汇语域表述。
AI.result: 应用于201个建筑KG（180个Brick、21个ASHRAE 223P），生成6,136条可执行SPARQL查询和30,680个问题。对300个问题的双评分者人工验证显示语义保真度98.8%、自然度98.8%、操作合理性84.0%。在三个开源权重语言模型上的检索增强评估将精确匹配准确率从零样本的0.2-20%提升至三样本检索的56-65%。
AI.conclusion: Build2SPARQL为建筑知识图谱text-to-SPARQL提供了大规模、高质量基准，验证了KG-grounded生成流程的有效性，并表明检索增强可显著提升开源模型在建筑领域text-to-SPARQL任务上的性能。

title: Measuring the Microtask Eligibility Gap: When Is an Off-the-Shelf SLM Enough for an Agent Harness?
comment: Preprint. under review at a NeurIPS 2026 workshop. 15 pages, 8 figures, 14 tables
summary: Agent harnesses increasingly want to run small language models (SLMs) on the microtasks around a frontier large language model (LLM) planner: auto-approving shell commands, writing memory, selecting tools, ranking past turns. We ask whether off-the-shelf SLMs meet practitioner-defined thresholds and, when they fail, why, and whether quantization changes the answer. We build a benchmark of 4 such microtasks with fixed prompts and automatic metrics, each with a pre-specified threshold $τ$ anchored to a cheap non-LLM baseline and a CI-aware eligibility rule (a configuration passes only if its confidence bound clears $τ$). Sweeping Qwen3 0.6/1.7/4/8B at their best (FP16, greedy, one frozen prompt, no tuning), we find an eligibility gap: 0 of 16 (4 tasks $\times$ 4 models) configurations pass (verified by checking the raw outputs and parser behavior). A logprob decision-threshold diagnostic (T1/T3/T4; T2 via a context-length/cascade probe) separates the failures into capability deficits and failures that can be addressed by changing the decoding threshold (4 regimes). Quantization to 4-bit (RTN/GPTQ/AWQ) does damage that depends on model size and moves no configuration into eligibility (certified on the reconstructable hard-label tasks T1/T3, diagnostic/windowed robustness on T2/T4), so the gap tracks model size more than precision; it replicates on Llama-3.x (12/12 ineligible) and is robust to the anchor choice (a $τ$-sweep) and to prompt wording (0/112 eligible across the original plus 3 neutral paraphrases per cell). The practical implication: place SLMs behind a baseline that meets the CI-backed threshold, and use the SLM only where the baseline fails to meet the threshold; e.g. a 4B re-ranker over a BM25 shortlist beats BM25 ($+0.047$ [0.020, 0.073], without itself certifying eligibility).

AI.tldr: 本文构建了包含4个微任务（shell命令自动批准、记忆写入、工具选择、历史轮次排序）的基准，固定提示与自动指标并预设阈值τ（锚定非LLM基线、采用CI感知资格规则），对Qwen3 0.6/1.7/4/8B（FP16贪心、单一冻结提示）进行评测，发现16种配置全部不合格；通过logprob决策阈值诊断将失败划分为能力缺陷与可通过调整解码阈值解决的失败（4种情形）；4-bit量化（RTN/GPTQ/AWQ）造成的损伤随模型规模变化，未能使任何配置达标，说明差距更多取决于模型规模而非精度；结论在Llama-3.x（12/12不合格）上复现，且对锚点选择与提示措辞稳健（0/112合格）。实践启示：将SLM置于满足CI阈值的基线之后，仅在基线不达标处使用SLM。
AI.motivation: 智能体框架越来越多地希望在围绕前沿大语言模型（LLM）规划器展开的微任务中运行小语言模型（SLM），如自动批准shell命令、写入记忆、选择工具、对历史轮次排序。作者希望回答：现成的SLM能否满足从业者设定的阈值；若不能，失败原因是什么；量化是否会改变结论。
AI.method: 构建包含4个微任务的基准，采用固定提示和自动指标；每个任务预设阈值τ（锚定于低成本非LLM基线），并采用CI感知的资格规则（配置仅在置信界超过τ时才算通过）。在Qwen3 0.6/1.7/4/8B上进行最佳设置评测（FP16、贪心解码、一个冻结提示、不做微调）。使用logprob决策阈值诊断（T1/T3/T4直接诊断，T2通过上下文长度/级联探针）区分失败类型。对4-bit量化（RTN/GPTQ/AWQ）进行评测：在可重建硬标签任务T1/T3上做认证，在T2/T4上做诊断与窗口化稳健性分析。另在Llama-3.x上复现，并做τ扫描和3种中性改写提示的稳健性检验。
AI.result: 出现资格缺口：16种配置（4任务×4模型）全部不通过（经原始输出与解析器行为核验）。logprob决策阈值诊断将失败分为能力缺陷与可通过改变解码阈值解决的失败，共4种情形。4-bit量化造成的损伤依赖模型规模，未能使任何配置进入合格状态，差距更多随模型规模而非精度变化。结论在Llama-3.x上复现（12/12不合格），对锚点选择（τ扫描）与提示措辞稳健（原始提示加每格3个中性改写，0/112合格）。示例：基于BM25候选列表的4B重排器优于BM25（+0.047 [0.020, 0.073]），但自身未能认证合格。
AI.conclusion: 从业者应将SLM部署在满足CI支持阈值的基线之后，仅在基线未达阈值处使用SLM；SLM可作为基线的补充而非替代，即使其单独无法通过资格认证。

title: Knowing When to Yield: Grounded Arbitration of User Corrections in Text-Based Embodied Agents
summary: How should an embodied agent respond when a person's correction may be wrong? We formulate grounded correction arbitration as a choice among accepting, rejecting, inspecting the world, and asking the speaker. GAVA implements this interface with observation-bounded evidence, legal probes, and a one-step expected-loss rule. In text-only ALFWorld, 162 checkpoints produce 972 paired true and false interventions. Complete local inspections give GAVA and always verify 100 percent correction accuracy, establishing the evidence contract rather than a comparative advantage. In same-episode execution, GAVA reduces interaction cost against always verify but ties a cost threshold under a perfect speaker. An exploratory training-only object-location prior lowers interaction and declared joint cost on 340 unseen scenarios by 0.490 and 0.420 relative to uniform GAVA. After freezing the policy, costs, baselines, and multiplicity plan, the gains replicate on 77 non-overlapping seen checkpoints, covering 308 scenarios: 0.595 and 0.517, with both 95 percent checkpoint-bootstrap confidence intervals excluding zero. Joint cost also improves over an identical-prior fixed policy, while the matched calibrated no-VOI comparison remains inconclusive. Semantic GAVA makes four factual errors in each cohort, corresponding to 98.8 percent and 98.7 percent accuracy, and all methods complete every task. Results support selective information gathering with semantic priors under declared costs, but do not establish a general advantage of environmental value of information over clarification. The study uses normalized claims, complete symbolic observations, and controlled speakers; it evaluates neither human participants, visual input, nor physical robots.

AI.tldr: 论文提出具身智能体在人类纠错可能错误时的"grounded correction arbitration"问题，将其建模为接受、拒绝、检查世界与询问说话者之间的选择，并以GAVA实现。实验在ALFWorld文本环境中验证了证据契约、交互成本优势及语义先验带来的增益，但未证明环境信息价值相对澄清提问的普遍优势。
AI.motivation: 具身智能体面对人类纠正时，纠错本身可能出错，因此智能体需要判断是否应直接接受、拒绝、主动检查环境，还是向说话者澄清。现有工作缺乏对这一多选项仲裁问题的系统形式化与代价敏感性评估。
AI.method: 提出grounded correction arbitration框架，将响应建模为四类动作（接受、拒绝、检查世界、询问说话者）。GAVA基于观测有界证据、合法探针（legal probes）和一步期望损失规则实现该接口。在文本ALFWorld中，使用162个检查点生成972组配对真/假干预；引入仅训练用的物体位置先验，并在冻结策略、成本、基线与多重性计划后进行复制验证，采用检查点bootstrap置信区间。
AI.result: 完整局部检查下，GAVA与always verify均达到100%纠错准确率，确立证据契约而非比较优势。同回合执行中，GAVA相比always verify降低交互成本，但在完美说话者下与成本阈值打平。训练先验在340个未见过场景中将交互成本与声明联合成本相对uniform GAVA分别降低0.490和0.420；在77个不重叠已见检查点（308场景）上复制为0.595和0.517，两个95%置信区间均排除零。联合成本优于同先验固定策略，但校准no-VOI比较不确定。语义GAVA每队列4个事实错误，准确率98.8%与98.7%，所有方法均完成任务。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持在声明成本下结合语义先验的选择性信息收集，但未确立环境信息价值相对澄清提问的普遍优势。研究限于归一化声明、完整符号观测与受控说话者，未评估真人参与者、视觉输入或物理机器人。

title: Conflicting Supervision Moves Commitment, Not Capability: A 12.29σ arrangement effect that is exactly zero under a convention-agnostic score
summary: "Train a model on the same problems written under two incompatible conventions, both correct, and ask what the ordering of that data writes into the parameters. The learning-rate schedule is not a background condition for that question. It is the averaging operator, and it decides the answer. We prove a bound in which the arrangement and the schedule enter the ordering effect as separate multiplied factors: the arrangement only as a block period, the schedule only as how much weight the endpoint can place on any one moment of the run. A decaying schedule cannot put a large step size and an uncontracted remainder at the same moment; a constant one does exactly that at the last step. That decay moderates ordering effects has been reported in pretraining; the mechanism, the separation, and a controlled measurement of both halves are ours. Ten orderings of one corpus, one budget, everything but the path held fixed, run twice under families differing in lr_scheduler_type and nothing else: at a constant rate the interior spans 0.2221 in allocation, 11.63 contrast floors, monotone in how blocked the arrangement is. Under the single cosine every published arm uses, the same ten arms occupy two distinguishable states where their own resolution would allow about ten. "Order matters" and "order does not matter" are the two ends of one knob. What the path writes is which convention the model commits to, and no exact-match benchmark can see it. Across twelve arms acc_A+acc_B is constant to within 9.7% while the allocation share runs 0.04 to 0.87, so the 12.29-sigma arrangement switch this paper measures is exactly zero under a convention-agnostic metric. That conservation is quoted from the decayed family throughout, the constant-rate one being a noisier place to read it. Marking the convention in the prompt collapses the switch and reaches 87.5% of the union ceiling."

AI.tldr: 该论文研究数据排列顺序对模型参数的影响，证明学习率调度并非背景条件而是决定顺序效应的“平均算子”，并将顺序效应分解为排列（块周期）与调度（端点权重）两个相乘因子；实验显示恒定学习率下十种排列产生大而单调的差异，而余弦衰减将其压缩为两个状态，且这种差异在任何精确匹配指标下都不可见，但通过在提示中标注约定可消除。
AI.motivation: 以往预训练中已观察到衰减调度能缓解顺序效应，但缺乏对机制的说明、两个因子的分离以及两者的受控测量。作者希望澄清学习率调度在顺序效应中的角色：它不是背景条件，而是决定答案的“平均算子”，并据此解释为何顺序效应在某些调度下存在、在某些调度下消失。
AI.method: 将同一批问题分别以两种互不兼容但都正确的约定书写，训练模型并考察数据顺序写入参数的效果。理论上证明一个界：排列与调度作为独立的相乘因子进入顺序效应——排列仅表现为块周期，调度仅表现为端点对任意时刻所能施加的最大权重。实验上取同一语料、同一预算、除路径外其余全部固定，构造十种排列，仅在lr_scheduler_type上不同的两个家族各跑两次，并测量分配份额与对比下限。
AI.result: 恒定学习率下，内部跨度达0.2221（分配）与11.63（对比下限），且随排列的块化程度单调变化；在已发表工作普遍使用的单一余弦调度下，同样的十个臂仅落在两个可区分状态，而其自身分辨率本应允许约十个。跨十二个臂，acc_A+acc_B在9.7%以内保持恒定，而分配份额在0.04到0.87之间变动，使得12.29-sigma的排列切换在约定无关指标下恰好为零；该守恒量取自衰减家族，恒定速率家族读数更噪声。在提示中标注约定可使切换消失，并达到并集上限的87.5%。
AI.conclusion: “顺序重要”与“顺序不重要”是同一旋钮的两端，学习率调度决定模型在多大程度上把排列写入参数。路径所写入的是模型对某一约定的承诺，任何精确匹配基准都无法察觉；顺序效应在约定无关指标下被完全守恒所掩盖。通过在提示中显式标注约定，可以消除该切换并接近并集性能上限。

title: Rules to Tools: Executable Checks for LLM Agents in Scientific Computing
summary: Scientific coding agents receive equations, boundary conditions, and output requirements in writing, then must assess the programs they revise. Rules to Tools (R2T) supplies prepared executable checks of public scientific requirements. Matched SciCode repair groups share written checks, starting programs, model, and budgets; the tool group receives a callable implementation. Across two task-ID cohorts, complete repair is 26/30 with text and 29/30 with the prepared checks. Three task IDs favor tools, one favors text, and eleven tie. The eight-ID cohort scores 13/16 versus 15/16, with a task-cluster bootstrap 95% interval of [-12.5, 43.75] percentage points for the difference. The larger shared-definition SciCode cohort ties at 13/24 per group. Five development-exposed tasks with alternate starting programs score 3/10 versus 7/10. The tool group favors tasks 17, 77, and 11; initial checks flag task 17 and report no violation for tasks 77 and 11. Task 37 favors text and has no initial reported violation. A fresh source-through-Python arm also reaches 15/16, matching the dedicated command's aggregate. In a matched PDE comparison, detailed text scores 23/24 and checks score 24/24, with 31.2% lower reported model output for checks. Agent-side output savings vary by cohort, while public CPU use rises in both task-ID cohorts. These results measure task-dependent repair outcomes and agent-side costs with prepared checks.

AI.tldr: R2T将公开科学需求转为可调用检查工具，使编码智能体修复SciCode任务的成功率由文本条件下的26/30提升至29/30（另一队列13/16→15/16），但在共享定义队列中两组持平（13/24），且PDE对比中两者近乎持平（23/24 vs 24/24），同时智能体侧输出降低、公共CPU开销上升。
AI.motivation: 科学编码智能体需依据书面给出的方程、边界条件与输出要求，评估并修改程序。作者探究：将公开科学需求预先转化为可执行检查（而非仅以文本描述）是否能提升修复成功率，并衡量其对智能体侧成本与公共计算资源的影响。
AI.method: 提出Rules to Tools (R2T)：把公开科学需求预先实现为可调用、可执行检查。采用匹配实验设计——SciCode修复组共享书面检查、起始程序、模型与预算，工具组额外获得可调用的检查实现；比较两个任务ID队列、一个共享定义队列、五个开发暴露任务（含替代起始程序）、一个从源码到Python的新臂，以及一项匹配的PDE对比，并报告任务簇bootstrap置信区间。
AI.result: 两个任务ID队列：完整修复为文本26/30、检查29/30；三个任务ID偏好工具、一个偏好文本、十一个持平。八ID队列为13/16 vs 15/16，差值任务簇bootstrap 95%区间[-12.5, 43.75]个百分点。共享定义SciCode队列两组均13/24持平。五个开发暴露任务的替代起始程序为3/10 vs 7/10。工具组偏好任务17、77、11，初始检查标记任务17、对77和11未报告违规；任务37偏好文本且无初始报告违规。新源码经Python臂达15/16，与专用命令汇总一致。PDE对比中详细文本23/24、检查24/24，检查侧报告模型输出低31.2%。智能体侧输出节省随队列变化，公共CPU使用在两个任务ID队列均上升。
AI.conclusion: R2T的修复收益具有任务依赖性：整体偏向工具但存在任务级反转与队列间异质性；工具可降低智能体侧输出，但会增加公共CPU开销。因此应以任务分层方式评估，并同时报告成功率与计算成本。

title: Fault-Tolerant Budget Conservation in Distributed Multi-Agent Delegation
comment: 67 pages, 3 figures, 17 tables, 4 algorithms, and 3 listings. Includes formal proofs, bounded model checking, mutation analysis, and crash-injected two-process SQLite experiments
summary: Resource limits are becoming an authorization boundary for AI agents that delegate work across concurrent and failure-prone workers. Parent-child allocation constraints, affine objects, and distributed escrow do not by themselves prevent overspend when replies are lost, effects complete after timeout, messages repeat, branches partition, or DAG joins alias one lineage. We formalize fault-tolerant budget conservation for distributed multi-agent delegation. Budgets are quantized resource vectors represented by exclusive escrow credits that move through a delegation DAG. Before dispatch, a branch converts credit into an operation reservation bound to lineage, epoch, normalized effect, maximum charge, receiver, and idempotency key. It persists a signed dispatch permit with quarantine; the gateway verifies that permit before first acceptance. Uncertain effects remain charged until authenticated settlement, a fenced authoritative no-effect proof, or permanent retirement. We prove ownership partition, ledger and effect conservation, descendant non-amplification, at-most-once settlement, late-completion safety, and partition confinement under explicit mediation, durability, authentication, normalization, and gateway assumptions. An indistinguishability result shows that partition-local availability requires exclusive preallocation. Bounded TLA+ checking, an independent JavaScript explorer, and crash-injected two-process SQLite experiments exercise the declared scope and detect timeout-refund and historical-certificate-validation mutants. The mechanism preserves the issued budget bound across the evaluated crash, retry, duplicate, partition, join, and late-completion schedules.

AI.tldr: 本文形式化了分布式多智能体委派中的容错预算守恒问题，提出基于专属托管信用、委派DAG与签名调度许可的机制，并证明所有权划分、账本/效果守恒、至多一次结算等性质，经TLA+、JavaScript探索器与崩溃注入实验验证。
AI.motivation: AI智能体在并发且易故障的worker间委派工作时，资源限制正成为新的授权边界。现有的父子分配约束、仿射对象与分布式托管，在回复丢失、超时后效果才完成、消息重复、分支分区或DAG汇合导致血缘别名化等情形下，无法防止超额支出。
AI.method: 将预算量化为资源向量，用专属托管信用在委派DAG中流转；分派前将信用转换为绑定血缘、epoch、规范化效果、最大扣费、接收方与幂等键的操作预留，并持久化带隔离的签名调度许可，由网关在首次接受前验证。不确定效果在认证结算、带栅栏的权威无效果证明或永久退役前持续计费。在显式中介、持久性、认证、规范化与网关假设下进行形式化证明。
AI.result: 证明了所有权划分、账本与效果守恒、后代非放大、至多一次结算、迟到完成安全性与分区限制；不可区分性结果表明分区局部可用性需要独占预分配。通过有界TLA+检查、独立JavaScript探索器及崩溃注入的双进程SQLite实验覆盖声明范围，并检测出超时退款与历史证书验证两类变异体。在所评估的崩溃、重试、重复、分区、汇合与迟到完成调度下，该机制保持已发放预算上界。
AI.conclusion: 该机制在故障与不确定条件下为分布式多智能体委派提供可证明的预算守恒保证，且分区局部可用性与独占预分配在理论上等价，实验验证了其有效性与安全性。

title: Mathematical Transfer in LLMs Follows Reasoning Approach More Than Topic
summary: When selecting mathematical training data for LLMs, a natural organizing principle is topic: probability examples for probability targets. An alternative is reasoning approach: worked solutions that share a solution method with the target, even when the mathematical domain differs. We ask which relation produces greater transfer after fine-tuning. We evaluate two counterbalanced $2\times2$ designs: probability and combinatorics crossed with invariant reasoning and double counting (2,000 problems), and number theory and geometry crossed with complement and pigeonhole reasoning (800 problems). In each design, every cell serves as the held-out target in turn: same-approach (SA) sources share the target's method but change the topic, while same-topic (ST) sources share the topic but change the method. Every source appears once in each role, so additive source-quality effects cancel from the equally weighted aggregate contrast. Across five base models and three training seeds per design, SA outperforms ST in all 40 seed-pooled model--target comparisons. Model-level advantages range from 8.2 to 16.2 percentage points in the primary design (mean: 10.8) and from 12.0 to 16.0 in the second design (mean: 14.3); all ten model-level 95% confidence intervals exclude zero. In both designs, ST sources are more similar to targets under embedding and lexical measures, so the SA advantage runs opposite to the measured ordering of statement-level resemblance. These findings identify reasoning approach as a more effective matching criterion than topic for mathematical transfer across the evaluated topic--approach combinations.

AI.tldr: 在数学微调数据选择中，以"推理方法"匹配（而非"主题"匹配）能带来更强的迁移效果：五个基础模型×两种设计下，SA在全部40个种子汇总对比中均优于ST，模型级优势达8.2–16.2与12.0–16.0个百分点。
AI.motivation: 为LLM选择数学训练数据时，直觉性组织原则是按主题匹配（如为概率目标选用概率例题）。作者质疑这一默认假设，转而考察另一种匹配原则——推理方法：即使数学领域不同，只要解答所用的方法相同即可迁移。核心问题是：哪种关系在微调后产生更强迁移。
AI.method: 采用两个平衡的2×2设计。设计一：概率与组合数学 × 不变式推理与双计数（2,000题）；设计二：数论与几何 × 补集法与鸽巢原理（800题）。每个单元格轮流作为留出目标：同方法（SA）来源共享目标方法但改变主题，同主题（ST）来源共享主题但改变方法；每个来源在每种角色中各出现一次，使加性来源质量效应在等权聚合对比中相互抵消。跨五个基础模型、每个设计三个训练种子进行评测。
AI.result: 在所有40个种子汇总的"模型—目标"对比中，SA均优于ST。设计一中模型级优势为8.2至16.2个百分点（均值10.8），设计二为12.0至16.0个百分点（均值14.3）；十个模型级95%置信区间均不含零。两个设计中，ST来源在嵌入与词汇相似度指标上都更接近目标，说明SA优势与语句层面相似度的测量排序相反。
AI.conclusion: 在所评测的主题—方法组合范围内，推理方法比主题是更有效的数学迁移匹配准则。相似度更高的ST来源反而迁移更差，提示基于表层相似度的数据选择可能具有误导性。

title: Predictive Credit: Measuring What Scientific Explanations Add to Experimental Forecasts
summary: Research agents explain planned experiments. We measure predictive credit with paired forecasts sharing an intervention, forecaster, and outcome while varying description, matched explanation, and donor context. Five checks track commitment, delivery, predictive gain, alignment, and known-signal uptake. Across 336 prospective states in controlled learning, 12 Tox21 endpoints, and 24 OpenML tasks, v5's frozen credit decision was inconclusive. Tox21's preregistered ROC AUC interval-score harm test was unmet ($D-M=-.0026$, 95 percent interval [$-.0174$, .0104]); OpenML's joint formation, point-equivalence, and repeatability rule was unmet. Matched point-accuracy gains over description remained unconfirmed, and Tox21/OpenML seed-donor intervals spanned zero. Under requested DeepSeek V4 Pro, matched and donor cards reduced secondary Tox21 drift by 64.5 and 59.1 percent. A DeepSeek V4 Flash replay raised matched point MAE from .01823 to .02020 and missed matched-donor interval-score equivalence. OpenML full-card assignment widened nominal 80 percent intervals by 21 percent, with 49.3 percent coverage versus 51.4 percent for description and content in 66/144 cards. Direct-text Flash delivered all 144 notes without detectable matched point-accuracy gain. A researcher-authored mechanism positive control lowered point MAE by 2.60 percentage points versus description. The protocol measures predictive credit for research-agent benchmarks and scientific forecasting; natural-explanation credit remained unconfirmed at the tested donor resolutions.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种测量“预测性信用”的协议：通过配对预测（共享干预、预测者与结果，仅变化描述、匹配解释与捐赠者上下文）并设置五项检查（承诺、交付、预测增益、对齐、已知信号采纳），在336个前瞻状态、12个Tox21端点与24个OpenML任务上评估研究智能体的预测信用，结果显示v5的冻结信用判定为不确定，自然解释的信用在测试的分辨率下未获确认。
AI.motivation: 研究型智能体会解释其计划实验，但其解释是否真正承载可验证的预测信用尚不清楚。作者希望建立一套可复现的协议，将“解释质量”与“预测增益”解耦衡量，从而为研究智能体基准与科学预测提供信用归属的测量工具。
AI.method: 采用配对预测设计：同一干预、预测者与结果，分别改变描述、匹配解释和捐赠者上下文，以隔离解释带来的预测贡献。设置五项检查：承诺、交付、预测增益、对齐与已知信号采纳。评估覆盖336个前瞻状态（受控学习）、12个Tox21端点与24个OpenML任务。Tox21使用预注册的ROC AUC区间评分伤害检验，OpenML使用联合形成、点等价与可重复性规则；并采用DeepSeek V4 Pro/Flash回放与研究员撰写的机制阳性对照。
AI.result: v5冻结信用决策为不确定。Tox21预注册ROC AUC区间评分伤害检验未达标（D-M=-.0026，95%区间[-.0174, .0104]）；OpenML联合形成、点等价与可重复性规则未达标。匹配点准确率相对描述的增益未获确认，Tox21/OpenML种子-捐赠者区间跨越零。在DeepSeek V4 Pro下，匹配卡与捐赠者卡分别将次要Tox21漂移降低64.5%和59.1%；DeepSeek V4 Flash回放使匹配点MAE从.01823升至.02020，未通过匹配-捐赠者区间评分等价。OpenML全卡分配使名义80%区间加宽21%，覆盖率49.3%（描述与内容为51.4%，66/144卡）。纯文本Flash交付全部144条记录但无可检测的匹配点准确率增益。研究员撰写的机制阳性对照使点MAE相对描述降低2.60个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 该协议可用于测量研究智能体基准与科学预测中的预测性信用；但在所测试的捐赠者分辨率下，自然解释的信用仍未获确认。阳性对照有效表明协议具备检测真实机制增益的敏感性，而自然解释未达标提示其信用声明的稳健性不足。

title: When Harnesses Lose the Signal: Causal Evaluation of Recovery in LLM Agents
summary: Large language model agents rely on external harnesses to pass information between the model and its environment and to recover from execution errors. Yet recovery is usually judged only by average task success. This hides an important tension. The same operation can rescue a failing trajectory or disrupt one that would otherwise succeed. We frame recovery as a causal decision problem. Starting from the same execution state, we compare what happens with and without recovery, separate rescue from harm, and study how the value of recovery changes over time. We then introduce the Causal Intervention Router (CIR), a lightweight policy that uses information available before recovery to decide when intervention is worthwhile. On long-horizon ALFWorld tasks with Qwen3-14B, CIR raises success from 70.33% to 73.33%, a gain of 3.00 percentage points. It leaves all evaluated trajectories with correct observations untouched. Additional controls show that the benefit of recovery cannot be explained solely by the new observation returned by the environment. These results provide a practical way to evaluate recovery and apply it selectively.

AI.tldr: 该论文将大模型智能体的"恢复"机制建模为因果决策问题，提出轻量策略CIR，在ALFWorld任务上以Qwen3-14B将成功率从70.33%提升至73.33%。
AI.motivation: 现有对恢复机制的评价只关注平均任务成功率的提升，忽视了恢复的双面性：同一恢复操作既能挽救本会失败的轨迹，也可能破坏本会成功的轨迹。因此需要从因果角度区分"救援"与"损害"。
AI.method: 将恢复形式化为因果决策问题：从相同执行状态出发，对比"有恢复"与"无恢复"的结果，分离救援与损害效应，并研究恢复价值随时间的演变。据此提出Causal Intervention Router（CIR）——一种轻量策略，仅利用恢复前可获得的信息来判断是否值得干预。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-14B的长时程ALFWorld任务上，CIR将成功率从70.33%提升至73.33%，提升3.00个百分点；对观测正确的所有轨迹保持不动（不干扰原本成功的轨迹）。额外对照实验表明，恢复带来的收益不能仅由环境返回的新观测解释。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一种评估恢复效果并选择性应用恢复的实用方法，兼顾挽救失败与避免损害。

title: JusticeAxis: Benchmarking Legal Judgment between Rigid Rule Application and Ungrounded Discretion
summary: A sound judgment applies the law to established facts and weighs the circumstances in which they arose. However, existing methods swing between rigid statute matching and ungrounded discretion, benchmarks score a label or a rubric, and the experience that would supply the balance stays unverified. We formalize legal judgment as a reference-anchored task, whose object is a single decision that stays tied to the statute and to the circumstances at once. We introduce JusticeAxis, 256 real-world criminal cases from 18 countries with audio, image, and text evidence, and three lawyer-written judgments for every case: the recorded one and one for each failure. We further propose JusticeAgent, a harness whose element agents establish the facts and whose judge agent applies the law under skills carrying experience of the circumstances. Skills are distilled from execution trajectories and admitted only under Bayesian credible bounds. Experiments show that failure turns direction with scale: open-weight backbones drift to unsupported grounds, frontier models to the statutory default. We further verify that JusticeAgent, as a simple yet effective plugin, carries a frozen open-weight backbone to commercial level. Project resources are available at https://github.com/beita6969/JusticeAxis.

AI.tldr: 该论文将法律判决形式化为"参照锚定"任务，提出JusticeAxis基准（18国256个真实刑事案件，含音视频文本证据及三份律师判决）和JusticeAgent框架（要素智能体确立事实、法官智能体依经验技能适用法律），揭示失败方向随模型规模反转，并使冻结开源模型达到商业水平。
AI.motivation: 现有法律判决方法在僵化的法条匹配与缺乏依据的自由裁量之间摇摆，基准仅评估单一标签或评分表，而提供平衡判断所需的经验未被验证，因此需要将法律判决作为参照锚定任务加以形式化。
AI.method: 提出JusticeAxis基准与JusticeAgent框架。JusticeAxis包含来自18个国家的256个真实刑事案件，提供音频、图像和文本证据，每案配三份律师撰写的判决（一份为实际记录，另两份对应两种失败情形）。JusticeAgent为一种harness，其要素智能体确立事实，法官智能体在携带情境经验的技能下适用法律；技能从执行轨迹中蒸馏，仅在贝叶斯可信界条件下被采纳。
AI.result: 实验表明失败方向随规模反转：开源骨干模型漂移至无依据理由，前沿模型则漂移至法定默认值。JusticeAgent作为简单而有效的插件，可将冻结的开源骨干模型提升至商业水平。
AI.conclusion: 法律判决应被建模为同时锚定法条与情境的参照锚定任务；经验技能可作为可验证插件弥补开源模型与商业模型之间的差距。

title: JevSpawn: Adaptive Agentic Inference through Compositional Action Spaces
summary: LLM agents generate intermediate reasoning and actions token by token, making extended interactions slow and computationally expensive. Jev-style models offer fast probabilistic predictions over finite fields, but require those fields to be specified in advance. This requirement limits autonomous task solving, where the available actions must be derived from natural language instructions and adapted through interaction. We introduce JevSpawn, a compositional policy that connects natural language task specifications to finite probabilistic exploration. Parallel action spawning is coupled with feedback driven branch selection, representation revision, and recovery from retained alternatives. Shared action structure and model prefixes reduce repeated generation and context computation without additional training. Evaluations on eight benchmark tasks against seven agent baselines and a TypeSafe Jev variant establish JevSpawn as a promising approach to structured agentic inference, with improved task performance and faster navigation.

AI.tldr: 提出 JevSpawn，一种将自然语言任务指令与有限域概率探索相连接的组合式策略，通过并行动作生成、反馈驱动的分支选择与表示修正，实现无需额外训练的高效结构化智能体推理。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体逐 token 生成推理与动作，导致长程交互缓慢且计算昂贵。Jev 风格模型虽能在有限域上提供快速概率预测，但要求预先指定有限域，难以支持需从自然语言指令推导动作、并通过交互调整的自主任务求解。
AI.method: JevSpawn 是一种组合式策略：将自然语言任务描述映射到有限概率探索空间；采用并行动作生成（parallel action spawning），并结合反馈驱动的分支选择、表示修正以及从保留备选中恢复的机制；通过共享动作结构与模型前缀，减少重复生成与上下文计算，无需额外训练。
AI.result: 在八个基准任务上，与七个智能体基线及一个 TypeSafe Jev 变体对比，JevSpawn 在任务性能上有所提升，并实现更快的导航，展现出作为结构化智能体推理方法的潜力。
AI.conclusion: JevSpawn 有效弥合了自然语言任务规范与有限概率探索之间的鸿沟，在无需额外训练的情况下提升了任务表现与推理效率，为结构化智能体推理提供了有前景的方向。

title: Benchmarking Prompt Optimization of Large Language Models With Chess
summary: Evaluating large language models becomes increasingly challenging as their capabilities advance: benchmarks can saturate, public test sets risk contamination, and assessing harder tasks can require expensive grading or execution infrastructure. These challenges are amplified in automatic prompt optimization (APO), where evaluation is repeated throughout the search for better prompts. Studying APO therefore requires a benchmark that is cheap and deterministic to score, hard enough to leave room for improvement, and renewable as models evolve. We introduce a chess benchmark built from 1,118 Lichess puzzles to study APO for frozen LLMs: we optimize their prompts without updating their model weights. Chess combines inexpensive exact-match scoring, engine-based evaluation of alternative moves, and a renewable supply of problems with adjustable difficulty. Unlike evaluations that report only success on isolated test items, the benchmark also connects puzzle-solving gains to short game-play rollouts within the same domain. We use it to evaluate six APO algorithms on eight target models, measuring not only baseline strength but also how much each model responds to optimization and whether optimized prompts transfer across models and to game play. Chess is thus a well-suited benchmark for APO: it is (i) challenging, as even the strongest evaluated model, Gemini 3.5 Flash (used as the meta-model), solves only about 55\% of puzzles; (ii) discriminative, revealing gains, unchanged performance, and regressions across methods and models; (iii) renewable, with fresh puzzles to reduce contamination risk and adjustable difficulty to maintain headroom as models improve; and (iv) affordable, as the complete study runs for around \$800. We release the puzzles, optimization and evaluation code, and dataset-renewal scripts (https://github.com/imec-ailabs/Automatic-Prompt-Optimization-with-Chess).

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于1,118道Lichess国际象棋谜题的基准，用于研究冻结大语言模型的自动提示优化（APO），兼顾低成本精确评分、可再生题目与同域对局迁移评估。
AI.motivation: 大模型能力提升使评测日益困难：基准饱和、公开测试集存在污染风险、难题评测需昂贵评分或执行设施；这些问题在APO中因需反复评测而被放大。因此需要一种评分廉价且确定、难度足够留有余量、并随模型演进而可再生的基准。
AI.method: 构建含1,118道Lichess谜题的国际象棋基准，对冻结LLM仅优化提示词而不更新权重。利用精确匹配评分与引擎对替代走法的评估，并配可调难度、可再生的题目来源。在同一领域内将解题收益与短对局rollout关联。基于该基准在8个目标模型上评测6种APO算法，衡量基线强度、模型对优化的响应程度，以及优化提示词跨模型与向对局的迁移性。
AI.result: 最强评测模型Gemini 3.5 Flash（用作meta-model）仅解出约55%谜题；不同方法与模型间呈现增益、无变化与性能回退三种情况；完整研究成本约800美元。
AI.conclusion: 该象棋基准适合APO研究：具备挑战性、区分度、可再生性与低成本优势。作者开源谜题、优化与评测代码及数据集更新脚本。

title: Before Agents Decide: Epistemic Action in LLM-Based Systems
comment: Accepted at the Foundations of Agentic Systems Theory (FAST) Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Before a difficult decision, people often act simply to understand the situation better. We turn an object to see another side, place alternatives next to each other, or change one condition and observe what happens. These actions may not complete the task, but they improve the evidence needed for the next choice. LLM-based agents can search and explore, yet agent design gives less attention to an earlier question: is the available evidence ready for the decision? Sometimes necessary evidence is missing. In other cases, the evidence is present but its form hides what matters, or the comparison needed to judge it does not yet exist. Cognitive science calls actions that improve the basis for a later choice epistemic actions. We bring this idea to LLM-based agents and distinguish three modes: acquiring missing evidence, transforming available evidence, and probing a system to create a revealing response. We use the term epistemic scaffolding for the interfaces, tools, and environments that make these actions possible and auditable. This paper argues that agent design must address how decision-ready evidence is produced.

AI.tldr: 本文主张LLM智能体设计应关注"决策证据就绪"问题，从认知科学引入认知行动概念，区分获取缺失证据、转化已有证据、探测系统生成揭示性响应三种模式，并用"认知脚手架"指称支撑这些行动的界面、工具与环境。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体研究侧重搜索与探索能力，却较少关注更前置的问题：当前可得证据是否已足以支撑决策。证据可能缺失、形式遮蔽关键信息、或缺乏必要比较，因此智能体设计需转向"决策就绪证据如何产生"。
AI.method: 概念性论证与框架构建（非实证研究）。借用认知科学中"认知行动"（epistemic actions）概念，将其引入LLM智能体，提出三种模式：获取缺失证据、转化已有证据、探测系统以产生揭示性响应；并以"认知脚手架"（epistemic scaffolding）概括实现这些行动的界面、工具与环境的可审计性。
AI.result: 本文属立场/观点论文，未报告实验数据，其产出是概念区分与术语框架：三类认知行动模式及"认知脚手架"的分析单元。
AI.conclusion: 智能体设计必须明确处理"决策就绪证据如何被生产"这一问题，将认知行动与认知脚手架纳入设计核心，而非仅关注搜索与探索。

title: What Should an Agent Remember? Disentangling Retention from Retrieval in Bounded-Memory Evaluation
comment: Code available in the accompanying repository
summary: A persistent agent must decide both what to retain as information arrives and what to surface once a query appears, yet memory evaluations can confound these decisions by comparing methods that differ in both retention and selection. We build a streaming-recall benchmark crossing retention and selection rules and evaluate every condition on the same 300 seeded episodes. Holding access fixed, query-aware selection improves required-fact recall by 15.5 percentage points (95% CI: 12.8 to 18.2), whereas a mixed comparison that also changes history access reports a 68.7-point advantage, of which 53.2 points are attributable to access. Under bounded retention, query-aware, dense, and oracle selection reach the retention ceiling, and all 319 observed failures in the bounded recency condition are caused by eviction rather than ranking errors. Recall falls to 0% as targets recede sufficiently far into the past. Repeating the evaluation on SQuAD preserves the retention ceiling while showing that dense retrieval can outperform lexical retrieval on natural text. These results show that bounded-memory evaluations should hold access fixed and report retention and selection separately.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了一个流式召回基准，将记忆的"保留"与"选择"两个决策解耦，在相同300个种子情节上交叉评估，证明混淆两者的比较会严重高估选择策略的收益，并主张有界记忆评测应固定访问方式并分别报告保留与选择指标。
AI.motivation: 持续型智能体在信息到达时需决定保留什么、在查询出现时需决定呈现什么，但既有记忆评测常把保留与选择混在一起比较，使方法差异无法归因。作者希望厘清"访问(access)"、"保有(retention)"与"选择(selection)"对召回表现的独立贡献，避免评测结论失真。
AI.method: 构建流式召回(streaming-recall)基准，交叉保留规则与选择规则；所有条件在相同的300个带种子的情节(episode)上评估。对比两类情形：一是固定访问方式、只改变查询感知的选择；二是同时改变历史访问的混合比较，并进行收益归因分解。进一步在有界保留下比较查询感知、稠密与oracle选择，分析失败成因（驱逐 vs 排序），考察目标越久远时的召回衰减，并在SQuAD上重复实验以验证自然文本上的泛化。
AI.result: 固定访问下，查询感知选择把必需事实召回提升15.5个百分点(95% CI: 12.8–18.2)；而同时改变历史访问的混合比较报告68.7个百分点的优势，其中53.2个百分点可归因于访问本身。有界保留下，查询感知、稠密与oracle选择均达到保留上限(retention ceiling)；有界近因(recency)条件下全部319个观测失败均由驱逐而非排序错误导致。当目标回退到足够久远时召回降至0%。在SQuAD上保留上限依然成立，且稠密检索在自然文本上可优于词法检索。
AI.conclusion: 记忆评测中的"收益"很大程度来自访问设置的差异，而非选择策略本身。因此有界记忆评测应固定访问方式，并分别报告保留与选择两方面的表现，才能得到可归因、可比较的结论。

title: Ontology-Based Contextual AI Evaluations (OB-CAIE) Methodology
summary: The ontology-based contextual AI evaluation (OB-CAIE) methodology was developed to address a lack of scientific rigor that arises from unclear testing coverage, to balance human expertise and automations, and to address a lack of reproducibility of AI evaluation testing environments. OB-CAIE strengthens the current state of AI evaluations by addressing the first step in the scientific method by clearly defining what will be tested. Two ontologies represent the tractable problem space in the OB-CAIE methodology: the Domain-Specific Ontology (DSO) and the Evaluation Process Ontology (EPO). The DSO is the what; the EPO is the how. An OB-CAIE problem space can be used for one or multiple AI evaluations. The OB-CAIE methodology allows for human judgment at specific points, in scientifically grounded ways, and in complex subject areas where human feedback is genuinely irreducible or machine irreplaceable. A key advantage of the OB-CAIE methodology is that failure points can be traced, visualized and analyzed within the canonical OB-CAIE methodology problem space.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于本体的情境化人工智能评估方法（OB-CAIE），通过领域特定本体与评估过程本体界定可测试问题空间，提升AI评估的科学严谨性、人机平衡与可复现性。
AI.motivation: 当前AI评估存在测试覆盖不清导致的科学严谨性不足、人类专家知识与自动化之间失衡、以及评估测试环境缺乏可复现性等问题。
AI.method: OB-CAIE方法以两个本体刻画可处理问题空间：领域特定本体（DSO）界定"评估什么"，评估过程本体（EPO）界定"如何评估"；单一问题空间可支持一次或多次AI评估，并在特定节点以科学化方式引入人类判断。
AI.result: 该方法明确了科学方法的第一步——清晰界定测试对象，从而加强现有AI评估；其关键优势在于失败点可在规范化的问题空间内被追踪、可视化与分析。
AI.conclusion: OB-CAIE通过在科学框架内明确定义测试范围并合理配置人机分工，提升了AI评估的严谨性与可复现性，尤其适用于人类反馈不可约减或机器不可替代的复杂领域。

title: Science or Slop?: Benchmarking and Mitigating Scientific Slop in AI-Generated Papers
summary: AI-generated content, often called AI slop, is increasingly common everywhere, particularly in academia. Slop in AI-generated scientific papers, however, has more complex patterns that cannot be easily detected by existing token-based AI detectors. Each part of such a paper looks plausible while the scientific reasoning that connects the parts breaks down, which can mislead how readers assess the work. We benchmark these failures as scientific slop through six measures across Structure, Argument, and Artifacts. We construct SciSlopBench with 390 AI-generated papers, mostly in computer science but spanning the life, social, and natural sciences, each paired with a human-written paper matched by research problem and contribution type. Our measures identify the AI paper in each pair with 85.9% accuracy, compared with 68.7% for Binoculars. Higher scientific slop accompanies lower ICLR ratings and distinguishes rejected from accepted papers above chance in every year from 2017 to 2025. Reducing these patterns, however, is not as simple as directly optimizing the measures. We therefore propose SciSlopHarness, a harness-level framework that guides a fixed LLM to revise slop only where the experiment records support the change. While standard revisions leave residual slop and direct slop-aware prompting triggers reward hacking, SciSlopHarness reduces the remaining AI-human gap by 63% over the strongest revision baseline without requiring human reference targets. Overall, we demonstrate that AI-generated scientific papers leave fundamental traces in their global reasoning, and that responsible mitigation demands strict evidentiary grounding rather than mere prose refinement.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"科学slop"概念与六项度量（Structure/Argument/Artifacts），构建390篇AI论文的SciSlopBench基准，配对同题同贡献类型的人类论文，识别准确率85.9%（优于Binoculars的68.7%）；并提出SciSlopHarness框架，在证据约束下修订slop，将AI-人类差距缩小63%。
AI.motivation: AI生成内容（AI slop）在学术界日益普遍，但AI生成科学论文的缺陷模式更复杂，基于token的检测器难以识别：各局部看似合理，而连接各部分的科学推理链条断裂，误导读者对工作的评估。因此需要一个面向"全局科学推理"的评测与缓解框架。
AI.method: 1) 将此类失败定义为"科学slop"，从Structure、Argument、Artifacts三个维度设计六项度量；2) 构建SciSlopBench：390篇AI生成论文（以计算机科学为主，涵盖生命、社会与自然科学），每篇配一篇研究问题与贡献类型匹配的人类论文；3) 提出SciSlopHarness——一种harness-level框架，引导固定LLM仅在实验记录支持之处进行修订，避免直接优化度量带来的reward hacking。
AI.result: 六项度量在配对识别AI论文上达85.9%准确率，高于Binoculars的68.7%；科学slop越高，ICLR评分越低，且在2017–2025每一年均能以高于随机的水平区分被拒与接收论文。标准修订残留slop，直接slop感知提示会触发reward hacking；SciSlopHarness在无人类参考目标下，将剩余AI-人类差距较最强修订基线缩小63%。
AI.conclusion: AI生成科学论文在全局推理层面留下根本性痕迹；负责任的缓解需要严格的证据接地（evidentiary grounding），而非仅做文字润色。

title: Incident-Arena: Getting agents to the last nine of reliability
summary: AI coding agents are ubiquitous in engineering workflows amongst industry and academia. Yet, despite their use in app coding, relatively less attention has been paid to their ability to execute on production incident response. This emerging field, termed agentic site-reliability-engineering (SRE) contains benchmarks limited by (1) unrealistic environments, typically toy repositories (2) non-standard framework implementations and (3) simple static verifiers. We introduce Incident-Arena, a human-built benchmark of 20 carefully selected tasks grounded in real-world deployed open source software. Each task deploys a production application to an ephemeral Kubernetes cluster, injecting a fault from the config layer through underlying images, and a sustained load profile given the task requirements. We also present a novel verification method, going beyond static checks to functional verifiers, holding systems level metrics stable, while ensuring repairs are done safely. Agent trials run an average of 2.81M tokens and 41 turns, going beyond existing benchmarks, demonstrating agentic long horizon reasoning. Across 20 tasks and 3 application substrates, frontier models score below 64.3%, with failures extending from diagnosis/localization errors, through incomplete repairs and unsafe regressions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Incident-Arena，一个基于真实开源软件的生产事故响应基准，包含 20 个在临时 Kubernetes 集群中部署、含配置层故障注入与持续负载的任务，并引入功能性验证器替代静态检查，用于评估 AI 编码智能体的长程 agentic SRE 能力。
AI.motivation: AI 编码智能体已广泛用于工程流程，但其在生产事故响应（agentic SRE）中的能力关注不足。现有基准存在三大局限：环境不真实（多为玩具仓库）、框架实现非标准化、验证器仅为简单静态检查，无法反映真实生产事故响应的难度与复杂度。
AI.method: 构建 Incident-Arena：人工设计的 20 个任务，均基于真实部署的开源软件；每个任务将生产应用部署到临时 Kubernetes 集群，从配置层穿透底层镜像注入故障，并按任务需求施加持续负载曲线。同时提出新型验证方法：由静态检查升级为功能性验证器，在保持系统级指标稳定的前提下确认修复是否安全有效。
AI.result: 智能体试验平均消耗 2.81M tokens、41 轮交互，显著超过现有基准，体现出长程推理特征。在 20 个任务、3 种应用底座上，前沿模型得分均低于 64.3%；失败类型涵盖诊断/定位错误、修复不完整以及不安全回归。
AI.conclusion: Incident-Arena 通过真实环境、标准化部署与功能性验证提升了 agentic SRE 评测的真实性与难度，表明当前前沿模型在生产事故响应上仍存在显著能力缺口；该基准为长程、系统级故障诊断与安全修复研究提供了更严格的评估平台。

title: Worse Together: How Performance Breaks Down in Multi-User Multi-Agent Teams
comment: 63 pages, 22 Figures, 10 Tables, Code: https://github.com/safety-research/MAMUBench (will be released after review)
summary: People are increasingly delegating tasks to AI agents, and those agents are increasingly encountering other people's agents over shared resources such as a codebase, a calendar, or a budget. When each agent acts for a different user with different goals, coordination often fails, and the group ends up worse off than if a single agent had acted for everyone. We study this multi-user, multi-agent setting across five frontier models and 77 scenarios in four environments: an API key environment in which agents share a compute budget, a clinic in which they share a calendar, a personal assistant environment in which they share a group order or booking, and a merge queue in which they share a release cutoff. In each scenario, we compare a single agent that serves every user (a coordinator) to a team in which each agent serves one user, with and without a communication channel between the agents. Teams deliver worse group outcomes than the coordinator in every environment: without a channel, they completely collapse in two environments, and even with one, coordination overhead creates substantial gaps. For example, in the personal assistant environment, the coordinator fulfills a targeted user request about twice as often as teams. We identify distinct behaviors associated with this poor group-level performance, including stalling as teams grow, overriding each other's actions, and fabricating claims. We find effective but environment-specific mitigations, such as a team lead, explicit procedural instructions, and a platform check that makes an agent read its peers' messages before committing. We will release the API key, clinic, and personal assistant environments as MAMUBench, comprising 74 scenarios for evaluating multi-user, multi-agent coordination.

AI.tldr: 论文研究多用户、多智能体（multi-user, multi-agent）场景下的协调失败问题：在4类环境、77个场景、5个前沿模型上，团队智能体（每个智能体服务一个用户）的群体表现普遍劣于单一协调者（coordinator），即使加入通信信道也存在显著差距，并分析了失败行为与针对性缓解措施。
AI.motivation: 随着人们越来越多地将任务委托给AI智能体，不同用户、目标各异的智能体在共享资源（如代码库、日历、预算）上频繁交互，协调常失败，导致群体收益低于由单一智能体统一服务的收益。作者希望系统性地量化并理解这种多用户多智能体协调问题。
AI.method: 构建跨4种环境（API key计算预算、诊所共享日历、个人助理共享团购/预订、合并队列共享发布截止）共77个场景的评测；在5个前沿模型上对比两类配置——服务所有用户的单一协调者 vs. 每个智能体服务一个用户的团队（有/无通信信道）；并通过行为分析识别失败模式与缓解措施。
AI.result: 在每种环境中团队群体表现均劣于协调者：无信道时在两种环境中彻底崩溃，即便有信道也因协调开销产生显著差距；例如个人助理环境中协调者满足目标用户请求的频率约为团队的两倍；观察到的失败行为包括随团队规模增大而停滞（stalling）、相互覆盖对方操作、以及编造声明（fabricating claims）。
AI.conclusion: 团队式多智能体协调在群体层面系统性劣于集中式协调者，且失败源于可识别的行为模式。作者发现有效但依赖具体环境的缓解措施，如设置团队负责人（team lead）、明确流程指令、以及平台强制智能体提交前阅读同伴消息的检查机制。将开源API key、诊所与个人助理环境为MAMUBench，包含74个场景用于评测多用户多智能体协调。

title: CompMat-Bench: Benchmarking AI Agents for Computational Materials Science
summary: Evaluating AI agents on scientific research tasks is constrained by the time and resources required for the underlying experiments or calculations. In computational materials research, repeating the same expensive simulations across agents and trials can make evaluation impractical. We introduce CompMat-Bench, a benchmark of 94 tasks derived from recently published computational materials studies, each asking agents to complete a step toward achieving the study's scientific goal. We reproduce the research steps in advance and assess agents on preparing inputs and analyzing outputs for expensive simulations, so expensive simulations can be avoided during evaluation. The reproduced inputs and results serve as ground truth for grading agents with fixed rules, without an LLM judge. The benchmark supports four evaluation conditions: single tasks and workflows composed of related tasks, each with full or reduced methodological guidance. With full guidance on single tasks, agents based on three LLMs demonstrate the ability to complete individual materials research steps, with pass rates of 66.0-90.4% across 94 tasks. Both longer workflows and reduced guidance can limit agent performance, but in different ways for different agents: they lower the pass rates of the weaker agents, whereas the strongest agent falls only when a long workflow is combined with reduced guidance. Failure analysis attributes most failures to scientific errors rather than to errors in software usage. CompMat-Bench provides a basis for comparing agents on the steps of real materials research and for analyzing agent failure modes.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 CompMat-Bench，一个包含 94 个来自近期计算材料研究任务、预先复现输入与结果作为基准真值、无需 LLM 评判的基准，用于在避免昂贵模拟的前提下评估 AI 智能体。
AI.motivation: 在科学研究任务上评估 AI 智能体受限于实验或计算所需的时间和资源。在计算材料研究中，跨智能体、跨试验重复执行昂贵模拟使评估不切实际。需要一种无需重复昂贵模拟、又能反映真实研究步骤的评估方式，并支持对智能体失败模式的系统分析。
AI.method: 构建 CompMat-Bench：从近期发表的计算材料研究中抽取 94 个任务，每个任务要求智能体完成通向该研究科学目标的一步；提前复现研究步骤，让智能体准备昂贵模拟的输入并分析输出，从而在评估时避开昂贵模拟；以复现的输入与结果作为真值，采用固定规则评分，不使用 LLM 评判。基准支持四种评估条件：单任务与由相关任务组成的工作流，各自配以完整或缩减的方法学指导。
AI.result: 在单任务且提供完整指导的条件下，基于三种 LLM 的智能体表现出完成单个材料研究步骤的能力，94 个任务的通过率为 66.0%–90.4%。更长的工作流与缩减的指导都会限制智能体表现，但对不同智能体方式不同：二者会降低较弱智能体的通过率，而最强的智能体仅在工作流较长且指导缩减同时出现时才下降。失败分析将多数失败归因于科学错误，而非软件使用错误。
AI.conclusion: CompMat-Bench 为在真实材料研究步骤上比较智能体、并分析其失败模式提供了基础，同时通过预复现与固定规则评分规避了昂贵模拟带来的评估成本与不可行性。

title: Agent Evaluation Reliability: More Tasks Won't (Always) Fix An Agent Leaderboard
summary: Agent evaluations are increasingly used to compare LLMs and inform deployment decisions, yet ranks can reflect not only the model but also the effects of the evaluation conditions such as the scaffolds or tasks. This makes reliability claim-dependent: an evaluation that reliably ranks deployed systems may not reliably rank underlying models. We ask which conclusions current agent evaluations reliably support and what additional evaluation would improve them. We develop a Bayesian variance-decomposition framework for sparse, imbalanced agent leaderboards and apply it to 22 benchmarks from the Holistic Agent Leaderboard and Harbor Index. The framework separates signal, performance differences relevant to the intended claim, from noise, irrelevant variation that can still change rankings. We find: (1) Reliability depends on the measurement goal. Fixed model-scaffold systems are ranked reliably (0.935-0.994), while underlying-model reliability is substantially lower (0.148-0.841). (2) Scaffold choice can change conclusions. Inter-scaffold reliability measures whether scaffolds preserve model rankings, showing that scaffold effects vary substantially across evaluations. (3) More tasks cannot resolve all uncertainty. Even infinitely many similarly constructed tasks improve model-ranking reliability of a benchmark by at most 0.097 when uncertainty is dominated by limited scaffold coverage. (4) Pooling diverse benchmarks can improve cross-task rankings at lower cost. For rankings across diverse agentic tasks, pooling benchmarks raises projected reliability from 0.44 to 0.75 at the same task budget and can reduce projected cost by up to 83\%. Evaluation design should follow the intended claim: identify what a score or ranking should mean, diagnose what limits its reliability, and spend evaluation budget on the sources of uncertainty that matter.

AI.tldr: 本文提出贝叶斯方差分解框架，用于分析稀疏不平衡的智能体排行榜，揭示当前智能体评测的可靠性依赖于具体结论类型，并给出改进评测设计的建议。
AI.motivation: 智能体评测被广泛用于比较LLM并指导部署决策，但排名不仅反映模型本身，还受评测条件（如脚手架、任务）影响，因此可靠性是"结论依赖"的——一个能可靠排名部署系统的评测未必能可靠排名底层模型。作者希望厘清当前评测究竟能可靠支持哪些结论，以及需要何种补充评测来改进。
AI.method: 提出贝叶斯方差分解框架，面向稀疏、不平衡的智能体排行榜，将信号（与目标结论相关的性能差异）与噪声（虽无关但仍会改变排名的变异）分离，并应用于Holistic Agent Leaderboard和Harbor Index的22个基准。
AI.result: (1)可靠性取决于测量目标：固定的模型-脚手架系统排名可靠（0.935-0.994），而底层模型可靠性显著较低（0.148-0.841）。(2)脚手架选择会改变结论：跨脚手架可靠性显示脚手架效应在各评测间差异很大。(3)增加任务无法解决所有不确定性：当不确定性主要来自脚手架覆盖有限时，即使无限增加同类任务，基准的模型排名可靠性最多提升0.097。(4)合并多样基准能以更低成本改进跨任务排名：同等任务预算下，合并基准可将跨多样智能体任务的排名可靠性从0.44提升至0.75，并最多降低83%的预估成本。
AI.conclusion: 评测设计应遵循目标结论：明确分数或排名应表达什么含义，诊断限制其可靠性的因素，并将评测预算投入到真正重要的不确定性来源上。

title: When More Data Is Not Enough: The Context-Sufficiency Frontier in Generative AI Personalization
comment: PREPRINT - SUBMITTED TO JOURNAL OF SERVICE RESEARCH (JSR)
summary: Personalization has long relied on customer data to infer what an individual is likely to value. We call this customer evidence: the customer's historical behavior and preferences. Generative AI extends personalization by allowing providers to supply changing situational information at the moment a response is produced, without encoding every condition in advance. We define this provider-side context as information about what is possible, permitted, or advisable now. This flexibility creates a new problem: once context becomes easy to supply, more is not necessarily better. We develop a theory of context sufficiency in which the relevance of context to the customer's current intent matters more than its volume. The theory identifies four states, insufficiency, sufficiency, saturation, and interference, and introduces the Context-Sufficiency Frontier to locate the minimal relevant set. In a full-factorial experiment with a generative recommender at a large home-furnishing retailer, relevant context improved appropriateness, while irrelevant context reduced it and destabilized retrieval. The framework shifts personalization from supplying more context toward identifying what the current interaction actually requires and enforcing constraints throughout the service process.

AI.tldr: 本文将生成式AI引入的"提供方侧情境"与客户历史证据区分开来，提出情境充分性理论及情境充分性前沿，指出情境相关度比数量更重要。通过大型家居零售商生成式推荐系统的全因子实验发现，相关情境提升回复适当性，无关情境降低适当性并扰乱检索，主张个性化应从"提供更多情境"转向"识别当前互动真正需要什么"。
AI.motivation: 传统个性化依赖客户数据（历史行为与偏好）推断客户价值。生成式AI使提供方能在响应生成时即时补充情境信息，无需预先编码所有条件，但由此产生新问题：情境供给变得容易后，数量多并不必然更好，需要新的理论框架来判断情境何时足够。
AI.method: 提出情境充分性理论（theory of context sufficiency），以"情境与客户当前意图的相关性"为核心优于情境数量；划分四种状态：不充分（insufficiency）、充分（sufficiency）、饱和（saturation）、干扰（interference）；引入情境充分性前沿（Context-Sufficiency Frontier）以定位最小相关情境集合。并在某大型家居零售商开展生成式推荐系统全因子实验进行验证。
AI.result: 全因子实验表明，相关情境提升了推荐的适当性（appropriateness），而无关情境降低了适当性并导致检索不稳定（destabilized retrieval）。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将个性化从"提供更多情境"转向"识别当前互动实际所需"，并在整个服务流程中贯彻约束（enforcing constraints）。

title: Backdoor Containment via Expert Quarantine and Shutdown in LLMs
summary: Backdoored large language models (LLMs) can behave normally on benign inputs while producing attacker-specified outputs under hidden triggers. Existing defenses span four stages--prior-training, in-training, post-training, and inference-time--and share one of two underlying strategies: either suppress backdoor learning (by filtering poisoned data or interrupting its acquisition during optimization) or learn, then purify (by repairing model weights or gating inputs after a fully backdoored model has formed). We propose a third strategy, learn, but channel: allow backdoor formation during training but route it into a designated, quarantined component that can be disabled at deployment. To this end, we propose Quarantined Expert Shutdown QES, a computationally efficient containment strategy built in a regularization-steered MoE-like setting. Specifically, given a poisoned dataset, QES augments a Transformer-based language model with routed expert-specific LoRA branches and lightweight routers, and uses auxiliary routing objectives to attract trigger-conditioned behavior into a designated expert while preserving benign capability elsewhere. At deployment, mitigation reduces to a single constant-time operation: zeroing the quarantined expert's routing weight, without trigger screening or further updating model weights. Empirically, our methods reduce the attack success rate ASR from 100% to 0-10% on most settings across two tasks, three attacks, and four model families, while downstream utility is often preserved or only modestly affected. These results establish learn, but channel as a previously unexplored regime for backdoor containment in generative LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"学习但隔离"（learn, but channel）这一后门防御新范式，并实现QES方法：在MoE式架构中用路由目标将触发条件行为引导至指定专家，部署时仅需将该专家路由权重置零即可缓解后门。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM后门防御分为四个阶段（训练前、训练中、训练后、推理时），但底层策略仅两类：抑制后门学习，或先学习后净化。作者认为这两种策略各有局限，因此探索第三种思路——允许后门在训练中形成，但将其引导隔离到可在部署时关闭的独立组件中。
AI.method: QES（Quarantined Expert Shutdown）是一种计算高效的隔离遏制策略，构建于正则化引导的类MoE设定中。具体做法：给定投毒数据集，为Transformer语言模型增加路由化的专家专属LoRA分支和轻量路由器，并引入辅助路由目标，将触发条件行为吸引到指定专家，同时在其他专家中保留良性能力。部署时缓解只需一个常数时间操作——将隔离专家的路由权重置零，无需触发词筛查或更新模型权重。
AI.result: 在两项任务、三种攻击、四个模型族上，大多数设置下攻击成功率（ASR）从100%降至0-10%，同时下游效用通常得以保持或仅受到轻微影响。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果确立了"学习但隔离"作为生成式LLM后门遏制的一个此前未被探索的新范式。

title: A Simple Doxastic Deontic Logic for Norm-Guided Decision Making
comment: Manuscript accepted at PRIMA 2026. Includes an additional appendix with proofs
summary: Making decisions despite conflicting norms and incomplete or unreliable information is a fundamental challenge for autonomous systems. We introduce a simple doxastic deontic logic for this setting: a classically reducible fragment of Chellas' Minimal Deontic Logic, extended with explicit conditional norms and combined with multi-agent KD45, so that norms can depend on agents' beliefs about both facts and norms. On this logic we define the Doxastic Norm Compliance Optimization Problem, where an agent chooses a decision minimizing weighted norm violations. We distinguish subjective optimization (relative to the agent's beliefs) from objective optimization (relative to the actual facts). We give conditions under which (i) the two coincide and (ii) optimal decision-making can be reduced to weighted partial MaxSAT in polynomial time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种道义认知逻辑（doxastic deontic logic），并在此基础上定义"道义认知规范遵从优化问题"，研究主客观优化的一致性条件及多项式时间归约到加权部分MaxSAT的方法。
AI.motivation: 自主系统在规范冲突、信息不完整或不可靠的情况下仍需做出决策，这是一个基本挑战。现有逻辑难以同时刻画"规范依赖于智能体对事实与规范本身的信念"这一特征，也缺乏将规范遵从决策形式化为可计算优化问题的统一框架。
AI.method: 1) 构造一种简单的道义认知逻辑：取Chellas极小道义逻辑（Minimal Deontic Logic）的一个经典可归约片段，扩展以显式条件规范，并与多智能体KD45认知逻辑结合，使规范可依赖于智能体关于事实和规范的信念。2) 在该逻辑上定义"道义认知规范遵从优化问题"（Doxastic Norm Compliance Optimization Problem），即智能体选择使加权规范违反最小化的决策。3) 区分主观优化（相对于智能体信念）与客观优化（相对于实际事实）。
AI.result: 给出两类条件：(i) 主观与客观优化结果一致的条件；(ii) 最优决策可在多项式时间内归约为加权部分MaxSAT的条件。
AI.conclusion: 该逻辑框架为信念不完备且规范冲突下的自主决策提供了统一的逻辑与优化基础，并通过归约到加权部分MaxSAT给出可计算性保证，为规范遵从决策的形式化与求解建立桥梁。

title: R-GroundBench: A Diagnostic Benchmark for R-Group Groundingin Markush Molecular Editing
summary: Recent advances in AI for scientific discovery enable molecular understandingand design, yet reasoning over incomplete chemical representations remainsunclear.Markush structures, which encode molecular families through variable R-groupplaceholders (\textit{R\textsubscript{1}}, \textit{R\textsubscript{2}}, \textit{X}, etc.), are ubiquitous in pharmaceutical patents and requiregrounding across molecular, textual, and chemical information.However, existing molecule-language benchmarks focus on fully specifiedmolecules, leaving R-group grounding largely unevaluated.We introduce R-GroundBench:, a diagnostic benchmark built from real patent Markushstructures, featuring a Multiple-Choice (VQA) track with controlled difficultyand modality splits, and an open-ended Generation track.Our results reveal a substantial gap between recognition andmolecular grounding.While models achieve over 90\% accuracy on Easy VQA, performance drops to56--66\% on Hard VQA when shortcuts are controlled.Chemical-domain VLMs also remain unreliable, achieving only 25.7--46.2\% on HardVQA despite domain-specific pretraining.Moreover, Generation Exact Match remains below 20\% for most models and below8\% when visual input is required.These findings reveal that current AI systems lack reliable grounding andexecution for Markush editing, highlighting challenges for AI-drivenscientific discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 R-GroundBench，一个基于真实专利 Markush 结构的诊断基准，包含受控难度的多选 VQA 轨道与开放式生成轨道，用于评估模型对可变 R 基团的化学基础锚定能力。
AI.motivation: Markush 结构通过 R 基团占位符编码分子族，广泛存在于制药专利中，需要跨分子、文本与化学信息进行 grounding。然而现有分子-语言基准聚焦于完全指定的分子，R 基团 grounding 基本未被评估。
AI.method: 构建 R-GroundBench：取材真实专利 Markush 结构，设计 Multiple-Choice (VQA) 轨道（含受控难度与模态划分）以及开放式 Generation 轨道，以区分识别与分子 grounding 能力。
AI.result: Easy VQA 上模型准确率超 90%，但在控制捷径后 Hard VQA 降至 56–66%；化学领域 VLM 即使在领域预训练下，Hard VQA 也仅 25.7–46.2%。Generation Exact Match 多数模型低于 20%，需要视觉输入时低于 8%。
AI.conclusion: 当前 AI 系统在 Markush 编辑上缺乏可靠的 grounding 与执行能力，识别与分子 grounding 之间存在显著差距，为 AI 驱动的科学发现提出挑战。

title: Backdoor Purification for LoRA-Tuned LLMs via Null-Space Projection
summary: With the rapid adoption of large language models (LLMs) and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods, the risk of backdoor attacks has become more severe. Existing backdoor purification methods typically rely on at least one of the strong assumptions, such as prior knowledge of triggers, access to clean references, or aggressive retraining, and they often lack comprehensive evaluations. These constraints substantially limit their practical applicability. To overcome these challenges, our work proposes purifying LoRA-tuned LLMs without these assumptions and even without post-hoc retraining of the suspect parameters. Our objective is to significantly reduce the attack success rates (ASR) while preserving both (i) the base model's general capabilities and (ii) the new downstream skills learned through the adapter. Through a series of ablation studies, we progressively scale our approach from a single layer in a text classification setting to a full-parameter LLM in the generative task. Through careful data curation and feature approximation, we extract high-fidelity backdoor directions and, for each layer or head, construct orthogonal null spaces in both the input and output channels, onto which the LoRA updates are projected. Empirically, our null-space projection method reduces the ASR from nearly 100% to less than 10%, while preserving the base model's benign performance and the adapter's learned abilities during downstream task adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需触发知识、干净参考或重训练的后门净化方法，通过在输入/输出通道构造正交零空间并投影LoRA更新来移除后门，将ASR从近100%降至10%以下，同时保留基座模型通用能力与适配器下游能力。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM与PEFT（如LoRA）的广泛应用，后门攻击风险加剧；现有后门净化方法普遍依赖触发先验、干净参考数据或激进重训练等强假设，且缺乏全面评估，实际适用性受限。本文旨在打破这些假设约束。
AI.method: 不依赖后门假设且不进行事后重训练。通过数据策划与特征近似提取高保真后门方向，在每层或每个注意力头中于输入、输出通道构造正交零空间，将LoRA更新投影到该零空间上以去除后门。方法从文本分类单层设置逐步扩展到生成任务的全参数LLM。
AI.result: 消融实验验证了方法的可扩展性；实验中将攻击成功率（ASR）从接近100%降至10%以下，同时保持基座模型的良性性能与适配器在下游任务适应中学到的能力。
AI.conclusion: 基于零空间投影的LoRA后门净化方法在无强假设、无重训练条件下有效去除后门，兼顾安全性、基座通用能力与下游适配能力，具有较强实用性与可扩展性。

title: Ontology-Grounded, Reasoner-Verified Benchmarks for Evaluating LLM Reasoning in Scientific AI
comment: 17 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at the AI Data Readiness for Scientific Discovery (AIDaR) Workshop at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026), Paris
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly underpin scientific AI applications that reason over structured knowledge, from biomedical question answering to materials informatics. However, their logical reasoning often falls short, producing factual inaccuracies unacceptable in these settings. Reliable evaluation remains challenging: manual dataset construction scales poorly, and LLM-based generation risks embedding the very flaws it aims to measure. High-quality benchmarks must ground both correct and incorrect labelled examples in explicit background knowledge, formally verifiable by a standard reasoner. We propose a pipeline that automatically generates ontology-grounded multiple-choice question (MCQ) benchmarks from any sufficiently axiomatised OWL 2 ontology, with correct answers grounded in the ontology by design. Distractors are generated by perturbing the right-hand-side class expressions of class definition axioms, and their incorrectness is formally verified by an OWL reasoner via entailment checks. We evaluate the pipeline on three ontologies: Pizza (small, academic), PMDco (complex, materials science), and DOID (large, biomedical), generating 112, 2,491, and 15,216 MCQs respectively. Distractors span four semantic categories from class unsatisfiability to weakened subsumptions, enabling diagnostic evaluation of specific reasoning failures. Items meet natural language quality standards: mean LLM judge scores of 4.02, 4.36, and 3.36 out of 5 confirm fluency, and correct-answer-to-distractor similarity above 0.8 shows that wrong options cannot be dismissed on surface form alone. Six LLMs evaluated zero-shot achieve 41.1-76.8% accuracy, well above the 25% random-guessing baseline, indicating the benchmarks are challenging and discriminative. This work is a step towards more reliable benchmarks for assessing logical reasoning in scientific AI.

AI.tldr: 提出一种从OWL 2本体自动生成多选题基准的流水线，正确答案由本体逻辑蕴含保证，干扰项通过对类定义公理右侧类表达式扰动生成并用OWL推理机形式化验证，在三个本体上验证了基准的挑战性与可区分性。
AI.motivation: LLM在生物医学问答、材料信息学等科学AI应用中依赖结构化知识，但逻辑推理能力不足，常产生不可接受的事实错误。现有评测存在两难：人工构建数据集难以规模化；LLM生成题目又会引入其试图测量的缺陷。因此需要高质量基准，其正确与错误标注样本均须以显式背景知识为基础，并可被标准推理机形式化验证。
AI.method: 提出从任意具备充分公理化的OWL 2本体自动生成多选题基准的流水线。正确答案按设计由本体逻辑蕴含保证；干扰项通过扰动类定义公理右侧的类表达式生成，并借助OWL推理机通过蕴含检查形式化验证其错误性。干扰项覆盖从类不可满足到削弱子类关系等四类语义范畴。
AI.result: 在Pizza（小型学术）、PMDco（复杂材料科学）和DOID（大型生物医学）三个本体上分别生成112、2,491和15,216道多选题。自然语言质量达标：LLM评判平均分分别为4.02、4.36、3.36（满分5）；正确答案与干扰项相似度高于0.8，表明错误选项无法仅凭表层形式排除。六个LLM零样本准确率为41.1%–76.8%，远高于25%的随机基线。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为科学AI中的逻辑推理评估提供了更可靠的基准，所生成基准具有挑战性和可区分性，并支持对特定推理失败进行诊断性评估，是迈向可靠评测的一步。

title: Meta-Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Fast Adaptation of Interactive Policies with Applications to Autonomous Driving
summary: This paper develops a meta-multi-agent reinforcement learning (meta-MARL) framework to enable fast adaptation of interactive policies in a multi-agent system (MAS). Meta-reinforcement learning (meta-RL) enables agents to rapidly adapt to new tasks/environments using a bi-level optimization mechanism. However, existing meta-RL generally focuses on single-agent systems. Extending these frameworks and algorithms to multi-agent systems poses additional challenges, as tasks are characterized by not only the environment but also agents' strategic interactions. To address these challenges, we model multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) problems as Markov games (MGs) and develop a meta-MARL framework for rapid interactive policy adaptation across a distribution of MGs. A new concept, called meta-NE, is defined to describe the desired solution concept in a meta-MARL problem. Sufficient conditions for the equivalence between a meta-NE and a stationary point of the gradient-play-based meta-MARL algorithm are established. Our evaluation on autonomous-driving tasks demonstrates that the proposed meta-MARL method achieves faster adaptation than pretrained MARL baselines, validating the effectiveness of our framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出元多智能体强化学习（meta-MARL）框架，以马尔可夫博弈建模MARL问题，定义meta-NE解概念并建立其与梯度博弈元学习算法驻点间的等价条件，在自动驾驶任务上实现比预训练MARL基线更快的策略自适应。
AI.motivation: 现有元强化学习主要针对单智能体系统，直接扩展到多智能体系统面临额外挑战：任务不仅由环境刻画，还取决于智能体之间的策略交互。因此需要专门的多智能体元学习框架来支持交互策略的快速自适应。
AI.method: 将MARL问题建模为马尔可夫博弈（MGs），据此构建跨MG分布的meta-MARL框架，用于交互策略的快速适应；提出meta-NE（元纳什均衡）概念以刻画meta-MARL问题的期望解；基于梯度博弈（gradient-play）的meta-MARL算法，推导meta-NE与该算法驻点等价的充分条件。
AI.result: 在自动驾驶任务上的评估表明，所提meta-MARL方法相比预训练的MARL基线具有更快的适应速度，验证了框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将元学习从单智能体扩展至多智能体交互场景，通过meta-NE解概念与梯度博弈驻点的等价性为meta-MARL提供理论支撑，并在自动驾驶任务上验证了交互策略快速自适应的可行性。

title: MemFit: Efficient Long-Term Agentic Memory
summary: Long-term memory systems for large language models (LLMs) have gained popularity for extending reasoning capabilities across applications. Current memory systems rely on LLM agents to organize and consolidate memory, resulting in costly, inefficient write operations. To address this limitation, we propose MemFit, a long-term memory system for conversational agents that reduces the cost and latency of memory operations. Unlike existing systems that rely on expensive LLM calls for memory construction or discard surface-level details through compression, MemFit stores each turn verbatim in an append-only store with near-instantaneous, LLM-free insertion, indexing turns with segment summaries rather than replacing them. Additionally, MemFit uses an LLM-free, multi-path retrieval strategy that combines lexical and semantic signals with cross-encoder reranking over caption- augmented episodes in both textual and multimodal settings. Empirical results on three widely used benchmarks, LoCoMo, MemGallery, and LongMemEval-S, show that MemFit achieves state-of-the-art performance while reducing memory construction time and cost several-fold, providing a scalable and efficient solution for persistent agentic memory.
