AI.tldr: MemFit是一种面向对话智能体的长期记忆系统，通过免LLM的追加式存储与多路检索，在降低记忆构建成本与延迟的同时达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM长期记忆系统依赖LLM智能体组织与整合记忆，导致写入操作成本高、效率低。同时，部分系统通过压缩丢弃表层细节，造成信息损失。
AI.method: MemFit将每轮对话逐字存入仅追加（append-only）存储，插入过程无需LLM、近乎即时；用片段摘要（segment summaries）为对话轮建立索引而非替换原文；并采用免LLM的多路检索策略，融合词汇与语义信号，并在文本与多模态场景下对带标题增强的片段（caption-augmented episodes）进行交叉编码器重排序。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo、MemGallery和LongMemEval-S三个广泛使用的基准上，MemFit取得SOTA性能，同时将记忆构建时间与成本降低数倍。
AI.conclusion: MemFit为持久化智能体记忆提供了一种可扩展且高效的解决方案，兼顾性能与效率。

title: An Educator-Guided LLM Pedagogical Agent for Scaffolded Feedback in Conceptual Database Design
summary:
We present an educator-guided LLM pedagogical agent for scaffolded feedback in conceptual database design. Integrated into an entity--relationship diagram (ERD) editor, the system grounds feedback in the student artifact, assignment requirements, educator-authored rubrics, and instructional resources. Its architecture separates hidden, artifact-grounded diagnosis from the workflow that controls the form and disclosure level of student-facing support.
  We instantiate the architecture as a four-stage workflow progressing from concept checks and guided application to low-detail feedback and localized clarification. Each feedback request creates a stateful episode linked to versioned ERD states. In a deployment spanning three ERD environments and 383 feedback episodes, 71.1\% of observed target-level changes fully or partially incorporated the hidden diagnostic target, including many after Stages~1--2. Qualitative analysis showed that staged disclosure sometimes withheld inaccurate details, supported selective uptake, or allowed later recovery, though some errors still shaped revisions. Survey responses from a self-selected sample favored delayed disclosure and student agency but noted indirectness and repetition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种由教育者引导的LLM教学智能体，用于概念数据库设计中的支架式反馈，并在真实部署中验证其效果。
AI.motivation: 概念数据库设计（如ER图绘制）对学生具有挑战性，需要及时反馈；但直接给出完整答案会削弱学习效果，因此需要一种既能提供支持又能促进自主学习的支架式反馈机制。
AI.method: 系统集成于ERD编辑器，基于学生作品、作业要求、教育者编写的量规和教学资源生成反馈。架构将隐藏的、基于作品的诊断与控制学生可见支持形式及披露程度的工作流分离，并实例化为四阶段工作流：概念检查、引导应用、低细节反馈、局部澄清。每次反馈请求生成与版本化ERD状态关联的有状态回合。在三个ERD环境和383个反馈回合的部署中评估。
AI.result: 71.1%的目标层变更完全或部分纳入了隐藏的诊断目标，其中包括许多发生在第1-2阶段之后的情况。定性分析表明，分阶段披露有时能隐藏不准确细节、支持选择性采纳或允许后续补救，但部分错误仍影响了修改。自选样本的问卷偏好延迟披露和学生自主性，但也指出反馈较为间接且重复。
AI.conclusion: 分阶段、隐藏诊断的支架式LLM反馈能有效引导学生采纳诊断目标，同时保留学习自主性，但需改进反馈的间接性和重复性问题。

title: ReLiveGym: Evaluating Long-Lived Agents over Weeks of Replayed Reality
summary: As large language model (LLM) agents become widely adopted, they are increasingly deployed for tasks that require persistent monitoring or recurring actions (e.g., market analysis). These agents are expected to operate unattended for days or weeks, act at the right timing, and adapt to the dynamic environment over time. These challenges are not fully captured in the existing long-horizon agent work, as they often consider a static environment that is not temporally changing. We introduce ReLiveGym, a diagnostic evaluation environment of long-lived tasks in which agents act sparsely over simulated weeks of chronologically replayed real-world news, market, and social-media streams. The tasks span diverse levels of time sensitivity, reasoning intensity, and recurrence. Across eight base language models, we investigate how model choice and harness design affect agent performance on such long-lived tasks. Our results show that how agents determine when to act arises as an important harness-design axis for long-lived tasks; and that the optimal design varies across tasks and sometimes model choices as well. We also evaluate how continuous learning from hindsight feedback affects performance and addresses failure modes observed in these long-lived tasks. These findings indicate model choice, action timing mechanism, and use of feedback as important considerations in the design of long-lived agents. Code: https://github.com/SaharaLabsAI/ReLiveGym

AI.tldr: 提出 ReLiveGym，一个面向"长寿命"LLM 智能体的诊断性评测环境：在按时间顺序重放的数周真实新闻、市场与社交媒体流中，让智能体稀疏行动，并在 8 个基座模型上考察模型选择、harness 设计与反馈学习对性能的影响。
AI.motivation: 现有长时程智能体工作多假设静态环境，无法刻画需要持续监控、反复执行、按正确时机行动并随时间适应动态环境的长寿命任务（如市场分析），因此缺乏相应的评测手段与设计指导。
AI.method: 构建 ReLiveGym 评测环境，将真实世界的新闻、市场与社交媒体流按时间顺序重放，模拟数周时间跨度，任务在时间敏感性、推理强度与重复性上分层；智能体在其中稀疏行动。基于 8 个基座语言模型，系统对比模型选择与 harness（外围框架）设计的影响，并评估基于事后反馈（hindsight feedback）的持续学习效果及对失效模式的缓解。
AI.result: "何时行动"的决策机制成为长寿命任务中重要的 harness 设计维度；最优设计随任务变化，有时也随模型选择变化；持续学习的事后反馈能影响性能并应对观察到的失效模式。
AI.conclusion: 模型选择、行动时机机制与反馈利用是长寿命智能体设计中的关键考量，ReLiveGym 为相关诊断评测提供了可复现平台。

title: Robust Nash Alignment under Preference Uncertainty
comment: 38 pages, accepted at 2026 40th Advances in Neural Information Processing System (NeurIPS)
summary: Preference-based alignment methods typically optimize against a single preference model, and can therefore be brittle when pairwise preferences are uncertain: noisy, heterogeneous, or shift after deployment. To address these issues, we propose Robust Nash Alignment, a game-theoretic framework for alignment to uncertain pairwise preferences. Our formulation has a major learner seeking a policy with a large worst-case win rate against both an adversarial competitor and any preference kernel lying in an ambiguity set around a nominal preference. When the ambiguity set captures the uncertainty in preferences, the resulting robust objective of the game directly yields a certified lower bound on worst-case performance. However, we note this problem is computationally challenging to optimize, and to address this, we introduce a four-player primal-dual proxy game involving the leader policy, follower policy, adversarial kernel, and dual variable, and develop a single-loop optimistic mirror descent-ascent algorithm for it. We show that the proxy always lower-bounds the truncated hard-constrained objective, quantify the proxy-to-hard gap, and characterize an exactness condition under which the proxy recovers the robust objective. We then prove an \(\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{T})\) average-iteration convergence for the proxy-game duality gap, which implies a near-optimal robust policy for the original robust objective. Experiments on controlled tabular games and LLM alignment with uncertain preference further validate the convergence theory and show improved performance over nominal baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Robust Nash Alignment，一个面向不确定成对偏好的博弈论对齐框架，通过对含对抗竞争者与偏好核模糊集的鲁棒目标构建四人原对偶代理博弈，并用单循环乐观镜像下降-上升算法求解，给出收敛性与鲁棒性保证。
AI.motivation: 现有基于偏好的对齐方法通常只针对单一偏好模型优化，当成对偏好存在噪声、异质性或部署后发生偏移等不确定性时表现脆弱。因此需要一种能在不确定偏好下提供最坏情况性能保证的鲁棒对齐方法。
AI.method: 作者将问题建模为博弈：主要学习者在与对抗竞争者及位于名义偏好周围模糊集内的任意偏好核博弈时，追求最大化最坏情况胜率，其鲁棒目标直接给出最坏情况性能的认证下界。由于原问题难以优化，引入包含领导者策略、跟随者策略、对抗核与对偶变量的四人原对偶代理博弈，并提出单循环乐观镜像下降-上升算法求解。
AI.result: 理论上证明代理博弈始终下界截断硬约束目标，量化代理与硬约束之间的差距，并给出代理可精确恢复鲁棒目标的精确性条件；证明代理博弈对偶间隙具有 O(1/√T) 的平均迭代收敛率，从而得到原鲁棒目标的近优鲁棒策略。在受控表格博弈与不确定偏好的 LLM 对齐实验中，验证了收敛理论并优于名义基线。
AI.conclusion: Robust Nash Alignment 为不确定成对偏好下的对齐提供了具有最坏情况性能认证的博弈论框架，并通过高效的四人代理博弈算法实现近优鲁棒策略，实验表明其收敛性与性能均优于仅针对名义偏好的基线方法。

title: Kepler: Auditable World Models for ARC-AGI-3
comment: 17 pages. Accepted to the non-archival Interpreting Agent Behavior workshop at NeurIPS 2026. Project: https://kepler-harness.vercel.app/ . Code and public traces available
summary: ARC-AGI-3 evaluates agents in interactive environments whose rules and objectives must be inferred from observation. We present Kepler, an open-source harness that represents hypotheses as executable world models and validates them through retrospective transition checks and conditional prediction checks. Under one frozen Claude Opus 5 configuration, Kepler obtained a server-verified 100.00 RHAE on all 25 public games, with no per-game model selection or score-conditioned reruns. On 181 of 183 completed levels, the final Opus attempt used no more actions than the corresponding median-human baseline. The retained board runs used 8,256 environment actions, of which 7,292 occurred in scored levels. Retained local provider-session records yield 858.0 million tokens, 97.37% cache reads, and a \$777.72 cost at September 1, 2026 API list-equivalent rates. We also report three evaluation failures: source-code leakage that produced an invalid perfect run, agents reconstructing a removed harness in a control condition, and autonomous repair masking a broken planner. A single-game observation case study showed that animation frames contained task-relevant information absent from settled text grids. Across the final Claude Opus 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol boards, 48 of 50 game-model cells reached 100. These results indicate that public-set score alone has limited discriminative value and motivate first-attempt, cost-conditioned, and verification-aware reporting.

AI.tldr: Kepler 是一个开源测试框架，将假设表示为可执行世界模型，并通过回溯性转移检查与条件预测检查加以验证；在冻结配置下于 ARC-AGI-3 全部 25 个公开游戏上取得服务器核验的 100.00 RHAE，但同时报告了三类评测失效，指出公开集分数本身判别力有限。
AI.motivation: ARC-AGI-3 评测的是规则与目标需从观测中推断的交互式环境，此类任务难以用静态分数衡量能力；同时公开集分数趋于饱和，可能掩盖评测流程中的失效模式，因此需要可验证的评测框架与更具判别力的报告方式。
AI.method: 提出开源测试框架 Kepler：把假设显式表示为可执行的世界模型，通过回溯性转移检查（retrospective transition checks）与条件预测检查（conditional prediction checks）进行验证；在单一冻结的 Claude Opus 5 配置下运行，不做逐游戏模型选择、不做分数条件化重跑；辅以单游戏观测案例研究，并对比最终 Claude Opus 5 与 GPT-5.6 Sol 的完整结果面板。
AI.result: 在全部 25 个公开游戏上取得服务器核验的 100.00 RHAE；183 个完成关卡中有 181 个最终 Opus 尝试所用动作数不超过对应人类中位数基线；保留的棋盘运行共 8,256 次环境动作，其中 7,292 次发生在计分关卡；本地供应商会话记录为 8.58 亿 tokens、97.37% 缓存读取、按 2026-09-01 API 标价折算成本 777.72 美元；报告三类评测失效：源码泄漏导致的无效满分运行、控制条件下智能体重建被移除的框架、自主修复掩盖了损坏的规划器；单游戏案例显示动画帧含有稳定文本网格中缺失的任务相关信息；最终两模型面板共 50 个游戏-模型单元中有 48 个达到 100。
AI.conclusion: 公开集分数单独使用的判别价值有限，评测应转向首次尝试（first-attempt）、成本条件化（cost-conditioned）与验证感知（verification-aware）的报告范式，并披露评测失效情形。

title: OR for AI That Does OR: Routing LLMs up the Escalator inside the OSCAR Framework
summary: Large language models can translate business descriptions into optimization models, but executable code may misrepresent constraints or objectives. A solver can then return an optimal solution to the wrong problem. Even when the solution satisfies the intended operating rules, a better plan may exist. For organizations that repeatedly use optimization modeling, an LLM-based framework should produce accurate formulations at low cost and, ideally, run locally. We study how to verify improvements and allocate attempts across LLMs that differ in price and capability. We develop OSCAR (Optimization modeling by Simulator, Coder, And Reviewer), which uses an offline Simulator certified against labeled decision examples to compare candidates and continues searching beyond feasibility. We model the search for the next certified improvement as sequential decisions under unobserved difficulty: which LLMs to call and when to stop. In a simplified known-prior setting, we give conditions under which cost-ordered escalation is optimal. For general menus, we derive a prior-free competitive guarantee. On five benchmark problems, OSCAR achieves 95% to 100% accuracy at the reported settings using two small open-weight LLMs, each deployable locally on a single GPU. Their single-attempt accuracies average 29% and 48%. In five runs per problem, Codex and Claude Code incur average token costs 3.1 and 5.8 times OSCAR's, respectively. OSCAR supports open-weight models locally or in the cloud, depending on budget and confidentiality requirements. Firms should maintain labeled decision examples of feasible and infeasible decisions to clarify plain-language operating rules. OSCAR follows these labels when an LLM's interpretation conflicts with them. As LLM capabilities and prices change, OSCAR's simple operating rules and adjustable settings help firms adapt their model choices and benefit from these advances.

AI.tldr: 提出OSCAR框架，通过Simulator-Coder-Reviewer三模块并用带标签的决策示例验证优化模型，将LLM调用建模为顺序决策问题以分配尝试预算；在五个基准上用两个小型开源LLM达到95%–100%准确率，成本远低于Codex和Claude Code。
AI.motivation: LLM可将业务描述转为优化模型，但生成的代码可能错误表达约束或目标，导致求解器对错误问题给出最优解；即使解满足既有规则，也可能存在更优方案。对反复使用优化建模的组织而言，需要一个低成本、可本地部署且能验证改进的框架。
AI.method: 提出OSCAR（Optimization modeling by Simulator, Coder, And Reviewer）：用经带标签决策示例认证的离线Simulator比较候选方案，并在可行性之外持续搜索。将寻找下一次认证改进建模为难度不可观测下的顺序决策（调用哪些LLM、何时停止）；已知先验下给出成本递增升级最优的条件；一般菜单下给出无先验的竞争性保证。
AI.result: 在五个基准问题上，OSCAR使用两个可在单GPU本地部署的小型开源LLM，报告设置下准确率达95%–100%；这两个模型单次尝试准确率平均为29%和48%。每个问题五次运行中，Codex和Claude Code的平均token成本分别是OSCAR的3.1倍和5.8倍。
AI.conclusion: OSCAR支持开源模型本地或云端部署，视预算与保密需求而定。企业应维护可行与不可行决策的带标签示例以澄清自然语言规则，OSCAR在LLM解释与标签冲突时遵循标签。随着LLM能力与价格变化，其简单操作规则和可调设置有助于企业调整模型选择并获益。

title: PG-SFT: Balancing Capability Acquisition and Retention in Offline Agent Fine-Tuning
summary: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on offline agent trajectories is the standard approach for training specialized tool-using agents, but forcing models to imitate reasoning and actions token by token may harm other capabilities (e.g., general reasoning, tool calling, code generation) of the base model. In this work, we focus on studying \emph{how to better balance the trade-off between acquiring new capabilities and preserving existing ones during agent trace SFT}. By comparing several baselines in our setup, standard SFT improves the target benchmark while lowering several non-target benchmark scores; meanwhile, simply constraining distributional drift using KL penalty or limiting the update magnitude did not avoid this regression trend. Motivated by recent token-wise adaptive learning objectives, this work proposes \textbf{Privilege-Guided SFT (PG-SFT)} to leverage turn-level information gain of agent trajectories as an indicator to adjust supervision strength. PG-SFT yields a more favorable observed trade-off on the evaluated benchmarks, substantially reducing distributional drift and broad capability degradation at the cost of slight degradation in target-task performance. Our findings suggest that balancing the acquisition--retention trade-off depends not only on whether the model is anchored to its base behavior, but also on where and how strongly supervision should depart from that behavior.}

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Privilege-Guided SFT (PG-SFT)，利用 agent 轨迹的 turn-level 信息增益作为监督强度调节信号，在获得新能力与保留既有能力之间取得更优权衡。
AI.motivation: 在离线 agent 轨迹上做 SFT 是训练专用工具调用 agent 的标准做法，但逐 token 模仿推理与动作会损害基座模型的通用推理、工具调用、代码生成等能力。作者关注的科学问题是：如何在 agent trace SFT 中更好地平衡"获得新能力"与"保留旧能力"这一 trade-off。已有基线（标准 SFT、KL 惩罚约束分布漂移、限制更新幅度）均无法避免非目标基准的性能回退。
AI.method: 受近期 token-wise 自适应学习目标启发，提出 Privilege-Guided SFT (PG-SFT)：以 agent 轨迹的 turn-level 信息增益（turn-level information gain）作为"特权"指标，据此调整每个位置的监督强度，使监督在需要处、以适当强度偏离基座行为，而非对所有 token 一视同仁。
AI.result: 在评估基准上，PG-SFT 呈现出更有利的观测 trade-off：显著降低分布漂移与广泛的通用能力退化，代价是目标任务性能略有下降。
AI.conclusion: 平衡"能力获得—保留"trade-off 的关键不仅在于模型是否被锚定于基座行为（whether anchored），还在于监督应在何处、以多强的力度偏离该行为（where and how strongly）。

title: ABDA-NL: A Natural-Language Scenario Explorer for Argument-Based Reasoning
comment: 9 pages, 3 figures. Extended version of a demonstration abstract in the Proceedings of COMMA 2026. Code at https://github.com/idaks/ABDA-NL and live demo at https://demo.abda-nl.org
summary: ABDA-NL adds a natural-language interface to ABDA, a system for argument-based discussion using ASPIC- knowledge bases under grounded semantics. Users see which conclusions are accepted, rejected, or undecided, open an interactive rendering of the grounded discussion game to learn why, explore what-if alternatives by suspending assumptions and rules or changing preferences, ask questions that are answered from a scenario's reference documents, and author new facts, assumptions, and rules in plain English. A large language model provides the bridge between language and formalism: it answers questions from the documents and the current state of the scenario, and it translates plain-English edits into candidate formal statements. The deterministic ABDA engine remains the sole source of arguments, attacks, and acceptance labels, and every proposal of the model is validated and confirmed by the user before it takes effect.

AI.tldr: ABDA-NL 为基于 ASPIC- 知识库与 grounded 语义的论证讨论系统 ABDA 添加自然语言接口，大语言模型负责文档问答与自然语言到形式化语句的翻译，而确定性 ABDA 引擎仍是论证、攻击与接受标签的唯一来源，模型提议须经用户确认方可生效。
AI.motivation: ABDA 等基于论证的讨论系统依赖形式化知识库与形式语义，非专业用户难以直接理解接受/拒绝/未定结论的依据，也难以用形式语言进行编辑与探索。因此需要一个自然语言接口来降低使用门槛。
AI.method: 在 ABDA（ASPIC- 知识库、grounded 语义）之上构建 ABDA-NL：用户可查看结论的接受/拒绝/未定状态，打开 grounded 讨论博弈的交互式呈现以了解原因，通过暂停假设与规则或改变偏好来探索 what-if 替代方案，基于场景参考文档提问，并用自然英语撰写新事实、假设与规则。由大语言模型充当语言与形式化之间的桥梁，负责文档及场景当前状态的问答，并将英语编辑翻译为候选形式化语句。
AI.result: 系统实现了结论状态可视化、讨论博弈交互呈现、what-if 探索、文档问答与自然语言编辑等功能；确定性 ABDA 引擎始终作为论证、攻击和接受标签的唯一来源，模型的所有提议都经过验证并由用户确认后才生效。
AI.conclusion: ABDA-NL 通过引入大语言模型作为自然语言与形式化之间的接口，在保持论证语义严格性与确定性的同时，显著提升了基于论证的讨论系统的可用性与可解释性，并以用户确认机制保障编辑的可靠性。

title: Finding the Right Fit: Model-Harness Interactions across Agent Tasks
summary: Choosing an agent system means choosing both a language model and the harness through which it acts. We ask whether a strong model, harness, or pairing stays strong when the setting changes. We evaluate 66 configurations: four configurable harnesses (OpenHands, DeepSeek Harness, PI, and openJiuwen) paired with five models on TUA-Bench, ALE-CLI, and Terminal-Bench 4, plus the native Codex-GPT and Claude Code-Claude pairings. Model rankings reverse across harnesses. On Terminal-Bench 4, Claude leads GPT by 7.94 points in OpenHands but trails it by 30.16 points in PI. For four of the five models, the best harness changes from one benchmark to another, yet some pairings hold: openJiuwen gives Kimi its highest score on all three benchmarks, by 5.61 to 11.11 points. A model's own vendor harness is not reliably its best, and higher cost does not reliably buy a higher score. On Terminal-Bench 4, GPT scores higher under PI than under DSH at less than a quarter of the cost per task. Matched trajectories suggest why fit varies. Models start almost all repairs themselves, so much depends on whether the harness hands failures back in a form the model can use. GPT does best with PI's lean scaffold, while Kimi, which often issues malformed tool calls, does best in openJiuwen. We argue that the model, the harness, and the task should be evaluated together, and we release the harness adapters, evaluation code, and all 6,204 scored trajectories at https://github.com/liyix/finding-the-right-fit and https://huggingface.co/datasets/yixuanli97/finding-the-right-fit.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评测 66 种"模型+执行框架（harness）"配置，发现模型排名会随 harness 与基准任务变化而反转，强模型/强 harness/强配对并不具备跨情境的稳定性，主张将模型、harness 与任务作为整体进行评测，并公开了适配器、评测代码与 6,204 条轨迹。
AI.motivation: 选用智能体系统实际上同时选定了语言模型与其执行框架（harness），但社区普遍默认"强模型"或"强 harness"可跨设置保持优势。作者质疑这种可迁移性假设：模型能力与框架设计高度耦合，脱离 harness 抽象地比较模型可能导致误判，因此需要系统检验模型、harness 与任务之间的匹配效应。
AI.method: 构建 66 种配置：4 个可配置 harness（OpenHands、DeepSeek Harness、PI、openJiuwen）搭配 5 个模型，外加原生配对 Codex-GPT 与 Claude Code-Claude；在 TUA-Bench、ALE-CLI、Terminal-Bench 4 三个基准上评测。同时通过匹配轨迹（matched trajectories）做细粒度分析，考察修复发起方式、失败反馈形式与成本效率等因素。
AI.result: 模型排名在不同 harness 间发生反转：Terminal-Bench 4 上 Claude 在 OpenHands 中领先 GPT 7.94 分，但在 PI 中落后 30.16 分。五个模型中有四个的最优 harness 随基准变化；但某些配对相对稳定，如 openJiuwen 使 Kimi 在三个基准上均取得最高分（领先 5.61–11.11 分）。模型厂商自带的 harness 并非最优；更高成本也不必然带来更高分数——Terminal-Bench 4 上 GPT 在 PI 下得分高于 DSH，且每任务成本不足其四分之一。
AI.conclusion: 模型、harness 与任务应联合评测，而非孤立比较。匹配轨迹显示模型几乎自行发起全部修复，效果取决于 harness 能否以模型可用的形式回传失败信息：GPT 适配 PI 的轻量脚手架，而常产生畸形工具调用的 Kimi 更适合 openJiuwen。作者公开 harness 适配器、评测代码及 6,204 条打分轨迹。

title: VeriHarness: Scaling Agentic Verification for Long-Horizon Tasks
summary: As LLM agents undertake increasingly complex, long-horizon tasks, verifying their outputs becomes increasingly challenging. We study how verification capability can be strengthened with a fixed base model, without access to reference answers or grading rubrics at test time. Repeated sampling yields multiple rollouts that can contain complementary correct claims, but we need a reliable verification mechanism to determine which claims to trust. We first find that disagreement often exposes correct alternatives, while consensus can conceal errors. These observations motivate VeriHarness, which turns the underlying LLM a generator uses into an agentic verifier by giving it a workspace, evidence tools, and reusable verification skills. A disagreement resolver checks competing claims against environmental evidence, while a consensus challenger tests shared claims and searches for omitted requirements. Their findings guide the selection and revision of the final artifact. Across five long-horizon workspace benchmarks and two frontier models, VeriHarness achieves the highest selection scores among the evaluated baselines. Evidence-backed revision further improves average performance, bringing gains over a single rollout to 6.2 points with Gemini 3.5 Flash and 6.4 points with Claude Opus 4.8. We further show that verification skills can self-improve from failure feedback, demonstrating VeriHarness as a novel and critical approach for scaling long-horizon agentic verification. We release the full pool of approximately 26,000 rollouts across all five benchmarks and both models, produced at a cost of over $100,000, to support future research on agentic verification.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 VeriHarness，将生成所用的大模型转化为具备工作区、证据工具与可复用验证技能的智能体验证器，通过"分歧解析器"核对竞争性主张、"共识挑战器"测试共享主张并搜索遗漏需求，从而在固定基座模型且无参考答案条件下强化验证能力。
AI.motivation: 随着 LLM 智能体承担越来越复杂、长跨度（long-horizon）的任务，其输出验证愈发困难。论文关注的核心问题是：在测试时既无参考答案也无评分标准，且不更换基座模型的前提下，如何增强验证能力。重复采样虽能产生包含互补正确主张的多个 rollout，但缺乏可靠的验证机制来判断应信任哪些主张。
AI.method: 论文首先观察到"分歧常暴露正确备选方案，而共识可能掩盖错误"。基于此提出 VeriHarness：把生成器所用的大模型转变为智能体验证器，为其配备工作区、证据工具与可复用验证技能。其中分歧解析器（disagreement resolver）依据环境证据核对相互竞争的主张；共识挑战器（consensus challenger）测试共享主张并搜索被遗漏的需求。两者的发现指导最终产物的选择与修订。
AI.result: 在五个长跨度工作区基准与两个前沿模型上，VeriHarness 在所评估基线中取得最高选择得分。基于证据的修订进一步提升平均性能，相较单次 rollout，Gemini 3.5 Flash 提升 6.2 分，Claude Opus 4.8 提升 6.4 分。此外，验证技能可从失败反馈中自我改进。
AI.conclusion: VeriHarness 被证明是一种新颖且关键的、可扩展长跨度智能体验证的方法。作者将覆盖全部五个基准与两个模型、成本超过 10 万美元的约 26,000 条 rollout 全量池公开，以支持未来智能体验证研究。

title: Cybernetic and Epistemic: A Missing Vocabulary for Trustworthy Agentic Delegation
comment: Accepted at TAS 2026 (AAAI Fall Symposium Series), Nov 5-7, 2026, Arlington VA
summary: As code generation is increasingly delegated to AI systems, the bottleneck is shifting from writing code to supervising the systems that write it --- a shift CS-education researchers have begun to name. This shift exposes a vocabulary gap: the field asks for "human oversight" without a working distinction between the two things language does in a delegation channel --- coordinate action (cybernetic: words succeed when the world comes to match them) and coordinate understanding (epistemic: they succeed when they answer to the world and a hearer can check that they do). The failure this names is not cybernetic language but epistemic-form language doing cybernetic work: explanation-shaped output calibrated for approval rather than truth. Oversight that checks only whether an output was approved is satisfiable by rubber-stamping; oversight that holds an agent accountable requires the reasoning behind its work be retrievable and checkable. We present three delegation episodes --- illustrations, not controlled evidence --- in which epistemic engagement proved practicable while remaining auditable, one public record where a recommendation was withdrawn on its own stated terms, and one failure case illustrating oversight that requires no reasons for its discretionary choices. We propose a criterion for agentic-system governance, alongside existing technical trust properties: every consequential choice should carry the condition under which it would have gone otherwise, in a form a third party can test. Without such a condition, a third party cannot distinguish a decision from a rubber stamp. We give the criterion an operational form --- a two-part reconstruction test scoring a delegation record by whether a second reader can predict what the agent does under a perturbation --- and a deliberation-recording convention, ORRCF, that makes the condition a required component of every recorded choice.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"认识论式语言"与"控制论式语言"的区分，指出当前AI代码生成治理的症结在于用"解释外壳"充当"批准背书"。作者主张：任何重要决策都应附带其在何种条件下会做出不同选择的可检验条件，并提出可操作的"两部分重构测试"及记录规范ORRCF，使第三方能区分真正的决策与盖章批准。
AI.motivation: 随着代码生成逐渐交由AI系统完成，教育研究领域的瓶颈已从"写代码"转向"监督写代码的系统"。但该领域在要求"人类监督"时，缺乏一套可用的词汇来区分语言在委托通道中所做的两件事：协调行动（控制论意义）与协调理解（认识论意义）。由此产生的失败并非控制论语言本身，而是让"认识论外壳"的语言去承担控制论功能——输出以解释为形式，却以获批而非真理为校准目标。仅检查"输出是否被批准"的监督可被橡皮图章式操作满足，无法真正实现问责。
AI.method: 作者给出三则委托实例作为示例性（而非受控实验）证据，说明认识论参与在实践中可行且仍可审计；另举一例公开记录，其中某建议依据其自身所述条件被撤回；以及一个失败案例，展示只要求裁量选择、不要求理由的监督方式。在此基础上提出治理准则：每个重要选择都应携带"在何种条件下会做出不同结果"的条件，且该条件须以第三方可检验的形式呈现。作者将其操作化为一个"两部分重构测试"（由第二位读者判断在该扰动下能否预测智能体的行为），并设计了一种审议记录约定ORRCF，使该条件成为每条记录选择的必备组成部分。
AI.result: 三则委托实例表明认识论参与在保持可审计性的前提下具有可实践性；撤回建议的公开记录显示决策可依据其自身声明的条件被推翻；失败案例则说明缺乏理由要求的监督会退化为裁量性盖章。所提出的两部分重构测试将委托记录按"第二位读者能否预测扰动下的行为"进行评分，ORRCF则把条件性要求嵌入记录格式。
AI.conclusion: 在既有技术信任属性之外，作者提出一条面向智能体系统治理的准则：凡重要选择都应附带其反事实条件，且该条件须可被第三方检验；否则第三方无法区分一个决策与一次盖章批准。该准则通过两部分重构测试获得可操作形式，并由ORRCF记录约定予以制度化落实。

title: RISED: RubrIcs for agentic multi-environment Selection and sElf-Distillation
summary: Training a single LLM agent jointly across diverse interactive environments has attracted increasing attention as a route to generalist agents. Existing curriculum and data-selection strategies often allocate training at the environment level or prioritize local reward-based signals, without explicitly considering relationships between current rollouts across environments for prompt-group selection. Meanwhile, as environments are learned at different rates, all-failure and all-success rollout groups can coexist within a batch, leaving those data without group-relative reward signals. Both challenges highlight limitations of relying solely on scalar rewards in multi-environment RL: they provide limited information about cross-environment relationships and no within-group reward contrast when rewards are identical. This motivates richer textual feedback, such as rubrics describing rollout behaviours, to guide learning. Beyond rubrics' usage as reward, we repurpose rubrics to guide both online data selection and policy supervision. An LLM judge tags each rollout using a predefined rubric vocabulary shared across environments. The resulting profiles guide the selection of data that aligns with the overall behavioural composition of the mixed-environment batch while limiting overlap with already-selected data. Available positive rubrics (describing desired behaviours) provide privileged context for an on-policy self-distillation teacher, supplying additional token-level supervision, while negative rubrics (describing undesired behaviours) guide subsequent rollout generation away from recurring failure modes. Together, these components form RISED. Across model backbones, RISED achieves the highest mean pass rate across environments and ranks first or second in every individual environment. Rubric-based analysis of RISED can further characterize the behavioural changes accompanying these gains.

AI.tldr: 提出RISED方法，将评分量表(rubrics)从单纯的奖励信号扩展用于在线数据选择与策略监督，在多个交互环境联合训练LLM智能体时取得最优平均通过率。
AI.motivation: 现有课程与数据选择策略多在环境层面分配训练，或依赖局部标量奖励信号，未显式建模不同环境间rollout的关系，导致prompt-group选择次优；同时各环境学习速率不同，同一batch内会并存全失败与全成功的rollout组，组内奖励相同而无组相对奖励对比信号。这揭示了仅靠标量奖励在多环境RL中的局限：无法提供跨环境关系信息，也缺乏组内奖励对比，因此需要更丰富的文本反馈。
AI.method: RISED复用评分量表(rubrics)以同时指导在线数据选择与策略监督。由LLM评判器用跨环境共享的预定义rubric词表为每个rollout打标签生成profile；据此选择既符合混合环境batch整体行为构成、又与已选数据重叠最少的数据。正向rubric(期望行为)作为特权上下文提供给on-policy自蒸馏教师，生成额外token级监督；负向rubric(非期望行为)引导后续rollout生成远离反复出现的失败模式。
AI.result: 在不同模型骨干上，RISED在各环境取得最高平均通过率，并在每个单独环境中排名第一或第二。基于rubric的分析可进一步刻画伴随这些收益的行为变化。
AI.conclusion: 将rubrics从奖励用途扩展为数据选择与策略监督的统一信号，可有效缓解多环境RL中跨环境关系缺失与组内奖励无对比的问题，提升通用智能体训练的泛化性能。

title: Evaluating LLM-Generated Preference Distributions
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used as probabilistic generators for simulation, synthetic data generation, and decision support in settings where real-world data are unavailable. Yet, the structure and reliability of the distributions they produce remain understudied. Here, we systematically analyze LLM-generated distributions of preferences for air travel, restaurants, and consumer products. Encouragingly, all models considered in our analysis exhibit self-coherence, with the most probable outcomes stabilizing rapidly under repeated sampling. At the same time, we observe substantial discordance across both model families and scales, with little consensus even among their most probable outcomes. These patterns hold across nine open-weight models, three choice domains, and show robustness under temperature changes, greedy decoding, and perturbations of prompt and ordering. Our findings indicate that outcomes are influenced more by the choice of model than by the wording of the prompt, challenging the common assumption that sufficiently capable LLMs produce similar preference distributions when used as stand-ins for survey respondents.

AI.tldr: 论文系统分析LLM生成的偏好分布：模型内部自洽（最可能结果随采样迅速稳定），但跨模型族与规模差异显著；且结果更多受模型选择而非提示词措辞影响。
AI.motivation: LLM日益被当作概率生成器，用于仿真、合成数据与在缺乏真实数据的场景下辅助决策，但其输出分布的结构与可靠性尚缺乏系统研究。
AI.method: 系统分析LLM生成的航空旅行、餐厅与消费品偏好分布；考察九个开放权重模型、三个选择域，并进行温度变化、贪心解码及提示词与排序扰动的稳健性检验，比较模型内部一致性与跨模型一致性。
AI.result: 所有模型表现出自洽性，最可能结果在重复采样下迅速稳定；但模型族之间与不同规模之间差异显著，即便在最可能结果上也缺乏共识；上述模式在温度变化、贪心解码和扰动下保持稳健。
AI.conclusion: LLM生成结果更多取决于所选模型而非提示词措辞，这挑战了“足够强的LLM在充当受访者替代时会产生相似偏好分布”的常见假设。

title: Calibration-risk routing for controlled world-model adaptation
summary: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) can exploit simulated experience, but a simulator-to-target shift creates a model-selection problem: correcting the simulator and fitting the target directly can each fail under limited target data. We introduce the Model-Corrected World Model (MC-WM), which separates initial target data into disjoint fit, selection, and calibration partitions and deploys the family with lower standardized calibration risk. A learned confidence signal and deterministic validity predicates weight one-step imagined policy updates without rewriting physical rewards. We evaluate 540 unique reported run cells across three controlled Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact (MuJoCo) shifts; one exact-routing cell was repeated after a pre-deployment artifact gate, giving 541 completed executions.

AI.tldr: 提出MC-WM：将目标数据划分为拟合/选择/校准三部分，用标准化校准风险在"修正模拟器"与"直接拟合目标"两族模型间选择，并以置信信号与有效性谓词加权单步想象策略更新。
AI.motivation: 基于模型的强化学习中，模拟器与目标任务间存在simulator-to-target shift，形成模型选择难题：在目标数据有限时，修正模拟器与直接拟合目标两种做法都可能失效。
AI.method: 将初始目标数据划分为互不相交的fit、selection、calibration三个划分；基于标准化校准风险在模型族中选择风险更低的一族；引入学习的置信信号与确定性有效性谓词，对单步想象（one-step imagined）策略更新进行加权，且不重写物理奖励。
AI.result: 在三个受控的MuJoCo（Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact）偏移设定下，评估了540个唯一上报运行单元；其中1个精确路由单元在部署前artifact gate后重复执行，共完成541次执行。
AI.conclusion: MC-WM通过数据分区与校准风险驱动选择，缓解simulator-to-target shift下的模型选择问题，并在MuJoCo偏移任务中完成系统性评估。

title: What Can Analogy Tell Us About Artificial Consciousness?
summary: Who or what is conscious? Because subjective experience is directly accessible only in the first person, judgments about consciousness in other entities depend partly on analogy. Historically, such inferences have focused on nonhuman animals, but advances in artificial intelligence have raised the possibility of conscious AI. Here we develop a causal framework for evaluating such evidential analogies. The key distinction is between similarities in factors plausibly involved in generating consciousness and similarities in downstream behavioural or cognitive effects. Our framework weights source-target similarity by causal relevance while allowing for unknown causes, disabling differences and alternative routes to consciousness. Applied to biological systems, it explains why analogical support generally weakens with increasing causal distance from humans. Applied to contemporary AI, it suggests that behavioural similarity provides only limited evidence for consciousness because relevant causal correspondences remain poorly established. The framework also clarifies what evidence would strengthen claims of artificial consciousness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个因果框架，用于评估关于他者（动物、AI）是否具有意识的类比证据，主张应以"生成意识的因果因素相似性"而非"行为/认知效果相似性"作为判断依据。
AI.motivation: 主观体验只能被第一人称直接通达，因此对他者意识的判断只能部分依赖类比。传统上这类推断主要针对非人动物，而人工智能的进展使"有意识的AI"成为可能议题，然而现有类比论证缺乏对因果结构的系统分析，容易把行为相似与意识相似混为一谈。
AI.method: 建立一个因果类比评估框架：区分"与意识生成相关的因素相似性"和"下游行为或认知效果相似性"两类；以因果相关性对源—目标相似性加权，并允许存在未知原因、使类比失效的差异（disabling differences）以及通向意识的替代路径。
AI.result: 应用于生物系统时，该框架解释了为何类比支持随与人类因果距离的增大而普遍减弱；应用于当代AI时，表明行为相似对意识仅有有限证据力，因为相关的因果对应关系尚未充分建立。
AI.conclusion: 判断他者意识的关键在于因果机制对应，而非行为表现匹配；该框架同时指出了哪些证据能够强化人工意识的主张。

title: Beyond Answer Confidence: A Controlled Audit of Self-Knowledge in a Black-Box Decision Model
summary: Decision models return probabilities intended for routing, abstention and automated action. Calibration makes those probabilities useful on average, but does not establish whether low confidence reflects chance or missing knowledge, nor whether confidence falls when a model moves beyond what it knows. We audit this distinction in Jev, a decision model, with over 15 public datasets and 6 generated task families, with paired interventions that vary the information supplied for a fixed item. Jev's confidence is calibrated on familiar closed-choice tasks but fails as an indicator of missing knowledge: with no answer-relevant information it assigns up to 0.80 to a salient option, and on news beyond an observed knowledge boundary it exceeds accuracy by 0.21--0.33, a gap that recalibration on earlier months does not close. Targeted yes/no questions give sharper readouts of the case: whether an outcome is settled (AUROC 1.00) and whether the evidence suffices (0.95, against 0.85 for confidence on the same items). Asking whether Jev knows the answer appears to flag fabricated entities and post-boundary news (0.91), but with realistic names or with dates removed it shows no advantage over answer uncertainty. Black-box knowledge audits therefore need explicit controls for surface cues. Code: https://github.com/Syntheme/beyond-answer-confidence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"知识缺失"审计框架，通过配对干预实验检验决策模型（Jev）的置信度是否能区分"运气/猜测"与"真正缺乏知识"，发现校准良好但无法反映知识边界。
AI.motivation: 现有校准（calibration）只能保证置信度在平均意义上可用，无法说明低置信度究竟源于随机性还是知识缺失，也无法判断模型在超出已知范围时置信度是否下降。因此需要审计"置信度"与"知识缺失"之间的区别。
AI.method: 在决策模型Jev上进行审计：使用超过15个公开数据集和6类生成任务族；采用配对干预（paired interventions），对同一问题改变所提供的信息量；设计针对性是非题（yes/no）探测任务是否已定（settled）与证据是否充分。
AI.result: Jev在熟悉的闭式选择任务上置信度校准良好，但不能指示知识缺失：在无答案相关信息时对显著选项给出高达0.80的置信度；在超过观测知识边界的新闻上，置信度超出准确率0.21–0.33，且用早期月份重新校准无法缩小该差距。是非题读数更锐利：判断结果是否已定AUROC 1.00，判断证据是否充分0.95（同一批题目上置信度仅0.85）。"模型是否知道答案"的提问可标记虚构实体与边界后新闻（0.91），但使用真实姓名或移除日期后，相较答案不确定性无优势。
AI.conclusion: 黑盒知识审计必须显式控制表层线索（surface cues），否则置信度会被表面显著性误导；校准不等于知识边界感知，需要专门的干预式审计手段。

title: Improving Math Reasoning through Value-guided Informative Search
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has substantially improved the mathematical reasoning capabilities of large language models. Recent work introduces search into RLVR rollouts to increase trajectory diversity, but diversity alone does not ensure that the search-induced rollout policy improves upon the current policy. To address this gap, we propose APIVIS, a training-time framework that adapts finite-budget Gumbel search to chunk-level mathematical reasoning. APIVIS combines direct and searched responses within each rollout group, allowing improvements found by search to produce informative relative rewards. It further applies selective supervision to search-improved tokens, preserving a learning signal when uniform group rewards render GRPO ineffective. We show that exact value-guided selection improves the expected verifier reward at each searched state and that this guarantee extends to the complete rollout policy, with a corresponding approximate guarantee under bounded value-estimation error. Experiments on widely recognized mathematical reasoning benchmarks and different model scales demonstrate substantial improvements over competitive search-based methods, validating the effectiveness of APIVIS.

AI.tldr: 提出APIVIS训练框架，将有限预算Gumbel搜索适配到分块级数学推理，通过混合直接与搜索响应、对搜索改进token进行选择性监督，在理论上保证提升验证器奖励，实验验证有效。
AI.motivation: 现有RLVR方法引入搜索以增加轨迹多样性，但多样性本身不能保证搜索产生的rollout策略优于当前策略，即搜索改进能否转化为策略提升存在空白。
AI.method: APIVIS将有限预算的Gumbel搜索适配到分块（chunk-level）数学推理；在每个rollout组内混合直接响应与搜索响应，使搜索带来的改进产生有信息量的相对奖励；对搜索改进的token进行选择性监督，避免组内奖励一致导致GRPO失效；并从理论分析精确值引导选择对每个搜索状态期望验证器奖励的提升。
AI.result: 理论证明精确值引导选择可提升每个搜索状态的期望验证器奖励，并将该保证扩展至完整rollout策略（在值估计误差有界下为近似保证）；在多个公认数学推理基准和不同模型规模上，APIVIS相较竞争性搜索方法取得显著提升。
AI.conclusion: APIVIS通过将搜索改进与相对奖励、选择性监督结合，有效弥合搜索多样性与策略改进之间的差距，验证了搜索增强RLVR在数学推理上的有效性，并提供了理论支撑。

title: From Discovery to Decision: Finite-Budget Recoverability in LLM Voting
summary: Voting over multiple LLM responses is a common primitive in test-time scaling and ensemble inference. Collecting more responses can expand the candidate pool and increase the chance that a correct answer is discovered. Under a fixed call budget, a discovered answer still needs to accumulate enough support within the remaining calls to become the final plurality winner, creating a discovery-to-decision gap. In this work, we characterize this gap through the realized vote state and remaining call budget. We derive a sharp recoverability threshold and show that, as sampling proceeds, the observed candidate set can only expand while the set of reachable endpoint winners can only contract, inducing a candidate-level conversion window. Under a specified iid response law, the same state yields exact finite-horizon endpoint probabilities. We further show that merging wrong-answer identities preserves single-call correctness and cannot improve plurality accuracy, and that the effect of redistributing wrong-answer probability depends on the realized vote state. Singleton reachability yields a gold-free exact locking certificate. For a known answer universe, its first trigger is the earliest prefix at which all admissible continuations yield the same fixed-budget output. Empirically, most discovered-but-unselected correct answers lose reachability only after discovery. In a controlled Word16 study, input permutation improves raw-plurality accuracy by 21.1 points with essentially unchanged single-call correctness. Exact locking saves 28-30% of calls at a 16-call budget while preserving every fixed-budget output.

AI.tldr: 本文刻画多响应投票中"发现—决策"缺口，推导可恢复性阈值与候选级转换窗口，给出精确有限期终点概率、合并错误答案身份的无改进性与单例可达性的免金标准锁定证书，并在Word16实验中验证：输入置换提升原始多数投票准确率21.1点，精确锁定在16次调用预算下节省28–30%调用量且输出不变。
AI.motivation: 测试时缩放与集成推理常通过多采样投票提升正确率，但预算固定时，被发现的正确答案可能因剩余调用不足而无法积累足够票数成为最终多数赢家，存在"发现到决策"的缺口，本文旨在刻画并利用这一缺口。
AI.method: 以已实现的投票状态与剩余调用预算为状态变量，分析候选集与可达终点赢家集的单调性（候选集只扩、可达赢家集只缩），推导可恢复性锐阈值与候选级转换窗口；在指定iid响应律下给出精确有限期终点概率；证明错误答案身份合并不改变单次正确率且不能提升多数投票准确率；构造基于单例可达性的免金标准精确锁定证书，并定义其首次触发条件。
AI.result: 理论上给出可恢复性锐阈值、候选级转换窗口、精确有限期终点概率与单例可达锁定证书；实验中多数"已发现但未被选中"的正确答案仅在发现之后才失去可达性；Word16受控实验中输入置换使原始多数投票准确率提升21.1点而单次正确率基本不变，精确锁定在16次调用预算下节省28–30%调用量并保持每个固定预算输出一致。
AI.conclusion: 多响应投票的瓶颈不仅是发现正确答案，更在于剩余预算下的可达性与转化；通过投票状态分析可实现精确锁定以提前终止，在保证输出不变的前提下降低调用成本，并提示输入置换等技巧可显著提升投票收益。

title: Network World Models as Environments for Algorithm Design on Complex Systems
summary: World models, which simulate an environment and predict how it changes under actions, are increasingly used in real-world applications such as robotics. Complex systems call for the same tool because the effect of an action is not immediate. Seeding nodes for a campaign, or immunizing nodes against an epidemic, changes little on its own; what matters is the outcome that unfolds over the steps that follow. Designing an algorithm that selects such actions to maximize expected performance on a task is inherently iterative, and every candidate must be scored by the outcome it produces. Obtaining that outcome has relied on simulation, whose cost becomes a bottleneck when candidates are evaluated over many sampled trajectories. We propose an action-conditioned Network World Model that learns a network's diffusion dynamics under interventions over time, applies each action to the network, and predicts the outcome that follows. It serves as a fast evaluator inside an algorithm design loop in which a coding agent designs and refines executable algorithms using feedback from full rollouts, action-level credit, and counterfactual probes over alternative interventions. Across eight network tasks and five diffusion models, the designed algorithms match or exceed the strongest reported baseline in 138 of 141 settings while enabling up to 14.5 times faster rollouts than Monte Carlo simulation. Code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 提出动作条件网络世界模型，学习网络在干预下的扩散动力学，作为快速评估器嵌入由编码智能体驱动的算法设计循环，在8类网络任务和5种扩散模型上，138/141设置中匹配或超越最强基线，并实现最高14.5倍的加速。
AI.motivation: 复杂网络系统（如机器人、选举/免疫等干预场景）中，动作的效果并非即时显现，需要在后续多步中展开。为最大化任务期望性能而选择动作的算法本质上是迭代的，每个候选动作都需通过其产生的结果来评分。传统上依赖蒙特卡洛模拟获取结果，但当候选动作需在大量采样轨迹上评估时，模拟成本成为瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出动作条件网络世界模型（action-conditioned Network World Model），学习网络在时间维度上受干预影响的扩散动力学，将每个动作施加于网络并预测随之而来的结果。该模型作为快速评估器嵌入算法设计循环中，由编码智能体（coding agent）借助完整rollout反馈、动作级credit以及针对替代干预的反事实探针，设计并迭代优化可执行算法。
AI.result: 在8类网络任务与5种扩散模型的共141个设置中，所设计的算法在138个设置中达到或超过已报告的最强基线；同时rollout速度相比蒙特卡洛模拟最高提升14.5倍。代码将在接收后发布。
AI.conclusion: 用学习得到的网络世界模型替代昂贵的蒙特卡洛模拟作为评估器，可将算法设计过程转化为由编码智能体驱动的迭代优化循环，在保持甚至提升任务性能的同时显著降低评估成本，为复杂网络干预决策提供高效可扩展的方案。

title: Beyond State-of-the-Art: Standardising Environmental Impact Metrics for AI Research
summary:
As the capabilities and ubiquity of Large Language Models (LLMs) grow, so does their environmental footprint. Despite calls for responsible AI, the machine learning community lacks standardised practices for carbon accounting. Our automated literature review of the 5,285 papers accepted to NeurIPS 2025 reveals that reporting of environmental impact is nearly non-existent. To catalyse a shift toward sustainable AI, we define standardised sustainability metrics for evaluating model training efficiency, accompanied by simple heuristics to estimate the carbon cost of LLM inference. We implement these metrics in carbonbenchmark, a drop-in software solution for tracking and reporting emissions.
  Finally, to combat the pursuit of marginal accuracy gains at disproportionate environmental costs, we formalise the `Smallest Model that Achieves the Job' (SMAJ), a framework which challenges the field to prioritise computational efficiency and environmental accountability alongside traditional `State-of-the-Art' (SotA) accuracy.

AI.tldr: 论文指出LLM环境足迹缺乏标准化碳核算，通过自动化文献综述发现NeurIPS 2025的5285篇论文几乎未报告环境影响；为此提出标准化可持续性指标、推理碳成本估算启发式、carbonbenchmark工具，并形式化SMAJ框架以兼顾效率与精度。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型能力增强与普及，其环境足迹日益显著；尽管业界呼吁负责任AI，机器学习社区仍缺乏标准化的碳核算实践，且领域存在为追求微小精度提升而付出不成比例环境代价的倾向。
AI.method: 对NeurIPS 2025录用的5285篇论文进行自动化文献综述，评估环境影响报告现状；定义用于评估模型训练效率的标准化可持续性指标，并提出估算LLM推理碳成本的简单启发式方法；将这些指标实现为即插即用软件工具carbonbenchmark；形式化"Smallest Model that Achieves the Job"（SMAJ）框架。
AI.result: 自动化文献综述显示，所审查论文中环境影响报告几乎不存在，表明社区缺乏标准碳核算实践。
AI.conclusion: 论文呼吁AI领域在传统SotA精度之外，同时优先考虑计算效率与环境责任，通过标准化指标、carbonbenchmark工具及SMAJ框架推动向可持续AI转变。

title: YouRA: A Persistent-State Architecture for Evidence-Traceable Autonomous Research Agents
comment: Accepted to the AACL-IJCNLP 2026 Main Conference. 21 pages, 5 figures, 17 tables
summary: End-to-end research agents can now produce complete scientific papers, yet manuscript claims often diverge from executed experiments. This gap is structural: research state, failure histories, and claim-evidence alignment are not maintained as persistent, verifiable state across long-horizon pipelines. We present YouRA (Your Research Agent), an architecture for stateful, evidence-traceable autonomous research. YouRA preserves research state, execution evidence, and failure history across the research trajectory by integrating three components: a Verification State Architecture (VSA) that tracks hypotheses, gates, and evidence pointers; an Independent Controller that turns state and reflection records into lifecycle, recovery, and debate/review control while separating control from execution; and Stateful Reflection that logs failures as structured lessons and routes recovery through bounded repair, redesign, or reset. On MLR-Bench's predefined ten-task end-to-end subset, YouRA improves over both MLR-Agent and AI Scientist V2 on scalar Overall across all three matched backbones. An automated diagnostic using MLR-Bench's hallucination taxonomy reports intersection/union counts for four fact-based failure types, and data-provenance diagnostic shows more real-data-based outputs. Ablating each of the four components (the VSA, the Independent Controller, MCP tool access, and reflection-guided recovery) supports their separable contributions. Removing either core-state component drops YouRA below the full system. Code: https://github.com/PrayPrey/Your-Research-Agent.

AI.tldr: YouRA 是一种面向自主科研的有状态、证据可追溯架构，通过验证状态体系、独立控制器与有状态反思，在长程科研流程中保持研究状态、执行证据与失败历史，从而缩小论文主张与实验结果之间的偏差。
AI.motivation: 端到端科研智能体已能产出完整科学论文，但手稿中的主张常与已执行的实验不一致。该偏差具有结构性根源：在长程流水线中，研究状态、失败历史以及主张—证据一致性未被维护为持久、可验证的状态。因此需要一种能跨科研轨迹保存并核验这些信息的架构。
AI.method: YouRA 整合三个组件：(1) Verification State Architecture（VSA），追踪假设、门控与证据指针；(2) Independent Controller，将状态与反思记录转化为生命周期、恢复与辩论/评审控制，同时将控制与执行分离；(3) Stateful Reflection，将失败记录为结构化经验教训，并通过有界修复、重新设计或重置来引导恢复。整体实现研究状态、执行证据与失败历史的持久化保存。
AI.result: 在 MLR-Bench 预定义的十任务端到端子集上，YouRA 在三个匹配主干模型上，其标量 Overall 指标均优于 MLR-Agent 与 AI Scientist V2。基于 MLR-Bench 幻觉分类法的自动诊断给出了四类事实型失败的交集/并集计数；数据溯源诊断显示其输出更多基于真实数据。对四个组件（VSA、Independent Controller、MCP 工具访问、反思引导恢复）的消融验证了各自可分离的贡献；移除任一核心状态组件都会使 YouRA 表现低于完整系统。
AI.conclusion: YouRA 通过将研究状态、执行证据与失败历史作为持久、可验证的状态显式维护，有效提升了自主科研流程中主张与证据的一致性，并在端到端基准上稳定优于现有方法，消融结果进一步支持各核心组件的必要性。

title: AbsorbEvo: An Agentic Framework for Autonomous Inverse Design of Microwave Absorbers
summary: Designing high-performance microwave absorbers requires specialized expertise in electromagnetic theory, materials science and simulation programming, and entails time-consuming optimization. Here, we present AbsorbEvo, an agentic framework for autonomous inverse design that translates natural-language performance objectives into designs verified by full-wave simulations. Its candidate evolution strategy integrates language reasoning, physics-based prediction and historical feedback. A large language model proposes the directions and magnitudes of parameter adjustments based on task objectives and computational history. The system combines directed increments with global sampling to generate candidates and uses a low-cost predictive model as a physics prior to rank them. Only high-ranking designs undergo full-wave simulation. Results passing physical validity checks are used to evaluate performance and guide subsequent search. Experience from training tasks is further distilled into textual skills, which are independently validated before use in new tasks. Under identical proposal budgets on held-out AbsorbBench-36 tasks, AbsorbEvo achieved a task success rate of 79.17%, versus 25.00% for a generic agent and 12.50% for random search. Its mean best coverage was 0.7816, compared with 0.6434 and 0.6448, respectively. By integrating language reasoning and physics-based feedback into design decisions, AbsorbEvo provides a methodological foundation for natural-language-driven autonomous inverse design of microwave absorbers.

AI.tldr: AbsorbEvo 是一个智能体框架，可将自然语言性能目标转化为经全波仿真验证的微波吸收器逆向设计，在 AbsorbBench-36 上显著优于通用智能体与随机搜索。
AI.motivation: 高性能微波吸收器设计需要电磁理论、材料科学与仿真编程的专门知识，且优化过程耗时。论文旨在实现由自然语言驱动的自主逆向设计，降低对专业经验与人工迭代的依赖。
AI.method: 提出 AbsorbEvo 智能体框架：候选进化策略融合语言推理、物理预测与历史反馈。大语言模型依据任务目标与计算历史提出参数调整方向与幅度；系统将定向增量与全局采样结合生成候选，并用低成本预测模型作为物理先验进行排序；仅高排名设计进入全波仿真；通过物理有效性检查的结果用于评估性能并引导后续搜索。训练任务经验被蒸馏为文本技能，经独立验证后用于新任务。
AI.result: 在相同提议预算下，于留出的 AbsorbBench-36 任务上：任务成功率达 79.17%，通用智能体为 25.00%，随机搜索为 12.50%；平均最优覆盖率为 0.7816，对比 0.6434 与 0.6448。
AI.conclusion: 将语言推理与物理反馈整合进设计决策，AbsorbEvo 为自然语言驱动的微波吸收器自主逆向设计提供了方法论基础。

title: CortexBridge: Cortical Alignment of EEG Montages for Foundation Models
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) foundation models are often pretrained with a fixed channel vocabulary or a limited set of montages, making transfer difficult when electrode layouts change. We propose CortexBridge, a lightweight adapter that combines EEG features with electrode and atlas coordinates to map arbitrary montages into a shared cortical latent space. Evaluated with three frozen foundation models on five brain-computer interface (BCI) datasets from the Mother of All BCI Benchmarks (MOABB), CortexBridge improves performance in 13 of 15 evaluations. The gains in balanced accuracy average 0.80% for EEGPT, 0.70% for LaBraM, and 3.26% for CBraMod, with a maximum gain of 13.02% on 12-class steady-state visual evoked potential (SSVEP) classification. Visualizations of the learned atlas representations reveal task-dependent spatial patterns, with SSVEP showing a more concentrated representation in the Yeo Visual network than auditory P300. These results establish cortical alignment as a learnable and anatomically grounded routing mechanism from heterogeneous EEG montages to pretrained foundation models.

AI.tldr: 提出 CortexBridge 轻量适配器，将任意 EEG 导联布局映射到共享皮层潜空间，实现异构蒙太奇到预训练基础模型的可学习、解剖学对齐路由。
AI.motivation: EEG 基础模型通常以固定通道词表或有限蒙太奇预训练，当电极布局改变时迁移困难。
AI.method: CortexBridge 将 EEG 特征与电极坐标、图谱（atlas）坐标结合，把任意蒙太奇映射到共享皮层潜空间；在三个冻结基础模型与 MOABB 五个 BCI 数据集上评估。
AI.result: 15 项评估中 13 项提升；平衡准确率平均增益：EEGPT 0.80%、LaBraM 0.70%、CBraMod 3.26%，12 类 SSVEP 分类最高增益 13.02%；学习到的图谱表征呈任务依赖空间模式，SSVEP 在 Yeo 视觉网络中比听觉 P300 更集中。
AI.conclusion: 皮层对齐可作为从异构 EEG 蒙太奇到预训练基础模型的可学习且具解剖学依据的路由机制。

title: Grounding Large Language Models in DSGE Simulators for Policy Generation and Forecasting
summary:
Large language models can produce economic policy responses that sound reasonable, but this does not show that their actions are consistent with economic dynamics. We test this by placing an instruction-tuned language model inside six Snowdrop-backed dynamic stochastic general equilibrium (DSGE) simulators. At each turn, the model observes the economy and a change in economic discourse, selects a bounded policy action, and receives the next simulated state and an economic reward. We implement a common Python interface for repeated rollouts, persistent shocks, state cloning, and rolling-horizon simulation.
  This setting creates a long-horizon credit-assignment problem. Policy effects may appear several quarters after an action is taken. PPO has a learned value function that can propagate delayed reward to earlier tokens through generalized advantage estimation. GRPO has no learned value function and instead assigns a group-relative advantage from complete rollout returns. It therefore cannot distinguish which earlier turn caused the outcome; if every rollout receives the same return, the normalized advantage is zero. We use PPO as the primary method and GRPO as a matched critic-free baseline. The experiments also test directional semantic signals, reward horizon, trajectory warm starts, cross-simulator transfer, and historically anchored pandemic and monetary-policy shocks. The objective is to judge policy actions by their simulated economic consequences rather than by plausible language alone.

AI.tldr: 将指令微调语言模型置于六个Snowdrop DSGE模拟器中，测试其政策行为是否契合经济动态；以PPO为主方法、GRPO为无价值函数的对照，揭示长程信用分配问题。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型能生成听起来合理的政策回应，但这并不代表其行动符合经济动态。本文旨在以模拟经济后果而非语言合理性来评判政策行动。
AI.method: 构建统一Python接口支持重复rollout、持续冲击、状态克隆与滚动视界模拟；模型每轮观测经济状态与话语变化，选择有界政策动作并接收下一状态与奖励。实验采用PPO（含学习价值函数，通过GAE将延迟奖励传播至早期token）作为主方法，GRPO（无价值函数、基于完整rollout回报的组相对优势）作为匹配的无critic基线；并测试方向性语义信号、奖励视界、轨迹热启动、跨模拟器迁移及历史锚定的疫情与货币政策冲击。
AI.result: 该设定形成长程信用分配问题：政策效果可能在行动后数个季度才显现。GRPO无法区分哪一早期轮次导致结果；若所有rollout获得相同回报，归一化优势为零，而PPO可借助学习价值函数与GAE将延迟奖励回溯分配。
AI.conclusion: 应以模拟经济后果而非语言合理性来评价政策行动；在长程延迟奖励的经济模拟中，基于价值函数的PPO相较无critic的GRPO具备更可靠的信用分配能力。

title: Auditing Action Settlement in LLM Agent Environments: Order, Progress, and Replay
summary: Concurrent actions in large language model (LLM) agent environments require arbitration even when each proposal is individually valid. We implement a typed snapshot-settlement contract and audit three distinct properties: order sensitivity, useful progress, and replay consistency. Five settlement policies are tested in 28,800 exhaustive permutation trials and 2,160 scripted multistep episodes. Joint policies are spatially order-invariant conditional on fixed priorities, yet conservative rejection completes only 31.25% of agents in a six-agent doorway task versus 90.28% for random tickets; the paired improvement is 59.03 percentage points (95% bootstrap interval: 50.00-68.06). All policies preserve the tested spatial constraints, and priority arbitration still misses the independent small-instance optimum. A separate full-state journal audit exactly replays 156 checkpoints and rejects 1,332 constructed corruptions with a retained terminal anchor. The evidence concerns execution semantics, not human realism or long-run fairness.

AI.tldr: 本文实现类型化快照-结算契约，审计顺序敏感性、有效进展与重放一致性，通过28,800次穷举排列试验和2,160个多步脚本回合测试五种结算策略，发现联合策略在固定优先级下空间顺序不变，但保守拒绝仅完成31.25%智能体，随机票券达90.28%。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型智能体环境中，即使每个提案单独有效，并发动作仍需要仲裁；研究旨在检验仲裁策略的执行语义，而非人类真实性或长期公平性。
AI.method: 实现类型化快照-结算契约，审计三项性质：顺序敏感性、有效进展、重放一致性；在28,800次穷举排列试验和2,160个脚本化多步回合中测试五种结算策略；另进行全状态日志审计。
AI.result: 联合策略在固定优先级下空间顺序不变；保守拒绝在六智能体门口任务中仅完成31.25%智能体，随机票券为90.28%，配对改进59.03个百分点（95% bootstrap区间50.00-68.06）；所有策略保持测试的空间约束；优先级仲裁仍未达到独立小实例最优；全状态日志审计精确重放156个检查点并拒绝1,332个构造性破坏，保留终端锚点。
AI.conclusion: 证据涉及执行语义，而非人类真实性或长期公平性；优先级仲裁在独立小实例最优性上仍有差距，保守拒绝显著降低完成率。

title: ReSolve: Reusing Candidate Reasoning through Selective Generative Moderation
summary: Sampling multiple solutions spends computation on intermediate deductions and unfinished arguments as well as final answers. We introduce ReSolve, a training-free inference procedure that reuses this candidate reasoning through selective generative moderation. An answer-distribution controller invokes a model to examine existing derivations when candidates disagree or lack a parseable answer, then incorporates the generated solution into a bounded loop. Under Hybrid scoring on 130 competition-mathematics problems evaluated with two independently sampled candidate pools, ReSolve obtains 100 and 99 correct answers, compared with 91 and 92 for voting over the same four candidates, with no correct-to-incorrect changes relative to that vote in either pool. Eight-sample self-consistency obtains 94 and 96 correct answers while consuming substantially more tokens; ReSolve uses 46.3% and 47.2% fewer tokens in the two evaluations. A controlled ablation removes visible derivations while retaining answer keys, vote counts, and the per-state output-cap rule, reducing accuracy from 100 to 93 correct despite increasing computation. Selective and always-on Uniform moderation both solve 97 problems, while selectivity reduces moderation tokens by approximately 54% and total pipeline tokens by 6.2%. These results support candidate reasoning as reusable inference computation. They do not establish an accuracy advantage over additional sampling or a distinct benefit from specialized route instructions.

AI.tldr: ReSolve是一种免训练推理流程，通过选择性的生成式调节复用候选推理过程，在竞赛数学题上以更少token取得更高准确率。
AI.motivation: 多次采样会产生中间推导与未完成论证等被浪费的计算；作者希望把候选推理作为可复用的推理计算加以利用，而非仅对最终答案投票。
AI.method: 提出ReSolve免训练推理流程：当候选答案不一致或缺少可解析答案时，由答案分布控制器调用模型检查已有推导，并将生成解纳入有界循环；采用Hybrid评分。并做控制消融（去除可见推导但保留答案键、投票计数与每状态输出上限规则）以及选择性vs常开Uniform调节的对比。
AI.result: 在130道竞赛数学题、两个独立采样候选池上，ReSolve分别答对100与99题，同四候选投票为91与92，且无正确转错误；八样本自洽为94与96但token更多，ReSolve分别节省46.3%与47.2% token。消融使准确率从100降至93（计算反而增加）。选择性与常开Uniform均解出97题，但选择性使调节token降约54%、总流程token降6.2%。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持候选推理可作为可复用推理计算，但未证明其相对额外采样的准确率优势，也未确立专门路由指令的独立收益。

title: When Does Exercise-Specific Joint Selection Help? An Audit of Evaluation and Control Design
comment: Exploratory offline audit of subject-disjoint skeleton-based exercise correctness evaluation; 5 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables
summary: Exercise-specific joint selection can improve skeleton-based correctness classification, but what does that gain establish? We audit 1,057 repetitions from ten REHAB24-6 subjects, separating evaluation aggregation, subset structure, and temporal representation. The manual-subset kNN gain changes from 0.055 for pooled out-of-fold AUROC to 0.020 for equal-weight within-person AUROC; both paired intervals include zero. Among 1,000 dimension-matched random maps, 14 match or exceed the manual pooled result, versus 145 when bilateral structure and trunk inclusion are also matched. RBF-SVM retains a positive within-person gain, whereas logistic regression and a random-convolution comparator have negative point gains under that estimand. Sequence-order and paired-seed controls further qualify the interpretation. This exploratory audit shows why joint-selection claims require explicit estimands and structurally appropriate controls; it does not establish a new algorithm or clinical benefit.

AI.tldr: 该研究对1057个康复动作样本进行探索性审计，发现"关节特定选择能提升骨骼动作正确性分类"的结论高度依赖评估聚合方式、子集结构与随机对照设置，配对置信区间均含零，故不支持提出新算法或临床获益。
AI.motivation: 前期工作声称"针对特定动作选择关节"可提升基于骨骼的正确性分类性能，但该增益的来源与稳健性不明。作者希望厘清这种增益究竟由真实的结构性信息驱动，还是由评估口径（聚合方式）、子集划分和随机对照设计造成，从而判断原结论能否成立。
AI.method: 在REHAB24-6的10名受试者、共1057次重复动作上开展审计，拆解三个维度：(1) 评估聚合——比较pooled out-of-fold AUROC与等权within-person AUROC；(2) 子集结构——用1000个维度匹配的随机映射做对照，并进一步匹配双侧结构与躯干纳入；(3) 时序表示——引入序列顺序控制与配对种子控制；同时以RBF-SVM、逻辑回归和随机卷积作为比较器。
AI.result: 手动子集kNN的增益从pooled out-of-fold AUROC的0.055降至等权within-person AUROC的0.020，两个配对区间均包含零。1000个维度匹配随机映射中，14个达到或超过手动pooled结果；当同时匹配双侧结构与躯干纳入时，该数字升至145。RBF-SVM在within-person估计量下仍保持正的增益，而逻辑回归与随机卷积比较器在该估计量下点增益为负。
AI.conclusion: 该审计表明，关节选择类结论必须明确估计量并采用结构恰当的对照；原报告的增益在很大程度上可被聚合方式、随机映射和比较器选择所解释。本研究仅为探索性审计，既不提出新算法，也未证实临床获益。

title: Federated Agent Optimization
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly operate in private environments and accumulate valuable experience from task execution, tool use, feedback, and local knowledge. Yet such experience is distributed across organizations and cannot be directly shared because of privacy and proprietary constraints. Conventional federated learning is insufficient for this setting, as agent capabilities extend beyond model parameters to memory, tools, rewards, skills, and structured knowledge. In this paper, we formulate \textbf{Federated Agent Optimization (FAO)}, which studies how distributed agents can collaboratively improve through controlled information exchange while keeping raw data, complete trajectories, and private knowledge local. We define FAO as a multi-objective problem balancing agent utility, privacy leakage, and communication cost, and organize its optimization space across policy, memory, tool use, reward, and structured knowledge and skills. We further characterize how private experience can be abstracted, protected, aggregated, and adapted into transferable capabilities, providing a unified view of how agents can benefit from one another without direct experience sharing. Finally, we identify the key challenges of FAO and outline several promising directions for future research toward trustworthy federated agent systems.

AI.tldr: 该文提出"联邦智能体优化(FAO)"新范式，研究分布式LLM智能体如何在保护隐私前提下通过受控信息交换协同提升能力，并将其形式化为多目标问题，梳理优化空间与关键挑战。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在私有环境中积累的经验（任务执行、工具使用、反馈、本地知识）分布于各组织，因隐私与产权约束无法直接共享；传统联邦学习仅聚焦模型参数，无法覆盖智能体在记忆、工具、奖励、技能与结构化知识等方面的能力，因此亟需新的协同优化框架。
AI.method: 提出联邦智能体优化(FAO)问题形式化：将其定义为在智能体效用、隐私泄露与通信开销之间权衡的多目标优化问题；沿策略、记忆、工具使用、奖励、结构化知识与技能五个维度组织优化空间；刻画私有经验如何被抽象、保护、聚合与适配为可迁移能力，从而给出智能体间"无需直接共享经验即可互惠"的统一视角。
AI.result: 构建了FAO的统一问题框架与优化空间分类体系，明确了私有经验向可迁移能力转化的抽象—保护—聚合—适配路径，并识别出FAO面临的关键挑战与若干有前景的未来研究方向。
AI.conclusion: FAO为分布式智能体协同提供了超越传统联邦学习的新范式，指向可信联邦智能体系统这一目标，为后续研究奠定概念基础并指明方向。

title: Dependency-Aware Reward Shaping for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: When training large language models with reinforcement learning, terminal rewards provide little guidance about which steps matter. Common methods for assigning step credit overlook that work built on uncorrected mistakes is wasted while independent work remains valid. With only a final success/failure reward, every step in a failed episode has zero total future reward, even when it made progress. We propose Dependency-Aware Reward Shaping (DARS), which represents task progress as predicates linked by prerequisite relations and assigns step-level credit over the dependency graph. An annotator marks which predicates each step verifies, invalidates, or repairs. Verified predicates are discounted according to graph distance from the nearest broken prerequisite, while independent predicates are unaffected. Repairs update these weights based on any errors that remain; invalidated predicates need re-verification to regain credit. A fixed potential converts these annotations into signed per-step rewards. A common reward and annotation interface allows DARS to integrate with a range of reasoning and agentic training methods, such as GiGPO and ARPO/AEPO, without changing their rollout strategies or optimizers. Across five task families and models from 1.5B to 8B, DARS improves success by up to 10 points over GiGPO trained with the same budget and harness (ALFWorld), raises the WebShop task score and Search-R1 QA accuracy, complements AEPO's entropy-based training on AIME24/25 with a Python interpreter, and exceeds OmniOPD in controlled tool-free reasoning comparisons at 1.7B and 4B. Ablations show that step-level credit, dependency attenuation, and graph topology each contribute. On ALFWorld, a distilled 8B annotator matches the API annotator, enabling DARS to run efficiently without a frontier judge. Code is available at https://github.com/JianhuiWei7/DARS.

AI.tldr: 论文提出依赖感知奖励塑形（DARS），用谓词及前置依赖图分配步骤级信用，解决终端奖励定位不准的问题，并在推理与智能体任务上取得一致提升。
AI.motivation: 强化学习训练大语言模型时，终端奖励对中间步骤缺乏指导信息。常见步骤信用分配方法忽视依赖结构：建立在未纠正错误之上的工作无效，而独立工作仍然有效。仅在最终成败奖励下，失败轨迹中即使有进展的步骤未来奖励也为零，导致信用无法定位。
AI.method: 将任务进展表示为由前置关系连接的谓词，在依赖图上分配步骤级信用。标注者标记每步验证、失效或修复了哪些谓词。已验证谓词按与最近被破坏前置的图距离进行折扣，独立谓词不受影响；修复按遗留错误更新权重，失效谓词需重新验证才恢复信用。通过固定势函数将标注转换为带符号的每步奖励。统一奖励与标注接口，可与GiGPO、ARPO/AEPO等方法集成，无需改动其 rollout 策略或优化器。
AI.result: 在五个任务族和1.5B至8B模型上，DARS在相同预算与实验框架下较GiGPO成功率最高提升10个百分点（ALFWorld）；提升WebShop任务分数与Search-R1问答准确率；在AIME24/25配合Python解释器时补充AEPO的熵训练；在1.7B和4B的无工具受控推理对比中超过OmniOPD。消融显示步骤级信用、依赖衰减与图拓扑均有贡献。ALFWorld上蒸馏8B标注者可匹配API标注者，无需前沿模型评判即可高效运行。
AI.conclusion: DARS通过依赖图上的步骤级奖励塑形，有效改善终端奖励稀疏问题，具备通用集成性、跨任务与跨模型规模的稳定增益，并可通过蒸馏标注者降低对前沿模型评判的依赖。代码已开源。

title: HHR: Hierarchical Hash Retrieval for Efficient LLM Generation
summary: Efficient long-context inference is essential for large language models (LLMs), yet it poses a severe computational bottleneck. Hash-based retrieval offers an efficient alternative by encoding queries and keys into binary codes and using Hamming distance for key selection. However, this leads to a critical mismatch between Hamming distance and attention relevance. Query-Key logits depend jointly on directional similarity and feature magnitudes, whereas hash binarization discards magnitude information, causing both false-positive retrieval of low-logit keys and false-negative omission of high-logit keys. To address these failures, we propose Hierarchical Hash Retrieval (HHR), a coarse-to-fine framework that progressively improves retrieval accuracy through Geometry-Aware Key Routing (GKR) and Learned Hash Projection (LHP). GKR learns a head-wise orthogonal transformation to redistribute feature magnitudes and derive more discriminative page-level logit bounds, enabling effective pruning of low-logit keys while preserving important candidates. LHP then learns a head-wise projection space that aligns Hamming distance with the true Query-Key relevance ranking for fine-grained retrieval. By combining GKR and LHP, HHR suppresses false positives and recovers false negatives, substantially improving the fidelity of hash-based sparse attention. Extensive experiments across diverse LLMs and benchmarks demonstrate that HHR achieves superior performance over existing methods. For example, on LongBench, HHR improves the average score by 1.10 points and, at a context length of 128K, achieves up to a 3.30x decoding speedup and a 2.83x end-to-end speedup for Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/lianjunl13-sudo/HHR.

AI.tldr: 提出分层哈希检索HHR，通过几何感知路由与学习哈希投影对齐汉明距离与注意力相关性，提升长上下文推理效率与精度。
AI.motivation: 长上下文推理是LLM的计算瓶颈。基于哈希的检索虽高效（二进制编码+汉明距离选键），但汉明距离与注意力相关性存在错配：Query-Key logits同时依赖方向相似度与特征幅度，而哈希二值化丢失幅度信息，导致低logit键被误检（假阳性）和高logit键被漏检（假阴性）。
AI.method: HHR粗到细框架，含两个组件：GKR（Geometry-Aware Key Routing）学习逐头正交变换，重分布特征幅度并推导更具判别力的页面级logit边界，剪枝低logit键；LHP（Learned Hash Projection）学习逐头投影空间，使汉明距离与真实Query-Key相关性排序对齐，实现细粒度检索。
AI.result: 在多种LLM与基准上优于现有方法。LongBench平均分提升1.10分；128K上下文下，Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct解码加速最高3.30x，端到端加速2.83x。代码开源。
AI.conclusion: GKR与LHP结合抑制假阳性、召回假阴性，显著提升哈希稀疏注意力保真度，在长上下文场景实现精度与效率的双重提升。

title: Learning to Ask: Information Acquisition for SLM-LLM Collaboration, under a budget
summary: Collaboration between a small language model (SLM) and a large language model (LLM) offers an opportunity to combine the efficiency of smaller models with the strong reasoning capabilities of larger ones. Existing approaches primarily frame such collaboration as a computation allocation problem, determining which model should handle each portion of the reasoning process. In black-box API-based settings, however, this paradigm can be inefficient due to coarse-grained delegation or repeated transmission of context across model switches. In this work, we instead formulate SLM-LLM collaboration as an information acquisition problem, under an API budget constraint. The SLM remains the primary reasoner and selectively queries a black-box LLM advisor only when needed, issuing targeted queries rather than delegating the reasoning process itself. To realize this strategy, we develop a three-stage RLVR framework that learns whether to call the advisor, how to formulate useful queries, and how to integrate the collaboration into the reasoning process by jointly refining advisor invocation and information use. Across mathematical reasoning and coding tasks, our approach improves the performance--cost tradeoff over existing collaboration baselines and, in some settings, matches or exceeds oracle problem-level routing. Finally, we show that our strategy can transfer to other advisor model families, without further training.

AI.tldr: 该论文将小模型-大模型协作从"计算分配"重新定义为"信息获取"问题，提出三阶段RLVR框架，让SLM作为主推理器按需向黑盒LLM顾问发出定向查询，在API预算约束下改善性能-成本权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有SLM-LLM协作主要被建模为计算分配问题，即决定推理过程的哪部分由哪个模型处理。但在黑盒API场景下，这种范式存在效率问题：委派粒度过粗，且模型切换时需重复传输上下文，导致API开销大。作者希望找到更高效的协作方式。
AI.method: 将SLM-LLM协作形式化为API预算约束下的信息获取问题：SLM保持主推理器角色，仅在需要时向黑盒LLM顾问发起针对性查询，而非让渡推理过程。为此设计三阶段RLVR（可验证奖励强化学习）框架，分别学习：是否调用顾问、如何构造有效查询、如何将顾问信息整合进推理过程，通过联合优化顾问调用与信息利用。
AI.result: 在数学推理和代码任务上，该方法相比现有协作基线改善了性能-成本权衡，在某些设置下达到或超过oracle问题级路由的效果；同时策略可无需额外训练迁移到其他顾问模型系列。
AI.conclusion: 以信息获取视角重构SLM-LLM协作，配合三阶段RLVR训练，可在黑盒API与预算约束下实现更优的效率-效果权衡，并具备跨顾问模型的泛化能力。

title: Reputation, Strategy, and Emotion Effects on Generative AI Cooperation: A Comparison Across Reasoning and Non-Reasoning Models
summary: As generative AI (Gen AI) systems take on increasingly autonomous roles in economically and socially consequential interactions, understanding their propensity to cooperate -- and the signals that shape this propensity -- has become essential. We examine cooperative behavior in frontier Gen AI models using the iterated prisoner's dilemma, manipulating counterpart reputation (positive, unknown, negative), strategy (extortion vs. generosity), and non-verbal emotional signaling (facial expressions conveying competitive or cooperative appraisals). In a first study with non-reasoning models (Claude 3.5, Gemini 2.0 Flash, GPT-4o), cooperation was systematically shaped by all three factors, paralleling patterns long documented in human behavioral research, though models varied substantially in how heavily each factor was weighted. A second study with reasoning models (Claude 4.6, Gemini 3, GPT-5.2) revealed a more concentrated reliance on strategy and reputation, a near-elimination of the Potemkin effect observed in non-reasoning models (evidenced by near-uniform cooperation in a diagnostic harmony game), and a more conditional role for emotion consistent with a hierarchical cue-weighting strategy rather than a simple loss of social sensitivity. Reasoning models also showed heterogeneous end-game behavior, ranging from sustained cooperation to systematic last-round defection effect, revealing model-specific exploitability profiles with direct practical relevance for deployment in negotiation and other multi-round interactions. Together, these findings characterize Gen AI models as increasingly sophisticated, though heterogeneous, social actors, and underscore the practical value of developing standardized cooperation benchmarks to inform the responsible deployment of Gen AI in interactive, socially consequential settings.

AI.tldr: 该研究用迭代囚徒困境考察前沿生成式AI的合作倾向：非推理模型（Claude 3.5、Gemini 2.0 Flash、GPT-4o）的合作行为同时受对方声誉、策略（勒索/慷慨）与非语言情绪信号影响，类似人类行为模式；推理模型（Claude 4.6、Gemini 3、GPT-5.2）则更集中依赖策略与声誉，几乎消除"波将金效应"，情绪作用更具条件性（层级线索加权），并在终局行为上呈现从持续合作到末轮背叛的异质性，指向模型特有的可被利用性差异。
AI.motivation: 随着生成式AI在具有经济与社会后果的交互中承担日益自主的角色，理解其合作倾向及塑造该倾向的线索（声誉、策略、情绪信号）成为必要问题；同时缺乏标准化合作基准来指导其负责任部署。
AI.method: 采用迭代囚徒困境范式，操纵三个变量：对手声誉（正/未知/负）、策略（勒索型 vs 慷慨型）以及非语言情绪信号（传达竞争性或合作性评价的面部表情）。研究一测试非推理模型（Claude 3.5、Gemini 2.0 Flash、GPT-4o）；研究二测试推理模型（Claude 4.6、Gemini 3、GPT-5.2），并借助诊断性"和谐博弈"检验波将金效应。
AI.result: 非推理模型中，三因素均系统性影响合作，与人类行为研究一致，但各模型对因素的权重差异显著。推理模型更集中依赖策略与声誉，诊断性和谐博弈中合作近乎一致，表明非推理模型中观察到的波将金效应几乎消失；情绪作用更具条件性，符合层级线索加权而非社会敏感性丧失。推理模型终局行为异质，从持续合作到系统性末轮背叛不等，显示模型特有的可被利用性特征。
AI.conclusion: 生成式AI模型是日益成熟但异质的社会行动者，其合作行为受线索加权机制支配，且存在模型特异的可利用性差异；这凸显了建立标准化合作基准对指导生成式AI在交互性、具社会后果场景中负责任部署的实际价值。

title: Feedback Without the Wait: Piloting a Generative AI Practice Platform in a Large Maths Class
summary: Timely and specific feedback is one of the strongest influences on student learning, yet it is difficult to sustain in large electrical engineering classes where the ratio of students to demonstrators is high and a learner who is stuck may wait days to find out why an approach was wrong. Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) offers a way to scale conversational feedback, but using it to grade assessed work raises trust and accountability concerns, and keeping a human in the loop to assure its judgements reintroduces the very delay that erodes the value of feedback. The result is a tension between the immediacy that makes feedback so impactful and the human oversight that makes it trustworthy. In this work, we set out to resolve that tension in practice by designing and piloting a GenAI practice platform that delivers immediate, scaffolded feedback during self-directed practice. This relocates human oversight from real-time grading to the upfront verification of solutions. Our goal was to understand how students engaged with the tool, how they perceived the value and reliability of its feedback, and what lessons transfer to other engineering subjects.

AI.tldr: 该研究设计并试点了一个生成式AI练习平台，在电气工程大班的自学练习中提供即时、支架式反馈，将人工监督从实时评分转移到对解答的前置验证，以化解反馈即时性与可信性之间的矛盾。
AI.motivation: 及时而具体的反馈对学习影响显著，但在学生与助教比例高的大型电气工程课堂中难以持续；学生卡住后可能等待数天才能得知思路错在哪里。生成式AI可扩展对话式反馈，但用于评分引发信任与问责问题，而保留人工监督又会重新引入削弱反馈价值的延迟。由此形成即时性与人工监督之间的张力。
AI.method: 设计并试点一个生成式AI练习平台，在自主练习中提供即时、支架式反馈；将人工监督从实时评分环节转移到对解答的前置验证。
AI.result: 考察了学生对工具的使用参与方式、对其反馈价值与可靠性的感知，以及可迁移至其他工程学科的经验。
AI.conclusion: 通过在实践层面重新配置人工监督的位置（前置于解答验证而非实时评分），可在保证可信度的同时实现反馈的即时性，该设计经验具有向其他工程学科推广的潜力。

title: DeFA: Dependency-Guided Failure Attribution for LLM Agents
comment: DeFA: Dependency-Guided Failure Attribution for LLM Agents
summary: Errors in LLM agent executions and their visible consequences can be separated by many steps, making decisive-error localization a matter of understanding both step content and step dependencies. We introduce DeFA, a dependency-guided framework for agent failure attribution. DeFA first combines protocol relations and semantic dependencies into an event dependency graph spanning the trajectory. It then identifies events that may violate task requirements and traces their sources and subsequent effects to construct a failure propagation graph. Finally, DeFA uses step evidence and the steps' roles in failure propagation to identify the decisive error, responsible agent, and error category. To support long trajectories, DeFA partitions executions into segments and combines the current segment's detailed content with summaries of the other segments, giving local diagnosis access to global execution context. Across Who and When and the Who and When Pro text subset, DeFA achieves the highest responsible-agent and exact step accuracy with all evaluated backbones, and the highest failure-mode accuracy among taxonomy-aligned methods on Pro. Further experiments on image and video trajectories demonstrate its applicability to multimodal failure attribution. Ablations support the contributions of segmentation, the event dependency graph, and the failure propagation graph. Using DeFA's diagnostic feedback for skill evolution in Trace2Skill improves downstream task accuracy by 6-15 percentage points over the native pipeline, showing that the diagnoses can also support agent improvement on subsequent tasks.

AI.tldr: DeFA：一种依赖引导的LLM智能体失败归因框架，通过事件依赖图与失败传播图定位决定性错误，支持长轨迹分段诊断与多模态归因。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体执行中的错误与其可见后果之间常相隔多个步骤，且步骤间存在复杂依赖关系，因此决定性错误定位不仅需要理解单步内容，还需理解步骤依赖。现有方法难以在长轨迹中有效归因失败源头与责任主体。
AI.method: DeFA分为三步：(1) 将协议关系与语义依赖融合为跨越轨迹的事件依赖图；(2) 识别可能违反任务要求的事件，追踪其来源与后续影响，构建失败传播图；(3) 结合步骤证据及步骤在失败传播中的角色，识别决定性错误、责任智能体与错误类别。为支持长轨迹，将执行划分为多个片段，用当前片段的详细内容结合其他片段的摘要，使局部诊断获得全局上下文。
AI.result: 在Who and When及Who and When Pro文本子集上，DeFA在所有评估主干模型上取得最高的责任智能体准确率与精确步骤准确率，并在Pro上取得分类体系对齐方法中最高的失败模式准确率。在图像与视频轨迹上的实验验证了其对多模态失败归因的适用性。消融实验支持分段、事件依赖图与失败传播图的贡献。将DeFA的诊断反馈用于Trace2Skill的技能演化，使下游任务准确率较原始流程提升6-15个百分点。
AI.conclusion: DeFA通过依赖引导的图结构归因与分段长轨迹处理，实现了高精度的智能体失败定位，并可将诊断结果用于智能体能力改进，具备跨模态适用性与实际增益。

title: Trustworthy Data- and ML-Ops for Intelligent Transportation Systems and Logistics
comment: Paper accepted at accepted at IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems. DOI: 10.1109/TITS.2026.3711756
summary: The rapid evolution of Intelligent Transportation Systems and Logistics (ITS\&L) has become a cornerstone of the modern social economy, relying heavily on the integration of Data, Artificial Intelligence (AI), and, more specifically, Machine Learning (ML). This paper provides a comprehensive review of Trustworthy Data and Machine Learning Operations (DataOps and MLOps) in the ITS\&L domain, underscoring their importance in improving efficiency, reliability, and decision-making precision within transportation and logistics services. We begin by identifying gaps in current literature, offering clear context for our contribution. Subsequently, we explore the complexities of DataOps and MLOps, discussing their necessity, key components, available tools, practical insights, and case studies relevant to ITS\&L. Additionally, we address the critical issue of Trustworthiness in AI applications, examining methods and tools designed to strengthen confidence in AI systems - especially in real-world ITS\&L scenarios. The paper concludes with a discussion of persisting challenges and future prospects in this rapidly advancing field, aiming to serve as a vital resource for researchers, industry practitioners, and policy makers. Overall, this work not only establishes a foundational understanding of DataOps and MLOps in ITS\&L but also charts a path for further research and innovation in developing more efficient, sustainable, and trustworthy intelligent transportation and logistics systems.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了智能交通与物流（ITS&L）领域中可信数据运维（DataOps）与机器学习运维（MLOps），梳理其必要性、关键组件、工具与案例，并探讨AI可信性问题及未来挑战。
AI.motivation: ITS&L已成为现代社会经济的基石，高度依赖数据、AI与机器学习。然而现有文献在DataOps与MLOps及其可信性方面存在空白，缺乏系统性梳理，亟需一份面向该领域的综合评述来指导研究与实务。
AI.method: 采用综述方法：首先识别现有文献缺口并界定研究背景；随后剖析DataOps与MLOps的复杂性，涵盖其必要性、关键组件、可用工具、实践洞见及与ITS&L相关的案例研究；最后讨论AI可信性问题，考察用于增强AI系统可信度的方法与工具。
AI.result: 构建了ITS&L领域DataOps与MLOps的基础性认知框架，系统整合了工具、实践与案例，并归纳了AI可信性保障方法与现存的持续挑战及未来研究方向。
AI.conclusion: 本文为研究人员、行业从业者与政策制定者提供了重要参考资源，既奠定了ITS&L中DataOps与MLOps的基础理解，也为开发更高效、可持续且可信的智能交通与物流系统指明了研究创新路径。

title: ITC-MoE: Importance-guided Token-aware Compression for MoE Diffusion Language Models
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) offer flexible parallel decoding and increased model capacity, but their large number of expert parameters incurs substantial computation and storage costs. Existing low-rank MoE compression methods largely rely on static factorization and fixed rank allocation, which overlook the distinctive properties of MoE DLMs. Specifically, we identify two properties: cross-mode non-uniform redundancy, where parameter redundancy and sensitivity to rank truncation vary across the input, output, and expert modes, and token-wise utilization variation, where hot and cold tokens exhibit distinct spectral characteristics and expert activation patterns. To address these challenges, we propose ITC-MoE, an Importance-guided Token-aware Compression framework for MoE DLMs. ITC-MoE consists of two complementary components. First, Importance-guided Adaptive Tucker Compression (IATC) incorporates activation and gradient importance into expert weight transformation, jointly factorizes expert weights across multiple modes, and adaptively allocates ranks under a fixed parameter budget. Second, Token-aware Compensation and Routing (TCR) applies lightweight low-rank compensation to compression-sensitive hot tokens and restricts the candidate expert set for cold tokens with concentrated routing patterns. By jointly adapting compression capacity and inference execution to both parameter redundancy and token-wise variation, ITC-MoE substantially reduces the computation and storage costs of MoE DLMs while preserving their generation quality. For example, on SDAR-30B-A3B-Chat-b32, ITC-MoE maintains an accuracy of 96.33% on MultiArith under a 30% compression budget, while achieving up to a 7.22x end-to-end speedup. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/lianjunl13-sudo/ITC-MoE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ITC-MoE，一种面向MoE扩散语言模型的重要性引导、令牌感知压缩框架，通过自适应Tucker分解与令牌级补偿/路由，在保持生成质量的同时大幅降低计算与存储开销。
AI.motivation: MoE扩散语言模型具备灵活并行解码与高容量优势，但大量专家参数带来沉重的计算与存储成本。现有低秩MoE压缩方法多采用静态分解与固定秩分配，忽视了MoE DLM的两个特性：跨模式非均匀冗余（输入、输出、专家模式在参数冗余与秩截断敏感性上存在差异）与令牌级利用率变化（热/冷令牌呈现不同谱特性与专家激活模式）。
AI.method: ITC-MoE由两部分组成：（1）重要性引导自适应Tucker压缩（IATC）：将激活与梯度重要性引入专家权重变换，跨多模式联合分解专家权重，并在固定参数预算下自适应分配秩；（2）令牌感知补偿与路由（TCR）：对压缩敏感的热令牌施加轻量低秩补偿，对路由分布集中的冷令牌限制候选专家集合。
AI.result: 在SDAR-30B-A3B-Chat-b32上，30%压缩预算下MultiArith准确率保持96.33%，端到端加速最高达7.22倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过联合适配压缩容量与推理执行至参数冗余及令牌级变化，ITC-MoE在显著降低MoE DLM计算与存储成本的同时保持生成质量。

title: Questionnaire-Guided Disaggregation of Energy Appliance Use for Domestic Smart Meter Data
summary: Ireland's smart metering programme records electricity use at 30-minute resolution, with smart meters installed in over 80\% of households as of late 2025. While this is useful for billing of smart, time-of-use tariffs, it is too coarse to capture use of domestic appliances. We present a label-free disaggregation system that breaks usage data into 9 appliance categories by combining event detection for high-power loads with questionnaire-guided estimation. Our evaluation draws on four datasets: a calibration household with a commercial comparator, two public benchmarks (UK-DALE and REFIT) with per-appliance sub-metering, and a smart meter dataset of more than 4,800 years of use from 2,968 Irish consumers. Compared against two independently developed disaggregation systems our hybrid method combining analysis of usage data with questionnaire results, achieves the lowest whole-decomposition error on all buildings across the datasets, with better month-level performance over 54 paired months ($p<0.001$, Holm-corrected). Our method provides useful advice on a household's energy consumption patterns and advice on how to reduce or shift usage on some appliances in order to reduce costs.

AI.tldr: 爱尔兰智能电表提供30分钟粒度用电数据，本文提出一种无标签、结合事件检测与问卷引导估计的分解系统，将用电数据拆分为9类电器，在四个数据集上取得最低整体分解误差，并可输出用能建议。
AI.motivation: 爱尔兰智能电表覆盖率高（2025年底超过80%），30分钟采样对分时电价计费够用，但粒度太粗，无法刻画家用电器层面的用电情况。因此需要一种无需人工标注的负荷分解方法，从智能电表数据中还原电器级用能。
AI.method: 提出无标签分解系统，将事件检测（针对大功率负荷）与问卷引导估计相结合，把总用电拆解为9个电器类别。评测使用四类数据：带商用对比系统的校准家庭、带分表计量的公开基准UK-DALE与REFIT，以及来自2,968户爱尔兰用户、累计超过4,800年用电的智能电表数据集。
AI.result: 与两个独立开发的分解系统相比，该混合方法（用能数据分析+问卷结果）在全部数据集的所有建筑上取得最低的整体分解误差；在54个配对月份上，月度层面表现更优且具统计显著性（p<0.001，Holm校正）。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能提供家庭用能模式的有用建议，并针对部分电器给出降低或转移用电以节省电费的指导。
