title: ProtoFlow: Prototype-Guided Flow Matching for Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
summary: Generative modeling has shown strong promise for multivariate time mseries (MTS) forecasting, especially scale to high-dimensional settings. Diffusion-based methods achieve competitive performance but typically require many sampling steps at inference. VAE-based non-iterative forecasting frameworks have therefore emerged as an efficient alternative. Within this line of work, vector quantization (VQ) enables controllable latent space modeling by mapping multivariate series into compact discrete representations. Existing VQ-based forecasting methods, however, typically rely on autoregressive (AR) token generation, which suffers from exposure bias and training-inference mismatch. Flow matching provides an efficient non-autoregressive alternative for latent forecasting, but existing formulations usually initialize transport from a generic Gaussian prior. We instead observe that the trained VQ codebook already captures representative latent prototypes and can thus serve as a more informative prior for flow matching. Based on this insight, we propose ProtoFlow, a forecasting framework that combines vector-quantized autoencoding with Prototype-prior Flow matching. Our method first maps multivariate sequences into a discrete latent space, then constructs a structured prior from the learned codebook, and finally learns a DiT-based rectified flow to transport samples from this prior to future latent representations conditioned on historical observations. By replacing generic noise initialization with a learned prototype prior, ProtoFlow avoids the rollout mismatch of AR token prediction and promotes faster training convergence. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets show that it consistently achieves superior forecasting performance with efficient inference.

AI.tldr: ProtoFlow 将向量量化自编码与"原型先验"流匹配结合，用训练好的 VQ 码本作为结构化先验代替通用高斯噪声，学习 DiT 整流流从该先验传输到未来隐表示，避免自回归 token 生成的暴露偏差，实现高效且性能优越的多变量时间序列预测。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型虽性能强但推理需大量采样步骤；VAE 非迭代框架效率高，其中 VQ 能通过离散隐表示实现可控建模，但现有 VQ 方法依赖自回归 token 生成，存在暴露偏差与训练-推理不一致。流匹配提供高效非自回归替代，但现有形式通常从通用高斯先验初始化，忽略了已训练码本中蕴含的代表性隐原型信息。作者据此提出以码本作为更具信息量的先验。
AI.method: 1) 将多变量序列映射到离散隐空间（向量量化自编码）；2) 从学得的码本构建结构化先验（原型先验）；3) 学习基于 DiT 的整流流，在历史观测条件下将样本从该先验传输到未来隐表示。以学习到的原型先验替代通用噪声初始化。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，ProtoFlow 在保持高效推理的同时，持续取得更优的预测性能，并促进更快的训练收敛。
AI.conclusion: 利用 VQ 码本作为流匹配的先验是一种有效思路：既避免了自回归 token 预测的 rollout 不匹配问题，又提升了训练收敛速度与预测精度，为非自回归潜空间时间序列预测提供了高效方案。

title: PPO-HRAP: Proximal Policy Optimization with a Hybrid Regime-Aware Policy for Risk-Controlled Trading
summary: Reinforcement learning for trading often struggles to balance upside participation with drawdown control. Profit-only policies can collapse toward passive long exposure on upward-drifting assets, while aggressively risk-penalized rewards can become too defensive during volatile periods. This paper proposes PPO-HRAP, a hybrid regime-aware policy that combines Proximal Policy Optimization with an interpretable regime prior. The agent observes both market features and portfolio-state variables, receives a reward combining portfolio log return, VIX-conditioned drawdown-increase penalty, target-exposure deviation, and turnover cost, and executes a blended action between the PPO actor output and a regime-derived target exposure. On the held-out 2020-2022 SPY test window, PPO-HRAP achieves 27.62% total return, 8.48% annualized return, 0.6447 Sharpe ratio, 0.8588 Sortino ratio, and 0.4592 Calmar ratio, while reducing maximum drawdown from 34.10% for Buy and Hold to 18.47%. Across five SPY seeds, PPO-HRAP remains stable with mean total return $0.2725 \pm 0.0109$ and mean Sharpe ratio $0.6219 \pm 0.0565$. Single-run cross-asset tests on QQQ and DIA further show that the proposed method ranks first on total return and Sharpe ratio for all three reported assets. These results suggest that blending learned actions with a volatility-aware regime prior is a practical way to improve risk-adjusted trading behavior, although the current policy still incurs high turnover and cross-asset robustness beyond SPY remains limited to single-run evidence.

AI.tldr: 提出PPO-HRAP，将PPO与可解释的市场状态先验结合，通过融合动作在2020–2022 SPY上实现收益与回撤控制的平衡。
AI.motivation: 强化学习交易难以平衡上涨参与和回撤控制：仅追求利润的策略在上涨趋势资产上易退化为被动多头，而风险惩罚过强则在波动期过于防御。
AI.method: PPO-HRAP：智能体同时观测市场特征与组合状态变量；奖励由组合对数收益、VIX条件化的回撤增幅惩罚、目标暴露偏离和换手成本构成；最终动作是PPO actor输出与基于状态推导的目标暴露之间的混合。
AI.result: 在2020–2022 SPY留出测试窗口，总收益27.62%、年化8.48%、Sharpe 0.6447、Sortino 0.8588、Calmar 0.4592，最大回撤由买入持有的34.10%降至18.47%；5个SPY种子下均值总收益0.2725±0.0109、Sharpe 0.6219±0.0565；QQQ与DIA单次跨资产测试中，总收益与Sharpe均排名第一。
AI.conclusion: 将学习动作与波动率感知的状态先验混合，是改善风险调整后交易行为的实用途径；但策略换手率仍偏高，且超出SPY的跨资产稳健性仅来自单次运行证据。

title: An ontology for cross-sectoral crisis management: core and public health modules
summary: This paper presents the European Crisis Management Ontology (ECMO), a modular OWL-based ontology intended as a cross-sectoral reference for disaster risk reduction and response. ECMO is designed to be organised as a network of ontological modules. Among the modules, ECMO-CORE captures fundamental crisis management concepts such as hazard, event, exposure, impact, and response measure and uses ontology design patterns and the OWL2 punning technique to resolve ambiguities between hazard types and event manifestations. In addition, domain-specific modules are defined as in the case of the public health module aligned with SNOMED CT and ICD-11. To demonstrate the resource's utility, we used ECMO to represent the data of the Epidemic Intelligence from Open Sources system of the Joint Research Centre to generate an end-to-end pipeline that populates an ECMO-compliant knowledge graph from unstructured epidemiological news. Initial results demonstrate that ECMO provides the formal guardrails necessary for consistent and unified knowledge representation and integration. The ontology is publicly available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20070268 and is released under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) license.

AI.tldr: 本文提出欧洲危机管理本体ECMO，一个面向灾害风险减少与响应的模块化OWL本体，作为跨部门参考资源。
AI.motivation: 灾害风险减少与响应领域缺乏跨部门、统一且形式化的知识表示参考，导致危机管理数据的表示与整合不一致。
AI.method: ECMO以模块化OWL本体组织，核心模块ECMO-CORE刻画hazard、event、exposure、impact、response measure等基本概念，并采用本体设计模式与OWL2 punning技术消解hazard类型与event表现之间的歧义；同时定义领域专用模块，如与SNOMED CT和ICD-11对齐的公共卫生模块。
AI.result: 利用ECMO表示联合研究中心的Epidemic Intelligence from Open Sources系统数据，构建了从非结构化流行病新闻填充ECMO合规知识图谱的端到端流水线；初步结果表明ECMO为一致、统一的知识表示与整合提供了形式化约束。
AI.conclusion: ECMO可作为危机管理的跨部门本体参考，支持数据表示与整合，并以CC BY 4.0许可公开提供。

title: TRACE: Trajectory Return Attribution and Contrastive Erasure for Multi-Turn Safety
summary: Safety-aligned large language models (LLMs) often refuse a harmful request but comply once the same goal is spread over several turns. Preference objectives score whole responses to single prompts, so their training loss alone cannot control risk on unseen histories. Our analysis gives sufficient conditions under which suppression at supervised single-turn contexts yields a bound on multi-turn trajectory risk. The bound accounts for coverage, transfer slack, and leakage, and characterizes contraction relative to a base-policy risk budget evaluated on the trained policy's contexts. TRACE (Trajectory Return Attribution and Contrastive Erasure) turns this principle into a token-level objective. On the safe response, each token is weighted by the discounted return of a refusal-attributable advantage. The advantage compares a frozen reference model with its refusal-ablated copy, allowing earlier response tokens to receive credit from later refusal-related evidence. At high-gap positions on rejected responses, TRACE combines the observed token with policy-selected alternatives in the erasure target. A gradient-norm penalty replaces the retain set. Across five open-weight models and seven multi-turn attacks, TRACE gives the lowest attack success rate (ASR) in all 35 model and attack pairs, while the model utility evaluated on MMLU and HellaSwag drop by at most 1\.23 points. Source code can be found in the supplemental material.

AI.tldr: 安全对齐的LLM在多轮对话中易被"化整为零"式攻击绕过，现有偏好目标仅对单轮整体响应打分，无法约束多轮风险。本文给出单轮抑制可约束多轮轨迹风险的充分条件，并据此提出token级目标TRACE。在5个开源模型、7种多轮攻击共35个组合中，TRACE的ASR均为最低，且MMLU与HellaSwag效用最多下降1.23分。
AI.motivation: 安全对齐的LLM常拒绝单轮的明显有害请求，但当同一目标被分散到多轮对话中时却会配合，说明存在多轮风险。偏好类目标（如DPO）对单提示的整段响应打分，其训练损失无法控制在未见多轮历史下的风险，因此需要一种能约束多轮轨迹风险、且可在token级实施的训练目标。
AI.method: 理论部分：推导单轮受监督上下文中的抑制能够约束多轮轨迹风险的充分条件，该上界由覆盖率(coverage)、迁移松弛(transfer slack)与泄漏(leakage)构成，并刻画相对于在训练策略上下文上评估的基策略风险预算的收缩。方法TRACE（Trajectory Return Attribution and Contrastive Erasure）：在安全响应上，每个token按"拒绝可归因优势"的折扣回报加权；该优势比较冻结参考模型与其"拒绝能力消融"副本，使靠前的响应token能从靠后的拒绝相关证据中获得信用。在被拒响应的高间隔(high-gap)位置，TRACE将观测token与策略自选替代token组合进擦除目标；并以梯度范数惩罚替代retain set。
AI.result: 在五个开源权重模型与七种多轮攻击、共35个模型-攻击组合上，TRACE均取得最低攻击成功率(ASR)；同时在MMLU与HellaSwag上评估的模型效用最多仅下降1.23分，表明安全提升未以显著通用能力损失为代价。源代码见补充材料。
AI.conclusion: TRACE将"单轮抑制约束多轮轨迹风险"的理论条件落地为token级训练目标，通过拒绝可归因优势的折扣回报加权与非偏好对擦除，在不显著损害通用效用的情况下，全面优于基线在多轮攻击下的鲁棒性，说明轨迹级信用分配是缓解多轮越狱的有效途径。

title: Verify Claims, Not Scores: Evidence-Based Verification of Modular Agents
summary: When developers change one component of an agent, such as its controller, a learned model or its verifier, they usually judge the change by an aggregate task score. That score cannot tell whether improvement was attainable, which component lost value, or what the agent's own checks certify. We introduce a claim-specific verification audit for modular agents that plan, act, check and refine. Instead of scoring the agent, the audit scores the evidence: each conclusion is recorded with the evidence behind it, one of four verdicts (supported, unsupported, unresolved or not evaluated) and the boundary within which it holds. Three tools supply that evidence. Oracle policies measure attainable improvement under an explicitly stated action set, so that a low value can be traced to the evaluation rather than to the environment. Replacing one component at a time with a perfect counterpart locates lost value, with null results read as unresolved whenever a downstream component could mask them. A separate test asks whether the verifier's score identifies the quantity it is read as bounding. Applied to a constrained portfolio-allocation agent in a synthetic market with known hidden regimes, the audit shows that the value of perfect regime information depends on the action set used to measure it, that the scenario generator discards most of the regime signal while better local fidelity does not improve decisions, and that the runtime verifier can be bypassed with no visible change in outcomes. The contribution is the protocol and the evidential distinctions it enforces; the empirical findings are specific to the agent and environment studied.

AI.tldr: 提出面向模块化智能体的"声明级验证审计"协议，不评智能体而评证据：每条结论附带证据、四类裁决（supported/unsupported/unresolved/not evaluated）及适用边界，并用Oracle策略、逐组件完美替换、验证器独立性三项工具实施。
AI.motivation: 开发者修改智能体某一组件（控制器、学习模型或验证器）时通常只看聚合任务分数。该分数无法说明改进是否可达、哪个组件损失了价值、或智能体自身的检查究竟能证明什么。
AI.method: 三项证据工具：(1) Oracle策略在明确设定的动作集下测量可达改进，使低分可归因于评价设定而非环境；(2) 逐一以完美对应组件替换，定位价值损失，若下游组件可能掩盖则把零结果读作unresolved；(3) 单独检验验证器分数是否真能界定它所被解读为界限的量。整体记录每项结论的证据、裁决与成立边界。
AI.result: 在具有已知隐藏regime的合成市场约束型组合配置智能体上：完美regime信息的价值取决于测量所用的动作集；场景生成器丢弃了大部分regime信号，提高局部保真度并未改善决策；运行时验证器可被绕过而对结果无可观察影响。
AI.conclusion: 贡献在于协议及其强制的证据性区分；实证结论仅对该智能体与环境成立。

title: PRISM: A Category-Theoretic Framework for Measuring and Refining Multimodal Analogies
summary: Analogical reasoning involves identifying and preserving relational structures across domains. However, existing approaches to AI-driven multimodal analogy generation lack an interpretable measure of whether this structure is understood and maintained in the generated output. We address this gap with Pullback Refinement via Interpretable Structural Mapping (PRISM), a modality-agnostic framework for measuring and improving relational alignment in multimodal analogies, evaluated on visual metaphor generation. PRISM represents analogies as explicit relational mappings grounded in category theory and uses VLMs to instantiate these structures across modalities. Its first component, the pullback score, quantifies relational alignment from the resulting graph representation. On the AnaloBench benchmark, selecting the correct analogy purely by pullback score achieves 82.5% accuracy, demonstrating that the score captures meaningful relational information. PRISM's second component is an iterative refinement loop that uses the pullback score as an in-context feedback signal to iteratively revise the generated image towards greater relational depth. VLM-as-a-judge and human evaluations show that PRISM consistently improves metaphor consistency and analogy appropriateness over zero- shot generation, with human participants preferring the refined output in 57.65% of pairwise comparisons. However, a qualitative analysis reveals that refinement can favour visually crowded compositions rather than genuinely deeper relational correspondences.

AI.tldr: PRISM 是一个模态无关的框架，用范畴论的拉回分数度量并改进多模态类比中的关系对齐，在视觉隐喻生成上验证有效。
AI.motivation: 现有 AI 驱动的多模态类比生成缺乏可解释的度量来判断生成结果是否理解并保持了跨域的关系结构。
AI.method: PRISM 将类比表示为基于范畴论的显式关系映射，并用视觉语言模型（VLM）跨模态实例化这些结构。其第一组件为拉回分数（pullback score），从图表示中量化关系对齐；第二组件是迭代精炼循环，将拉回分数作为上下文反馈信号，迭代修正生成图像以增强关系深度。
AI.result: 在 AnaloBench 基准上，仅凭拉回分数选择正确类比可达 82.5% 准确率；VLM 评判与人工评估显示，PRISM 相比零样本生成持续提升隐喻一致性与类比恰当性，人工在 57.65% 的成对比较中偏好精炼输出。定性分析发现精炼有时偏向视觉拥挤的构图，而非真正更深的关系对应。
AI.conclusion: PRISM 提供了可解释的多模态类比关系对齐度量与改进机制，效果显著，但精炼过程存在追求视觉复杂度而非关系深度的局限。

title: Contrastive Attention Mitigates Spectral Bias in Spiking Transformers
summary: Spiking Transformers merge the energy-efficiency of spiking neural networks (SNNs) with the representational power of self-attention, creating a promising architecture for high-performance, energy-efficient computation. However, a performance gap persists versus its counterparts in artificial neural networks (ANNs). Unlike prior works attributing this to binary activations, we reveal that both spiking neurons and spiking self-attention (SSA) act as low-pass filters through multiscale spectral analysis. This characteristic leads to the dissipation of high-frequency components. To address this issue, we propose the Spiking Contrastive Attention (SCA) paradigm, which draw inspiration from the edge-detection and differential sensing properties of biological visual system. By extracting contrast prototypes via global contrastive aggregation and applying local differential refinement, SCA effectively enhances high-frequency information. Extensive experiments show that SCA is a general module that consistently boosts Spiking Transformers across image classification, semantic segmentation, and event-based tracking. Furthermore, it achieves lower complexity, offering superior efficiency over original SSA. These results establish its potential as a fundamental building block for energy-efficient Spiking Transformers.

AI.tldr: 本文通过多尺度频谱分析发现脉冲神经元与脉冲自注意力(SSA)均表现为低通滤波器，导致高频信息耗散，并据此提出脉冲对比注意力(SCA)范式以增强高频信息，提升脉冲Transformer性能。
AI.motivation: 脉冲Transformer结合了SNN的能效与自注意力的表征能力，但与ANN对应架构之间仍存在性能差距。以往工作将其归因于二值激活，本文则试图揭示这一差距的真实来源。
AI.method: 通过多尺度频谱分析诊断脉冲Transformer的性能瓶颈；受生物视觉系统的边缘检测与差分感知特性启发，提出脉冲对比注意力(SCA)：通过全局对比聚合提取对比原型，并进行局部差分精炼，以增强高频信息。
AI.result: 实验表明SCA是一种通用模块，在图像分类、语义分割与事件驱动跟踪任务中一致提升脉冲Transformer性能；同时其复杂度更低，相比原始SSA具有更优效率。
AI.conclusion: SCA有望成为高能效脉冲Transformer的基础构建模块，为高性能、低能耗计算提供新的范式。

title: Beyond Memory: Harnessing Long-Horizon Agents with Explicit Belief States
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents can now undertake increasingly complex tasks, but the way they organize interaction history into memory does not ensure a coherent understanding of the current world. We introduce PoS, an inference-time framework that constructs and continually maintains explicit belief states as the agent's decision context. Each belief combines an estimate of the current world state with unresolved task requirements, making explicit what the agent still needs to learn and accomplish. To keep this belief reliable and actionable, PoS validates its consistency and monitors task progress to detect Belief Trapping, where the agent continues to act without making meaningful progress toward the goal. Recovery is then tailored to both the trapping pattern and the type of unresolved task requirement. Experiments on four benchmarks spanning execution and diagnosis show that PoS achieves the highest overall performance on every benchmark with all three LLM backbones. Ablations demonstrate the importance of consistency validation and recovery, while context-scaling experiments show resilience to context growth. Together, these results support belief construction and continual maintenance as a foundation for long-horizon context management beyond history retention and compression.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出PoS，一种推理时框架，通过构建并持续维护显式信念状态（结合世界状态估计与未解决任务需求）作为智能体决策上下文，并利用一致性校验、任务进展监控与针对性恢复机制解决Belief Trapping问题，在四个基准上均取得最优表现。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体可承担日益复杂的任务，但其将交互历史组织为记忆的方式无法保证对当前世界的连贯理解。现有方法多为历史保留与压缩，缺乏对当前世界状态的显式、可靠表征，导致长时间跨度下决策上下文不一致。
AI.method: 提出PoS推理时框架，构建并持续维护显式信念状态作为智能体决策上下文。每个信念融合当前世界状态估计与未解决任务需求，显式刻画智能体仍需学习与完成的内容。为保证信念可靠可用，PoS进行一致性校验并监控任务进展，以检测Belief Trapping（智能体持续行动但未取得实质进展）。恢复策略根据陷阱模式与未解决任务需求类型进行定制。
AI.result: 在涵盖执行与诊断的四项基准上，PoS在三种LLM骨干模型下均取得最高整体性能。消融实验表明一致性校验与恢复机制的重要性；上下文扩展实验显示其对抗上下文增长的韧性。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，信念构建与持续维护可作为长时程上下文管理的基础，超越单纯的历史保留与压缩范式。

title: DRelay: Global Draft Context for Prefix-Aware Parallel Speculative Decoding Repair
summary: Parallel drafting reduces the drafting overhead of speculative decoding for large language models (LLMs), but its gains remain limited by the accepted prefix length. Even when the correct token is present in the candidate pool, a single early selection error prevents subsequent predictions from being used. We propose DRelay, which uses global information from the entire draft block to perform prefix-aware selective repair of candidate selections before target-model verification. DRelay bases its decisions on candidate correlations and the selected path: a global reader extracts predictive information across positions for each candidate. While a causal selector combines candidate-level information extracted by the global read with the tokens selected at preceding positions to determine whether the native choice at the current position is consistent with the global evidence and the selected prefix. It then decides whether to retain or replace the token, thereby repairing early errors and extending the accepted prefix. We further jointly train the draft backbone and the selector, combining candidate-support learning with a repair objective, while weighting the repair loss according to each block position's potential contribution to the consecutive accepted prefix. Across eight diverse benchmarks on an H800 GPU, DRelay consistently improves both average acceptance length and end-to-end decoding performance over DFlash, Domino, and DSpark. Under SGLang serving, DRelay improves average end-to-end speedup over DFlash, Domino, and DSpark by 14.7%-16.8%, 8.7%-9.3%, and 8.1%-9.3%, respectively.

AI.tldr: DRelay 通过全局信息对候选池进行前缀感知的选择性修复，提升投机解码的接受前缀长度与端到端速度。
AI.motivation: 并行草稿虽降低投机解码开销，但收益受接受前缀长度限制；即使正确 token 在候选池中，单个早期选择错误也会导致后续预测作废。
AI.method: DRelay 在目标模型验证前进行前缀感知的选择性修复：全局读取器（global reader）跨位置提取候选的预测信息；因果选择器（causal selector）结合全局读取的候选级信息与前序位置已选 token，判断当前位置的原生选择是否与全局证据及已选前缀一致，并决定保留或替换，从而修复早期错误。此外联合训练草稿骨干与选择器，将候选支持学习与修复目标结合，并按各块位置对连续接受前缀的潜在贡献加权修复损失。
AI.result: 在 H800 GPU 的八个基准上，DRelay 在平均接受长度与端到端解码性能上持续优于 DFlash、Domino 和 DSpark；在 SGLang serving 下，相较三者平均端到端加速分别为 14.7%-16.8%、8.7%-9.3%、8.1%-9.3%。
AI.conclusion: DRelay 通过全局前缀感知的候选选择修复机制有效延长接受前缀，带来一致且显著的接受长度与端到端解码加速收益。

title: SpikeMoE: Brain-Inspired Competitive Routing for Flexible Spiking Mixture-of-Experts
summary: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) enable event-driven computation through biologically inspired dynamics at the neuronal scale, while Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) perform conditional computation through expert selection at the model scale. Integrating their strengths offers potential for flexible neural architectures. A key challenge, however, lies in designing an expert selection mechanism based on spiking activity. To address this, we introduce a spike-based k-WTA Router inspired by competition-inhibition observed in the hippocampal CA1 region. The router incorporates lateral inhibition and refractory period to select Top-K experts according to discrete spike counts. Building on this, we present SpikeMoE, a framework that integrates neuronal-scale spiking dynamics with model-scale expert selection. To address incomplete multisensory inputs in multimodal tasks, we further equip SpikeMoE with a two-stage missing-modality modeling module that combines empirical prototypes from an observed-modality pool with modality-specific learnable embeddings to construct missing-modality representations. Experiments on vision, language, and multimodal benchmarks demonstrate that SpikeMoE achieves state-of-the-art performance among the SNN baselines, matches or exceeds the performance of ANN counterparts, and maintains robustness across diverse missing-modality conditions. These results demonstrate a favorable trade-off between performance and energy efficiency, validating the integration of spiking dynamics with sparse expert computation and highlighting SpikeMoE as a promising approach to energy-efficient brain-inspired computing.

AI.tldr: 提出脉冲k-WTA路由器与SpikeMoE框架，将脉冲神经元动力学与专家混合的稀疏计算结合，并加入两阶段缺失模态建模，在多模态基准上取得优于SNN基线、媲美ANN的表现，兼顾性能与能效。
AI.motivation: 脉冲神经网络（SNN）具备事件驱动计算与神经元尺度生物动力学特性，Mixture-of-Experts（MoE）在模型尺度实现条件计算与专家选择。两者结合有潜力构建灵活的神经架构。核心难点在于如何基于脉冲活动设计专家选择机制；此外多模态任务中常存在模态缺失问题。
AI.method: 1) 受海马CA1区竞争-抑制机制启发，提出脉冲k-WTA路由器，通过侧向抑制与不应期，依据离散脉冲计数选择Top-K专家；2) 构建SpikeMoE框架，融合神经元尺度脉冲动力学与模型尺度专家选择；3) 针对多模态缺失输入，设计两阶段缺失模态建模模块，结合观测模态池的经验原型与模态特定可学习嵌入来构造缺失模态表示。
AI.result: 在视觉、语言与多模态基准上，SpikeMoE在SNN基线中达到SOTA，性能匹配或超越ANN对应方法，并在多种缺失模态条件下保持鲁棒性，展现出性能与能效的良好折中。
AI.conclusion: 结果验证了脉冲动力学与稀疏专家计算结合的有效性，SpikeMoE是面向能效类脑计算的有前景方案。

title: Rethinking Probability-Based Reinforcement Learning From Posterior Concentration
summary: Verifier-free reinforcement learning with probability-based rewards offers a promising way to train LLMs on general reasoning tasks where external verifiers are unavailable. Yet the reliability of these rewards, especially in long-horizon reasoning, remains underexplored. This work identifies a length-dependent failure mode of probability rewards, which we call the Posterior Concentration Phenomenon (PCP). We show that the probability of a reference answer conditioned on a reasoning trace often collapses to a low-variance interval as the trace becomes lengthy. This phenomenon results in nearly indistinguishable rewards, which, under GRPO-based settings, makes probability-based policy optimization unstable and inefficient. Motivated by this, we propose Reinforcement Learning with Concentration-aware Posterior Rewards (RLCPR), a verifier-free RL framework to explicitly account for PCP for better optimization stability and token efficiency. It has two components: uncertainty-aware data sampling, which reduces concentration-prone rollouts before generation, and concentration-aware regularization, which penalizes unnecessarily long traces when posterior rewards collapse. Extensive experiments show that, alongside higher token efficiency, RLCPR outperforms the state-of-the-art verifier-free RL baseline by up to 4.0% on six of seven benchmarks, including general-domain and mathematical reasoning challenges.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示无验证器强化学习中基于概率奖励的长程失效模式（后验集中现象PCP），并提出浓度感知的RLCPR框架以提升优化稳定性与token效率。
AI.motivation: 在缺乏外部验证器的通用推理任务上，基于概率奖励的无验证器强化学习很有前景，但这类奖励的可靠性、尤其在长程推理中的可靠性尚未被充分研究。
AI.method: 提出RLCPR框架，显式建模PCP，包含两个组件：不确定性感知的数据采样（生成前减少易集中的rollout）和浓度感知正则化（奖励坍缩时惩罚不必要长的推理轨迹）。
AI.result: 实验表明，RLCPR在七个基准中的六个上比最先进的无验证器RL基线最高提升4.0%，涵盖通用领域与数学推理任务，同时具有更高的token效率。
AI.conclusion: 概率奖励在长推理轨迹下会因后验集中而产生近乎无区分的奖励，导致GRPO类策略优化不稳定；RLCPR通过浓度感知的采样与正则化可有效缓解该问题，兼顾性能与token效率。

title: A Deterministic and Auditable AI Security Risk Assessment Framework with ATLAS Aligned Executable Rules and Formal Verification
summary: Artificial intelligence systems are increasingly deployed in high impact and safety critical settings, yet security assessment remains difficult to reproduce and defend under audit. Existing approaches often rely on narrative checklists or assessor driven scoring, and they lack an explicit, machine evaluable mapping from observable engineering artefacts to stable technique level outcomes. We present an evidence driven AI security assessment framework that operationalises assessment as a deterministic decision function. The framework normalises heterogeneous artefacts into a project independent Control ID taxonomy scored on a bounded four level ordinal scale, compiles technique level predicates from a pinned MITRE ATLAS snapshot via an explicit mitigation to control mapping, and outputs technique indexed feasibility and impact levels with traceable links back to the triggering evidence. We package all normative choices as a versioned assessment policy object to support repeatable reassessment across snapshots. To ensure semantic correctness, we formally verify boundedness, totality, ordered semantic consistency, and monotonicity of the compiled evaluator over the full declared score domain. We evaluate the framework on five public open source AI projects pinned to explicit repository snapshots, quantify before and after changes under a unified hardening intervention, and validate responsiveness to real engineering changes through fork based implementations of Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) generation and Continuous integration (CI) security scanning gates. Results show consistent downward shifts in feasibility profiles under strengthened observable controls, while worst case residual feasibility persists when technique specific core controls remain absent from the evidence scope.

AI.tldr: 提出证据驱动的AI安全评估框架，将评估操作化为确定性决策函数，用控制项分类法和MITRE ATLAS技术级谓词输出可追溯的技术级可行性与影响等级，并在五个开源AI项目上验证。
AI.motivation: AI系统日益部署于高影响、安全关键场景，但安全评估难以复现、难以在审计下辩护。现有方法多依赖叙事式清单或评估者主观打分，缺乏从可观测工程制品到稳定技术级结论的显式、机器可评估映射。
AI.method: 将异构制品归一化为项目无关的Control ID分类法，并按有界四级序数量表打分；基于固定版本的MITRE ATLAS快照，通过显式的"缓解措施—控制项"映射编译技术级谓词；输出技术索引的可行性与影响等级，并链接回触发证据；全部规范性选择封装为带版本的评估策略对象；形式化验证编译后评估器的有界性、全域性、有序语义一致性与单调性。
AI.result: 在五个固定仓库快照的公开开源AI项目上评估，在统一加固干预下量化前后变化，并通过fork实现SBOM生成与CI安全扫描门禁验证对真实工程变更的响应性。结果表明，可观测控制项增强后可行性剖面一致下移，但当证据范围内仍缺少技术专属核心控制项时，最坏情况残余可行性依然存在。
AI.conclusion: 该框架以证据驱动、确定性、可追溯的方式实现AI安全评估，支持跨快照的可重复复评；形式化验证保证了语义正确性；但技术专属核心控制项的缺失会造成残余风险，需进一步补齐证据范围。

title: A Multi-Agent LLM Framework for Personalized Health Checkup Interpretation and Guidance
summary: Personalized interpretation of health checkup results requires reasoning across longitudinal records, medical knowledge, lifestyle guidance, and healthcare navigation. We present a multi-agent large language model (LLM) system that identifies multiple intents, maps each to a task-specific agent, executes them in parallel, and synthesizes their outputs. We compared answers generated in Single Agent and Multi Agent settings on 120 Korean compound queries combining two to four requirements, using synthetic health checkup records. The Multi Agent improved the weighted LLM-judge score from 1.695 to 1.797 (p = 0.027), and three additional LLM judges showed consistent improvements ($Δ$ = +0.111 to +0.186, all p < 0.05). The gains came from usefulness, consistency, and the handling of every requirement in compound queries, whereas numerical accuracy and grounding improved significantly under only one of the four judges and medical safety did not differ, and critical failures occurred at similar rates (Single Agent 15.0% vs. Multi Agent 13.3%). Two human evaluators preferred Multi Agent in 66.7% and 68.3% of pairwise comparisons. Multi Agent execution increased latency and cost by 1.31$\times$ and 2.02$\times$, respectively. In exploratory subgroup analyses, the improvement was concentrated in queries involving personal-record lookup.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个多智能体LLM系统用于个性化体检结果解读，在120条韩语复合查询上优于单智能体，加权LLM评分由1.695提升至1.797，人工偏好率约2/3，但延迟和成本分别增加1.31倍和2.02倍。
AI.motivation: 个性化解读体检结果需要同时推理纵向记录、医学知识、生活方式指导与就医导航等多类需求，单一LLM难以在一次生成中兼顾所有要求，因此需要多意图识别与任务分解的架构。
AI.method: 构建多智能体LLM系统：识别多个意图，将每个意图映射到任务专用智能体，并行执行后综合各智能体输出。使用合成体检记录构造120条韩语复合查询（每条含2–4项需求），对比单智能体与多智能体生成的回答，评估指标包括加权LLM裁判评分、另外三个LLM裁判评分、两名人工评估者的成对偏好，以及延迟、成本与关键失败率。
AI.result: 多智能体将加权LLM裁判分从1.695提升至1.797（p = 0.027），另外三个裁判结果一致改善（Δ = +0.111至+0.186，均p < 0.05）。提升主要来自有用性、一致性和对复合查询中每项需求的覆盖；数值准确性与依据性仅在四个裁判中的一个显著改善，医疗安全性无差异，关键失败率相近（单智能体15.0% vs 多智能体13.3%）。两名人工评估者分别在66.7%和68.3%的成对比较中偏好多智能体。多智能体使延迟和成本分别增加1.31倍和2.02倍。探索性亚组分析显示，改善集中在涉及个人记录查询的请求上。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体分解对个性化体检解读的复合查询有可测量的质量收益，尤其体现在需求覆盖度与有用性上，但代价是更高的延迟与成本，且未降低关键失败率或显著提升医疗安全性；其优势局限于需要个人记录检索的任务，需进一步验证泛化性与临床安全性。

title: NextMe-800: Anticipating Personal Behavior from Months of Egocentric Video
comment: 24 pages, 7 figures. Dataset and benchmark: https://huggingface.co/datasets/mmm8383/NextMe-800 ; project page: https://kkkkawayi.github.io/nextme-800/
summary: We often plan ambitiously yet act habitually and wonder, in retrospect, whether we would have planned differently had we known what we would actually do. Hindsight offers a valuable perspective on past decisions, although we often wish we could have simulated hindsight at the moment of choosing. If a system could generate plausible trajectories from one's personal history, such previews might help people formulate more realistic plans and make better informed decisions. We introduce NextMe-800, an approximately 800-hour first-person dataset from one volunteer over 126 days with 1 Hz images, gaze, and audio, captioned at five hierarchical abstraction levels from atomic actions to major activities. We formulate personalized action anticipation as open-vocabulary K-step sequence prediction and construct NextAct, a 1,500-point benchmark combining NextMe-800 with the multi-person EgoLife dataset. Using an embedding-based soft edit distance as the metric, we evaluate how well different models can anticipate personal behavior across abstraction levels and prediction horizons. NextMe-800 and NextAct provide a months-long resource and evaluation framework for studying how far ahead personal behavior can be anticipated from egocentric observation.

AI.tldr: 提出约800小时第一人称数据集 NextMe-800 及基准 NextAct，将个性化行为预测建模为开放词汇 K 步序列预测，并基于嵌入软编辑距离评估跨抽象层级与预测时长的预测能力。
AI.motivation: 人们在事后回望常发现实际行为与计划不符，若能基于个人历史生成可信的未来轨迹预览，或有助于制定更现实的计划、做出更有依据的决策。
AI.method: 采集单个志愿者 126 天、约 800 小时的第一人称数据，含 1 Hz 图像、注视与音频，并在从原子动作到主要活动的五个层次化抽象级别上进行标注；构建 NextAct 基准（1,500 个评测点），融合 NextMe-800 与多人 EgoLife 数据集；以开放词汇 K 步序列预测为任务形式，采用基于嵌入的软编辑距离作为评价指标。
AI.result: 提供可跨抽象层级与不同预测时长评估模型预判个人行为能力的基准，并比较了多种模型的预测表现。
AI.conclusion: NextMe-800 与 NextAct 为研究"从第一人称观察中能提前多久预测个人行为"提供了跨月级资源与评测框架。

title: OpenMTB-Audit: Exposing Over-Refusal and Clinical Expert Perspectives in LLM-Based Molecular Tumor Board Safety Evaluation
comment: Accepted for oral presentation and publication at the Pacific Symposium on Biocomputing (PSB) 2027
summary: Molecular tumor boards integrate genomic findings, clinical context, and therapeutic evidence to support precision oncology. As AI enters this workflow, a key safety challenge is distinguishing truly unsupported recommendations from evidence-supported options that still require oncologist review because of incomplete information, poor ECOG performance status, or other clinical caveats. We introduce OpenMTB-Audit, an open-source benchmark of 500 synthetic non-small cell lung cancer cases spanning five adversarial error categories and four safety labels: Supported, Partially Supported, Unsupported, and Insufficient Information. Across eight large language model configurations, we identify pervasive over-refusal: all LLM configurations failed to retain the Partially Supported label in 83.3-100% of true Partially Supported cases, achieving high aggregate safety scores through label collapse rather than clinically calibrated reasoning. To address this limitation, we developed MTB-AuditAgent, a deterministic seven-module framework separating evidence verification, missing-information detection, safety classification, and abstention. It reduces over-refusal to 6.7% and achieves 91.2% accuracy (95% CI: 88.6-93.6%). A two-oncologist annotation study found disagreement concentrated at the boundary between information sufficiency and treatment optimization, underscoring the need to preserve clinically meaningful distinctions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OpenMTB-Audit基准与MTB-AuditAgent框架，用于分子肿瘤委员会中AI推荐的安全审计，解决大模型"过度拒绝"问题。
AI.motivation: AI进入分子肿瘤委员会工作流后，关键安全挑战在于区分真正无证据支持的推荐与虽需肿瘤医生复核但仍有证据支持的选择（后者可能因信息不完整、ECOG体能状态差等临床注意事项而需复核）。现有LLM可能无法保留这一临床上有意义的区分。
AI.method: 构建OpenMTB-Audit开源基准，包含500例合成的非小细胞肺癌病例，涵盖五类对抗性错误和四个安全标签（Supported、Partially Supported、Unsupported、Insufficient Information）；评估八种LLM配置；开发MTB-AuditAgent，一个确定性七模块框架，将证据验证、缺失信息检测、安全分类与弃权分离。
AI.result: 所有LLM配置在83.3-100%的真实"Partially Supported"病例中未能保留该标签，通过标签坍缩获得高总体安全分数；MTB-AuditAgent将过度拒绝降至6.7%，准确率达91.2%（95% CI: 88.6-93.6%）。两名肿瘤医生标注研究发现分歧集中于信息充分性与治疗优化之间的边界。
AI.conclusion: LLM的过度拒绝源于标签坍缩而非临床校准推理，需保留临床上有意义的区分；MTB-AuditAgent通过模块化设计有效缓解该问题。

title: MCRI: A Four-Dimensional Framework for Analyzing and Evaluating Agent Skills
summary: As agents evolve from single-tool systems into modular, composite architectures, skills are becoming an important mechanism for capability development and distribution. However, the academic community lacks a structured framework for systematically analyzing and evaluating skills. Drawing on information gain and behavioral constraint, we propose the four-dimensional MCRI Framework and operationalize it as MCRI-Eval, a large language model-based evaluation method. We evaluate MCRI-Eval using 63,812 public skills from the OpenClaw skill Hub, with 58,275 skill-conditioned model executions across BigCodeBench, BFCL-Fundamental, and Mind2Web. MCRI-Eval scores are positively associated with community popularity signals and achieve the highest downstream ranking agreement among the evaluated methods. MCRI-Eval also improves top-1 skill selection across all three benchmarks: compared with the strongest baseline on each benchmark, the skills selected by MCRI-Eval advance by 17.7, 22.8, and 19.6 percentile points in downstream performance rank on BigCodeBench, BFCL-Fundamental, and Mind2Web, respectively. These results indicate that MCRI-Eval provides a useful pre-execution signal for prioritizing promising skills before costly execution-based evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出四维MCRI框架及其可操作化的大模型评估方法MCRI-Eval，用于在执行前系统评估Agent技能，并在大规模技能库与三类基准上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 随着Agent从单一工具系统演变为模块化、组合式架构，技能成为能力开发与分发的关键机制；但学界缺乏对技能进行系统分析与评估的结构化框架。
AI.method: 借鉴信息增益与行为约束两个视角，构建四维MCRI框架，并将其操作化为基于大语言模型的评估方法MCRI-Eval；使用OpenClaw技能库中63,812个公开技能，在BigCodeBench、BFCL-Fundamental、Mind2Web上进行58,275次技能条件化模型执行，进行实证评估。
AI.result: MCRI-Eval评分与社区流行度信号正相关，在所评估方法中取得最高的下游排序一致性；在三个基准上均提升top-1技能选择性能，相较各基准最强基线，所选技能在下游性能排名上分别提升17.7、22.8与19.6个百分点。
AI.conclusion: MCRI-Eval为在昂贵的执行式评估之前优先筛选有潜力的技能提供了有效的执行前信号。

title: Auditing Routing Entropy as an Uncertainty Signal in Attention-Residual Transformers
summary: Dynamic architectures leave a per-example routing trace beside each prediction, and diffuse routing is easy to read as a sign that the prediction is unreliable. We audit that reading for routing entropy in Attention-Residual (AR) variants of Swin-Tiny and DeiT-Small, trained from scratch on CIFAR-10/100 with a soft-binned calibration auxiliary loss, asking whether the trace carries information about correctness beyond what the model's own confidence already reveals. Three checks probe this increment: does a routing signal appear at fixed confidence, does it replicate across training seeds, and can a held-out predictor exploit it against output-only and shuffled-trace controls? A sensitivity audit then injects effects of known size and measures the fraction of each that the probes recover. No test in the fixed 30-test binned family survives multiplicity correction, and neither the nominal hit nor a borderline result recurs in its sibling seeds. Across 24 paired runs a scalar routing probe yields no pooled improvement in routing-stratified calibration, and an entropy-profile probe predicts correctness better than the same probe given shuffled profiles yet worse than a confidence-only predictor in both binary log-loss and Brier score: a gain over shuffled traces does not become a gain over the output. Conditioning on the complete logit vector leaves the corresponding comparison unresolved. The audit bounds how far these non-detections can be read: at an injected effect of 0.010 nats the profile probe recovers 24-59% of the oracle gain, and a reference-preserving correction probe recovers 8% and 23% in the two CIFAR-100 settings, below the threshold we fixed for applying it to real labels. The results establish control-dependent gains and incomplete estimator recovery, not the absence of conditional routing information.

AI.tldr: 通过在CIFAR-10/100上从头训练AR版Swin-Tiny与DeiT-Small，审计路由熵是否在模型自身置信度之外携带正确性信息；三类检验与敏感性审计均未发现稳健的增量信号。
AI.motivation: 动态架构在每次预测旁留下逐样本路由轨迹，弥散路由易被直觉解读为不可靠信号；作者要检验这一解读，即路由熵是否在输出置信度之外提供额外的正确性信息。
AI.method: 在AR变体（Swin-Tiny、DeiT-Small）上以软分箱校准辅助损失从头训练；三项检验：固定置信度下是否存在路由信号、是否跨训练种子复现、留出预测器能否在仅输出与打乱轨迹控制下利用该信号；并进行注入已知效应量的敏感性审计，测量各探针对效应的回收比例。
AI.result: 固定30个分箱检验家族经多重性校正后无一存活，名义命中与临界结果均未在同类种子中复现；24对运行中，标量路由探针对路由分层的校准无合并改善；熵剖面探针虽优于打乱剖面，却在二元log-loss与Brier上均劣于仅置信度预测器；条件化完整logit向量后比较仍无定论。敏感性审计：注入0.010 nats时剖面探针回收24–59%的oracle增益；保参考的校正探针在两种CIFAR-100设置中仅回收8%与23%，低于应用于真实标签的阈值。
AI.conclusion: 结果确立了依赖控制的增益与不完整的估计器回收，而非条件路由信息的不存在；路由熵不能作为超出置信度的可靠正确性代理。

title: Decision Titan: Test-Time Training for Long-Term Memory in Offline Reinforcement Learning
comment: Accepted at ICML 2026 Workshop on Decision-Making from Offline Datasets to Online Adaptation: Black-Box Optimization to Reinforcement Learning
summary: Long-term dependencies remain a major challenge for sequential decision-making in the field of AI: RNNs suffer from vanishing gradients and the limited expressivity of vector-based hidden states, whilst Transformer-based models are limited by the quadratic scaling of attention. Recent work has proposed tackling this problem with the Test-Time Training (TTT) framework, which stores episodic memories in the parameters of a neural network through gradient descent at both train and test-time. This approach has seen success in the domain of Natural Language Processing, however, to the best of our knowledge it has not yet been applied to the domain of Reinforcement Learning (RL), nor has there been a study analysing how this memory practically functions. In this paper, we study the potential of the TTT framework for offline RL by augmenting a Decision Transformer with TTT layers, dubbed the Decision Titan. We analyse performance and properties of the model in the X-Maze environment, an extension of T-Maze designed to test sequential memory, and investigate how the memory mechanism learns by visualising gate values over time. Our key findings are that Decision Titan can learn long-term dependencies with ranges 20x longer than the context window, generalises to lengths 1.7x the training data, but crucially temporal generalisation depends on the time embeddings used, and the ability to learn long-term dependencies depends on how the relevant information is encoded.

AI.tldr: 本文将TTT（Test-Time Training）框架引入离线强化学习，提出Decision Titan（在Decision Transformer上增加TTT层），在X-Maze环境中验证其长时依赖记忆能力及机制。
AI.motivation: 序列决策中的长时依赖仍是难题：RNN受梯度消失与向量隐状态表达能力限制，Transformer受注意力二次复杂度限制。TTT框架通过梯度下降在参数中存储情节记忆已在NLP中成功，但尚未应用于强化学习，也缺乏对其记忆机制的实证分析。
AI.method: 在离线RL中，将TTT层增强到Decision Transformer上，提出Decision Titan模型。在X-Maze环境（T-Maze的扩展，用于测试序列记忆）中评估性能与特性，并通过可视化门控值随时间的变化来分析记忆机制的学习方式。
AI.result: Decision Titan能学习比上下文窗口长20倍范围的长时依赖；可泛化到训练数据1.7倍的长度；但时间泛化依赖所使用的时间嵌入（time embeddings），且学习长时依赖的能力取决于相关信息如何被编码。
AI.conclusion: TTT框架在离线RL中具有潜力，Decision Titan可显著扩展有效记忆范围，但其时间泛化与长时依赖学习受时间嵌入设计和信息编码方式的关键制约。

title: Sharpening Tax in Post-Training
summary: An emerging hypothesis about reinforcement learning (RL) post-training of large language models (LLMs) is that it merely sharpens existing behaviors of a base model, improving single-shot accuracy at the cost of solution coverage. Although this trade-off has been observed in math and coding tasks, it need not extend to agentic tasks, where multi-turn tool use and interaction may require capabilities newly acquired during post-training. Our surprising finding is that pre-trained LLMs, equipped with a light inference harness, can serve as capable agents. Despite far lower accuracy (pass@1), they often surpass their post-trained counterparts in solution coverage (pass@K) given a sufficient test-time budget. We further analyze the underlying mechanism and show that post-training pushes tasks toward two extremes, always solved or never solved, and thereby improves sampling efficiency and consistency at the cost of solution coverage. To measure this cost, we propose Sharpening Tax, a diagnostic metric that quantifies the loss in test-time scalability after post-training. Across 14 base/post-trained model pairs from four families and three agentic benchmarks (42 cases in total), the tax is prevalent in most settings, can be estimated from a few rollouts, and correlates well with other metrics. Finally, we present posterior-tempered group sampling (PTGS), a simple plug-and-play Bayesian sampler that adapts the sampling temperature per prompt to its estimated difficulty. Applied during RL training in two agentic environments, PTGS pays a smaller tax than the fixed-temperature baseline, solving more tasks under repeated sampling while also improving single-shot accuracy.

AI.tldr: 预训练LLM配合轻量推理框架即可作为有效智能体，在充足测试时预算下其解覆盖度（pass@K）常超越经RL后训练的模型；后训练将任务推向"必解或必不解"两极，以牺牲解覆盖度换取采样效率与一致性。作者提出Sharpening Tax指标量化该代价，并提出PTGS自适应采样器缓解此问题。
AI.motivation: 已有假设认为RL后训练仅锐化基座模型的既有行为，以牺牲解覆盖度换取单次准确率。但这一权衡主要是在数学与代码任务中被观察到，智能体任务涉及多轮工具使用与交互，可能需要后训练阶段新获得的能力，因此该权衡未必适用于智能体场景。作者希望探究：在智能体任务中，后训练是否仍只是锐化既有行为，还是引入了新能力。
AI.method: 1）对比预训练模型（配轻量推理框架）与其后训练对应模型在智能体基准上的pass@1与pass@K表现；2）机制分析：考察后训练如何将任务分布推向"总是解出"或"从不解出"两极；3）提出Sharpening Tax诊断指标，量化后训练带来的测试时可扩展性损失，在4个模型家族的14对base/post-trained模型、3个智能体基准（共42个案例）上验证，并检验其可从少量rollout估计及与其他指标的相关性；4）提出posterior-tempered group sampling (PTGS)——一种即插即用的贝叶斯采样器，按提示估计难度自适应调整采样温度，在两个智能体环境的RL训练中应用。
AI.result: 1）预训练LLM配合轻量推理框架虽pass@1远低于后训练对应模型，但在给定充足测试时预算时pass@K常超越后者；2）后训练使任务趋向两极分化，提升采样效率与一致性但降低解覆盖度；3）Sharpening Tax在42个案例中多数设置下普遍存在，可从少量rollout估计，且与其他指标相关性良好；4）PTGS相比固定温度基线缴纳更小的税，在重复采样下解出更多任务，同时提升单次准确率。
AI.conclusion: RL后训练并非仅锐化既有行为，其代价是解覆盖度的损失，这一现象在智能体任务中同样显著，可用Sharpening Tax量化。PTGS作为简单的即插即用贝叶斯采样器，能有效降低该代价，兼顾重复采样下的覆盖度与单次准确率，为RL后训练提供改进方向。

title: The AI Assessment Sandbox Configurator: A Framework to Support Technical Assessment in AI Regulatory Sandboxes
summary: The EU's Artificial Intelligence Act requires all Member States to establish AI Regulatory Sandboxes (AIRS) by August 2027: supervised environments bringing together national Competent Authorities, technical experts, and the organisations under assessment. When AIRS engagements include structured technical testing, running such testing at scale demands dedicated infrastructure, yet the tooling ecosystem remains structurally fragmented, with heterogeneous tools producing outputs that are difficult to compare, trace, and reuse. From the procedural conditions of AIRS engagements and the AI Act obligations for high-risk systems, we derive 11 architectural and governance requirements for the infrastructure that operationalises technical testing within an AIRS. In response to these requirements, we introduce the AI Assessment Sandbox Configurator, an open-source framework combining a curated Catalogue of tests and controls accessed through a stable plug-in API, a shared data model that harmonises heterogeneous outputs, role-specific dashboards for multi-disciplinary interpretation, and audience-segmented reporting. We describe the architecture and current release, and report an early-stage pilot that exercised the harmonisation and reporting layers within a live AIRS engagement and contributed to an official Exit Report. We discuss the roadmap, the governance questions raised by the Catalogue's tiered contribution model, and the institutional pathways through which an open-source assessment ecosystem could emerge across Member States.

AI.tldr: 本文针对欧盟《人工智能法案》要求各成员国于2027年8月前建立AI监管沙盒（AIRS）的背景，从AIRS程序条件与高风险系统义务中提炼出11项基础设施架构与治理需求，并提出开源框架"AI Assessment Sandbox Configurator"，以测试目录、插件API、共享数据模型、角色化仪表盘和分层报告支撑规模化技术测试。
AI.motivation: 欧盟《人工智能法案》要求所有成员国在2027年8月前建立AI监管沙盒，将国家主管机关、技术专家与受评估组织汇聚于受监督环境中。当AIRS活动包含结构化技术测试时，规模化运行需要专用基础设施；然而现有工具生态结构碎片化，异构工具产出难以比较、追溯与复用，亟需统一的基础设施与治理框架。
AI.method: 作者从AIRS活动的程序条件与《AI法案》对高风险系统的义务出发，推导出11项架构与治理需求；据此设计开源框架"AI Assessment Sandbox Configurator"，包含：经稳定插件API访问的测试与控制精选目录（Catalogue）、统一异构输出的共享数据模型、面向多学科解读的角色化仪表盘，以及面向不同受众的分层报告。
AI.result: 论文描述了该框架的架构与当前版本，并报告了一项早期试点：在真实的AIRS活动中运行其数据协调层与报告层，相关成果被纳入一份官方退出报告（Exit Report）。
AI.conclusion: 论文讨论了后续发展路线图、Catalogue分层贡献模式所引发的治理问题，以及开源评估生态在成员国间形成的制度路径，表明统一基础设施有助于实现可比、可追溯、可复用的大规模AI合规技术测试。

title: Evaluating Physical Consistency and Plausibility in Generative Scenario Models for Autonomous Driving
summary: Generative AI models are increasingly used for scenario generation in autonomous driving. While they can generate realistic-looking scenarios, they often provide limited transparency into learned representations and consistency with real-world vehicle dynamics. This lack of formal assurance limits their use in safety-critical validation and certification workflows. To address this aspect, we introduce a layered evaluation protocol that complements existing methods by assessing models across five layers. The first four layers inspect internal representations and network layers through kinematic alignment, statistical baseline comparison, latent controllability, and activation analysis. The fifth layer evaluates model outputs against vehicle dynamics constraints such as lateral jerk thresholds. We demonstrate the protocol on a Variational Autoencoder (VAE)-based scenario generator. Although standard output-level metrics and visualizations suggest that the generated scenarios are realistic, our protocol provides deeper insight into the extent to which the model's latent space aligns with kinematic features and whether visually plausible trajectories satisfy vehicle-dynamics constraints. We further apply the protocol to additional generative models, demonstrating its applicability beyond the VAE architecture.

AI.tldr: 提出五层评估协议，从内部表示到车辆动力学约束全面评估自动驾驶场景生成模型，兼顾透明性与物理一致性。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI在自动驾驶场景生成中虽能产出逼真场景，但其学习表示的透明度有限，且与真实车辆动力学的一致性难以保证，缺乏形式化保障，限制了其在安全关键验证与认证流程中的应用。
AI.method: 提出互补性分层评估协议，涵盖五层：前四层通过运动学对齐、统计基线对比、隐空间可控性和激活分析检查内部表示与网络层；第五层依据横向急动度阈值等车辆动力学约束评估模型输出。以VAE场景生成器为案例进行验证，并推广至其他生成模型。
AI.result: 标准输出级指标与可视化虽显示生成场景逼真，但该协议揭示了隐空间与运动学特征的对齐程度，以及视觉合理轨迹是否满足车辆动力学约束；在多种生成模型上均验证了协议的适用性。
AI.conclusion: 该分层协议弥补了现有评估方法的不足，提升了生成模型的可解释性与物理一致性验证能力，可拓展至VAE之外的其他生成架构。

title: FedLore: Communication and Memory Efficient Federated Learning via Shared Gradient Low-Rank Projection
summary: Federated training of foundation models is constrained by client memory and communication costs. LoRA-based methods reduce these costs through low-rank adapters, but their fixed rank budget can limit adaptation. Gradient low-rank optimization offers greater flexibility, yet independently chosen client subspaces create a problem we term \emph{subspace fragmentation}: local projections interact with data heterogeneity to bias aggregated directions, while aggregation can increase update rank and communication cost. Thus, accurate local gradient compression need not preserve global descent. We propose \texttt{FedLore}, which shares a low-rank optimization basis within each round and refreshes it across rounds. The shared basis enables exact aggregation in low-rank coordinates and eliminates the identified projection bias. Subspace refresh allows the accumulated model update to exceed the per-round rank budget. We characterize the aggregation bias and establish an $O(T^{-1/2})$ stationarity bound for the projected-SGD variant under a global-gradient coverage condition and standard smoothness and variance assumptions, with bounded gradient heterogeneity. Experiments on vision and language tasks, including federated pre-training, show that \texttt{FedLore} outperforms the evaluated low-rank adapter baselines and matches or exceeds full-parameter training, while reducing communication and optimizer-state memory.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FedLore，通过在一轮内共享低秩优化基并在轮间刷新，解决联邦低秩优化中的子空间碎片化问题，实现精确低秩坐标聚合，并支持累计更新超出单轮秩预算。
AI.motivation: 联邦基础模型训练受客户端内存与通信成本限制；LoRA 等低秩适配方法虽降低成本，但固定秩预算限制适配能力；梯度低秩优化更灵活，却因客户端独立选择子空间导致“子空间碎片化”，使局部投影与数据异质性共同偏置聚合方向，且聚合可能增加更新秩与通信开销。因此，精确的局部梯度压缩未必保持全局下降。
AI.method: 提出 FedLore：在每个通信轮内共享同一低秩优化基，并在轮间刷新该基。共享基使低秩坐标中的聚合变得精确，消除投影偏差；子空间刷新使累计模型更新可超过单轮秩预算。理论分析刻画聚合偏差，并在全局梯度覆盖条件、标准光滑性与方差假设、有界梯度异质性下，为 projected-SGD 变体建立 O(T^{-1/2}) 平稳性界。
AI.result: 在视觉与语言任务（包括联邦预训练）上，FedLore 优于所评估的低秩适配基线，并达到或超过全参数训练，同时降低通信量与优化器状态内存。
AI.conclusion: FedLore 通过轮内共享低秩基与轮间刷新，有效缓解子空间碎片化与聚合偏差，兼顾低秩压缩、跨轮表达能力与通信/内存效率，为联邦基础模型训练提供可扩展方案。

title: Agents Are Systems, Not Models: Rethinking Agentic Evaluation
summary: Agent evaluations increasingly go beyond a single success rate, reporting metrics such as cost, consistency, and robustness. Yet they typically treat the agent itself as fixed. In practice, an agent is a configurable system: users decide what to tell it, how long to let it run, and which model to use, and each of these choices can change how well and how consistently it performs. We study these choices on a new benchmark of four scientific tasks, where a coding agent must find and correctly operate a published specialist model. We investigate five parts of the agent's configuration: task information, reasoning, self-verification, time budget, and backbone model. We find substantial run-to-run variability, with approximately 54% of the outcome variance coming from repeating the same configuration rather than changing it. Across configurations, the information provided to the agent has the largest effect, exceeding both time budget and model size, while also reducing cost and improving calibration. Configuration choices also interact: additional time helps only when the agent has sufficient information or a capable enough model to use it. Finally, a trajectory-based taxonomy of agent behavior reveals that prompting an agent to verify its answer has little effect on its verification behavior, whereas providing a dedicated verification tool changes that behavior substantially. These results suggest that agents should be evaluated as configurable systems themselves, and that some desired behaviors are more effectively implemented in the system than requested through prompting. We release the benchmark and more than 18,000 agent trajectories.

AI.tldr: 论文提出将Agent视为可配置系统进行评估，在四个科学任务基准上研究任务信息、推理、自验证、时间预算和骨干模型五项配置对性能的影响，发现信息量影响最大且配置间存在交互作用，并发现专用验证工具比提示词更能改变验证行为。
AI.motivation: 现有Agent评估通常把Agent本身视为固定不变，只报告单一成功率及成本、一致性、鲁棒性等指标。但实际中Agent是可配置系统，用户对提示内容、运行时长、模型选择等决策会影响其表现与稳定性，因此需要系统性地研究配置选择对Agent的影响。
AI.method: 构建包含四个科学任务的新基准，要求编码Agent找到并正确操作已发表的专家模型。针对Agent配置的五个方面展开实验：任务信息、推理、自验证、时间预算和骨干模型，并分析运行间方差、各配置的主效应与交互效应，同时基于轨迹对Agent行为进行分类。
AI.result: 存在显著的运行间波动，约54%的结果方差来自重复相同配置而非改变配置。跨配置比较中，提供给Agent的信息影响最大，超过时间预算和模型规模，同时降低成本并改善校准。配置间存在交互：额外时间只有在信息充分或模型足够强时才有帮助。基于轨迹的分类显示，提示Agent验证答案对其验证行为影响甚微，而提供专用验证工具则显著改变该行为。
AI.conclusion: Agent应作为可配置系统本身来评估；某些期望行为通过系统实现比通过提示词请求更有效。论文发布基准及超过18,000条Agent轨迹。

title: TopK-Guided: Adaptive, Budget-Aware Activation Sparsity for Efficient LLM Inference
summary: Activation sparsity speeds up large language model (LLM) inference by setting unimportant activations to zero so that the corresponding computations can be skipped. Existing training-free methods, however, make different trade-offs: threshold-based methods such as TEAL adapt the sparsity level to each token but do not tightly control the realised sparsity, while TopK-based methods such as WINA enforce a fixed sparsity level but use the same sparsity budget for every token. Both also apply the same budget across transformer blocks, despite large differences in block sensitivity. We introduce TopK-Guided, a training-free method that addresses both limitations by combining bounded token-level sparsity adaptation with sensitivity-aware block-level budget allocation. Across Llama-2 and Llama-3 models, TopK-Guided consistently improves perplexity and downstream accuracy over TEAL and WINA while preserving essentially the same sparsitydependent projection compute as WINA, with the largest gains at high sparsity. Ablations show that both components provide complementary improvements.

AI.tldr: 提出无需训练的TopK-Guided方法，结合令牌级稀疏度自适应与层级预算分配，在Llama-2/3上优于TEAL和WINA。
AI.motivation: 现有免训练激活稀疏方法存在权衡：阈值法（如TEAL）按令牌自适应稀疏度但无法严格控制实际稀疏度；TopK法（如WINA）固定稀疏度但对每个令牌使用相同预算。两者还对所有transformer块采用相同预算，忽视块间敏感度差异，导致次优效果。
AI.method: 提出免训练方法TopK-Guided，将受限的令牌级稀疏度自适应与感知敏感度的块级预算分配相结合，以同时解决上述两个局限。
AI.result: 在Llama-2和Llama-3模型上，TopK-Guided在困惑度和下游准确率上持续优于TEAL和WINA，同时保持与WINA基本相同的稀疏度相关投影计算量，高稀疏度时增益最大。
AI.conclusion: 消融实验表明令牌级自适应和块级预算分配两个组件提供互补改进，TopK-Guided在保持计算效率的同时提升质量。

title: Measuring the Stability Assumption Behind Action Chunking
summary: Action chunking improves the performance of policies learned by behavioural cloning, and several mechanisms have been proposed to explain why, including temporal consistency, horizon reduction, representation learning, and reduced error compounding. We instead study what happens to an action error once it enters the system. At each state, we inject a small action error and measure how fast it grows or shrinks under two execution regimes: open-loop, where the rest of the chunk is replayed without replanning, and closed-loop, where the policy replans after the perturbation. The fitted rate labels each state as contracting, expanding, or unresolved. Across twelve manipulation tasks from three benchmark suites, we find that confidently stable states are rare, while error amplification is common among states whose propagation rate can be resolved. We further find that the measured propagation rate depends strongly on the fitting horizon: amplification is typically front-loaded, so short windows can overestimate longer-horizon propagation. Finally, we train predictors on these labels and find that a state's open-loop regime can be recovered from camera frames and proprioception alone, while its closed-loop propagation is only partially recoverable because it also depends on how the policy acts after the perturbation. These results suggest that error-compounding arguments alone do not provide a complete account of action chunking: neither passive open-loop dynamics nor policy replanning consistently contracts an injected error, and replanning rarely turns open-loop amplification into confident contraction. This suggests that closed-loop reactivity should be trained explicitly, using perturbation- and tree-coverage-oriented training to expose policies to deviations they must recover from, rather than expected to emerge reliably from standard imitation learning.

AI.tldr: 本文通过注入动作误差并测量其传播速率，研究动作分块（action chunking）为何提升行为克隆策略性能，发现"误差复合"并非完整解释：稳定收缩状态稀少、误差放大普遍，且闭环重规划很少将开环放大转为收缩。
AI.motivation: 动作分块已被证明能提升行为克隆策略的性能，现有解释包括时间一致性、缩短决策视界、表征学习和减少误差复合。作者认为这些机制缺乏对"动作误差进入系统后如何演化"的直接刻画，因此希望从误差传播动力学的角度重新审视该问题。
AI.method: 在每个状态注入一个小动作误差，并在两种执行机制下测量误差增长或收缩的速度：开环（不回重新规划，直接重放整个分块）与闭环（扰动后策略重新规划）。将拟合得到的传播速率用于把每个状态标记为收缩、扩张或未解析。在来自三个基准套件的十二个操作任务上进行实验，并考察拟合视界对速率估计的影响；最后训练预测器，从相机帧和本体感觉预测这些标签。
AI.result: 在十二个操作任务中，置信的稳定状态很少，而在可解析传播速率的状态中误差放大很常见。传播速率强烈依赖拟合视界：放大通常"前置"，短窗口会高估长视界下的传播。预测器实验显示，状态的开环机制可仅从相机帧和本体感觉恢复，而闭环传播只能部分恢复，因为它还取决于策略在扰动后如何动作。
AI.conclusion: 误差复合论不足以完整解释动作分块的作用：被动开环动力学与策略重规划都不能一致地收缩注入误差，重规划也很少把开环放大转为置信收缩。作者建议应显式训练闭环反应性，采用面向扰动和树覆盖（tree-coverage）的训练方式让策略接触必须恢复的偏差，而不是指望它从标准模仿学习中可靠涌现。

title: vFedProtoQNAS: Prototype-Guided Personalized Quantum Neural Architecture Search for Virtual Federated Learning
summary: Quantum federated learning (QFL) has emerged as a promising approach for collaboratively training compact quantum neural networks (QNNs) over distributed private data on resource-constrained devices. However, differences in device capabilities make a single shared QNN architecture unsuitable for all clients. While personalized quantum neural architecture search (QNAS) allows each client to select a device-specific QNN, averaging parameters across structurally different QNN architectures mixes semantically inconsistent circuit operations. To address this, prototype-guided personalized QNAS for virtual FL (vFedProtoQNAS) is proposed, where model parameters are never aggregated across clients and federated collaboration is achieved through class-wise prototype sharing. Each client independently searches and trains a client-specific QNN, computes class-wise local prototypes from latent representations, and refines them using global prototypes from the server as federated semantic anchors. Experiments demonstrate that vFedProtoQNAS improves accuracy by 3.70\% over FedAvg and enhances class-consistent representation alignment.

AI.tldr: 提出 vFedProtoQNAS，用类级原型共享替代参数聚合，实现无需聚合结构异构 QNN 的个性化量子联邦学习。
AI.motivation: 设备能力差异使单一共享 QNN 架构难以适配所有客户端；个性化 QNAS 可为各客户端搜索专属架构，但结构不同导致参数平均会混合语义不一致的量子线路操作。
AI.method: 客户端独立搜索并训练自身 QNN；从隐层表示计算类级局部原型；利用服务器下发的全局原型作为联邦语义锚点进行细化；跨客户端不聚合模型参数，仅共享类级原型。
AI.result: 相对 FedAvg 准确率提升 3.70%，并改善了类一致性的表示对齐。
AI.conclusion: 以原型共享为通信与协同机制，可绕开异构量子架构的参数聚合问题，兼顾个性化与联邦协作。

title: Q-Learning for Reachability in MEC-Free MDPs
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) for reachability specifications is fundamental to sequential decision-making. Prior work establishes asymptotic convergence to optimal policies, but only through model-based methods that must explicitly estimate the transition probabilities of the underlying Markov Decision Process (MDP). We present Quasar, the first model-free algorithm with asymptotic guarantees for reachability on the fragment of MDPs free of non-terminal maximal end components (MECs), a building block to which every MDP reduces by the standard MEC quotient. Our algorithm follows the classical Q-learning approach, using temporal-difference updates to converge to an optimal policy without ever learning the transition probabilities. The resulting learner reduces the memory footprint from the O(|S|^2|A|) that model-based methods require to O(|S||A|). On the standardized Quantitative Verification Benchmark Set, our algorithm converges to the optimal policy with orders of magnitude fewer samples than the previous model-based state-of-the-art. Together these results are a concrete step toward the practical deployment of reachability learning and, with it, of specification-guided RL.

AI.tldr: Quasar：首个在无非终止极大端分量(MEC)的MDP片段上具有渐近可达性保证的无模型算法，基于Q-learning的时序差分更新，无需估计转移概率。
AI.motivation: 可达性规格的强化学习是序贯决策的基础。已有工作虽建立了到最优策略的渐近收敛，但仅依赖基于模型的方法，必须显式估计底层MDP的转移概率，导致内存开销大、样本效率低。
AI.method: 提出Quasar算法，遵循经典Q-learning框架，利用时序差分更新直接收敛到最优策略，全程无需学习转移概率。算法针对无非终止MEC的MDP片段设计，该片段是所有MDP经标准MEC商约简后的基本构造块。
AI.result: 将内存占用从基于模型方法所需的O(|S|^2|A|)降至O(|S||A|)。在标准化定量验证基准集(QVBS)上，本算法以比先前最优基于模型方法少数个数量级的样本量收敛到最优策略。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为可达性学习的实际部署及规格引导强化学习迈出了坚实一步，表明无模型方法能够在保持渐近保证的同时显著提升效率。

title: RealCompanion: Benchmarking Human Understanding from Reasoning over Longitudinal Real-World Conversations
summary: A companion that talks with a person for months should come to understand them. It should remember what they said, infer who they are, and know when the past bears on the message in front of it. Testing this requires a real person's record, and such records are private, so benchmarks generate the person and the questions and settle in advance what matters. We release \bench, ten real relationships with an AI companion: 27,218 messages over up to 120 days, released as the conversation and four files derived from it, a profile, a persona, a chat ground truth and a question set, each citing the messages it rests on. Every chat label carries the reasoning trace that produced it, checked stage by stage against the conversation. Three findings follow. First, the past is rarely needed and far away. Pooled measures mislead: a recency window finds the required message for 95.9\% of probes and 2.2\% of those that need memory, and at the natural rate 96\% of the gain from supplying recorded evidence comes from messages that need none. Second, no detector we tried can tell when memory is needed on real messages, authored questions over the same histories leak the cue, and labeling the same messages as memories raises their use by ten to fourteen points. Third, three agent systems reconstruct the persona with the same F1 at a 31-fold difference in cost.

AI.tldr: 论文发布 BENCH 基准：10 段真实人机陪伴关系、27,218 条消息、最长 120 天，配套 profile、persona、chat ground truth 与问题集（每条均附引用消息与推理链）。三项发现：真实对话中"记忆"极少被需要且多为近期消息导致聚合指标失真；现有检测器无法判断何时需要记忆、题面会泄漏线索；三种智能体系统以 31 倍成本差达到相同 F1。
AI.motivation: 长期陪伴型 AI 应当记住用户所述、推断其人格并在相关时调用历史信息。但检验这一点需要真实用户的私人记录，无法公开；现行基准因此人工生成"人"与问题、预先规定哪些内容重要，脱离了真实语料与真实相关性分布，导致对记忆能力的评测失真。
AI.method: 构建并发布 BENCH：采集 10 段真实关系，共 27,218 条消息、历时最长 120 天。以对话及四个派生文件（profile、persona、chat ground truth、question set）形式发布，每个标签均标注其所依赖的消息及生成该标签的推理轨迹，并逐阶段与对话核对。基于该基准开展三项实验：近期窗口与记忆需求消息的覆盖率分析、记忆需求检测器测试（含作者题目线索泄漏与消息重标为记忆的对照）、以及三种智能体系统在 persona 重构上的成本—性能对比。
AI.result: 其一，历史信息很少被需要且距离较远：近期窗口可为 95.9% 的探针找到所需消息，但其中仅 2.2% 真正需要记忆；按自然分布，供给已录证据所带来收益的 96% 来自本不需要记忆的消息，聚合指标因此具有误导性。其二，在所尝试的检测器中，没有一个能在真实消息上判断何时需要记忆；作者撰写的问题在同一历史上会泄漏线索；而将相同消息标注为"记忆"可将其使用率提高 10–14 个百分点。其三，三种智能体系统在 persona 重构上取得相同的 F1，但成本相差 31 倍。
AI.conclusion: 真实性源于采用真人记录而非合成：只有真实对话才能暴露"记忆需求"的稀疏性、检测之难与线索泄漏问题，并揭示成本差异。BENCH 以可追溯标签与推理链为长期记忆评测提供可核查的基线，并提示应以自然分布下的条件性指标替代聚合指标来评估 AI 陪伴系统的记忆能力。

title: LineupRL: Verifiable Reinforcement Learning for Time Series Captioning via Caption-to-Series Identification
summary: Time series captioning is a fundamental step in time series understanding and can also serve as the bridge between signal and natural language. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) relies on a larger model's captions and cannot exceed their quality. Reinforcement learning (RL) can, but its rewards were designed for other modalities and other tasks, and they transfer poorly to open-ended generation in the time series domain. We address this by proposing LineupRL, a reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) pipeline whose reward is caption-to-series identification. The reward model is a frozen large language model (LLM) verifier that reads the generated caption and the candidate time series as raw values, never the chart, and must pick the described time series from multiple distractors. Matching is a far lighter demand on the verifier than writing questions or judging a caption, so an off-the-shelf LLM can supply the reward. Across two captioning benchmarks, and on forecasting and reconstruction where the predictor sees only the caption, LineupRL outperforms SFT and RL baselines on every metric. The 3B vision language model (VLM) trained by LineupRL also outperforms, at 1/24 of the parameters, the 72B VLM whose captions the SFT baseline is distilled from. Our case study shows that LineupRL resists reward hacking, and that the captioner it trains both traces the trend and names the values at key points.

AI.tldr: 提出LineupRL，一种基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）流水线，以"标题—序列识别"作为奖励，训练时间序列描述模型，性能超越SFT与RL基线。
AI.motivation: 时间序列描述（captioning）是连接信号与自然语言的关键环节。现有监督微调（SFT）依赖更大模型生成的标题，质量无法超越教师模型；而强化学习（RL）的奖励多针对其他模态与任务设计，迁移到时间序列领域的开放式生成时效果不佳。
AI.method: 提出LineupRL：采用可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）流水线，奖励函数为"标题到序列的识别"。奖励模型为冻结的LLM验证器，仅读取生成的标题与候选时间序列的原始数值（不看图表），需从多个干扰项中选出被描述的时间序列。识别匹配对验证器的要求远低于撰写问题或评判标题，因此可直接使用现成的LLM提供奖励。
AI.result: 在两个描述基准，以及在预测与重建任务（预测器仅看到标题）上，LineupRL在所有指标上均优于SFT与RL基线。经LineupRL训练的3B视觉语言模型（VLM）以1/24的参数规模，超越了SFT基线所蒸馏的72B VLM。案例研究显示LineupRL能抵御奖励攻击（reward hacking），其训练的描述器既能刻画趋势，又能指出关键点的数值。
AI.conclusion: 以"标题—序列识别"作为可验证奖励的RLVR方法，为时间序列描述提供了一种高效、免标注、抗奖励攻击的训练范式，且证明小型VLM可超越大型教师模型。

title: AI-assisted mitotic counting improves reproducibility and efficiency across multiple tumour types
summary: Mitotic counting is an important component of tumour grading, diagnosis and prognostic assessment across several tumour types, but manual assessment is time-consuming and subject to inter-pathologist variability. To help address these challenges, we developed MitPro, an AI tool designed to improve consistency and efficiency by directing pathologists towards regions with the highest predicted mitotic activity and highlighting mitotic figures for review, while retaining pathologist control over region selection and the final count. We evaluated its effect on the reproducibility and efficiency of mitotic counting in a retrospective, non-interventional, paired reader study comprising 385 whole-slide images from 3 centres in 3 countries and 7 tumour types using 3 different scanners. 13 pathologists participated, with each slide assessed independently by 3 pathologists without AI assistance and again with AI assistance after a minimum 2 week washout period. Across all slides, AI-assisted counting increased the intraclass correlation coefficient from 0.589 to 0.949. Mean pathologist-level median assessment time decreased from 286.4 to 127.8 seconds, corresponding to an average saving of 151.8 seconds per assessment. Improvements in agreement and efficiency were also observed in supporting analyses using HALO AP and Sectra image management systems and in 2 additional tumour types outside the main study population. AI-assisted assessment was associated with a subtle shift towards higher mitotic counts and scores, consistent with identification of more active mitotic hotspots and fewer missed mitotic figures. The frequency of score change between unassisted and AI-assisted assessment was comparable with inter-pathologist variation during routine counting. These findings support the use of MitPro as an assistive tool for more consistent and efficient mitotic assessment in routine practice.

AI.tldr: 该论文开发了AI工具MitPro，通过引导病理学家定位最高有丝分裂活性区域并标注有丝分裂象，在保留病理学家最终决定权的前提下，评估其提升有丝分裂计数一致性与效率的效果。
AI.motivation: 有丝分裂计数是多种肿瘤分级、诊断与预后评估的重要环节，但人工评估耗时且存在病理学家间差异，需要一种工具来提升一致性和效率。
AI.method: 采用回顾性、非干预性、配对读者研究，纳入3个国家3个中心的385张全切片图像，涵盖7种肿瘤类型、3种扫描仪，13位病理学家参与；每张切片由3位病理学家独立评估，先无AI辅助，经至少2周洗脱期后再借助AI辅助评估。
AI.result: AI辅助将有丝分裂计数的组内相关系数（ICC）从0.589提升至0.949；病理学家层面中位评估时间从286.4秒降至127.8秒，平均每次评估节省151.8秒；在HALO AP与Sectra系统及2种额外肿瘤类型的支持性分析中亦观察到一致性与效率的提升。
AI.conclusion: AI辅助评估伴随有丝分裂计数与评分向偏高方向轻微偏移，与识别出更多活跃的有丝分裂热点和减少遗漏有关；评分变化频率与常规计数中的病理学家间差异相当，支持MitPro作为常规实践中提升有丝分裂评估一致性与效率的辅助工具。

title: Continuous Process-Level Evaluation for Evolving Enterprise AI Agent Skills
comment: Accepted to Workshop on Continual Learning for Enterprise AI Agents (CLEA), NeurIPS 2026
summary: Enterprise AI agent skills evolve as tool APIs, models, and specifications change, yet final-output evaluation can miss process-level behavioral drift. We present a continuous evaluation framework combining outcome-level and process-level checks, applied to Revenue and Productivity variants of a Business Value Determination skill in an enterprise Value Aware Resiliency system. The framework independently computes per-run ground truth, materializes reusable template tests, and evaluates tool selection, arguments, execution order, and database integrity through programmatic checks and a narrowly scoped LLM judge. We evaluate 240 trials across two skills, two specification variants, two agent harnesses, and three models. Of 175 trials passing all applicable final numerical checks, 162 (92.6 percent; Wilson 95 percent CI: 87.7-95.6 percent) contained another evaluator-detected deviation. Under a broader seven-check final-state definition, 151 of 164 passing runs (92.1 percent; 95 percent CI: 86.9-95.3 percent) still violated a trajectory check. Dependency attribution reduced a mean of 6.34 failed checks per run to 2.65 roots. Specification sensitivity varied by model and harness, with exploratory bootstrap interaction intervals excluding zero for all three Revenue comparisons and one of three Productivity comparisons. Runtime-resolved templates provided reusable regression coverage across the evaluated configurations; longitudinal validation under actual API evolution remains future work.

AI.tldr: 提出过程级连续评估框架，揭示企业AI智能体在最终输出正确时仍广泛存在过程行为偏差。
AI.motivation: 企业AI智能体技能随工具API、模型和规范变化而演化，仅靠最终输出评估会遗漏过程层面的行为漂移，需要补充过程级检查以实现连续评估。
AI.method: 面向企业Value Aware Resiliency系统中业务价值判定技能的Revenue与Productivity变体，框架独立计算每次运行的ground truth，物化可复用模板测试，并通过程序化检查与窄范围LLM评判器评估工具选择、参数、执行顺序和数据库完整性。共240次试验，覆盖2个技能、2个规范变体、2种智能体harness和3个模型。采用依赖归因与bootstrap交互区间分析。
AI.result: 175次通过全部适用最终数值检查的试验中，162次(92.6%，Wilson 95% CI: 87.7-95.6%)存在其他评估器检测到的偏差；在更宽泛的七项最终状态定义下，164次通过中151次(92.1%，95% CI: 86.9-95.3%)仍违反轨迹检查。依赖归因将平均6.34个失败检查归约为2.65个根因。规范敏感性随模型和harness变化，Revenue的三组比较及Productivity三组中的一组的bootstrap交互区间不含零。
AI.conclusion: 最终输出通过并不代表过程合规，过程级检查能捕获大量被遗漏的行为漂移；运行时解析模板提供了跨配置的可复用回归覆盖，但真实API演化下的纵向验证仍待未来工作。

title: Not All Experience Belongs in the Weights: Component Routing for Self-Improving GUI Agents
summary: Self-improving GUI agents keep the trajectories they produce and return them to the agent, by fine-tuning or by retrieval into the prompt, and studies that compare the two destinations disagree. We attribute this to the unit of experience: a trajectory bundles items with different properties, so a conclusion about the bundle depends on its mix. To address this, (i) we introduce component routing, which splits the experience into locators, procedures, state facts and lessons and sends each component to the context or to the weights, compared on the same items across three backbone families, two environments and three seeds. One pool has two destinations: locators and lessons win in the weights, procedures and state facts in the context. (ii) We fit a rule in two properties measured before any training, recurrence and state-conditionality; it recovers the destination of a held-out backbone family in 24 of 24 cells, two interventions move a component toward the boundary, and routing by the rule beats every whole-trajectory baseline and, by +3.5 points on average, the better single destination of each backbone. (iii) We identify how training and producer-consumer differences change the value of the two destinations: note readout decreases after the same component is written into the weights, most for the items that recur most, context gains increase with the information gap, and weights gains decrease with the policy gap. Code and data will be released.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"组件路由"方法，将GUI智能体的经验拆分为定位器、流程、状态事实和教训四类组件，分别路由到权重(微调)或上下文(检索)，并发现各组件的最优目的地不同。作者用训练前的两个属性(重复性、状态条件性)拟合出一条规则来预测目的地，在留出的backbone家庭上24/24格全部命中，路由策略优于所有整体轨迹基线及单一目的地。
AI.motivation: 自改进GUI智能体将产生的轨迹返回给智能体，可通过微调写入权重或检索进提示两种方式，但已有研究对两者优劣结论不一致。作者认为根源在于"经验单元"：一条轨迹捆绑了性质不同的条目，因此关于整个捆绑的结论取决于其成分混合比例，导致结论相互矛盾。
AI.method: (i) 引入组件路由，把经验拆成定位器、流程、状态事实、教训四类组件，分别送往上下文或权重，并在三个backbone家族、两个环境、三个随机种子下对相同条目进行对照比较。(ii) 用训练前可测的两个属性——重复性与状态条件性——拟合一条规则来预测组件目的地，并通过两项干预验证规则边界，再与各类整体轨迹基线对比。(iii) 分析训练过程及生产者-消费者差异如何改变两种目的地的价值。
AI.result: 同一经验池中两目的地分工明确：定位器与教训在权重中更优，流程与状态事实在上下文中更优。拟合规则对留出的backbone家族在24/24个单元中成功预测目的地；两项干预可将组件推向边界。按规则路由优于所有整体轨迹基线，并平均比每个backbone的较优单一目的地高3.5个百分点。此外，读出的笔记在同一组件写入权重后价值下降，重复最多的条目下降最大；上下文增益随信息差增大而增加，权重增益随策略差增大而减少。
AI.conclusion: 经验的最优归置取决于组件类型而非整条轨迹，用训练前可测的重复性与状态条件性即可预测组件应进入上下文还是权重；组件路由在性能上超过整体轨迹方案与单一目的地策略，并揭示了训练与生产者-消费者差异对两种目的地价值的系统性影响。

title: Temporal-Difference Learning for Dragonchess
comment: Springer Lecture Notes in Artificial Intelligence
summary: Our research investigates how two adaptive AI methods, evolutionary transfer learning and TD(lambda), perform in the three-dimensional chess environment Dragonchess. The game challenges players with its unique board structure and computational load, making it an ideal setting to study how adaptive methods can update evaluation heuristics in novel environments. In this work we re-implement the Dragonchess engine, changing it from a PyGame engine to C++. This enables faster gameplay, allowing us to run 10,000 games with confidence intervals and significance tests, rather than a single small tournament. Both adaptive methods outperform all other agents in the round-robin tournament. Our results showed that there is no significant difference in the performance between the evolved and learned evaluations. This research establishes the efficacy of adaptive methods in structurally complex, novel game domains.

AI.tldr: 研究将Dragonchess引擎从PyGame重写为C++，并用进化迁移学习与TD(λ)两种自适应方法更新评估启发式，在大规模循环赛中验证其性能。
AI.motivation: Dragonchess具有独特棋盘结构与高计算负载，是研究自适应方法在新颖环境中更新评估启发式的理想场景，而原有PyGame实现限制了大样本与统计检验的开展。
AI.method: 重新实现Dragonchess引擎，由PyGame改为C++以获得更快对弈速度；采用进化迁移学习与TD(λ)两种自适应方法，并组织循环赛，运行10000局对局，加入置信区间与显著性检验。
AI.result: 两种自适应方法在循环赛中均优于所有其他智能体；进化评估与学习评估之间的性能差异不显著。
AI.conclusion: 自适应方法在结构复杂、新颖的博弈领域具有有效性。

title: Mapping the RAG Landscape: A Four Axis Taxonomy of Efficiency, Defense, Interactivity, and Reasoning
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable fluency across many tasks but remain limited by their static, parameter bound knowledge and their susceptibility to hallucinating information. Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) addresses these issues by incorporating external retrieval into the generation process, grounding model outputs in verifiable and up to date sources. While prior surveys primarily focus on core RAG architectures and standard pipelines, recent research explores broader challenges and capabilities that extend beyond these foundational designs. This survey provides a consolidated and structured examination of contemporary RAG developments, organizing the field into a four axis taxonomy: improving retrieval efficiency, strengthening robustness and security, supporting user driven and interactive workflows, and enabling multi step or complex reasoning. We formalize key components of the RAG framework and review methods spanning dense and sparse retrieval, fusion strategies, embedding optimizations, and reinforcement learning based retrieval policies, highlighting how these advances influence practical deployment and system design. We also synthesize evaluation practices, domain specific applications, and architectural variants such as Naive, Advanced, and Modular RAG. Finally, we outline persistent challenges related to retrieval quality, reliability, domain adaptation, scalability, and explainability, and identify opportunities for building RAG systems that are more reliable, adaptable, and transparent.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇RAG（检索增强生成）综述，提出四轴分类体系：检索效率、鲁棒性与安全性、用户驱动交互式工作流、多步复杂推理，并系统梳理组件、方法、评估实践与应用。
AI.motivation: LLM受限于静态参数化知识且易产生幻觉。RAG通过引入外部检索将输出锚定于可验证、最新的来源以缓解上述问题。既有综述多聚焦核心架构与标准流程，而近期研究已扩展到更广的挑战与能力，亟需整合性的结构化梳理。
AI.method: 采用综述性研究方法：形式化RAG框架的关键组件，构建四轴分类体系（检索效率、鲁棒性与安全、用户驱动与交互式工作流、多步或复杂推理），并综述稠密与稀疏检索、融合策略、嵌入优化、基于强化学习的检索策略等方法，同时归纳评估实践、领域应用及Naive/Advanced/Modular等架构变体。
AI.result: 给出了当代RAG发展的整合性结构化视图，阐明各方法如何影响实际部署与系统设计，并归纳了评估实践、领域特定应用与架构变体。
AI.conclusion: RAG仍面临检索质量、可靠性、领域适配、可扩展性与可解释性等持续挑战，未来机会在于构建更可靠、可适配、透明的RAG系统。

title: On the Divergence of Accuracy and Mechanism Consistency in Time Series World Models
summary: A time series world model (TSWM) predicts a controlled system's state from its observed history and planned actions and exogenous inputs. Current approaches build forecasters with actions as covariates, trained and evaluated on prediction error under the executed plan. Yet world models compare unexecuted plans, but their responses to changed plans remain untested. We ask which design choices matter and whether accurate forecasters respond to changed plans as real systems do. We address both with a formalization and benchmark. The formalization separates state, actions and exogenous inputs, distinguishes continuous, mode and event actions, and introduces mechanism consistency, a metric built on declared action-state relations with known directions, such as a vasopressor raising blood pressure: it checks whether shifting an action moves the forecast in the declared direction. The benchmark consolidates eight public datasets with real actions from engineered infrastructure and clinical care, varying prediction space, plan fusion and plan encoding across seven backbones and five seeds. First, a frozen latent prediction space lowers MAE by 9.9% over observation space and gated output fusion lowers it by 12.7% over input concatenation on average, with both improving all eight datasets; temporal plan encoding changes average MAE by at most 2.2%. Second, prediction error and mechanism consistency diverge: the lowest-error configuration is at or below chance in consistency on four of five datasets with declared mechanisms, and no design choice avoids this. Finally, directional supervision, a loss penalizing the wrong-signed part of the response to a shifted action, significantly raises consistency on penalized mechanisms with no change in MAE. Together they give TSWMs a recipe: a frozen latent space and output-side fusion for accuracy, and a training objective for mechanism consistency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出时间序列世界模型（TSWM）的形式化框架与基准，区分状态、动作与外生输入及三类动作，并提出"机制一致性"指标；实验表明冻结隐空间与输出端融合可提升精度，而精度与机制一致性相互背离，方向性监督可在不损失MAE的情况下提升一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有TSWM以动作作为协变量训练与评估，仅在已执行计划下衡量预测误差；但世界模型的核心用途是评估未执行的计划，其对计划变更的响应能力尚未被检验。因此作者追问：哪些设计选择真正重要，以及高精度预测器是否像真实系统那样对计划变更做出响应。
AI.method: 1) 形式化：将系统状态、动作与外生输入分离，区分连续型、模式型与事件型动作；引入机制一致性指标，基于已知方向的动作-状态关系（如血管升压药升高血压）检验动作偏移是否使预测沿声明方向移动。2) 基准：整合八个来自工程基础设施与临床护理、含真实动作的公开数据集，在七种骨干网络与五个随机种子上变化预测空间、计划融合与计划编码。3) 方法层面检验方向性监督（惩罚对偏移动作响应中符号错误部分的损失）。
AI.result: 冻结的隐预测空间相比观测空间平均降低MAE 9.9%，门控输出融合相比输入拼接平均降低12.7%，且二者在全部八个数据集上均有效；时间型计划编码对平均MAE影响不超过2.2%。预测误差与机制一致性出现背离：误差最低的配置在五个含声明机制的数据集中有四个的一致性处于随机水平或更低，且无任何设计选择能避免该现象。方向性监督在受惩罚机制上显著提升一致性，同时MAE不变。
AI.conclusion: TSWM的设计配方为：以冻结隐空间与输出端融合保证精度，以面向机制一致性的训练目标保证对计划变更的正确响应；精度指标不足以衡量世界模型对未执行计划的响应质量，需引入机制一致性作为补充评价维度。

title: Can AI Oversight Be Zero Knowledge?
summary:
AI systems increasingly produce outputs from confidential data, such as a fitness-for-duty assessment from medical records or the predicted properties of a drug candidate from its secret structure. It is important to verify that such outputs are correct without revealing the underlying data. A recent line of work studies verification of AI outputs via interactive proofs and debate for oracle-aided computation, where correctness may depend on an oracle such as human judgment, a physical experiment, or the web. These works focus on verification by a verifier that runs much faster than the computation. However, such efficient verification is impossible for general oracle-aided computation, and these works therefore rely on additional assumptions. We focus instead on privacy: allowing the verifier to run in time polynomial in the computation, we ask whether interactive arguments for oracle-aided computation can be zero knowledge, so that the verifier learns nothing about the confidential data beyond the correctness of the output.
  We prove that, in general, they cannot. In the random oracle model, there are no zero-knowledge proofs for all oracle-aided computations, even if both the prover and the verifier are allowed to run much longer than the computation itself. The impossibility extends to debate, a canonical model for scalable oversight.
  On the positive side, we show that if the oracle attaches a cryptographic signature to each of its answers, then every oracle-aided computation can be verified in zero knowledge with an efficient prover and verifier, assuming only collision-resistant hash functions. Beyond privacy, this also gives an alternative approach to scalable oversight that relies neither on an honest opponent, as in debate, nor on the robustness of the computation, as in prior single-prover protocols.

AI.tldr: 本文研究 oracle 辅助计算的零知识交互论证（zero-knowledge interactive arguments）是否可行：一般情形下不可行，但在 oracle 对答案附加密码学签名时，可实现高效证明者与验证者的零知识验证。
AI.motivation: AI 系统常基于机密数据（如医疗记录、药物分子结构）产生输出，需要在不泄露底层数据的前提下验证输出的正确性。已有 oracle 辅助计算的验证工作依赖验证者远快于计算方这一假设，且需额外假设；而高效验证对一般 oracle 辅助计算不可能，故本文转向隐私维度，在验证者可运行多项式时间的前提下，追问是否存在零知识交互论证。
AI.method: 采用交互论证与零知识证明的理论框架，针对 oracle 辅助计算（oracle 可为人类判断、物理实验或网络）展开不可能性证明与构造性协议设计。不可能性结果在随机预言机模型（random oracle model）下给出，并推广到 debate 模型；正面结果则在 oracle 对每个回答附加密码学签名的设定下，基于抗碰撞哈希函数构造零知识验证协议。
