AI.result: 不可能性：在随机预言机模型中，不存在适用于所有 oracle 辅助计算的零知识证明，即使证明者与验证者均可运行远长于计算本身的时间；该不可能性亦延伸至 debate 这一可扩展监督（scalable oversight）的典型模型。正面结果：若 oracle 对每个回答附加密学签名，则任何 oracle 辅助计算都可在零知识下被验证，且证明者与验证者高效，仅需假设抗碰撞哈希函数存在。
AI.conclusion: oracle 辅助计算的零知识验证在一般情形下不可实现，但通过为 oracle 回答附加密码学签名，可获得高效零知识验证方案。除隐私外，该方案还提供了不依赖诚实对手（如 debate）也不依赖计算鲁棒性（如既有单证明者协议）的可扩展监督新途径。

title: Atoms to Processes: The Role of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning in Chemical Engineering
summary: The rapid maturation of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) has catalyzed a profound shift in how chemical engineering problems are formulated, analyzed, and solved. Advances in computing, data availability, and learning algorithms have enabled AI/ML methods to impact applications spanning atomic-scale simulations, materials and catalyst discovery, transport and thermodynamics, separations, process systems engineering, and industrial operations. This article provides a perspective on recent methodological developments and representative applications, emphasizing how AI/ML tools are being integrated with first-principles models to address challenges of predictive accuracy, data scarcity, extrapolation, interpretability, and model lifecycle management. Across domains, a unifying trend is the move away from purely black-box approaches toward hybrid and physics-informed frameworks that explicitly respect conservation laws, thermodynamic consistency, and known structural constraints. These approaches not only improve robustness and reliability, but also enable meaningful human-AI collaboration by providing information at an appropriate level of abstraction for the task and decision context. We conclude that AI and ML are not replacing the core principles of chemical engineering; rather, they are amplifying them. As the field advances toward increasingly autonomous, adaptive, and sustainable systems, the thoughtful integration of AI/ML with first-principles understanding and domain expertise will be essential to realizing their full potential across both research and industrial practice.

AI.tldr: 本文以综述视角梳理AI/ML在化学工程各领域的代表性进展，指出其正从纯黑箱方法转向融合第一性原理的混合与物理信息框架，并强调AI/ML是对化学工程核心原理的增强而非替代。
AI.motivation: AI与机器学习快速成熟，正在改变化学工程问题的建模与求解方式；但纯数据驱动方法在预测精度、数据稀缺、外推能力、可解释性及模型全生命周期管理方面存在局限，因此需要审视AI/ML与领域知识结合的发展路径与前景。
AI.method: 采用观点性综述（perspective）方法，梳理AI/ML在原子尺度模拟、材料与催化剂发现、传递与热力学、分离、过程系统工程及工业运营等方向的方法学发展与典型应用，重点分析AI/ML与第一性原理模型集成的途径。
AI.result: 综述表明，AI/ML已渗透化学工程多个应用层面；跨领域的统一趋势是摒弃纯黑箱建模，转向显式遵守守恒定律、热力学一致性与已知结构约束的混合及物理信息框架，从而提升鲁棒性与可靠性，并支持人在回路的人机协同。
AI.conclusion: AI与ML并未取代化学工程的核心原理，而是对其起到放大作用；面向日益自主、自适应与可持续的系统，将AI/ML与第一性原理理解及领域专业知识审慎融合，是实现其科研与工业应用潜力的关键。

title: SPHERE: Adaptive VR Indoor Scene Generation via LLM-Enhanced Spatial Preference Learning and Human-in-the-Loop RL
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) advance 3D indoor scene synthesis, current pipelines fail to retain user-specific preferences across sessions, making immersive authoring a repetitive and physically fatiguing process. We present SPHERE, an adaptive VR generation framework that transforms isolated synthesis into continuous human-AI co-creation. SPHERE extracts persistent spatial preferences from natural multimodal interactions (speech and controller edits). To ensure geometric resilience against spatial distortions, it abstracts these raw edits into hierarchical constraints modeling both local functional and global topological contexts. Furthermore, a human-in-the-loop reinforcement learning mechanism dynamically updates retrieval policies based on the user's final edited scenes. A mixed-design user study ($N=42$) and an offline ablation demonstrate that SPHERE significantly reduces corrective edits and physical demand, preventing bias toward shallow object-level traits to yield geometrically resilient, profile-aligned layouts. Ultimately, SPHERE demonstrates how capturing demonstrated spatial logic enables controlled spatial adaptation, establishing a reliable, governed human-AI collaboration framework for immersive authoring. Project page and source code will be available at: https://github.com/hyeonmin11/SPHERE

AI.tldr: SPHERE：一个自适应VR生成框架，通过提取持久空间偏好、分层约束抽象与人在回路强化学习，将孤立的3D场景合成转化为持续的人机协同创作。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM驱动的3D室内场景合成流程无法跨会话保留用户特定偏好，导致沉浸式创作重复且身体疲劳。
AI.method: 从自然多模态交互（语音与控制手柄编辑）中提取持久空间偏好；将原始编辑抽象为同时建模局部功能与全局拓扑上下文的分层约束，以保证对空间畸变的几何鲁棒性；采用人在回路强化学习机制，依据用户最终编辑的场景动态更新检索策略。
AI.result: 混合设计用户研究（N=42）与离线消融实验表明，SPHERE显著减少纠正性编辑与身体负荷，避免偏向浅层物体级特征，生成几何鲁棒且与用户画像一致的布局。
AI.conclusion: 通过捕捉用户演示的空间逻辑，SPHERE实现了可控的空间自适应，为沉浸式创作建立了可靠、可治理的人机协作框架。

title: Counting Moves, Weighing Voices: Bayesian Dialectical Argumentation for Calibrated Multi-LLM Councils under Persistent Adversaries
summary: A multi-LLM \emph{council} lets several large language models (LLMs) deliberate on a question and return an answer together with a confidence estimate. As these systems become increasingly used for reasoning, that confidence should represent a calibrated \emph{probability of being correct}, and the decision should remain robust when some agents are persistently unreliable. Existing \emph{council aggregation} methods fail on both fronts: their confidence estimates measure decisiveness rather than correctness, and they cannot identify or discount persistently unreliable agents. We introduce Bayesian Dialectical Argumentation (BDA), which treats the council's \emph{typed} moves---who proposed, challenged, or conceded which answer---as observations of a classical annotator model with \emph{per-agent} reliabilities. This formulation recasts multi-agent deliberation as a reliability estimation problem, using the deliberation trace to infer agent reliability under persistent adversarial behavior. By weighting evidence according to inferred agent reliability, BDA yields calibrated posterior probabilities over candidate answers while allowing persistently unreliable agents to be inverted rather than merely outvoted. Across binary and multi-class benchmarks, BDA achieves the best calibration among zero-cost council aggregation methods, requiring no additional LLM calls, and improves robustness under persistent adversarial coalitions while remaining competitive in clean settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出贝叶斯辩证论证（BDA），将多LLM议会中带类型的发言视为经典标注者模型的观测，通过推断每个代理的可靠性对证据进行加权，从而得到校准的后验置信并识别持续不可靠的代理。
AI.motivation: 多LLM议会系统日益用于推理任务，其返回的置信应表示校准的"正确概率"，并在部分代理持续不可靠时保持鲁棒。然而现有议会聚合方法存在两方面缺陷：置信估计衡量的是决断性而非正确性；且无法识别并折减持续不可靠的代理。
AI.method: BDA将议会中带类型的动作（谁提出/质疑/认可哪个答案）建模为具有每代理可靠性的经典标注者模型的观测，把多代理审议重构为可靠性估计问题，利用审议轨迹推断代理在持续对抗行为下的可靠性；再依据推断出的代理可靠性对证据加权，从而给出候选答案上的校准后验概率，并使持续不可靠的代理可被"反转"而非仅被多数压制。
AI.result: 在二分类与多分类基准上，BDA在零额外成本的议会聚合方法中取得最佳校准效果；无需额外LLM调用；在持续对抗联盟下鲁棒性提升，同时干净场景中保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: BDA通过可靠性估计视角统一了多代理审议的置信校准与对抗鲁棒性问题，以零额外LLM调用代价实现更优校准与对抗鲁棒性，为议会聚合提供了可解释且高效的方案。

title: Mimir: Physics-Grounded LLM Agents for Long-Horizon Irrigation Control
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly combine reasoning, tool use, and action, but most evidence comes from episodic tasks with relatively immediate feedback and reset failures. Long-running physical control operates in a different regime: actions alter future states, errors compound across decisions, and an agent must improve from experience without being allowed to rewrite the physical rules that make execution safe. We study this regime through irrigation, where daily decisions interact with soil-water dynamics over entire growing seasons. We present Mimir, a physics-grounded LLM agent organized around two repair timescales. At the fast timescale, a structured physical interface and deterministic simulator turn an LLM output into a proposal that we numerically check, revise, and subject to bounded deterministic action selection before execution. At the slow timescale, recurrent failure patterns are consolidated into persistent contextual principles that condition future proposals, while the physical model, evaluator, and execution constraints remain immutable. Under a common retrospective evaluator across multiple sites, crops, and years, Mimir attains the lowest reported aggregate control cost among the evaluated references and uses about 51% less irrigation than the historical schedule replay. The ablation study show higher control cost when forward simulation, verified revision, or persistent context is removed; model-scale and model-family studies show no monotonic gain from increasing LLM size. The resulting lesson show that persistent physical agents can combine semantic reasoning with bounded, evidence-driven self-improvement while reserving physical truth and actuator authority for explicit numerical mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Mimir——一个物理接地的 LLM 智能体，围绕快慢两个修复时间尺度设计，在灌溉长期物理控制任务上取得最低综合控制成本，并比历史排程回放少用约 51% 灌溉量。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体的证据多来自回合制任务，反馈及时、失败可重置；而长期物理控制处于不同情境：动作改变未来状态、误差跨决策累积、智能体须从经验中改进但不能改写保障执行安全的物理规则。论文以灌溉为例研究这一情境。
AI.method: Mimir 采用双时间尺度修复机制。快时间尺度：结构化物理接口与确定性模拟器将 LLM 输出转为候选方案，经数值校验、修订，并在有界确定性动作选择后再执行。慢时间尺度：将反复出现的失败模式固化为持久上下文原则以约束未来提案，而物理模型、评估器与执行约束保持不可变。
AI.result: 在跨多站点、多作物、多年的统一回溯评估器下，Mimir 在所评估参照中获得最低的综合控制成本，灌溉量比历史排程回放少约 51%。消融研究表明，移除前向模拟、验证修订或持久上下文均导致控制成本上升；模型规模与模型家族研究表明，增大 LLM 规模并无单调增益。
AI.conclusion: 持久性物理智能体可将语义推理与有界、证据驱动的自我改进相结合，同时把物理真实性与执行器权限保留给显式数值机制。

title: External Observers May See More Clearly: Cross-Model Span-Level Hallucination Detection in Large Language Models via Hidden State Probing
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly serve as foundational reasoning engines, their tendency to hallucinate remains a critical vulnerability. While recent internal state probes offer a promising alternative to slow external retrieval systems, they largely reduce hallucination detection to a token-wise binary classification task, failing to capture the structured, sequential boundaries of semantic drift. Here, we introduce an internal hidden state framework for fine-grained, span-level hallucination detection. By inspecting layer-wise activation patterns, we attempt to detect the exact hallucination onset and continuation tokens in an LLM generation. Our experiments show that this approach successfully isolates hallucination onsets, achieving substantial improvements in Precision-Recall AUC over random baselines despite extreme class imbalance. Ultimately, we propose a novel cross-model detection framework in which one model observes the internal representations elicited by another model's generation. We find that an external observer can match or exceed a generator's self-detection of its own hallucination onsets, including when the observer is the smaller model, suggesting that self-detection is not the ceiling for onset localisation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于内部隐状态的细粒度、span级幻觉检测框架，可定位LLM生成中幻觉的起始与延续token，并进一步提出跨模型检测框架，发现外部观察者模型的检测能力可匹配甚至超越生成模型的自检能力。
AI.motivation: LLM作为基础推理引擎时，幻觉仍是关键脆弱点；现有内部状态探针虽快于外部检索，但多将幻觉检测简化为token级二分类，无法刻画语义漂移的结构化、序列化边界，且缺乏对幻觉起始点的精确定位。
AI.method: 1. 构建内部隐状态框架，检查逐层激活模式，实现span级细粒度幻觉检测；2. 检测LLM生成中的幻觉起始（onset）与延续（continuation）token；3. 提出跨模型检测框架，用一个模型观察另一模型生成时所激发的内部表征，并比较不同规模观察者与生成者自检的表现。
AI.result: 该方法成功分离出幻觉起始点，在极端类别不平衡条件下，Precision-Recall AUC相较随机基线取得显著提升；跨模型实验表明，外部观察者可匹配或超越生成模型对自身幻觉起始点的自检，且当观察者为更小模型时该结论依然成立。
AI.conclusion: 自检并非幻觉起始定位的性能上限；通过跨模型观察内部表征，可有效提升或持平幻觉起始检测能力，为细粒度幻觉检测提供了新方向。

title: Global Coherence: When Every Agent Is Right and the Team Is Still Wrong - A Local-to-Global Semantic Foundation for Multi-Agent Collaboration
summary:
AI agents can each make locally valid decisions yet jointly produce an invalid result. We call this the global coherence problem: a failure of shared state, not merely of model intelligence.
  Our Observation-Aliasing Impossibility Theorem gives the exact boundary. A policy can guarantee a valid action exactly when all worlds producing the same observation share an admissible action. If k indistinguishable worlds require pairwise-disjoint actions, the best randomized worst-case success is 1/k; more reasoning, roles, messages, or samples cannot recover the missing distinction. A stronger model can reason better within its context, but it cannot see beyond it.
  We then give local-to-global runtime semantics X = (H, C, G, F; D): topology H records overlapping scopes; category C governs state-changing actions; groupoid G retains reversible translations; sheaf F tests whether local views glue into one world; and minimal history D keeps only distinctions that alter legal futures. Models propose; the harness owns shared state and governs commit.
  Nine studies test both the failure and its boundary. On a controlled revision benchmark, the same frontier model scores 40/40 when the deciding event is visible; when it is hidden, tested arms score 12--17/40, consistent with chance (1/3); restoring one authoritative fact returns 40/40. On TeamBench, ordinary teams exceed a shared budget in 5/5 runs, a visible live count leaves 4/5 violations, and commit enforcement leaves 0/5. In tau2-bench Telecom, current-state checks score 0.07 after silent reverts, while the harness scores 1.00. Where a conventional solver already owns the complete relevant state, it ties the harness as predicted. The counterintuitive conclusion is that local intelligence cannot substitute for missing global state.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"全局一致性"问题及其形式化边界：当多个不可区分的世界需要互斥动作时，任何策略的最坏随机成功率上限为1/k，增加推理、角色、消息或采样都无法弥补缺失的状态区分；作者给出局部到全局运行时语义X=(H,C,G,F;D)，强调共享状态应由外部harness掌控提交，并用九项实验证明缺失全局状态无法由局部智能替代。
AI.motivation: AI agents可各自做出局部有效的决策，却联合产生无效结果。作者将这种失败归因于共享状态的缺失，而非模型智能不足，因此需要刻画"局部智能无法弥补全局状态"的精确边界，并给出可执行的运行时机制。
AI.method: 理论部分给出Observation-Aliasing Impossibility Theorem确定有效动作可保证的精确边界，并构造局部到全局运行时语义X=(H,C,G,F;D)：拓扑H记录重叠作用域，范畴C约束状态变更动作，groupoid G保留可逆变换，sheaf F检验局部视图能否粘合为统一世界，最小历史D只保留影响合法未来的区分；架构上模型只负责提议，harness拥有共享状态并掌管提交。实验部分设计九项研究，覆盖受控修订基准、TeamBench和tau2-bench Telecom，对比隐藏/可见关键事件、预算超限、静默回滚等条件。
AI.result: 受控修订基准中，同一前沿模型在决策事件可见时得40/40，隐藏时测试组仅12--17/40（与1/3随机水平一致），恢复单一权威事实后回到40/40；TeamBench中普通团队5/5次超预算，显示实时计数仍4/5违规，提交强制后0/5违规；tau2-bench Telecom中静默回滚后当前状态检查仅0.07，而harness达1.00；当传统求解器已拥有完整相关状态时，其表现与harness相当，符合理论预测。
AI.conclusion: 局部智能无法替代缺失的全局状态。观测混叠造成的不可区分性设定了策略成功的硬性上限，唯有通过显式的共享状态、粘合检验与提交控制（即harness机制）才能实现全局一致性。

title: HydroJEV: A one-second, training-free screen for cyber-attack and fault attribution in water distribution networks
summary: When a SCADA alarm is raised in a water distribution network, operators must decide quickly whether it reflects a cyberattack, a physical fault, a normal transient or a faulty sensor. Supervised classifiers need labelled incidents that utilities rarely have, and frontier large language models (LLMs) take tens of seconds per decision. We tested whether Jev, a training-free model that returns class probabilities in about one second, can serve as the first tier of this triage. On a four-class cause-attribution benchmark built on the C-Town network in EPANET, Jev was compared with a hand-written rule tree, a supervised classifier and seven cloud LLMs on identical evidence in four sealed, pre-registered rounds. With only a label-free prior correction, Jev matched the rule tree (macro-F1 0.62-0.64 against 0.56-0.61 in distribution) and exceeded the supervised classifier by 0.36-0.42 on event subtypes absent from its labels, in all four rounds, and it outperformed the classifier whenever fewer than about four labelled events per class were available. Jev also decided 20-40 times faster than frontier LLMs. Accepting only benign Jev verdicts confirmed by the rule tree spared an LLM reviewer 35-38% of windows on fresh sealed sets without loss of macro-F1. Transferred unchanged to two further networks, this gated cascade stayed within the non-inferiority margin of its reviewer on all four sets. A fast, training-free screen can therefore take over about a third of the review load in SCADA anomaly triage while preserving the accuracy of deliberate review.

AI.tldr: 本文检验了免训练模型Jev能否作为SCADA告警分诊的第一层筛选，在四轮预注册密封测试中，Jev用约1秒返回类别概率，匹配规则树、超越监督分类器，并比前沿大模型快20-40倍；经规则树门控后可为LLM复核者减少35-38%的窗口且不损失精度。
AI.motivation: 供水管网SCADA告警触发后，操作员需快速判断其源于网络攻击、物理故障、正常瞬态还是传感器故障。监督分类器依赖公用事业很少拥有的标注事件，而前沿大模型（LLM）每次决策耗时数十秒，因此在分诊流程中需要一种快速、无需训练的第一层筛选手段。
AI.method: 在EPANET的C-Town网络构建四类原因归因基准，将免训练模型Jev与手写规则树、监督分类器及七个云端LLM在相同证据下比较，采用四轮密封、预注册的评估协议；仅加入无标签的先验校正，并设计规则树门控级联，再原样迁移至另外两个网络验证非劣效性。
AI.result: Jev匹配规则树（分布内macro-F1为0.62-0.64，规则树为0.56-0.61），在其标签中缺失的事件子类上比监督分类器高出0.36-0.42，且在四轮中均成立；当每类可用的标注事件少于约四个时，Jev优于该分类器，决策速度比前沿LLM快20-40倍。仅接受经规则树确认的良性Jev判定，可在新的密封集上为LLM复核者节省35-38%的窗口且不损失macro-F1；迁移到两个额外网络后，该门控级联在全部四组数据上均处于其复核者的非劣效边界内。
AI.conclusion: 快速、免训练的筛选模型可在SCADA异常分诊中承担约三分之一的复核负荷，同时保持审慎人工/大模型复核的准确率。

title: Causal Memory Policy: Making Memory Utility Identifiable by Intervening on Retrieval
summary: Memory-augmented large language models must decide which memories to retain, and recent systems do so by estimating each memory's effect on task performance. However, these estimates rely entirely on retrieved memories. When a memory is never retrieved, store-level interventions produce identical outcomes, leaving its utility unidentified. This is a retrieval-level positivity violation, invisible to diagnostics that examine only memory operations. We introduce Causal Memory Policy (CMP), a causal framework that restores identification by intervening on retrieval itself, reserving a fixed number of context slots for memories sampled with known propensities. CMP estimates memory utility by self-normalized inverse propensity weighting under a balanced assignment design. We prove the causal factorization of memory utility through retrieval, the unbiasedness and exact variance of the estimator, and the optimal decision rule under irreversible operations. Empirically, identification fails for 54% of required memories on LongMemEval and 67% on LoCoMo, and the failure persists in a deployed memory system. CMP improves discrimination between required and non-required memories from 0.54 to 0.66 AUC. Finally, we show that identified memory utility alone is insufficient for retention decisions: per-query utility reaches 0.78 AUC on the query for which it is estimated, yet no aggregation available to a retention policy predicts a memory's value on unseen queries. Code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/cmp-release-D0C3/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出因果记忆策略（CMP），通过在检索环节施加干预（预留固定上下文槽位并以已知倾向性采样记忆），解决了因检索层面阳性违反而导致的记忆效用不可识别问题，并给出了估计量的无偏性证明与最优决策规则。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆增强大语言模型通过估计每条记忆对任务性能的影响来决定保留哪些记忆，但这类估计完全依赖被检索到的记忆。当某条记忆从未被检索时，无论是否进行存储层面的干预，结果都完全相同，其效用无法被识别。这构成"检索层面的阳性违例"，且仅检查记忆操作的诊断方法无法发现该问题。实验显示，在 LongMemEval 上有 54%、在 LoCoMo 上有 67% 的必需记忆无法被识别，该失败在已部署的记忆系统中依然存在。
AI.method: 提出因果记忆策略（Causal Memory Policy, CMP）这一因果框架：直接对检索本身进行干预，为记忆采样预留固定数量的上下文槽位，并以已知倾向性（propensity）进行采样；在平衡分配设计下，采用自归一化逆倾向加权（self-normalized inverse propensity weighting）估计记忆效用。理论部分证明了记忆效用经由检索的因果分解、估计量的无偏性与精确方差，以及不可逆操作下的最优决策规则。
AI.result: 识别失败普遍存在：LongMemEval 上 54%、LoCoMo 上 67% 的必需记忆无法识别，已部署系统亦然。CMP 将必需记忆与非必需记忆的区分能力从 0.54 AUC 提升至 0.66 AUC。此外实验表明，仅凭已被识别的记忆效用仍不足以支撑保留决策：逐查询效用在被估计的那个查询上可达 0.78 AUC，但保留策略可用的任何聚合方式都无法预测该记忆在未见查询上的价值。
AI.conclusion: 记忆效用的因果识别必须干预检索环节，而非仅干预存储操作；CMP 通过倾向性采样与逆倾向加权恢复了识别性并提升了记忆区分能力。但识别出的效用本身并不足以支撑记忆保留决策，因为单查询效用无法聚合为对未见查询价值的有效预测，这揭示了记忆保留问题中"识别"与"泛化"两个独立难题。

title: PyPottery: an AI-powered end-to-end suite for pottery processing and publication
summary: The study of ceramic materials constitutes a cornerstone of archaeological research, yet the post-production workflow for pottery documentation remains labor-intensive and creates significant publication bottlenecks. This paper presents PyPottery, an open-source, AI-powered suite designed to semi-automate the complete ceramic documentation pipeline. The suite comprises four integrated modules: PyPotteryScan for automated image extraction and handwriting recognition; PyPotteryInk for automatic inking of pencil drawings; PyPotteryTrace for semantically-aware vectorization; and PyPotteryLayout for automated layout generation. Evaluated on 50 hand-drawn sheets containing 240 pottery drawings from the Terramara di Montale (Italy), the framework achieved substantial time savings confirmed by usability study participants, who reported a median perceived speedup of 40$\times$ over traditional workflows (range: 17.5$\times$--120$\times$). These results highlight the potential of AI-assisted tools in archaeological documentation, while the paper addresses the strategic redistribution of cognitive labor toward augmentation rather than automation.

AI.tldr: PyPottery 是一套开源 AI 工具套件，通过四个集成模块半自动化陶器记录全流程，在 240 幅陶器绘图样本上实现了约 40 倍的中位感知加速。
AI.motivation: 陶器材料研究是考古学的基石，但制陶记录的事后工作流程劳动密集，造成严重的出版瓶颈。作者希望借助 AI 半自动化整个记录流程，缓解人力负担。
AI.method: 提出开源 AI 套件 PyPottery，包含四个集成模块：PyPotteryScan（自动图像提取与手写识别）、PyPotteryInk（铅笔图自动上墨）、PyPotteryTrace（语义感知矢量化）、PyPotteryLayout（自动版式生成）。在意大利 Terramara di Montale 的 50 张手绘图纸、共 240 幅陶器绘图上进行评估，并结合可用性研究。
AI.result: 框架实现显著时间节省，可用性研究参与者报告相较传统工作流的中位感知加速为 40 倍（范围 17.5–120 倍）。
AI.conclusion: 结果体现了 AI 辅助工具在考古记录中的潜力；论文同时探讨认知劳动的战略性再分配，强调以“增强”而非“替代”为导向。

title: SW-KAN: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks with Stieltjes-Wigert q-Orthogonal Polynomials
comment: 22 pages, Code and pretrained models available at: https://github.com/amirhoseinazarpour/SW-KAN
summary: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) represent a paradigmatic shift in deep learning by replacing fixed node activations with learnable univariate functions on edges, offering enhanced interpretability and parameter efficiency. While recent polynomial-based KAN variants have addressed the computational overhead of original B-spline implementations, they introduce a fundamental yet underexplored challenge: the domain mismatch between unbounded real-valued inputs and the bounded or semi-infinite support of orthogonal polynomial bases. To address this limitation, we propose the Stieltjes-Wigert Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (SW-KAN), a novel architecture that employs Stieltjes-Wigert q-orthogonal polynomials defined on the semi-infinite domain (0, infinity). We introduce a smooth exponential-of-tanh mapping that stably bridges the domain gap while preserving well-conditioned gradients, and leverage a numerically stable three-term recurrence that evaluates polynomial expansions in O(N) operations without special-function calls. Through comprehensive experiments spanning image classification and continuous function approximation, we demonstrate that SW-KAN achieves superior accuracy-efficiency trade-offs across diverse tasks. The log-normal weight structure and learnable q-parameter of Stieltjes-Wigert polynomials provide a distinct inductive bias that enables robust performance under resource-constrained conditions, including reduced feature dimensionality and limited training data. The proposed architecture not only outperforms established polynomial KAN baselines on standard benchmarks but also exhibits strong representational capacity for approximating complex multivariate functions with remarkably few parameters, making it a compelling alternative for efficient function approximation and classification in resource-constrained settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SW-KAN，用定义在半无限区间 (0,∞) 的 Stieltjes-Wigert q-正交多项式替代固定节点激活，通过指数-of-tanh 映射弥合无界输入与多项式支集的域失配，在图像分类与函数逼近任务上取得更优的精度-效率权衡。
AI.motivation: 原始 KAN 的 B 样条实现计算开销大；已有的多项式 KAN 变体虽降低开销，却存在无界实数输入与正交多项式有界/半无限支集之间的域失配问题，该挑战尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 采用定义在 (0,∞) 半无限域的 Stieltjes-Wigert q-正交多项式；引入 smooth exponential-of-tanh 映射稳定弥合域差距并保持良态梯度；使用数值稳定的三项递推在 O(N) 复杂度内求值多项式展开，无需调用特殊函数；利用对数正态权重结构与可学习 q 参数提供归纳偏置。
AI.result: 在图像分类与连续函数逼近的综合实验中，SW-KAN 在多种任务上实现优于现有多项式 KAN 基线的精度-效率权衡；在降维特征、有限训练数据等资源受限条件下表现稳健，并能以极少参数逼近复杂多元函数。
AI.conclusion: SW-KAN 有效解决了多项式 KAN 的域失配问题，兼顾可解释性与参数效率，是资源受限场景下高效函数逼近与分类的有力替代方案。

title: Homomorphic Advantage Operator: Stabilizing Reinforcement Learning Under Fully Homomorphic Encryption Constraints
summary: Privacy-preserving machine learning presents significant deployment challenges on the cloud for intelligent systems with confidential data. Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) offers a compelling solution for secure computation, preserving data confidentiality of cloud computations. However, applying FHE to reinforcement learning (RL) requires replacing non-linear operations with polynomial approximations, which diverge catastrophically due to a unique recursive error phenomenon known as the Bellman drift. This article introduces the Homomorphic Advantage Operator (HAO), a stabilization framework designed to prevent polynomial approximation divergence in FHE-based deep RL. HAO adapts the zero-mean centering projection from advantage-based value estimation directly to temporal-difference (TD) targets. This linear projection annihilates the uniform state-value baseline that drives the Bellman drift, maintaining per-state action rankings while requiring zero additional non-linear multiplicative depth and avoiding expensive ciphertext bootstrapping. The proposed HAO framework was evaluated using a three-tier experimental methodology, including a tabular Markov Decision Process (MDP), an encrypted CartPole environment using real CKKS cryptographic operations, and a 20-node logistics routing benchmark with dense continuous features. The results demonstrate that the proposed HAO strictly bounds network pre-activations within the safe polynomial approximation domain. The proposed HAO RL agents achieved 0% boundary breaches across all random seeds used, whereas regularization alone (L2 weight decay and gradient clipping) breached the bound on 3 of 5 seeds and the unstabilized baseline did so in 83.8% of episodes. Finally, HAO agents improve optimal policy accuracy by 18.0 percentage points in tabular domains and remain stable when DP-SGD-style Gaussian noise is added to the clipped gradients.

AI.tldr: 本文提出同态优势算子（HAO），通过将优势估计中的零均值中心化投影直接作用于时序差分目标，抑制FHE深度强化学习中的多项式近似发散（Bellman漂移），在不增加非线性乘法深度和无需密文自举的前提下实现稳定训练。
AI.motivation: 在云端智能系统中，隐私保护机器学习面临部署难题。全同态加密（FHE）可支持保密计算，但将FHE应用于强化学习时，非线性操作必须替换为多项式近似，而同态加密下的递归误差（Bellman漂移）会导致近似灾难性发散。现有正则化手段（L2权重衰减、梯度裁剪）不足以稳定该发散。
AI.method: 提出同态优势算子（HAO）稳定框架：将基于优势的价值估计中的零均值中心化投影直接迁移到TD目标上。该线性投影消除驱动Bellman漂移的均匀状态价值基线，同时保持每状态的动作排序，且不引入额外非线性乘法深度、避免昂贵的密文自举。评估采用三层实验设计：表格MDP、使用真实CKKS加密运算的CartPole环境，以及含稠密连续特征的20节点物流路径规划基准。
AI.result: HAO严格将网络预激活值约束在多项式近似的安全域内：在所用全部随机种子下实现0%边界越界；仅用正则化（L2权重衰减与梯度裁剪）在5个种子中有3个越界，未稳定基线在83.8%的回合中越界。HAO智能体在表格域中将最优策略准确率提升18.0个百分点，且在裁剪梯度上加入DP-SGD式高斯噪声后仍保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: HAO通过线性中心化投影有效抑制Bellman漂移引起的多项式近似发散，在不增加乘法深度与自举开销的情况下显著提升FHE深度强化学习的稳定性与策略准确率，并兼容差分隐私噪声，为云端保密强化学习提供了可行方案。

title: Four Ways to Grow a Classifier and Why One of Them Cannot Learn
comment: 10 pages, 4 tables. Code and measurement scripts: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22718897
summary:
Constructive classifiers add structure while they train: a level to a tree, a unit to a hidden layer, a split at a leaf. This paper asks what each of four such growth decisions actually buys, measured under one fixed protocol in tree-structured and constructive models, and gives an exact diagnosis and a fix for the one that buys nothing.
  The diagnosis concerns the most natural way to deepen a soft decision tree: turn every leaf into a gate whose two children inherit the parent's class distribution, so that the function is unchanged. I prove that this leaves the gradient of every new gate identically zero and, with the gate at 1/2, gives the two children identical gradients, so the added level can never learn. Unlike the symmetry that Net2Net breaks with noise or the saddle point that splitting steepest descent escapes with second-order information, first-order information here is not weak but absent. Over three seeds of five-fold cross-validation the construction loses 19.6 accuracy points on Iris, 19.1 on Wine and 55.6 on Digits against the same depth trained from scratch. The fix is a small random perturbation of the children, whose size barely matters. The practical rule is one line in a test: after adding parameters, assert that their gradient is nonzero.
  The other three decisions each buy one thing. Fitting a new hidden unit to the residual error before installing it buys a smaller network on every dataset, though not a more accurate one, and on Digits it costs accuracy significantly. Splitting the leaf with the largest expected error buys sparsity, reaching 0.885 with 3.7 splits where a complete depth-six tree uses 63, but loses 4.3 points on a harder problem. Requiring statistical significance before a node receives a more expressive split buys nothing: the tree gets larger and less accurate.
  Every number in the paper is inserted from the measurement script.

AI.tldr: 本文在同一实验协议下考察四种构造式/树结构模型的"增长决策"各自带来什么收益，并对其中毫无收益的一种（软决策树加深）给出精确诊断与修复方案。
AI.motivation: 构造式分类器在训练过程中不断添加结构（树加一层、隐层加一个单元、叶子处加一个分裂）。本文追问：这些增长决策究竟各自"买到了"什么，特别是哪一种买不到任何东西，并解释其原因。
AI.method: 采用固定协议，在树结构与构造式模型上比较四种增长决策：(1) 将软决策树每个叶子变成门、两个子节点继承父节点类别分布以加深树；(2) 将新隐单元先拟合残差再安装；(3) 分裂期望误差最大的叶子；(4) 要求统计显著性才允许更富表达力的分裂。对第一种给出梯度分析并做三seed五折交叉验证，提出随机扰动修复。
AI.result: 加深软决策树的构造使每个新门梯度恒为零且两子节点梯度相同（门在1/2处），无法学习；相比同深度从头训练，Iris损失19.6、Wine损失19.1、Digits损失55.6个精度点，小幅随机扰动即可修复，扰动大小几乎无关。残差拟合隐单元使网络更小但不更准，在Digits上显著降准。分裂最大期望误差叶子带来稀疏性（3.7次分裂达0.885，而完整深度六树需63次），但在更难问题上损失4.3点。要求统计显著性不带来任何收益，树更大且更不准。
AI.conclusion: 四种增长决策中三种各有其收益（更小网络、稀疏性），一种（自然加深软决策树）一无所获，原因是新参数梯度恒为零；实用规则是：添加参数后断言其梯度非零。

title: Useful to Whom? Sample Value Is Defined Only Relative to the Learner
summary: What kind of data does a model need in order to learn? Coreset selection makes this question concrete: under a budget, keep the samples most useful for training. Easy-first and geometric coverage criteria can win in different budget regimes, separated by a crossover boundary. We ask whether this boundary is fixed by the data or changes with the target learner. Controlled experiments freeze the selected subsets and manipulate only the training learner. On low-resolution ImageNet-100, doubling ResNet-18's width moves the crossover from 57 to 85 samples per class: the learner changes the relative value of the same samples. A wider sweep reveals an interaction between input grid and capacity. Enlarging the grid while retaining the same image information shifts the boundary left, and this shift weakens as width increases. Stride controls reproduce and reverse the grid effect without changing the input grid; removing only the last downsampling stride is sufficient to recover the leftward shift. Under the native-224px ImageNet-1k protocol, width effects are smaller and depend on the probe: LFrac remains nearly flat, while EL2N shifts modestly right. Swapping the convolutional learning system for a ViT makes coverage win throughout the measured range, even when the easy subsets come from the convolutional proxy. These results establish learner dependence through frozen-subset interventions and identify network structure that can move the boundary. They do not yield a universal scaling law. Their practical implication is direct: a selection strategy's preferred budget regime must be evaluated with respect to the target learner.

AI.tldr: 核集选择的"易样本优先"与"几何覆盖"准则之间的交叉边界并非由数据固定，而随目标学习器（宽度、输入网格、步幅、架构）变化。
AI.motivation: 核集选择研究通常假定选样准则的优劣（易样本优先 vs 几何覆盖）由数据特性决定，但作者质疑该交叉边界是否固定，还是随目标学习器而变，从而需要受控实验加以检验。
AI.method: 采用冻结子集干预：固定已选子集，仅操纵训练学习器。在低分辨率 ImageNet-100 上改变 ResNet-18 宽度、输入网格与下采样步幅；并在原生 224px ImageNet-1k 协议下测试宽度效应；同时将卷积学习系统替换为 ViT。
AI.result: 在低分辨率 ImageNet-100 上，将 ResNet-18 宽度加倍使交叉点从每类 57 个样本移到 85 个；扩大输入网格（信息量不变）使边界左移，且该效应随宽度增加而减弱；仅移除最后一个下采样步幅即可复现左移。原生 224px ImageNet-1k 下宽度效应较小且依赖探针（LFrac 近乎平坦，EL2N 略右移）。换成 ViT 后，覆盖准则在测量范围内全面占优，即便易样本子集来自卷积代理。
AI.conclusion: 结果通过冻结子集干预确立了选样准则的学习器依赖性，并指认了可移动该边界的网络结构因素；但并未给出普适缩放律。实践含义明确：选择策略偏好的预算区间必须相对于目标学习器来评估。

title: Nous: Learning and Certifying Memory Decisions Before Source Calibration
comment: 19 pages, 3 figures; code and reproducibility package available at https://github.com/Pranavsingh431/nous-state/tree/main/research/decision-certification
summary: Belief-based agent memory needs reliable decisions about current state, yet its evidence may be noisy, copied, or stale. Must a memory calibrate its sources before it can improve its decisions? We separate learning, calibration, and revision certification. On one four-model hidden Markov family, learning an unknown Bayes decision requires Theta(l^-2) records and certifying its improvement over an informative incumbent takes O(l^-2) fresh records from the same observation law, while fixed-precision source estimation requires Theta(l^-4) as persistence l vanishes. Thus learning and certifying useful decisions can require quadratically fewer records than source calibration. A broader model class retains the decision rate and source lower bound. Under an unknown identity-plus-background report channel, we characterize the sharp identified interval for policy improvement and derive a finite-sample certificate using observable witness regions, without pure-class anchors. A robustness extension tolerates bounded history-dependent misspecification and conditional copying; split-trained witnesses apply to arbitrary history spaces with explicit power conditions. We integrate policy-bound receipts with Nous Dimensions and test 45,000 held-out mutable-state histories and 9,000 episodes in three external MiniGrid memory environments with an introduced noisy-report interface. The new certificate accepts 9/9 improvements over a constant incumbent and 4/9 over last-write-wins, versus none for the earlier certificate in MiniGrid. Strong established inference baselines remain competitive or better. The result is a statistical account of when memory decisions can be learned and justified without recovering source reliability, not a universally superior memory algorithm.

AI.tldr: 本文区分了记忆系统的"学习、校准、修订认证"三类问题，证明在隐马尔可夫族中学习并认证有效决策所需样本量（Θ(l⁻²)）可比估计信息源精度（Θ(l⁻⁴)）少平方级，并给出无需恢复源可靠性的有限样本认证方法。
AI.motivation: 基于信念的智能体记忆在证据含噪、复制或过期时需做出可靠的状态决策，但传统观点认为必须先校准信息源可靠性才能改进决策。作者质疑这一必要性，探究"记忆能否在不恢复源可靠性的前提下学习并证明决策改进"。
AI.method: 将学习、校准与修订认证分离；在四模型隐马尔可夫族上给出样本复杂度下界与上界；在未知"身份加背景"报告信道下刻画策略改进的锐利可识别区间，并用可观测见证区域构造有限样本证书；扩展到有界历史依赖误设与条件复制，采用分裂训练见证，适用于任意历史空间；结合策略界凭证与 Nous Dimensions，在 45,000 条可变状态历史及 3 个 MiniGrid 环境中验证。
AI.result: 学习未知贝叶斯决策需 Θ(l⁻²) 条记录，认证其相对信息性基准的改进需 O(l⁻²) 条同观测律新记录，而固定精度源估计需 Θ(l⁻⁴)；更广模型类保留决策速率与源下界。新证书在 MiniGrid 中接受 9/9 相对常数基准的改进、4/9 相对 last-write-wins 的改进，旧证书接受数为零；强基线方法仍具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 本文给出了"何时可在不恢复源可靠性的情况下学习并证明记忆决策"的统计解释，而非一种普适更优的记忆算法。学习与认证有效决策的样本代价可远低于源校准。

title: The Weakest Link: Distilling LLM Reasoning with Worst-Case Constrained Reinforcement Learning
summary: Distilling the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) into smaller students is a central challenge for efficient deployment. Current approaches face a fundamental tension: optimizing purely for verifiable task rewards (e.g., via GRPO) leads to reward hacking, where students arrive at correct final answers through flawed intermediate logic, while regularizing with soft divergence penalties against a teacher (e.g., KL-based distillation) dilutes task performance and, critically, allows the student to compensate for severe logical violations at one step with high teacher agreement at others. We argue that this averaging is fundamentally misaligned with the nature of reasoning: a chain-of-thought is only as valid as its weakest link. Motivated by this observation, we formulate reasoning distillation as a constrained reinforcement learning problem in which the task reward is maximized subject to a worst-case constraint on the teacher log-likelihood along every prefix of the trajectory. To avoid the prohibitive cost of dual Lagrangian solvers and the test-time teacher dependence of state-augmented methods such as Saute, we derive an unaugmented constrained MDP whose reward transformation preserves the hard-constraint semantics, admits a low-variance policy gradient decomposition into single-step and long-term terms, and provably satisfies the worst-case constraint almost surely in the penalty limit. Through extensive experiments on mathematical reasoning and code generation tasks, we demonstrate that our method significantly expands the accuracy-fidelity Pareto front. By matching the high Final Answer Correctness of pure RL and drastically reducing teacher constraint violations, we ultimately achieve the highest rigorous Reasoning Success Rate across all evaluated settings.

AI.tldr: 该论文将推理蒸馏建模为带最坏情况教师约束的受限强化学习问题，提出一种无需增广状态、保留硬约束语义的奖励变换方法，显著扩展了准确率-保真度帕累托前沿。
AI.motivation: 现有推理蒸馏存在两难：纯任务奖励优化（如GRPO）导致奖励劫持，学生以错误中间推理得到正确答案；而教师软散度/KL正则又稀释任务性能，且允许学生在某步严重违背逻辑后用其他步的高教师一致性来"平均"补偿。作者认为这种平均化与推理本质不符——思维链的有效性取决于其最薄弱环节。
AI.method: 将推理蒸馏表述为受限强化学习问题：在轨迹每个前缀上对教师对数似然施加最坏情况约束的前提下最大化任务奖励。为规避对偶拉格朗日求解器的高开销以及Saute等状态增广方法的测试期教师依赖，作者推导出一个无增广的受限MDP，其奖励变换保留硬约束语义，具备低方差策略梯度分解（单步项与长期项），并在惩罚极限下几乎必然满足最坏情况约束。
AI.result: 在数学推理与代码生成任务上的大量实验表明，该方法显著扩展了准确率-保真度的帕累托前沿：既匹配纯RL的高最终答案正确率，又大幅减少教师约束违背，最终在所有评测设置下取得最高的严格推理成功率（Reasoning Success Rate）。
AI.conclusion: 以最坏情况前缀约束替代软平均对齐，能同时兼顾最终答案正确性与中间推理保真度，为高效部署下的小模型推理蒸馏提供了兼具理论保证与实证优势的方案。

title: T2SPO: Trajectory-to-Step Policy Optimization for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning enables large language model (LLM) agents to learn multi-step behaviors through interaction with their environments. However, rewards in many interactive tasks reflect only the final outcome, providing limited guidance on which intermediate decisions advance the task. Successful training trajectories contain intermediate states that can provide supervision for subsequent interactions. We introduce Trajectory-to-Step Policy Optimization (T2SPO), a method that uses past interaction trajectories to provide step-level feedback for policy learning. T2SPO derives remaining-distance targets from successful trajectories and pairs them with representations of the states visited along the way. Conditioned on these examples, a pretrained TabPFN regressor estimates the remaining distance to success at each state of a new rollout. Changes in this distance estimate across consecutive states yield auxiliary credit for agent steps alongside task-level supervision. As training proceeds, newly completed trajectories refresh the estimator's context, incorporating new experience without updating its parameters. Experiments with 1.5B and 7B language models on ALFWorld and WebShop show that T2SPO consistently improves overall task success over GRPO.

AI.tldr: 提出轨迹到步级策略优化（T2SPO），利用成功轨迹构建"剩余距离"回归样本，用TabPFN估计新 rollout 各状态的剩余距离，以其跨状态变化作为步级辅助信用，与任务级奖励共同优化策略，在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 上稳定优于 GRPO。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体在多步交互任务中得到的奖励常为稀疏的最终结果奖励，无法指示哪些中间决策真正推进任务。然而成功轨迹本身蕴含中间状态信息，可用来为后续交互提供监督信号。现有方法未能充分利用这类历史经验来提供细粒度的步级指导。
AI.method: T2SPO 从成功轨迹中计算"剩余到成功的距离"作为目标，并与沿途访问状态的表征配对，构成上下文样本。在新 rollout 中，以这些样本为条件，由预训练 TabPFN 回归器估计每个状态的剩余距离；相邻状态估计值的变化量即为该步的辅助信用，与任务级监督（如 GRPO 的优势）叠加用于策略学习。随训练推进，新完成的轨迹不断刷新估计器的上下文，从而在不更新其参数的情况下纳入新经验。
AI.result: 在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 两个交互环境上，使用 1.5B 和 7B 规模的语言模型实验，T2SPO 相较 GRPO 在整体任务成功率上取得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 利用成功轨迹中的剩余距离信号、并通过免参数更新的上下文回归器进行步级信用分配，是一种有效缓解稀疏奖励、提升 LLM 智能体多步任务表现的方法。

title: Interpretable Synthetic Medical Tabular Data Generation for Clinical Decision Support Using Fuzzy Cognitive Maps
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures, 1 table. Accepted for publication in the 2026 IEEE 39th International Symposium on Computer-Based Medical Systems (CBMS), Limassol, Cyprus
summary: Synthetic medical tabular data generation has become essential for developing and validating computer-based medical systems (CBMSs) when real clinical data is restricted due to privacy, ethical, or data availability limitations. Existing probabilistic and deep generative models often lack interpretability and fail to preserve clinically meaningful dependencies, limiting their suitability for safety-critical applications. This paper proposes a novel application of Fuzzy Cognitive Maps (FCMs) in a framework for synthetic medical tabular data generation with explicit causality and privacy preservation. Clinical features are described using linguistically interpretable fuzzy sets, and inter-feature dependencies are encoded as FCM edge weights computed from fuzzy set intersections. Synthetic patient records are generated by propagating randomly initialized linguistic activation vectors through the FCM until convergence, followed by defuzzification to produce clinically coherent numerical values. The approach natively handles mixed data types, and domain constraints common in health records. Experimental evaluation on UCI medical benchmark datasets demonstrates competitive performance under a Train-on-Synthetic-Test-on-Real (TSTR) protocol. The proposed method achieves accuracy of up to 0.81 and AUROC of up to 0.90 on the Heart Disease dataset, matching or exceeding TVAE and Gaussian Copula baselines while running exclusively on CPU. Fidelity metrics including KS Complement (up to 0.91) and Correlation Similarity (up to 0.95) confirm strong statistical coherence, and DCR Baseline Protection scores consistently exceed those of TVAE, confirming adequate privacy guarantees. These results demonstrate that causally grounded, interpretable fuzzy modeling offers a computationally efficient and transparent alternative to deep generative models for trustworthy synthetic data generation in CBMSs.

AI.tldr: 提出基于模糊认知图（FCM）的合成医疗表格数据生成框架，兼具因果可解释性与隐私保护，在CPU上即可匹配或超越TVAE和高斯Copula基线。
AI.motivation: 真实临床数据受隐私、伦理与可获取性限制，合成医疗表格数据对CBMS的开发与验证至关重要；而现有概率模型与深度生成模型缺乏可解释性，且难以保留具有临床意义的特征依赖，不适合安全攸关场景。
AI.method: 用语言可解释的模糊集描述临床特征，以模糊集交集计算FCM边权重来编码特征间依赖；通过将随机初始化的语言激活向量在FCM中迭代传播至收敛，再经去模糊化生成临床一致的数值，从而原生支持混合数据类型与领域约束。
AI.result: 在UCI医疗基准数据集上采用TSTR协议评估：Heart Disease数据集上准确率达0.81、AUROC达0.90，匹配或超越TVAE与高斯Copula基线，且仅用CPU运行；保真度指标KS Complement最高0.91、Correlation Similarity最高0.95，DCR Baseline Protection持续优于TVAE。
AI.conclusion: 因果 grounded、可解释的模糊建模为CBMS中可信合成数据生成提供了计算高效且透明的深度生成模型替代方案。

title: Representation Transitions Reveal Emerging Safety Risks in Multi-Turn LLM Agents
summary:
Multi-turn attacks on agentic systems can compose individually permissible actions into harmful outcomes, challenging defenses that assess actions or states in isolation. We show that such attacks leave a detectable signature in the agent's internal representations: harmful behavior emerges as an accumulated representation transition across context updates, whose triggering context can be identified from the same signal. We further find that naive aggregation is confounded by benign representation drift, as a contrastive safety direction need not assign zero to benign transitions. We address this by denoising the direction, anchoring benign traffic at zero and removing its leading variation directions, with no runtime cost.
  These findings motivate DART, a runtime framework that detects and attributes representation shifts and intervenes with targeted reminders. Across six models and two multi-turn benchmarks, DART reduces attack success from 84% to 25% on MT-AgentRisk, catching every attack at a mean false-alarm rate of 12%, and from 97% to 52% on ASEval, at costs in benign non-refusal of 8% and 0%, respectively. On MT-AgentRisk, it outperforms ToolShield, the state-of-the-art multi-turn defense, on all six models: under the same protocol, ToolShield reaches only 55%. Denoising is critical: on ASEval, the undenoised monitor catches only 7%-40% of attacks, while the denoised monitor catches 60%-85%. The same monitor covers single-turn indirect injection without modification and adds only 0.14-0.56 s overhead per monitored step without requiring an auxiliary model, making it a lightweight complement to computation-heavy speculative defenses.

AI.tldr: 提出DART框架，通过检测并归因智能体内部表征的累积转移来防御多轮攻击，并结合表征方向去噪提升检测效果。
AI.motivation: 多轮攻击可将单个合规动作组合成有害结果，而仅评估孤立动作或状态的防御手段难以应对。作者希望利用智能体内部表征中可检测的攻击特征来构建运行时防御。
AI.method: 发现有害行为表现为上下文更新中累积的表征转移，其触发上下文可由同一信号识别；针对良性表征漂移的干扰，通过将良性流量锚定为零并移除其主要变化方向来对对比安全方向进行去噪，且无运行时开销；据此构建DART运行时框架，用于检测、归因表征偏移并进行定向提醒干预。
AI.result: 在六种模型和两个多轮基准上，DART将MT-AgentRisk的攻击成功率从84%降至25%（平均误报率12%，捕获全部攻击），将ASEval从97%降至52%（良性非拒绝代价分别为8%和0%）；在MT-AgentRisk上六种模型均优于ToolShield（同协议下仅达55%）；去噪至关重要：ASEval上去噪监测器捕获60%-85%攻击，未去噪仅7%-40%；同一监测器无需修改即可覆盖单轮间接注入，每步仅增加0.14-0.56秒开销，且无需辅助模型。
AI.conclusion: 多轮攻击在智能体表征中留下可检测的累积转移信号，表征去噪对有效检测至关重要；DART以轻量、无辅助模型的方式显著降低攻击成功率，可作为计算密集型推测性防御的补充。

title: The Life Cycle of a Massive Activation: Stochastic Birth, Weight-Decay-Driven Growth, and Competitive Consolidation
summary: Massive activations, residual-stream coordinates with magnitudes far larger than typical activations, are associated with attention sinks in transformers, but how their scale is regulated during training remains incompletely understood. Combining training-trajectory analyses and controlled interventions, we trace their emergence, growth, and consolidation. Sink-carrying channels vary across random seeds but stabilize early within each run. Over longer training, surrounding channels erode and the sink concentrates onto a few redundant carriers. Across ablations, gradient attenuation follows the sink token's collective root-mean-square magnitude rather than any single channel, making collective scale central to understanding their effects. Our central result is that weight decay causally controls the turnover of global activation scale. In controlled continuations, removing decay near the peak allows this scale to keep rising, whereas retaining it produces decline even at constant learning rate. We develop a balance model for the rise and peak of massive-activation magnitude, in which AdamW-preconditioned growth opposes weight decay. Sweeping the decay coefficient $λ$ shifts peak timing approximately log-linearly and yields peak magnitudes scaling approximately as $λ^{-1/2}$, consistent with this balance. Optimizer measurements further show that preconditioning sustains the large-channel cohort against decay even when raw maintaining forces are too small to do so. Together, these findings connect the observed life cycle to scale-regulating training dynamics and establish weight decay as a training-time lever on activation magnitude.

AI.tldr: 本文通过训练轨迹分析与受控干预，揭示了Transformer中大规模激活（massive activations）的生命周期，并证明权重衰减（weight decay）因果性地调控其全局尺度。
AI.motivation: 大规模激活（量级远大于典型激活的残差流坐标）与Transformer中的注意力汇（attention sinks）相关，但其尺度在训练过程中如何被调控尚不完全清楚。作者希望追踪其出现、增长与固化过程，并找到调控其尺度的训练动力学因素。
AI.method: 结合训练轨迹分析与受控干预（连续训练中改变配置、消融实验、优化器测量）；建立描述大规模激活量级上升与峰值的平衡模型，其中AdamW预条件增长与权重衰减相对抗；通过扫掠衰减系数λ观察峰值时间与峰值量级。
AI.result: 承载汇的通道随随机种子变化，但在每次训练早期即稳定；长期训练中周围通道被侵蚀，汇集中于少数冗余载体。梯度衰减跟随汇token的集体均方根量级而非单个通道。移除衰减使尺度在峰值附近继续上升，保留衰减即使学习率恒定也会导致下降。峰值时间随λ近似对数线性移动，峰值量级近似按λ^{-1/2}缩放，符合平衡模型。预条件机制使大通道群体能抵抗衰减。
AI.conclusion: 研究将大规模激活的观测生命周期与尺度调控的训练动力学相连接，确立权重衰减作为训练期调控激活量级的杠杆。

title: Deep Learning for Anomaly Detection in Railway Systems: A Structured Survey
comment: Survey paper. Published in Engineering Applications of Artificial Intelligence (EAAI), 2026
summary: Ensuring safe and reliable operation of modern railway systems increasingly relies on data-driven monitoring and intelligent fault detection. Deep learning has emerged as an effective paradigm for railway anomaly detection, driven by the growing availability of heterogeneous sensor data from rolling stock and infrastructure. This paper presents a structured survey of deep learning-based anomaly detection approaches for railway systems. The surveyed methods are organized using a unified taxonomy covering anomaly location, data representation and manifestation, sensing modality, and temporal characteristics. Existing approaches, including convolutional, recurrent and attention-based architectures, autoencoders, generative adversarial networks, and transformers, are structured into classification-based, prediction-based, reconstruction-based, and hybrid learning paradigms. The survey also examines data-centric challenges, evaluation practices, performance metrics, and practical deployment aspects, including edge-cloud architectures, computational constraints, and hardware-aware optimization. Finally, a decision-oriented framework links anomaly characteristics, data properties, and operational constraints to suitable detection paradigms and deployment configurations. This work provides a structured reference for selecting and deploying deep learning solutions for railway anomaly detection and highlights open challenges toward reliable and scalable intelligent monitoring systems.

AI.tldr: 一篇关于铁路系统深度学习异常检测的结构化综述，提出统一分类法、归纳四类学习范式，并给出面向部署的决策框架。
AI.motivation: 现代铁路系统安全可靠运行日益依赖数据驱动的监测与智能故障检测，来自机车车辆与基础设施的异构传感器数据不断增长，使深度学习成为铁路异常检测的有效范式；但该领域方法分散、术语与分类不统一，缺乏对数据挑战、评估实践与工程部署的系统梳理，因此需要一篇结构化综述。
AI.method: 采用结构化综述方法：构建统一分类法，覆盖异常位置、数据表示与表现形式、传感模态、时间特性四个维度；将卷积、循环、注意力架构、自编码器、生成对抗网络与Transformer等方法归入基于分类、基于预测、基于重构和混合四类学习范式；同时梳理以数据为中心的挑战、评估实践与性能指标，以及边缘—云架构、计算约束和硬件感知优化等实际部署问题。
AI.result: 形成了一套贯穿异常检测全流程的分类体系与范式归纳，系统整理了数据、评估与部署层面的关键问题，并提出一个决策导向框架，将异常特征、数据属性与运行约束映射到合适的检测范式与部署配置。
AI.conclusion: 该综述为铁路异常检测中深度学习方案的选择与部署提供了结构化参考，并指出面向可靠、可扩展智能监测系统的开放挑战。

title: Gumbel Straight Flow: Distilling Autoregressive Models into One-step Flow Maps
summary: We present Gumbel Straight Flow (GSF), a continuous flow map language model that leverages the noise-data coupling of a pretrained autoregressive language (AR) model. We theoretically demonstrate that the coupling between Gumbel noise and one-hot token sequences induced by an autoregressive model yields non-intersecting linear paths connecting the noise to the sequence representations. To further enhance high-quality few-step path sampling, we use a flow map semigroup objective where the tangent (velocity) condition is guided directly by the AR teacher. Across various benchmarks, including pretraining and downstream tasks, GSF can outperform current few-step language generation baselines.

AI.tldr: Gumbel Straight Flow (GSF) 是一个连续流映射语言模型，利用预训练自回归模型的噪声-数据耦合构造非相交线性路径，并通过流映射半群目标实现高质量少步采样。
AI.motivation: 少步语言生成需要在少量采样步骤下保持高质量，现有基线在此方面仍有不足。作者希望借助预训练自回归教师模型的噪声-数据耦合先验，构造更易处理的生成路径以提升少步采样性能。
AI.method: GSF 为连续流映射语言模型。理论证明：自回归模型诱导的 Gumbel 噪声与 one-hot 词元序列之间的耦合产生连接噪声与序列表示的非相交线性路径。为增强少步采样质量，采用流映射半群（flow map semigroup）目标，其中切向（速度）条件由 AR 教师直接引导。
AI.result: 在包括预训练与下游任务的多项基准上，GSF 优于当前主流的少步语言生成基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用预训练 AR 模型的耦合结构并引入半群流映射目标，GSF 为高效高质量少步语言生成提供了有效方案。

title: XOR-Trellis: Ultra-Low-Complexity Dequantization and Curvature-Aware Hadamard-Free LLM Quantization
summary: Trellis-coded quantization enables high-dimensional compression of large language model (LLM) weights at ultra-low bit widths without the exponentially large codebooks required by conventional vector quantization. Practical deployment, however, presents two challenges: reconstructing compressed weights at sufficient parallel throughput to avoid making dequantization an inference bottleneck, and maintaining quantization accuracy without costly incoherence transformations. We address these challenges with two complementary techniques. First, we introduce an ultra-low-complexity trellis dequantizer that uses a structured, hardware-efficient state-to-value mapping while preserving diverse reconstruction choices for trellis search. Second, we reformulate discrete trellis path optimization with a curvature-aware objective that reflects model sensitivity directly in the original coordinate space. Together, these techniques enable high-quality ultra-low-bit trellis quantization with inexpensive, highly parallel runtime reconstruction and without relying on Hadamard-based incoherence processing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种互补技术，使格栅编码量化（TCQ）在超低比特下高效部署于LLM权重压缩：一种超低复杂度、硬件友好的格栅反量化器，以及对格栅路径优化的曲率感知重构，从而免去Hadamard非相干变换并实现高并行重建。
AI.motivation: LLM权重的超低比特压缩需要高维量化，但传统向量量化码本指数级增长。TCQ可避免这一问题，然而实际部署存在两个瓶颈：反量化并行吞吐不足会成为推理瓶颈，以及在不使用昂贵非相干变换的情况下难以保持量化精度。
AI.method: 1）设计超低复杂度的格栅反量化器，采用结构化、硬件高效的状态到数值映射，同时保留格栅搜索所需的多样重建选择；2）将离散格栅路径优化重构为曲率感知目标函数，在原始坐标空间中直接反映模型敏感度。
AI.result: 两种技术结合后，实现了高质量的超低比特格栅量化，具备低成本、高度并行的运行时重建能力，并且不依赖基于Hadamard的非相干处理。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为LLM权重的超低比特TCQ压缩提供了可实用部署的方案，在保持精度的同时解决了反量化吞吐瓶颈并去除了非相干变换依赖。

title: Beyond Affine Transformations: A Soft Dominance Layer for Coordinate-Wise Neural Computation
summary: This paper presents a preliminary study of an alternative to the affine transformation underlying conventional neural-network layers. In the proposed Soft Dominance Layer, each output unit compares input coordinates with a learnable reference vector and aggregates smooth inequality responses. A sigmoid relaxation makes the comparisons differentiable, while a sharpness parameter $α$ controls their transition toward hard threshold decisions. The aim is to examine the trainability and direct threshold interpretation of this primitive, not to claim a replacement for affine layers. In single-run MNIST experiments, the highest observed Soft Dominance accuracy is $0.9061$ without annealing and $0.9173$ with annealing, compared with $0.9827$ for the MLP baseline. These descriptive results do not establish reliable configuration rankings or a statistically supported annealing benefit. Learned reference vectors exhibit spatial structure, providing qualitative evidence of structured learning. Repeated-seed experiments and broader datasets are required to assess robustness and practical relevance beyond this proof of concept.

AI.tldr: 提出 Soft Dominance Layer，用可学习参考向量与平滑不等式比较替代仿射变换，初步检验其可训练性与阈值可解释性；MNIST 单次实验中准确率低于 MLP 基线，仅作为概念验证。
AI.motivation: 探索传统神经网络层所依赖的仿射变换之外的替代原语，重点关注该原语的可训练性，以及输出单元能否直接解释为阈值决策，而非声称其可取代仿射层。
AI.method: Soft Dominance Layer 中每个输出单元将输入坐标与可学习参考向量比较，聚合并平滑的不等式响应；通过 sigmoid 松弛使比较可微，并用锐度参数 α 控制其向硬阈值决策的过渡；在 MNIST 上以单次运行方式对比是否使用退火（annealing）的配置，并与 MLP 基线对照。
AI.result: 最高观测准确率：无退火 0.9061，有退火 0.9173，MLP 基线为 0.9827；这些描述性结果不足以确立可靠的配置排序，也不构成对退火增益的统计支持；学习到的参考向量呈现空间结构，提供结构化学习的定性证据。
AI.conclusion: 该工作属于概念验证阶段，结论有限：需通过多随机种子重复实验和更广泛的数据集来评估稳健性与实际相关性。

title: ALER: Adaptive Learnable Experience Rewriting for Reinforcement Learning
summary: In partially observable reinforcement learning (RL), a later observation can make stored information obsolete or change what it implies for the next decision. Memory architectures and benchmarks for RL mostly test retention, the ability to keep information unchanged until it is needed. We formalize two further requirements. Rewriting sets the decision-relevant content to a value independent of the old one, and experience fusion transforms the old content by a rule that a later observation specifies. For tasks built from such updates, we count the memory states that a solution needs, and several baselines reach their lowest success rates on compositions that need more states. We introduce ALER (Adaptive Learnable Experience Rewriting), an agent that pairs an LSTM with a slot memory. An independently addressed Gumbel-Softmax write that concentrates its weight on one slot overwrites that slot, and a learned gate fuses the retrieved content with the recurrent state before the policy and value heads. We also introduce Rune-Mazes, three environments in which rune observations invert, cancel, reset, or repeat updates of a hidden cue under vector and pixel observations. Against seven baselines, ALER reaches a success rate of at least $0.82$ in all sixteen Endless T-Maze configurations and at least $0.99$ on all five Rune T-Maze compositions, and it has the highest mean success rate on four-branch Rune Multi-Corridor with an Invert rune. On pixel-based Rune MiniGrid Memory, it has a higher mean success rate than PPO-LSTM in eight of ten configurations. Project page: https://quartz-admirer.github.io/ALER-Adaptive-Learnable-Experience-Rewriting/.

AI.tldr: 论文提出部分可观测强化学习中"重写"与"经验融合"两个记忆需求，并设计ALER（LSTM+槽位记忆，含Gumbel-Softmax写入与门控融合），配合Rune-Mazes基准，在多个配置上优于七个基线。
AI.motivation: 现有RL记忆架构与基准主要测试"保持"能力，即信息在被使用前不发生改变；但实际任务中后续观测可能使已存信息过时或改变其含义，这一"重写"与"经验融合"需求被忽视，且缺乏相应评测。
AI.method: 形式化两类更新：重写（将决策相关内容设为与旧值无关的值）与经验融合（按后续观测给出的规则变换旧内容）；以所需记忆状态数构建任务。提出ALER：LSTM搭配槽位记忆，采用独立寻址的Gumbel-Softmax写入，将权重集中于单一槽位以覆写该槽，并用学习门控在策略与价值头之前融合检索内容与循环状态。同时构建Rune-Mazes，含三个环境，在向量与像素观测下对隐藏线索进行反转、取消、重置或重复更新。
AI.result: 对比七个基线，ALER在全部16种Endless T-Maze配置中成功率≥0.82，在全部5种Rune T-Maze组合中≥0.99；在带Invert符文的四分支Rune Multi-Corridor上取得最高平均成功率；在像素版Rune MiniGrid Memory中，十个配置中有八个平均成功率高于PPO-LSTM。
AI.conclusion: 记忆不仅要保持信息，还需支持重写与经验融合；槽位化可寻址写入与门控融合是实现该能力的关键，ALER在需要更多记忆状态的任务上显著优于现有基线。

title: Misalignment of Low-Loss Regions Causes Grokking
summary: Grokking refers to the delayed emergence of validation-set generalization after a model has already overfit the training set. Although first observed in small algorithmic tasks trained with transformers, its underlying mechanism remains unsettled. In this work, we develop an analysis framework based on mode connectivity and the geometry of low-loss regions. The framework predicts that the standard modular-arithmetic setting does not always produce grokking: under a symmetry-preserving train/validation split, we observe a stable anti-grokking case in which validation performance does not recover. This counterexample challenges several existing correlational explanations of grokking. More broadly, our analysis framework and results further suggest that grokking arises when the low-loss regions induced by the training and validation partitions are misaligned. Once these regions become well aligned, training hyperparameters alone cannot produce grokking and the observed dynamics collapse to either trainable or non-trainable behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于模式连通性与低损失区域几何的分析框架，指出标准模运算设定并非总能产生grokking，并给出一个保持对称性的train/validation划分下稳定的anti-grokking反例；进一步认为grokking源于训练与验证划分诱导的低损失区域不对齐，一旦对齐，仅靠超参数无法产生grokking。
AI.motivation: grokking现象（训练集已过拟合后验证集泛化才延迟出现）虽在小型算法任务与transformer中被观察到，但其机制尚无定论；现有解释多为相关性解释，缺乏统一、可预测的分析框架。
AI.method: 构建基于模式连通性（mode connectivity）与低损失区域几何的分析框架，用以刻画训练划分与验证划分诱导的低损失区域之间的关系，并在标准模运算任务上设计对称性保持的train/validation划分进行检验。
AI.result: 在对称性保持的train/validation划分下，观察到稳定的anti-grokking案例：验证性能不会恢复；该反例对若干现有grokking相关性解释构成挑战。分析进一步表明，grokking出现在训练与验证划分的低损失区域不对齐时；当区域良好对齐时，仅训练超参数无法产生grokking，动力学退化为可训练或不可训练两种行为。
AI.conclusion: grokking并非标准模运算设定的必然结果，其发生取决于训练与验证划分诱导的低损失区域是否对齐；该几何分析框架可统一解释grokking与anti-grokking，并说明超参数单独不足以触发grokking。

title: Random Recursive Models
summary: Recursive models create computational depth through parameter reuse, offering a parameter-efficient alternative to increasing model size. However, most recursive models repeatedly apply one learned transformation or a prescribed sequence of transformations, restricting computation to a fixed layer order. We introduce the Random Recursive Model (RRM), which maintains a pool of $L$ learned layers and performs $T$ recursive steps by sampling one layer independently with replacement for each example and step. This enables flexible layer reuse while retaining the parameter efficiency of recurrence. We evaluate RRM on challenging reasoning tasks, where it matches or exceeds the baselines, often with 50-75 % fewer parameters. RRM can vary its depth at inference, including beyond that seen during training, without retraining or adding parameters, improving tasks that benefit from deeper iterative computation. RRM also supports Monte Carlo inference and probabilistic test-time scaling, both of which improve performance without retraining. These insights may open new directions in neural network architecture design.

AI.tldr: 提出随机递归模型(RRM)，在层池中按样本、按步独立有放回抽样层，实现灵活层复用，在推理任务上以更少参数匹配或超越基线。
AI.motivation: 递归模型通过参数复用获得计算深度，是提升模型规模的参数高效替代方案。但现有递归模型多重复应用单一变换或固定变换序列，使计算局限于固定的层顺序，限制了灵活性与表达能力。
AI.method: RRM维护一个含L个已学习层的层池，通过T个递归步，对每个样本和每个步独立地、有放回地采样一层进行应用；从而在保留递归参数效率的同时实现灵活层复用。支持推理时改变深度（含超出训练深度）以及蒙特卡洛推理和概率式测试时扩展。
AI.result: 在具有挑战性的推理任务上，RRM匹配或超越基线，且参数常减少50–75%；推理时可改变深度（包括超出训练深度）而无需重训或增加参数，从而改善受益于更深迭代计算的任务；蒙特卡洛推理与概率式测试时扩展均可在不重训的情况下提升性能。
AI.conclusion: 随机层采样为递归架构提供了灵活性，兼顾参数效率与推理时自适应深度及测试时扩展能力，可能为神经网络架构设计开启新方向。

title: Exploring More, Reasoning Better: Stepwise Risk-Sensitive GRPO for Diffusion Language Models
comment: 40 pages, 12 figures, 2 tables. The first two authors contributed equally
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) generate text by denoising a sequence or successive blocks, allowing several tokens to be revealed in parallel. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) reuses terminal feedback across these decisions, even as their conditioning context changes. We propose stepwise risk-sensitive GRPO (StepRS-GRPO), which varies the risk coefficient of the group-advantage transformation across denoising states while retaining the underlying trainer. For binary rewards, we show that this transformation is exactly a prompt- and state-dependent rescaling of centered outcome advantages. A capability-based calibration suggests a coefficient scale, while endpoint and interpolation ablations guide schedule selection. Across multiple dLLM backbones and mathematical reasoning benchmarks, StepRS-GRPO improves both pass@1 accuracy and pass@k coverage over centered GRPO, while increasing answer diversity. In our ablation studies, mass-matched controls support the contributions of state allocation and schedule direction, and the gains persist after matching the root mean square (RMS) of the advantages to that of centered GRPO. Reasoning-trace diagnostics further show that the diversity gains from StepRS-GRPO extend beyond final-answer strings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 StepRS-GRPO，一种在扩散语言模型（dLLM）的去噪状态间调整组优势变换风险系数的 RLVR 方法，在多骨干与数学推理基准上提升 pass@1 与 pass@k 覆盖并增加答案多样性。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型通过去噪序列或连续块生成文本，可并行揭示多个 token；RLVR 在这些决策间复用终端反馈，但其条件上下文不断变化，导致同一反馈被施加于不同去噪状态，存在风险分配不匹配问题。
AI.method: 提出 StepRS-GRPO：在保留底层训练器的前提下，随去噪状态改变组优势变换的风险系数。对二值奖励，证明该变换等价于对中心化结果优势进行提示与状态相关的重缩放。用基于能力的校准确定系数尺度，并通过端点与插值消融指导调度选择。
AI.result: 在多个 dLLM 骨干与数学推理基准上，StepRS-GRPO 较中心化 GRPO 提升 pass@1 准确率与 pass@k 覆盖率，并提高答案多样性。消融中，质量匹配对照支持状态分配与调度方向的贡献；将优势 RMS 匹配至中心化 GRPO 后增益仍存在；推理轨迹诊断显示多样性增益不止于最终答案字符串。
AI.conclusion: 通过对去噪状态进行风险敏感的优势重缩放，StepRS-GRPO 在不改动训练器的情况下有效改进 dLLM 的 RLVR 训练，兼顾准确率、覆盖率与多样性。

title: LabBook: Harnessing Experimental History for Efficient LLM-Driven Discovery
summary: Evolutionary approaches to LLM-driven discovery often generate new programs from a small set of selected ancestors. This keeps contexts manageable but can omit useful evidence from other experiments, whereas including the full experimental history produces long, redundant contexts. We introduce a simple, single-agent discovery harness built around LabBook, an agent-maintained memory that serves two complementary roles: guiding retrieval of relevant evidence from a complete experimental log and informing the generation of new solutions. At each iteration, the same agent combines its memory with retrieved evidence and jointly produces the next program and an updated LabBook. This separates complete history retention from selective context construction, without requiring an explicit population or branching search structure. On 49 Frontier-CS problems, LabBook improves the observed quality-cost trade-off over the evaluated evolutionary baselines with two backbones, while remaining competitive across nine additional mathematical, systems, and heuristic-design tasks. Code will be released at https://github.com/BoYuanVisionary/LabBook.

AI.tldr: 提出LabBook：一种由智能体维护的记忆机制驱动的单智能体发现框架，兼顾完整实验历史保留与选择性上下文构建，在49个Frontier-CS问题上优于进化基线，并在九项数学、系统与启发式设计任务上保持竞争力。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的进化式发现方法通常只从少量被选中的祖先程序生成新程序。这种方式虽能控制上下文长度，但会遗漏其他实验中的有用证据；而若纳入完整实验历史，又会导致上下文过长且冗余。因此需要一种能同时实现"保留完整历史"与"构建精简上下文"的方法。
AI.method: 提出以LabBook为核心的单智能体发现框架。LabBook是智能体自行维护的记忆，承担两个互补作用：一是引导从完整实验日志中检索相关证据，二是指导新解的生成。每次迭代中，同一智能体将记忆与检索到的证据结合，联合产出下一个程序与更新后的LabBook。该方法将完整历史保留与选择性上下文构建解耦，且无需显式种群或分支搜索结构。
AI.result: 在49个Frontier-CS问题上，LabBook在两种主干模型下均改善了所观察到的质量-成本权衡，优于所评估的进化基线；在另外九项数学、系统与启发式设计任务上也保持竞争力。代码将在 https://github.com/BoYuanVisionary/LabBook 发布。
AI.conclusion: 通过智能体维护的记忆实现历史保留与上下文选择的分离，可在不依赖种群或分支搜索的情况下提升LLM驱动发现的效率与效果，为自动化发现提供了一种简洁且可扩展的替代范式。

title: Training-Aware Target Coverage for Synthetic Data Selection
summary: Synthetic data are increasingly used to scale LLM training, yet more synthetic data do not necessarily produce better models. Useful synthetic data must add information relevant to the target task without introducing errors that offset their benefit, and the value of an example can change as the training set grows. We develop a linear theory that characterizes this tradeoff and determines where synthetic data are useful, how much should be added, and the marginal value of adding one example to an existing set. The analysis shows the conditions when input coverage alone is sufficient and when synthetic errors must also be considered. Guided by these results, we introduce \emph{Training-Aware Target Coverage} (TATC), a synthetic data selection method for LLM fine-tuning. TATC identifies candidates whose training effects are beneficial to the target task and selects among them to expand coverage of target-relevant directions not already represented by the available data. Experiments on text and image data verify the linear theory. With mathematical reasoning tasks, TATC selects synthetic solutions for fine-tuning Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct and outperforms alternative synthetic-data selection methods on GSM8K across selection budgets. In summary, we provide a principled approach to synthetic data selection by quantifying and maximizing its value to the target task.

AI.tldr: 本文提出线性理论刻画合成数据对目标任务的收益-误差权衡，并据此设计TATC选择方法，用于LLM微调中的合成数据筛选。
AI.motivation: 合成数据被广泛用于扩展LLM训练，但更多合成数据并不必然带来更好模型：有用数据需提供与目标任务相关的信息，同时不引入抵消其收益的错误，且单个样本的价值会随训练集规模变化。因此需要一个理论框架来判断合成数据是否有用、应加入多少、以及边际价值如何。
AI.method: 建立线性理论刻画“信息增益”与“合成误差”之间的权衡，给出输入覆盖充分的条件及必须考虑合成误差的条件；基于该分析提出Training-Aware Target Coverage (TATC)：在微调中筛选训练效应有利于目标任务的候选样本，并在其中选择扩展尚未被现有数据覆盖的目标相关方向。
AI.result: 在文本与图像数据上的实验验证了线性理论；在数学推理任务中，TATC为Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct选择合成解进行微调，在不同选择预算下于GSM8K上优于其他合成数据选择方法。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过量化并最大化合成数据对目标任务的价值，提供了一个有原则的合成数据选择方法，明确了合成数据何时有用、添加多少以及边际收益如何变化。

title: Benchmarking Generative Models for Weather Data Assimilation on Real Station Observations
summary: Weather reanalysis products rely on computationally intensive numerical weather predictions followed by data assimilation that corrects the forecast toward observations. Deep generative models offer a cheaper alternative that shifts much of this cost from inference to offline training. However, existing generative approaches have been evaluated on synthetic observations or under different datasets and evaluation schemes, making it unclear which design choices actually improve real-world data assimilation. We present the first controlled benchmark of generative weather data assimilation on real weather station observations. Using 11,849 NOAA MADIS stations across the contiguous United States and four weather variables, we evaluate methods while holding the dataset, observation operator, and deep learning architecture fixed. The benchmark compares the major design choices, including diffusion versus flow matching, pixel versus latent-space formulations, and multiple inference-time conditioning strategies, against a classical 3D-Var baseline. The benchmark reveals three clear conclusions. First, learned generative priors outperform the Gaussian prior of 3D-Var (35.7% vs. 33.3% RMSE reduction over ERA5) despite using no ERA5 background field at inference. Second, full-gradient guidance consistently outperforms stop-gradient and initial-noise optimization. Third, other choices provide little measurable benefit: diffusion and flow matching perform nearly identically under matched conditions, and latent-space variable mixing does not help. We further evaluate both dense and sparse station settings and find advantages from generative AI and full-gradient guidance more pronounced under sparsity. Together, these results identify which components of generative weather data assimilation improve performance on real station observations and establish a standardized benchmark for future work.

AI.tldr: 首个基于真实气象站观测的生成式天气数据同化受控基准：学习生成先验优于3D-Var高斯先验，全梯度引导始终更优，扩散与流匹配等选择差异甚微，稀疏站点下生成式优势更明显。
AI.motivation: 天气再分析依赖数值天气预报与数据同化，成本高昂；深度生成模型可将成本从推理转移到离线训练。但已有生成式方法多在合成观测或不同数据集/评估方案下评测，无法判断哪些设计选择真正提升真实数据同化性能，因而需要统一受控的基准来厘清各设计要素的实际贡献。
AI.method: 在真实气象站观测上开展首个受控基准。使用美国本土11,849个NOAA MADIS站点、4个气象变量，固定数据集、观测算子与深度学习架构，仅变动设计选择：扩散 vs 流匹配、像素空间 vs 潜空间建模、多种推理时条件引导策略，并与经典3D-Var基线对比；同时评估稠密与稀疏站点两种设置。
AI.result: 三点结论：（1）学习生成先验优于3D-Var高斯先验，相对ERA5的RMSE降低35.7% vs. 33.3%，且推理时不使用ERA5背景场；（2）全梯度引导一致优于停止梯度与初始噪声优化；（3）其他选择收益有限——匹配条件下扩散与流匹配表现几乎相同，潜空间变量混合无帮助。稀疏站点下生成式AI与全梯度引导的优势更显著。
AI.conclusion: 该工作识别出生成式天气数据同化中真正提升真实站点观测性能的关键组件，并建立了可复用的标准化基准，为后续研究提供统一评测框架。

title: SHARPO: Segment-Level Credit Assignment for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) trains a large language model (LLM) to act over long, multi-step interactions. However, a single localized error can cause task failure, while trajectory-level rewards provide limited guidance for assigning credit to individual decisions. To address this limitation, we introduce Segment-level Hindsight Advantage Reweighting for Policy Optimization (SHARPO), a credit-assignment mechanism that refines Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) at the level of environment-facing segments. Inspired by the existing on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) method, SHARPO computes teacher-student log-probability gaps within each segment and uses the resulting signal to compute a bounded multiplier on the GRPO advantage. This multiplier is shared by all tokens within the segment, allowing credit to vary across different segments. With Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, SHARPO outperforms existing baselines on the ALFWorld and WebShop benchmarks, including GRPO, SDAR, RLSD, and StepOPSD.

AI.tldr: 提出SHARPO，一种在环境交互片段层面进行信用分配的机制，通过对GRPO优势施加有界乘子来细化策略优化，在ALFWorld和WebShop上超越GRPO等基线。
AI.motivation: 智能体强化学习需LLM进行长程多步交互，但单个局部错误即可导致任务失败，而轨迹级奖励难以为各决策分配信用，信用分配粒度过粗成为关键瓶颈。
AI.method: SHARPO受在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）启发，在面向环境的片段（segment）层面计算教师-学生对数概率差，据此生成有界乘子，调制GRPO优势；该乘子在片段内所有token间共享，使信用可跨片段差异化。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct上，SHARPO于ALFWorld和WebShop基准上优于GRPO、SDAR、RLSD与StepOPSD等现有基线。
AI.conclusion: 片段级回顾优势重加权为长程智能体RL提供更细粒度的信用分配，验证了分段级自蒸馏信号调制优势函数的有效性。

title: Rethinking Data Augmentation under Covariate Shift: Invariant-Guided Diffusion and Prototype Reweighting
summary: In many industrial applications, 1) tabular data is scarce and imbalanced and thus requires synthetic expansion; 2) input distributions drift between training and deployment (covariate shift); 3) validation sets often diverge from unseen test environments; or 4) standard generative models simply mimic outdated source distributions. This learning setting limits the stability of standard augmentation and adaptation pipelines. We generalize the task under such setting as the Augmented and Weighted Learning under Covariate Shift problem (AWL-CS). AWL-CS imposes two critical challenges on existing methods: 1) misleading generative guidance where models optimize for source similarity rather than downstream task relevance, and 2) structural instability of distributional density where reweighting mechanisms overfit to noisy validation signals. To tackle these challenges, we propose IGDPR (Invariant-Guided Diffusion with Prototype Reweighting), a unified framework that synergizes stable synthesis and structural adaptation: i) To achieve task-relevant generation, we steer the diffusion sampling process using invariant potentials to ensure synthetic samples align with stable decision boundaries rather than outdated correlations. ii) To ensure stable adaptation, we develop a prototype-based reweighting strategy that assesses sample reliability through structural clusters instead of isolated points, effectively filtering validation noise. Extensive experiments on real data demonstrate our method improves data quality by augmenting the most beneficial data for robust learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AWL-CS问题设定并设计IGDPR框架，通过不变势能引导扩散采样与原型重加权，实现协变量偏移下的稳定合成与自适应。
AI.motivation: 工业应用中存在表格数据稀缺且不平衡、训练与部署分布漂移（协变量偏移）、验证集与未见测试环境不一致、生成模型仅模仿过时源分布等问题，导致标准增强与自适应流程不稳定。
AI.method: 提出IGDPR（Invariant-Guided Diffusion with Prototype Reweighting）统一框架：i) 用不变势能引导扩散采样过程，使合成样本对齐稳定决策边界而非过时相关性；ii) 基于原型的重加权策略，通过结构簇而非孤立点评估样本可靠性，过滤验证噪声。
AI.result: 在真实数据上的大量实验表明，该方法通过增强对稳健学习最有益的数据，提升了数据质量。
AI.conclusion: IGDPR能够协同稳定合成与结构自适应，有效应对AWL-CS中的生成引导误导与密度重加权不稳定两大挑战。

title: Match the Distribution, Not the Compute: Post-Training Multi-Token Prediction Heads
summary: Multi-token prediction (MTP) improves the throughput of autoregressive generation by enabling the language model to draft multiple next tokens per forward pass, while a verification step over draft tokens ensures that token distribution of the backbone is preserved. Every open MTP-family release (MiMo-7B, DeepSeek-V3, Qwen3) trains its heads jointly with the backbone over the full pretraining run of tens of trillions of tokens, thus setting the drafter quality at pretraining time. We ask whether a lightweight post-training pass on target-generated chain-of-thought is enough to reach the same expected throughput speedup on a frozen reasoning model, and study how a serving-time system built on such a checkpoint can be optimized. We present three findings. 1) On a frozen Qwen3-8B with $K{=}3$ chained MTP heads, we show that a post-training recipe with plain cross-entropy on $\approx\!2.5$B tokens reaches or exceeds the expected speedup of jointly trained MiMo-7B on math, coding and knowledge benchmarks. Our post-training recipe utilizes $10^3$-$10^4\times$ less MTP-training tokens as compared with joint pre-training of MiMO-7B MTP baseline. 2) We propose a chain-aware relaxation of draft token verification rule that allows a bounded drift from backbone language model token distribution. We show that this relaxation lifts expected speedups by $+12$ to $+16\%$ per benchmark while preserving task accuracy. 3) We propose an adaptive controller that dynamically chooses the number of MTP heads to be engaged at inference time and demonstrate recovery of upto $11$--$14\%$ loss in speedup using fixed maximum MTP draft length.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在冻结的推理模型上，仅通过轻量级后训练即可获得多token预测（MTP）加速，并提出验证松弛与自适应控制器两项服务期优化，取得与联合预训练相当甚至更优的加速效果。
AI.motivation: 现有MTP方案（MiMo-7B、DeepSeek-V3、Qwen3）均需在数万亿token的完整预训练过程中将预测头与主干联合训练，草稿头质量在预训练阶段即被固定，成本极高且难以适配已训练好的推理模型。作者希望验证：对冻结的推理模型做一次轻量后训练，是否足以达到同等吞吐加速，并探索服务期系统优化空间。
AI.method: 1）在冻结的Qwen3-8B上以K=3链式MTP头，用约2.5B目标生成思维链token做普通交叉熵后训练；2）提出链感知的草稿token验证松弛规则，允许相对主干分布的有界漂移；3）提出自适应控制器，在推理时动态选择启用的MTP头数量。
AI.result: 1）后训练方案在数学、代码、知识基准上达到或超过联合训练的MiMo-7B期望加速，MTP训练token量减少10^3–10^4倍；2）验证松弛使各基准期望加速提升12–16%，且任务精度保持；3）自适应控制器在固定最大草稿长度下挽回11–14%的加速损失。
AI.conclusion: 对冻结推理模型进行轻量后训练即可高效获得MTP加速，配合验证松弛与自适应头调度，可在几乎不损精度的前提下进一步提升服务吞吐，为MTP的实际部署提供了低成本、可插拔的替代路径。

title: On-the-fly Weight Generation: A Hypernetwork Proof of Concept on ARC-1D
comment: Published (Spotlight) at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Neural Network Artifacts as a New Data Modality
summary: General-purpose models can adapt to many tasks from context, while specialised models can execute individual functions with less capacity. Yet obtaining such specialists requires task-specific training or adaptation. We ask whether they can instead be generated directly from a few demonstrations. Using ARC-1D as a controlled testbed, we show that individual transformations can be represented by tiny specialist models, and that a hypernetwork can generate their parameters from context. The generated parameters form a structured weight space, while the resulting specialists show partial compositional generalisation and generalisation to transformations not seen during training. In both settings, removing explicit task identifiers improves generalisation beyond the training transformations. Together, these results provide a proof of concept that few-shot task context can be compiled on-the-fly into compact executable model parameters, and that the resulting weight space can support reuse and generalisation beyond known functions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种超网络方法，可从少量示例直接生成专用模型参数，在ARC-1D测试床上验证了这种"按需编译"的可行性。
AI.motivation: 通用模型依赖上下文适应多任务，而专用模型虽容量小却需任务特定训练或适配。作者追问能否直接从少量示范中即时生成这些专用模型，从而兼顾小容量与无需任务特定训练。
AI.method: 以ARC-1D作为受控测试床，用微型专用模型表示单个变换，并训练一个超网络根据上下文生成这些专用模型的参数。通过消融实验（移除显式任务标识）考察对泛化的影响。
AI.result: 生成的参数形成了结构化的权重空间；专用模型展现出部分组合泛化能力，并能泛化到训练中未见的变换。在两种设定下，移除显式任务标识都能提升超越训练变换的泛化性能。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了概念验证：少样本任务上下文可被即时编译为紧凑的可执行模型参数，且由此形成的权重空间能够支持超出已知函数的复用与泛化。

title: Structure-agnostic Causal Representation Learning
summary: Causal representation learning aims to discover robust features by exploiting the causal structure underlying data generation. Existing methods require specifying the causal structure a priori, yet different structures demand fundamentally incompatible invariance constraints, and misspecification leads to representations that discard predictive information. We introduce SaCRL, a framework that jointly identifies the causal structure and learns the corresponding invariant representation without prior structural knowledge. Our approach formulates structure selection as a soft optimization over candidate invariances using HSIC-based violation metrics, with adaptive weights that automatically concentrate on the achievable structure. We provide theoretical guarantees for structure identification, including under random-feature approximation, invariance satisfaction, and out-of-distribution generalization. Empirically, SaCRL recovers the true structure on synthetic and semi-synthetic Bayesian-network benchmarks, outperforms fixed-invariance baselines on Colored MNIST, achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on three DomainBed benchmarks (PACS, VLCS, OfficeHome), and degrades gracefully under structural misspecification and limited environment diversity. Code is available at: https://github.com/ArmanBehnam/sacrl.

AI.tldr: SaCRL 提出一种无需先验因果结构的框架，将结构选择建模为基于 HSIC 违规度量的软优化，联合识别因果结构并学习不变表示，兼具理论与实证优势。
AI.motivation: 现有因果表示学习方法需预先指定因果结构，而不同结构对应互不兼容的不变约束，结构误设会导致表示丢弃预测信息。
AI.method: 将结构选择表述为对候选不变性的软优化，使用基于 HSIC 的违规度量，并通过自适应权重自动聚焦于可实现的结构，从而在无先验结构知识下联合识别结构与学习不变表示。
AI.result: 在合成与半合成贝叶斯网络基准上恢复真实结构；在 Colored MNIST 上超越固定不变性基线；在 DomainBed 的 PACS、VLCS、OfficeHome 三个基准上达到 SOTA；在结构误设与环境多样性有限时性能平滑退化。理论方面给出结构识别（含随机特征近似下）、不变性满足与分布外泛化的保证。
AI.conclusion: SaCRL 在不依赖先验因果结构的前提下实现了结构识别与不变表示学习的统一，理论与实验均验证其有效性与鲁棒性，代码已开源。

title: Cross-Benchmark Transfer from RL on Agentic Coding Tasks
summary: Coding agents often fail in the last mile: they build most of a feature but drop a requirement, test only the cases their implementation already handles, break behavior that was supposed to stay intact, or validate against an unchecked assumption. We ask whether reinforcement learning (RL) on expert-built agentic coding tasks closes this gap, and whether what the agent learns transfers beyond the training distribution. We post-train Kimi K2.7 Code, a 1T-parameter (32B active) open-weight mixture-of-experts model, with RL alone on 1,700 tasks: 1,000 repository tasks graded by hidden fail-to-pass tests and by pass-to-pass tests of existing behavior, and 700 terminal tasks graded by expert-written hidden verifiers. The reward is the fraction of target checks passed and drops to zero if any pass-to-pass test fails. One epoch of GSPO on a rank-32 LoRA adapter improves pass@1 on each of the six external benchmarks we evaluated, across three agent harnesses: SWE-Bench Pro (60.1 to 64.8), DeepSWE (31.0 to 43.4), Terminal-Bench 2.1 (67.4 to 82.0), Terminal-Bench 3 (1.4 to 12.1), Terminal-Bench 4 (0.0 to 7.6), and SWE-Marathon (5.0 to 25.0). Pooled over the five independent task sets (Terminal-Bench 4 revises Terminal-Bench 3), the improvement is significant (p < 0.001), and it remains significant on the three sets released after the training data was collected (p = 0.004); the model also improves under both harnesses never used in training. Median trajectories on DeepSWE and Terminal-Bench 3 are 24-35% shorter in agent steps. The base model's failed DeepSWE runs are mostly near-misses, and on the tasks the trained model newly solves, paired trajectories show it avoiding each of the four failure modes above.

AI.tldr: 仅用强化学习（GSPO + rank-32 LoRA，1个epoch）对Kimi K2.7 Code（1T参数MoE）在1700个专家构建任务上后训练，六个外部编码基准全部提升，且提升可迁移到训练后发布的新基准与未见过的agent harness。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体常因"最后一公里"问题失败：需求遗漏、测试仅覆盖已实现的情形、破坏原有行为、或依赖未经验证的假设。作者想验证强化学习能否弥合这一差距，以及所学能力能否超出训练分布迁移。
AI.method: 对Kimi K2.7 Code（1T参数、32B激活的开放权重MoE模型）仅用RL后训练，任务集1700个：1000个代码仓库任务（由隐藏fail-to-pass测试与现有行为的pass-to-pass测试评分）、700个终端任务（由专家编写的隐藏验证器评分）。奖励为目标检查通过比例，任一pass-to-pass测试失败即归零。使用GSPO在rank-32 LoRA适配器上训练1个epoch。评估覆盖六个外部基准、三种agent harness。
AI.result: 各基准pass@1提升：SWE-Bench Pro 60.1→64.8，DeepSWE 31.0→43.4，Terminal-Bench 2.1 67.4→82.0，Terminal-Bench 3 1.4→12.1，Terminal-Bench 4 0.0→7.6，SWE-Marathon 5.0→25.0。五个独立任务集汇总提升显著（p<0.001），在训练数据收集之后发布的三个集合上仍显著（p=0.004）；在两个训练中未使用的harness下也均有提升。DeepSWE与Terminal-Bench 3的中位轨迹在agent步数上缩短24-35%。
