AI.conclusion: 纯RL后训练可有效缓解编码智能体的最后一公里失败，并具备跨分布迁移能力。基座模型失败的DeepSWE任务多为"近失"，而在新解出的任务上，配对轨迹显示模型规避了上述四类失败模式。

title: GUI-HARVEST: Self-Improving GUI Agents through Evidence-Driven Harness Evolution
summary: The executable harness surrounding a GUI model determines how observations are assembled, actions are executed, and verification, recovery, and termination are controlled. Compared with harness optimization for non-GUI agents, automatically optimizing this harness poses three coupled challenges: reconciling model intent with observed visual effects, diagnosing failures under variable execution outcomes, and identifying recurrent failure patterns across tasks and translating them into reusable runtime changes. We introduce GUI-HARVEST, an automatic harness optimizer that enables self-improving GUI agents with frozen backbone models. First, to ground diagnosis in observed action effects, it aligns model outputs and executed actions with before-and-after screenshots, tying findings to specific interface transitions. Second, to account for execution variability, it treats repeated runs of the same task as a joint evidence unit, using within-task comparisons to locate outcome-relevant behavioral differences. Third, it consolidates verified findings across tasks into recurring failure patterns, maps them to bounded source-code edits with predictions recorded before evaluation, and checks the predicted behavioral effects alongside task performance through repeated execution. Experiments on OSWorld-Verified show consistent held-out gains across six general-purpose open, GUI-specialized open, and proprietary backbone models; Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct gains 12.33 points on the full suite. Frozen-harness transfer improves GPT-5 by 13.87 percentage points on WindowsAgentArena at 50 steps without further optimization. With the same backbone and initial harness, GUI-HARVEST outperforms Self-Harness and Meta-Harness, suggesting that GUI-specific diagnosis and validation help harness improvements generalize to unseen tasks. The code is available at https://github.com/GaryYang12345/GUI-HARVEST.

AI.tldr: GUI-HARVEST：在冻结主干模型下自动优化GUI智能体harness，通过截图对齐诊断、重复运行联合证据与跨任务失败模式归纳，实现自改进；在OSWorld-Verified上多模型稳定提升。
AI.motivation: GUI模型的可执行harness决定了观测组装、动作执行及验证、恢复与终止控制。相较于非GUI智能体的harness优化，自动优化GUI harness面临三个耦合挑战：协调模型意图与观测到的视觉效果、在可变执行结果下诊断失败、以及跨任务识别复发失败模式并转化为可复用运行时改动。
AI.method: 提出GUI-HARVEST自动harness优化器，支持冻结主干模型的自改进GUI智能体。三点机制：（1）将模型输出与执行动作同前后截图对齐，使诊断锚定具体界面转场；（2）把同一任务的重复运行视为联合证据单元，通过任务内比较定位与结果相关的行为差异；（3）将跨任务验证后的发现归纳为复发失败模式，映射为有界源码编辑，评估前记录预测并在重复执行中同时检验预测行为效果与任务性能。
AI.result: 在OSWorld-Verified上，六种通用开源、GUI专用开源及闭源主干模型均取得一致的留出集提升；Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct在全套件上提升12.33分。冻结harness迁移在50步下使GPT-5在WindowsAgentArena上提升13.87个百分点且无需进一步优化。相同主干与初始harness下，GUI-HARVEST优于Self-Harness与Meta-Harness。
AI.conclusion: GUI特定的诊断与验证有助于harness改进泛化到未见任务；代码已开源。

title: Optimal Transport Reweighting for Robust Learning under Spurious Correlations and Label Noise
summary: Machine learning models often suffer performance degradation under subpopulation shift, particularly when spurious correlations cause models to rely on shortcut features that fail to generalize across subgroups. A recent line of work mitigates this issue by using loss-based signals to identify informative samples, but these signals can become severely distorted under label noise: mislabeled samples may also incur large losses and contaminate subsequent reweighting or retraining. Despite its practical importance, this intersection remains largely underexplored. We propose POTER, a reweighting framework based on optimal transport that derives sample importance from the transport geometry between the training distribution and a reference distribution constructed from limited validation group annotations. By measuring alignment at the individual-sample level rather than relying on loss, POTER downweights mislabeled or strongly bias-aligned samples while assigning higher importance to samples better aligned with the reference distribution. In addition, POTER requires only a single ERM training stage, moving beyond the retraining paradigm common in recent work. Across standard benchmarks and noisy-label settings, POTER achieves state-of-the-art worst-group accuracy, including cases where label corruption is concentrated within minority subgroups.

AI.tldr: 提出POTER：基于最优传输的子群体偏移重加权框架，以样本身份对齐度替代损失信号，单阶段ERM训练，在有噪声标签下取得最优最差组精度。
AI.motivation: 机器学习模型在子群体偏移下性能下降，常因伪相关导致依赖捷径特征。已有工作用损失信号识别样本，但在标签噪声下会严重失真：误标样本同样产生大损失，污染重加权或重训练过程。该交叉问题研究不足。
AI.method: POTER基于最优传输的重加权框架，利用训练分布与由少量验证组标注构建的参考分布之间的传输几何来推导样本重要性。在单样本层面度量对齐程度而非依赖损失，从而降低误标样本与强烈偏置对齐样本的权重，提高与参考分布对齐样本的重要性。仅需单一ERM训练阶段，无需重训练。
AI.result: 在标准基准与噪声标签设定下，POTER取得最先进的最差组精度，包括标签污染集中于少数子群体的情况。
AI.conclusion: 以传输几何替代损失信号可缓解标签噪声下的信号失真问题，兼顾性能与训练效率，为子群体偏移下的鲁棒学习提供新思路。

title: Parameter-Efficient Distributionally Robust Adaptation of Tabular Foundation Models under Subpopulation Shift
summary: Despite strong mean accuracy, tabular foundation models (TFMs) can perform poorly on underrepresented groups under subpopulation shift, where group proportions change between training and deployment. We propose DR-TFM, a parameter-efficient distributionally robust adaptation framework that requires no true group annotations. DR-TFM adjusts attention to labeled context examples by fine-tuning an existing query scaling network or adding and training one, while keeping all other parameters fixed. We instantiate the framework with two robust objectives using estimated groups or source conditional distributions derived from training data. For TabPFN-3, adaptation updates only 0.016% of the pretrained model's parameters. Across five tabular benchmarks, DR-TFM achieves substantially higher average worst-group accuracy than pretrained TFMs and the compared robust baselines without true group annotations, while maintaining competitive mean group accuracy. DR-TFM also improves average worst-group accuracy on ACS Income and across four additional TFMs.

AI.tldr: 提出DR-TFM，一种无需真实组标注的参数高效分布鲁棒适配框架，通过微调或新增查询缩放网络调整注意力，在五个表格基准上显著提升最差组准确率。
AI.motivation: 表格基础模型（TFM）虽平均准确率高，但在子群体偏移（训练与部署时组比例变化）下对代表性不足的群体表现差；且真实组标注通常不可得。
AI.method: DR-TFM：参数高效分布鲁棒适配框架，无需真实组标注。通过微调现有查询缩放网络或新增并训练一个该网络来调整对带标签上下文样本的注意力，其余参数冻结。用基于训练数据估计的组或源条件分布实例化两种鲁棒目标。以TabPFN-3为例仅更新预训练模型0.016%参数。
AI.result: 在五个表格基准上，DR-TFM无需真实组标注即取得显著高于预训练TFM及对比鲁棒基线的平均最差组准确率，同时保持有竞争力的平均组准确率；在ACS Income及另外四种TFM上平均最差组准确率也获提升。
AI.conclusion: DR-TFM以极低参数量实现分布鲁棒的表格基础模型适配，在无组标注条件下有效缓解子群体偏移带来的性能不均。

title: Does Scaling Reinforcement Learning Really Require More Training?
summary: Scaling reasoning typically spends more compute on reinforcement learning (RL) or on inference. We show that a completed RL training history can yield policies stronger than the checkpoints visited by its optimizer. We call this policy-space scaling: expanding the deployable policy set accessible from a fixed RL history, without extending training or increasing per-query inference computation. We instantiate it with SURGE (Scaling Up RL Gradient-free via Eigenspace fusion). SURGE combines two checkpoints from the same RL run: a high-accuracy anchor and a competitive donor that generates shorter responses. It expresses both checkpoints as changes from their shared initialization, then spectrally decomposes the anchor's update to retain its dominant component and incorporate the donor's complementary component. With a fixed target for how much of the anchor update to retain, SURGE determines the block size from the weights without testing candidate policies. We evaluate two 1.5B mathematical-reasoning histories, DeepSeek and Nemotron, and one 7B coding history, OLMo. SURGE improves benchmark-average accuracy over both input checkpoints while using fewer reasoning tokens than the anchor. It reaches 54.17% on DeepSeek AIME24 against a measured native maximum of 50.83%, and 83.7% on OLMo HumanEval+ against 82.8%. These gains exceed the observed training curves. Geometric controls support the importance of RL-update structure beyond weight displacement or token reduction alone. Each constructed model runs as a single policy. Our findings identify stored RL history as a reusable scaling resource: the capability available from a training run need not end at its best checkpoint.

AI.tldr: 提出"策略空间扩展"概念，通过SURGE方法融合同一次RL训练的两个检查点，在不增加训练或推理开销的前提下获得超越优化器访问过的检查点的策略，验证了RL历史是可复用的扩展资源。
AI.motivation: 传统扩展推理能力的方式是在RL或推理阶段投入更多算力，但一次RL训练完成后，其最终策略集是否已被充分利用尚不明确。作者希望挖掘已完成的RL训练历史中潜在的、未被优化器访问到的更强策略，从而在固定训练与推理成本下提升能力。
AI.method: 提出SURGE（基于特征空间融合的无梯度RL扩展）。它取同一次RL运行中的两个检查点：一个高精度锚点和一个能生成更短回复的竞争性供体。将两者表达为相对共享初始化的变化量，对锚点更新做谱分解，保留其主成分并融入供体的互补成分。在固定锚点更新保留比例的目标下，SURGE直接由权重确定块大小，无需测试候选策略。
AI.result: 在DeepSeek与Nemotron两个1.5B数学推理历史和OLMo一个7B代码历史中评估。SURGE在基准平均准确率上超过两个输入检查点，且推理token少于锚点。DeepSeek AIME24达到54.17%（实测原生上限50.83%），OLMo HumanEval+达83.7%（对比82.8%），增益超出观测到的训练曲线。几何对照实验支持RL更新结构的重要性，而非仅靠权重位移或token削减。
AI.conclusion: RL训练历史是可复用的扩展资源，一次训练运行可获得的能力不必止步于其最佳检查点。每个构建出的模型均作为单一策略运行，策略空间扩展为固定训练预算下提升部署能力提供了新途径。

title: Generalist Representation, Specialist Detection: TS-Router for Time-Series Anomaly Detection
summary: Time-series anomaly detection (TSAD) is difficult to generalize across datasets because heterogeneous temporal dynamics imply different notions of normality and favor different detection criteria. While time-series foundation models provide transferable representations, coupling them with a fixed anomaly-scoring mechanism can overlook this variation. This motivates a different perspective on foundation-model-based TSAD: using foundation models to coordinate specialized anomaly criteria rather than directly imposing a universal one. Based on this view, we propose \textbf{TS-Router}, a generalist-representation, specialist-detection framework that estimates the relative competence of heterogeneous anomaly detectors from pretrained temporal representations and selects suitable specialists for each target series. To avoid relying on specialist-performance labels from real tasks, we derive soft competence supervision from specialists' relative performance on labeled simulated tasks. At deployment, routing requires no target anomaly labels, and only the selected specialists are fitted unsupervisedly on the target series. We bound Top-\(k\) set-competence regret under representation coverage and conditional competence stability. Across 16 real-world benchmarks and four complementary evaluation metrics, TS-Router achieves the best overall average rank. Controlled ablations with multiple frozen TSFM encoders further support the use of pretrained representations for competence estimation and adaptive specialist selection. The code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TS-Router-D8FF.

AI.tldr: 提出TS-Router框架，用预训练时序基础模型表征来估计异构异常检测器的相对能力，从而为每条目标序列路由合适的专家检测器，在16个真实基准上取得最佳平均排名。
AI.motivation: 时间序列异常检测（TSAD）难以跨数据集泛化：异构时序动态意味着不同的"正常"定义，也偏好不同的检测准则。虽然时序基础模型提供可迁移表征，但若将其与固定的异常打分机制绑定，会忽略这种差异性。因此作者主张换一个视角——用基础模型去协调多种专门的异常准则，而非直接施加统一准则。
AI.method: 提出TS-Router，一种"通才表征、专家检测"的框架：基于预训练时序表征估计异构异常检测器（专家）的相对能力，并为每条目标序列选择适配的专家。为避免依赖真实任务上的专家性能标签，从专家在带标签的模拟任务上的相对表现中导出软能力监督。部署时路由不需要目标异常标签，只有被选中的专家才在目标序列上做无监督拟合。理论上给出了在表征覆盖度与条件能力稳定性条件下的Top-k集合能力遗憾界。
AI.result: 在16个真实世界基准和四个互补评价指标上，TS-Router取得最佳总体平均排名；使用多个冻结TSFM编码器的受控消融实验进一步支持了用预训练表征做能力估计与自适应专家选择的合理性。
AI.conclusion: 将基础模型用于协调专家异常准则（而非强加统一准则）是TSAD泛化的有效路径；预训练时序表征可用于能力估计与路由，且无需目标域异常标签即可部署。代码已开源。

title: Looping Beyond Twice: A Scalable Recipe for Looped Mixture-of-Experts
summary: Looped Transformers introduce recurrent depth as a new scaling axis for LLMs: by repeatedly applying shared Transformer blocks, they increase effective depth without increasing parameter count. However, the benefits of looping remain unclear for large MoE LLMs under FLOPs-matched comparisons. The main reason is that the gains from additional iterations diminish quickly and can even turn into degradation, so the extra FLOPs spent on looping yield little substantial improvement. Consequently, prior work typically settles on two loops. We identify two main obstacles to scaling looped MoE. First, looping inherits and amplifies the curse of depth: hidden-state variance grows with each iteration as residual updates accumulate, which destabilizes deep recurrence and causes representations to drift. Second, looped MoE suffers from expert selection collapse: routers repeatedly select the same experts across loops, so extra iterations add computation without adding computational diversity. Guided by this diagnosis, we propose LOOM, built on a single principle: each loop should contribute new computation while keeping the recurrent state stable. LOOM stabilizes recurrence by scaling residual updates to bound variance growth and re-injecting the input embedding at every loop, and diversifies it through per-loop routers that engage different experts and a Looping Residual that carries earlier outputs forward. Experiments across 100M-1.7B models show stable scaling to 9-12 loops. Under near-iso-FLOP, the 700M model performs best at 5 loops, reducing perplexity from 18.36 to 16.54 and improving average zero-shot accuracy from 38.84% to 39.53% over the non-looped baseline. Without FLOP matching, the 1.7B model trained on 60B tokens peaks at 9 loops, reducing perplexity from 9.62 to 7.77 and improving average zero-shot accuracy from 42.4% to 47.7%. Code is available https://github.com/hed-ucas/LOOM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LOOM，通过稳定循环状态并提升每轮计算多样性，使循环式MoE LLM可扩展至9-12次循环，显著降低困惑度并提升零样本准确率。
AI.motivation: 循环Transformer以共享块重复应用增加有效深度而不增参数，但在FLOPs匹配下，大MoE模型的循环收益快速递减甚至退化，导致已有工作通常仅用2次循环。作者诊断出两大障碍：一是深度诅咒被继承和放大，残差累积使隐状态方差随迭代增长，深层循环不稳定并致表征漂移；二是专家选择坍缩，路由器在各轮重复选择同一批专家，额外迭代只增算力而不增多样性。
AI.method: LOOM遵循单一原则：每轮循环应贡献新计算同时保持循环状态稳定。稳定性方面，缩放残差更新以约束方差增长，并在每轮重新注入输入嵌入；多样性方面，采用per-loop路由器以激活不同专家，并引入Looping Residual将早期输出向前传递。
AI.result: 在100M-1.7B模型上实验，可稳定扩展至9-12次循环。近等FLOP下，700M模型在5次循环最佳，困惑度由18.36降至16.54，平均零样本准确率由38.84%升至39.53%；不做FLOP匹配时，1.7B模型在60B token训练下于9次循环达峰，困惑度由9.62降至7.77，平均零样本准确率由42.4%升至47.7%。
AI.conclusion: LOOM通过稳定循环并多样化每轮计算，克服了循环MoE的深度不稳定与专家选择坍缩两大瓶颈，实现了循环深度在大规模MoE LLM中的有效扩展，验证了循环深度作为LLM缩放新轴线的潜力。

title: Have an LLM Write Your Anomaly Detector: Autonomous Discovery of Compact, Interpretable Detectors for Time Series
summary: Time-series anomaly detection trades off predictive accuracy, computational efficiency, and interpretability. We use a large language model not as the detector but as the author of one: an autonomous research loop in which the model repeatedly edits a single short NumPy program under a leakage-free objective, keeping the best-scoring detector it finds. The loop discovers two compact detectors, one for univariate and one for multivariate series, that describe short windows by their local spectral features and compare them with the training-region distribution through a covariance-aware distance. On the TSB-AD benchmark these detectors lead the field across metrics, ahead of the strongest classical, deep, and foundation-model baselines including Time-RCD, yet they train no network and use no GPU, and the multivariate detector is faster than every similarly performing baseline. LLM-driven program search is thus a practical route to accurate, efficient, and transparent detectors.

AI.tldr: 利用大语言模型作为"作者"进行自主程序搜索，发现两个紧凑的NumPy检测器（单变量与多变量），在TSB-AD基准上领先现有方法，且无需GPU训练、速度快、可解释性强。
AI.motivation: 时间序列异常检测需在预测精度、计算效率与可解释性之间权衡。现有方法（经典、深度、基础模型）往往难以同时兼顾三者，作者希望探索一条能同时实现准确、高效与透明的检测器构建路径。
AI.method: 提出LLM驱动的自主研究循环：将大语言模型不直接作为检测器，而是作为检测器的"作者"。在无泄漏的目标函数下，模型反复编辑一段简短的NumPy程序，并保留得分最优的检测器。该方法最终发现两个紧凑检测器（单变量与多变量各一），通过局部谱特征描述短窗口，并用协方差感知距离与训练区分布进行比较。
AI.result: 在TSB-AD基准上，这两个检测器在多项指标上领先，超越最强的经典、深度及基础模型基线（包括Time-RCD）；无需训练网络、无需GPU；多变量检测器比所有性能相近的基线都快。
AI.conclusion: LLM驱动的程序搜索是构建准确、高效且透明检测器的实用途径，证明了将LLM作为算法设计作者而非直接检测器的可行性。

title: Discrete Wasserstein Flows for One-Step Generative Modeling
summary: We introduce a new framework for one-step generative modelling on finite state spaces. To extend drifting beyond continuous domains, we use discrete Wasserstein geometry to define a target-relative KL gradient flow over the transitions of a reversible Markov kernel. We realize this probability flow at the particle level through Markov jumps and amortize the resulting transport updates into a latent-conditioned generator, so that the iterative dynamics are required only during training while inference remains one-step. In a controlled setting where the underlying distributions and transport dynamics can be computed exactly, we verify KL dissipation, consistency between the particle dynamics and the probability flow, and the predicted numerical scaling. We further show that a finite-capacity neural generator can track these exact transport targets while retaining one-step generation. These results validate the basic construction and provide a foundation for scaling Discrete Drifting to structured discrete data.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"Discrete Drifting"框架，在有限状态空间上实现一步生成建模：借助离散Wasserstein几何定义目标相对的KL梯度流，并通过马尔可夫跳跃在粒子层面实现概率流，再将传输更新摊销到隐变量条件生成器中，使迭代动力学仅用于训练、推理保持一步生成。
AI.motivation: 现有的drift类生成方法主要在连续域上定义，难以直接推广到离散空间。作者希望将drifting思想扩展到有限状态空间，从而为结构化离散数据提供一步生成建模的基础。
AI.method: 利用离散Wasserstein几何，在可逆马尔可夫核的转移上定义一个目标相对KL梯度流作为概率流；通过马尔可夫跳跃在粒子层面实现该概率流；将由此得到的传输更新摊销为一个隐变量条件生成器，使迭代动力学只在训练阶段需要，推理阶段为一步生成。并在分布和传输动力学可精确计算的受控环境中，验证KL耗散、粒子动力学与概率流的一致性以及预测的数值缩放规律。
AI.result: 在受控实验中验证了KL耗散、粒子动力学与概率流的一致性以及预测的数值缩放行为；进一步表明有限容量的神经生成器能够跟踪这些精确传输目标，同时保持一步生成能力。
AI.conclusion: 结果验证了该基本构造的有效性，并为将Discrete Drifting扩展到结构化离散数据提供了基础。

title: Detect, Explain, Interpret: An End-to-End Benchmark for Time Series Anomaly Detection, Explainability and Interpretability
summary: Time Series Anomaly Detection has received increasing attention, driven by the growing availability of complex time series data. This surge has led to the development of numerous detection methods, as well as a variety of benchmarks aimed at thoroughly evaluating their performance. However, most existing detectors remain largely agnostic to domain context, overlooking explainability and interpretability. One of the main reasons for this gap is that current benchmarks primarily focus on detection accuracy, and only few of them evaluate spatial explainability. Moreover, no benchmark currently provides sufficiently rich semantic annotations to support the generation of human-understandable interpretations of anomalies. To address these limitations, we introduce SHAD (Scality High-dimensional Anomaly Detection benchmark), a fully annotated benchmark composed of 215 multivariate, high-dimensional time series collected from real-world distributed cloud storage systems operated by Scality. The proposed dataset includes rich contextual information, covering three families of anomalies with varying degrees of severity. As further contribution, we provide a foundation for future work by evaluating baseline methods for Detection, Explainability, and Interpretability, covering all stages of a TSAD pipeline. For Detection, we benchmark a wide range of existing anomaly detectors, testing their effectiveness on the proposed real-world dataset. Then, we consider explainability by evaluating whether measuring the contribution of each dimension in the generated anomaly score can provide accurate anomaly attributions. Finally, for interpretability, we investigate the effectiveness of frozen LLM baselines in localizing and interpreting anomalies.

AI.tldr: 论文提出SHAD——一个基于Scality真实分布式云存储系统、包含215条多变量高维时间序列的全标注异常检测基准，并首次系统评估检测、可解释性与可理解性三个环节的基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列异常检测器大多忽略领域语境，缺乏可解释性与可理解性；根源在于当前基准主要关注检测精度，仅少数评估空间可解释性，且没有任何基准提供足够丰富的语义标注来支撑人类可理解的异常解释。
AI.method: 构建SHAD基准：采集自Scality真实分布式云存储系统的215条多变量高维时间序列，含丰富上下文信息，覆盖三类不同严重程度的异常；并搭建覆盖TSAD全流程的基线评测框架，分别针对检测（多种现有异常检测器）、可解释性（评估各维度对异常分数贡献的归因准确性）、可理解性（冻结LLM基线定位与解释异常）。
AI.result: 在真实数据集上测试了广泛现有异常检测器的检测有效性；验证了通过度量各维度对异常分数的贡献能否提供准确异常归因；考察了冻结LLM基线在异常定位与解释上的效果。
AI.conclusion: SHAD弥补了现有基准在语义标注与可解释性评估上的空白，为时间序列异常检测的检测、可解释性与可理解性研究提供了统一、真实且全标注的评测基础。

title: Model validation in machine learning: A scenario-based guide from hold-out splits to nested group cross-validation in biomedical and applied research
comment: Tutorial with eight controlled scenarios; includes MATLAB and Python/scikit-learn code listings
summary: Model validation estimates the performance of a complete learning procedure on new data. However, an invalid split can produce an optimistic and stable result. This tutorial reviews hold-out validation, train/validation/test designs, repeated random subsampling, k-fold and repeated stratified cross-validation, leave-one-out and leave-p-out schemes, group-aware validation, and nested group cross-validation. General machine-learning principles are linked to EEG epochs, paired-eye OCT images, repeated clinical measurements, and multicenter data. Eight controlled scenarios compare flawed and leakage-safe designs: seven use locked confusion matrices with auditable metrics, and one uses a reproducible repeated-study simulation. The scenarios cover global feature selection, normalization leakage, dependent records, center mixing, repeated test-set use, and estimator instability. Bias, variance, metric aggregation, uncertainty, and computational cost are also examined. A data-size matrix, a decision tree, and reporting checklists are provided. Reproducible MATLAB templates and scikit-learn counterparts are included. The results show that no validation method is universally best. The independent unit must match the intended deployment target. Every data-dependent operation must also exclude the observations used for performance estimation.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了模型验证方法（留出法、k折交叉验证、嵌套交叉验证、分组验证等），通过八个受控场景对比有缺陷与防泄漏设计，证明不存在普适最优的验证方法，独立单元须匹配部署目标，且所有依赖数据的操作都须排除用于性能估计的样本。
AI.motivation: 模型验证用于估计完整学习流程在新数据上的性能，但无效的数据划分会产生乐观且稳定的结果，导致性能高估。因此有必要梳理各类验证方案并揭示常见的数据泄漏与偏差来源。
AI.method: 综述留出法、训练/验证/测试设计、重复随机子采样、k折与重复分层交叉验证、留一与留p法、分组感知验证及嵌套分组交叉验证，并将通用机器学习原则与EEG epochs、配对眼OCT图像、重复临床测量和多中心数据相结合。设计八个受控场景对比有缺陷与防泄漏设计：七个使用锁定的混淆矩阵与可审计指标，一个使用可复现的重复研究仿真；场景涵盖全局特征选择、归一化泄漏、依赖记录、中心混合、重复使用测试集和估计器不稳定性，并考察偏差、方差、指标聚合、不确定性与计算成本。另提供数据规模矩阵、决策树与报告清单，以及可复现的MATLAB模板和scikit-learn对应实现。
AI.result: 结果表明，没有任何一种验证方法具有普适最优性；独立单元必须与预期的部署目标相匹配；所有依赖数据的操作都必须排除用于性能估计的观测。有缺陷的划分会导致乐观且稳定的性能估计。
AI.conclusion: 验证设计应由部署目标驱动，核心原则是独立单元匹配部署目标且所有数据依赖操作排除评估样本；建议借助数据规模矩阵、决策树和报告清单规范验证流程，并提供可复现的实现模板。

title: Feature Selective Model Collapse in Diffusion Models: Total Replacement versus Fixed-Budget Training
summary: Model collapse arises when generative models are trained on synthetic data produced by earlier models. The phenomenon has attracted considerable attention because of its societal and technical implications. However, previous studies have reached seemingly contradictory conclusions: replacing real data with synthetic data causes collapse (Shumailov et al.), yet accumulating real data alongside synthetic data can prevent it. For diffusion models, we study an intermediate regime typical of finite-budget pipelines: all past datasets and the real data are kept, but each new model is trained on a fixed-size sample from this growing pool, so the real fraction vanishes without any data being removed. Experiments on a 2D spiral dataset as well as the image benchmarks (MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and CIFAR-10) show that replacement protocol degrades dataset rapidly as in the literature, whereas the fixed budget degrades only partially, sparing some features. A linear-response model of the multi-generational parameter dynamics, analyzed by stochastic recursion, confirms that the two protocols differ: some features will be fragile and lost within a few generations for both protocols, while some will be robust and preserved over practically unbounded horizons under the fixed budget protocol.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究扩散模型在有限预算数据流水线中的模型坍缩现象：追踪模型在累积数据池上固定采样规模训练时的退化行为，并与替换协议对比，揭示固定预算下仅有部分特征丢失、部分特征可长期保留。
AI.motivation: 既有研究结论看似矛盾：用合成数据替换真实数据会导致模型坍缩，而将真实数据与合成数据并行累积则可避免坍缩。作者希望澄清这一分歧，并刻画现实中更常见的有限预算场景——数据不被删除但每代模型只能用固定规模采样。
AI.method: 在2D螺旋数据集及MNIST、Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10图像基准上，对扩散模型比较两种协议：替换协议与固定预算协议（保留所有历史与真实数据，每代从增长池中抽取固定规模样本）。同时建立多代参数动力学的线性响应模型，并用随机递归进行分析。
AI.result: 替换协议使数据集快速退化；固定预算协议仅部分退化，并保留部分特征。线性响应模型证实两协议不同：两者均有一些特征脆弱、仅几代内即丢失；固定预算协议下另有一些特征稳健，可在近乎无界的代际范围内被保留。
AI.conclusion: 模型坍缩的严重程度取决于数据协议而非单纯合成数据占比；固定预算下真实数据比例虽渐近消失，但并非必然导致全面崩溃，退化为特征选择性现象，部分特征可长期幸存。

title: FedMIX-P: Mixing Local and Global Preconditioners for Federated Vision and Language Model Training
summary: Adaptive preconditioners accelerate model training, but heterogeneous client geometries can bias federated updates even when gradients are evaluated at the same model. Round-start synchronization alone cannot prevent this mismatch from reappearing during local training. We propose \texttt{FedMIX-P}, which mixes shared and local preconditioners at every local step, retaining local adaptation while reducing mean-squared operator mismatch by a factor of $λ^2$. For smooth nonconvex objectives with stochastic gradients and partial participation, we establish an $O(R^{-1/2})$ stationarity bound using suitable stepsizes and a horizon-dependent mixing weight, without requiring local preconditioners to converge to one another. A two-client counterexample shows that fixed positive mixing can preserve a nonstationary fixed point. The theory covers bounded linear symmetric positive-definite preconditioners. Experiments with SOAP, Sophia, and Muon variants across vision and language tasks show improvements over corresponding local optimizers, including accuracy gains of up to $19.47$ percentage points and lower validation loss for 60M--350M language models. Full nonlinear and momentum-based updates require separate analysis.

AI.tldr: 提出FedMIX-P，在每个本地步混合共享与本地预条件子，将算子失配的均方降低λ²倍，并在非凸随机梯度与部分参与下给出O(R^{-1/2})平稳性界，实验验证优于纯本地优化器。
AI.motivation: 自适应预条件子能加速训练，但客户端间异构的几何结构会使联邦更新产生偏差，即使在同一模型处计算梯度也难以避免；仅在轮次开始时同步无法阻止这种失配在本地训练中再次出现。
AI.method: 提出FedMIX-P，在每个本地训练步将共享预条件子与本地预条件子进行混合，在保留本地自适应的同时把算子失配的均方按λ²倍降低；针对光滑非凸目标、随机梯度和部分参与，采用合适的步长与随训练轮数变化的混合权重进行收敛分析；理论覆盖有界线性对称正定预条件子。
AI.result: 建立了O(R^{-1/2})的平稳性界，且不要求各本地预条件子相互收敛；构造双客户端反例表明固定正混合权重可能保留非平稳不动点；在视觉与语言任务上对SOAP、Sophia、Muon变体进行实验，相比对应本地优化器取得提升，准确率最高提升19.47个百分点，60M–350M语言模型验证损失更低。
AI.conclusion: 逐本地步的共享-本地预条件子混合可有效缓解异构几何导致的联邦偏差并保证收敛性。但完整非线性及基于动量的更新需要另行分析。

title: Auto-Formalizing Neuro-Symbolic Predictors
summary: Neuro-Symbolic (NeSy) predictors incorporate prior knowledge into the prediction process of neural networks, ensuring that outputs satisfy specified constraints, making them particularly suitable for high-stakes applications where compliance with domain knowledge is essential. A key bottleneck in this paradigm is the acquisition of symbolic constraints: encoding domain knowledge into logical formulas remains a manual and expert-intensive process. In this work, we investigate the extent to which auto-formalization via LLMs can systematically translate textual knowledge into symbolic knowledge that can be plugged into NeSy predictors. To this end, we introduce auto-nesy-bench, a new benchmark for evaluating constraint formalization and its impact on downstream accuracy of NeSy predictors. Through an extensive evaluation across several domains, we find that LLMs can formalize constraints to a meaningful extent, generating formulas that are often similar to those provided by human experts. Moreover, when the generated formulas are syntactically valid, they can lead to high-quality downstream predictions. The code and benchmark are available at https://unitn-sml.github.io/auto-nesy-bench/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出auto-nesy-bench基准，系统评估LLM自动形式化文本知识为符号约束并接入神经符号预测器的能力，发现LLM可在一定程度上生成与专家相似的约束，且语法有效的公式能带来高质量的下游预测。
AI.motivation: 神经符号（NeSy）预测器需将领域知识编码为逻辑约束以保证输出合规，但符号约束的获取依赖人工专家、成本高且难以规模化，成为该范式的关键瓶颈。因此需探究LLM自动形式化能否系统地将文本知识转化为可用的符号知识。
AI.method: 引入auto-nesy-bench基准，用于评估约束形式化质量及其对NeSy预测器下游准确率的影响，并在多个领域开展广泛实验。
AI.result: LLM能在有意义的程度上形式化约束，生成公式常与人类专家提供的相似；当生成公式语法有效时，可带来高质量的下游预测。
AI.conclusion: LLM自动形式化在缓解NeSy约束获取瓶颈方面具有潜力，文法有效性是保证下游性能的关键条件；代码与基准已公开。

title: Beyond Pointwise Error: A Multi-Metric Evaluation of Spatial Climate Downscaling
summary: Climate downscaling aims to reconstruct fine scale spatial fields from coarse resolution inputs. Evaluating the quality of these reconstructions is challenging: low pointwise error can come at the cost of fine scale variability, while realistic spatial variability can be achieved with inaccurate local structures. The evaluation metric can therefore change which method appears to perform best. This work presents a multi metric benchmark comparing five spatial downscaling methods on ERA5 temperature, wind, and precipitation fields. Five criteria assess complementary properties: pointwise error, structural similarity, distribution error, spectral error, and gradient error. The results reveal a systematic trade off between spatial fidelity and fine scale variability. Some methods perform best on pointwise and spatially aligned metrics, but lose high frequency content, while others preserve substantially more spectral variability at the cost of less accurately positioned local structures. Consequently, method rankings change across metrics and variables. These results show that there is no single best downscaling method. Multi metric evaluation is therefore essential for assessing which properties of a climate field are preserved.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个多指标基准，用五类互补准则比较五种气候降尺度方法在ERA5温度、风速和降水场上的表现，揭示空间保真度与精细尺度变率之间的系统性权衡，说明方法排名随指标和变量变化，不存在单一最优降尺度方法。
AI.motivation: 气候降尺度评估存在根本性困难：低逐点误差可能以牺牲精细尺度变率为代价，而真实的空间变率也可能伴随不准确的局地结构。因此评估指标本身会改变"哪种方法最优"的结论，单一指标评估容易产生片面判断。
AI.method: 构建多指标基准，在ERA5温度、风场和降水场上对比五种空间降尺度方法，采用五项互补准则进行评估：逐点误差、结构相似性、分布误差、谱误差和梯度误差，从而综合刻画重构质量的多个维度。
AI.result: 结果显示空间保真度与精细尺度变率之间存在系统性权衡：部分方法在逐点误差和空间对齐类指标上表现最佳，但丢失高频内容；另一些方法保留了显著更多的谱变率，却以局地结构定位不准确为代价。方法排名随指标和变量的不同而变化。
AI.conclusion: 不存在单一最优的降尺度方法，多指标评估对于判断气候场中哪些属性得到保留至关重要，应作为降尺度方法评价的标准范式。

title: MCIR: A Feature Dependence-Aware Explainability Method with Reliability Guarantees
comment: Accepted for publication in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR)
summary: Modern machine-learning models often contain strongly dependent or redundant features, making feature attribution difficult because shared predictive information can be distributed across correlated predictors. Existing methods such as SHAP, LIME, HSIC, MI/CMI, and SAGE may therefore produce unstable rankings under multicollinearity or near-duplicate predictors. We propose the Mutual Correlation Impact Ratio Method (MCIR-M), a dependence-aware global feature-importance approach that quantifies the unique predictive information contributed by each feature beyond a selected dependence neighbourhood. MCIR-M introduces the Mutual Correlation Impact Ratio (MCIR), which conditions each feature on strongly dependent neighbours and computes a normalized ratio of conditional to block-level information. The population score lies in [0,1] and equals zero under exact conditional redundancy. We also introduce a lightweight estimation procedure that computes MCIR using a fraction of the available data and evaluates agreement with full-data explanations. Across controlled synthetic redundancy experiments and the UCI HAR benchmark, MCIR shows dependence-aware ranking behaviour, with its clearest advantage under injected near-duplicate predictors. Comparisons with independent and conditional SHAP, SAGE, HSIC, MI-based scores, and CIR-family baselines are mixed across real-data criteria. Reduced explanation samples lower computational burden in the evaluated configurations, while agreement with full-data explanations is assessed separately through ranking, head-set, and faithfulness diagnostics. Overall, MCIR-M provides a practical dependence-aware diagnostic for global explanation under strong feature dependence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MCIR-M方法，通过条件化强依赖邻居计算归一化的互相关影响比（MCIR），以量化特征在依赖邻域之外的独特预测信息，用于强特征依赖下的全局特征重要性诊断。
AI.motivation: 现代机器学习模型常包含强依赖或冗余特征，共享的预测信息会分散在相关预测变量中，导致SHAP、LIME、HSIC、MI/CMI、SAGE等现有方法在多重共线性或近重复预测变量下产生不稳定的重要性排序，因此需要依赖感知的特征归因方法。
AI.method: 提出互相关影响比方法（MCIR-M）：定义MCIR，将每个特征对其强依赖邻居进行条件化，计算条件信息与块级信息的归一化比值；总体分数落在[0,1]，在精确条件冗余下为零。同时引入轻量级估计流程，仅用部分数据计算MCIR，并通过排序、头部集合和忠实性诊断评估其与全数据解释的一致性。
AI.result: 在受控合成冗余实验和UCI HAR基准上，MCIR表现出依赖感知的排序行为，在注入近重复预测变量时优势最明显。与独立及条件SHAP、SAGE、HSIC、基于MI的分数及CIR家族基线的比较结果参差不齐，随真实数据评价标准而异。减少解释样本量在所评估配置中降低了计算负担。
AI.conclusion: MCIR-M为强特征依赖下的全局解释提供了一种实用的依赖感知诊断工具，其优势主要体现在近重复预测变量场景，但相对现有基线在真实数据上并非全面占优。

title: Permutation-Robust Decision Modeling with Candidate-Independent Block-Causal Attention
comment: Technical Report, will not be submitted to a conference
summary: Decision models often score a variable-sized set of candidate actions encoded in a single sequence. This setting is increasingly relevant for System 1 components inside generative systems, where candidates may be proposed or ordered differently across runs. Standard causal cross-encoding is expressive, but it can make a candidate's score depend on serialization order rather than on the underlying decision problem. We introduce candidate-independent block-causal attention, which preserves causal computation within the shared context and each candidate while blocking cross-candidate information flow and resetting candidate positions. We compare this architecture with standard causal attention and complementary invariant baselines across Gemma 3 1B, Qwen3 1.7B, and Qwen3 4B backbones. Candidate-independent attention consistently reduces permutation sensitivity while retaining competitive decision quality; ablations indicate that candidate isolation is the primary source of the effect, with position resetting completing the intended symmetry. A larger Qwen3-4B study further examines the behavior of the proposed architecture with substantially more training data. Code is available at the \href{https://github.com/guyAmit/ci-decision-models}{\textcolor{blue}{project repository}}, and the \href{https://huggingface.co/Guy-Amit/qwen3-4b-ci-decision-4096-poc}{\textcolor{blue}{Qwen3-4B model artifact}} is available on Hugging Face.

AI.tldr: 论文提出候选独立块因果注意力（candidate-independent block-causal attention），通过阻断候选间信息流并重置候选位置，降低决策模型对候选序列排列顺序的敏感性，同时保持决策质量。
AI.motivation: 决策模型常将可变数量的候选动作编码在单一序列中，尤其在生成式系统的System 1组件里，候选的提出或排序在不同运行间可能不同。标准因果交叉编码虽有表现力，但会使候选得分依赖序列化顺序，而非底层决策问题本身，导致排列敏感性问题。
AI.method: 提出候选独立块因果注意力：在共享上下文及每个候选内部保留因果计算，同时阻断跨候选信息流，并重置候选位置。在Gemma 3 1B、Qwen3 1.7B、Qwen3 4B骨干模型上，与标准因果注意力及互补的不变基线进行对比，并开展消融实验。
AI.result: 候选独立注意力在保持有竞争力决策质量的同时，持续降低排列敏感性。消融实验表明候选隔离是该效果的主要来源，位置重置补全了预期的对称性。在更大规模的Qwen3-4B实验中，使用显著更多训练数据进一步考察了该架构的行为。
AI.conclusion: 候选隔离加位置重置能有效缓解决策模型对候选序列化顺序的依赖，为生成式系统中顺序不稳定的候选评分提供了一种更对称、更稳定的建模方案。代码与模型工件已公开。

title: Iterative Policy Refinement through Semantic Rollout Analysis
summary: Structured policies improve efficiency, robustness, and interpretability in imitation learning by introducing task-specific inductive bias, but existing structure generation methods rely either on extensive human input or on static domain knowledge encoded in LLMs, which may be inconsistent with the expert demonstrations. We propose a closed-loop framework that iteratively refines structured policies using LLM-guided analysis of policy rollouts. By logging rollouts as semantically meaningful tabular data and prompting the LLM to generate diagnostic analysis code, our method identifies suboptimalities in the policy structure and iteratively corrects them without requiring human instruction. Experiments on car racing and door opening tasks show that our approach improves imitation learning performance by up to 15% over zero-shot LLM-generated structures and requires 75% less compute to achieve the same reinforcement learning performance. These results demonstrate that tabular rollout analysis provides an effective feedback signal to align LLM-generated policy structures with expert demonstrations, and we can utilize it to generate good policy structures automatically.

AI.tldr: 提出闭环框架，通过LLM分析tabular形式的策略rollout来迭代精炼结构化策略，无需人工指导即可自动生成与专家演示对齐的策略结构。
AI.motivation: 结构化策略通过引入任务特定的归纳偏置，提升了模仿学习的效率、鲁棒性和可解释性。但现有结构生成方法要么依赖大量人工输入，要么依赖LLM中编码的静态领域知识，可能与专家演示不一致。
AI.method: 一种闭环框架，迭代地精炼结构化策略：将策略rollout记录为语义上有意义的表格数据，提示LLM生成诊断分析代码，从而识别策略结构中的次优之处并迭代修正，无需人工指令。
AI.result: 在赛车和开门任务上，相比零样本LLM生成的结构，模仿学习性能提升最高达15%；达到相同强化学习性能所需计算量减少75%。
AI.conclusion: 表格化的rollout分析提供了有效的反馈信号，可将LLM生成的策略结构与专家演示对齐，从而自动生成良好的策略结构。

title: iADD: Improving Alignment and Diversity in Diffusion Policy Optimization
summary: Reinforcement learning based post training of diffusion models, such as Denoising Diffusion Policy Optimization (DDPO), optimizes a reverse diffusion process under a reward function. However, current approaches to reward optimizations do so at the cost of diversity and quality. In this paper, we provide better tradeoffs through careful theoretical considerations and method design. We analyze the theoretical framework and mathematically demonstrate that \emph{only-latter timestep} updates of diffusion model may be harmful for diversity contrary to the conclusions presented in a previous work. Additionally, we propose an incremental Feynman-Kac training based on strong theoretical foundations in order to achieve the best-yet alignment-diversity tradeoffs. We perform extensive experiments and compare our method against related diffusion policy optimization approaches in three different tasks and also provide strong ablations for each component, thus validating strong performance gains in both alignment and diversity.

AI.tldr: 本文通过理论分析与方法设计改进扩散模型的强化学习后训练，提出增量Feynman-Kac训练方法，实现对齐与多样性之间更优的权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有基于强化学习的扩散模型后训练方法（如DDPO）在优化奖励时牺牲了生成样本的多样性和质量，需要在对齐与多样性之间取得更好的权衡。
AI.method: 从理论上分析扩散模型后训练框架，数学证明仅对后段时间步进行更新可能损害多样性（与既有工作结论相反）；并基于坚实的理论基础提出增量Feynman-Kac训练方法。
AI.result: 在三种不同任务上与相关扩散策略优化方法进行大量实验对比，并对每个组件进行充分消融，验证了在对齐和多样性两方面均取得显著的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 理论分析与增量Feynman-Kac训练设计能够有效改善扩散模型强化学习后训练的对齐-多样性权衡，实验证明该方法的优越性。

title: Flowing Faster to Coordinate: One-Step Online Multi-Agent Flow Policies
summary: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) provides a powerful framework for learning coordinated behaviors through interactions with the environment. Developing MARL policies requires balancing expressive modeling of complex and multimodal action distributions with efficient training and execution. Generative policies, particularly diffusionbased policies, can faithfully capture complex and multimodal behaviors, but costly iterative sampling hinders their scalability in online multi-agent settings. We propose an Online MARL framework via one-step Flow model (OMAF) that combines expressive generative policies with efficient one-step action generation. OMAF employs a Transformer-based flow policy to capture complex coordination behaviors, while its approximate path score surrogate provides a principled route to synchronized flow policy optimization. To enable stable and sampleefficient learning, we further develop a joint optimization scheme coupling softmax Q-value estimation with a joint flow policy objective for coordinated policy learning. By eliminating iterative sampling, OMAF dramatically reduces training overhead without sacrificing policy expressiveness. Extensive experiments across 10 standard tasks from MPE and MAMuJoCo show that OMAF consistently achieves superior performance, with up to 3.4x higher returns and 10.5x sample efficiency improvement compared with baseline methods. These results validate the effectiveness of OMAF as an expressive and computationally efficient one-step flow policy paradigm for online MARL.

AI.tldr: 提出OMAF：基于一步流模型的在线多智能体强化学习框架，兼顾表达力与效率。
AI.motivation: MARL需在复杂多模态动作分布的表达建模与高效训练执行之间取得平衡；扩散策略表达力强但迭代采样代价高，限制在线多智能体场景的可扩展性。
AI.method: OMAF采用基于Transformer的流策略捕捉复杂协调行为，并利用近似路径得分代理实现同步流策略优化；进一步提出联合优化方案，将softmax Q值估计与联合流策略目标耦合，消除迭代采样。
AI.result: 在MPE和MAMuJoCo的10个标准任务上，OMAF持续取得更优性能，回报最高提升3.4倍，样本效率提升最高达10.5倍。
AI.conclusion: OMAF是一种表达力强且计算高效的一步流策略范式，验证了其在在线MARL中的有效性。

title: Removing spurious minima for planar features by skip connections
comment: 43 pages, 4 figures. Under review. Accompanying Lean 4 formalization available at https://github.com/JayPiZimmermann/Removing-spurious-minima-for-planar-features-by-skip-connections
summary: Understanding loss landscapes is central to explaining neural-network training, yet their structure remains only partially understood even in simple models. We study the Gaussian population loss of shallow, bias-free ReLU networks in the teacher--student setting. This provides a simple model for studying essential aspects such as feature learning and overparameterization. For teacher networks with positive output weights and planar features, we show that including a learned linear skip removes all spurious local minima with non-negative student output weights once the student network is at least as wide as the teacher network. In contrast, without the skip, we construct a fixed teacher network with positive output weights and only three hidden neurons in input dimension two whose spurious local minima persist at every student width at least three. Thus, a learned linear skip can remove spurious minima that persist under arbitrary overparameterization. Furthermore, we show that a positive output weight student network always learns the subspace spanned by the teacher features: student features at local minima with non-negative student output weights lie in the span of the teacher features. For ReLU networks in two dimensions, even heavily overparameterized student networks have effective width controlled by the teacher width: every critical point with positive student output weights has at most twice as many distinct student feature directions as teacher neurons. Finally, we transfer the benignity result to empirical minima over parameter balls of any prescribed radius, with the required sampling accuracy depending on that radius.

AI.tldr: 本文研究无偏置浅层ReLU网络在teacher-student框架下的高斯总体损失景观，证明加入可学习线性skip可消除持续存在的伪局部极小，并揭示了过参数化下有效宽度受teacher宽度控制的规律。
AI.motivation: 理解损失景观是解释神经网络训练的关键，但即便在简单模型中其结构仍未被充分理解。作者希望借助teacher-student设定下的浅层无偏置ReLU网络这一简洁模型，研究特征学习与过参数化等核心问题，并厘清skip连接与过参数化对伪局部极小的影响。
AI.method: 采用高斯总体损失，在teacher-student设定下分析浅层、无偏置ReLU网络。针对输出权重为正、特征为平面的teacher网络，考察学生网络加入可学习线性skip前后的局部极小结构；并通过构造固定teacher网络（输入维度为2、仅3个隐神经元）进行对比分析；同时刻画正输出权重学生在局部极小处特征所在子空间，并研究二维ReLU网络临界点的有效宽度，最后将良性结果推广到任意给定半径参数球上的经验极小。
AI.result: 当学生网络宽度不小于teacher且输出权重非负时，加入可学习线性skip可消除所有伪局部极小；而不加skip时，存在一个输出权重为正、仅3个隐神经元、输入维度为2的固定teacher，其伪局部极小在学生宽度至少为3的任意宽度下都持续存在。此外，正输出权重学生网络总能学到teacher特征张成的子空间，其局部极小处的学生特征落在teacher特征的张成中；二维ReLU网络中，正输出权重学生的每个临界点至多具有teacher神经元两倍的不同学生特征方向，即有效宽度受teacher宽度控制。良性结果可迁移至任意给定半径参数球上的经验极小，所需采样精度依赖于该半径。
AI.conclusion: 可学习线性skip能消除在任意过参数化下仍持续存在的伪局部极小，表明过参数化本身不足以保证良性景观，而skip结构具有关键作用；同时，过参数化学生的有效宽度受teacher宽度约束，特征学习始终发生在teacher特征张成的子空间内，且总体层面的良性性质可在一定采样精度下迁移到经验损失。

title: Selection-Based Structured Reasoning: Toward Efficient Multimodal Search Agents
summary: Multimodal agents commonly generate free-form reasoning before each action. For small models, limited model capacity can result in lengthy reasoning that provides little useful guidance for action generation while incurring substantial inference cost. To address this challenge, we introduce Selection-based Structured Reasoning (SSR), a framework that reformulates reasoning as selection instead of open-ended generation. SSR represents recurring high-level reasoning as pre-specified, reusable natural-language candidates. At each turn, the model selects from these reasoning candidates based on their likelihoods given the current context, without requiring an auxiliary task head. Using pre-specified reasoning traces enables parallel scoring, where teacher-forced prefilling computes token likelihoods concurrently within and across candidates using a shared context KV cache. We evaluate SSR on seven multimodal search benchmarks using 2B and 4B models. Across multiple reinforcement learning objectives and supervised fine-tuning, SSR delivers significant efficiency gains without sacrificing task performance. SSR achieves an average success rate competitive with leading search agents of the same scale, while reducing per-turn reasoning latency by over 90% and total per-question model inference latency by 28-54%. Project page: https://zfy0314.github.io/ssr-webpage/.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Selection-based Structured Reasoning (SSR)框架，将多模态智能体的推理由开放式生成改为从预设的、可复用的自然语言推理候选中进行选择，从而在2B/4B小模型上大幅降低推理延迟且任务表现不降。
AI.motivation: 多模态智能体通常在每次动作前生成自由形式的推理。对于小模型，受限于模型容量，推理往往冗长却对动作生成帮助甚微，同时带来可观的推理开销。因此需要一种更高效、对动作更有指导性的推理方式。
AI.method: SSR将反复出现的高层推理表示为预先指定、可复用的自然语言候选。每一轮中，模型依据当前上下文计算各候选的似然并从中选择，无需额外的辅助任务头。预设的推理轨迹支持并行打分：通过teacher-forced prefilling与共享上下文的KV cache，在候选项内部及候选项之间并发计算token似然。
AI.result: 在七个多模态搜索基准上使用2B和4B模型进行评估，覆盖多种强化学习目标与监督微调。SSR在不损失任务表现的前提下取得显著效率提升：平均成功率与同规模领先搜索智能体相当，单轮推理延迟降低90%以上，每问题模型总推理延迟降低28-54%。
AI.conclusion: 将推理形式化为选择而非开放式生成，可在小模型多模态智能体中同时实现高推理效率与有竞争力的任务性能，为低成本智能体推理提供了可行方案。

title: On Language Drift during RLVR Post-Training
summary: Recent advances in LLM reasoning models---driven primarily by the paradigm of post-training via reinforcement learning with verifiable reward (RLVR)---have enabled them to accomplish impressively complex tasks. However, in parallel with their rising capabilities, LLMs have increasingly displayed signs of language drift in their chains of thought (CoTs): unusual, non-standard, and seemingly nonsensical language use. Although it is well-documented---and can potentially impair CoT monitorability---the causes of language drift are thus far poorly understood. In this paper, we identify the conditions under which language drift occurs: we prove theoretically that RLVR optimization pressure permits unbounded language drift, while supervised fine-tuning does not. We then show empirically that language drift specifically arises during RLVR on novel reasoning tasks---i.e. when the target behavior cannot be drawn out of the base model. Finally, we prove that it is not possible to constrain language drift without constraining expected reward, suggesting that CoT monitorability cannot be improved without harming performance during RLVR post-training at the frontier.

AI.tldr: 论文研究LLM推理模型中思维链（CoT）的"语言漂移"现象，理论证明RLVR优化压力可导致无界语言漂移而监督微调不会，实验证实语言漂移在新颖推理任务的RLVR过程中出现，并证明约束语言漂移必然约束期望奖励，即CoT可监控性与性能在前沿RLVR后训练中不可兼得。
AI.motivation: RLVR后训练使LLM具备强大推理能力，但模型CoT中日益出现语言漂移（非常规、无意义的语言使用）。该现象已有记录且可能损害CoT可监控性，但其成因尚不清楚，本文旨在揭示语言漂移发生的条件与根源。
AI.method: 采用理论证明与实证验证相结合的方法：理论上对比RLVR与监督微调对语言漂移的约束差异，并分析语言漂移与期望奖励之间的权衡关系；实证上考察语言漂移在何种任务条件下（如新颖推理任务）随RLVR出现。
AI.result: 理论证明RLVR的优化压力允许无界语言漂移，而监督微调不会；实证表明语言漂移专门产生于新颖推理任务的RLVR过程中，即当目标行为无法从基座模型中引出时；进一步证明若不约束期望奖励，就无法约束语言漂移。
AI.conclusion: 语言漂移是RLVR后训练的固有产物，且其约束与性能之间存在不可调和的矛盾：在前沿RLVR后训练中，无法在提升CoT可监控性的同时不损害模型性能。

title: Asynchronous LLM Post-Training: Group-Mass Capping and Convergence Analysis
summary: Asynchronous reinforcement learning (RL) improves the efficiency of large language model post-training but introduces stale rollouts generated by earlier policies. Theoretical understanding of how this staleness affects convergence and how to mitigate its impact remains limited. We derive a convergence bound for GRPO-style algorithms that explicitly characterizes the tradeoff between the gradient estimator's second moment and bias. For trajectory-level importance-weighted estimators, our analysis shows that once the second moment is uniformly controlled, delay enters the bound through the bias introduced by clipping or rescaling. Guided by this insight, we propose a novel group mass capping GRPO (GMC-GRPO) method, which minimizes a ratio-based bias bound within a class of weighted estimators sharing a common second-moment guarantee. We establish convergence guarantees for asynchronous GMC-GRPO and show that, compared with TIC-GRPO, it improves the threshold dependence of the fourth-order delay term from $O(ε^{-4})$ to $O(ε^{-2})$ as $ε\to0$, where $1+ε$ is the ratio threshold. Under local policy overlap, the delay-dependent term decreases as $G^{-2/5}$ after tuning the step size, where $G$ is the group size. For fixed behavior and current policies, the bias introduced by group rescaling also vanishes as $G\to\infty$, whereas the bias from trajectory-wise clipping can persist. Experiments across Qwen3 models and reasoning benchmarks demonstrate improved robustness to stale rollouts, with GMC-GRPO achieving the best performance among stable baselines under large rollout delays.

AI.tldr: 本文针对异步强化学习中陈旧rollout导致的收敛与偏差问题，提出了收敛界分析并设计了GMC-GRPO方法，改进了延迟依赖项的阶数并提升了大延迟下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 异步RL提升了大语言模型后训练效率，但引入了早期策略产生的陈旧rollout（stale rollouts）。关于陈旧性如何影响收敛以及如何缓解其影响的理论理解仍然有限。
AI.method: 推导了GRPO类算法的收敛界，刻画梯度估计器二阶矩与偏差之间的权衡；针对轨迹级重要性加权估计器，证明一旦二阶矩被一致控制，延迟通过裁剪或重缩放引入的偏差进入界。据此提出group mass capping GRPO（GMC-GRPO），在共享二阶矩保证的加权估计器类中最小化基于比值的偏差界，并建立异步GMC-GRPO的收敛保证。
AI.result: 理论上，相比TIC-GRPO，GMC-GRPO将四阶延迟项的阈值依赖从$O(ε^{-4})$改善为$O(ε^{-2})$（$ε\to0$，$1+ε$为比值阈值）；在局部策略重叠下，调优步长后延迟相关项按$G^{-2/5}$下降（$G$为组大小）。固定行为策略与当前策略时，组重缩放引入的偏差随$G\to\infty$消失，而轨迹级裁剪的偏差可能持续存在。实验在Qwen3模型与推理基准上验证了对陈旧rollout的鲁棒性提升，GMC-GRPO在大rollout延迟下优于稳定基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过收敛界分析揭示陈旧性经偏差影响收敛，GMC-GRPO在理论与实验上均改善了异步RL对陈旧rollout的鲁棒性。

title: SoftServe: A Scalable Quasi-Newton Method for Deep Learning
summary: Quasi-Newton (QN) methods have long been among the most effective methods for large-scale unconstrained convex optimization. Two obstacles have limited their use in deep learning: non-convexity and enormous parameter sizes. We introduce SoftServe, a family of QN methods designed to overcome these obstacles without line searches or ad hoc curvature corrections. SoftServe derives positivedefinite curvature estimates from the variational objective of Berglund et al. (2025), even in the presence of negative curvature. We develop diagonal and Kroneckerfactored variants that preserve positive definiteness by construction and scale to massive neural networks. Finally, SoftServe relies on the stable coupled Newton-Schulz iteration for the required matrix operations, replacing costly matrix decompositions with GPU-friendly matrix multiplications. SoftServe excels on problems that are severely ill-conditioned, including tasks such as recurrent networks, deep autoencoders, physics-informed neural networks, and a 136M-parameter physics-informed diffusion model, often achieving lower losses than established baselines including Adam, Muon, and SOAP.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SoftServe，一类无需线搜索或特设曲率修正的拟牛顿方法，可从变分目标导出正定曲率估计，具备对角与Kronecker分解变体，并借助Newton-Schulz迭代实现GPU友好计算，在病态问题与大规模网络（如136M参数扩散模型）上优于Adam、Muon、SOAP等基线。
AI.motivation: 拟牛顿方法在大规模无约束凸优化中长期高效，但用于深度学习受限：一是目标非凸，二是参数量巨大。现有方法常依赖线搜索或特设曲率修正，难以直接扩展。
AI.method: SoftServe从Berglund等人（2025）的变分目标中导出正定曲率估计，即使存在负曲率也能保持正定；提出对角与Kronecker分解变体，通过构造保证正定性并扩展到超大规模网络；采用稳定的耦合Newton-Schulz迭代完成所需矩阵运算，以GPU友好的矩阵乘法替代昂贵的矩阵分解。
AI.result: SoftServe在严重病态问题上表现突出，包括循环网络、深度自编码器、物理信息神经网络以及136M参数的物理信息扩散模型；在这些任务中常取得比Adam、Muon、SOAP等既有基线更低的损失。
AI.conclusion: SoftServe证明无需线搜索与特设曲率修正即可将拟牛顿方法有效用于非凸、超大规模深度学习优化，并在病态与大规模场景中展现出优于主流基线的性能。

title: Local Support Learning
summary: We explore catastrophic forgetting in the context of large pre-trained models. By considering forgetting as a geometric problem in the input space of each weight matrix, we uncover a natural retention objective under which updates produced by gradient-based optimizers are suboptimal. Following this observation, we propose Local Support Learning (LSL), a general-purpose framework that augments gradient-based training for retention of prior capabilities without access to prior data. During a new learning phase, LSL pairs two components with distinct roles: a standard weight adapter, trained as usual to minimize the loss, and a gating function that enables the adapter only on input activations from its own training distribution, making the update local to that distribution. The key challenge is that this gate must route data from all learning phases while training only on data from the current one. We address this with a gate based on a Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM), whose likelihood decays rapidly away from its training data, giving it a natural tendency to stay closed on data from prior phases. We show that this post-training approach can resolve forgetting in LLMs of up to 7 billion parameters, retaining both pretrained and finetuned capabilities across multiple training phases, while being efficient in memory and compute, robust to hyperparameter choice, and showing scaling potential.

AI.tldr: 该论文将大模型中的灾难性遗忘视为权重矩阵输入空间中的几何问题，提出Local Support Learning（LSL）框架，通过权重适配器与基于高斯混合模型的门控函数配对，在无历史数据条件下实现多阶段能力保持。
AI.motivation: 大规模预训练模型在连续学习新任务时会出现灾难性遗忘，即新学习阶段会损害已有能力。作者希望在无法访问先前数据的约束下，找到一种通用方法来保留预训练及已微调的能力。核心动机源于一个观察：若将遗忘视为每个权重矩阵输入空间中的几何问题，则梯度优化器产生的更新在该保留目标下是次优的。
AI.method: 提出Local Support Learning（LSL），一个通用框架，用于增强基于梯度的训练以保留先前能力且无需访问旧数据。LSL由两个角色不同的组件构成：（1）标准权重适配器，按常规方式训练以最小化损失；（2）门控函数，仅在来自其自身训练分布的输入激活上启用适配器，使更新局部化于该分布。关键挑战在于门控需路由所有学习阶段的数据，却仅在当前阶段数据上训练。为此采用基于高斯混合模型（GMM）的门控，其似然值远离训练数据时迅速衰减，从而在先前阶段数据上自然趋于关闭。
AI.result: 该训练后方法可在多达70亿参数的LLM中解决遗忘问题，在多个训练阶段中同时保留预训练和微调能力，并在内存和计算上高效，对超参数选择稳健，且展现出扩展潜力。
AI.conclusion: LSL通过将遗忘建模为输入空间的几何问题，并利用GMM门控实现分布局部化的适配器更新，为无旧数据条件下的灾难性遗忘提供了一种通用、高效且可扩展的解决方案，在7B规模LLM上验证了多阶段能力保留的有效性。

title: Distributionally Robust Schrödinger Bridge
summary: Schrödinger bridge (SB) learns stochastic transport between prescribed initial and target distributions. When the initial distribution shifts at test time, the learned dynamics can fail to recover the target distribution. We introduce the Distributionally Robust Schrödinger Bridge (DRSB), which learns a single controller that accounts for uncertainty in the initial distribution. The DRSB objective consists of control energy and a KL penalty between the resulting terminal distribution and the target distribution. DRSB seeks a single controller that minimizes the worst-case value of this objective as the initial distribution varies within an ambiguity set around the nominal distribution. We derive an exact variational formulation of this objective and connect its fixed-terminal-cost subproblem to stochastic optimal control and distributionally robust optimization. This formulation motivates an alternating algorithm that updates the adversarial initial distribution, estimates the terminal log-density ratio, and trains the controller. We develop Wasserstein and Sinkhorn variants using stochastic control optimality conditions to approximate the gradients required for adversarial updates. Experiments on two-dimensional transport tasks and image-to-image translation show improved robustness to input perturbations relative to standard SB, with a tradeoff in nominal performance. On Gaussian mixture transport, Sinkhorn DRSB also achieves lower mean sliced Wasserstein distance than fixed-level noise augmentation at both tested unseen noise levels.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出分布鲁棒薛定谔桥（DRSB），学习单一控制器以应对初始分布不确定性，并给出变分构建、交替算法及Wasserstein/Sinkhorn变体，在二维传输与图像翻译任务上提升鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 标准薛定谔桥（SB）学习给定初始与目标分布间的随机传输，但测试时初始分布发生偏移时，所学动力学可能无法恢复目标分布，即缺乏对初始分布不确定性的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出DRSB，目标由控制能量与终端分布和目标分布间的KL惩罚构成；在标称分布周围的不确定集内，寻求使最坏情况目标值最小的单一控制器。推导该目标的精确变分形式，并将固定终端成本子问题联系到随机最优控制与分布鲁棒优化；据此设计交替算法，依次更新对抗初始分布、估计终端对数密度比、训练控制器。基于随机控制最优性条件开发Wasserstein与Sinkhorn变体以近似对抗更新所需梯度。
AI.result: 在二维传输任务和图像到图像翻译上，相对标准SB对输入扰动表现出更好的鲁棒性，但标称性能有所折衷；在高斯混合传输上，Sinkhorn DRSB在两个测试的未见噪声水平下均取得低于固定水平噪声增强的平均切片Wasserstein距离。
AI.conclusion: DRSB通过分布鲁棒优化为薛定谔桥提供对初始分布偏移的鲁棒控制框架，兼顾鲁棒性与标称性能的权衡，并在实验中验证其有效性。

title: How Far is Adam from Natural Gradient Descent?
summary: Adam is the standard optimizer in deep learning, yet its geometric relationship to natural gradient descent (NGD) contains unresolved questions. We study Adam's full update rule, including momentum, as a diagonal empirical Fisher approximation subject to diagonal truncation, empirical label substitution, and temporal lag. Using the scale-invariant $γ(Δθ)$ metric, we measure Adam's geometric deviation from true NGD across four loss landscapes: well-conditioned linear regression, ill-conditioned linear regression, logistic regression, and a non-convex small neural network. Adam's geometric trajectory is context-dependent. Deviation remains low in well-conditioned settings but rises significantly under ill-conditioning, reaching misalignments of $\approx 10^3$ in the neural network. Higher geometric drift correlates with slower initial optimization but does not degrade final objective minimization; Adam consistently reaches low loss. Furthermore, the improved empirical Fisher (iEF) tracks more stable paths than the standard empirical Fisher (EF), which frequently oscillates or diverges. Our results suggest Adam's practical optimization power may stem from a balance of structural approximation errors and momentum smoothing rather than close tracking of the natural gradient path.

AI.tldr: 本文将Adam的完整更新规则（含动量）解释为对角经验Fisher近似，受对角截断、经验标签替换和时间滞后三重约束，并用尺度不变的γ(Δθ)度量在四类损失曲面上量化Adam与真实自然梯度下降的几何偏差。
AI.motivation: Adam是深度学习的标准优化器，但其与自然梯度下降的几何关系尚存未解问题。作者希望明确Adam在何种程度上、在何种条件下偏离真实NGD路径，并厘清这种偏离对实际优化性能的影响。
AI.method: 将Adam的完整更新（包括动量项）建模为对角经验Fisher近似，识别出三种结构性来源：对角截断、经验标签替换、时间滞后。采用尺度不变的γ(Δθ)度量，在四类损失曲面上测量Adam与真实NGD的几何偏差：良态线性回归、病态线性回归、逻辑回归，以及一个非凸小型神经网络；并对比改进经验Fisher（iEF）与标准经验Fisher（EF）的轨迹稳定性。
AI.result: Adam的几何轨迹依赖具体情境：良态设置下偏差较低，但在病态条件下显著上升，在神经网络中错位程度可达约10^3。较高的几何漂移与初期优化变慢相关，但并未损害最终目标最小化——Adam始终能达到低损失。此外，iEF比标准EF路径更稳定，后者常出现振荡或发散。
AI.conclusion: Adam的实际优化能力可能源自结构性近似误差与动量平滑之间的平衡，而非对自然梯度路径的紧密追踪。

title: Reverse Item Response Theory for Sparsity-Robust Ranking in Fragmented Cancer Drug-Response Matrices
summary: We introduce reverse Item Response Theory (IRT) to pharmacogenomic drug-response analysis by treating cancer types as latent "subjects" with resistance ability and drugs as "items" with evasion difficulty. Applied to 242,036 drug sensitivity measurements from the Genomics of Drug Sensitivity in Cancer (GDSC2) database, the model estimates cancer-type-level in-vitro resistance and drug-level broad activity on a shared latent scale. Validation across four missingness regimes demonstrates that reverse IRT better recovers the full-data latent ranking than simple averaging, with advantages of Delta-rho = +0.089 to +0.095 at 60% missingness under MCAR, cancer-biased, and drug-biased sparsity. Held-out prediction confirms IRT achieves the best Brier score among five evaluated methods. Bootstrap confidence intervals show 19 of 28 cancer types have stable resistant/sensitive classifications. Cross-platform PRISM replication shows 82% directional agreement but weak rank-order correlation (rho = 0.25), indicating the contribution is methodological robustness under fragmented evaluation, not a universal clinical resistance leaderboard.

AI.tldr: 本文将反向项目反应理论（reverse IRT）引入药物基因组学药物反应分析，把癌症类型视为具有"耐药能力"的潜在被试、药物视为具有"逃避难度"的题目，在GDSC2的242,036条药物敏感性数据上估计癌症类型层面的体外耐药性与药物层面的广谱活性，并验证其在稀疏数据下的稳健性。
AI.motivation: 药物敏感性数据在癌症类型与药物维度上高度碎片化，简单平均法在缺失率较高时难以稳健地恢复潜在的耐药/活性排序，需要一个能在共享潜在尺度上同时估计癌症类型耐药性与药物活性的方法框架。
AI.method: 提出反向IRT，将癌症类型当作潜在"被试"（耐药能力为特质）、药物当作"题目"（逃避难度为参数），在GDSC2的242,036条药物敏感性测量上拟合模型，得到共享潜在尺度上的癌症类型体外耐药性与药物广谱活性估计；并在四种缺失机制下与简单平均比较，进行留出预测与Bootstrap置信区间分析，另用PRISM数据做跨平台复制。
AI.result: 在MCAR、癌症偏置与药物偏置稀疏下，60%缺失时相对简单平均的优势为 Delta-rho = +0.089 至 +0.095；留出预测中IRT在五种方法中取得最优Brier分数；Bootstrap置信区间显示28种癌症类型中有19种具有稳定的耐药/敏感分类；PRISM跨平台复制显示82%的方向一致性，但排序相关性较弱（rho = 0.25）。
AI.conclusion: 该研究的贡献在于碎片化评估条件下的方法论稳健性，而非提供一个普适的临床耐药排行榜；反向IRT可作为药物基因组学药物反应分析中处理缺失与稀疏的可靠建模工具。

title: Higher-Order Molecular Grammars for Generative and Foundation Models in Chemistry
summary: Molecular learning models are strongly shaped by their underlying representations. Yet standard sequential and graph formalisms struggle to explicitly encode higher-order topology, such as ring systems and recurring motifs. Existing higher-order representations can capture these structures directly, but they are often computationally demanding and difficult to decode into valid molecules. Here, we introduce Higher-order Grammar Representation (HGR), a principled, topology-aware framework that lifts molecules to combinatorial complexes and parses each complex into a compact sequence of production rules under a context-free higher-order grammar. By serialising higher-order topology into rule sequences, HGR makes these structures directly compatible with standard sequence models, avoiding the computational overhead of explicit higher-order encodings while preserving topological expressiveness. To reduce benchmark bias towards simple ring systems, we construct RingDiv, a ring-enriched benchmark containing 1.18 million molecules, including the curated RingDiv300k subset, and introduce the ring diversity index (RDI) to quantify ring-system coverage. In molecular generation, HGR-based models uniquely combine 100% validity by construction with leading distributional alignment, ranking first in FCD on all five generation benchmarks. In representation learning, HGR-FM achieves the highest mean AUC across seven MoleculeNet benchmarks under both transfer protocols, improving on the strongest baseline by 8.3 and 3.3 AUC points under probing and full fine-tuning, respectively. Collectively, these results establish HGR as an efficient higher-order representation for molecular generation and transferable representation learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出高阶文法表示（HGR），将分子提升为组合复形并用上下文无关高阶文法解析为产生式规则序列，从而在保持高阶拓扑表达能力的同时兼容标准序列模型；另构建RingDiv基准与环多样性指数（RDI），在生成与表示学习任务上均取得领先结果。
AI.motivation: 标准序列与图表示难以显式编码环系统、重复基序等高阶拓扑结构；已有高阶表示虽能直接刻画这些结构，但计算开销大、且难以解码为有效分子。
AI.method: 提出HGR框架：将分子提升为组合复形（combinatorial complexes），在上下文无关高阶文法下将每个复形解析为紧凑的产生式规则序列，把高阶拓扑序列化以适配标准序列模型，避免显式高阶编码的算力开销。同时构建含118万分子的环富集基准RingDiv（含精编子集RingDiv300k）并提出环多样性指数RDI以量化环系统覆盖度。
AI.result: 分子生成中，基于HGR的模型天然保证100%有效性并同时具备领先的分布对齐能力，在全部五个生成基准的FCD上排名第一；表示学习中，HGR-FM在七项MoleculeNet基准、两种迁移协议下均取得最高平均AUC，相较最强基线在探测（probing）与全量微调下分别提升8.3和3.3个AUC点。
AI.conclusion: HGR是一种高效的高阶分子表示，可同时服务于分子生成与可迁移表示学习。

title: Fast Polynomial Transcendentals for LLMs
summary: Graphics processing unit (GPU) generations scale matrix, special-function, and memory pipelines at different rates, so kernel bottlenecks move as hardware evolves. FlashAttention-4 exposed this imbalance inside attention on NVIDIA Blackwell. We test whether short polynomial programs can accelerate other special-function-unit (SFU) operations in large language models (LLMs). We first compare native PyTorch evaluation with packed fused multiply--add (FMA) programs in an isolated IEEE binary16 (FP16) sweep spanning L2-resident and high-bandwidth-memory (HBM)-resident working sets. We then replace native sigmoid, tanh, and sigmoid linear unit (SiLU) with degree-3 or degree-4 bfloat16 (BF16) programs in four GB200 integration tasks: dense SiLU, tanh-softcapped attention, sigmoid attention, and routed-expert Swish-gated linear unit (SwiGLU). The programs combine analytical symmetry, target-format rounding, and packed arithmetic inside consuming kernels. The isolated paths improve by 1.19--2.19x in L2 and 1.00--1.70x in HBM. The dense-SiLU, tanh-softcapped-attention, and routed-expert substitutions improve complete training-step throughput by 2.7\%, 2.9\%, and 8.0\%, respectively. The sigmoid-attention substitution improves complete-attention forward by 7.4\% and the complete GPU step by 0.3\%. Same-checkpoint open-weight ablations and one paired pre-training comparison per task extend the evaluation to model behavior. At common horizons near 100 billion tokens, the final smoothed training-loss differences (polynomial minus native) range from $-0.107$ to $+0.079$ across the four tasks.

AI.tldr: 该论文探究用短多项式程序替代GPU上SFU激活函数，在GB200上获得1.19–2.19x(L2)、1.00–1.70x(HBM)的单元加速，并在四类集成任务中提升训练/推理吞吐（最高8.0%），训练损失偏差在±0.107内。
AI.motivation: GPU各代对矩阵、特殊功能单元(SFU)和内存管线的扩展速率不一致，导致kernel瓶颈随硬件演进而迁移（FlashAttention-4在Blackwell上已暴露此失衡）。作者据此假设：短多项式程序可加速LLM中其他SFU运算，并检验其可行性与模型影响。
AI.method: 1) 在隔离的FP16扫描中，对比原生PyTorch求值与打包FMA程序，覆盖L2驻留与HBM驻留工作集；2) 用3/4次BF16多项式替换原生sigmoid、tanh、SiLU，并集成到四个GB200任务：dense SiLU、tanh-softcapped attention、sigmoid attention、routed-expert SwiGLU；3) 程序结合解析对称性、目标格式舍入与消费kernel内的打包算术；4) 通过同检查点开放权重消融和每任务一次配对预训练比较评估模型行为。
AI.result: 隔离路径在L2提升1.19–2.19x、HBM提升1.00–1.70x。dense-SiLU、tanh-softcapped-attention、routed-expert替换分别提升完整训练步吞吐2.7%、2.9%、8.0%；sigmoid-attention替换提升完整attention前向7.4%、完整GPU步0.3%。约1000亿token的常见训练视界下，四个任务最终平滑训练损失差异（多项式减原生）为-0.107至+0.079。
AI.conclusion: 短多项式SFU替换可在真实LLM集成中带来可观吞吐收益，且训练损失偏差小，表明该策略在硬件演进导致SFU瓶颈时具有实用价值。

title: Format-Aware Fusion for Fast FP4 Pretraining
summary:
Four-bit floating-point (FP4) Tensor Cores accelerate matrix multiplication, but scale computation, operand packing, layout construction, and saved backward state can erase the gain. We present \emph{format-aware fusion}, which co-designs each quantization producer with its scale domain and consumer layout for native \mxfp{}, global 
vfp{}, and cooperative-thread-array-local 
vfp{}. We evaluate Llama-3-family 8B pretraining through 160 billion tokens using bfloat16 output projections and compiled cross entropy. In matched same-accelerator probes, bfloat16 and Transformer Engine 
vfp{} reach 18.8K and 27.6K tokens/s/GPU, while our fastest custom route reaches 37.9K. \mxfp{} with row-gradient stochastic rounding and fixed-sign 32-value Hadamard weight-gradient preconditioning reaches 37.2K tokens/s/GPU (86.3\% bfloat16 model FLOP utilization) and ends 2.11\% above the raw bfloat16 training-loss endpoint. A Transformer Engine recipe with four final bfloat16 blocks ends 0.87\% above bfloat16 at 27.1K tokens/s/GPU. Downstream rankings differ from training-loss rankings, showing that FP4 outcomes depend jointly on scale contract, operand, and execution path.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"格式感知融合"（format-aware fusion）方法，将量化生成器与其尺度域和消费者布局协同设计，以解决FP4张量核在矩阵乘法加速时被尺度计算、操作数打包、布局构建和反向状态保存所抵消的问题。在Llama-3系列8B预训练中，最快定制路径达到37.9K tokens/s/GPU，MXFP4路径达37.2K（86.3% bfloat16 FLOP利用率），训练损失终点仅高出bfloat16基线2.11%。
AI.motivation: FP4张量核虽可加速矩阵乘法，但尺度计算、操作数打包、布局构建以及反向传播状态的保存等开销会抵消其加速收益。此外，FP4的训练结果依赖于尺度契约、操作数与执行路径的联合作用，需要协同设计才能获得实际收益。
AI.method: 提出格式感知融合（format-aware fusion），将每个量化生成器与其尺度域和消费者布局进行协同设计，覆盖原生MXFP4、全局NVFP4以及协作线程阵列局部NVFP4三种格式。在Llama-3系列8B模型上训练1600亿tokens，使用bfloat16输出投影和编译版交叉熵损失。采用行梯度随机舍入（row-gradient stochastic rounding）的MXFP4，以及固定符号32值Hadamard权重梯度预条件（fixed-sign 32-value Hadamard weight-gradient preconditioning）。
AI.result: 在匹配的同加速器探针中，bfloat16达到18.8K tokens/s/GPU，Transformer Engine NVFP4达到27.6K，最快的定制路径达到37.9K。采用行梯度随机舍入和固定符号32值Hadamard预条件的MXFP4达到37.2K tokens/s/GPU（86.3% bfloat16模型FLOP利用率），训练损失终点仅比原始bfloat16高出2.11%。使用四个最终bfloat16块的Transformer Engine方案达到27.1K tokens/s/GPU，损失终点高出bfloat16 0.87%。下游任务排名与训练损失排名不一致。
AI.conclusion: FP4的实际效果取决于尺度契约、操作数和执行路径的联合作用，不能仅以训练损失或单一指标评判。格式感知融合可实现显著的吞吐提升并保持可接受的精度损失，但下游任务排名与训练损失排名存在差异，说明需综合评估FP4训练方案。

title: One Mastery Threshold Does Not Fit All Knowledge Tracing Models
summary: Tutoring systems use mastery thresholds to decide when students can stop practicing and advance, but the same numerical threshold can lead to very different decisions when the underlying knowledge tracing (KT) model changes. We examine six KT models across four public educational datasets and evaluate 12 thresholds from 0.50 to 0.99 using post-advancement performance, advancement coverage, practice burden, and disparities across prior-performance groups. We also identify thresholds that balance performance, extra practice, and advancement under 30 predefined instructional settings. Bayesian Knowledge Tracing (BKT) is relatively insensitive to threshold changes, while neural models become much more selective as thresholds increase. This partly reflects different model outputs: BKT estimates latent mastery probability, whereas neural models estimate the probability of a correct next response, so the same cutoff does not represent the same level of mastery. The best-balanced threshold varied substantially across models and settings. In half of the tested settings, neural models and BKT differed by more than 0.10 in their selected thresholds, although this gap became smaller when greater priority was placed on reducing extra practice and allowing more students to advance. Stricter thresholds also did not reliably reduce performance gaps and could disproportionately restrict advancement, with stronger-prior students advancing up to 3.26 times as often as weaker-prior students. These results show that mastery thresholds should be recalibrated when the KT model or instructional priorities change and evaluated by their effects on performance, practice, advancement, and access.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统考察六个知识追踪（KT）模型在四个公开数据集上、12个0.50–0.99掌握阈值下的表现差异，发现同一阈值在不同KT模型（尤其BKT与神经模型）间并不等价，掌握阈值需随模型与教学优先级重新校准，并从表现、练习负担、进阶覆盖率与群体差异多维度评估。
AI.motivation: 智能辅导系统用统一的数值掌握阈值决定学生是否停止练习并进阶，但该阈值的实际含义依赖于底层知识追踪模型。若不同模型对同一数值阈值的解读不同，则会导致不一致甚至不公平的进阶决策，因此有必要系统检验阈值与KT模型的交互效应。
AI.method: 选取六个KT模型、四个公开教育数据集，测试0.50至0.99之间的12个阈值，评估指标包括进阶后表现、进阶覆盖率、练习负担以及不同先前表现组之间的差异；同时在30种预设教学情境下，识别能在表现、额外练习与进阶之间取得平衡的阈值。
AI.result: 贝叶斯知识追踪（BKT）对阈值变化相对不敏感，而神经模型随阈值升高变得显著更为选择性，部分原因在于模型输出含义不同：BKT估计潜在掌握概率，神经模型估计下一次作答正确的概率，故相同截断值不代表相同掌握水平。最优平衡阈值在模型与情境间差异较大；半数测试情境中神经模型与BKT所选阈值相差超过0.10，但当更强调减少额外练习并允许更多学生进阶时，差距缩小。更严格的阈值并未可靠地缩小表现差距，反而可能不成比例地限制进阶，先前表现较强的学生进阶频率最高可达较弱学生的3.26倍。
AI.conclusion: 掌握阈值并非可跨模型通用的固定参数；当KT模型或教学优先级改变时，应重新校准阈值，并依据其对学习表现、练习负担、进阶机会与公平性的综合影响进行评估。

title: Uncertainty-Aware Learning from Multi-Expert Interval Targets
summary: Many machine learning (ML) applications rely on expert labels, and qualified experts may provide different but plausible interpretations of the same observation. Such variation across expert labels may reflect genuine disagreement or ambiguity rather than annotation error. When individual experts additionally report intervals rather than exact values, the supervision contains two distinct sources of label uncertainty: within-label imprecision and between-expert variation. Existing methods treat these forms separately: multi-expert approaches collapse labels to a consensus, interval-target methods often yield a single prediction, and predictive-uncertainty methods rarely validate their uncertainty estimates against observed expert disagreement. To address this problem, we propose an approach that preserves individual expert intervals, separates within-label imprecision from between-expert variation, and validates the corresponding predictive uncertainty components. First, heterogeneous label vocabularies are harmonized into a common probabilistic label space, separating encoding differences from expert judgement. Second, individual label intervals are retained and modeled with a mixture of Beta distributions trained using a proper Cramér-distance objective, preserving distinct expert-reported labels. Third, we decompose predictive uncertainty into within-component, between-component, and model uncertainty, and evaluate whether these components correspond to within-label uncertainty, between-label uncertainty, and model error, respectively. Because this correspondence is not guaranteed, we introduce decomposition matching, which aligns the predictive components to their intended label-side sources. On sea-ice concentration the model reduces MAE by 31\% over hard labels and outperforms aggregation, interval-distribution, and interval-regression baselines.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对多专家区间标注中同时存在的"标签内不精确性"与"专家间差异性"两类标签不确定性，提出一个保留个体专家区间、分解并校验预测不确定性的方法，在海冰浓度任务上将MAE较硬标签降低31%。
AI.motivation: 许多机器学习应用依赖专家标注，而合格专家对同一观测可能给出不同但合理的解释，这种差异反映的是真实分歧或歧义而非标注错误。当专家进一步报告区间而非精确值时，监督信号同时包含两类标签不确定性：标签内不精确性（within-label imprecision）与专家间差异（between-expert variation）。现有方法将二者分离处理：多专家方法把标签坍缩为共识，区间目标方法通常只输出单点预测，而预测不确定性方法很少用观测到的专家分歧来验证其不确定性估计。
AI.method: 1）将异质标签词表统一到公共概率标签空间，以分离编码差异与专家判断差异；2）保留个体标签区间，用Beta混合分布建模，并以恰当的Cramér距离目标函数训练，从而保留各专家报告的独立标签；3）将预测不确定性分解为within-component、between-component与model uncertainty三部分，并检验其是否分别对应标签内不确定性、标签间不确定性与模型误差；4）由于该对应关系并非必然成立，提出decomposition matching，将预测分量对齐到其预期的标签侧来源。
AI.result: 在海冰浓度（sea-ice concentration）任务上，该模型相比硬标签将MAE降低31%，并优于聚合方法、区间分布方法与区间回归等基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过统一标签空间、以Beta混合建模个体区间、并显式分解与匹配预测不确定性分量，该方法能够有效区分并利用标签内不精确性与专家间差异两类不确定性，在海冰浓度任务上取得显著精度提升，为多专家区间标注下的不确定性建模提供了可行框架。

title: "very likely" Means "uncertain"? How LLMs Diverge from Humans in Linguistic Uncertainty Quantification
summary: Humans express uncertainty verbally via markers (e.g., "possible," "likely"), yet most LLM uncertainty quantification (UQ) relies on costing likelihood- or consistency-based signals. From a cognitive perspective, accurate verbal uncertainty reflects metacognitive monitoring, representing knowledge boundaries ("knowing that you don't know") to support regulation and information seeking. In this paper, we investigate how LLMs diverge from humans in verbal uncertainty quantification and whether verbal markers can reliably quantify LLM uncertainty. We curate a corpus of human uncertainty markers from psychology and decision-science literature and benchmark LLMs against it. We observe that LLMs encode verbal uncertainty with numerical levels that differ substantially from those of humans. We then introduce METHODNAME, a novel optimization-based algorithm that learns an optimal uncertainty profile over uncertainty markers directly from LLM outputs. By fitting a marker-uncertainty mapping to best explain empirical correctness, METHODNAME discovers how much probability mass each verbal marker should convey, rather than estimating uncertainty via repeated sampling. METHODNAME enables a direct, marker-level comparison of confidence semantics between humans and LLMs, disentangling mismatch and revealing systematic confidence disparities in verbal expressions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究LLM与人类在言语不确定性表达上的差异，并提出METHODNAME，一种基于优化的算法，从LLM输出中直接学习不确定性标记的最优概率映射，实现标记层面的人机置信语义比较。
AI.motivation: 人类通过"可能""很可能"等言语标记表达不确定性，这反映元认知监控（"知道自己不知道"），而现有LLM不确定性量化多依赖似然或一致性信号，与认知视角脱节。论文旨在探究LLM在言语不确定性量化上如何偏离人类，以及言语标记能否可靠量化LLM不确定性。
AI.method: 从心理学与决策科学文献中整理人类不确定性标记语料，并以此为基准评测LLM。提出METHODNAME：一种基于优化的算法，直接从LLM输出中学习不确定性标记上的最优不确定性画像；通过拟合标记-不确定性映射以最优解释经验正确性，确定每个言语标记应承载的概率质量，而非通过重复采样估计不确定性。
AI.result: LLM以与人类存在显著差异的数值水平编码言语不确定性。METHODNAME可在标记层面直接比较人类与LLM的置信语义，解耦不匹配之处，揭示言语表达中的系统性置信差异。
AI.conclusion: 言语标记可作为量化LLM不确定性的有效切入点，METHODNAME为跨人类与LLM的置信语义对齐与差异分析提供了直接、可解释的方法，有助于弥合人机不确定性表达的鸿沟。

title: Classification Based on Association Rules Algorithm for Breast Cancer
comment: 6 pages, 1 figure, 1 table, accepted & presented at Advances in Science and Engineering Technology International Conferences (ASET) 2024
summary: Breast cancer is a significant contributor to female mortality across the world, displaying one of the highest oc currence rates among the various cancer types. In response to the need for early breast cancer detection, researchers have increasingly turned to association rule-based classification as a favored method. Association Rule mining is a data mining approach which offers the benefit of yielding results that are readily understandable for medical professionals. This paper introduces a novel association rule-based data mining technique for breast cancer classification based on a weighted classification approach. This implementation employs three core algorithms: Rule Generation, Rule Pruning, and Rule Prediction. Rule Generation identifies frequent itemsets and creates association rules. Rule Pruning eliminates rules using specific criteria and separates them into major and minor groups based on their influence on training data. Rule Prediction applies the pruned rules to classify test data. The final prediction algorithm was tested on several testing samples to show the feasibility and performance of the approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于加权分类的关联规则挖掘方法用于乳腺癌分类，包含规则生成、规则剪枝和规则预测三个核心算法，并在多个测试样本上验证了可行性与性能。
AI.motivation: 乳腺癌是全球女性死亡率的重要来源，发病率在各类癌症中位居前列，早期检测需求迫切。基于关联规则的分类因其结果易于被医疗专业人员理解，成为研究者日益青睐的方法。
AI.method: 采用基于加权分类的关联规则数据挖掘技术，实现三个核心算法：规则生成（识别频繁项集并生成关联规则）、规则剪枝（按特定标准剔除规则，并依据其对训练数据的影响分为主要和次要组）、规则预测（应用剪枝后的规则对测试数据进行分类）。
AI.result: 在多个测试样本上测试了最终预测算法，展示了该方法的可行性与性能。
AI.conclusion: 基于加权分类的关联规则方法能够有效支持乳腺癌分类，其规则形式便于医疗专业人员理解，具备实际可行性。

title: Generalized Biomedicine Discovery
summary: In real-world clinical practice, medical images face open-world shifts: (i) long-tailed rare diseases, (ii) subtle lesions dominated by normal anatomy, and (iii) hierarchical taxonomies. Yet most open-world paradigms assume flat, balanced label spaces, leaving these biomedical demands unresolved. We introduce Generalized Biomedicine Discovery (GBD) and a unified benchmark spanning long-tail, anomaly, and taxonomy-aware discovery. Our key insight is that dominant known patterns form a visual manifold that masks subtle novelty. Inspired by expert diagnosis, we propose SCAN (Surprise-evoked Complementary AccommodatioN), which follows a cognition-inspired perceptual progression: it applies predictive suppression to filter expected norms, triggers surprise-evoked salience to highlight unexpected deviations, and performs complementary accommodation to integrate these shifts into global representations. Extensive experiments show that SCAN improves novel concept discovery while generally preserving established clinical knowledge, and it plugs into existing architectures to better navigate the known-unknown trade-off in medical imaging. Code is available at https://github.com/lytang63/generalized-biomedicine-discovery.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出广义生物医学发现（GBD）任务及统一基准，涵盖长尾、异常和层级分类发现，并提出SCAN方法，通过预测抑制、惊讶诱发显著性和互补适应，提升新概念发现能力并保持已有临床知识。
AI.motivation: 真实临床医学图像存在开放世界分布偏移，包括长尾罕见病、正常解剖主导的细微病灶以及层级分类体系，而多数开放世界范式假设标签空间平坦且类别均衡，无法满足这些生物医学需求。
AI.method: 受专家诊断启发，提出SCAN（Surprise-evoked Complementary AccommodatioN）。其核心洞察是主导的已知模式形成视觉流形，掩盖了细微的新颖性。方法遵循认知启发的感知进程：先用预测抑制过滤预期常态，再通过惊讶诱发显著性突出意外偏差，最后进行互补适应，将这些偏移整合到全局表示中。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，SCAN在提升新概念发现的同时，总体上能够保留既有的临床知识，并且可以嵌入现有架构，以更好地处理医学图像中已知与未知之间的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将开放世界问题拓展为GBD并建立统一基准，SCAN作为可插拔方法有效缓解视觉流形对新颖性的掩盖，在医学影像的已知-未知权衡中取得更好表现。

title: Energy Time-Series Imputation with Differentially Private Diffusion Models via Clipping-Aware Objective Conditioning
summary: Reliable recovery of missing measurements is important for monitoring and analysis in energy time-series systems, where fine-grained measurements may contain sensitive temporal information. Diffusion models trained with differentially private stochastic gradient descent (DP-SGD) provide a promising framework for privacy-sensitive energy time-series imputation. Under cosine diffusion schedules, late timesteps correspond to low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) conditions, where standard $\varepsilon$-prediction can induce large pre-clipping gradients. Such gradients are more likely to be clipped, reducing the retained optimization signal. The artificial intelligence (AI) contribution lies in formulating this objective--clipping interaction as an objective optimization problem under fixed-threshold DP-SGD and developing timestep-aware objective conditioning for diffusion-based energy time-series imputation. The method adopts $v$-prediction to mitigate late-timestep gradient amplification, uses static loss weighting as a uniform-scaling control, and introduces diffusion-schedule-aware dynamic weighting for stronger attenuation before clipping. For the engineering application, we evaluate the method on five real-world energy time-series datasets across random point missingness, contiguous block missingness, persistent outages, and multiple missing-data severities. Under matched DP-SGD settings, the proposed method consistently improves imputation utility over the $\varepsilon$-prediction baseline. Gradient diagnostics reveal lower upper-tail pre-clipping gradient norms, reduced clipping fractions, and stronger attenuation at late low-SNR timesteps, supporting the effectiveness of clipping-aware objective conditioning for energy time-series imputation.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对差分隐私扩散模型在能源时序插补中的梯度裁剪问题，提出时间步感知的目标条件化方法（v-prediction + 动态损失加权），在五个真实数据集上稳定提升插补效用。
AI.motivation: 能源时序数据中精细测量含敏感时间信息，需在隐私保护下进行可靠插补；采用DP-SGD训练的扩散模型是有前景的框架。但在余弦扩散调度下，晚期时间步处于低信噪比（SNR）状态，标准ε-prediction会产生较大的裁剪前梯度，更易被裁剪，导致保留的优化信号减少，从而损害插补性能。
AI.method: 将"目标函数—裁剪"交互建模为固定阈值DP-SGD下的目标优化问题，提出时间步感知的目标条件化：1）采用v-prediction缓解晚期时间步的梯度放大；2）使用静态损失加权作为统一缩放对照；3）引入扩散调度感知的动态加权，在裁剪前实现更强衰减。
AI.result: 在五个真实能源时序数据集上，覆盖随机点缺失、连续块缺失、持续中断及多种缺失严重度；在匹配的DP-SGD设置下，所提方法持续优于ε-prediction基线。梯度诊断显示裁剪前梯度范数上尾更低、裁剪比例下降、晚期低SNR时间步衰减更强。
AI.conclusion: 裁剪感知的目标条件化能有效缓解低SNR晚期时间步的梯度裁剪问题，为隐私敏感能源时序插补提供实用改进。

title: How Many Categories Are Enough? Distribution-Free Certification Limits for Few-Shot Anomaly Thresholds
summary: Few-shot anomaly detectors are judged by ranking metrics, yet deployment requires an alarm threshold with a controlled false-alarm rate (FAR). We ask how much normal evidence, in images or category units, is needed to certify such a threshold for an unseen category.
