Using a frozen DINOv2 principal component analysis (PCA) residual ranker on 15 MVTec and 12 VisA categories under four corruption types, we show that target-only leave-one-image-out (LOIO) calibration is resolution-limited and shift-fragile: rank values cannot fall below $1/(k+1)$, and at the attainable level $α=0.20$, empirical FAR reaches 0.341 on Gaussian-corrupted MVTec at $k=4$, 1.7 times the nominal level. A category-count feasibility calculus is then derived: even with all-zero category losses and no multiplicity charged, any deterministic, uniformly valid, distribution-free 95% upper confidence bound (UCB) requires at least 14, 29, and 59 independent and identically distributed (iid) category draws at $α=0.20$, $0.10$, and $0.05$; these counts are necessary but not sufficient. The Cross-category Reliability Estimation with Source Support (CRESS) protocol splits source categories into disjoint reference, proposal, and certification roles. With only three or four certification categories, all 960 frozen configurations return the fail-closed threshold $τ^\star=0$, and the smallest category-level UCB is 0.950. Image-unit analyses of the same archive select positive thresholds in 36.7% to 60.3% of target cells; these bounds hold for the selected source mixture, not for the marginal risk of a new-category draw. The contribution is a quantitative feasibility boundary and an estimand-aware protocol specifying when source evidence can, and cannot, support a transferable reliability claim.

AI.tldr: 该研究量化了少样本异常检测中可迁移报警阈值所需的正常样本量，提出类别计数可行性边界与CRESS协议，证明少量类别证据无法支撑分布无关的可靠性认证。
AI.motivation: 少样本异常检测虽以排序指标评价，但实际部署需要控制误报率（FAR）的报警阈值。核心问题是：对于未见类别，需要多少图像或类别单位的正常证据才能认证这一阈值。
AI.method: 采用冻结的DINOv2 PCA残差排序器，在MVTec（15类）和VisA（12类）的四种污染类型下评估；提出类别计数可行性演算，并设计CRESS协议，将源类别划分为参考、提议和认证三种互斥角色。
AI.result: 目标类别LOIO校准受分辨率限制且对分布漂移脆弱：秩值无法低于1/(k+1)，α=0.20、k=4时高斯污染MVTec上经验FAR达0.341（为标称的1.7倍）。分布无关95% UCB在α=0.20/0.10/0.05下分别至少需14/29/59个iid类别。仅用3-4个认证类别时，960个冻结配置全部返回fail-closed阈值τ*=0，最小类别级UCB为0.950。图像单元分析在36.7%–60.3%的目标单元中选出正阈值。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出了一条定量可行性边界和估计目标感知（estimand-aware）协议，明确了源域证据何时能够、何时不能支撑可迁移的可靠性声明，揭示了图像单元界仅对所选源混合成立而非新类别抽样的边际风险。

title: Constant-Memory Recall: Learned Associations in a Fixed Matrix State
summary: Fixed-size recurrent memory limits storage growth during inference, but successful recall depends on the task and training. We study a small DeltaNet variant with fixed token-specific key biases, trained to remember 32 new key-value pairings per sequence. With 32 KiB of recurrent matrix state, it achieves 99.95% mean accuracy across three training seeds when choosing among the sequence's values. Recall remains near perfect when filler extends the pre-query context to 1,798 tokens without adding pairings. Zeroing the first memory block removes this recall. An exploratory 48-pair test remains near chance after one quarter of the primary training budget and does not locate a capacity limit. Parameter-matched vector and Transformer baselines remain near chance, including the Transformer after additional training searches. This unresolved baseline failure prevents a memory-efficiency comparison.

AI.tldr: 一个小型 DeltaNet 变体（固定 token 特定 key 偏置）在 32 KiB 循环矩阵状态下，对每序列 32 组新键值对实现 99.95% 平均召回精度（3 个随机种子），但参数匹配的向量与 Transformer 基线仍接近随机水平，导致无法完成记忆效率对比。
AI.motivation: 固定大小的循环记忆可在推理时限制存储增长，但其成功召回取决于任务与训练方式。作者希望检验这种固定状态记忆在受控的键值关联召回任务中的实际能力边界，并尝试与参数匹配的基线进行记忆效率比较。
AI.method: 研究一个带固定 token 特定 key 偏置的小型 DeltaNet 变体，训练其在每个序列中记住 32 个新的键值配对；使用 32 KiB 的循环矩阵状态；通过三个训练种子评估；以填充文本将查询前上下文扩展至 1,798 个 token（不增加配对数）测试召回；并做归零首个记忆块的消融；另设 48 配对的探索性测试（约为主训练预算的四分之一）。同时设置参数匹配的向量基线与 Transformer 基线，后者还额外进行了训练搜索。
AI.result: 在 32 KiB 循环矩阵状态下，32 配对任务平均精度达 99.95%（三个种子）；将查询前上下文用填充扩展至 1,798 个 token 后召回仍近乎完美；归零首个记忆块后召回消失；48 配对探索性测试在四分之一训练预算下仍接近随机，未定位到容量上限；参数匹配的向量与 Transformer 基线均接近随机，即使 Transformer 经过额外训练搜索亦未改善。
AI.conclusion: 该 DeltaNet 变体在受控 32 键值配对召回任务上表现优异且对填充长度鲁棒，但尚未探明其容量上限。由于基线未能超越随机水平，当前无法对记忆效率作出有效比较，基线失败问题有待解决。

title: The Hidden Costs of 99% Accuracy: A Trustworthiness Audit of the Telco Customer Churn Benchmark
summary: Customer churn prediction on the IBM Telco Customer Churn benchmark (n = 7,043) routinely reports test accuracies above 95%, with the most cited published study reporting 99.01%. We audit this benchmark for four trustworthiness failures invisible to the accuracy- and F1-centred reporting that dominates the literature. First, pre-split SMOTE inflates churn-class F1 by 13.1 percentage points across ten classifiers and fifteen seeds (Wilcoxon p < 10^-4 per classifier); the same leaky pipeline ordering paired with class weighting yields no inflation, isolating the effect to SMOTE's geometric construction. We measure the mechanism directly: approximately 36% of synthetic training points are nearest-neighbour interpolations of test-set instances. Second, the TotalCharges field is approximately determined by tenure multiplied by MonthlyCharges (R2 = 0.999); removing it changes accuracy by less than 0.2 percentage points, yet TreeSHAP ranks it ninth in mean absolute attribution - a pattern that materially corrupts SHAP-based interpretation. We propose an R2 > 0.95 pre-modelling diagnostic. Third, in a 15-seed calibration audit, isotonic regression is the strongest default; temperature scaling fails on class-weighted tree ensembles whose predicted-probability distribution is bimodal. Fourth, the cost-optimal decision threshold (under a 50 USD retention offer and 24-month CLV proxy) is approximately 5-10 times lower than the F1-optimal threshold, saving approximately 77,000 USD per 1,000 customers. We replicate F1 and F2 on Iranian Telecom Churn (within domain) and Bank Customer Churn (across domain): F1 generalises; F2 generalises only within telecom. We synthesise these findings into a four-component reporting checklist - pipeline disclosure, redundancy diagnostic, calibration audit, and cost-sensitive thresholds - and release a reproducible implementation.

AI.tldr: 该文对IBM Telco客户流失基准进行可信度审计，揭示四个被传统准确率/F1报告掩盖的缺陷，并提出四项报告清单。
AI.motivation: 该基准上普遍报告的95%以上测试准确率（最高99.01%）在文献中占据主导地位，但这类以准确率和F1为中心的报告无法暴露数据泄漏、特征冗余、概率校准失效与决策阈值不当等可信度问题，因此需要系统性审计。
AI.method: 在n=7,043的IBM Telco数据上进行四项审计：(1)对比预划分SMOTE与类权重在10个分类器、15个随机种子下的F1差异，并用最近邻检验量化合成点与测试集的几何重叠；(2)用R²分析TotalCharges与tenure×MonthlyCharges的冗余关系，并以TreeSHAP归因排序检验其对解释的污染，提出R²>0.95的预建模诊断；(3)开展15种子校准审计，比较isotonic回归与temperature scaling；(4)在50美元挽留成本与24个月CLV代理下比较成本最优阈值与F1最优阈值。并在Iranian Telecom（同域）与Bank Customer Churn（跨域）上复现F1、F2。
AI.result: 预划分SMOTE使流失类F1平均虚高13.1个百分点（每分类器Wilcoxon p<10⁻⁴），改用类权重后无膨胀，约36%合成训练点为测试集样本的最近邻插值；TotalCharges近似由tenure×MonthlyCharges决定（R²=0.999），删除后准确率变化小于0.2个百分点，但TreeSHAP仍将其排至平均绝对归因第9位；isotonic回归为最稳健默认校准方法，temperature scaling在类加权树集成（预测概率双峰分布）上失效；成本最优阈值比F1最优阈值低约5–10倍，每千名客户节省约77,000美元；F1在同域与跨域均泛化，F2仅在电信同域泛化。
AI.conclusion: 现有Telco流失预测文献的高准确率与解释结论部分由数据泄漏、特征冗余和评估设计缺陷驱动，应纳入四要素报告清单——流程披露、冗余诊断、校准审计与成本敏感阈值——并附可复现实现。

title: Contingent Exposure Routing for Financial AI: Outage Risk and the Cost of Indivisible Decisions
comment: 15 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/shi1720/contingent-exposure-routing
summary: Model failover restores availability, but changes which financial institutions share decision errors. We formulate outage-contingent routing through a local market-impact response matrix and study expected squared price displacement. A symmetric construction shows that a shared backup can leave an order-one concentration floor as the number of primary endpoints grows, while balanced fallback risk decreases inversely with the surviving endpoint count. For indivisible decisions, we derive the exact second moment of independent randomized routing and an effective-exposure granularity that determines its gap from fractional allocation. Conditional-expectation rounding gives a finite-agent bound without coupled quotas; a separate swap procedure preserves endpoint counts and is assessed against dual lower bounds. Across 60 synthetic portfolio networks and 11,340 scenario evaluations, the latter reduces risk by 6.57% and 10.53% for single and double endpoint removals at the central feedback setting with independent errors. A replay of 1,024 recorded API responses on constructed rebalancing tasks gives a smaller held-out reduction of 3.30% (paired bootstrap interval 2.07--4.57%). Strongly aligned errors, inferior endpoints, and indivisibility limit diversification. The contribution is an auditable routing stress test and implementation analysis, not an estimate of real-market crash probabilities.

AI.tldr: 该文将故障切换路由建模为局部市场冲击响应矩阵下的期望平方价格位移最小化问题，分析共享备份的集中度下限、不可分决策的精确二阶矩与粒度、以及取整与交换算法，并在合成网络与真实API回放中评估风险下降。
AI.motivation: 模型故障切换虽能恢复可用性，但会改变哪些金融机构共享决策误差，从而带来新的风险集中问题。作者希望量化这种由路由结构变化引发的系统性风险，而非估计真实市场崩盘概率。
AI.method: 1) 构建故障情景相关的路由问题，用局部市场冲击响应矩阵刻画期望平方价格位移；2) 对称构造分析共享备份在主要端点增多时的集中度下限，以及均衡回退风险随存活端点数的衰减；3) 对不可分决策推导独立随机路由的精确二阶矩，并定义有效暴露粒度以刻画其与分数配置的差距；4) 采用条件期望取整获得无需耦合配额的有限智能体界，并设计保持端点计数的交换过程，以对偶下界评估。
AI.result: 在60个合成组合网络、11,340次情景评估中，中心反馈设定与独立误差下，交换过程在单端点和双端点移除时分别降低风险6.57%和10.53%。在构建的再平衡任务上回放1,024条记录的API响应，留出集风险下降较小，为3.30%（配对自助法区间2.07%–4.57%）。强相关误差、较差端点和不可分性会限制分散化收益。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出了一种可审计的路由压力测试与实现分析框架，用于评估故障切换下的决策误差集中风险，而非估计真实市场崩盘概率。结果表明路由设计可在一定程度上降低风险，但受误差相关性、端点质量与不可分性制约。

title: The Null Is the Hard Part: Exact Tests for Memorization in Generative Models
comment: 23 pages, 5 figures. Code and measurement outputs at https://github.com/sushovan4/memorization-audits
summary: Memorization audits of generative models read similarity scores against thresholds, with no null distribution, and the conclusions they support can be wrong. By MemBench's rule, the benchmark's mitigations roughly halve Stable Diffusion's memorization; audited with false-discovery control, two thirds of the certified images are no longer detected under random prompt perturbations, five sixths under attention rescaling, and all of them under embedding optimization. The field's data-copying test, read against its own null, flags ten of twenty-four generators that reproduce nothing. We argue that for memorization the null is the hard part, and supply two. For a whole model, training and held-out images are exchangeable given its samples, and relabelling them is a permutation test, exact for any statistic when the held-out images are a random split; under it, a nearest-neighbour preference still fires on seven of those twenty-four, and a count restricted to the near-duplicate scale on none (McNemar p=0.016). For single images, the natural nulls fail twice, measurably: ranking an image among random images yields 596 false discoveries among 2,365 controls, and resampling independent generations makes the null three times too narrow. Calibrated against matched controls, the audit certifies 36 of 61 MemBench images at 5% false-discovery rate, held-out controls are certified in 0.01% of calibration splits, and on this benchmark two generations per image recover that count. A calibrated maximum, which reads occasional rather than typical copying, certifies 46. As the scale-restricted statistic we recommend the small-scale mass of the Intersection Euler Characteristic Profile, which also counts distinct images copied and tests whether two models copy the same ones.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出生成模型记忆化审计普遍将相似度分数直接与阈值比较、缺乏零分布，结论可能错误；作者主张"零分布才是难点"，并提出模型级（置换检验）与图像级（匹配对照校准）两类精确零假设，验证原审计大幅高估记忆化。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆化审计读取相似度分数与固定阈值比较，不构建零分布，导致支持结论可能出错；领域内数据复制检验若与其自身零分布对照，会错误标记24个生成器中的10个。作者认为记忆化问题的核心难点在于零分布的构建。
AI.method: 提出两类零假设：(1) 模型级——给定样本时训练图像与留出图像可交换，重标注构成置换检验（留出为随机划分时对任意统计量精确）；(2) 图像级——对单张图像使用匹配对照校准，并定义读取"偶发而非典型复制"的校准最大值统计量，推荐使用交集欧拉特征谱的小尺度质量作为尺度受限统计量。
AI.result: 按MemBench规则其缓解措施约将Stable Diffusion记忆化减半；在错误发现控制下，随机提示扰动使2/3认证图像不再被检出，注意力重缩放使5/6不再检出，嵌入优化使全部不再检出。置换检验下，最近邻偏好仍在24个生成器中7个触发，近重复尺度计数在0个触发（McNemar p=0.016）。图像级：随机图像排序在2,365个对照中产生596个错误发现，独立生成重采样使零分布过窄3倍；匹配对照校准下，61张MemBench图像中36张在5% FDR下被认证，留出对照仅在0.01%校准划分中被认证，每图两次生成即可恢复该数量；校准最大值认证46张。
AI.conclusion: 记忆化审计的关键难点是零分布而非统计量；所提出的置换检验与匹配对照校准零分布能有效控制错误发现，揭示原审计大幅高估记忆化，并推荐交集欧拉特征谱小尺度质量作为尺度受限统计量，可计数被复制的不同图像并检验两模型是否复制同一批图像。

title: Verification Pulses and the Cost of Escaping Wrong Consensus
comment: 18 pages, 5 figures; code and raw experimental records: https://github.com/shi1720/verification-pulses
summary: External verification can correct individual outputs while leaving a self-reinforcing population in the basin of a wrong consensus. We study how the timing and addressing of a fixed verification budget affect recovery in an asynchronous binary register. For a general nonlinear response, we derive the minimum fuel required to cross a basin boundary under a peak verification constraint. For a finite population, an exact birth--death calculation gives the probability of subsequent wrong consensus after a pulse. Our main asymptotic result identifies the critical budget window: a leading term $N\log(x_0/b)$ and a correction of order $\sqrt N$, with separate variance contributions from repeated verification targets and autonomous amplification after verification stops. The distinction is substantial: with 16 majority-updated slots and 14 initially wrong, 9 random checks cross the mean-field budget threshold, whereas 23 are required for 95% eventual recovery in the exact model. A prospectively specified experiment records 13,392 language-model responses, including calibration and 108 held-out trajectories. Calibration produces different fitted response regimes, but all four adjusted schedule-comparison intervals include zero. A distributional audit also finds that modest mean-prediction error can conceal a large underestimate of terminal consensus occupancy. The results support risk-calibrated reset scheduling under a specified update contract, while explicitly separating it from distinct-target checking and unrestricted evidence broadcast.

AI.tldr: 研究固定验证预算的时机与投放方式对异步二元寄存器中错误共识恢复的影响，给出穿越盆地边界的最小"燃料"、脉冲后错误共识概率的精确计算，以及临界预算窗口的渐近结果，并用语言模型实验加以检验。
AI.motivation: 外部验证虽能纠正个体输出，但可能留下一个位于错误共识盆地内、可自我强化的群体。论文旨在厘清在固定验证预算下，验证的时机与"投放对象"如何决定系统能否从错误共识中恢复。
AI.method: 以异步二元寄存器为模型。对一般非线性响应，推导在峰值验证约束下穿越盆地边界所需的最小燃料；对有限种群，用精确生灭过程计算脉冲后再次形成错误共识的概率；进一步给出渐近分析刻画临界预算窗口（主项 N log(x0/b) 与 √N 阶修正，并分离重复验证目标与验证停止后自主放大的方差贡献）；最后设计前瞻性实验，采集 13,392 条语言模型响应，含校准集与 108 条留出轨迹。
AI.result: 渐近分析识别出临界预算窗口：主项 N log(x0/b)，修正为 √N 阶，方差来自重复验证目标与验证停止后的自主放大。二者差异显著：16 个多数更新槽中 14 个初始错误时，9 次随机检查即可越过均场预算阈值，而精确模型中需 23 次才能达到 95% 的最终恢复率。实验中校准给出不同的拟合响应区间，但四个调整后的调度比较区间均包含零；分布审计发现，均值预测误差较小可能掩盖对终端共识占有率的大幅低估。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持在明确更新契约下采用风险校准的重置调度，并明确将其与"针对不同目标的检查"及"无限制证据广播"区分开来。

title: Sharp Oracle-Regret Tradeoffs for Projection-Free Online Convex Optimization
summary: We characterize the regret attainable in online convex optimization when access to the feasible set is limited to an exact linear optimization oracle. The learner is given an inscribed ball and a diameter bound and must remain feasible on every consistent instance. For convex $G$-Lipschitz losses, diameter at most $D$, a total allowance of $Q$ oracle calls, and a strict limit of $B$ calls per round, the dimension-free minimax expected regret is $Θ(GD\max\{\sqrt T,T/(1+\min\{Q,BT\})^{1/4}\})$. The lower bound applies to arbitrary randomized learners. Universal feasibility first forces each action into the hull of the supplied ball and the preceding oracle replies. A fixed-body construction then couples fresh phase directions to a shared simplex, making useful replies costly repeatedly even though all losses have a common minimizer. A counted approximate-gradient method with interleaved blocks attains the matching rate. Total-budget and strict per-round guarantees follow as special cases, including the $T^{3/4}$ rate with one call per round and the quadratic total budget needed for $\sqrt T$ regret. For prescribed smoothness $β$, an analytic construction yields a curvature-dependent lower bound and identifies the threshold above which the general characterization remains sharp.

AI.tldr: 本文刻画了在线凸优化中当可行集访问仅限精确线性优化oracle时的可达遗憾：在G-Lipschitz凸损失、直径D、总调用预算Q、每轮严格限制B次调用下，无维度依赖的minimax期望遗憾为Θ(GD max{√T, T/(1+min{Q,BT})^{1/4}})，并给出下界构造与匹配算法。
AI.motivation: 研究在线凸优化在受限一阶信息访问模型下的根本性能极限。传统方法假设可投影或可高效计算梯度，但实际中可能只能访问精确线性优化oracle（即仅能求解线性优化问题）。作者希望刻画在这种受限访问下遗憾的理论下界与上界，并阐明可行性约束与调用预算对学习性能的影响。
AI.method: 1) 建立的可行性分析：通用可行性迫使每个动作必须落在给定内切球与前序oracle回复的凸包内。2) 下界构造：采用固定体（fixed-body）构造，将新鲜相位方向耦合到共享单纯形上，使有用回复反复付出高昂代价，且对所有随机化学习器成立。3) 上界算法：设计一种带交错块的计数近似梯度方法（counted approximate-gradient method with interleaved blocks），达到匹配速率。4) 针对给定光滑度β，构造解析例子得到曲率相关的下界，并识别一般刻画保持锐利的阈值。
AI.result: 得到无维度依赖的minimax期望遗憾精确刻画：Θ(GD max{√T, T/(1+min{Q,BT})^{1/4}})。特例包括：每轮一次调用时达到T^{3/4}速率；需要二次总预算才能实现√T遗憾。总预算限制与严格每轮限制作为特例统一涵盖。光滑情形下给出曲率相关下界并确定一般刻画保持sharp的阈值。
AI.conclusion: 在线凸优化在仅可访问精确线性优化oracle时，其遗憾由调用预算（总量Q与每轮B）与时间T的联合效应决定，存在无维度依赖的精确minimax刻画。可行性约束与oracle调用成本共同导致T^{3/4}等新速率，且总预算与每轮预算可统一处理。该刻画在光滑损失情形下存在阈值，超过该阈值仍保持锐利。

title: Attention Manifolds: Steering or Blocking Language Models by Editing Learned B-Spline Surfaces
summary: In standard transformer attention, a source token sends the same value vector to every receiver. The query determines \emph{how much} to attend but not \emph{what} to extract. This work introduces \textbf{attention manifolds}: learned 2D B-spline surfaces $S_d(q_d, k_d)$ that modulate each value dimension based on the query-key interaction. Each surface is a tensor-product cubic B-spline initialized to zero, preserving pretrained behavior. Applied to LLaMA 3.2-1B-Instruct and 3B-Instruct, attention manifolds reduce WikiText-2 validation perplexity by 2--2.5 points with 0.3\% parameter overhead. Across 112 diverse prompts, surfaces change greedy-decoded output for 69\% (1B) to 83\% (3B) of cases, with the strongest effects on ambiguous and polysemous inputs (94--100\% change rate). The surfaces improve output quality: correcting factual errors (\emph{``the CAP theorem has three main components''} $\to$ \emph{``it is impossible to guarantee all three''}), increasing precision (\emph{``impossible to know certain properties''} $\to$ \emph{``impossible to know both position and momentum''}), and adding specificity (a generic quote $\to$ an attributed Saint Augustine citation, consistently at both scales). The learned surfaces are also mechanically editable: inverting a layer's coefficients changes greedy output for 9/10 prompts (KL~0.010), providing a geometric mechanism for model steering. Setting surface coefficients to $-1$ creates ``attention walls'' that block value flow through specific dimensions. In a preliminary experiment, a layer-wide wall redirects an explosive-device prompt from specific instructions to general educational content, suggesting a path toward safety-oriented manifold shaping.

AI.tldr: 提出注意力流形（attention manifolds）：用可学习的二维B样条曲面 S_d(q_d,k_d) 依据查询-键交互调制每个 value 维度，零初始化为恒等映射。在 LLaMA 3.2 1B/3B 上以 0.3% 参数开销将 WikiText-2 困惑度降低 2–2.5，并显著改变贪心解码输出、提升事实与细节质量，且可通过系数编辑实现几何式模型操控与"注意力墙"。
AI.motivation: 标准 Transformer 注意力中，源 token 向所有接收者发送相同的 value 向量，查询只决定"关注多少"（how much）而不能决定"提取什么"（what）。这一结构性限制使同一 value 无法依查询语义被差异化读取，导致模型难以处理歧义、多义及需要精确提取的输入。
AI.method: 引入注意力流形：为每个 value 维度学习一张二维张量积三次 B 样条曲面 S_d(q_d, k_d)，以查询与键的对应维度作为曲面坐标，输出乘性调制该 value 维度。曲面初始化为零，使初始行为等价于恒等映射，从而在不破坏预训练行为的前提下微调。应用于 LLaMA 3.2-1B-Instruct 与 3B-Instruct。
AI.result: 参数开销仅 0.3%，WikiText-2 验证困惑度下降 2–2.5 点。112 条多样提示中，69%（1B）至 83%（3B）的贪心解码输出发生改变，歧义与多义输入上改变率达 94–100%。输出质量提升：纠正事实错误（CAP 定理由"三个主要组成部分"变为"无法同时保证三者"）、提高精确性（"无法确定某些性质"→"无法同时确定位置与动量"）、增加具体性（泛化引语→圣奥古斯丁署名引用，两个规模一致）。机械可编辑性：反转某层系数使 9/10 提示的贪心输出改变（KL≈0.010）；系数设为 −1 形成"注意力墙"阻断特定维度的 value 流动，初步实验中层-wide 墙将爆炸装置相关提示从具体指令重定向为一般教育性内容。
AI.conclusion: 查询可对 value 提取内容进行几何化调制，是该架构中一个未被利用的自由度。注意力流形以极低参数代价带来困惑度与生成质量双重收益，并提供可解释、可编辑的几何操控机制（系数反转、注意力墙），为模型引导及面向安全的流形塑形提供了初步路径。

title: MOVE: Multimodal Open-world Verification and Expansion for Graph Learning
summary: Multimodal graph learning faces a fundamental challenge: new classes may emerge after deployment, while models are trained with a fixed label space. Existing approaches typically detect unknown nodes and use LLMs to generate candidate class descriptions, but they do not determine whether existing classes are insufficient to cover these nodes or whether a generated class is reliable enough to expand the class space. Our empirical study reveals three challenges: multimodal information beyond individual modalities is required for unknown-node identification, LLM-generated class descriptions may not fully capture multimodal class characteristics, and directly adding candidate classes can introduce redundant categories. Based on these observations, we propose MOVE, a multimodal open-world class verification and expansion framework. MOVE identifies nodes that cannot be assigned to existing classes by jointly considering visual tokens, textual attributes, and graph context, leverages a multimodal LLM to generate candidate classes, and selectively expands the class space only when candidates are consistently supported by multimodal evidence without introducing unnecessary categories. Experiments demonstrate that MOVE achieves an average improvement of 11.87\% across unknown recognition, open-domain annotation, and downstream graph learning tasks.

AI.tldr: MOVE：面向多模态开放世界的类别验证与扩展框架，联合视觉、文本与图上下文识别未知节点，用多模态LLM生成候选类并有选择地扩展类别空间。
AI.motivation: 多模态图学习面临部署后新类涌现而模型标签空间固定的问题。现有方法仅检测未知节点并用LLM生成候选类描述，但未判断：现有类是否不足以覆盖这些节点，以及生成的类是否足够可靠以扩展类空间。实证研究揭示三个挑战：未知节点识别需要超越单一模态的多模态信息；LLM生成的类描述可能无法充分刻画多模态类特性；直接添加候选类会引入冗余类别。
AI.method: MOVE通过联合考虑视觉token、文本属性和图上下文，识别无法归入现有类别的节点；利用多模态LLM生成候选类；仅当候选类得到多模态证据的一致支持且不会引入不必要类别时，才选择性地扩展类空间。
AI.result: 在未知识别、开放域标注和下游图学习任务上，MOVE平均提升11.87%。
AI.conclusion: MOVE通过多模态联合的未知节点识别与候选类一致性验证，实现可靠的开放世界类别空间扩展，避免冗余类别，显著提升多项任务性能。

title: Large Language Bayes Is Not Reparameterisation-Invariant
summary: Large Language Bayes (LLB) answers an informal modelling question by sampling candidate probabilistic programs from a language model, running approximate inference on each, and averaging them with weights proportional to an exponentiated evidence bound. We show that this weighting depends on how a model is written. The log marginal likelihood is invariant to reparameterisation; the evidence bound is not. On eight schools the centered and non-centered programs are the same measure to $5.7\times10^{-14}$, yet their weights differ by $6.1\times$; importance weighting reduces this only to $2.2\times$, and reproducing the inference LLB actually runs, a full-covariance Gaussian matched to the posterior moments, still leaves $1.9\times$ on eight schools and $8.9\times$ in $64$ dimensions. Across likelihood families, dimensions and funnel severities the discrepancy reaches $31.9\times$ and reverses sign, so no single writing is uniformly preferable. It inverts Bayes factors against eight natural competitors, and the induced error in the model posterior, and in any downstream target, is controlled by the spread $Δ$ of the bound shortfalls through a known sharp Hilbert-distance bound. Across $360$ programs from six language models the parameterisation written ranges from $0\%$ to $100\%$ centered and is stable within a model. Detecting equivalent programs statistically can falsely merge genuinely different models at practical sample budgets; verifying reparameterisations we generate ourselves cannot, and closes the window.

AI.tldr: LLB通过语言模型采样候选概率程序、对每个程序做近似推断并按指数化证据界的权重加权平均；论文指出该权重依赖于程序的书写方式（参数化），是方法的一个内在缺陷。
AI.motivation: LLB 用证据界（evidence bound）的指数作为模型加权，隐含假设该权重反映模型优劣；但证据界对重参数化不具不变性，若同一模型的不同写法得到不同权重，则加权结果不可靠，需要系统检验这一敏感性。
AI.method: 理论上对比对数边缘似然的不变性与证据界的不变性；在 eight schools（中心化 vs 非中心化写法）等基准上比较权重差异；考察重要性加权、以及复现 LLB 实际使用的全协方差高斯后验矩匹配推断；跨似然族、维度与漏斗（funnel）严重程度测试；分析权重差异对贝叶斯因子与模型后验的影响，用 Hilbert 距离的尖锐界刻画由界缺口离散度 Δ 控制的误差；统计 360 个来自 6 个语言模型的程序的中心化比例；并比较统计式等价检测与自行验证重参数化两种识别策略。
AI.result: eight schools 上中心化与非中心化程序作为测度差异仅 5.7e-14，但权重相差 6.1 倍；重要性加权只降到 2.2 倍；复现实际推断（全协方差高斯矩匹配）在 eight schools 仍差 1.9 倍，64 维下 8.9 倍。跨似然族、维度与漏斗严重度，差异最高达 31.9 倍且会变号，说明没有统一种写法占优。它使相对八个自然竞争者的贝叶斯因子发生反转，模型后验及任意下游目标的误差由界缺口离散度 Δ 经 Hilbert 距离界控制。360 个程序中心化比例从 0% 到 100%，且在同一模型内稳定。统计式等价程序检测在实用样本预算下会错误合并真正不同的模型，而验证自行生成的重参数化则不会，能封住这一漏洞。
AI.conclusion: LLB 的加权对参数化敏感，权重差异可达数十倍并改变符号，导致贝叶斯因子反转和下游误差，因此该加权不构成对模型的可靠偏好。修复方向是验证自行生成的重参数化（而非用统计检测合并等价程序），以消除书写依赖。

title: Stable and Counterfactually Robust Physical World Models from Imposed Structure and Learned Physics
summary: A world model learns to forecast how a physical system evolves from recorded trajectories, yet the systems it imitates obey physical laws that are neither fully supplied nor reliably respected. The model may create energy, drift or diverge over long rollouts, and answer a changed law query using the law observed during training. We ask how much general physical structure must be hard coded into a world model, and how much system-specific physics can then be learned from data, for four properties to hold simultaneously: second law compatible dissipation, correct responses to interventions on physical parameters, stability out to one hundred times the training horizon, and robustness to disturbances. The imposed structure is general: dynamics are generated from the gradient of a learned energy through a fixed reversible operator, the energy is restricted to a confining class, a one way port can remove energy but never inject it, the drive channel is known, and the intervened parameter enters through a separable map. The model learns the energy functional, constitutive relations, dissipation rate, and couplings. Across an electromagnetic cavity, a particle in cell grid, and a shallow-water fluid, models with roughly nine thousand parameters recover constitutive functions with unit slope, separate conserving from dissipating worlds by four orders of magnitude using a single set of weights, and transfer changes in sign, magnitude, rate, and gravity to unseen values, where equal-capacity models without the same structure perform at chance or worse. A nonlinear constitutive law is recovered with its curvature preserved and predicts a held-out intervention $2$-$17\times$ better than a converged linear model.

AI.tldr: 通过将通用物理结构（能量梯度+固定可逆算子+耗散端口）硬编码进世界模型，仅约9000参数即可在电磁腔、粒子网格、浅水流体三类系统中同时满足耗散相容、干预响应、长期稳定与扰动鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 世界模型从轨迹学习物理系统演化，但既未获完整物理定律也难以可靠遵守，常出现能量凭空产生、长期rollout漂移或发散、以及在物理参数被干预后仍沿用训练时定律作答的问题。核心问题是：需要多少通用物理结构被硬编码，多少系统特异性物理可从数据学习，才能同时满足四个性质。
AI.method: 硬编码通用结构：动力学由学习能量的梯度经固定可逆算子生成；能量限定于约束类；单向端口只能移除不能注入能量；驱动通道已知；被干预参数经可分离映射进入。模型学习能量泛函、本构关系、耗散率与耦合项。
AI.result: 在电磁腔、粒子网格与浅水流体三系统中，约9000参数模型恢复出单位斜率本构函数；用单一权重集将守恒与耗散世界分离四个数量级；将符号、幅值、速率与重力的变化迁移到未见值。等容量但无该结构的模型表现仅为随机或更差。非线性本构律以保曲率方式恢复，对留出干预的预测比收敛线性模型好2–17倍。
AI.conclusion: 少量通用物理结构硬编码加上数据驱动的系统特异性物理学习，足以让世界模型同时具备第二定律相容耗散、正确干预响应、百倍训练视野稳定性和扰动鲁棒性，且参数效率极高。

title: Bellman-Certified Rounding for Sparse Policy Deployment in MDPs
summary: Continuous policy optimization may spread an update across many states, even when deployment permits only a few complete state-level changes. We study how much discounted return can be retained when continuous row mixtures are rounded to sparse binary policies in finite MDPs. Policy-dependent visitation couples the row edits, while long horizons make global curvature bounds conservative. From $2d+2$ Bellman solves, we derive reusable envelopes that support uniform and candidate-specific guarantees before rounding. A rank-two rational representation of each exchange further permits weighted curvature integration along the realized trajectory. We prove that linear dimension dependence is unavoidable when the budget scales, and that exact global curvature thresholding is hard. Candidate-specific bounds raise pre-rounding certification coverage from $48.2\%$ to $74.1\%$ on the structured suite. At $γ=0.95$, local integration lowers the median bound-to-loss ratio from $402.3$ to $2.08$ on coupled instances.

AI.tldr: 研究有限MDP中连续行混合策略经稀疏二值化后折现回报的可保留量，提出可复用包络与秩二有理表示，并给出理论下界与近似困难性。
AI.motivation: 部署场景仅允许少量完整的、状态级的（二值）策略改动，而连续策略优化往往将更新分散到大量状态上，因此需要评估将连续行混合舍入为稀疏二值策略时能保留多少折现回报。该问题的难点在于：策略相关的访问分布使各行编辑相互耦合，且长时域导致全局曲率界过于保守。
AI.method: 1) 通过2d+2次Bellman求解导出可复用的包络，在舍入前提供一致性保证与候选特定（candidate-specific）保证；2) 对每个交换（exchange）构造秩二有理表示，从而沿实际轨迹进行加权曲率积分；3) 建立理论结果：当预算规模增长时线性维度依赖不可避免，且精确的全局曲率阈值化是困难的。
AI.result: 候选特定界将结构化测试集上的舍入前认证覆盖率从48.2%提升至74.1%；在γ=0.95时，局部积分将耦合实例上的中位数界与损失之比从402.3降至2.08。
AI.conclusion: 通过可复用包络与秩二有理曲率积分，可在稀疏二值化前对折现回报保留进行更紧致且更广覆盖的认证，同时揭示了预算规模化下的维度依赖与精确阈值化的计算困难性。

title: MoRA: MoE Pruning via Router Bias Learning and Expert Approximation
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models enable parameter scaling with limited per-token computation by activating only a small subset of experts for each token, but deploying them still requires loading the complete expert pool into memory. Structured expert pruning can effectively reduce the memory usage by removing experts. However, existing pruning methods either use expert ranking criteria that are not well aligned with model performance or rely on effective expert subset searching that is computationally expensive. Moreover, these methods typically overlook the routing-behavior redundancy among the retained experts. In this paper, we propose MoE Pruning via Router Bias Learning and Expert Approximation (MoRA), a framework for structured MoE expert pruning. We introduce a learnable router bias for each expert and optimize these biases by minimizing the language-modeling loss and a routing-diversity regularizer. The learned router biases sharpen the routing probability distributions to identify experts critical to model performance while encouraging the selection of experts with diverse routing preferences. In addition, we introduce an expert approximation mechanism as a post-pruning enhancement. It leverages the remaining experts to approximate the outputs of pruned experts by affine transformation, further improving the performance of the pruned model. We evaluate MoRA on Qwen3-30B-A3B, DeepSeek-V2-Lite, and Moonlight-16B-A3B, removing 25\% and 50\% of the routed experts in each MoE layer. Extensive experiments on nine zero-shot benchmarks show that MoRA outperforms state-of-the-art pruning algorithms. Our code will be released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MoRA框架，通过可学习路由器偏置与路由多样性正则化进行结构化专家剪枝，并结合专家近似机制，在多个MoE模型和基准上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: MoE模型虽能通过稀疏激活扩展参数，但部署时仍需将全部专家加载进内存。现有结构化专家剪枝方法存在两大问题：一是专家排序标准与模型性能对齐不佳，或依赖计算昂贵的子集搜索；二是忽视了保留专家之间的路由行为冗余。
AI.method: MoRA为每个专家引入可学习路由器偏置，通过最小化语言建模损失与路由多样性正则项来优化这些偏置，使路由概率分布更尖锐以识别关键专家，同时鼓励选择路由偏好多样的专家。此外，引入专家近似机制作为剪枝后增强，利用保留专家通过仿射变换近似被剪枝专家的输出，进一步提升剪枝模型性能。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-30B-A3B、DeepSeek-V2-Lite和Moonlight-16B-A3B上，每层移除25%和50%的路由专家；在九个零样本基准上的大量实验表明，MoRA优于当前最先进的剪枝算法。
AI.conclusion: MoRA通过路由器偏置学习与专家近似机制，有效缓解了现有结构化专家剪枝中排序标准不匹配、搜索昂贵及路由冗余问题，在多个MoE模型与基准上取得领先的剪枝性能，代码将开源。

title: Beyond Diagonal State Space Models: Exact Non-Abelian Group Tracking, Solvability Barriers, and Geometric Physical Manifolds
comment: 26 pages, 1 table, 5 theorems. Source code and reproducible benchmarks available
summary: Selective state space models (SSMs), such as Mamba, S4D, and LRU, are bounded by transition matrix commutativity (A_t A_t' = A_t' A_t) and solvable affine transformation groups (Aff_D of derived length <= 2). Consequently, stacked multi-layer diagonal networks face severe optimization degradation on non-solvable simple groups such as A_5 due to the exponential circuit emulation depth required to simulate non-abelian commutators. We propose Non-Commutative State Space Models (NC-SSM), their real-orthogonal counterpart SO(3)-SSM, and arbitrary-dimension Cayley-SSM, lifting state transitions to compact Lie groups SU(2), SO(3), and SO(N). Via closed-form Euler-Rodrigues maps and rational Cayley transforms, NC-SSM achieves exact norm-preserving isometry (||U_t|| = 1). We introduce pure Hopf-fibration Bloch projective readouts (S^3/{+-1} =~ S^2 =~ SO(3)) to eliminate sign ambiguity, true quaternion parallel prefix scans (9.06x speedup at T=2048), and Identity-Gated Lie SSMs to eliminate sparse syntax phase drift. Extensive benchmarks across 14 experimental regimes show: (1) NC-SSM achieves 100% tracking on S_3, D_4, Q_8 and simple group A_5, where a 3-layer deep diagonal baseline collapses to 6.60% (p = 8.81e-4); (2) Cayley-SO(5)-SSM breaks Klein's 1884 ceiling on symmetric group S_5 (50.92% vs diagonal 5.25%, p = 0.0015, delivering 7.8x variance reduction over SO(3)); (3) SO(3)-SSM preserves Riemannian manifolds across 300 steps (< 3.12e-6 drift, > 580,000x advantage), achieving 0.04 deg dead-reckoning error and active tangent denoising; (4) NC-SSM achieves 74.36% on Dyck-2 and 30.26% on deep AST scope tracking (p = 0.0081); and (5) ablation confirms strict isometry is mathematically necessary for lossless long-range associative memory.

AI.tldr: 本文提出非交换状态空间模型（NC-SSM）及其实正交与Cayley变体，将状态转移提升到紧李群SU(2)、SO(3)、SO(N)，突破对角SSM的交换性瓶颈，在非可解群与流形保持任务上取得显著增益。
AI.motivation: 现有选择性状态空间模型（Mamba、S4D、LRU等）受转移矩阵可交换性（A_t A_t' = A_t' A_t）与可解仿射变换群（Aff_D，导出长度≤2）限制，堆叠多层对角网络在非可解单群（如A_5）上因模拟非阿贝尔交换子所需指数级电路仿真深度而优化严重退化。作者旨在通过引入非交换李群结构打破该表达瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出NC-SSM、SO(3)-SSM及任意维Cayley-SSM，将状态转移提升到紧李群SU(2)、SO(3)、SO(N)；采用闭式Euler-Rodrigues映射与有理Cayley变换实现严格保范等距（||U_t|| = 1）；引入纯Hopf纤维化Bloch投影读出（S^3/{±1} ≅ S^2 ≅ SO(3)）消除符号歧义，设计真四元数并行前缀扫描（T=2048时加速9.06倍），以及Identity-Gated Lie SSM以消除稀疏语法相位漂移。
AI.result: 在14组实验设置中：(1) NC-SSM在S_3、D_4、Q_8及单群A_5上达100%跟踪，而3层深对角基线崩溃至6.60%（p = 8.81e-4）；(2) Cayley-SO(5)-SSM突破Klein 1884年对称群S_5上限（50.92% vs 对角5.25%，p = 0.0015，相较SO(3)方差降低7.8倍）；(3) SO(3)-SSM在300步内保持黎曼流形（漂移< 3.12e-6，优势> 580,000倍），实现0.04度航位推算误差与主动切空间去噪；(4) NC-SSM在Dyck-2达74.36%，深层AST作用域跟踪达30.26%（p = 0.0081）；(5) 消融证实严格等距是无损长程联想记忆的数学必要条件。
AI.conclusion: 将状态转移从可交换对角结构推广到非交换紧李群，可从根本上克服对角SSM在非可解群与流形保持任务上的优化退化；严格等距性质是无损长程联想记忆的必要条件，NC-SSM系列在多类基准上均展现出显著性能优势。

title: Benchmarking System One decision models against trained classifiers and language models for automated decision gates
summary: Software that hands branching decisions to a model needs a declared option and a probability it can threshold. Typed decision models, also called System One models, return such probabilities without generating text, while supervised classifiers and generative language models are the established alternatives. Under matched conditions, one harness sends eight decision-model checkpoints from six families, including the hosted model Jev, and two generative comparators the same semantic requests, and scores supervised and zero-shot classifiers on the same workflow, intent and social-science items. The ranking of the model classes depends on the conditions. With the task's own labels, small trained classifiers are the most accurate on intents and not significantly different from the best decision models on workflows. Without labels, every decision model except the encoder-based checkpoints exceeds a zero-shot entailment classifier on workflows and intents. Read through option-key likelihoods, a larger generative model is level with Jev on workflows and intents and accepts more workflow decisions at five percent risk, and fine-tuned decision checkpoints gain intent accuracy over their untuned backbones. Stored temperatures fitted on few options raise calibration error with many options, and a held-out threshold for five percent in-scope risk still lets Jev accept 0.310 of out-of-scope requests. Swapping yes and no flips 50.5 answers per hundred for Jev, while fine-tuned checkpoints cut their backbones' social-science flips. An intent-trained first stage escalating to Jev matches its accuracy at 0.43 of its cost at full graphics-processor utilization. The results yield condition-dependent design rules for automated decision gates.

AI.tldr: 在统一测试条件下比较类型化决策模型（System One）、监督分类器与生成式语言模型的决策门控表现，发现模型类别的优劣取决于是否有标签，并给出条件相关的设计规则。
AI.motivation: 软件若将分支决策交给模型，需要一个可声明的选项及其可阈值化概率。类型化决策模型（System One）能不生成文本直接输出概率，而监督分类器与生成式语言模型是既有替代方案，但缺乏在匹配条件下的系统比较。
AI.method: 用同一套测试装置向六个家族的八个决策模型检查点（含托管模型 Jev）和两个生成式对比模型发送相同语义请求，并在相同的工作流、意图与社会科学条目上评测监督分类器和零样本分类器；同时分析选项键似然、温度校准、风险阈值与是/否选项交换等设置的影响。
AI.result: 有任务自身标签时，小型已训练分类器在意图上最准，在工作流上与最佳决策模型无显著差异；无标签时，除编码器类检查点外，所有决策模型在工作流和意图上均超过零样本蕴含分类器。通过选项键似然读取，较大的生成模型在工作流和意图上与 Jev 持平，并在5%风险下接受更多工作流决策；微调后的决策检查点相较未微调骨干在意图准确率上提升。在少量选项上拟合的存储温度在选项增多时反而提高校准误差；5%范围内风险的留出阈值仍使 Jev 接受0.310的越界请求。交换是/否选项使 Jev 每百个答案翻转50.5个，而微调检查点减少了其骨干的社会科学翻转。意图训练的第一阶段升级到 Jev，在满GPU利用率下以0.43的成本达到其准确率。
AI.conclusion: 结果为自动化决策门控提供了依赖条件的设计规则：有标签时优先小模型分类器，无标签时决策模型整体占优，且校准与阈值需随选项数量和风险目标重新拟合。

title: A First Glance at Jev for Network Traffic Classification: Accuracy, Processing Time, and Cost
summary: We evaluate Jev on ten dataset-defined application labels in CESNET-QUICEXT-25 using only the first ten packets' sizes, directions, and inter-packet times. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first empirical study of general-purpose decision models, represented here by Jev, for application classification of network flows. Across 52,000 records from 26 collection weeks following the training period, 40 fixed labeled examples raise Jev's accuracy from 9.80% to 28.42%. Random Forest and Extra Trees trained on 8,000 records achieve 69.95% and 66.80% and outperform Jev in every week. Increasing Jev's context to 150 examples yields 34.50% on the first test week. On a paired 100-record subset, Jev with 40 examples achieves 29% accuracy at a median request time of 0.750 s, versus 37% and 6.036 s for the generative language model OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol with high reasoning effort through Azure; Jev also incurs lower API charges. The paired subset does not establish an accuracy advantage for either service, and the timing reflects different service configurations. Thus, labeled examples substantially improve Jev, but the tested Jev configurations remain less accurate than trained tree ensembles; unequal supervision budgets and fixed configurations prevent attributing the gap to a single cause.

AI.tldr: 该文首次实证评估通用决策模型Jev在网络流应用分类上的表现：少量标注示例可显著提升准确率，但仍不及传统树集成模型，且比较受监督预算与配置差异限制。
AI.motivation: 探索通用决策模型（以Jev为代表）能否用于网络流量应用分类，并与训练式树集成模型及生成式语言模型进行对比。
AI.method: 在CESNET-QUICEXT-25数据集上，仅用前10个数据包的大小、方向与包间时间，针对10个数据集定义的应用标签，用26个采集周、52,000条记录评估Jev；对比随机森林与Extra Trees（8,000条记录训练），并与OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol（高推理强度，经Azure）在100条配对子集上比较准确率、请求时延与API费用。
AI.result: 40个固定标注示例使Jev准确率由9.80%升至28.42%；随机森林与Extra Trees分别为69.95%和66.80%，且在每一周均优于Jev；Jev将上下文增至150示例时首个测试周达34.50%。100条配对子集上，Jev（40示例）准确率29%、中位请求时间0.750 s，GPT-5.6 Sol为37%与6.036 s，Jev API费用更低；该子集未显示任一服务的准确率优势。
AI.conclusion: 标注示例能大幅提升Jev，但所测Jev配置仍不及训练式树集成模型；由于监督预算不等且配置固定，无法将差距归因于单一原因。

title: OmniMed-Jev: Calibrating LVLM Confidence for Trustworthy Medical Multimodal Decisions via System One
comment: We introduce OmniMed-Jev, a decision-native interface based on Jev that outputs Choice, Noul or Score decisions with calibrated probabilities
summary: Medical models are judged not only on correctness, but on whether reported confidence matches actual accuracy. Generalist multimodal medical models have expanded what a single model can perceive, yet they still express bounded decisions such as diagnoses, findings or cell counts as generated text, so the reported probability reflects the next token rather than the decision itself. Motivated by decision-native interfaces such as Jev, we introduce OmniMed-Jev, which represents each medical decision as a Choice, Noul or Score decision over a runtime-supplied candidate set and returns a full distribution over that set: mutually exclusive classes, binary presence of a finding, or a bounded ordered value. The design is omni in three respects: it accepts diverse imaging modalities, covers different prediction tasks, and expresses them through one candidate-conditioned probability model, so heterogeneous outputs become comparable probabilities rather than task-specific strings. In an interface-controlled comparison against a generative baseline trained on the same backbone, data and schedule, OmniMed-Jev's reported probabilities track observed correctness far more closely, reducing calibration error by up to an order of magnitude and reliability error by up to two, while point-prediction performance remains comparable; counting is the one family where the generative baseline stays ahead. Making the decision distribution the model's output is not a format change but what turns reported numbers into probabilities that mean what they say. These results support explicit decision modeling as a way to make reported confidence meaningful within the evaluated tasks, and they are not evidence of clinical readiness: the comparison cannot separate the interface from associated training differences, which we state alongside the results. Code is available at github.com/lytang63/OmniMed-Jev.

AI.tldr: 提出 OmniMed-Jev，将医学决策建模为对运行时候选集的 Choice/Noul/Score 决策并输出完整概率分布，使报告置信度与真实准确率更匹配。
AI.motivation: 通用多模态医学模型虽扩展了感知能力，但把诊断、发现、细胞计数等有界决策表达为生成文本，导致报告的概率反映的是下一个 token 而非决策本身，置信度与准确率脱节。
AI.method: 受 Jev 等决策原生接口启发，将每个医学决策表示为运行时候选集上的 Choice、Noul 或 Score 决策，返回该集合上的完整分布（互斥类别、发现的二元存在性、有界有序值）。设计在三个方面"omni"：接受多种成像模态、覆盖不同预测任务、通过统一的候选条件概率模型表达，使异构输出变为可比较的概率。
AI.result: 在与相同骨干、数据和训练计划的生成式基线的界面受控对比中，OmniMed-Jev 的报告概率更贴近观测正确率，校准误差最多降低一个数量级，可靠性误差最多降低两倍，而点预测性能相当；计数是生成式基线仍占优的唯一一类任务。
AI.conclusion: 将决策分布作为模型输出不仅是格式变化，而是让报告数字成为名副其实的概率；结果支持显式决策建模可使报告置信度在所评估任务中有意义，但不构成临床就绪的证据，因为对比无法分离接口与相关训练差异。

title: EvoGen-Harness: Learning Where and How to Evolve Image-Generation Harnesses
summary: Modern text-to-image (T2I) systems can be improved without modifying generator parameters by adapting the external system around frozen generators. However, existing approaches typically optimize a predefined dimension, such as prompts, routing, or workflows, restricting the space in which generation failures can be corrected. Allowing multiple generator-external responsibilities to evolve provides a broader adaptation space, but introduces a new challenge: visual feedback reveals what failed, but not where persistent evolution should occur or how this space should be explored efficiently. We introduce EvoGen-Harness, a generator-agnostic framework for multi-responsibility image-generation harness evolution, together with Trace (Trajectory-Relative Attribution and Coordinated Evolution). Trace aggregates evidence across stochastic executions, uses failure attribution as a search prior to focus candidate updates, and progressively re-attributes residual failures to coordinate evolution across responsibilities, while No-Patch and held-out validation prevent unnecessary or harmful updates. Across GenEval2, T2I-CompBench++, and WISE, EvoGen-Harness improves over the strongest evaluated baselines by +0.2633, +0.0720, and +0.0752, respectively, while achieving 87.9-91.4% attribution recall, 94.8% No-Patch accuracy, and only 1.9% regression. These results demonstrate that attribution-guided multi-responsibility evolution can substantially enhance frozen T2I systems beyond single-dimension adaptation.

AI.tldr: 提出 EvoGen-Harness 框架与 Trace 方法，在冻结生成器外部实现多职责协同进化，显著超越单维度适配基线。
AI.motivation: 现有冻结生成器的外部适配方法通常只优化单一预设维度（如提示、路由或工作流），限制了失败修正的搜索空间；而引入多职责协同演化虽能扩大适配空间，却带来新的难题：视觉反馈只能揭示"失败是什么"，无法说明"演化应发生在何处"以及"如何高效探索该空间"。
AI.method: 提出与生成器无关的多职责图像生成 harness 演化框架 EvoGen-Harness，以及 Trace（Trajectory-Relative Attribution and Coordinated Evolution）。Trace 聚合多次随机执行中的证据，以失败归因作为搜索先验来聚焦候选更新，并逐步将残余失败重新归因，以协调各职责间的演化；同时用 No-Patch 机制与留出验证避免无必要或有害的更新。
AI.result: 在 GenEval2、T2I-CompBench++ 与 WISE 上，EvoGen-Harness 相较最强评估基线分别提升 +0.2633、+0.0720、+0.0752；归因召回率达 87.9–91.4%，No-Patch 准确率 94.8%，回归率仅 1.9%。
AI.conclusion: 归因引导的多职责协同演化能显著提升冻结 T2I 系统，效果超过单维度适配，验证了扩大外部职责演化空间的可行性与有效性。

title: Specificity-Aware Diffusion Steering via Variance-Reduced Sequential Monte Carlo
summary: Inference-time steering enables pretrained diffusion models to satisfy new constraints without full retraining. However, specificity-aware generation is difficult: repelling samples from a negative reference distribution can also erode the positive distribution where the two overlap. The key challenge is to suppress negative mass while minimally distorting the positive distribution. We address this problem by formulating specificity-aware steering as a target-design problem and deriving a target distribution from an overlap-based objective. The resulting target keeps the desired reference distribution only in regions where it is sufficiently preferred over the undesired reference distribution, giving a likelihood-ratio interpretation of specificity. To sample from the corresponding time-dependent target path, we develop a Sequential Monte Carlo sampler with a variance-minimized local proposal. We further introduce a practical fixed-noise optimization procedure with the Jacobian--vector products with the desired and undesired score fields. Experiments on synthetic task, class-contrastive generation, text-to-image tasks and peptide-MHC (p-MHC) binder show that the proposed method suppresses undesired regions more effectively, reduces mode shift, and improves sampling stability by decreasing the SMC weight collapse compared with negative-guidance baselines. Code is available at: https://github.com/WangLuran/Specificity-Aware-Diffusion-Steering

AI.tldr: 该论文将特异性感知的推理时引导建模为目标分布设计问题，基于重叠度目标推导出具有似然比解释的目标分布，并提出方差最小化局部提议的序贯蒙特卡洛采样器及固定噪声优化方法，在多个任务上有效抑制负样本并减少模式偏移。
AI.motivation: 推理时引导（inference-time steering）可让预训练扩散模型无需重训练即满足新约束，但特异性感知生成存在困难：从负参考分布排斥样本时，会在正负分布重叠区域侵蚀正分布。核心挑战是在抑制负质量（negative mass）的同时尽量不扭曲正分布。
AI.method: 1. 将特异性感知引导形式化为目标设计问题，基于重叠度目标推导目标分布，仅在正参考分布相对负分布充分占优的区域保留其偏好，从而给出特异性的似然比解释。2. 为从相应的时间相关目标路径采样，提出带有方差最小化局部提议的序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）采样器。3. 引入实用的固定噪声优化过程，利用期望与不期望得分场的 Jacobian-向量积（JVP）。
AI.result: 在合成任务、类对比生成、文本到图像任务以及肽-MHC（p-MHC）结合物任务上，与负引导基线相比，所提方法更有效地抑制了不期望区域、减少了模式偏移（mode shift），并通过降低 SMC 权重坍塌（weight collapse）提升了采样稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将特异性感知引导重新表述为目标分布设计，并配合 SMC 采样与固定噪声优化，可在推理阶段实现更精准、稳定的扩散模型负向控制，兼具理论解释性与实用效果。

title: Forking: Sudden Overfitting Under Replay
comment: 42 pages, 22 figures. Code and reproduction materials: https://github.com/guoshaoyang-pku/forking/tree/release
summary: This paper studies forking, a generalization failure discovered in NanoGPT autoresearch. Under data replay, models with an over-encoding n-gram memory branch show a sharp separation of training and validation loss at epoch boundaries, resembling the shape of forks. We study this phenomenon in a controlled vanilla NanoGPT setting and reproduce it in a DeepSeek-style model with Engram. Mechanistically, repeated updates sharpen the continuations observed in training while suppressing the probability of unseen continuations, whose loss grows with each pass. The n-gram module creates weakly interacting context-specific subspaces, amplifying this effect. Low-frequency contexts contribute most of the gap, whereas larger training budgets and heavily crowded tables suppress it. We also observe forking in short-budget, heavily repeated SFT and RL-like regimes. The contributions of this paper are twofold: (1) Forking reveals yet another curious phenomenon in deep learning, in addition to grokking and double descent. (2) Forking is an unexpected and unpleasant by-product of tricks proposed by autoresearch agents. While these agents produce an enormous number of results that seem useful, we should always be careful with their results.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究NanoGPT自动科研中发现的泛化失败现象"forking"：在数据重放与过度编码的n-gram记忆分支下，训练/验证损失在epoch边界出现急剧分离（形似叉子），并在带Engram的DeepSeek式模型中复现。机理是重复更新锐化训练中出现的续写、压低未见续写概率，n-gram模块的弱交互上下文子空间放大该效应；低频上下文贡献主要差距，更大训练预算与高拥挤表可抑制。该现象在短预算、高重复的SFT与类RL场景中也出现。
AI.motivation: 动机是解释在NanoGPT自动科研（autoresearch）中观察到的一种新的泛化失败：当使用数据重放且模型带有过度编码的n-gram记忆分支时，训练损失与验证损失在epoch边界出现急剧分离（形如"fork"）。作者希望将其从偶发现象提升为可控可复现的研究对象，检验其是否普遍存在，并揭示其机制与影响条件，从而提醒研究者审慎对待自动科研代理产生的大量"看似有用"的结果。
AI.method: 在受控的vanilla NanoGPT设置下复现forking，并在带Engram的DeepSeek式模型中验证其可迁移性；结合数据重放、过编码n-gram记忆分支等变量进行消融，分析损失曲线在epoch边界的分离行为。机理层面考察重复更新对训练中出现的续写概率的锐化作用及对未见续写概率的抑制，分析n-gram模块形成的弱交互上下文特定子空间如何放大该效应。进一步按上下文频率分层，检验低频上下文、训练预算大小与哈希表拥挤度对差距的影响，并在短预算、高重复的SFT与类RL训练范式中检验该现象。
AI.result: 成功在受控vanilla NanoGPT中复现forking，并在带Engram的DeepSeek式模型中重现。机制上，重复更新锐化了训练中观察到的续写、抑制未见续写，其损失随每轮遍历增大；n-gram模块产生的弱交互上下文特定子空间起放大作用。低频上下文贡献了绝大部分损失差距；更大的训练预算和高度拥挤的哈希表可抑制forking。该现象亦出现于短预算、高度重复的SFT与类RL训练情境。
AI.conclusion: forking是继grokking与double descent之后深度学习中的又一奇特现象，同时是自动科研代理所提技巧带来的意外且不利的副产物。作者强调，尽管自动科研代理能产出大量看似有用的结果，研究者仍须对其结果保持审慎验证。

title: Metacognitive Reasoning in Energy Based Models using Instance Based Learning Theory
summary: Metacognition involves reasoning about cognitive processes themselves. An example is in resource allocation where we choose how much time and effort to put into a reasoning task before we begin based on our confidence. Current Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems that rely on Large Language Models (LLMs) cannot estimate their uncertainty about an output without first responding, and cannot dynamically allocate resources to producing an output, making this type of metacognitive process difficult. A recently proposed alternative to classic transformer architectures that addresses these two concerns is the Energy Based Model (EBM) which allows for interpretable uncertainty modeling and dynamic allocation of compute resources. While EBMs can allow for control of these two processes, the actual metacognitive task of determining compute allocation based on uncertainty is not directly addressed. Instance-Based Learning Theory (IBLT) provides an approach to modeling human-like decisions from experience that has previously been applied to predicting human metacognitive reasoning. In this paper we introduce a framework for MEtacognitive Reasoning with Instance-based Learning Theory and Energy Dynamics (MERITED). Grounded in IBLT, this framework allows for control of the computational effort allocated in an EBM to allow for metacognitive control over reasoning effort based on uncertainty while remaining computationally efficient. This work has two main contributions, the training and open weight sharing of a 191M parameter reasoning EBM, and an implementation of the MERITED framework for dynamic compute allocation using an IBL model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MERITED框架，将基于实例的学习理论（IBLT）与能量模型（EBM）结合，实现基于不确定性的元认知推理计算资源动态分配，并开源了一个191M参数推理EBM。
AI.motivation: 现有基于大语言模型（LLM）的AI系统无法在响应前估计不确定性，也无法动态分配计算资源，难以实现人类式的元认知过程。EBM虽能提供可解释的不确定性建模与动态算力分配，但如何基于不确定性决定算力分配这一元认知任务尚未被直接解决。
AI.method: 以IBLT（Instance-Based Learning Theory，基于实例的学习理论）为基础，提出MERITED框架（MEtacognitive Reasoning with Instance-based Learning Theory and Energy Dynamics），在EBM中控制计算投入量，依据不确定性实现推理努力的元认知控制，同时保持计算效率。
AI.result: 主要贡献有两项：训练并开放权重共享一个191M参数的推理EBM；实现MERITED框架，通过IBL模型实现动态计算分配。
AI.conclusion: MERITED将IBLT与EBM能量动态结合，使模型在响应前即可基于不确定性进行元认知算力控制，为LLM之外的推理架构提供了可解释且高效的替代路径。

title: NEUROTOKEN: Joint Source and Directional AAD with Envelope Decoding via Conditional Flow Matching
summary: Identifying which speaker a listener is attending to in a noisy room -- the cocktail-party problem -- is the missing ingredient for next-generation hearing aids and brain-computer interfaces: it tells the device whose voice to amplify. Auditory attention decoding (AAD) reads this answer from EEG, but the literature splits into disconnected pieces: directional-AAD classifies side but does not map side to stream; regression-based source-AAD ranks candidate streams by a single Pearson correlation that is intrinsically noisy at the 1-5 s windows real devices need; and envelope reconstruction has no native AAD rule. We argue the right object is not any single statistic but the conditional likelihood of the attended envelope given EEG, and we make this practical with NEUROTOKEN: a single network whose three heads share one EEG front-end, with a conditional flow-matching head (ATTUNEFLOW) that scores candidates by an integrated velocity-residual likelihood ratio. Two inference-time ensembles -- QUADTRACK (four complementary statistics) and ENV-FLOW (z-normalised QUADTRACK+ATTUNEFLOW) -- absorb per-statistic failure modes for free. On KU Leuven, DTU, and NJU at 5 s, ATTUNEFLOW lifts per-segment source-AAD by 9%-16% over the strongest non-generative baseline and shrinks across-subject variance by ~3x; trial-level fusion exceeds 93% on two of three datasets. In parallel reproductions we show that canonical 95-97% direction-AAD numbers collapse by 17%-45% under a strict trial-disjoint protocol, clarifying both the true ceiling and why a likelihood-based formulation is needed.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出NEUROTOKEN，将听觉注意解码（AAD）重新表述为"给定EEG下被注意包络的条件似然"问题，并用条件流匹配头ATTUNEFLOW及两个推理期集成（QUADTRACK、ENV-FLOW）实现。在KU Leuven、DTU、NJU三个数据集5 s窗口下，ATTUNEFLOW使逐段source-AAD较最强非生成基线提升9%-16%，跨被试方差缩小约3倍，两个数据集试次级融合准确率超93%；同时指出严格试次不相交协议下传统方向AAD准确率会下降17%-45%。
AI.motivation: 鸡尾酒会问题（识别听者关注的对象）是下一代助听器与脑机接口的关键，AAD可从EEG中读出被注意声源。但现有文献割裂为三块：方向AAD只分类侧向而不映射到具体声流；回归式source-AAD依赖单一Pearson相关，在设备所需的1-5 s窗口下噪声大；包络重建缺乏原生AAD规则。作者认为正确对象不是单一统计量，而是给定EEG下被注意包络的条件似然。
AI.method: 提出NEUROTOKEN：单一网络，三个头共享一个EEG前端，其中条件流匹配头ATTUNEFLOW通过积分速度残差似然比对候选流进行打分。推理期使用两个集成：QUADTRACK（四种互补统计量）与ENV-FLOW（z归一化的QUADTRACK+ATTUNEFLOW），免费吸收单统计量的失效模式。同时在严格试次不相交协议下对传统方向AAD进行复现分析。
AI.result: 在KU Leuven、DTU、NJU数据集5 s窗口下，ATTUNEFLOW使逐段source-AAD较最强非生成基线提升9%-16%，跨被试方差缩小约3倍；试次级融合在两个数据集上准确率超过93%。复现实验表明，在严格试次不相交协议下，传统95%-97%的方向AAD准确率会下降17%-45%。
AI.conclusion: 基于似然的AAD建模（条件似然+流匹配打分）在真实设备所需短窗口下显著优于既有统计量方法，并更稳定、跨被试方差更小；同时揭示了传统方向AAD因协议宽松而高估真实上限，说明采用似然式表述的必要性。

title: WIPSNet: Deep Learning for Paediatric Wheeze Detection from Overnight Impedance Pneumography
comment: Accepted at the Workshop on Structured Data for Health, ICML 2026. Code: https://github.com/felix-oury/WIPSNet
summary: Overnight impedance pneumography (IP) is used to monitor paediatric respiratory health. Its current clinical readout, the Expiratory Variability Index (EVI), compresses each IP recording into a single scalar and achieves an AUC of 0.633 for night-level wheeze classification. We introduce Wheeze Impedance Pneumography Scalogram Network (WIPSNet), a 3D ResNet operating on stacked continuous wavelet transform scalograms of overnight IP signals. On a 15-patient cohort (60 nights, 281 hours), WIPSNet achieves an AUC of $0.783 \pm 0.026$, outperforming EVI, a state-space model (Mamba), and two modern sleep-staging architectures. Performance peaks at a volumetric depth corresponding to 32 minutes of temporal context, suggesting that multi-scale temporal aggregation is important for modelling nocturnal respiratory dynamics. Overall, these results indicate that structured time-frequency representations combined with 3D convolutional architectures provide an effective approach for learning from long, irregular physiological time series.

AI.tldr: 提出WIPSNet，用3D ResNet处理夜间阻抗肺图（IP）的连续小波变换尺度图，实现夜间喘息分类，AUC由EVI的0.633提升至0.783±0.026。
AI.motivation: 现有临床指标EVI将整段IP记录压缩为单一标量，仅达AUC 0.633，信息损失大，难以刻画夜间呼吸动态；需要能处理长时、不规则生理时序并保留时频结构的方法。
AI.method: 构建WIPSNet：对夜间IP信号做连续小波变换（CWT）得到尺度图，堆叠后用3D ResNet进行体卷积学习；在15名患者、60个夜晚、281小时的队列上与EVI、状态空间模型Mamba及两种现代睡眠分期架构对比。
AI.result: WIPSNet取得AUC 0.783±0.026，优于EVI、Mamba及两种睡眠分期架构；性能在对应32分钟时间上下文的体深度处达到峰值。
AI.conclusion: 结构化时频表示结合3D卷积架构，可有效学习长时、不规则生理时序，多尺度时间聚合对建模夜间呼吸动态至关重要。

title: The Conflict Between Logic and Memory: Learning Higher-Order Interactions in Shallow MLPs
summary: A network can fit its training examples while failing to recover the rule that generated their labels. We examine this separation in single-hidden-layer multilayer perceptrons (MLPs), using synthetic tasks that control interaction order and the presence of nuisance inputs. We establish elementary benchmark properties: pure parity contains no predictive lower-order marginals, admits an exact Bayes posterior, and can be represented on clean latent inputs by a width-$k$ ReLU network. Experiments then identify distinct optimization outcomes. In a matched order-2--4 sweep, SGD, Adam, and Muon all reach 100\% peak test accuracy at order two; at order three they reach 96.25\%, 50.87\%, and 76.82\%, respectively, while Muon reaches 99.21\% at order four. In a separate mixed-order task, freezing only the first-layer weights connected to independent nuisance inputs raises AdamW's epoch-10 accuracy from 44.73\% to 95.07\%. Removing the same inputs only at test time raises it to 48.38\%. Thus, nuisance-weight learning changes the training outcome beyond its immediate effect on prediction. Bias interventions expose a connection between target symmetry and shallow ReLU representations. In a compact signal-only regime, both SGD and Muon learn orders five through eight, with higher SGD peak accuracy at orders nine through eleven. Together, the results show how optimization and nuisance learning constrain the higher-order rules realized by a shallow network.

AI.tldr: 本文以合成任务研究单隐层MLP中"拟合训练样本"与"恢复标签生成规则"之间的分离，考察交互阶数、冗余输入及优化器对高阶规则学习的影响。
AI.motivation: 网络可以完美拟合训练样本却无法恢复生成标签的真实规则，这一泛化/规则恢复的分离现象在浅层网络中尚缺乏系统的基准刻画，作者希望厘清优化过程与冗余特征学习如何限制浅层ReLU网络所能实现的高阶规则。
AI.method: 构建控制交互阶数与冗余输入存在的合成任务：纯奇偶（parity）任务无低阶预测边际、存在精确贝叶斯后验、可在干净隐变量上用宽度k的ReLU网络表示。开展序2–4的匹配扫描比较SGD、Adam、Muon；设计混合阶任务，对连接到独立冗余输入的仅第一层权重进行冻结；在测试时移除冗余输入；并做偏置干预，分析目标对称性与浅层ReLU表示的关系；在纯信号紧致设定下测试5–8阶与9–11阶。
AI.result: 匹配序2–4扫描中，序2时SGD、Adam、Muon均达100%峰值测试准确率；序3分别为96.25%、50.87%、76.82%；序4时Muon达99.21%。混合阶任务中，仅冻结连接到独立冗余输入的第一层权重可将AdamW第10轮准确率从44.73%提升至95.07%；仅在测试时移除相同输入仅提升至48.38%。纯信号紧致设定下，SGD与Muon都能学到5–8阶，SGD在9–11阶峰值准确率更高。
AI.conclusion: 优化器选择与冗余权重学习共同决定浅层ReLU网络实际实现的高阶规则；冗余权重的学习对训练结果的影响超出其对预测的即时作用，目标对称性与浅层ReLU表示之间存在联系。

title: EchoPress: Query-Agnostic KV Cache Pruning via Virtual Context Reconstruction
summary: KV cache pruning reduces long-context inference memory usage by evicting less important key-value pairs. KVzip estimates importance through context reconstruction: prompting a model to repeat the context chunk by chunk. This achieves strong compression quality at the cost of additional forward passes. Learned approximations reduce this cost but require model-specific training. We analyze how KVzip identifies important cached information and show how to approximate its reconstruction scores using information already computed during prefill. These findings motivate EchoPress, a training-free method that approximates reconstruction attention using queries and keys from standard prefill. For each request, it reconstructs only the first chunk to calibrate importance scores for the remaining context. Experiments on LongBench and RULER with Qwen3-8B and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct show that EchoPress matches KVzip in task accuracy across eviction ratios from 50% to 90%, while reducing compression overhead by a factor of 1.7-19.6 and total prefill time by a factor of up to 2.9. Code is available at https://github.com/ljwljwljwljw/kvpress/tree/echo-press.

AI.tldr: EchoPress：免训练KV缓存剪枝方法，利用prefill阶段的query/key近似KVzip的重建注意力分数，仅重建首个chunk以校准重要性，在保持精度的同时大幅降低压缩开销。
AI.motivation: 长上下文推理的KV缓存内存占用大，剪枝可缓解。KVzip通过逐chunk重建上下文的额外前向传播来估计重要性，压缩质量好但开销高；已有的学习式近似方法需要针对特定模型训练，泛化性差。本文旨在免训练地降低这种重建开销。
AI.method: 作者分析了KVzip如何识别重要缓存信息，发现其重建分数可用prefill阶段已计算的query和key来近似。基于此提出EchoPress：对每个请求仅重建第一个chunk，用于校准剩余上下文的重要性分数，从而免训练地近似重建注意力。
AI.result: 在LongBench和RULER上，使用Qwen3-8B与Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct，EchoPress在50%–90%的淘汰率下任务精度与KVzip相当，同时将压缩开销降低1.7–19.6倍，总prefill时间最多缩短2.9倍。
AI.conclusion: 重建注意力可由prefill已有信息有效近似，且仅校准首个chunk即可推广至整个上下文。EchoPress在无需训练的前提下实现了与KVzip相当的精度并显著降低开销。

title: Do Better Scores Mean Better Physics? Physics-Grounded Explanations for Sim2Real Neural Operators
comment: 10 pages, 6 figures. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 XAI4Science Workshop, Tiny Paper Track
summary: Machine-learning surrogates accelerate physical simulation, but lower prediction error need not coincide with lower error in physically relevant flow statistics. We examine this question for flow around a NACA4418 airfoil using paired computational-fluid-dynamics simulations and experimental particle-image-velocimetry measurements. A mean-preserving input intervention removes velocity fluctuations from selected regions of observed flow histories. Across four neural operators, removing fluctuations from the most energetic 10% of valid observed cells changes forecasts more than equal-area random removal. Because the masks are not matched for removed fluctuation energy, this contrast measures sensitivity, not independent evidence of physical importance. Separately, a CNO has lower velocity-field error but substantially higher two-component fluctuation-energy error than the reference on both analysis subsets. An output attenuation stress test also demonstrates disagreement between benchmark errors and domain-summed fluctuation energy. These single-benchmark results motivate reporting complementary physical diagnostics alongside aggregate prediction scores; they do not establish counterfactual physical correctness.

AI.tldr: 本文以NACA4418翼型绕流为对象，检验神经算子预报中"低速度场误差"是否等同于"低物理流动统计误差"，发现二者并不一致，主张在聚合预测评分之外补充物理诊断指标。
AI.motivation: 机器学习代理模型虽能加速物理仿真，但更低的预测误差未必对应物理相关流动统计量的更低误差；作者希望检验基准误差与物理统计误差之间的一致性。
AI.method: 结合配对的CFD仿真与实验PIV测量；采用均值保持的输入干预（从观测流场历史中选定区域移除速度脉动），在四种神经算子上对比"能量最高的10%有效观测单元"移除与等面积随机移除；并开展输出衰减压力测试。
AI.result: 移除能量最高10%单元的脉动对预报的改变大于等面积随机移除；但由于掩膜未按去除脉动能量匹配，该对比仅度量敏感性而非物理重要性的独立证据。此外，CNO速度场误差更低，但在两个分析子集上其双分量脉动能量误差显著高于参考模型；输出衰减压力测试同样显示基准误差与域求和脉动能量之间存在分歧。
AI.conclusion: 单一基准结果支持在聚合预测分数之外报告互补的物理诊断指标，但这些结果不足以确立反事实的物理正确性。

title: Source Identification Is Not Fitness Testing: Measuring the Limits of Synthetic-Data Attribution
summary: Repeated training on model-generated data can degrade later models. One possible response is to use provenance when deciding which generated examples to reuse. We test both how reliably that provenance can be recovered and whether it helps identify better training data. Using financial-risk text, we first identify the source of generated passages and then repeat the test after rewriting them. Generator attribution is 98.7% accurate on the original passages but falls to 53.1% after paraphrasing and 29.0% after style rewriting. Generated-versus-human detection remains close to perfect against the tested human comparison set. We then compare two ways of selecting generated examples over three rounds of generation and retraining. One uses source information. The other uses a score from a separate reference model. The two rules select different examples, but the planned comparison does not detect a stable difference in the degradation of the resulting models. The results show that identifying where data came from and identifying which data are useful for training are separate problems. The experiment therefore separates source identity, criterion-facing selection, and recursive training outcome: neither the provenance score nor the tested criterion-facing proxy is established as sufficient for future recursive behaviour.

AI.tldr: 本文以金融风险文本为对象，检验模型生成数据"来源可恢复性"与"来源信息能否用于筛选更好训练数据"两个问题。结果显示来源归因在改写后大幅下降，而基于来源的选择规则未带来稳定的递归训练改善，表明来源识别与数据有用性识别是两个独立问题。
AI.motivation: 对模型生成数据反复训练会导致后续模型退化。一种可能的应对策略是利用数据来源（provenance）来决定哪些生成样本值得复用。但这一策略成立需满足两个前提：来源信息可被可靠恢复，且来源信息有助于识别更优的训练数据。论文即针对这两点进行检验。
AI.method: 以金融风险文本为素材，先识别生成段落的来源模型，再在改写后重复测试（包括复述与风格改写），考察生成器归因与生成/人类文本检测的准确率变化。随后在生成—重训的三轮循环中，比较两种生成样本筛选方式：一种使用来源信息，另一种使用独立参考模型给出的评分，比较二者所选样本及所得模型的退化情况。
AI.result: 生成器归因在原始段落上准确率为98.7%，复述后降至53.1%，风格改写后进一步降至29.0%；而生成文本与人类文本的检测在所用人类对照集上仍近乎完美。两种筛选规则选出的样本不同，但预设比较未检测到所得模型退化程度存在稳定差异。
AI.conclusion: 识别数据来源与识别哪些数据对训练有用是两个彼此分离的问题。实验将来源身份、面向准则的选择与递归训练结果三者区分开来：无论是来源评分还是所测试的面向准则的代理指标，均未被证明足以预测未来的递归行为。

title: CommunityKV: Efficient Long-Context Decoding via Graph Partitioning
summary: Scaling Transformers to long contexts is constrained by the quadratic cost of self-attention and the linear growth of key-value cache memory transfer. Sparse attention mitigates this by retrieving only relevant tokens, but current approaches either require large-scale training or, within the training-free regime, rely on semantically coarse heuristics or expensive clustering that is difficult to update efficiently during decoding. We introduce CommunityKV, a framework that formulates sparse attention as a community detection problem. CommunityKV constructs a token graph from the $QK^T$ scores already computed during standard prefill, and partitions the graph into communities to enable retrieval of semantically coherent token groups. A local update rule assigns newly generated tokens to communities in constant time, enabling sparse retrieval throughout streaming decoding without global re-partitioning. We evaluate CommunityKV on Qwen3 and Llama-3.1 models across three long-context benchmarks. With one graph per query head, CommunityKV delivers up to $1.25\times$ the end-to-end generation throughput of dense attention, while query-group graph aggregation yields up to $1.71\times$ with comparable accuracy.

AI.tldr: CommunityKV将稀疏注意力建模为社区检测问题：利用预填充阶段已计算的QK^T构建token图并划分社区以实现语义连贯的token组检索，且支持常数时间的局部更新以适配流式解码。
AI.motivation: Transformer长上下文受限于自注意力的二次开销与KV缓存线性增长的显存传输。现有稀疏注意力方案要么需要大规模训练，要么在免训练范式下依赖语义粗糙的启发式或难以在解码中高效更新的昂贵聚类。
AI.method: 从预填充阶段已计算的QK^T分数构建token图，将其划分为社区以获得语义连贯的token组用于稀疏检索；引入局部更新规则，在常数时间内将新生成token分配到社区，避免全局重划分，从而在流式解码中持续进行稀疏检索。评估涵盖Qwen3与Llama-3.1模型及三个长上下文基准，并比较单query head建图与query-group图聚合两种配置。
AI.result: 在Qwen3和Llama-3.1上，每query head一张图时端到端生成吞吐最高为稠密注意力的1.25倍；采用query-group图聚合时吞吐最高达1.71倍，且精度相当。
AI.conclusion: 免训练社区检测式稀疏注意力可在保持精度的同时显著提升长上下文生成吞吐，且局部更新机制使稀疏检索可无缝用于流式解码。

title: Every Batch Is Its Own Validation Set: Leave-One-Out Gradient Matching for Online Data Selection in LLM Fine-Tuning
summary: Online batch selection fine-tunes a language model on the most useful part of each candidate batch. Selectors that match the gradient of the candidate batch are attractive because they need no held-out data, yet they rarely beat training on the whole batch. We show why. In-sample gradient matching uses every example as part of its own target, so its objective credits each example with its own gradient noise. This is the covariance penalty that makes training error optimistic, now sitting on the diagonal of the gradient Gram matrix: it steers selection toward the noisiest examples and makes the full batch the best solution the objective can reach. The fix costs nothing. For each example, the other candidates form an independent sample of the data distribution, so removing the diagonal turns the matching objective into an unbiased estimate of the update's error with respect to the population gradient. The minimizer of this leave-one-out objective weights examples by their gradient signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), and whenever per-example SNR is heterogeneous enough, half of a batch yields a lower-error update than the whole batch; we give the exact condition. We build \method{} on this principle. It computes the Gram matrix in the metric of the Adam preconditioner during the ordinary backward pass, selects a weighted subset greedily with a $(1-e^{-γ})$ guarantee, and uses no held-out data. Across four fine-tuning tasks and seven backbones from 1.5B to 8B parameters, LOOM improves on full-batch training by 2.3 and 2.4 points on Llama-3.1-8B and Qwen2.5-7B, exceeds every in-sample gradient matcher by 2.4 points and the validation-guided GREATS and OPUS by 1.6--2.0, and selects injected label noise at under a fifth of its base rate.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了在线批次选择中样本内梯度匹配为何难以超越全批次训练，并提出留一法（leave-one-out）目标消除协方差惩罚项，构建LOOM方法按梯度信噪比加权选样，在多项微调任务上显著优于全批次训练及现有方法。
AI.motivation: 在线批次选择旨在从候选批次中挑选最有用的样本微调语言模型。基于梯度匹配的选择器无需留出数据，颇具吸引力，但实践中很少能击败全批次训练。作者希望解释这一现象的根本原因，并给出无额外成本的解决方案。
AI.method: 作者从理论上指出，样本内梯度匹配把每个样本同时当作自身的目标，导致目标函数将样本自身的梯度噪声计入其贡献，这一协方差惩罚项位于梯度Gram矩阵的对角线上，使选择偏向噪声最大的样本，并使全批次成为该目标的最优解。修正方法：由于其他候选样本构成对数据分布的独立采样，去掉对角线后匹配目标即成为相对于总体梯度的无偏误差估计。据此提出LOOM：在常规反向传播中以Adam预条件子的度量计算Gram矩阵，按梯度信噪比（SNR）加权，用贪心策略选取加权子集并获得(1-e^{-γ})保证，无需留出数据。当每样本SNR异质性足够大时，半批样本即可取得比全批更低误差的更新，作者给出精确条件。
AI.result: 在四个微调任务、七个1.5B至8B参数的骨干模型上，LOOM相比全批次训练在Llama-3.1-8B和Qwen2.5-7B上分别提升2.3和2.4个点，超过所有样本内梯度匹配方法2.4个点，超过依赖验证集指导的GREATS和OPUS达1.6–2.0个点，并能以低于其基础率五分之一的水平选出注入的标签噪声。
AI.conclusion: 样本内梯度匹配因协方差惩罚项而受限于全批次解，去除对角线构成的无偏留一目标能按梯度信噪比加权选样，在SNR异质时优于全批次训练。LOOM以零额外数据成本实现了稳定的实证增益，验证了该理论分析的有效性。

title: One pool, many targets: a conservation layer and what archival data can identify
summary: Pairwise guide--transcript scores do not enforce conservation of a finite guide-loaded RISC pool when they are interpreted independently as occupancies. We formulate a differentiable scalar equilibrium layer: one conservation equation with a unique positive root and exact implicit gradients. It yields a redistribution theorem, a qualified high-resource limit, an analysis of the retrieval approximation, and a conditional rank-invariance result: within one construct at one dose, rankings by fractional occupancy cannot distinguish equilibrium from independent scoring. We therefore audit the two experiments that proposition leaves open, dose and cross-context, on archival off-target data. Corrected thermodynamic affinities associate weakly with measured repression in the direction a working predictor requires, but a paired permutation test and a construct-cluster bootstrap do not establish added predictive value from the coupling: what survives their differing permutation-null baselines is \GapNet{}, a descriptive \GapNetOverSE{} of the equilibrium association's cluster standard error. The dose fits are heterogeneous and frequently violate the model-implied exponent constraint, which is superlinear rather than sublinear, so these data do not identify the competition parameter. A saturable compression of the competitor set holds both accuracy targets on held-out guide families but is not faster at the size measured. The contribution is a reusable conservation operator and the experimental information needed to test it. The code for this study is available at https://github.com/shadi97kh/One-Pool-Many-Targets.

AI.tldr: 本文将成对 guide–transcript 评分从"独立占据度"重新解释为有限 RISC 池的竞争性分配，提出可微标量平衡层（守恒方程唯一正根、精确隐式梯度），证明分数占据度排序在单一构建同一剂量下无法区分平衡模型与独立评分，并用归档脱靶数据审计剂量与跨情境两个实验。
AI.motivation: 现有成对 guide–transcript 评分被各自独立地当作占据度使用，这隐含忽略了 RISC 复合物总量有限这一事实；若存在有限的 guide 加载 RISC 池，各靶标会相互竞争，独立评分在原理上不守恒。作者希望明确这一建模缺陷，并提供可检验的替代框架及其实验判别方案。
AI.method: 构建可微的标量平衡层：以单一守恒方程求解唯一正根，并推导精确隐式梯度；在此之上给出重分配定理、有条件的"高资源极限"、检索近似的误差分析，以及条件性秩不变性结论。随后在归档脱靶数据上审计秩不变性未覆盖的两个实验维度——剂量与跨情境。检验手段包括校正热力学亲和力的关联分析、配对置换检验、构建簇自助法（cluster bootstrap），以及带饱和压缩的竞争靶标集合模型；并通过剂量拟合检验模型隐含的指数约束。
AI.result: 校正后的热力学亲和力与实测抑制的关联虽方向正确但较弱，未达到工作预测器的要求；配对置换检验与构建簇自助法均未能确立耦合带来的额外预测价值。不同置换零假设基线比较后，仅 \GapNet（平衡关联的簇标准误描述性 \GapNetOverSE{}）稳健存活。剂量拟合异质性大且常违反模型隐含的（超线性而非次线性）指数约束，因而无法从数据中识别竞争参数；饱和压缩的竞争靶标集合在留出 guide 家族上保持两项精度目标，但在所测规模下并不更快。
AI.conclusion: 本文的主要贡献是可复用的守恒算子以及对检验该算子所需的实验信息（剂量与跨情境扰动）的系统梳理；目前数据尚不足以证实耦合相对独立评分具有增量预测价值，竞争参数亦不可识别。作者据此给出后续实验的判别方向而非断言模型优越性。

title: Score the Update, Not the Token: Descent-Aligned Routing for Combinatorial LoRA Experts
summary: Mixture-of-LoRA-experts methods raise the capacity of low-rank adaptation by routing each token to a few low-rank experts. Nearly all of them tie one input-side factor to one output-side factor per expert, and nearly all of them route by scoring the token: the router picks experts without seeing what any of them would write. We argue that the router should score the update. To first order, adding an expert's update to a layer output lowers the loss by the inner product between that update and the negative loss gradient at the output. This usefulness is quadratic in the token, so a router that is linear in the token sees only the part of it that runs through the token mean, and routers that rank experts by the norm of their own activations never see the output factor. If each expert is split into a reader (down-projection) and a writer (up-projection), the usefulness of every reader--writer pair becomes an inner product in the shared rank-$r$ space, and all $N_AN_B$ pairs can be scored from $N_A+N_B$ vectors. We build VANE on this identity. A low-rank compass predicts the descent direction of each token. VANE scores every pair by the alignment between its update and the compass without forming any update, activates the top-$k$ pairs with additive gates, and gives every pair its exact first-order router gradient. On single-domain commonsense reasoning and a four-domain multi-task mixture with Llama-3.2-3B and Llama-3.1-8B, VANE attains the best average among twelve PEFT and MoE-LoRA baselines, by 0.9--1.1 and 1.3--1.5 points respectively, with less than half the trainable parameters of an 8-expert MoE-LoRA. Its router scores also track the measured usefulness of experts far more closely than token routers do.

AI.tldr: VANE将MoE-LoRA的路由从"对token打分"改为"对更新打分"：揭示专家更新的一阶有用性对token呈二次性，并通过reader–writer分解使所有N_AN_B个专家对的有用性可在共享rank-r空间中以N_A+N_B个向量计算，从而高效评分并激活top-k专家对。
AI.motivation: 现有Mixture-of-LoRA-experts方法存在两个根本缺陷：(1)几乎都把每个专家的输入侧因子与输出侧因子绑定为一对，限制了专家的组合灵活性；(2)几乎都基于token打分进行路由，即路由器在未看到专家会写出什么更新的情况下选择专家。作者认为路由器应当对"更新"（update）打分，因为一个专家对层输出的更新是否有效，取决于该更新与输出处负损失梯度的内积，而这一有用性对token是二次的，线性token路由器只能捕捉经由token均值传播的部分，基于自身激活范数排序的路由器则完全看不到输出侧因子。
AI.method: 将每个专家拆分为reader（下投影）与writer（上投影），则任意reader–writer对的有用性成为共享rank-r空间中的内积，全部N_AN_B个专家对可由N_A+N_B个向量统一评分。基于此恒等式构建VANE：(1)用低秩compass预测每个token的下降方向；(2)在不构造任何实际update的情况下，通过update与compass的对齐度对所有reader–writer对打分；(3)用加性门控激活top-k专家对；(4)为每个专家对提供精确的一阶路由器梯度。
AI.result: 在单领域常识推理任务上，以及使用Llama-3.2-3B和Llama-3.1-8B的四领域多任务混合设置下，VANE在十二种PEFT与MoE-LoRA基线中取得最佳平均性能，领先幅度分别为0.9–1.1分和1.3–1.5分，且可训练参数不到8专家MoE-LoRA的一半。此外，VANE的路由器打分与专家实测有用性的吻合程度远高于token路由器。
AI.conclusion: 通过对"更新"而非"token"进行路由，并利用reader–writer分解将专家对有用性转化为共享rank-r空间中的内积，VANE以更少参数实现了更优性能，且路由器打分能更准确地追踪专家的真实有用性，验证了一阶有用性视角在MoE-LoRA路由设计中的有效性。

title: AnyJev Technical Report
comment: 22 pages, 5 figures. Early report on work in development. Code: https://github.com/nokia-applied-research/AnyJev
summary: A typed decision is a choice among a fixed set of options, returned as a probability rather than as text. Systems that need typed decisions today use models trained for that purpose. This report describes AnyJev, which reads a typed decision from one prefill of a pretrained instruction-tuned language model. The readout restricts the next-token distribution at the answer position to the option tokens. It has two defects: the model assigns higher probability to some labels whatever the input, and to some positions in the option list. AnyJev corrects both with no gradient steps and no parameter changes: it divides out a label prior estimated from unlabelled inputs, and it averages log-probabilities over the K cyclic rotations of the option list. On two 20-option tasks the rotations lower the order-flip rate from 0.33 to 0.14 and from 0.33 to 0.18, and raise accuracy on 11 of 11 models on both. Reading every rotation requires K prefills. A stopping rule selected against the full-rotation decision on unlabelled states cuts that. Selecting the threshold on one unlabelled split and bounding its disagreement on a second, it reads 10.6 rotations of 18 at a verified 0.008 bound on two of four cells; selected and bounded on one split, as our serving run did, it reads 7.3 and serves 2.2 times as many decisions per second on vLLM. The code is open source.

AI.tldr: AnyJev 通过单次 prefill 从指令微调语言模型中读取"类型化决策"（在固定选项集上返回概率），并用标签先验校正与选项列表循环旋转平均两项无梯度缺陷修正，配合停止规则减少 prefill 次数。
AI.motivation: 现有需要类型化决策的系统依赖专门训练的模型；本文希望直接从预训练指令微调语言模型的单次 prefill 中读取类型化决策，避免额外训练。但直接读取存在两个缺陷：模型对某些标签的概率偏高与输入无关，且对选项列表中某些位置有位置偏好。
AI.method: 在答案位置将下一 token 分布限制到选项 token 上作为读出。修正两个缺陷且不做梯度更新、不改参数：一是除以从无标注输入估计的标签先验；二是对选项列表的 K 个循环旋转上的对数概率取平均。为降低需 K 次 prefill 的开销，引入停止规则：在无标注状态上依据全旋转决策进行选择，通过阈值剪枝减少实际读取的旋转数。
AI.result: 在两项 20 选项任务上，旋转将顺序翻转率从 0.33 降至 0.14 和从 0.33 降至 0.18，并在全部 11 个模型上提升准确率。停止规则在四个单元中的两个上以 10.6/18 次旋转实现经验证的 0.008 分歧上界；在生产服务配置（在同一划分上选择并界定阈值）下读取 7.3 次旋转，在 vLLM 上每秒服务的决策数为 2.2 倍。
AI.conclusion: AnyJev 表明无需训练或参数修改即可从单次 prefill 稳定读取类型化决策，旋转平均显著降低顺序敏感性并普遍提升准确率，停止规则可在可验证的分歧界内大幅减少 prefill 次数并提升服务吞吐。代码已开源。

title: TrueMuse: A Benchmark for Data Attribution in Text-to-Music Models
summary: Text-to-music generation models are trained on massive music collections, creating a growing need for data attribution methods that can quantify the contribution of individual training samples. However, existing attribution methods are difficult to rigorously evaluate due to the lack of reliable ground truth, making it challenging to reliably assess their actual effectiveness. To address this gap, we introduce TrueMuse, a controlled dataset and benchmark for text-to-music data attribution. TrueMuse is constructed by fine-tuning three diffusion-based text-to-music models on carefully curated attribution samples, whose known inclusion in fine-tuning provides controlled attribution targets for evaluation. The benchmark covers four attribution settings, spanning melodic structure, timbral characteristics, artist-level stylistic signatures, and genre-level shared patterns, and includes 133 attributes, 648 fine-tuned models, and 95,456 generated samples across two prompt types. Using TrueMuse, we systematically evaluate existing black-box attribution methods along four dimensions: fine-tuning improvement, prompt-type difficulty, multi-task training, and fine-tuning data size. Our results show that attribution remains challenging, with existing methods exhibiting substantial variation across evaluation settings, highlighting the need for more reliable and generalizable attribution methods for text-to-music generation. Code and Dataset will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TrueMuse——一个面向文本到音乐（text-to-music）生成模型数据归因的受控数据集与基准，通过在精心构造的归因样本上微调扩散模型，为归因方法提供可控的评估真值，并系统评测现有黑盒归因方法。
AI.motivation: 文本到音乐生成模型在大规模音乐数据集上训练，迫切需要量化单个训练样本贡献的数据归因方法。但现有归因方法缺乏可靠真值（ground truth），难以严格评估其实际有效性，导致效果无法可靠衡量。
AI.method: 构建TrueMuse：在精心筛选的归因样本上微调三个基于扩散的文本到音乐模型，利用已知的微调包含关系提供受控归因目标。基准覆盖四种归因设定——旋律结构、音色特征、艺术家级风格特征、流派级共享模式，包含133个归因属性、648个微调模型、两类提示下的95,456个生成样本。基于此从四个维度系统评估现有黑盒归因方法：微调提升程度、提示类型难度、多任务训练、微调数据规模。
AI.result: 结果表明数据归因仍具挑战性，现有方法在不同评估设定下表现出显著差异（substantial variation），说明其可靠性与泛化能力不足。
AI.conclusion: 文本到音乐生成的数据归因亟需更可靠、更可泛化的归因方法；TrueMuse为受控评估提供了标准基准。代码与数据集将在论文接收后发布。

title: Are We Recovering Mechanisms? Objective-Level Recovery Gaps in Mechanistic Interpretability
summary: Mechanistic interpretability aims to recover the internal computations responsible for model behavior. Progress in automated circuit discovery is often framed as a search problem: better attribution or optimization should identify better mechanisms. This assumes that the evaluation objective can recognize a better circuit once it is found. We show that intervention-defined faithfulness can instead prefer an equally sized circuit that reproduces the model's behavior less well, creating an objective-level recovery gap. Across four human-reference tasks and InterpBench, we compare validation faithfulness with behavior on held-out prompts under fixed ordinary resampling. The behavioral criterion is agreement with the intact model, including its mistakes, except on Greater-Than, where we use semantic accuracy. Controlled reference edits reveal misranking without any discovery algorithm, and outputs of EAP, EAP-IG, ACDC, and Edge-SP exhibit the same failure. Under resampling, KL misranks 9.4%-41.2% of candidate pairs across these methods on the human-reference tasks. We investigate context distortion as an explanation: replacing excluded signals changes the inputs on which retained components operate. Restoring selected signals from the recipient's intact-model execution repairs 96 of 100 persistent KL misrankings from the discovery pool on both validation and held-out prompts. The circuits and their original behavioral scores remain unchanged. These findings show why better discovery alone is insufficient when its objective rewards the wrong candidate.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示了机制可解释性中"干预定义的忠实度"评价指标存在目标层面的恢复缺口：它可能偏好一个与模型行为复现更差的同规模电路。作者在四个人类参考任务与InterpBench上，用固定普通重采样比较验证忠实度与留出提示上的行为表现；受控参考编辑和EAP、EAP-IG、ACDC、Edge-SP的输出均出现相同误排序，KL在人类参考任务上误排序9.4%–41.2%的候选对。作者以"上下文失真"解释该现象，恢复被排除信号后修复了100个持续误排序中的96个。
AI.motivation: 机制可解释性旨在恢复模型行为背后的内部计算。自动电路发现的进展常被建模为搜索问题，即更好的归因或优化能识别更好的机制。但这隐含一个假设：评价目标一旦找到更好的电路就能识别它。作者要检验这一假设——若评价客观本身有偏差，仅改进发现算法就不足以恢复真实机制。
AI.method: 在四个人类参考任务与InterpBench上，于固定普通重采样下比较验证忠实度与留出提示上的行为表现，行为标准为与完整模型（含其错误）的一致性，Greater-Than上使用语义准确率；通过受控参考编辑检验误排序；考察EAP、EAP-IG、ACDC、Edge-SP的输出；并以"上下文失真"（替换被排除信号改变了保留组件所操作的输入）为解释，尝试从接收方完整模型执行中恢复所选信号以修复KL误排序。
AI.result: 干预定义的忠实度可偏好一个同规模但行为复现更差的电路，形成目标层面的恢复缺口。受控参考编辑在无任何发现算法的情况下也显示误排序，EAP、EAP-IG、ACDC、Edge-SP均出现相同失败。在重采样下，KL在这些方法上误排序人类参考任务中9.4%–41.2%的候选对。以上下文失真为解释，恢复所选信号修复了发现池中100个持续KL误排序中的96个（验证与留出提示均如此），且电路及其原始行为分数保持不变。
AI.conclusion: 当评价目标奖励错误候选时，仅靠更好的发现算法是不充分的；忠实度指标本身可能误导机制恢复，需修正评价目标（如处理上下文失真）才能真正找到更好机制。
